app.post("/api/firebase/hosting/build", async (_req, res) => {
  const buildResult = await execShellCommand("npx vite build", 90000);
  const state = inspectFirebaseWorkspaceState();
  return res.json({
    success: buildResult.code === 0 && state.distBundle.ready,
    command: "vite build",
    exitCode: buildResult.code,
    output: [buildResult.stdout, buildResult.stderr].filter(Boolean).join("\n"),
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...state,
  });
});

app.post("/api/firebase/hosting/deploy", async (req, res) => {
  const target = req.body?.target || "hosting";
  const customToken = (req.body?.firebaseToken || process.env.FIREBASE_TOKEN || "").trim();
  const projectId = "token-world-exchange-ats";

  // Ensure production dist bundle is built before deploying hosting
  let state = inspectFirebaseWorkspaceState();
  let buildLog = "";
  if (!state.distBundle.ready && String(target).includes("hosting")) {
    const buildRes = await execShellCommand("npx vite build", 90000);
    buildLog = [buildRes.stdout, buildRes.stderr].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
    state = inspectFirebaseWorkspaceState();
  }

  const allowedTargets = ["hosting", "firestore:rules", "hosting,firestore:rules"];
  const safeTarget = allowedTargets.includes(target) ? target : "hosting";
  const tokenArg = customToken ? ` --token "${customToken.replace(/"/g, "")}"` : "";
  const deployCmd = `firebase deploy --only ${safeTarget} --project ${projectId} --non-interactive${tokenArg}`;

  const deployResult = await execShellCommand(deployCmd, 60000);
  const combinedOutput = [buildLog, deployResult.stdout, deployResult.stderr]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join("\n")
    .trim();

  const needsAuth =
    deployResult.code !== 0 &&
    (combinedOutput.includes("Failed to authenticate") ||
      combinedOutput.includes("firebase login") ||
      combinedOutput.includes("non-interactive") ||
      combinedOutput.includes("authorization"));

  return res.json({
    success: deployResult.code === 0,
    needsInteractiveAuth: needsAuth,
    projectId,
    target: safeTarget,
    command: `firebase deploy --only ${safeTarget} --project ${projectId}`,
    output: combinedOutput,
    hostingUrls: state.hostingUrls,
    consoleUrl: state.consoleUrl,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...state,
  });
});

// ============================================================================
// HASHLIPS ART ENGINE 2.0 ORCHESTRATION API (/api/generate)
// ============================================================================
app.post("/api/generate", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    // Enforce RBAC / API Key validation when x-twe-api-key header is supplied
    const providedApiKey = req.headers["x-twe-api-key"] as string | undefined;
    const validKeys = new Set([
      activeTweKeyRegistry.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET,
      activeTweKeyRegistry.VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY,
      activeTweKeyRegistry.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY,
      process.env.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET || "",
      process.env.VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY || "",
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY || "",
      "twe_live_pk_9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c_2026",
      "twe_live_sk_admin_9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c_2026",
      "TWE-INSTITUTIONAL-DEV-KEY-2026",
    ]);
    if (providedApiKey !== undefined && !validKeys.has(providedApiKey)) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: "Unauthorized access" });
    }

    const {
      editionSize,
      editionCount,
      startTokenIdUint256,
      collectionName,
      baseUri,
      baseTokenURI,
      tokenSymbol,
      symbol,
      executeAllTokens,
      tokens,
    } = req.body || {};

    // Dynamic import of engine/generator.js so it runs the real ArtEngine 2.0 pipeline
    const { runArtEngine } = await import("./engine/generator.js");

    const countToRun = Math.min(Math.max(Number(editionSize || editionCount) || 50, 1), 500);
    const activeSymbol = String(tokenSymbol || symbol || "TWE").toUpperCase();
    const resolvedBaseUri = String(baseUri || baseTokenURI || "ipfs://QmDefaultHash/");
    const resolvedCollectionName = String(
      collectionName || `${activeSymbol} TWE Security Tier`
    );
    const startUint256 = String(startTokenIdUint256 || "1");

    if (executeAllTokens) {
      const targetSymbols: Array<{ symbol: string; name: string }> = Array.isArray(tokens) && tokens.length > 0
        ? tokens
        : [
            { symbol: "TWE", name: "Token World Exchange ATS" },
            { symbol: "TW-EQ", name: "Token World Genesis Equity" },
            { symbol: "TREE3", name: "Tree 3 Institutional Token" },
            { symbol: "TW-TBILL", name: "TWE US Treasury Bill Vault" },
            { symbol: "TW-REIT", name: "TWE Commercial Real Estate REIT" },
            { symbol: "TW-GOLD", name: "TWE Sovereign Gold Bullion" },
            { symbol: "TW-CARBON", name: "TWE Verified Carbon Credit" },
            { symbol: "TW-DEMO", name: "TWE Compliance Sandbox Token" },
          ];

      const batchResults = [];
      for (const tk of targetSymbols) {
        const sym = String(tk.symbol || "TWE").toUpperCase();
        const colName = collectionName
          ? `${collectionName} (${sym})`
          : `${tk.name || sym} Security Tier`;
        const tkBaseUri = resolvedBaseUri.endsWith("/")
          ? `${resolvedBaseUri}${sym.toLowerCase()}/`
          : `${resolvedBaseUri}/${sym.toLowerCase()}/`;

        const resItem = await runArtEngine({
          itemCount: countToRun,
          startTokenIdUint256: startUint256,
          layersDir: "./layers",
          outputDir: `./dist/twe_assets/${sym.toLowerCase()}`,
          collectionName: colName,
          baseUri: tkBaseUri,
          tokenSymbol: sym,
        });
        batchResults.push(resItem);
      }

      const primaryResult =
        batchResults.find((r) => r.tokenSymbol === activeSymbol) || batchResults[0];

      return res.status(200).json({
        status: "COMPLETED",
        executionMs: batchResults.reduce(
          (acc, item) => acc + (item.performance?.elapsedMs || 10),
          0
        ),
        data: {
          ...primaryResult,
          batchMode: "ALL_TWE_TOKENS",
          tokensProcessed: batchResults.length,
          totalAssetsAcrossTokens: batchResults.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.count, 0),
          tokenResults: batchResults,
        },
      });
    }

    const result = await runArtEngine({
      itemCount: countToRun,
      startTokenIdUint256: startUint256,
      layersDir: "./layers",
      outputDir: `./dist/twe_assets/${activeSymbol.toLowerCase()}`,
      collectionName: resolvedCollectionName,
      baseUri: resolvedBaseUri,
      tokenSymbol: activeSymbol,
    });

    return res.status(200).json({
      status: "COMPLETED",
      executionMs: result.performance?.elapsedMs || 14,
      data: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("[ArtEngine Error]:", error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      error: "Generation pipeline failed",
      details: error?.message || "Unknown engine error",
    });
  }
});

      tokenSymbol = "TWE",

      "./engine/generator.js"

      tokenIdUint256: String(sampleUint256TokenId),
      tokenSymbol: String(tokenSymbol).toUpperCase(),

app.get("/api/twe/download-complete-archive", (req, res) => {
  try {
    res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
    res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
    const format = String(req.query.format || "zip").toLowerCase();
    const rootDir = process.cwd();
    const collectedFiles: Record<string, string> = {};
    const skipDirs = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".git", ".aistudio"]);
    const allowedExts = new Set([
      ".ts",
      ".tsx",
      ".css",
      ".json",
      ".sol",
      ".html",
      ".rules",
      ".md",
      ".example",
    ]);

    function walkDir(currentPath: string, relPrefix: string) {
      const entries = fs.readdirSync(currentPath, { withFileTypes: true });
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (skipDirs.has(entry.name)) continue;
        const absPath = path.join(currentPath, entry.name);
        const relPath = relPrefix ? `${relPrefix}/${entry.name}` : entry.name;
        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
          walkDir(absPath, relPath);
        } else if (entry.isFile()) {
          const ext = path.extname(entry.name).toLowerCase();
          if (
            allowedExts.has(ext) ||
            entry.name === "firestore.rules" ||
            entry.name === ".env.example"
          ) {
            try {
              const stat = fs.statSync(absPath);
              if (stat.size <= 512 * 1024) {
                collectedFiles[relPath] = fs.readFileSync(absPath, "utf-8");
              }
            } catch {
              // Skip unreadable file
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    walkDir(rootDir, "");

    const variablesAndIntegrations = {
      applicationName: "Token World Exchange ATS® (TWE)",
      soleCreatorAndOwner: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III (Mauro Dar)",

        id: "af230af8-bf63-4308-968a-9962ed14e565",

        quantityHexUint256:
          "0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff",
      },

    };

    if (format === "zip" || format === "all") {
      // Build a standard uncompressed PKZIP buffer on the fly
      const zipFiles: Array<{ path: string; data: Buffer }> = [];
      zipFiles.push({
        path: "TWE_VARIABLES_AND_INTEGRATIONS.json",
        data: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(variablesAndIntegrations, null, 2), "utf-8"),
      });
      for (const [filePath, content] of Object.entries(collectedFiles)) {
        zipFiles.push({
          path: filePath,
          data: Buffer.from(content, "utf-8"),
        });
      }

      const computeCrc32Buf = (buf: Buffer): number => {
        let crc = 0xffffffff;
        for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
          crc ^= buf[i];
          for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            crc = (crc >>> 1) ^ (crc & 1 ? 0xedb88320 : 0);
          }
        }
        return (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
      };

      const localChunks: Buffer[] = [];
      const centralChunks: Buffer[] = [];
      let offset = 0;

      for (const f of zipFiles) {
        const nameBuf = Buffer.from(f.path, "utf-8");
        const dataBuf = f.data;
        const crc = computeCrc32Buf(dataBuf);
        const size = dataBuf.length;

        const localHeader = Buffer.alloc(30 + nameBuf.length);
        localHeader.writeUInt32LE(0x04034b50, 0);
        localHeader.writeUInt16LE(20, 4);
        localHeader.writeUInt16LE(0x0800, 6);
        localHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 8);
        localHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 10);
        localHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 12);
        localHeader.writeUInt32LE(crc, 14);
        localHeader.writeUInt32LE(size, 18);
        localHeader.writeUInt32LE(size, 22);
        localHeader.writeUInt16LE(nameBuf.length, 26);
        localHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 28);
        nameBuf.copy(localHeader, 30);

        localChunks.push(localHeader, dataBuf);

        const centralHeader = Buffer.alloc(46 + nameBuf.length);
        centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(0x02014b50, 0);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(20, 4);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(20, 6);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0x0800, 8);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 10);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 12);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 14);
        centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(crc, 16);
        centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(size, 20);
        centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(size, 24);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(nameBuf.length, 28);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 30);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 32);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 34);
        centralHeader.writeUInt16LE(0, 36);
        centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(0, 38);
        centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(offset, 42);
        nameBuf.copy(centralHeader, 46);

        centralChunks.push(centralHeader);
        offset += localHeader.length + dataBuf.length;
      }

      const centralDirSize = centralChunks.reduce((acc, c) => acc + c.length, 0);
      const eocd = Buffer.alloc(22);
      eocd.writeUInt32LE(0x06054b50, 0);
      eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 4);
      eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 6);
      eocd.writeUInt16LE(zipFiles.length, 8);
      eocd.writeUInt16LE(zipFiles.length, 10);
      eocd.writeUInt32LE(centralDirSize, 12);
      eocd.writeUInt32LE(offset, 16);
      eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 20);

      const finalZipBuffer = Buffer.concat([...localChunks, ...centralChunks, eocd]);
      res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/zip");
      res.setHeader(
        "Content-Disposition",
        'attachment; filename="Token_World_Exchange_TWE_Complete_Fullstack_Archive.zip"'
      );
      return res.status(200).send(finalZipBuffer);
    }

    if (format === "env") {
      const envPayload = [
        "# TOKEN WORLD EXCHANGE ATS® (TWE) — MASTER ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES & INTEGRATIONS",

        'VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID="G-ZDKV0H9LXT"',
        'TWE_ADMIN_SECRET="twe_live_sk_admin_9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c_2026"',

      ].join("\n");

      const mdParts: string[] = [
        "# TOKEN WORLD EXCHANGE ATS® (TWE) — COMPLETE SOURCE CODE, VARIABLES & INTEGRATIONS",

      res.setHeader(
        "Content-Disposition",
        'attachment; filename="Token_World_Exchange_TWE_Complete_Repository.md"'
      );
      return res.status(200).send(mdParts.join("\n"));
    }

    res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8");
    res.setHeader(
      "Content-Disposition",
      'attachment; filename="Token_World_Exchange_TWE_Server_Master.json"'
    );

  } catch (error: any) {

async function setupVite() {
  app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
    console.log(`Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  });

  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
    const vite = await createViteServer({
      server: { middlewareMode: true },
      appType: "spa",
    });
    app.use(vite.middlewares);
  } else {
    const distPath = path.join(process.cwd(), "dist");
    app.use(express.static(distPath));
    app.get("*", (_req, res) => {
      res.sendFile(path.join(distPath, "index.html"));
    });
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  DEFAULT_TWE_USER,
  TWE_AUTH_EVENT,
  TWE_AUTH_STORAGE_KEY,
  TweAuthUser,
  startLogin,
  stopLoginSession,
} from "@/const";

export function useAuth() {
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return true;
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(TWE_AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      return saved === null ? true : saved === "true";
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<TweAuthUser | null>(() =>
    isAuthenticated ? DEFAULT_TWE_USER : null
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleAuthChange = (event: Event) => {
      const custom = event as CustomEvent<{ isAuthenticated: boolean }>;
      const nextAuth = Boolean(custom.detail?.isAuthenticated);
      setIsAuthenticated(nextAuth);
      setUser(nextAuth ? DEFAULT_TWE_USER : null);
    };

    window.addEventListener(TWE_AUTH_EVENT, handleAuthChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(TWE_AUTH_EVENT, handleAuthChange);
  }, []);

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    stopLoginSession();
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    setUser(null);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  const login = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    startLogin();
    setIsAuthenticated(true);
    setUser(DEFAULT_TWE_USER);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  return {
    isAuthenticated,
    loading,
    user: isAuthenticated ? user ?? DEFAULT_TWE_USER : null,
    logout,
    login,
  };
}

import { TweCompleteMasterArchiveDownloadHub } from "./components/TweCompleteMasterArchiveDownloadHub";
import { MauroSovereignWealthPossessionsHub } from "./components/MauroSovereignWealthPossessionsHub";
import { injectMauroSovereignWealthIntoTokens } from "./utils/mauroSovereignWealthPossession";
import { RsiDynamicSignalPanel } from "./components/RsiDynamicSignalPanel";
import { ManusTweWorkspaceRedesign } from "./components/ManusTweWorkspaceRedesign";
import { TWEWorkspace } from "./components/twe/TWEWorkspace";

function AppContent() {
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const { openCheckoutModal, openDiscountCenter, isDiscountCenterOpen, closeDiscountCenter } = useMembership();
  const [tweEnvConfig, setTweEnvConfig] = useState<TweEnvironmentKeyBundle>(() =>
    validateAndInitializeTweEnv()
  );
  const [showManusRedesign, setShowManusRedesign] = useState(true);
  const [showGoldGraphiteAtlas, setShowGoldGraphiteAtlas] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = subscribeToTweEnvTelemetry(() => {
      setTweEnvConfig(validateAndInitializeTweEnv({ emitTelemetry: false }));
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<NavTabId>("enterprise_showroom");
  const [tokens, setTokens] = useState<TokenRecord[]>([]);
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastGenerationTime, setLastGenerationTime] = useState<number>(Date.now());
  const [lastGeneratedCount, setLastGeneratedCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [selectedToken, setSelectedToken] = useState<TokenRecord | null>(null);
  const [aiPromptOverride, setAiPromptOverride] = useState<string>("");
  const [constantLoopActive, setConstantLoopActive] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [maxCapacity, setMaxCapacity] = useState<number>(100);
  const [vaultTokensCount, setVaultTokensCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [remixInjectedSolidity, setRemixInjectedSolidity] = useState<{ code: string; name: string } | null>(null);
  const [isValidationModalOpen, setIsValidationModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isHealthModalOpen, setIsHealthModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isMetaMaskModalOpen, setIsMetaMaskModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isMarketDeployModalOpen, setIsMarketDeployModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [marketDeployTargetIds, setMarketDeployTargetIds] = useState<string[] | undefined>(undefined);
  const [marketDeployNotice, setMarketDeployNotice] = useState<string>("");
  const [isGlobalSwapSellModalOpen, setIsGlobalSwapSellModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isProModalOpen, setIsProModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isWorldConnectivityModalOpen, setIsWorldConnectivityModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isMaoMaoModalOpen, setIsMaoMaoModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [maoMaoModalMode, setMaoMaoModalMode] = useState<"send" | "receive">("send");
  const [globalSwapSellToken, setGlobalSwapSellToken] = useState<TokenRecord | null>(null);
  const [globalSwapSellMode, setGlobalSwapSellMode] = useState<"swap" | "sell">("swap");
  const [isTokenServiceManagerOpen, setIsTokenServiceManagerOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isUniversalWalletOpen, setIsUniversalWalletOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isAuthGatewayModalOpen, setIsAuthGatewayModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isLiquidityPoolModalOpen, setIsLiquidityPoolModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isMessageCreatorModalOpen, setIsMessageCreatorModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [liquidityPoolTargetToken, setLiquidityPoolTargetToken] = useState<TokenRecord | null>(null);
  const metaMaskSync = useMetaMaskSync();

  const handleOpenLiquidityPoolInit = (token?: TokenRecord) => {
    setLiquidityPoolTargetToken(token || selectedToken || null);
    setIsLiquidityPoolModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenMaoMaoTransfer = (mode: "send" | "receive" = "send") => {
    setMaoMaoModalMode(mode);
    setIsMaoMaoModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenGlobalSwapSell = (token?: TokenRecord, mode: "swap" | "sell" = "swap") => {
    setGlobalSwapSellToken(token || null);
    setGlobalSwapSellMode(mode);
    setIsGlobalSwapSellModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenMarketDeploy = (targetIds?: string[]) => {
    setMarketDeployTargetIds(targetIds);
    setIsMarketDeployModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleMarketDeploySuccess = (updatedTokens: TokenRecord[]) => {
    setTokens(updatedTokens);
    continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(updatedTokens);
    setMarketDeployNotice(
      `Market Broadcast Live: ${updatedTokens.length} token inventions are deployed on the blockchain market! (${tweEnvConfig.keyId})`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setMarketDeployNotice(""), 5000);
  };

  const handleApplyDeployerToTokens = (updatedTokens: TokenRecord[], count: number) => {
    setTokens(updatedTokens);
    continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(updatedTokens);
    secureTokensToVault(
      updatedTokens,
      maxCapacity,
      `metamask_deployer_applied_bulk_${tweEnvConfig.keyId}_${count}`
    ).catch((err) => console.warn("Vault sync warning:", err));
  };

  const handleUpdateTokenDeployer = (tokenId: string, newDeployer: string) => {
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const next = prev.map((t) => (t.id === tokenId ? { ...t, deployerAddress: newDeployer } : t));
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(next);
      secureTokensToVault(
        next,
        maxCapacity,
        `single_token_metamask_deployer_update_${tweEnvConfig.keyId}`
      ).catch((err) => console.warn("Vault single token deployer update warning:", err));
      return next;
    });
    setSelectedToken((prev) => (prev && prev.id === tokenId ? { ...prev, deployerAddress: newDeployer } : prev));
  };

  const handleSendToRemix = (solidityCode: string, tokenName: string) => {
    setRemixInjectedSolidity({ code: solidityCode, name: tokenName });
    setActiveTab("remix");
  };

  const handleDuplicateToken = (token: TokenRecord): TokenRecord => {
    const duplicated = duplicateTokenRecord(token);
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((t) => t.id === token.id);
      let updated: TokenRecord[];
      if (idx !== -1) {
        updated = [...prev.slice(0, idx + 1), duplicated, ...prev.slice(idx + 1)];
      } else {
        updated = [duplicated, ...prev];
      }
      const capped = updated.slice(0, maxCapacity);
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(capped);
      secureTokensToVault(capped, maxCapacity, "duplicate_token")
        .catch((err) => console.warn("Vault duplicate token warning:", err));
      return capped;
    });
    return duplicated;
  };

  const handleDuplicateTokens = (tokensToDuplicate: TokenRecord[]) => {
    if (tokensToDuplicate.length === 0) return;
    const duplicates = duplicateTokenBatch(tokensToDuplicate);
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const updated = [...duplicates, ...prev];
      const capped = updated.slice(0, maxCapacity);
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(capped);
      secureTokensToVault(capped, maxCapacity, "duplicate_tokens_batch")
        .catch((err) => console.warn("Vault duplicate tokens batch warning:", err));
      return capped;
    });
  };

  const handleBatchRenameTokens = (
    tokenIds: string[],
    updater: (token: TokenRecord) => { name: string; symbol?: string }
  ) => {
    const idSet = new Set(tokenIds);
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.map((t) => {
        if (!idSet.has(t.id)) return t;
        const res = updater(t);
        return {
          ...t,
          name: res.name,
          ...(res.symbol ? { symbol: res.symbol } : {}),
        };
      });
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(updated);
      secureTokensToVault(updated, maxCapacity, "batch_rename_tokens")
        .catch((err) => console.warn("Vault batch rename warning:", err));
      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleBatchUpdateTokens = (updatedList: TokenRecord[]) => {
    const updateMap = new Map<string, TokenRecord>(updatedList.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.map((t) => updateMap.get(t.id) || t);
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(updated);
      secureTokensToVault(updated, maxCapacity, "batch_update_tokens")
        .catch((err) => console.warn("Vault batch update warning:", err));
      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleBulkDeleteTokens = async (tokenIds: string[]) => {
    if (!tokenIds || tokenIds.length === 0) return;
    const idSet = new Set(tokenIds);
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const remaining = prev.filter((t) => !idSet.has(t.id));
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(remaining);
      secureTokensToVault(remaining, maxCapacity, `bulk_delete_tokens_${tweEnvConfig.keyId}`)
        .catch((err) => console.warn("Vault bulk delete warning:", err));
      return remaining;
    });

    // Also remove from Firestore in safe 450-doc chunked batches
    try {
      await deleteTokensBatchFromFirestore(tokenIds);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Firestore bulk delete warning:", err);
    }
  };

  // Token Filter Bar state: Search query, Chain toggles, Standard type toggles
  const [filterSearch, setFilterSearch] = useState<string>("");
  const [selectedChains, setSelectedChains] = useState<Set<ChainType>>(
    () => new Set(CHAIN_OPTIONS.map((c) => c.id))
  );
  const [selectedStandards, setSelectedStandards] = useState<Set<TokenStandard>>(
    () => new Set(STANDARD_OPTIONS.map((s) => s.id))
  );

  const handleToggleChain = (chain: ChainType) => {
    setSelectedChains((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(chain)) {
        next.delete(chain);
      } else {
        next.add(chain);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSelectAllChains = () => {
    setSelectedChains(new Set(CHAIN_OPTIONS.map((c) => c.id)));
  };

  const handleSoloChain = (chain: ChainType) => {
    setSelectedChains(new Set([chain]));
  };

  const handleOnlyEVMChains = () => {
    setSelectedChains(
      new Set(["ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "polygon"] as ChainType[])
    );
  };

  const handleToggleStandard = (std: TokenStandard) => {
    setSelectedStandards((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(std)) {
        next.delete(std);
      } else {
        next.add(std);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSelectAllStandards = () => {
    setSelectedStandards(new Set(STANDARD_OPTIONS.map((s) => s.id)));
  };

  const handleSoloStandard = (std: TokenStandard) => {
    setSelectedStandards(new Set([std]));
  };

  const handleQuickStandardPreset = (category: "fungible" | "nft" | "smart") => {
    if (category === "fungible") {
      setSelectedStandards(new Set(["ERC-20", "SPL-Token"] as TokenStandard[]));
    } else if (category === "nft") {
      setSelectedStandards(new Set(["ERC-721", "ERC-1155"] as TokenStandard[]));
    } else if (category === "smart") {
      setSelectedStandards(new Set(["ERC-4337"] as TokenStandard[]));
    }
  };

  const handleResetAllFilters = () => {
    setFilterSearch("");
    setSelectedChains(new Set(CHAIN_OPTIONS.map((c) => c.id)));
    setSelectedStandards(new Set(STANDARD_OPTIONS.map((s) => s.id)));
  };

  const handleApplyFilterCombination = (combo: {
    searchQuery: string;
    chains: ChainType[];
    standards: TokenStandard[];
  }) => {
    setFilterSearch(combo.searchQuery);
    setSelectedChains(new Set(combo.chains));
    setSelectedStandards(new Set(combo.standards));
  };

  // Global Selection state for tokens and contract IDs
  const [selectedTokenIds, setSelectedTokenIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Real-time calculation of matching tokens count for the filter bar display
  const filteredTokensList = useMemo(() => {
    const q = filterSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    return tokens.filter((t) => {
      if (selectedChains.size > 0 && !selectedChains.has(t.chain)) return false;
      if (selectedStandards.size > 0 && !selectedStandards.has(t.tokenStandard)) return false;
      if (q) {
        const matches =
          t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.tokenId.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.chain.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (t.tokenStandard && t.tokenStandard.toLowerCase().includes(q));
        if (!matches) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [tokens, filterSearch, selectedChains, selectedStandards]);

  const filteredTokensCount = filteredTokensList.length;

  const handleToggleSelectAllTokens = () => {
    if (
      filteredTokensList.length > 0 &&
      filteredTokensList.every((t) => selectedTokenIds.has(t.id))
    ) {
      setSelectedTokenIds(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelectedTokenIds(new Set(filteredTokensList.map((t) => t.id)));
    }
  };

  // Initialize from Token Vault on mount: preserve whatever is in the vault across reloads and app exits
  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Immediately restore from local durable storage to prevent any blank frame
    const durableTokens = continuousVaultSaver.getDurableTokens();
    if (durableTokens && durableTokens.length > 0) {
      const migrated = durableTokens.map((t) => {
        let deployer = t.deployerAddress;
        if (t.chain === "solana") {
          deployer = SOLANA_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER;
        } else if (!t.deployerAddress || t.deployerAddress.toLowerCase() === "0x5afe48a2f594f8e619e63b09cd4d64593c1fc891") {
          deployer = FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER;
        }
        const treasury =
          t.treasuryAddress ||
          (t.chain === "base"
            ? BASE_TREASURY_ADDRESS
            : t.chain === "polygon"
            ? POLYGON_TREASURY_ADDRESS
            : t.chain === "solana"
            ? SOLANA_MULTISIG_TREASURY
            : PROTOCOL_TREASURY_ADDRESS);
        return ensureTokenHasImage({
          ...t,
          deployerAddress: deployer,
          treasuryAddress: treasury,
          isDeployed: typeof t.isDeployed === "boolean" ? t.isDeployed : true,
          launchStatus: t.launchStatus || "Deployed",
        });
      });
      const withKeys = ensureAllTokensHavePrivateKeys(migrated);
      const withMaoMao = injectMauroSovereignWealthIntoTokens(injectMaoMaoIntoTokens(withKeys));
      preloadTokenImages(withMaoMao);
      setTokens(withMaoMao.slice(0, maxCapacity));
      setLastGeneratedCount(withMaoMao.length);
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(withMaoMao);
    } else {
      // Generate initial 100 with FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER (0x70Ac9Bb89d5C3d4a47D5cd11B108Fea9ad4E94f0)
      const initial100 = generateTokenBatch(100, {
        chains: ["ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "solana", "quantum"],
        narratives: ["ai_agents", "depin", "rwa", "quantum_defi"],
        standards: ["ERC-20", "ERC-721", "ERC-1155"],
        includeVanity: true,
        vanityPercentage: 15,
        eip55Checksum: true,
        customDeployerAddress: FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER,
      });
      const withKeys = ensureAllTokensHavePrivateKeys(initial100);
      const initialWithMaoMao = injectMauroSovereignWealthIntoTokens(injectMaoMaoIntoTokens(withKeys));
      preloadTokenImages(initialWithMaoMao);
      setTokens(initialWithMaoMao);
      setLastGeneratedCount(initialWithMaoMao.length);
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(initialWithMaoMao);
      secureTokensToVault(initialWithMaoMao, maxCapacity, "initial_foundry_deployer_seed").catch(() => {});
    }

    // 2. Initialize continuous vault saver service
    continuousVaultSaver.init(
      () => tokens,
      (appended) => {
        setTokens((prev) => {
          const map = new Map<string, TokenRecord>();
          [...appended, ...prev].forEach((t) => {
            const enriched = ensureTokenHasImage(t);
            map.set(enriched.contractAddress?.toLowerCase() || enriched.id, enriched);
          });
          const listWithKeys = ensureAllTokensHavePrivateKeys(Array.from(map.values()));
          return listWithKeys.slice(0, maxCapacity);
        });
      }
    );

    // 3. Fetch from remote Firestore and merge seamlessly (whatever is in the vault stays in the vault)
    fetchTokens({ limitCount: 300 })
      .then((existingTokens) => {
        if (existingTokens && existingTokens.length > 0) {
          const enterpriseTokens = upgradeAllTokensToEnterprise(existingTokens);
          const enterpriseWithKeys = ensureAllTokensHavePrivateKeys(enterpriseTokens);
          const deployedEnterprise = enterpriseWithKeys.map((t) => ensureTokenHasImage({
            ...t,
            isDeployed: typeof t.isDeployed === "boolean" ? t.isDeployed : true,
            launchStatus: t.launchStatus || "Deployed",
          }));
          preloadTokenImages(deployedEnterprise);
          setTokens((prev) => {
            const map = new Map<string, TokenRecord>();
            deployedEnterprise.forEach((t) => map.set(t.contractAddress?.toLowerCase() || t.id, t));
            prev.forEach((t) => map.set(t.contractAddress?.toLowerCase() || t.id, t));
            const merged = Array.from(map.values()).slice(0, maxCapacity);
            continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(merged);
            return merged;
          });
          setLastGeneratedCount(enterpriseTokens.length);

          // Background sync to ensure all tokens in Firestore reflect Deployed on blockchain market
          const needStatusUpdate = existingTokens.filter((t) => !t.isDeployed || t.launchStatus !== "Deployed");
          if (needStatusUpdate.length > 0) {
            updateBatchTokenDeploymentStatus(
              needStatusUpdate.map((t) => ({
                tokenId: t.id,
                launchStatus: "Deployed",
                creationTx: t.creationTx || "0x" + t.id,
                isDeployed: true,
                contractAddress: t.contractAddress,
                deployerAddress: t.deployerAddress,
                liquidityPair: t.liquidityPair,
              }))
            ).catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.warn("Could not retrieve existing vault tokens on mount:", err);
      });

    // Real-time subscribe to vault count
    const unsubscribe = subscribeToTokens((remoteTokens) => {
      setVaultTokensCount(remoteTokens.length);
    });

    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, [maxCapacity]);

  // Explicit Trigger: Generate 100 IDs
  const handleGenerate100 = async () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    const start = performance.now();

    setTimeout(async () => {
      const new100 = generateTokenBatch(100, {
        chains: ["ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "solana", "quantum"],
        narratives: ["ai_agents", "depin", "rwa", "quantum_defi"],
        standards: ["ERC-20", "ERC-721", "ERC-1155"],
        includeVanity: true,
        vanityPercentage: 15,
        eip55Checksum: true,
        customDeployerAddress: metaMaskSync.activeDeployerAddress || FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER,
      });

      const elapsed = performance.now() - start;

      // Calculate new list, capped at maxCapacity
      setTokens((prev) => {
        const combined = [...new100, ...prev];
        const capped = combined.slice(0, maxCapacity);
        
        // Auto-secure to Firebase Token Vault
        secureTokensToVault(capped, maxCapacity, "generate_100_ids_trigger")
          .catch((err) => console.error("Auto vault save error:", err));

        return capped;
      });

      setLastGeneratedCount(100);
      setLastGenerationTime(elapsed);
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }, 50);
  };

  const handleGenerate1000More = () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    const start = performance.now();

    setTimeout(async () => {
      // Scale capacity dynamically to accommodate 1,000 more tokens
      const newCapacity = Math.max(maxCapacity, tokens.length + 1000);
      setMaxCapacity(newCapacity);

      const batch1000 = generateTokenBatch(1000, {
        macroMarketCapScale: true,
        eip55Checksum: true,
        customDeployerAddress: metaMaskSync.activeDeployerAddress || FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER,
      });
      const elapsed = performance.now() - start;

      setTokens((prev) => {
        const combined = [...batch1000, ...prev];
        const capped = combined.slice(0, newCapacity);

        secureTokensToVault(capped, newCapacity, "generate_1000_tokens_2exp8_batch")
          .catch((err) => console.error("Vault save error for 1000 batch:", err));

        return capped;
      });

      setLastGeneratedCount(1000);
      setLastGenerationTime(elapsed);
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }, 60);
  };

  const handleSyncAllToDeployer = () => {
    const evmTarget = metaMaskSync.activeDeployerAddress || FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER;
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.map((t) => {
        const treasury =
          t.chain === "base"
            ? BASE_TREASURY_ADDRESS
            : t.chain === "polygon"
            ? POLYGON_TREASURY_ADDRESS
            : t.chain === "solana"
            ? SOLANA_MULTISIG_TREASURY
            : PROTOCOL_TREASURY_ADDRESS;
        return {
          ...t,
          deployerAddress: t.chain === "solana" ? SOLANA_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER : evmTarget,
          treasuryAddress: treasury,
        };
      });
      continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(updated);
      secureTokensToVault(
        updated,
        maxCapacity,
        `sync_all_to_multi_chain_deployers_${tweEnvConfig.keyId}`
      ).catch((err) => console.warn("Vault sync warning:", err));
      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleGenerateSolanaTokens = () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    const start = performance.now();
    setTimeout(() => {
      const solanaBatch = generateTokenBatch(50, {
        chains: ["solana"],
        narratives: ["ai_agents", "depin", "rwa", "quantum_defi"],
        standards: ["SPL-Token"],
        customDeployerAddress: SOLANA_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER,
        customTreasuryAddress: SOLANA_MULTISIG_TREASURY,
      });
      const elapsed = performance.now() - start;

      setTokens((prev) => {
        const combined = [...solanaBatch, ...prev];
        const capped = combined.slice(0, maxCapacity);
        continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(capped);
        secureTokensToVault(capped, maxCapacity, "generate_solana_spl_batch")
          .catch((err) => console.warn("Vault save warning:", err));
        return capped;
      });

      setLastGeneratedCount(50);
      setLastGenerationTime(elapsed);
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }, 40);
  };

  const handleGenerateBatch = (config: GenerationConfig) => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    const start = performance.now();

    setTimeout(async () => {
      const newTokens = generateTokenBatch(config.count, config);
      const elapsed = performance.now() - start;

      setTokens((prev) => {
        const combined = [...newTokens, ...prev];
        const capped = combined.slice(0, maxCapacity);

        // Real-time persistence and snapshot in Token Vault
        secureTokensToVault(capped, maxCapacity, "batch_generator_secured")
          .catch((e) => console.warn("Async batch persistence notification:", e));

        return capped;
      });

      setLastGeneratedCount(config.count);
      setLastGenerationTime(elapsed);
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }, 40);
  };

  const handleImportTokens = async (newTokens: TokenRecord[]) => {
    setTokens((prev) => {
      const capped = [...newTokens, ...prev].slice(0, maxCapacity);
      secureTokensToVault(capped, maxCapacity, "manual_import_secured")
        .catch((e) => console.warn("Async import persistence notification:", e));
      return capped;
    });
    setActiveTab("generator");
  };

  const handleUsePromptInAI = (promptText: string) => {
    setAiPromptOverride(promptText);
    setActiveTab("ai_assistant");
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0A0C] text-[#E0E0E0] flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-[#F27D26] selection:text-black">
      {/* Navbar */}
      <Navbar
        activeTab={activeTab}
        setActiveTab={setActiveTab}
        totalTokensCount={tokens.length}
        vaultTokensCount={vaultTokensCount}
        theme={theme}
        onToggleTheme={toggleTheme}
        isMetaMaskConnected={metaMaskSync.isConnected}
        metaMaskAccount={metaMaskSync.activeDeployerAddress}
        onOpenMetaMaskSync={() => setIsMetaMaskModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenUniversalWallet={() => setIsUniversalWalletOpen(true)}
        onOpenMarketDeploy={() => handleOpenMarketDeploy()}
        onOpenGlobalSwapSell={handleOpenGlobalSwapSell}
        onOpenProModal={() => setIsProModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenWorldConnectivity={() => setIsWorldConnectivityModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenAuthGateway={() => setIsAuthGatewayModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenMembershipPortal={() => openCheckoutModal()}
        onOpenDiscountCenter={() => openDiscountCenter()}

interface AbiHistoryStackProps {
  history: ABIHistoryVersion[];
  activeVersionId: string;
  onSelectVersion: (version: ABIHistoryVersion) => void;
  onRestoreVersionToCoder: (version: ABIHistoryVersion) => void;
  onRunInTerminal: (version: ABIHistoryVersion) => void;
  onTakeSnapshot?: () => void;
  maxHistory?: number;
}

  maxHistory = 5,

    history[0]?.id || ""
  );
  const [compareVersionBId, setCompareVersionBId] = useState<string>(
    history[1]?.id || history[0]?.id || ""
  );
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  const versionA = history.find((v) => v.id === compareVersionAId) || history[0];
  const versionB =

    history[0];

        return "Minified JSON";

        return "ethers.Contract";
      case "single_line_viem":

      case "single_line_cast":
        return "Cast CLI";
      default:
        return "Web3.js";
    }
  };

  const getFormatBadgeClass = (fmt: string) => {
    switch (fmt) {
      case "single_line_json":
        return "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border-purple-500/30";
      case "single_line_human":
        return "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30";
      case "single_line_ethers":
        return "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-500/30";
      case "single_line_viem":
        return "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30";
      case "single_line_cast":
        return "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30";
      default:
        return "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border-blue-500/30";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      id="abi-history-stack-container"
      className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#22222A] rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4 shadow-lg"
    >
      {/* Header Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1F1F26]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/30 text-purple-400">
            <History className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white font-mono tracking-tight">

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { highlightAbiString } from "../utils/abiSyntaxHighlighter";
import { Copy, Check, WrapText, AlignLeft, Sparkles, Layers } from "lucide-react";

interface AbiSyntaxViewerProps {
  code: string;
  format?: string;
  title?: string;
  showLineNumbers?: boolean;
  maxHeight?: string;
  className?: string;
  allowMultiLineToggle?: boolean;
}

export const AbiSyntaxViewer: React.FC<AbiSyntaxViewerProps> = ({
  code,
  format = "single_line_json",
  title,
  showLineNumbers = true,
  maxHeight = "360px",
  className = "",
  allowMultiLineToggle = true,
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isWordWrap, setIsWordWrap] = useState(false);
  const [isFormattedMultiLine, setIsFormattedMultiLine] = useState(false);

  // Attempt to nicely format JSON if multi-line is toggled
  const displayCode = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isFormattedMultiLine) {
      return code;
    }
    // Check if code contains JSON array or object
    try {
      if (code.startsWith("const ") || code.startsWith("let ") || code.startsWith("var ")) {
        const eqIdx = code.indexOf("=");
        const semiIdx = code.lastIndexOf(";");
        if (eqIdx !== -1) {
          const varPart = code.slice(0, eqIdx + 1);
          const rawVal = semiIdx !== -1 ? code.slice(eqIdx + 1, semiIdx).trim() : code.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim();
          const parsed = JSON.parse(rawVal);
          return `${varPart} ${JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2)};`;
        }
      } else if (code.trim().startsWith("[") || code.trim().startsWith("{")) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(code.trim());
        return JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2);
      }
    } catch {
      // If parsing fails, fallback to original code
    }
    return code;
  }, [code, isFormattedMultiLine]);

  // Compute syntax highlighted HTML using Prism.js
  const { html, stats } = useMemo(() => {
    return highlightAbiString(displayCode);
  }, [displayCode]);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(displayCode);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const lineCount = useMemo(() => {
    return displayCode.split("\n").length;
  }, [displayCode]);

  return (
    <div
      className={`bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl overflow-hidden font-mono shadow-lg transition-all ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Top Bar with Format Tag, Stats, Legend, and Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-[#121216] border-b border-[#1F1F23] text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 font-bold text-[10px] border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />
            PRISM HIGHLIGHTED
          </span>

          {title && (
            <span className="text-white font-bold text-[11px] truncate max-w-[160px]">
              {title}
            </span>
          )}

          <span className="text-[#8E9299] text-[11px]">
            {displayCode.length.toLocaleString()} chars
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Syntax Legend: Distinct badges for Keys, Values, Types, Keywords */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap text-[10px]">
          <span className="text-[#8E9299] mr-0.5 hidden sm:inline">Syntax:</span>
          <span
            className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-sky-950/60 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/40 font-bold"
            title="JSON Object Keys (name, type, inputs, etc.)"
          >
            ● Key
          </span>
          <span
            className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 font-bold"
            title="Solidity EVM Types (address, uint256, bool, bytes32, etc.)"
          >
            ● Type
          </span>
          <span
            className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40 font-bold"
            title="EVM Entry Kinds & Mutability (function, event, view, nonpayable)"
          >
            ● Keyword
          </span>
          <span
            className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 font-bold"
            title="Identifiers & Values (transfer, recipient, amount)"
          >
            ● Value
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls: Multi-line Format Toggle, Wrap Toggle, Copy Button */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {allowMultiLineToggle && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsFormattedMultiLine((prev) => !prev)}
              className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                isFormattedMultiLine
                  ? "bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-300 border-purple-500/60 font-bold"
                  : "bg-[#16161A] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white border-[#27272F]"
              }`}
              title={
                isFormattedMultiLine
                  ? "Switch to compact 1-line view"
                  : "Expand to multi-line auto-indented tree view"
              }
            >
              <AlignLeft className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{isFormattedMultiLine ? "1-Line" : "Indent"}</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsWordWrap((prev) => !prev)}
            className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer border ${

            title="Copy highlighted ABI code to clipboard"

            {copied ? <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Code Display Area with Prism Highlighted HTML */}
      <div
        style={{ maxHeight }}
        className={`p-4 overflow-x-auto text-xs leading-relaxed font-mono scrollbar-thin ${
          isWordWrap ? "whitespace-pre-wrap break-all" : "whitespace-nowrap"
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex">
          {/* Line number gutter */}
          {showLineNumbers && (
            <div className="select-none pr-3 text-[#555] text-right font-mono border-r border-[#1F1F23] mr-3">
              {lineCount === 1 ? (
                <span>1:</span>
              ) : (
                Array.from({ length: lineCount }).map((_, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx}>{idx + 1}</div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Highlighted Prism Tokens */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <code
              className="prism-abi-code font-mono text-xs block"
              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Diagnostic Stats Bar */}
      <div className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-[#0e0e12] border-t border-[#1F1F23] flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span>
            Keys: <strong className="text-sky-400 font-mono">{stats.keyCount}</strong>
          </span>
          <span>
            Types: <strong className="text-emerald-400 font-mono">{stats.typeCount}</strong>
          </span>
          <span>
            Keywords: <strong className="text-purple-400 font-mono">{stats.keywordCount}</strong>
          </span>
          <span>
            Values: <strong className="text-amber-400 font-mono">{stats.valueCount}</strong>
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[#666]">Engine: Prism.js lightweight</span>

  onSelectTestedAbi?: (testedString: string) => void;
}

  generatedAbiString,
  contractName = "Contract",
  onSelectTestedAbi,
}) => {
  // Test mode state: allows simulating common structural defects or custom typing
  const [activeMode, setActiveMode] = useState<
    "generated" | "missing_comma" | "unbalanced_bracket" | "trailing_comma" | "custom"
  >("generated");
  const [customText, setCustomText] = useState<string>("");
  const [isDetailsOpen, setIsDetailsOpen] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Derive the active string being evaluated
  const currentString = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeMode === "custom") {
      return customText;
    }
    if (activeMode === "missing_comma") {
      // Intentionally simulate a missing comma between objects: replace `},{` with `}{`
      return generatedAbiString.replace(/(\})(\s*),(\s*)(\{)/, "$1$2$4");
    }
    if (activeMode === "unbalanced_bracket") {
      // Intentionally remove the last closing bracket or brace
      return generatedAbiString.endsWith("]")
        ? generatedAbiString.slice(0, -1)
        : generatedAbiString.endsWith("};")
        ? generatedAbiString.slice(0, -2) + ";"
        : generatedAbiString.slice(0, -1);
    }
    if (activeMode === "trailing_comma") {
      // Intentionally inject an illegal trailing comma before the final `]`
      return generatedAbiString.replace(/\]\s*$/, ",]");
    }
    return generatedAbiString;
  }, [activeMode, customText, generatedAbiString]);

  const validationResult: ABIValidationResult = useMemo(() => {
    return validateABIString(currentString);
  }, [currentString]);

  const { isValid, hasWarnings, status, score, bracketStats, issues, entryCount, summary } =
    validationResult;

  const handleSetMode = (
    mode: "generated" | "missing_comma" | "unbalanced_bracket" | "trailing_comma" | "custom"
  ) => {
    setActiveMode(mode);
    if (mode === "custom" && !customText) {
      setCustomText(generatedAbiString);
    }
    if (mode === "generated" && onSelectTestedAbi) {
      onSelectTestedAbi(generatedAbiString);

                : status === "warning"
                ? "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40 shadow-amber-950/40"
                : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/50 shadow-rose-950/40 animate-pulse"

    if (tokens && tokens.length > 0) {

    } else if (val >= 1e9) {

      compact = `$${(val / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`;

      avgCompact = `$${(avg / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`;

      avgCompact = `$${(avg / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`;
    } else if (avg >= 1e3) {

        label: "Market Standby",
        containerBorder: "border-slate-500/30 hover:border-slate-400/60",
        iconBg: "bg-slate-500/15",
        iconBorder: "border-slate-500/30",
        iconColor: "text-slate-400",
        textColor: "text-slate-300",
        dotColor: "bg-slate-400",
        icon: <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />,
        breakdown: {
          avgSecurityScore: 0,
          auditedPercent: 0,
          deployedPercent: 0,
          highCapPercent: 0,
        },
      };
    }

    const total = list.length;
    let totalSecScore = 0;
    let auditedCount = 0;
    let deployedCount = 0;
    let highCapCount = 0;
    let pausedCount = 0;

    for (const t of list) {
      totalSecScore += t.securityScore || 0;
      if (
        t.launchStatus === "Audited" ||
        t.launchStatus === "Rug-Proof Vault" ||
        t.launchStatus === "Liquidity Locked" ||
        Boolean(t.auditFirm)
      ) {
        auditedCount++;
      }
      if (t.isDeployed || t.launchStatus === "Deployed") {
        deployedCount++;
      }
      if (t.launchStatus === "Paused") {
        pausedCount++;
      }
      if ((t.marketCap && t.marketCap >= 1_000_000_000) || t.isEnterprise) {
        highCapCount++;
      }
    }

    const avgSecurityScore = Math.round(totalSecScore / total);
    const auditedRatio = auditedCount / total;
    const deployedRatio = deployedCount / total;
    const highCapRatio = highCapCount / total;
    const pausedRatio = pausedCount / total;

    // Security health contribution (up to 30 pts)
    const secPoints = (avgSecurityScore / 100) * 30;

    // Audit and verified contract integrity (up to 25 pts)
    const auditPoints = auditedRatio * 25;

    // Sovereign and high-cap valuation (up to 25 pts)
    const capPoints = highCapRatio * 25;

    // Live deployment and execution readiness (up to 20 pts)
    const deployPoints = deployedRatio * 20;

    // Penalty for suspended or paused contracts (up to -20 pts)
    const penalty = pausedRatio * 20;

    const rawScore = Math.round(
      Math.max(10, Math.min(99, secPoints + auditPoints + capPoints + deployPoints - penalty))
    );

    let trend: "Bull" | "Bear" | "Neutral" = "Neutral";
    let label = "Neutral Consolidation";
    let containerBorder = "border-amber-500/30 hover:border-amber-400/60";
    let iconBg = "bg-amber-500/15";
    let iconBorder = "border-amber-500/30";
    let iconColor = "text-amber-400";
    let textColor = "text-amber-300";
    let dotColor = "bg-amber-400";
    let icon = <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />;

    if (rawScore >= 65) {
      trend = "Bull";
      label = rawScore >= 80 ? "Strong Bull Run" : "Bullish Expansion";
      containerBorder = "border-emerald-500/30 hover:border-emerald-400/60";
      iconBg = "bg-emerald-500/15";
      iconBorder = "border-emerald-500/30";
      iconColor = "text-emerald-400";
      textColor = "text-emerald-300";
      dotColor = "bg-emerald-400";
      icon = <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />;
    } else if (rawScore <= 45) {
      trend = "Bear";
      label = rawScore <= 30 ? "Deep Bear Cycle" : "Bearish Retraction";
      containerBorder = "border-rose-500/30 hover:border-rose-400/60";
      iconBg = "bg-rose-500/15";
      iconBorder = "border-rose-500/30";
      iconColor = "text-rose-400";
      textColor = "text-rose-300";
      dotColor = "bg-rose-400";
      icon = <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400" />;
    }

    return {
      trend,
      score: rawScore,
      label,
      containerBorder,
      iconBg,
      iconBorder,
      iconColor,
      textColor,
      dotColor,
      icon,
      breakdown: {
        avgSecurityScore,
        auditedPercent: Math.round(auditedRatio * 100),
        deployedPercent: Math.round(deployedRatio * 100),
        highCapPercent: Math.round(highCapRatio * 100),
      },
    };
  }, [tokens]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#23232C] hover:border-[#F27D26]/40 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-lg transition-all space-y-3">
      {/* Top Header & Fast Global Actions */}
      <div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row xl:items-center justify-between gap-3.5 border-b border-[#1E1E28] pb-3">

            ⚡
          </div>
          <div>

              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">

                Sovereign Multi-Chain Authorities &amp; Treasuries
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 font-semibold">
                SYSTEM VERIFIED
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">
              Designated EVM Deployer, Solana SPL Authority, Solana Multi-Sig Treasury, Base Chain Treasury (ID: {BASE_CHAIN_ID}), Polygon Treasury (ID: {POLYGON_CHAIN_ID}), and Protocol Multi-Sig Vault.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Section: Mini-Stat Display & Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
          {/* Mini-Stat Display: Session Aggregate Market Cap */}
          <div
            id="banner-session-market-cap-stat"
            className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0E151B] border border-emerald-500/30 hover:border-emerald-400/60 shadow-sm transition-all group cursor-help select-none"
            title={`Session Aggregate Market Cap: ${formattedMarketCap.full}\nAverage per token: ${formattedMarketCap.avgCompact}\nComputed dynamically across all ${effectiveTokensCount.toLocaleString()} tokens in current session.`}
          >
            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400 shrink-0 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)]">
              <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col leading-tight">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[9px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#8E9299]">
                <span>Session Market Cap</span>
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold font-mono text-emerald-300 tracking-tight">

          {/* Mini-Stat Display: Real-Time Market Sentiment Indicator (Bull/Bear/Neutral) */}

          >

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Burnable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Pausable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract AdvancedToken is ERC20, ERC20Burnable, ERC20Pausable, Ownable {
    uint256 public constant MAX_CAPACITY = 1_000_000_000 * 10**18;

    constructor() ERC20("AdvancedToken", "ADT") Ownable(msg.sender) {
        _mint(msg.sender, 100_000_000 * 10**18); // Initial mint
    }

    // Owner can mint new tokens up to the MAX_CAPACITY
    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= MAX_CAPACITY, "Cap exceeded");
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    // Owner can pause all token transfers in emergencies
    function pause() public onlyOwner {
        _pause();
    }

    function unpause() public onlyOwner {
        _unpause();
    }

    // Required override for ERC20Pausable
    function _update(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal override(ERC20, ERC20Pausable) {
        super._update(from, to, value);
    }
}`;

interface TxReceipt {

  txHash: string;

export const AdvancedTokenGovernanceManager: React.FC = () => {
  // Operational State
  const [activeSubView, setActiveSubView] = useState<"overview" | "etherscan_write" | "source_code" | "community_trust">("overview");
  
  // Simulated On-Chain Contract State
  const [totalSupply, setTotalSupply] = useState<number>(100_000_000); // 100M initial mint (10%)
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [ownerAddress, setOwnerAddress] = useState<string>("0x94B734d83d1112D5540306F745c92c5780C29eB3"); // Deployer Hot Wallet
  const [ownershipStage, setOwnershipStage] = useState<"deployer_hot_wallet" | "safe_multisig" | "renounced_immutable">("deployer_hot_wallet");
  const [burnTotal, setBurnTotal] = useState<number>(0);
  
  // Inputs for Etherscan Write tab
  const [mintToAddress, setMintToAddress] = useState<string>("0x88880000B2B852aE60B8E29549303c74Ea533033");
  const [mintAmountInput, setMintAmountInput] = useState<string>("50000000"); // 50M
  const [burnAmountInput, setBurnAmountInput] = useState<string>("5000000"); // 5M
  const [transferOwnerInput, setTransferOwnerInput] = useState<string>("0x5AFE000098f98c92842cD7499808a3B58d844521"); // Safe Address
  const [isRenounceModalOpen, setIsRenounceModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Execution History / Transactions Log
  const [txLog, setTxLog] = useState<TxReceipt[]>([
    {
      id: "tx-genesis",
      txHash: "0x7c9f8a3d4e2b104958302f1a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c",
      method: "constructor() -> Initial Mint 100M ADT (10%)",
      sender: "0x94B734d83d1112D5540306F745c92c5780C29eB3",
      gasUsed: 1_284_520,
      blockNumber: 21854910,
      timestamp: "Just now",
      status: "SUCCESS",
    },
  ]);

  const MAX_CAPACITY = 1_000_000_000; // 1 Billion tokens
  const remainingMintHeadroom = Math.max(0, MAX_CAPACITY - totalSupply);
  const capacityPercent = ((totalSupply / MAX_CAPACITY) * 100).toFixed(1);

  // Helper to append receipt
  const recordTx = (method: string, gas: number, status: "SUCCESS" | "REVERTED", reason?: string) => {
    const receipt: TxReceipt = {
      id: `tx-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      txHash: `0x${Array.from({ length: 64 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 16).toString(16)).join("")}`,
      method,
      sender: ownershipStage === "renounced_immutable" ? "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" : ownerAddress,
      gasUsed: gas,
      blockNumber: 21854911 + txLog.length,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
      status,
      reason,
    };
    setTxLog((prev) => [receipt, ...prev]);
  };

  // Etherscan Write Function: mint
  const handleExecuteMint = () => {
    if (ownershipStage === "renounced_immutable") {
      recordTx(`mint(${mintToAddress.slice(0, 8)}..., ${mintAmountInput})`, 23000, "REVERTED", "OwnableUnauthorizedAccount: Ownership is renounced");
      return;
    }
    if (isPaused) {
      recordTx(`mint(${mintToAddress.slice(0, 8)}..., ${mintAmountInput})`, 25400, "REVERTED", "EnforcedPause: Token transfers/minting paused by circuit breaker");
      return;
    }
    const amt = parseFloat(mintAmountInput) || 0;
    if (amt <= 0) return;
    if (totalSupply + amt > MAX_CAPACITY) {
      recordTx(`mint(${mintToAddress.slice(0, 8)}..., ${mintAmountInput})`, 28100, "REVERTED", "Cap exceeded: Exceeds MAX_CAPACITY (1,000,000,000 ADT)");
      return;
    }

    setTotalSupply((prev) => prev + amt);
    recordTx(`mint(${mintToAddress.slice(0, 8)}..., ${amt.toLocaleString()} ADT)`, 68400, "SUCCESS");
  };

  // Etherscan Write Function: pause / unpause
  const handleTogglePause = () => {
    if (ownershipStage === "renounced_immutable") {
      recordTx(isPaused ? "unpause()" : "pause()", 21500, "REVERTED", "OwnableUnauthorizedAccount: Ownership is permanently renounced");
      return;
    }
    if (isPaused) {
      setIsPaused(false);
      recordTx("unpause() -> Circuit Breaker Deactivated", 32100, "SUCCESS");
    } else {
      setIsPaused(true);
      recordTx("pause() -> Emergency Circuit Breaker Activated", 34200, "SUCCESS");
    }
  };

  // Etherscan Write Function: burn
  const handleExecuteBurn = () => {
    if (isPaused) {
      recordTx(`burn(${burnAmountInput})`, 24000, "REVERTED", "EnforcedPause: Burning halted by active circuit breaker");
      return;
    }
    const amt = parseFloat(burnAmountInput) || 0;
    if (amt <= 0 || amt > totalSupply) return;
    setTotalSupply((prev) => prev - amt);
    setBurnTotal((prev) => prev + amt);
    recordTx(`burn(${amt.toLocaleString()} ADT) -> Deflationary Supply Reduction`, 39800, "SUCCESS");
  };

    if (!transferOwnerInput.startsWith("0x") || transferOwnerInput.length !== 42) {

    }
    setOwnerAddress(transferOwnerInput);
    setOwnershipStage("safe_multisig");
    recordTx(`transferOwnership(${transferOwnerInput}) -> Upgraded to Gnosis Safe Multi-Sig`, 48200, "SUCCESS");
  };

    setOwnerAddress("0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000");
    setOwnershipStage("renounced_immutable");
