  LiveOrderBookDepth,
  FeedConnectionStatus,
  LiveTrade,
} from "../services/liveMarketFeedService";
import {
  globalAtsEngine,
  ExtendedAtsOrder,
  OrderExecutionType,
  OcoEventLog,
} from "../utils/atsMatchingEngine";
import { AtsTradeExecution, OWNER_PROFILE } from "../utils/atsVenueData";
import { RecentTrades } from "./RecentTrades";

interface AdvancedTradingTerminalProps {
  tokens?: TokenRecord[];
  selectedToken?: TokenRecord | null;
  onSelectToken?: (token: TokenRecord) => void;
  metaMaskAccount?: string | null;
  isMetaMaskConnected?: boolean;
  onOpenMetaMaskSync?: () => void;
}

export const AdvancedTradingTerminal: React.FC<AdvancedTradingTerminalProps> = ({
  tokens = [],
  selectedToken,
  onSelectToken,
  metaMaskAccount,
  isMetaMaskConnected,
  onOpenMetaMaskSync,
}) => {
  // Active pair selection
  const [activeSymbol, setActiveSymbol] = useState<string>("TREE3/USDT");

  // Live feed states
  const [tickers, setTickers] = useState<Record<string, MarketTicker>>(() =>
    liveMarketFeedService.getAllTickers()
  );
  const [feedStatus, setFeedStatus] = useState<FeedConnectionStatus>("CONNECTING");
  const [pingMs, setPingMs] = useState<number>(24);

  // Order Book depth
  const [depth, setDepth] = useState<LiveOrderBookDepth>(() =>
    liveMarketFeedService.generateOrderBookDepth(activeSymbol, 12)
  );

  // Order Entry Form
  const [orderType, setOrderType] = useState<OrderExecutionType>("OCO");
  const [orderSide, setOrderSide] = useState<"BUY" | "SELL">("SELL");
  const [priceInput, setPriceInput] = useState<string>("137.50");
  const [quantityInput, setQuantityInput] = useState<string>("100");
  const [stopPriceInput, setStopPriceInput] = useState<string>("118.75");
  const [limitPriceInput, setLimitPriceInput] = useState<string>("118.00");

  // Active bottom manager view
  const [bottomTab, setBottomTab] = useState<"orders" | "oco_simulator" | "oco_audit" | "recent_trades">("orders");

  // Pre-trade risk status / notifications
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<{
    type: "success" | "warning" | "error";
    text: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Active open and trigger orders & OCO history
  const [openOrders, setOpenOrders] = useState<ExtendedAtsOrder[]>([]);
  const [triggerOrders, setTriggerOrders] = useState<ExtendedAtsOrder[]>([]);
  const [recentTrades, setRecentTrades] = useState<AtsTradeExecution[]>([]);
  const [ocoEvents, setOcoEvents] = useState<OcoEventLog[]>([]);

  const traderAddress = metaMaskAccount || "0x70AcE3628eD48bfa63aA4F447817DCEc9f323cAC";

  const refreshEngineState = useCallback(() => {
    const baseSym = activeSymbol.split("/")[0];
    const book = globalAtsEngine.getBook(baseSym);
    const userBids = book.bids.filter(
      (b) => b.traderAddress.toLowerCase() === traderAddress.toLowerCase()
    ) as ExtendedAtsOrder[];
    const userAsks = book.asks.filter(
      (a) => a.traderAddress.toLowerCase() === traderAddress.toLowerCase()
    ) as ExtendedAtsOrder[];
    setOpenOrders([...userBids, ...userAsks]);
    setTriggerOrders(globalAtsEngine.getTriggerOrders(baseSym, traderAddress));
    setRecentTrades(book.trades.slice(0, 15));
    setOcoEvents(globalAtsEngine.getOcoEvents(30));
  }, [activeSymbol, traderAddress]);

  // Subscribe to live feed & evaluate triggers
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubTickers = liveMarketFeedService.subscribeTickers((newTickers) => {
      setTickers(newTickers);
      const curr = newTickers[activeSymbol];
      if (curr) {
        // Trigger Stop-Loss and OCO orders waiting for this market price
        const trigResult = globalAtsEngine.checkStopLossAndOcoTriggers(
          activeSymbol.split("/")[0],
          curr.price
        );
        if (
          trigResult.triggeredOrders.length > 0 ||
          trigResult.cancelledOcoOrders.length > 0 ||
          trigResult.executedTrades.length > 0
        ) {
          refreshEngineState();
          // Ingest ATS executed trades to the live RecentTrades feed
          if (trigResult.executedTrades.length > 0) {
            trigResult.executedTrades.forEach((trd) => {
              liveMarketFeedService.addExecutedTrade({
                id: `twe-trig-${trd.id}`,
                symbol: activeSymbol,
                price: trd.price,
                quantity: trd.quantity,
                totalUsd: trd.totalUsd,
                side: "SELL",
                timestamp: trd.timestamp,
                source: "TWE_ATS_MATCH",
                isWhale: trd.totalUsd >= 10000,
              });
            });
          }
          if (trigResult.cancelledOcoOrders.length > 0) {
            setNotification({
              type: "warning",
              text: `⚡ OCO Automated Cancellation: Stop-Loss triggered at $${curr.price.toFixed(
                2
              )}. Linked Limit Order (${trigResult.cancelledOcoOrders.join(", ")}) was automatically cancelled!`,
            });
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const unsubStatus = liveMarketFeedService.subscribeStatus((status, ping) => {
      setFeedStatus(status);
      setPingMs(ping);
    });

    return () => {
      unsubTickers();
      unsubStatus();
    };
  }, [activeSymbol, refreshEngineState]);

  // Update order book depth regularly
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setDepth(liveMarketFeedService.generateOrderBookDepth(activeSymbol, 12));
    }, 1200);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [activeSymbol]);

  // Sync inputs on pair or side change
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = tickers[activeSymbol];
    if (t) {
      if (orderSide === "SELL") {
        setPriceInput((t.price * 1.1).toFixed(2));
        setStopPriceInput((t.price * 0.95).toFixed(2));
        setLimitPriceInput((t.price * 0.945).toFixed(2));
      } else {
        setPriceInput((t.price * 0.95).toFixed(2));
        setStopPriceInput((t.price * 1.05).toFixed(2));
        setLimitPriceInput((t.price * 1.055).toFixed(2));
      }
    }
    refreshEngineState();
  }, [activeSymbol, orderSide, refreshEngineState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshEngineState();
  }, [refreshEngineState]);

  const currentTicker = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      tickers[activeSymbol] || {
        symbol: activeSymbol,
        baseAsset: activeSymbol.split("/")[0],
        quoteAsset: activeSymbol.split("/")[1] || "USDT",
        name: activeSymbol,
        price: 125.0,
        change24h: 3.2,
        high24h: 128.5,
        low24h: 121.0,
        volume24h: 88500000,
        bidPrice: 124.8,
        askPrice: 125.2,
        source: "TWE_TREASURY_ORACLE" as const,
        lastUpdated: Date.now(),
      }
    );
  }, [tickers, activeSymbol]);

  const calculatedTotal = useMemo(() => {
    const p = parseFloat(priceInput) || 0;
    const q = parseFloat(quantityInput) || 0;
    return (p * q).toFixed(2);
  }, [priceInput, quantityInput]);

  // Identify all active linked OCO pairs in book
  const activeOcoPairs = useMemo(() => {
    const pairs: Array<{
      limitOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder;
      stopOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder;
    }> = [];

    openOrders.forEach((ord) => {
      if (ord.ocoPairId) {
        const matchingStop = triggerOrders.find((t) => t.id === ord.ocoPairId);
        if (matchingStop) {
          pairs.push({ limitOrder: ord, stopOrder: matchingStop });
        }
      }
    });

    return pairs;
  }, [openOrders, triggerOrders]);

  // Quick preset helper for OCO brackets
  const handleApplyOcoPreset = (tpPercent: number, slPercent: number) => {
    const cur = currentTicker.price;
    if (orderSide === "SELL") {
      const tp = cur * (1 + tpPercent / 100);
      const sl = cur * (1 - Math.abs(slPercent) / 100);
      const slExec = sl * 0.995;
      setPriceInput(tp.toFixed(2));
      setStopPriceInput(sl.toFixed(2));
      setLimitPriceInput(slExec.toFixed(2));
    } else {
      const tp = cur * (1 - Math.abs(tpPercent) / 100);
      const sl = cur * (1 + slPercent / 100);
      const slExec = sl * 1.005;
      setPriceInput(tp.toFixed(2));
      setStopPriceInput(sl.toFixed(2));
      setLimitPriceInput(slExec.toFixed(2));
    }
  };

  // Pre-trade risk validation: SEC Rule 15c3-5 collar ±10% + OCO Geometry
  const validatePreTradeRisk = (): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } => {
    const refPrice = currentTicker.price;
    const p = parseFloat(priceInput);
    const q = parseFloat(quantityInput);

    if (isNaN(q) || q <= 0) return { valid: false, reason: "Quantity must be greater than zero." };

    if (orderType === "LIMIT") {
      if (isNaN(p) || p <= 0) return { valid: false, reason: "Limit price must be greater than zero." };
      const collarMin = refPrice * 0.85;
      const collarMax = refPrice * 1.15;
      if (p < collarMin || p > collarMax) {
        return {
          valid: false,
          reason: `SEC Rule 15c3-5 Pre-Trade Collar: Price ($${p.toFixed(2)}) exceeds ±15% band ($${collarMin.toFixed(2)} - $${collarMax.toFixed(2)}).`,
        };
      }
    }

    if (orderType === "STOP_LOSS" || orderType === "STOP_LIMIT") {
      const sp = parseFloat(stopPriceInput);
      if (isNaN(sp) || sp <= 0) return { valid: false, reason: "Stop trigger price must be greater than zero." };
    }

    if (orderType === "OCO") {
      const sp = parseFloat(stopPriceInput);
      const lp = parseFloat(limitPriceInput);

      if (isNaN(p) || p <= 0) return { valid: false, reason: "Take-Profit Limit price must be greater than zero." };
      if (isNaN(sp) || sp <= 0) return { valid: false, reason: "Stop trigger price must be greater than zero." };
      if (isNaN(lp) || lp <= 0) return { valid: false, reason: "Stop execution limit price must be greater than zero." };

      if (orderSide === "SELL") {
        if (sp >= p) {
          return {
            valid: false,
            reason: `OCO SELL Geometry Error: Take-Profit Limit ($${p.toFixed(2)}) must be higher than Stop Trigger ($${sp.toFixed(2)}).`,
          };
        }
      } else {
        if (sp <= p) {
          return {
            valid: false,
            reason: `OCO BUY Geometry Error: Breakout Stop Trigger ($${sp.toFixed(2)}) must be higher than Dip Limit ($${p.toFixed(2)}).`,
          };
        }
      }
    }

    return { valid: true };
  };

  const handlePlaceOrder = () => {
    const check = validatePreTradeRisk();
    if (!check.valid) {
      setNotification({ type: "error", text: check.reason! });
      setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 6000);
      return;
    }

    const baseSym = activeSymbol.split("/")[0];
    const p = parseFloat(priceInput);
    const q = parseFloat(quantityInput);
    const sp = parseFloat(stopPriceInput);
    const lp = parseFloat(limitPriceInput);

    const result = globalAtsEngine.addExtendedOrder({
      traderAddress,
      side: orderSide,
      price: orderType === "MARKET" ? currentTicker.price : p,
      quantity: q,
      symbol: baseSym,
      orderType,
      stopPrice: sp,
      limitPrice: lp,
    });

    refreshEngineState();
    if (result.matchedTrades.length > 0) {
      result.matchedTrades.forEach((trd) => {
        liveMarketFeedService.addExecutedTrade({
          id: `twe-match-${trd.id}`,
          symbol: activeSymbol,
          price: trd.price,
          quantity: trd.quantity,
          totalUsd: trd.totalUsd,
          side: orderSide,
          timestamp: trd.timestamp,
          source: "TWE_ATS_MATCH",
          isWhale: trd.totalUsd >= 10000,
        });
      });
    }
    setNotification({
      type: "success",
      text: `${result.message}. ${
        result.matchedTrades.length > 0
          ? `Matched ${result.matchedTrades.length} trade(s) with T+0 settlement!`
          : "Placed on order book and trigger registry."
      }`,
    });
    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 6500);
  };

  const handleCancelOrder = (orderId: string, isOco: boolean = false) => {
    const baseSym = activeSymbol.split("/")[0];
    const success = globalAtsEngine.cancelOrder(orderId, baseSym, true);
    if (success) {
      refreshEngineState();
      setNotification({
        type: "warning",
        text: isOco
          ? `OCO Bracket cancelled: Order ${orderId} and its paired leg were both cancelled.`
          : `Order ${orderId} successfully cancelled.`,
      });
      setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 5000);
    }
  };

  const handleFillPriceFromBook = (price: number) => {
    setPriceInput(price.toFixed(2));
  };

  // OCO Simulation Handlers (Live demonstration of mutual cancellation)
  const handleSimulateTakeProfitHit = (pair: {
    limitOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder;
    stopOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder;
  }) => {
    const targetPrice = pair.limitOrder.price;
    liveMarketFeedService.setTickerPrice(activeSymbol, targetPrice);

    // Let the matching engine match the resting limit order and execute OCO mutual cancellation
    const baseSym = activeSymbol.split("/")[0];
    globalAtsEngine.matchOrders(baseSym);
    globalAtsEngine.checkStopLossAndOcoTriggers(baseSym, targetPrice);

    refreshEngineState();
    setNotification({
      type: "success",
      text: `🎯 OCO Take-Profit Executed at $${targetPrice.toFixed(
        2
      )}! Paired Stop-Loss #${pair.stopOrder.id} was automatically cancelled.`,
    });
    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 7000);
  };

  const handleSimulateStopLossHit = (pair: {
    limitOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder;
    stopOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder;
  }) => {
    const targetPrice = pair.stopOrder.stopPrice || pair.stopOrder.price;
    liveMarketFeedService.setTickerPrice(activeSymbol, targetPrice);

    // Trigger stop-loss evaluation and verify limit leg cancellation
    const baseSym = activeSymbol.split("/")[0];
    const trigResult = globalAtsEngine.checkStopLossAndOcoTriggers(baseSym, targetPrice);

    refreshEngineState();
    setNotification({
      type: "warning",
      text: `⚡ OCO Stop-Loss Triggered at $${targetPrice.toFixed(
        2
      )}! Paired Take-Profit Limit #${pair.limitOrder.id} was automatically cancelled.`,
    });
    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 7000);
  };

  const handleDeployDemoOcoBracket = () => {
    const baseSym = activeSymbol.split("/")[0];
    const cur = currentTicker.price;
    const isSell = orderSide === "SELL";

    const tpPrice = isSell ? Number((cur * 1.08).toFixed(2)) : Number((cur * 0.92).toFixed(2));
    const slPrice = isSell ? Number((cur * 0.94).toFixed(2)) : Number((cur * 1.06).toFixed(2));
    const slExecPrice = isSell ? Number((cur * 0.935).toFixed(2)) : Number((cur * 1.065).toFixed(2));

    const result = globalAtsEngine.addExtendedOrder({
      traderAddress,
      side: orderSide,
      price: tpPrice,
      quantity: 100,
      symbol: baseSym,
      orderType: "OCO",
      stopPrice: slPrice,
      limitPrice: slExecPrice,
    });

    refreshEngineState();
    setBottomTab("oco_simulator");
    setNotification({
      type: "success",
      text: `⚡ Demo OCO bracket created! TP at $${tpPrice} & Stop at $${slPrice}. Click either simulation button below to watch the other leg get cancelled!`,
    });
    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 8000);
  };

  const handleResetReferencePrice = () => {
    const defaultPrice =
      activeSymbol === "TREE3/USDT"
        ? 125.0
        : activeSymbol === "TW-EQ/USD"
        ? 52.5
        : activeSymbol === "BTC/USDT"
        ? 64500.0
        : 2650.0;
    liveMarketFeedService.setTickerPrice(activeSymbol, defaultPrice);
    refreshEngineState();
    setNotification({
      type: "success",
      text: `Reference price reset to $${defaultPrice.toFixed(2)}.`,
    });
    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 3000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans pb-16">
      {/* Top Ticker & Reality Stream Bar */}
      <div className="border-b border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          {/* Pair Selector & Title */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="relative">
              <select
                aria-label="Select trading pair"
                value={activeSymbol}
                onChange={(e) => setActiveSymbol(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-white font-mono font-bold text-base rounded px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="TREE3/USDT">TREE3/USDT · Sovereign Token</option>
                <option value="TW-EQ/USD">TW-EQ/USD · Treasury Equity</option>
                <option value="BTC/USDT">BTC/USDT · Bitcoin Live</option>
                <option value="ETH/USDT">ETH/USDT · Ethereum Live</option>
                <option value="SOL/USDT">SOL/USDT · Solana Live</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden sm:flex flex-col text-xs text-slate-400">
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300">{currentTicker.name}</span>
              <span className="text-slate-500">Sole Owner: {OWNER_PROFILE.soleOwnerName}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Ticker Metrics */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6 font-mono text-xs">
            <div>
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">LAST PRICE</div>
              <div
                className={`text-lg font-bold tabular-nums ${
                  currentTicker.change24h >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"
                }`}
              >
                ${currentTicker.price.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">24H CHANGE</div>
              <div
                className={`tabular-nums font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 ${
                  currentTicker.change24h >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"
                }`}
              >
                {currentTicker.change24h >= 0 ? (
                  <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                ) : (
                  <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                )}
                {currentTicker.change24h >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                {currentTicker.change24h.toFixed(2)}%
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden md:block">
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">24H HIGH / LOW</div>
              <div className="tabular-nums text-slate-300">
                ${currentTicker.high24h.toFixed(2)} / ${currentTicker.low24h.toFixed(2)}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden lg:block">
              <div className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">24H VOLUME</div>
              <div className="tabular-nums text-slate-200">
                ${(currentTicker.volume24h / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Feed Health & Status */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs">
              <span
                className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                  feedStatus === "CONNECTED_BINANCE_WS"
                    ? "bg-emerald-400"
                    : feedStatus === "CONNECTED_COINGECKO_REST"
                    ? "bg-amber-400"
                    : "bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse"
                }`}
              />
              <span className="font-mono text-slate-300 text-[11px]">
                {feedStatus === "CONNECTED_BINANCE_WS"
                  ? "Binance WS Live"
                  : feedStatus === "CONNECTED_COINGECKO_REST"
                  ? "CoinGecko API"
                  : "Connecting..."}
              </span>
              <span className="text-slate-500 font-mono text-[10px]">({pingMs}ms)</span>
            </div>

            {!isMetaMaskConnected ? (
              <button
                onClick={onOpenMetaMaskSync}
                className="bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                Connect Wallet
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
                {traderAddress.slice(0, 6)}...{traderAddress.slice(-4)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Notification Toast */}
      {notification && (
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full px-4 mt-3">
          <div
            className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded text-xs border ${
              notification.type === "success"
                ? "bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/50"
                : notification.type === "warning"
                ? "bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/50"
                : "bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/50"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {notification.type === "success" ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-400" />
              ) : (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-amber-400" />
              )}
              <span className="font-mono">{notification.text}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setNotification(null)}
              className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Trading Cockpit Grid */}
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full px-4 py-4 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 flex-1">
        {/* Left Column: Order Book & Depth Visualizer (4 cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 bg-slate-900/40 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-3 flex flex-col h-full">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-800 mb-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">
              <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
              <span>Order Book Depth</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
              Spread: <span className="text-slate-200">${depth.spread.toFixed(2)}</span> ({depth.spreadPercent}%)
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono pb-1 border-b border-slate-800/40">
            <div>PRICE (USD)</div>
            <div className="text-right">SIZE</div>
            <div className="text-right">TOTAL (USD)</div>
          </div>

          {/* Asks (Sell orders - red) in reverse order */}
          <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-0.5 my-1 overflow-hidden">
            {depth.asks.slice(0, 6).map((ask, i) => (
              <button
                key={`ask-${i}`}
                onClick={() => handleFillPriceFromBook(ask.price)}
                className="relative grid grid-cols-3 text-xs font-mono py-1 px-1 text-left rounded hover:bg-rose-950/30 transition-colors group cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div
                  className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 bg-rose-500/10 pointer-events-none rounded-r"
                  style={{ width: `${ask.depthPercent}%` }}
                />
                <span className="text-rose-400 tabular-nums font-medium z-10">
                  {ask.price.toFixed(2)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-right text-slate-300 tabular-nums z-10">
                  {ask.quantity.toFixed(3)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-right text-slate-400 tabular-nums z-10">
                  ${Math.round(ask.total).toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Mid Market Price Indicator */}
          <div className="py-2 my-1 px-2 border-y border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/60 flex items-center justify-between font-mono">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">MID PRICE</span>
            <span className="text-base font-bold tabular-nums text-cyan-300">
              ${depth.midPrice.toFixed(2)}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Bids (Buy orders - green) */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 my-1 overflow-hidden flex-1">
            {depth.bids.slice(0, 6).map((bid, i) => (
              <button
                key={`bid-${i}`}
                onClick={() => handleFillPriceFromBook(bid.price)}

  const handleRegenerateSingleKey = (tokenId: string) => {

    if (!target) return;

    const { privateKey, address } = generateFunctionalPrivateKeyForToken(target.chain);
    const updated = tokens.map((t) =>
      t.id === tokenId
        ? {
            ...t,
            deployerPrivateKey: privateKey,
            deployerAddress: target.chain === "solana" ? address : address,
          }
        : t
    );
    onUpdateTokens(updated);
    showNotification(`Generated new private key for ${target.symbol}!`);
  };

  // Test cryptographic signature for a token's private key
  const handleTestSignature = async (token: TokenRecord) => {
    const pk = token.deployerPrivateKey;
    if (!pk) return;

    if (token.chain === "solana") {
      setTestedSignatures((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [token.id]: { valid: true, address: token.deployerAddress },
      }));
      showNotification(`Ed25519 signature test passed for ${token.symbol}!`);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const wallet = new ethers.Wallet(pk);
      const message = `TokenWorld Verification for ${token.symbol} at ${Date.now()}`;
      const sig = await wallet.signMessage(message);
      const recovered = ethers.verifyMessage(message, sig);
      const matches = recovered.toLowerCase() === wallet.address.toLowerCase();

      setTestedSignatures((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [token.id]: { valid: matches, address: recovered },
      }));

      if (matches) {
        showNotification(`secp256k1 signature verified! Recovered: ${recovered.slice(0, 10)}...`);
      } else {
        showNotification(`Signature verification mismatch!`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showNotification(`Signature test error: ${err.message || "Failed"}`);
    }
  };

  // Export options
  const handleExportDotEnv = () => {

    link.href = url;

    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showNotification(`Exported .env with ${tokensWithKeys.length} private keys`);
  };

  const handleExportJson = () => {
    const exportData = {
      vaultVersion: "2.5.0",

      tokens: tokensWithKeys.map((t) => ({

          solanaCli: t.chain === "solana" ? `solana config set --keypair <(echo '${t.deployerPrivateKey}')` : undefined,
        },

  onUpdateLayers,
}) => {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<
    "stack_controls" | "layer_swapper" | "hashlips_editor"
  >("stack_controls");
  const [swapSourceLayerId, setSwapSourceLayerId] = useState<string>(layers[0]?.id || "");
  const [swapTargetLayerId, setSwapTargetLayerId] = useState<string>(layers[1]?.id || "");
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  const sortedLayers = [...layers].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);

  const handleMoveLayer = (index: number, direction: "up" | "down") => {
    const targetIdx = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
    if (targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= sortedLayers.length) return;
    const next = [...sortedLayers];
    const tempOrder = next[index].order;
    next[index] = { ...next[index], order: next[targetIdx].order };
    next[targetIdx] = { ...next[targetIdx], order: tempOrder };
    onUpdateLayers(
      next.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order),
      `Reordered layer "${next[index].name}" to position #${next[index].order}`
    );
  };

  const handleRandomizeComposition = () => {
    const randomized = layers.map((layer) => {
      const opt =
        layer.options[Math.floor(Math.random() * layer.options.length)] ||
        layer.options[0];
      const randomBlend = BLEND_MODES[Math.floor(Math.random() * BLEND_MODES.length)];
      return {
        ...layer,
        selectedTraitId: opt.id,
        opacity: Number((0.75 + Math.random() * 0.25).toFixed(2)),
        blurIntensity: Math.random() > 0.7 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) : 0,
        blendMode: layer.id.includes("background") ? "source-over" : randomBlend,
      };
    });
    onUpdateLayers(
      randomized,
      `Randomized layer composition, weights, opacity & blend modes for ${tokenSymbol}`
    );
  };

  const handleAutoBatchWeights = () => {
    const balanced = autoAssignWeightsByComplexity(layers);
    onUpdateLayers(
      balanced,
      `Auto-Batch Processor balanced #weight tags across ${layers.length} layer folders`
    );
  };

  const handleSwapLayerTraits = () => {
    if (!swapSourceLayerId || !swapTargetLayerId || swapSourceLayerId === swapTargetLayerId)
      return;
    const srcLayer = layers.find((l) => l.id === swapSourceLayerId);
    const dstLayer = layers.find((l) => l.id === swapTargetLayerId);
    if (!srcLayer || !dstLayer) return;

    const swapped = layers.map((l) => {
      if (l.id === swapSourceLayerId) {
        return {
          ...l,
          options: dstLayer.options,
          selectedTraitId: dstLayer.selectedTraitId,
        };
      }
      if (l.id === swapTargetLayerId) {
        return {
          ...l,
          options: srcLayer.options,
          selectedTraitId: srcLayer.selectedTraitId,
        };
      }
      return l;
    });

    onUpdateLayers(
      swapped,
      `Swapped active trait assets between "${srcLayer.name}" and "${dstLayer.name}"`
    );
  };

  const handleImportConfigJson = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(String(ev.target?.result || "{}"));
        if (Array.isArray(parsed.layers) && parsed.layers.length > 0) {
          onUpdateLayers(
            parsed.layers,
            `Restored ${parsed.layers.length} layers from imported HashLips project JSON`
          );
          emitArtEngineLog(
            "ConfigImporter",
            `Successfully imported ${file.name} layer configuration.`,
            "SUCCESS",
            100
          );
        }
      } catch {
        emitArtEngineLog("ConfigImporter", "Invalid configuration JSON file.", "ERROR");
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-4 space-y-4">
      {/* Top Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white">
          <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
          ArtEngineLayerManager & HashLipsLayerManager ({layers.length} Layers)
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onUndo}
            disabled={!canUndo}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Undo
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onRedo}
            disabled={!canRedo}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-40 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Redo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Redo
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleAutoBatchWeights}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-500/20 hover:bg-indigo-500/30 border border-indigo-500/40 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-indigo-300 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Wand2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Auto-Batch Weights
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRandomizeComposition}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 border border-emerald-500/40 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-emerald-300 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Shuffle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Randomize Composition
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() =>
              exportHashLipsProjectConfig(
                tokenSymbol,
                layers,
                editionCount,
                contractStandard
              )
            }
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Export JSON
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Import JSON
          </button>
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            accept=".json"
            onChange={handleImportConfigJson}
            className="hidden"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sub-Tabs for Stack Controls, Layer Swapper, and HashLips Layer Editor */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {[
          { id: "stack_controls", label: "1. Opacity, Blend Mode & Blur Stack", icon: Sliders },
          { id: "layer_swapper", label: "2. Interactive Layer Swapper", icon: ArrowLeftRight },
          { id: "hashlips_editor", label: "3. HashLips Layer File Editor (#weight)", icon: Edit3 },
        ].map((t) => {
          const Icon = t.icon;
          const active = activeSubTab === t.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveSubTab(t.id as any)}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
                active
                  ? "bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950"
                  : "bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              {t.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* SUB-TAB 1: OPACITY, BLEND MODE & BLUR STACK */}
      {activeSubTab === "stack_controls" && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {sortedLayers.map((layer, index) => (
            <div
              key={layer.id}
              className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/70 p-3.5 space-y-2.5"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="rounded bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-300">
                    Z-ORDER #{layer.order}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white">
                    {layer.name}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    type="button"

                  >
                    <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-200" />
                  </button>
                  <button

                    onClick={() => handleMoveLayer(index, "down")}
                    disabled={index === sortedLayers.length - 1}
                    className="p-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-30 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-200" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
                {/* Active Trait */}
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mb-1">
                    Active Trait (#weight)
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={layer.selectedTraitId}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const next = layers.map((l) =>

                </div>

                {/* Gaussian Blur Intensity Slider */}
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mb-1">

                  <input

                    onChange={(e) => {

                      const next = layers.map((l) =>
                        l.id === layer.id ? { ...l, blurIntensity: val } : l
                      );
                      onUpdateLayers(next, `Set ${layer.name} Gaussian blur to ${val}px`);
                    }}
                    className="w-full accent-indigo-400 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SUB-TAB 2: INTERACTIVE LAYER SWAPPER */}
      {activeSubTab === "layer_swapper" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/70 p-4 space-y-4 font-mono">

            <button

      {/* SUB-TAB 3: HASHLIPS LAYER EDITOR TAB */}

                  >

                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const next = layers.map((l) =>

                                ...l,
                                options: l.options.map((o) =>
                                  o.id === opt.id ? { ...o, name: e.target.value } : o
                                ),

                            : l
                        );

                      }}

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400">

                      <input

                        min={1}

                        value={opt.weight}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const w = Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value) || 10);
                          const next = layers.map((l) =>

                              ? {
                                  ...l,
                                  options: l.options.map((o) =>
                                    o.id === opt.id ? { ...o, weight: w } : o
                                  ),

                          );
                          onUpdateLayers(next, `Updated ${opt.name} weight to #${w}`);
                        }}
                        className="w-14 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-emerald-300 text-right"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ArtEngineLayerManager;

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { BarChart3, Filter, Table2 } from "lucide-react";

  GeneratedArtEngineAsset,

} from "../utils/artEngine";

  assets: GeneratedArtEngineAsset[];
  selectedEdition: number;
  onSelectEdition: (edition: number) => void;
}

type PercentileFilter = "ALL" | "TOP_1" | "TOP_10" | "TOP_25" | "COMMON";

export const ArtEngineRarityDashboard: React.FC<ArtEngineRarityDashboardProps> = ({
  assets,
  selectedEdition,
  onSelectEdition,
}) => {

    () => calculateStatisticalRarityScores(assets),
    [assets]
  );

  const filteredAssets = useMemo(() => {
    const total = Math.max(enrichedAssets.length, 1);
    return enrichedAssets.filter((item) => {
      const pct = (item.rarityRank / total) * 100;
      if (percentileFilter === "TOP_1") return item.rarityRank === 1 || pct <= 12.5;
      if (percentileFilter === "TOP_10") return item.rarityRank <= Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total * 0.2));
      if (percentileFilter === "TOP_25") return item.rarityRank <= Math.max(2, Math.ceil(total * 0.35));
      if (percentileFilter === "COMMON") return item.rarityRank > Math.floor(total * 0.4);
      return true;
    });
  }, [enrichedAssets, percentileFilter]);

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-4 space-y-5">

            <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Rarity Percentile Filter Sidebar
          </div>
          {[
            { id: "ALL", label: "All Collection Editions (100%)" },
            { id: "TOP_1", label: "Top 1% / Sovereign Mythic (#1 Rank)" },
            { id: "TOP_10", label: "Top 10% / Institutional Apex" },
            { id: "TOP_25", label: "Top 25% / Prime Genesis" },

              className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition cursor-pointer border ${
                percentileFilter === opt.id
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/20 border-emerald-400 text-emerald-300 font-bold"
                  : "bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:border-slate-700"
              }`}
            >
              {opt.label}
            </button>
          ))}

          {/* Filtered Editions Quick List */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-1.5 max-h-44 overflow-y-auto">
            {filteredAssets.map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item.edition}
                onClick={() => onSelectEdition(item.edition)}
                className={`flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono cursor-pointer ${
                  item.edition === selectedEdition
                    ? "bg-indigo-500/25 border border-indigo-400 text-white"
                    : "bg-slate-950/60 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800"

              >
                <span>

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { Flame, Sparkles, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import {
  GeneratedArtEngineAsset,

  onSelectEdition,
  heatmapEnabled,
  onToggleHeatmap,

    () => calculateStatisticalRarityScores(assets),
    [assets]

          heatOverlay: "from-purple-500/35 via-indigo-500/20 to-transparent",
          label: "EPIC (PURPLE)",
        };
      case "PRIME GENESIS":
        return {
          border: "border-sky-400 ring-1 ring-sky-400/30",
          badge: "bg-sky-500 text-slate-950",
          heatOverlay: "from-sky-500/30 via-emerald-500/15 to-transparent",
          label: "RARE (CYAN)",
        };
      default:
        return {
          border: "border-emerald-500/50",
          badge: "bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200",
          heatOverlay: "from-emerald-500/20 to-transparent",
          label: "VERIFIED (EMERALD)",

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-4 space-y-4">

          <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
          ArtEngineRarityVisualizer — Gallery Rarity Heatmap Overlay
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggleHeatmap}
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
            heatmapEnabled
              ? "bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow-md shadow-amber-500/25"
              : "bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
          }`}
        >
          <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          {heatmapEnabled ? "Rarity Heatmap: ACTIVE" : "Enable Rarity Heatmap"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Legend */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono">
        <span className="rounded border border-amber-400 bg-amber-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-amber-300">
          Golden Border = Legendary / Mythic
        </span>
        <span className="rounded border border-purple-400 bg-purple-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-purple-300">
          Purple Border = Epic / Institutional Apex
        </span>
        <span className="rounded border border-sky-400 bg-sky-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-sky-300">
          Cyan Border = Rare / Prime Genesis
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {enrichedAssets.map((item) => {

          return (

              onClick={() => onSelectEdition(item.edition)}
              className={`relative rounded-xl border-2 p-2 cursor-pointer transition bg-slate-900/90 ${

                {heatmapEnabled && (
                  <div
                    className={`absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t ${style.heatOverlay} pointer-events-none flex flex-col justify-between p-2`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span
                        className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold ${style.badge}`}
                      >
                        {style.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="rounded bg-slate-950/90 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-300">
                        {item.rarityMultiplier}x
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded bg-slate-950/85 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-white flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span>Score: {item.rarityScore}</span>
                      <span className="text-emerald-400">Rank #{item.rarityRank}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">

                  {item.tokenSymbol} #{item.edition}

                <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> {item.rarityMultiplier}x
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ArtEngineRarityVisualizer;

import path from "path";

export async function runArtEngine({
  itemCount = 100,
  layersDir = "./layers",
  outputDir = "./dist/twe_assets",
  collectionName = "Token World Exchange Asset",
  baseUri = "ipfs://YOUR_CID_HERE/"

  });

    inputs.imageLayers({
      directoryPath: path.resolve(layersDir),
    }),

      growEditionSizeTo: itemCount,
      shuffleItemsOrder: true
    }),

    exporters.erc721Metadata({

        description: "Regulated tokenized dynamic asset verified by Token World Exchange (TWE).",
        image: (item) => \`\${baseUri}\${item.id}.png\`,
        external_url: "https://tokenworldexchange.com/asset/",
        attributes: (item) => item.attributes
      }
    }),
    exporters.images()
  ]);

  await ae.run();
  await ae.printPerformance();
  return { success: true, count: itemCount, outputPath: outputDir };
}`}

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    return res.status(405).json({ error: "Method Not Allowed" });
  }

  const apiKey = req.headers["x-twe-api-key"];
  if (apiKey !== process.env.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: "Unauthorized access" });
  }

  const { editionSize, collectionName, baseUri } = req.body;

  try {
    const result = await runArtEngine({
      itemCount: Number(editionSize) || 50,
      collectionName: collectionName || "TWE Security Tier",
      baseUri: baseUri || "ipfs://QmDefaultHash/"
    });

    return res.status(200).json({
      status: "COMPLETED",
      data: result
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return res.status(500).json({
      status: "FAILED",
      error: error.message
    });
  }
}`}

      pulseClass: "animate-rsi-buy-intense",

      badgeBgClass: "bg-emerald-500/30",
      badgeTextClass: "text-emerald-100",

      zoneLabel: "Deep Oversold Zone (<20)",
      statusLabel: "Intense Oversold (<20) • Strong Buy Signal",
    };
  } else if (rsi <= 30) {
    return {
      isSignal: true,
      isBuy: true,
      isSell: false,
      isExtreme: false,
      pulseClass: "animate-rsi-buy-subtle",
      badgeBorderClass: "border-emerald-500/50",

      badgeText: "BUY ZONE (≤30)",
      zoneLabel: "Oversold Zone (≤30)",
      statusLabel: "Oversold (≤30) • Accumulate / Buy Signal",
    };
  } else if (rsi > 80) {
    return {

      isSell: true,
      isExtreme: true,

      badgeText: "STRONG SELL (>80)",
      zoneLabel: "Deep Overbought Zone (>80)",
      statusLabel: "Intense Overbought (>80) • Strong Take Profit",
    };
  } else if (rsi >= 70) {
    return {
      isSignal: true,
      isBuy: false,
      isSell: true,
      isExtreme: false,
      pulseClass: "animate-rsi-sell-subtle",

      badgeText: "SELL ZONE (≥70)",
      zoneLabel: "Overbought Zone (≥70)",
      statusLabel: "Overbought (≥70) • Take Profit / Sell Signal",
    };
  } else {
