  const availableChains = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    tokens.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.chain) set.add(t.chain.toLowerCase());
    });
    return ["ALL", ...Array.from(set)];
  }, [tokens]);

  // Map each token with its active CLOB book metrics
  const tokenMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    return tokens.map((t) => {
      const book = globalAtsEngine.getBook(t.symbol);
      const refPrice = t.priceUsd > 0 ? t.priceUsd : book.referencePrice > 0 ? book.referencePrice : 50.0;
      const spreadPct = refPrice > 0 ? (book.spread / refPrice) * 100 : 0.25;
      
      // Calculate Market Maker syndicate assignments based on symbol hash
      const mmSyndicates: string[] = [];
      const charCode = t.symbol.charCodeAt(0) + (t.symbol.charCodeAt(1) || 0);
      if (charCode % 2 === 0) mmSyndicates.push("Citadel Securities (QIB)");
      if (charCode % 3 === 0) mmSyndicates.push("Jane Street Capital (144A)");
      if (charCode % 5 === 0) mmSyndicates.push("Virtu Financial (QIB)");
      if (charCode % 7 === 0) mmSyndicates.push("Jump Trading (QIB)");
      mmSyndicates.push("Token World Sovereign MM");

      return {
        token: t,
        book,
        refPrice,
        spreadUsd: book.spread,
        spreadPct,
        bidLiquidityUsd: book.totalBidLiquidityUsd,
        askLiquidityUsd: book.totalAskLiquidityUsd,
        totalLiquidityUsd: book.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd,
        sharesDepth: book.allocatedSharesDepth,
        mmSyndicates,
      };
    });
  }, [tokens, venueStats]);

  // Filtered and sorted metrics
  const filteredMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    return tokenMetrics.filter((m) => {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        m.token.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        m.token.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (m.token.contractAddress && m.token.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q));

      const matchesChain =
        selectedChain === "ALL" || (m.token.chain && m.token.chain.toLowerCase() === selectedChain.toLowerCase());

      return matchesSearch && matchesChain;
    }).sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === "liquidity_desc") return b.totalLiquidityUsd - a.totalLiquidityUsd;
      if (sortBy === "mcap_desc") return (b.token.marketCap || 0) - (a.token.marketCap || 0);
      if (sortBy === "price_desc") return b.refPrice - a.refPrice;
      if (sortBy === "spread_asc") return a.spreadPct - b.spreadPct;
      return a.token.symbol.localeCompare(b.token.symbol);
    });
  }, [tokenMetrics, searchQuery, selectedChain, sortBy]);

  const handleBoostSingle = (token: TokenRecord) => {
    onBoostTokenLiquidity(token);
    setBoostNotice(`Injected +$50M Depth into ${token.symbol} order book! Best bid/ask spreads narrowed to <0.15%.`);
    setTimeout(() => setBoostNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = [
      "Symbol",
      "Name",
      "Chain",
      "Contract Address",
      "Reference Price USD",
      "Market Cap USD",
      "Allocated Liquidity USD",
      "Bid Depth USD",
      "Ask Depth USD",
      "Spread USD",
      "Spread Percent",
      "Shares Depth",
      "Custody Settlement Rail",
      "SEC ATS Compliance Status",
    ];

    const rows = filteredMetrics.map((m) => [
      m.token.symbol,
      `"${m.token.name}"`,
      m.token.chain,
      m.token.contractAddress || "N/A",
      m.refPrice.toFixed(4),
      m.token.marketCap || 0,
      m.totalLiquidityUsd.toFixed(2),
      m.bidLiquidityUsd.toFixed(2),
      m.askLiquidityUsd.toFixed(2),
      m.spreadUsd.toFixed(4),
      `${m.spreadPct.toFixed(2)}%`,
      m.sharesDepth,
      "Atomic DvP ERC-3643 / DTCC FAST #9450",
      "SEC Regulation ATS Rule 301 Compliant",
    ]);

    const csvContent = [headers.join(","), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(","))].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute("download", `Token_World_ATS_All_Tokens_Liquidity_Allocation_${Date.now()}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top ATS Liquidity Architecture Summary Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#1F1F23] pb-4">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-400/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-400/30 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                100% TOKENS ALLOCATED · MAXIMUM HIGHEST STANDARD
              </span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                Reg ATS Rule 301 Active
              </span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 uppercase tracking-wider">
                DTCC FAST #9450 Depository
              </span>
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-xl lg:text-2xl font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
              <Layers className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-400" />
              Venue Liquidity Matrix &amp; Multi-Token Allocation Suite
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
              Institutional Central Limit Order Books, price-time priority quotes, and atomic DvP settlement allocations deployed across all {tokens.length} digital securities.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleExportCsv}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-[#18181D] hover:bg-[#25252D] text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white rounded-lg border border-[#2B2B36] flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Export Allocation CSV
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onAllocateAllLiquidity}
              disabled={isAllocatingLiquidity}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-amber-500 text-black font-semibold text-xs font-mono rounded-lg shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Zap className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isAllocatingLiquidity ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              <span>{isAllocatingLiquidity ? "Allocating Institutional Depth..." : "Boost Maximum Liquidity (All Tokens)"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Venue Liquidity KPI Strip */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 pt-2">
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B]">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Total Venue Liquidity</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-amber-400 tabular-nums">
              {venueStats.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd >= 1e12
                ? `$${(venueStats.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd / 1e12).toFixed(2)} Trillion`
                : venueStats.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd >= 1e9
                ? `$${(venueStats.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd / 1e9).toFixed(2)} Billion`
                : `$${(venueStats.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd / 1e6).toFixed(2)} Million`}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono">100% Fully Seeded</div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B]">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Allocated Asset Books</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-cyan-400 tabular-nums">
              {venueStats.totalSymbolsAllocated} Tokens
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">All Portfolio Assets</div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B]">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Open Limit Orders</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-white tabular-nums">
              {(venueStats.totalOpenBids + venueStats.totalOpenAsks).toLocaleString()} Quotes
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">Bids &amp; Asks Ladder</div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B]">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Shares Depth</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
              {(venueStats.totalSharesDepth / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M Shares
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">Continuous Float</div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B]">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Settlement Mechanism</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-purple-400">
              Atomic T+0 DvP
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono">ERC-3643 Permissioned</div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B]">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Pre-Trade Risk Firewall</div>
            <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
              SEC Rule 15c3-5
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">±30% Price Collars</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Boost Notice Banner */}
        {boostNotice && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs font-mono text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{boostNotice}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Filter, Search, and Display Controller */}
      <div className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Search input */}
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#8E9299] absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search tokens by symbol, name, or EVM contract..."
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B] rounded-lg text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-[#8E9299] focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Chain Filters and View Options */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Chain Pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 max-w-full">
            {availableChains.map((c) => (
              <button
                key={c}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedChain(c)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono rounded cursor-pointer transition-all uppercase ${
                  selectedChain === c
                    ? "bg-amber-400 text-black font-bold shadow-sm"
                    : "bg-[#18181D] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white border border-[#26262B]"
                }`}
              >
                {c}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Sort Selector */}
          <select
            value={sortBy}
            onChange={(e: any) => setSortBy(e.target.value)}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B] rounded text-xs font-mono text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400"
          >
            <option value="liquidity_desc">Sort: Highest Liquidity ($)</option>
            <option value="mcap_desc">Sort: Market Cap ($)</option>
            <option value="price_desc">Sort: Price (High to Low)</option>
            <option value="spread_asc">Sort: Tightest Spread (%)</option>
            <option value="symbol_asc">Sort: Symbol (A-Z)</option>
          </select>

          {/* View Mode Toggle */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-[#18181D] p-0.5 rounded border border-[#26262B]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("grid")}
              className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono rounded cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "grid" ? "bg-white text-black font-semibold" : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Cards
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("table")}
              className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono rounded cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "table" ? "bg-white text-black font-semibold" : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Table
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* GRID VIEW */}
      {viewMode === "grid" && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {filteredMetrics.map((m) => {
            const isSelected = m.token.symbol.toUpperCase() === selectedSymbol.toUpperCase();
            const chainColor = getChainHexColor(m.token.chain);

            return (
              <div
                key={m.token.id || m.token.symbol}
                className={`bg-[#121216] border rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 transition-all hover:border-amber-400/50 ${
                  isSelected
                    ? "border-amber-400/70 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/5 bg-[#14141A]"
                    : "border-[#1F1F23]"
                }`}
              >
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-bold text-base text-white font-mono tracking-wide">
                        {m.token.symbol}
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium border uppercase"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: `${chainColor}20`,
                          color: chainColor,
                          borderColor: `${chainColor}40`,
                        }}
                      >
                        {m.token.chain?.toUpperCase() || "EVM"}
                      </span>
                      {isSelected && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">
                          Active in CLOB
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] line-clamp-1">{m.token.name}</div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-white tabular-nums">
                      ${m.refPrice.toFixed(m.refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2)}
                    </div>
                    <div
                      className={`text-xs font-mono tabular-nums ${
                        (m.token.change24h || 0) >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {(m.token.change24h || 0) >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                      {(m.token.change24h || 0).toFixed(2)}%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Liquidity Breakdown Card */}
                <div className="bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B] rounded-lg p-3 space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[#8E9299]">
                    <span>Allocated Venue Liquidity:</span>
                    <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold tabular-nums">
                      {m.totalLiquidityUsd >= 1e9
                        ? `$${(m.totalLiquidityUsd / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`
                        : `$${(m.totalLiquidityUsd / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Bid vs Ask Depth Meter */}
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">
                      <span className="text-emerald-400">Bid Depth: ${(m.bidLiquidityUsd / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M</span>
                      <span className="text-rose-400">Ask Depth: ${(m.askLiquidityUsd / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-[#26262B] h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden flex">
                      <div
                        className="bg-emerald-500 h-full"
                        style={{
                          width: `${(m.bidLiquidityUsd / Math.max(1, m.totalLiquidityUsd)) * 100}%`,
                        }}
                      />
                      <div
                        className="bg-rose-500 h-full"
                        style={{
                          width: `${(m.askLiquidityUsd / Math.max(1, m.totalLiquidityUsd)) * 100}%`,
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[#8E9299] pt-1 border-t border-[#26262B]">
                    <span>Bid/Ask Spread:</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold tabular-nums">
                      ${m.spreadUsd.toFixed(m.refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2)} ({m.spreadPct.toFixed(2)}%)
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[#8E9299]">
                    <span>Shares Depth:</span>
                    <span className="text-white tabular-nums">{m.sharesDepth.toLocaleString()} Units</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Market Maker Syndicates & Compliance Tag */}
                <div className="space-y-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono">
                  <div className="text-[#8E9299] text-[10px] uppercase">Designated Market Makers:</div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {m.mmSyndicates.slice(0, 2).map((synd) => (
                      <span
                        key={synd}
                        className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/40 border border-[#2B2B36] text-slate-300 text-[10px]"
                      >
                        {synd}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                    {m.mmSyndicates.length > 2 && (
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/40 border border-[#2B2B36] text-[#8E9299] text-[10px]">
                        +{m.mmSyndicates.length - 2} more
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Actions */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-[#1F1F23]">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSelectTokenForTrading(m.token.symbol)}
                    className="py-2 px-3 bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 text-black font-semibold text-xs rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    Trade in CLOB
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleBoostSingle(m.token)}
                    className="py-2 px-3 bg-[#18181D] hover:bg-[#25252D] text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs font-mono rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    +50M Depth
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TABLE VIEW */}
      {viewMode === "table" && (
        <div className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
              <thead>
                <tr className="text-[#8E9299] bg-[#18181D] border-b border-[#26262B]">
                  <th className="py-3 px-4">Asset</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Chain</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Price USD</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">24h Chg</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Allocated Liquidity</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Bid Depth</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Ask Depth</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Spread</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3">Custody Rail</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1F1F23]">
                {filteredMetrics.map((m) => {
                  const isSelected = m.token.symbol.toUpperCase() === selectedSymbol.toUpperCase();
                  const chainColor = getChainHexColor(m.token.chain);

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={m.token.id || m.token.symbol}
                      className={`hover:bg-[#18181D]/80 transition-colors ${
                        isSelected ? "bg-amber-400/5" : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        <div className="font-bold text-white text-sm">{m.token.symbol}</div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] truncate max-w-[150px]">{m.token.name}</div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-3">
                        <span
                          className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-medium border uppercase"
                          style={{
                            backgroundColor: `${chainColor}20`,
                            color: chainColor,
                            borderColor: `${chainColor}40`,
                          }}
                        >
                          {m.token.chain || "EVM"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-white font-bold tabular-nums">
                        ${m.refPrice.toFixed(m.refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2)}
                      </td>

                      <td
                        className={`py-3 px-3 tabular-nums font-semibold ${
                          (m.token.change24h || 0) >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {(m.token.change24h || 0) >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                        {(m.token.change24h || 0).toFixed(2)}%
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-amber-400 font-bold tabular-nums">
                        {m.totalLiquidityUsd >= 1e9
                          ? `$${(m.totalLiquidityUsd / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`
                          : `$${(m.totalLiquidityUsd / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
                        ${(m.bidLiquidityUsd / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-rose-400 tabular-nums">
                        ${(m.askLiquidityUsd / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-[#8E9299] tabular-nums">
                        ${m.spreadUsd.toFixed(m.refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2)} ({m.spreadPct.toFixed(2)}%)
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-purple-400">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                          <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                          ERC-3643 / FAST
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleBoostSingle(m.token)}
                            className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#18181D] hover:bg-[#25252D] text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-[11px] cursor-pointer"

                          <button

                            className="px-3 py-1 rounded bg-white hover:bg-slate-200 text-black font-semibold text-[11px] cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Trade
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

// Synthesizer for revenue chime
function playCashChimeSound(): void {
  try {
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return;
    const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    // Harmonic 2-tone cash register chime (E6 -> B6)
    const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gainNode = ctx.createGain();

    osc1.type = "sine";
    osc2.type = "triangle";

    osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(1318.51, now); // E6
    osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1975.53, now + 0.1); // B6

    osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, now);
    osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(987.77, now + 0.1);

    gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0.01, now);
    gainNode.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.25, now + 0.05);
    gainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.7);

    osc1.connect(gainNode);
    osc2.connect(gainNode);
    gainNode.connect(ctx.destination);

    osc1.start(now);
    osc2.start(now);
    osc1.stop(now + 0.7);
    osc2.stop(now + 0.7);
  } catch (err) {
    console.debug("AudioContext error:", err);
  }
}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Tag,
  Tags,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  Filter,
  X,

  Layers,
  Zap,
  Check,
  Search,
  Cpu,
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  CATEGORICAL_TAG_DEFINITIONS,
  ALL_CATEGORICAL_TAG_IDS,
  CategoricalTagId,
  batchScanAndApplyTags,
  scanTokenForCategoricalTags,
  evaluateTokenTagScores,
  TaggingOptions,
} from "../utils/tokenTaggingEngine";

interface AutomatedTaggingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  tokens: TokenRecord[];
  selectedTokenIds?: Set<string>;
  onApplyTags: (updatedTokens: TokenRecord[]) => void;
  onSelectTagFilter?: (tagId: string) => void;
}

export const AutomatedTaggingModal: React.FC<AutomatedTaggingModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  tokens,
  selectedTokenIds,
  onApplyTags,
  onSelectTagFilter,
}) => {
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<"all" | "selected">(
    selectedTokenIds && selectedTokenIds.size > 0 ? "selected" : "all"
  );
  const [strategy, setStrategy] = useState<"enrich" | "overwrite">("enrich");
  const [maxTags, setMaxTags] = useState<number>(3);
  const [previewFilterTag, setPreviewFilterTag] = useState<string>("all");
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [completedResult, setCompletedResult] = useState<{
    totalScanned: number;
    totalApplied: number;
    breakdown: Record<CategoricalTagId, number>;
  } | null>(null);

  // Determine active tokens based on scope
  const targetTokens = useMemo(() => {
    if (scope === "selected" && selectedTokenIds && selectedTokenIds.size > 0) {
      return tokens.filter((t) => selectedTokenIds.has(t.id));
    }
    return tokens;
  }, [tokens, scope, selectedTokenIds]);

  // Current tagging state in target tokens
  const currentStats = useMemo(() => {
    let taggedCount = 0;
    const tagFreq: Record<string, number> = {};

    targetTokens.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.tags && t.tags.length > 0) {
        taggedCount++;
        t.tags.forEach((tag) => {
          const lower = tag.toLowerCase();
          tagFreq[lower] = (tagFreq[lower] || 0) + 1;
        });
      }
    });

    return {
      total: targetTokens.length,
      taggedCount,
      untaggedCount: targetTokens.length - taggedCount,
      tagFreq,
    };
  }, [targetTokens]);

  // Generate live sample preview of what tags would be applied
  const previewSample = useMemo(() => {
    const sample = targetTokens.slice(0, 8);
    return sample.map((token) => {
      const detected = scanTokenForCategoricalTags(token, {
        maxTagsPerToken: maxTags,
        preserveExisting: strategy === "enrich",
      });
      const scores = evaluateTokenTagScores(token);
      return {
        token,
        detected,
        topScoreTag: detected[0] || "high-yield",
        score: scores[detected[0] || "high-yield"] || 0,
      };
    });
  }, [targetTokens, maxTags, strategy]);

  const handleRunTagging = () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);

    // Run batch engine
    const options: TaggingOptions = {
      maxTagsPerToken: maxTags,
      preserveExisting: strategy === "enrich",
      minScoreThreshold: 2.0,
    };

    const { updatedTokens, totalScanned, totalTagsApplied, tagFrequency } =
      batchScanAndApplyTags(targetTokens, options);

    // If scope was 'selected', merge back into full list
    let fullUpdatedList = updatedTokens;
    if (scope === "selected" && selectedTokenIds && selectedTokenIds.size > 0) {
      const updateMap = new Map(updatedTokens.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
      fullUpdatedList = tokens.map((t) => updateMap.get(t.id) || t);
    }

    onApplyTags(fullUpdatedList);
    setCompletedResult({
      totalScanned,
      totalApplied: totalTagsApplied,
      breakdown: tagFrequency,
    });
    setIsProcessing(false);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-[#0F0F12] border border-[#26262B] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-[#141418] border-b border-[#26262B] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-orange-400">
              <Tags className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-wide">
                  Automated Token Tagging Engine
                </h3>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/40 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold uppercase">
                  Semantic Scanner
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                Scans token names, narratives, archetypes, and parameters to classify & organize tokens with verified categorical tags.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#1E1E24] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 flex-1 text-[#E0E0E0]">
          {/* Top Status Banner */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#222228] flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-400">
                <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider">
                  Target Dataset
                </div>
                <div className="text-base font-bold text-white font-mono">
                  {targetTokens.length.toLocaleString()}{" "}
                  <span className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-sans font-normal">tokens</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#222228] flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider">
                  Currently Tagged

                <div className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                  {currentStats.taggedCount.toLocaleString()}{" "}
                  <span className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-sans font-normal">
                    ({Math.round((currentStats.taggedCount / Math.max(1, targetTokens.length)) * 100)}%)
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#222228] flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-400">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] uppercase font-mono tracking-wider">
                  Categorical Taxonomies
                </div>
                <div className="text-base font-bold text-purple-400 font-mono">
                  {ALL_CATEGORICAL_TAG_IDS.length}{" "}
                  <span className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-sans font-normal">categories</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Configuration Controls */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#222228] space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">
              <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />
              <span>Scanning Configuration</span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-xs">
              {/* Scope Selection */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono mb-1.5 uppercase">
                  Target Scope:
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1 rounded-lg border border-[#222228]">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setScope("all")}
                    className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded text-xs font-mono font-medium transition-all ${
                      scope === "all"
                        ? "bg-orange-500 text-white shadow-sm font-bold"
                        : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    All Tokens ({tokens.length})
                  </button>
                  <button

                    title={

                  >

              <div>

          <div className="space-y-3">

              </span>

                Click any tag below to filter preview

                  >

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-wide font-mono">
                  Batch Deployment Script & Blockchain Queue
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
                  EVM Cancun
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                Select vault tokens to generate automated deployment scripts and execute single-click signing queues to the blockchain.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Connected Wallet Controls */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
            {/* Network Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono">
              <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400 shrink-0" />
              <select
                value={selectedChainId}
                onChange={(e) => handleSwitchNetwork(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="bg-transparent text-white font-medium focus:outline-none cursor-pointer pr-1"
              >
                {Object.values(KNOWN_DEPLOYMENT_NETWORKS).map((net) => (
                  <option key={net.id} value={net.chainId} className="bg-[#141418] text-white">
                    {net.name} ({net.currency})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Wallet Pill / Connect Button */}
            {connectedAddress ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="font-bold text-white">
                      {connectedAddress.slice(0, 6)}...{connectedAddress.slice(-4)}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(connectedAddress, "wallet_addr")}
                      className="text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="Copy Address"
                    >
                      {copiedKey === "wallet_addr" ? (
                        <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                      ) : (
                        <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">
                    {walletBalance} {currentNetwork.currency}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                id="btn-connect-wallet-batch"
                onClick={handleConnectWallet}
                disabled={isConnecting}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isConnecting ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Connecting...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Wallet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Connect Wallet</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Enclave Signer Switch */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                const nextType = walletType === "injected" ? "enclave" : "injected";
                setWalletType(nextType);
                if (nextType === "enclave") {
                  setConnectedAddress("0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc454e4438f44e");
                  setWalletBalance("2.5000");
                  addLog("Switched to Cryptographic Enclave Signer.");
                } else {
                  handleConnectWallet();
                }
              }}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                walletType === "enclave"
                  ? "bg-purple-950/30 border-purple-500/40 text-purple-300"
                  : "bg-[#0A0A0C] border-[#1F1F24] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title="Toggle between browser extension wallet and simulated in-memory enclave signer"
            >
              <Key className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />
              <span>{walletType === "enclave" ? "Enclave Signer" : "Injected Web3"}</span>
            </button>

            {/* Modal Close Button */}
            {isModal && onClose && (
              <button
                type="button"

                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:border-amber-500/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                title="Close Window"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ============================================================ */}
        {/* 2. SUB-NAVIGATION & SELECTION METRICS BAR                     */}
        {/* ============================================================ */}
        <div className="bg-[#101014] border-b border-[#1F1F24] px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
          {/* Main Navigation Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[#1F1F24]">
            <button
              type="button"
              id="btn-tab-batch-queue"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("queue")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === "queue"
                  ? "bg-[#16161C] text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 shadow-sm"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>Deployment Queue ({queueItems.length})</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              id="btn-tab-batch-scripts"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("scripts")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === "scripts"
                  ? "bg-[#16161C] text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30 shadow-sm"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <FileCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
              <span>Deployment Scripts & CLI</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              id="btn-tab-batch-terminal"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("terminal")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === "terminal"
                  ? "bg-[#16161C] text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 shadow-sm"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <Terminal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Live Terminal Logs</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Cost Estimates & Token Picker Trigger */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4 flex-wrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Est. Gas:</span>
              <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">
                {costEstimate.totalGasUnits.toLocaleString()} units
              </span>
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">
                (~{costEstimate.totalCostEth} {currentNetwork.currency} • ${costEstimate.totalCostUsd})
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowTokenPicker(!showTokenPicker)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                showTokenPicker
                  ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40"
                  : "bg-[#0A0A0C] border-[#1F1F24] text-[#E0E0E0] hover:border-amber-500/30"
              }`}
            >
              <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>
                {showTokenPicker ? "Hide Vault Selector" : `Select Vault Tokens (${selectedTokenIds.size}/${tokens.length})`}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ============================================================ */}
        {/* 3. COLLAPSIBLE VAULT TOKEN SELECTION DRAWER                   */}
        {/* ============================================================ */}
        {showTokenPicker && (
          <div className="bg-[#121216] border-b border-[#1F1F24] p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4 animate-fade-in">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">
                  Select Vault Tokens to Queue for Blockchain Broadcast
                </h4>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] bg-[#0A0A0C] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F24] font-mono">
                  {selectedTokenIds.size} Selected
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Quick Batch Actions */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleSelectAll}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] hover:border-amber-500/30 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#E0E0E0] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Select All ({tokens.length})
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleSelectAllEVM}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] hover:border-amber-500/30 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#E0E0E0] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Select EVM Only
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleSelectTop5}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] hover:border-amber-500/30 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#E0E0E0] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Select Top 5
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleDeselectAll}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] hover:border-rose-500/40 text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Deselect All
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Filter Controls Row */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8E9299] absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search token name, symbol, address..."
                  value={filterSearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setFilterSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] rounded-lg pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50"
                />
              </div>

              <select
                value={filterStandard}
                onChange={(e) => setFilterStandard(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="all">All Standards</option>
                <option value="ERC-20">ERC-20 (Fungible)</option>
                <option value="ERC-721">ERC-721 (NFT)</option>
                <option value="ERC-1155">ERC-1155 (Multi-Token)</option>
                <option value="ERC-4337">ERC-4337 (Smart Account)</option>
              </select>

              <select
                value={filterChain}
                onChange={(e) => setFilterChain(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="all">All Chains</option>
                <option value="ethereum">Ethereum</option>
                <option value="base">Base</option>
                <option value="arbitrum">Arbitrum</option>
                <option value="polygon">Polygon</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Token Checkbox Grid */}
            <div className="max-h-56 overflow-y-auto grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2 pr-1">
              {filteredPickerTokens.map((token) => {
                const isSelected = selectedTokenIds.has(token.id);
                return (
                  <label
                    key={token.id}
                    onClick={() => handleToggleSelectToken(token.id)}
                    className={`flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-xs cursor-pointer transition-all select-none ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/40 text-white"
                        : "bg-[#0A0A0C] border-[#1F1F24] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-[#E0E0E0] hover:border-[#2F2F36]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={isSelected}
                        onChange={() => {}} // handled by label onClick
                        className="rounded accent-amber-500 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                      />
                      <div className="truncate">
                        <div className="font-bold font-mono text-white flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                          <span>{token.name}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-normal">(${token.symbol})</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                          {token.chain} • {token.tokenStandard} • {token.contractAddress.slice(0, 6)}...
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono shrink-0 ml-1 ${
                        token.launchStatus === "Deployed"
                          ? "bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800/40"
                          : "bg-[#141418] text-[#8E9299] border border-[#1F1F24]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {token.launchStatus}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ============================================================ */}
        {/* 4. MAIN TAB CONTENT AREA                                      */}
        {/* ============================================================ */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-5">
          {/* ========================================================== */}
          {/* TAB 1: DEPLOYMENT QUEUE & LIVE EXECUTION                    */}
          {/* ========================================================== */}
          {activeTab === "queue" && (
            <div className="space-y-5">
              {/* Queue Controls & Execution Dashboard Header */}
              <div className="bg-[#141418] border border-[#1F1F24] rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-lg space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[#8E9299] font-semibold tracking-wider">
                        Queue Status:
                      </span>
                      {isExecutingQueue ? (
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 animate-pulse">
                          <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                          <span>
                            Deploying ({activeDeployingIndex !== null ? activeDeployingIndex + 1 : 1}/{queueItems.length})
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      ) : confirmedCount === queueItems.length && queueItems.length > 0 ? (
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>All {confirmedCount} Tokens Deployed</span>
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-[#0A0A0C] text-[#8E9299] border border-[#1F1F24]">
                          Ready ({queueItems.length} in queue)
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                      Clicking "Start Batch Deployment Queue" sequentially prompts contract broadcasts and confirms blocks on{" "}
                      <strong className="text-white">{currentNetwork.name}</strong>.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Primary Single-Click Action Buttons */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                    {!isExecutingQueue ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        id="btn-execute-batch-deploy-queue"
                        onClick={handleStartBatchQueue}
                        disabled={queueItems.length === 0}
                        className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-orange-500 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-orange-400 text-black font-extrabold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
                      >
                        <Play className="w-4 h-4 fill-black" />
                        <span>Execute Batch Deployment Queue ({queueItems.length})</span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={handleTogglePause}
                        className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                          isPaused
                            ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white border-emerald-500"
                            : "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-black border-amber-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isPaused ? <Play className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" /> : <Pause className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" />}
                        <span>{isPaused ? "Resume Queue" : "Pause Queue"}</span>
                      </button>
                    )}

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleRetryFailed}
                      className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] hover:border-amber-500/30 text-xs font-mono text-[#E0E0E0] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
                      title="Retry any failed queue items"
                    >
                      <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                      <span>Retry Failed</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleExportReceipt}
                      className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] hover:border-amber-500/30 text-xs font-mono text-[#E0E0E0] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
                      title="Download JSON receipt manifest"
                    >
                      <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                      <span>Export Receipt</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Live Progress Bar */}
                <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-[#1F1F24]">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                    <span>Queue Completion</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-bold">
                      {confirmedCount} of {queueItems.length} confirmed ({progressPercent}%)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-[#0A0A0C] h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[#1F1F24]">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-emerald-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Queue Items Table */}
              <div className="bg-[#141418] border border-[#1F1F24] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
                    <thead className="bg-[#0E0E12] border-b border-[#1F1F24] text-[#8E9299] text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4 w-12 text-center">#</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4">Token & Symbol</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4">Standard</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4">Queue Status</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4">Target Contract ID (EIP-55)</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4">Tx Hash / Block</th>
                        <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1F1F24]/70">
                      {queueItems.length === 0 ? (
                        <tr>
                          <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-[#8E9299]">
                            <Layers className="w-8 h-8 text-[#666] mx-auto mb-2 opacity-50" />
                            <p className="font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                              No Tokens Selected for Queue
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mx-auto mb-3">
                              Click "Select Vault Tokens" above to pick tokens from your saved vault.
                            </p>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setShowTokenPicker(true)}
                              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Open Vault Selector
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ) : (
                        queueItems.map((item, idx) => {
                          const isCurrent = activeDeployingIndex === idx;
                          return (
                            <tr
                              key={item.id}
                              className={`hover:bg-[#1A1A20]/70 transition-colors ${
                                isCurrent ? "bg-amber-500/5 border-l-2 border-l-amber-400" : ""
                              }`}
                            >
                              {/* Index */}
                              <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center text-[#8E9299] font-bold">
                                {idx + 1}
                              </td>

                              {/* Token Name & Symbol */}
                              <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                  <TokenImage
                                    token={item.token}
                                    size="sm"
                                    rounded="rounded-lg"
                                    fallbackSymbolLength={3}
                                  />
                                  <div>
                                    <div className="font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                      <span>{item.token.name}</span>
                                      <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-normal">
                                        (${item.token.symbol})
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">
                                      Supply: {Number(item.token.initialSupply || 1000000000).toLocaleString()}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </td>

                              {/* Standard */}
                              <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">
                                  {item.token.tokenStandard}
                                </span>
                              </td>

                              {/* Queue Status Badge */}
                              <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                                {item.status === "pending" && (
                                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono bg-[#0A0A0C] text-[#8E9299] border border-[#1F1F24]">
                                    <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                                    <span>Queued</span>
                                  </span>
                                )}

                                {item.status === "preparing" && (
                                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30 animate-pulse">
                                    <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                                    <span>Preparing Bytecode...</span>
                                  </span>
                                )}

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { Download, FileSpreadsheet } from "lucide-react";
import {
  GeneratedArtEngineAsset,
  calculateStatisticalRarityScores,
  downloadBatchSummaryCsv,
} from "../utils/artEngine";

interface BatchGenerationSummaryProps {
  tokenSymbol: string;
  assets: GeneratedArtEngineAsset[];
  selectedEdition: number;
  onSelectEdition: (edition: number) => void;
}

export const BatchGenerationSummary: React.FC<BatchGenerationSummaryProps> = ({
  tokenSymbol,
  assets,
  selectedEdition,
  onSelectEdition,
}) => {
  const { enrichedAssets } = useMemo(
    () => calculateStatisticalRarityScores(assets),
    [assets]
  );

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 overflow-hidden font-mono">
      <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-white">
          <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
          BatchGenerationSummary — Token ID, Rarity Score, Multiplier & IPFS URI Table
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => downloadBatchSummaryCsv(tokenSymbol, assets)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Download CSV Summary ({enrichedAssets.length} NFTs)
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-64">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead className="bg-slate-900/90 text-slate-400">
            <tr>
              <th className="py-2 px-3">Token ID</th>
              <th className="py-2 px-3">Rank</th>
              <th className="py-2 px-3">Rarity Score</th>
              <th className="py-2 px-3">Multiplier</th>
              <th className="py-2 px-3">Rarity Tier</th>
              <th className="py-2 px-3">IPFS Metadata URI</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/70">
            {enrichedAssets.map((item) => (
              <tr
                key={item.edition}
                onClick={() => onSelectEdition(item.edition)}
                className={`cursor-pointer transition ${
                  item.edition === selectedEdition
                    ? "bg-emerald-500/15"
                    : "hover:bg-slate-900/60"
                }`}
              >
                <td className="py-2 px-3 font-bold text-white">#{item.edition}</td>
                <td className="py-2 px-3 text-emerald-400">#{item.rarityRank}</td>
                <td className="py-2 px-3 text-amber-300">{item.rarityScore}</td>
                <td className="py-2 px-3 text-purple-300 font-bold">
                  {item.rarityMultiplier}x
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 px-3 text-sky-300">{item.rarityTier}</td>
                <td className="py-2 px-3 text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[240px]">
                  {item.ipfsMetadataUri}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default BatchGenerationSummary;

    "ethereum",
    "base",
    "arbitrum",
    "solana",
  ]);
  const [selectedNarratives, setSelectedNarratives] = useState<NarrativeCategory[]>([

  const [vanityPercentage, setVanityPercentage] = useState<number>(5);
  const [customVanityPrefix, setCustomVanityPrefix] = useState<string>("0x000");
  const [uint256Format, setUint256Format] = useState<"decimal" | "hex64">("decimal");
  const [eip55Checksum, setEip55Checksum] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [simulatedMarketData, setSimulatedMarketData] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [exportNotice, setExportNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedCsv, setCopiedCsv] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showPreviewModal, setShowPreviewModal] = useState<boolean>(false);

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import {
  X,

  ExternalLink,
  Copy,

  Download,
  Terminal,

  Layers,
  Sparkles,
  AlertCircle,
  Play,
  RefreshCw,
  CheckCircle2,
  Code2,
  ListOrdered,
  ArrowUpRight,
  HelpCircle,
  Sliders,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Cpu,
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  buildBatchVerificationQueue,
  EtherscanQueueItem,
  generateBatchVerificationBashScript,
} from "../utils/etherscanBatchVerifier";

interface BulkEtherscanVerifyModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedTokens: TokenRecord[];
  allTokens: TokenRecord[];
  onSelectAllTokens?: () => void;
}

export const BulkEtherscanVerifyModal: React.FC<BulkEtherscanVerifyModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedTokens,
  allTokens,
  onSelectAllTokens,
}) => {
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState<EtherscanQueueItem[]>([]);
  const [isOpeningTabs, setIsOpeningTabs] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [openedCount, setOpenedCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedItemId, setExpandedItemId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [popupNoticeVisible, setPopupNoticeVisible] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");

  // Determine active list: if user selected tokens, use those; otherwise use first 10 or all
  const activeTokens = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedTokens.length > 0) return selectedTokens;
    return allTokens.slice(0, 10);
  }, [selectedTokens, allTokens]);

  // Build the queue when modal opens or tokens change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && activeTokens.length > 0) {
      const generatedQueue = buildBatchVerificationQueue(activeTokens);
      setQueue(generatedQueue);
      setOpenedCount(0);
      setIsOpeningTabs(false);
      if (generatedQueue.length > 0) {
        setExpandedItemId(generatedQueue[0].id);
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, activeTokens]);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  // Open single tab
  const handleOpenSingleTab = (item: EtherscanQueueItem) => {
    window.open(item.verificationUrl, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
    setQueue((prev) =>
      prev.map((q) => (q.id === item.id ? { ...q, tabOpened: true, status: "opened" } : q))
    );
  };

  // Multi-tab batch launcher with safety delay to prevent browser popup suppression
  const handleLaunchBatchTabs = async () => {
    if (queue.length === 0 || isOpeningTabs) return;

    setIsOpeningTabs(true);
    let count = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < queue.length; i++) {
      const item = queue[i];
      try {
        window.open(item.verificationUrl, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
        count++;
        setOpenedCount(count);
        setQueue((prev) =>
          prev.map((q, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...q, tabOpened: true, status: "opened" } : q))
        );
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Popup blocked for item", item.contractAddress, err);
      }

      // 350ms delay between tabs for browser pop-up dispatcher
      if (i < queue.length - 1) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 350));
      }
    }

    setIsOpeningTabs(false);
  };

  // Copy all verification URLs
  const handleCopyAllLinks = () => {
    const urls = queue.map((item) => `${item.name} (${item.symbol}): ${item.verificationUrl}`).join("\n");
    handleCopy(urls, "all-urls");
  };

  // Download batch automation script
  const handleDownloadScript = () => {
    const script = generateBatchVerificationBashScript(queue);
    const blob = new Blob([script], { type: "text/x-shellscript" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `batch_verify_etherscan_${queue.length}_contracts.sh`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Download all verification JSON payloads
  const handleDownloadBatchJson = () => {
    const payload = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      totalContracts: queue.length,
      compilerTarget: "v0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9",
      optimizerRuns: 200,
      contracts: queue.map((item) => ({
        name: item.name,
        symbol: item.symbol,
        contractAddress: item.contractAddress,
        chain: item.chain,
        explorerName: item.explorerName,
        verificationUrl: item.verificationUrl,
        contractCodeUrl: item.contractCodeUrl,
        contractName: item.contractName,
        compilerVersion: item.compilerVersion,
        constructorArgsHex: item.constructorArgsHex,
        publicContractId: item.publicContractId,
        sourceCode: item.sourceCode,
      })),
    };
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `etherscan_batch_verification_${queue.length}_contracts.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const filteredQueue = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return queue;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return queue.filter(
      (item) =>
        item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.chain.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [queue, searchQuery]);
