        timestamp: now - (CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.length - i) * 800,
        timeFormatted: new Date(now - (CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.length - i) * 800).toLocaleTimeString(),
        tokenSymbol: mockToken.symbol,
        contractAddress: mockToken.contractAddress,
        networkId: mockToken.networkId,
        status,
      };
    });
  });

  // Current per-chain latest latency record
  const latestByChain = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Partial<Record<ChainType, LatencySample>> = {};
    samples.forEach((s) => {
      if (!map[s.chain]) {
        map[s.chain] = s;
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [samples]);

  // Aggregate Stats
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (samples.length === 0) {
      return {
        avgTotalMs: 0,
        avgGenMs: 0,
        avgNetMs: 0,
        fastestChain: "None",
        fastestMs: 0,
        slowestChain: "None",
        slowestMs: 0,
        p95Ms: 0,
        tokensPerSec: 0,
        totalMeasurements: 0,
      };
    }

    const totals = samples.map((s) => s.totalMs).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const sumTotal = totals.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0);
    const sumGen = samples.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.generationMs, 0);
    const sumNet = samples.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.networkMs, 0);

    const avgTotal = sumTotal / totals.length;
    const avgGen = sumGen / samples.length;
    const avgNet = sumNet / samples.length;

    // P95
    const p95Idx = Math.floor(totals.length * 0.95);
    const p95 = totals[Math.min(p95Idx, totals.length - 1)];

    // Fastest & slowest from latest readings
    let fastest = CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES[0];
    let fastestVal = 9999;
    let slowest = CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES[0];
    let slowestVal = 0;

    CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.forEach((env) => {
      const rec = latestByChain[env.chain];
      if (rec) {
        if (rec.totalMs < fastestVal) {
          fastestVal = rec.totalMs;
          fastest = env;
        }
        if (rec.totalMs > slowestVal) {
          slowestVal = rec.totalMs;
          slowest = env;
        }
      }
    });

    // Approximate generation throughput in tokens/sec
    const tokensPerSec = avgGen > 0 ? Math.round(1000 / avgGen) : 2500;

    return {
      avgTotalMs: Number(avgTotal.toFixed(2)),
      avgGenMs: Number(avgGen.toFixed(2)),
      avgNetMs: Number(avgNet.toFixed(2)),
      fastestChain: fastest.name,
      fastestMs: Number(fastestVal.toFixed(2)),
      slowestChain: slowest.name,
      slowestMs: Number(slowestVal.toFixed(2)),
      p95Ms: Number(p95.toFixed(2)),
      tokensPerSec,
      totalMeasurements: samples.length,
    };
  }, [samples, latestByChain]);

  /**
   * Execute single round-trip token generation benchmark using performance.now()
   */
  const pingChain = useCallback(
    async (chainType: ChainType, customIndex?: number): Promise<LatencySample> => {
      const env = CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.find((p) => p.chain === chainType) || CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES[0];

      // 1. High-Precision Start
      const t0 = performance.now();

      // 2. Real Token Generation logic execution
      const tokenIndex = customIndex || Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000) + 1;
      const generated = generateTokenRecord(tokenIndex, { chains: [chainType] });

      // 3. Measure code generation timestamp
      const tGen = performance.now();
      const generationDuration = tGen - t0;

      // 4. Realistic RPC / Mempool Round-Trip simulation with natural variance
      const jitter = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * env.jitterVariance;
      const targetDelay = Math.max(8, env.baseRpcDelay + jitter);

      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, targetDelay));

      // 5. Total Round-Trip End
      const tEnd = performance.now();
      const totalDuration = tEnd - t0;
      const networkDuration = tEnd - tGen;

      const totalMs = Number(totalDuration.toFixed(2));
      const genMs = Number(generationDuration.toFixed(2));
      const netMs = Number(networkDuration.toFixed(2));

      const status = totalMs < 35 ? "optimal" : totalMs < 75 ? "nominal" : "congested";
      const now = Date.now();

      const sample: LatencySample = {
        id: `sample-${chainType}-${now}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
        chain: chainType,
        chainName: env.name,
        totalMs,
        generationMs: genMs,
        networkMs: netMs,
        timestamp: now,
        timeFormatted: new Date(now).toLocaleTimeString(),
        tokenSymbol: generated.symbol,
        contractAddress: generated.contractAddress,
        networkId: generated.networkId,
        status,
      };

      setSamples((prev) => [sample, ...prev.slice(0, 49)]); // Keep last 50
      return sample;
    },
    []
  );

  /**
   * Benchmark all chain environments sequentially
   */
  const benchmarkAllChains = async () => {
    if (isBenchmarking) return;
    setIsBenchmarking(true);
    setBenchmarkProgress(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.length; i++) {
      const env = CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES[i];
      await pingChain(env.chain);
      setBenchmarkProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.length) * 100));
    }

    setIsBenchmarking(false);
  };

  /**
   * Run 10x Stress Burst to test throughput and jitter
   */
  const runStressTest = async () => {
    if (stressRunning) return;
    setStressRunning(true);

    const stressChains: ChainType[] = ["solana", "arbitrum", "base", "ethereum"];
    for (let cycle = 0; cycle < 10; cycle++) {
      const chain = stressChains[cycle % stressChains.length];
      await pingChain(chain, 90000 + cycle);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 60));
    }

    setStressRunning(false);
  };

  // Live Auto-Ping Interval
  const autoPingRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const roundRobinIdx = useRef<number>(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAutoPingActive) {
      if (autoPingRef.current) clearInterval(autoPingRef.current);
      return;
    }

    autoPingRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      const nextEnv = CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES[roundRobinIdx.current % CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.length];
      roundRobinIdx.current += 1;
      pingChain(nextEnv.chain);
    }, autoPingIntervalSec * 1000);

    return () => {
      if (autoPingRef.current) clearInterval(autoPingRef.current);
    };
  }, [isAutoPingActive, autoPingIntervalSec, pingChain]);

  // Recharts Bar Data: Latest per chain
  const chartBarData = useMemo(() => {
    return CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.map((env) => {
      const sample = latestByChain[env.chain];
      return {
        name: env.name,
        chain: env.chain,
        total: sample ? sample.totalMs : env.baseRpcDelay,
        gen: sample ? sample.generationMs : 1.2,
        network: sample ? sample.networkMs : env.baseRpcDelay,
        color: env.accentColor,
        envType: env.envType,
      };
    });
  }, [latestByChain]);

  // Recharts Line Data: Chronological trend
  const chartLineData = useMemo(() => {
    const chronoSorted = [...samples].reverse().slice(-20);
    return chronoSorted.map((s, idx) => ({
      index: idx + 1,
      time: s.timeFormatted,
      chain: s.chainName,
      total: s.totalMs,
      gen: s.generationMs,
      network: s.networkMs,
    }));
  }, [samples]);

  const filteredSamples = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeChainFilter === "all") return samples;
    return samples.filter((s) => s.chain === activeChainFilter);
  }, [samples, activeChainFilter]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl" id="widget-chain-latency-monitor">
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-[#1F1F23] bg-[#0E0E12] flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#16161A] border border-[#26262B] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-[#F27D26] animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight uppercase flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span>Real-Time Chain Latency Monitor</span>
                </h3>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
                  <span>Live Heartbeat</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] mt-0.5">
                Precision tracking via <code className="text-[#F27D26] font-mono">performance.now()</code> API • Sub-millisecond round-trip speed of token generation & simulated chain broadcast
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 self-start md:self-auto">
          {/* Auto Ping Switch */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono">
            <button
              type="button"
              id="btn-toggle-autoping"
              onClick={() => setIsAutoPingActive((prev) => !prev)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                isAutoPingActive
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title={isAutoPingActive ? "Pause continuous auto-ping" : "Resume auto-ping"}
            >
              {isAutoPingActive ? <Pause className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Play className="w-3 h-3" />}
              <span>{isAutoPingActive ? "Auto-Ping ON" : "Auto-Ping OFF"}</span>
            </button>

            {isAutoPingActive && (
              <select
                id="select-autoping-interval"
                value={autoPingIntervalSec}
                onChange={(e) => setAutoPingIntervalSec(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="bg-[#16161A] text-white text-[11px] border border-[#26262B] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26]"
              >
                <option value={2}>Every 2s</option>
                <option value={3}>Every 3s</option>
                <option value={5}>Every 5s</option>
                <option value={10}>Every 10s</option>
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Benchmark All Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            id="btn-benchmark-all-chains"
            onClick={benchmarkAllChains}
            disabled={isBenchmarking}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              isBenchmarking
                ? "bg-[#26262B] text-[#8E9299] border-[#333] cursor-not-allowed"
                : "bg-[#F27D26]/10 text-[#F27D26] border-[#F27D26]/30 hover:bg-[#F27D26]/20 active:scale-95"
            }`}
          >
            <RotateCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isBenchmarking ? "animate-spin text-[#F27D26]" : ""}`} />
            <span>{isBenchmarking ? `Benchmarking (${benchmarkProgress}%)` : "Benchmark All"}</span>
          </button>

          {/* Stress Test 10x */}
          <button
            type="button"
            id="btn-stress-test-chains"
            onClick={runStressTest}
            disabled={stressRunning}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              stressRunning
                ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/40"
                : "bg-[#16161A] text-[#8E9299] border-[#1F1F23] hover:text-white hover:border-[#333]"
            }`}
            title="Fire 10 rapid burst generation cycles"
          >
            <Flame className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${stressRunning ? "text-amber-400 animate-bounce" : "text-amber-500"}`} />
            <span>{stressRunning ? "Burst Testing..." : "10x Burst"}</span>
          </button>

          {/* Toggle Expand */}
          <button
            type="button"
            id="btn-toggle-latency-expand"
            onClick={() => setIsExpanded((prev) => !prev)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
            title={isExpanded ? "Collapse Widget" : "Expand Widget"}
          >
            {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Primary Content (Expandable) */}
      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-5">
          {/* Quick Real-Time Metrics Strip */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            {/* 1. Fastest Chain */}
            <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                <span className="uppercase">Fastest Network</span>
                <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400">
                  {stats.fastestMs} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-[#8E9299]">ms</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-white truncate">({stats.fastestChain})</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block mt-0.5">SVM / Rollup Pipeline</span>
            </div>

            {/* 2. Average Round-Trip */}
            <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                <span className="uppercase">Fleet Average</span>
                <Gauge className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-mono text-[#F27D26]">
                  {stats.avgTotalMs} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-[#8E9299]">ms</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">P95: {stats.p95Ms}ms</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block mt-0.5">
                Gen: {stats.avgGenMs}ms • Net: {stats.avgNetMs}ms
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* 3. Compute Engine Rate */}
            <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                <span className="uppercase">Gen Throughput</span>
                <Cpu className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-mono text-blue-400">
                  ~{stats.tokensPerSec.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-[#8E9299]">tokens/sec</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block mt-0.5">Cryptographic Synthesis</span>
            </div>

            {/* 4. Timer Telemetry */}
            <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                <span className="uppercase">Timer API</span>
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-sm font-bold font-mono text-white">performance.now()</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-purple-300/80 block mt-0.5 font-mono">
                {stats.totalMeasurements} samples recorded
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Sub-Navigation Tabs */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#1F1F23] pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23]">
              <button
                type="button"
                id="tab-latency-cards"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab("cards")}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                  activeTab === "cards"
                    ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                <Layers className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Chain Cards</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                id="tab-latency-chart"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab("chart")}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                  activeTab === "chart"
                    ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                <BarChart2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Comparative Chart</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                id="tab-latency-log"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab("log")}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                  activeTab === "log"
                    ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Round-Trip Log ({samples.length})</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Filter by chain in log/card views */}
            {activeTab !== "chart" && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
                <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Filter:</span>
                <select
                  id="select-filter-latency-chain"
                  value={activeChainFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setActiveChainFilter(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-[#0A0A0C] text-white border border-[#1F1F23] rounded px-2 py-1 cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26]"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Chains ({CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.length})</option>
                  {CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.map((env) => (
                    <option key={env.chain} value={env.chain}>
                      {env.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Chart View Toggle */}
            {activeTab === "chart" && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1 rounded border border-[#1F1F23] text-xs font-mono">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setChartView("bar")}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer ${
                    chartView === "bar" ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border border-[#333]" : "text-[#8E9299]"
                  }`}
                >
                  Bar
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setChartView("line")}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer ${
                    chartView === "line" ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border border-[#333]" : "text-[#8E9299]"
                  }`}
                >
                  Trend Stream
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* TAB 1: CHAIN CARDS GRID */}
          {activeTab === "cards" && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
              {CHAIN_ENV_PROFILES.filter(
                (env) => activeChainFilter === "all" || env.chain === activeChainFilter
              ).map((env) => {
                const sample = latestByChain[env.chain];
                const total = sample ? sample.totalMs : env.baseRpcDelay;
                const gen = sample ? sample.generationMs : 1.2;
                const net = sample ? sample.networkMs : env.baseRpcDelay;

                // Status classification
                const status = total < 35 ? "optimal" : total < 75 ? "nominal" : "congested";
                const statusBadge =
                  status === "optimal"
                    ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30"
                    : status === "nominal"
                    ? "bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/30"
                    : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30";

                // Relative bar fill (max 120ms baseline)
                const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(8, (total / 120) * 100));

                return (
                  <div
                    key={env.chain}
                    className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 hover:border-[#2D2D35] transition-all"
                  >
                    {/* Header: Icon + Name + Ping button */}
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <ChainIcon chain={env.chain} size="sm" showContainer />
                        <div>
                          <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white leading-tight flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span>{env.name}</span>
                          </h4>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono block truncate max-w-[130px]">
                            {env.envType}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        id={`btn-ping-chain-${env.chain}`}
                        onClick={() => pingChain(env.chain)}
                        className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#16161A] text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] hover:text-[#F27D26] hover:border-[#F27D26]/40 border border-[#1F1F23] cursor-pointer transition-colors shrink-0"
                        title={`Run test ping for ${env.name}`}
                      >
                        Ping
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {/* Latency Number & Status */}
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
                        <span className="text-xl font-bold font-mono tracking-tight text-white">
                          {total} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-[#8E9299]">ms</span>
                        </span>
                        <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-mono border uppercase ${statusBadge}`}>
                          {status}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Visual Meter Bar */}
                      <div className="w-full bg-[#16161A] h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[#222]">
                        <div
                          className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                          style={{
                            width: `${percent}%`,
                            backgroundColor: env.accentColor,
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>

                      {/* Sub-breakdown */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] pt-1">
                        <span>
                          Gen: <strong className="text-white">{gen}ms</strong>
                        </span>
                        <span>
                          Net: <strong className="text-white">{net}ms</strong>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Last sample note */}
                    {sample && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[#1F1F23] flex items-center justify-between text-[9px] font-mono text-[#666]">
                        <span className="truncate max-w-[120px]" title={sample.tokenSymbol}>
                          Token: {sample.tokenSymbol}
                        </span>
                        <span>{sample.timeFormatted.split(" ")[0]}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: RECHARTS COMPARATIVE VISUALIZER */}
          {activeTab === "chart" && (
            <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-4 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>

  onToggleConstantLoop: () => void;

  onOpenVault: () => void;

  const [generationIntervalSec, setGenerationIntervalSec] = useState<number>(3);
  const [batchPerTick, setBatchPerTick] = useState<number>(5);
  const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error" | "secured">("idle");

  const [firebaseTokensCount, setFirebaseTokensCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [showConfig, setShowConfig] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [securedNotification, setSecuredNotification] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Sync with Firestore on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadGeneratorState().then((state) => {
      if (state) {
        setAutoSaveToFirebase(state.autoSaveEnabled ?? true);
        if (state.lastSavedAt) {
          setLastSavedTimestamp(new Date(state.lastSavedAt).toLocaleTimeString());
        }
      }
    });

    // Real-time listener for remote tokens count
    const unsubscribe = subscribeToTokens(
      (remoteTokens) => {
        setFirebaseTokensCount(remoteTokens.length);
      },
      undefined,
      () => {
        // Guarded by Centralized Sync & Permission Guard with local fallback
      }
    );

    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  // Constant Generator Loop: Strictly only generates when constantLoopActive is TRUE
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer: any = null;

    if (constantLoopActive) {
      // Check immediately if already at max capacity
      if (tokens.length >= maxCapacity) {
        onToggleConstantLoop();
        triggerMaxCapacitySecurity(tokens);
        return;
      }

      timer = setInterval(async () => {
        // Enforce maximum list capacity
        const remainingSlots = maxCapacity - tokens.length;
        if (remainingSlots <= 0) {
          onToggleConstantLoop();
          triggerMaxCapacitySecurity(tokens);
          return;
        }

        const countToGenerate = Math.min(batchPerTick, remainingSlots);
        const newBatch = generateTokenBatch(countToGenerate, {
          chains: ["ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "solana", "quantum"],
          narratives: ["ai_agents", "depin", "rwa", "quantum_defi"],
          standards: ["ERC-20", "ERC-721", "ERC-1155"],
          includeVanity: true,
          vanityPercentage: 15,
          eip55Checksum: true,
        });

        onAppendTokens(newBatch);

        // Check if this batch hit max capacity
        if (tokens.length + countToGenerate >= maxCapacity) {
          onToggleConstantLoop();
          triggerMaxCapacitySecurity([...newBatch, ...tokens]);
          return;
        }

        // Instant Auto-Save to Firebase Token Vault
        if (autoSaveToFirebase) {
          setSaveStatus("saving");
          try {
            const res = await persistTokenBatch(newBatch, { source: "constant_loop" });
            if (res.success) {
              setSaveStatus("saved");
              setLastSavedTimestamp(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
              setTotalSavedCount((prev) => prev + res.savedCount);
              setTimeout(() => setSaveStatus("idle"), 1500);
            } else {
              setSaveStatus("error");
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error("Auto save to vault failed:", err);
            setSaveStatus("error");
          }
        }
      }, generationIntervalSec * 1000);
    }

    return () => {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [constantLoopActive, generationIntervalSec, batchPerTick, autoSaveToFirebase, tokens.length, maxCapacity]);

        setLastSavedTimestamp(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());

        setLastSavedTimestamp(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());

        // Update persistent generator state
        await saveGeneratorState({

                  Max Capacity Secured
                </span>

            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import QRCode from "qrcode";
import {
  QrCode,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Download,
  Share2,
  Smartphone,
  ExternalLink,
  Sparkles,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";

export type QrPayloadMode =
  | "raw_address"
  | "eip681_wallet"
  | "explorer_url"
  | "json_manifest";

export type QrThemePreset = "crisp_white" | "cyber_cyan" | "sovereign_gold";

export type QrAddressTarget = "contract" | "deployer" | "treasury";

export interface ContractAddressQrGeneratorProps {
  contractAddress: string;
  tokenName: string;
  tokenSymbol: string;
  chain: string;
  tokenStandard?: string;
  decimals?: number;
  deployerAddress?: string;
  treasuryAddress?: string;
  explorerUrl?: string;
  compactByDefault?: boolean;
}

const CHAIN_ID_LOOKUP: Record<string, number> = {
  ethereum: 1,
  base: 8453,
  polygon: 137,
  arbitrum: 42161,
  optimism: 10,
  avalanche: 43114,
  bsc: 56,
};

const THEME_PALETTES: Record<
  QrThemePreset,
  { label: string; dark: string; light: string; badge: string }
> = {
  crisp_white: {
    label: "Crisp White (Universal Scan)",
    dark: "#0A0A0C",
    light: "#FFFFFF",
    badge: "bg-white text-black border-zinc-300",
  },
  cyber_cyan: {
    label: "Cyber Cyan",
    dark: "#00F0FF",
    light: "#0A0A0C",
    badge: "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-500/40",
  },
  sovereign_gold: {
    label: "Sovereign Gold",
    dark: "#F0D89B",
    light: "#0B0D10",
    badge: "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-200 border-amber-500/40",
  },
};

export const ContractAddressQrGenerator: React.FC<
  ContractAddressQrGeneratorProps
> = ({
  contractAddress,
  tokenName,
  tokenSymbol,
  chain,
  tokenStandard = "ERC-20",
  decimals = 18,
  deployerAddress,
  treasuryAddress,
  explorerUrl,
  compactByDefault = false,
}) => {
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState<boolean>(!compactByDefault);
  const [payloadMode, setPayloadMode] = useState<QrPayloadMode>("raw_address");
  const [themePreset, setThemePreset] = useState<QrThemePreset>("crisp_white");
  const [addressTarget, setAddressTarget] =
    useState<QrAddressTarget>("contract");
  const [qrDataUrl, setQrDataUrl] = useState<string>("");
  const [copiedState, setCopiedState] = useState<string | null>(null);

    if (addressTarget === "deployer" && deployerAddress) {
      return deployerAddress;
    }
    if (addressTarget === "treasury" && treasuryAddress) {
      return treasuryAddress;
    }
    return contractAddress;
  }, [addressTarget, contractAddress, deployerAddress, treasuryAddress]);

  const resolvedExplorerUrl = useMemo(() => {
    if (explorerUrl && addressTarget === "contract") return explorerUrl;
    const normalized = chain.toLowerCase();
    if (normalized === "base") {
      return `https://basescan.org/address/${activeAddress}`;
    }
    if (normalized === "polygon") {
      return `https://polygonscan.com/address/${activeAddress}`;
    }
    if (normalized === "solana") {
      return `https://solscan.io/account/${activeAddress}`;
    }
    return `https://etherscan.io/address/${activeAddress}`;
  }, [explorerUrl, addressTarget, chain, activeAddress]);

  const encodedPayload = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedChain = chain.toLowerCase();

    switch (payloadMode) {
      case "raw_address":
        return activeAddress;
      case "eip681_wallet":
        if (normalizedChain === "solana") {
          return `solana:${activeAddress}?label=${encodeURIComponent(
            `${tokenName} (${tokenSymbol})`
          )}`;
        }
        if (normalizedChain === "bitcoin") {
          return `bitcoin:${activeAddress}?label=${encodeURIComponent(
            `${tokenName} (${tokenSymbol})`
          )}`;

        return `ethereum:${activeAddress}${chainId ? `@${chainId}` : ""}`;

  return (

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                <ShieldCheck className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                ECC Level H (30%)
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-0.5">

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  X,
  Binary,
  Cpu,
  Layers,
  FileCode,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Download,
  Search,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  Zap,
  RefreshCw,
  Terminal,
  Activity,
  Code2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  decompileContractBytecode,
  DecompiledContractStructure,
} from "../utils/contractDecompiler";

interface ContractDecompilerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  token: TokenRecord | null;
}

export const ContractDecompilerModal: React.FC<ContractDecompilerModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  token,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"structure" | "opcodes" | "bytecode" | "security_re">("structure");
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [decompileResult, setDecompileResult] = useState<DecompiledContractStructure | null>(null);
  const [opcodeSearch, setOpcodeSearch] = useState<string>("");
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && token) {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setOpcodeSearch("");
      decompileContractBytecode(
        token.contractAddress || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
        token.chain || token.network || "Ethereum Mainnet"
      )
        .then((result) => {
          setDecompileResult(result);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          setIsLoading(false);
        });
    }
  }, [isOpen, token]);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownloadSol = () => {
    if (!decompileResult || !token) return;
    const blob = new Blob([decompileResult.decompiledSolidity], { type: "text/plain" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${token.symbol || "Contract"}_Decompiled.sol`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const filteredOpcodes = useMemo(() => {
    if (!decompileResult) return [];
    if (!opcodeSearch.trim()) return decompileResult.opcodes;
    const q = opcodeSearch.toLowerCase();
    return decompileResult.opcodes.filter(
      (op) =>
        op.mnemonic.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        op.hexPc.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (op.operand && op.operand.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }, [decompileResult, opcodeSearch]);

  if (!isOpen || !token) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md animate-fade-in">
      <div
        id="contract-decompiler-modal"
        className="bg-[#0D0E15] border border-[#252838] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-5xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-[#1F2230] flex items-center justify-between bg-[#12141F]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-cyan-500/20 to-blue-500/20 border border-cyan-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400">
              <Binary className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white font-mono">
                  EVM Contract Bytecode Decompiler
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 font-bold">
                  {decompileResult?.detectedStandard || "EVM Standard"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                Decodes on-chain runtime bytecode, extracts compiler metadata, function dispatchers, and storage layouts
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-[#1C1F2D] transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 flex-wrap">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block">Target Contract</span>
              <span className="text-white font-bold">{token.name} ({token.symbol})</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[#252838] hidden sm:block" />
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block">Address</span>
              <span className="text-cyan-400 font-bold select-all">{token.contractAddress}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-6 w-px bg-[#252838] hidden sm:block" />
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block">Network</span>
              <span className="text-gray-300">{token.chain || token.network}</span>

import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  OPENZEPPELIN_PRESETS,
  OpenZeppelinStandardPreset,
  computeContractDiff,
  DiffReport,
} from "../utils/openzeppelinStandards";
import {
  GitCompare,
  Split,
  FileCode,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Download,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  Sparkles,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  ChevronRight,
  Maximize2,
  Terminal,
  Zap,
  Info,
} from "lucide-react";
import { buildRemixIdeUrl } from "../utils/metamaskContractGenerator";

interface ContractDiffViewerProps {
  token: TokenRecord | null;
  generatedSolidity: string;
  onOpenSolidityEditor?: () => void;
  onDeployToMetaMask?: () => void;
}

export const ContractDiffViewer: React.FC<ContractDiffViewerProps> = ({
  token,
  generatedSolidity,
  onOpenSolidityEditor,
  onDeployToMetaMask,
}) => {
  // Determine default preset based on token standard
  const initialPresetId = useMemo(() => {
    if (!token) return "oz_erc20_standard";
    if (token.tokenStandard === "ERC-721") return "oz_erc721_standard";
    if (token.tokenStandard === "ERC-1155") return "oz_erc1155_standard";
    return "oz_erc20_ownable2step_permit";
  }, [token]);

  const [selectedPresetId, setSelectedPresetId] = useState<string>(initialPresetId);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<"split" | "unified" | "audit">("split");
  const [ignoreWhitespace, setIgnoreWhitespace] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showOnlyDiffs, setShowOnlyDiffs] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedDiff, setCopiedDiff] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Active OpenZeppelin preset
  const activePreset: OpenZeppelinStandardPreset = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      OPENZEPPELIN_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === selectedPresetId) ||
      OPENZEPPELIN_PRESETS[0]
    );
  }, [selectedPresetId]);

  // Compute diff
  const diffReport: DiffReport = useMemo(() => {
    return computeContractDiff(activePreset.code, generatedSolidity, ignoreWhitespace);
  }, [activePreset, generatedSolidity, ignoreWhitespace]);

  // Filter lines if showOnlyDiffs is enabled
  const displayLines = useMemo(() => {
    if (!showOnlyDiffs) return diffReport.lines;
    return diffReport.lines.filter((l) => l.type !== "unchanged");
  }, [diffReport, showOnlyDiffs]);

  // Copy entire git-style diff
  const handleCopyDiff = () => {
    const diffText = [
      `--- ${activePreset.filePath} (${activePreset.version})`,
      `+++ contracts/${token?.symbol || "Token"}.sol (Generated Implementation)`,
      `@@ -1,${diffReport.totalLinesLeft} +1,${diffReport.totalLinesRight} @@`,
      ...diffReport.lines.map((l) => {
        if (l.type === "added") return `+ ${l.rightContent}`;
        if (l.type === "removed") return `- ${l.leftContent}`;
        return `  ${l.leftContent || l.rightContent}`;
      }),
    ].join("\n");

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(diffText);
    setCopiedDiff(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedDiff(false), 2000);
  };

  // Download patch file
  const handleDownloadPatch = () => {
    const patchText = [
      `# OpenZeppelin v5.0 Standard vs ${token?.symbol || "Token"} Implementation Diff`,
      `# Base Reference: ${activePreset.name} (${activePreset.filePath})`,
      `# Target Token: ${token?.name || "Token"} (${token?.symbol || "TOK"})`,
      `# Generated Timestamp: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
      `# Standard Compliance Score: ${diffReport.similarityScore}%`,
      "",
      `--- a/${activePreset.filePath}`,
      `+++ b/contracts/${token?.symbol || "Token"}.sol`,
      ...diffReport.lines.map((l) => {
        if (l.type === "added") return `+ ${l.rightContent}`;
        if (l.type === "removed") return `- ${l.leftContent}`;
        return `  ${l.leftContent || l.rightContent}`;
      }),
    ].join("\n");

    const blob = new Blob([patchText], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${token?.symbol || "contract"}_vs_openzeppelin.diff`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleOpenRemix = () => {
    const url = buildRemixIdeUrl(generatedSolidity, `${token?.symbol || "Token"}.sol`);
    window.open(url, "_blank");
  };

  return (

              <span>{copiedDiff ? "Diff Copied!" : "Copy Diff"}</span>
            </button>

            <button

import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import { MaxThresholdInventionEngine } from "./MaxThresholdInventionEngine";
import { saveTokensToFirestore } from "../lib/firebase";
import { generateEVMAddress, generateUint256TokenId, generateRandomHex } from "../utils/cryptoGenerators";

interface Message {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

const STEP_BY_STEP_MODULES = [
  {
    step: 1,
    title: "Tokenomics & Economic Architecture",
    badge: "Phase 1: Design",
    summary: "Define total supply, inflation/deflation curves, vesting cliffs, staking yields, and utility sinks.",
    keyMetrics: [
      "Total Supply: 1,000,000,000 units (18 decimals)",
      "Public Liquidity: 35% at TGE",
      "Treasury & Compute Staking: 25% (4-yr linear release)",
      "Team & Devs: 18% (1-yr cliff, 3-yr vest)",
      "Strategic Reserve: 12%",
      "Ecosystem Grants: 10%",
    ],
    codeSnippet: `// Tokenomics Model Calculation (Python)
def calculate_emission(initial_supply=1_000_000_000, halving_years=2, years=10):
    supply = initial_supply
    for y in range(1, years + 1):
        inflation = (0.05 / (2 ** (y // halving_years)))
        minted = supply * inflation
        supply += minted
        print(f"Year {y}: +{minted:,.0f} tokens (Total: {supply:,.0f})")`,
  },
  {
    step: 2,
    title: "Consensus & Ledger Paradigm",
    badge: "Phase 2: Architecture",
    summary: "Select between an EVM Smart Contract (Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum) or a standalone Layer-1 Chain.",
    keyMetrics: [
      "EVM Standard: ERC-20 / ERC-721 / ERC-1155 / Quantum-Hybrid",
      "Gas Mechanism: Native EIP-1559 burn or gasless ERC-4337 paymasters",
      "Custom Chain Alternative: CometBFT PoS (Cosmos SDK) or Geth EVM Fork",
      "Block Time: 2.0s (L2 Rollups) to 12.0s (Ethereum L1)",
    ],
    codeSnippet: `// Hardhat & Foundry Config (foundry.toml)
[profile.default]
src = "src"
out = "out"
libs = ["lib"]
solc_version = "0.8.24"
optimizer = true
optimizer_runs = 1000000
evm_version = "cancun"`,
  },
  {
    step: 3,
    title: "Smart Contract & Genesis Implementation",
    badge: "Phase 3: Engineering",
    summary: "Write robust Solidity 0.8.24+ contracts with OpenZeppelin 5.0, ReentrancyGuard, and Permit.",
    keyMetrics: [
      "OpenZeppelin 5.0 ERC20Permit (EIP-2612 gasless approvals)",
      "ERC-4337 Account Abstraction compatible",
      "2-Step Ownership transfer (Ownable2Step)",
      "Custom minting caps and deterministic address salts (CREATE2)",
    ],
    codeSnippet: `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Permit.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol";

contract NextGenCrypto is ERC20Permit, Ownable2Step {
    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000 * 1e18;

    constructor(address initialOwner) 
        ERC20("Autonomous Quantum Currency", "AQC") 
        ERC20Permit("Autonomous Quantum Currency") 
        Ownable(initialOwner) 
    {
        _mint(initialOwner, MAX_SUPPLY);
    }
}`,
  },
  {
    step: 4,
    title: "Local Testing & Public Testnets",
    badge: "Phase 4: Verification",
    summary: "Simulate edge cases locally using Foundry fuzzing before broadcasting to Sepolia or Base Sepolia.",
    keyMetrics: [
      "Foundry Invariant Fuzzing: 100,000 random transaction runs",
      "Public Testnets: Ethereum Sepolia, Holesky, Base Sepolia",
      "Testnet Faucets & RPC Node Providers (Alchemy / Infura / QuickNode)",
    ],
    codeSnippet: `# Foundry Deployment Command
forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:DeployScript \\
  --rpc-url https://sepolia.infura.io/v3/$API_KEY \\
  --private-key $DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY \\
  --broadcast \\
  --verify \\
  --etherscan-api-key $ETHERSCAN_KEY`,
  },
  {
    step: 5,
    title: "Security Audits & Formal Verification",
    badge: "Phase 5: Security",
    summary: "Run automated static analysis (Slither, Mythril) and invariant tests before mainnet.",
    keyMetrics: [
      "Slither Static Analyzer: Zero high/medium findings",
      "Mythril Symbolic Execution: Reentrancy & overflow verified",
      "Safe Multi-Sig (3/5 threshold) + 48-hour Timelock controller",
    ],
    codeSnippet: `# Run Slither Security Suite
pip3 install slither-analyzer
slither . --print human-summary
slither . --detect reentrancy-eth,unprotected-upgrade,arbitrary-send-erc20`,
  },
  {
    step: 6,
    title: "Mainnet Genesis, Liquidity & DEX Listing",
    badge: "Phase 6: Mainnet Launch",
    summary: "Execute mainnet deployment, verify source code on Etherscan, and seed Uniswap v3/v4 pools.",
    keyMetrics: [
      "Mainnet Broadcast: Ethereum Mainnet (ChainID: 1) or Base (8453)",
      "Uniswap v3 Liquidity: Pair with ETH/USDC with concentrated tick ranges",
      "Liquidity Lock: 100% of initial LP tokens locked via UNCX / Team.Finance",
      "CoinGecko / CoinMarketCap DEX listing tracker metadata indexation",
    ],
    codeSnippet: `// Uniswap v3 Pool Initialization (Solidity)
INonfungiblePositionManager.MintParams memory params = 
    INonfungiblePositionManager.MintParams({
        token0: tokenA,
        token1: tokenB,
        fee: 3000, // 0.3% fee tier
        tickLower: -887220,
        tickUpper: 887220,
        amount0Desired: tokenAmount,
        amount1Desired: ethAmount,
        amount0Min: 0,
        amount1Min: 0,
        recipient: treasurySafe,
        deadline: block.timestamp + 1200
    });`,
  },
];

interface CryptoArchitectProps {
  onInventToken?: (tokens: TokenRecord[]) => void;
  onSendToRemix?: (solidityCode: string, tokenName: string) => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: string) => void;
}

export const CryptoArchitect: React.FC<CryptoArchitectProps> = ({
  onInventToken,
  onSendToRemix,
  onNavigateTab,
}) => {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<"max_thresholds" | "roadmap" | "ai_inventor" | "cli_cheatsheet">("max_thresholds");
  const [selectedStep, setSelectedStep] = useState<number>(1);
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [simulatedTokenSuccess, setSimulatedTokenSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // AI Invention conversation state
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([
    {
      role: "assistant",
      content: `### Welcome to the 2026 Cryptocurrency Invention & Deployment Engine

I am your out-of-sandbox Blockchain Architect. You can ask me to:
1. **Invent completely novel cryptocurrencies** (e.g. AI-agent swarm incentives, zero-knowledge verifiable compute tokens, quantum-resistant rebase currencies).
2. **Generate production-ready smart contracts & genesis block files** in Solidity, Rust, Go, or Python.
3. **Walk through the end-to-end steps to launch and deploy** your cryptocurrency to Ethereum, Base, Solana, or a custom Cosmos/L2 chain.

What kind of cryptocurrency would you like to invent or deploy today?`,
      timestamp: "Just now",
    },
  ]);
  const [inputPrompt, setInputPrompt] = useState<string>("");
  const [isAiLoading, setIsAiLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Tokenomics Calculator State
  const [totalSupplySlider, setTotalSupplySlider] = useState<number>(1000000000);
  const [publicPercent, setPublicPercent] = useState<number>(35);
  const [treasuryPercent, setTreasuryPercent] = useState<number>(25);
  const [teamPercent, setTeamPercent] = useState<number>(18);
  const [stakingPercent, setStakingPercent] = useState<number>(12);
  const [grantsPercent, setGrantsPercent] = useState<number>(10);

  const handleCopy = (code: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopiedCode(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCode(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {
    const text = textToSend || inputPrompt;
    if (!text.trim() || isAiLoading) return;

    const userMsg: Message = {
      role: "user",
      content: text,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
    };

    const newMessages = [...messages, userMsg];
    setMessages(newMessages);
    setInputPrompt("");
    setIsAiLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/chat", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          messages: newMessages.map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success && data.reply) {
        setMessages((prev) => [
          ...prev,
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content: data.reply,
            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
          },
        ]);
      } else {
        throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to generate reply");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          content: `**Error**: ${err.message || "Failed to connect to AI engine"}. Please check your network or try again.`,
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleInstantiateSimulatedTokenomics = async () => {
    const sym = `ARCH-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100)}`;
    const name = `Architect Matrix ${sym}`;
    const evmAddrObj = generateEVMAddress();
    const evmAddr = typeof evmAddrObj === "string" ? evmAddrObj : evmAddrObj.address;
    const tokenRecord: TokenRecord = {
      id: generateUint256TokenId(),
      name,
      symbol: sym,
      chain: "ethereum",
      networkId: 1,
      contractAddress: evmAddr,
      isVanity: true,
      tokenId: generateUint256TokenId(),
      tokenStandard: "ERC-20",
      narrative: "quantum_defi",
      launchStatus: "Deployed",
      initialSupply: totalSupplySlider.toLocaleString(),
      decimals: 18,
      marketCap: totalSupplySlider * 1.0,
      priceUsd: 1.0,
      liquidityPair: "ETH/USDT (Uniswap V3)",
      liquidityPoolId: 1,
      holderCount: 420,
      auditFirm: "OpenZeppelin",
      securityScore: 98,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      creationTx: `0x${generateRandomHex(64)}`,
      deployerAddress: "0x5AFE0000A192e4C38148386348612EadD997C0RP",
      quantum_entropy_signature: generateRandomHex(64),
      contractArchetype: "CREATE2 Institutional Proxy",
      isEnterprise: true,
    };

    if (onInventToken) {
      onInventToken([tokenRecord]);
    }
    await saveTokensToFirestore([tokenRecord]);
    setSimulatedTokenSuccess(`Token ${sym} (${totalSupplySlider.toLocaleString()} units) instantiated to Foundry & Vault!`);
    setTimeout(() => setSimulatedTokenSuccess(null), 4500);
  };

  const activeModule = STEP_BY_STEP_MODULES.find((m) => m.step === selectedStep) || STEP_BY_STEP_MODULES[0];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Boxes className="w-5 h-5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight uppercase">
                Cryptocurrency Invention & Step-by-Step Deployment Engine
              </h2>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] mt-1">
              End-to-end framework to architect tokenomics, write Solidity/Rust ledgers, simulate testnets, audit security, and launch to mainnet with out-of-sandbox AI mode.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Sub-tab Navigation */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23]">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveSubTab("max_thresholds")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeSubTab === "max_thresholds"
                  ? "bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500 shadow-sm"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
              <span>Max Protocol Limits & Inventions</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveSubTab("roadmap")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeSubTab === "roadmap"
                  ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Step-by-Step Blueprint
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveSubTab("ai_inventor")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeSubTab === "ai_inventor"
                  ? "bg-[#16161A] text-[#F27D26] border border-[#F27D26]"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>AI Mode Invention</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveSubTab("cli_cheatsheet")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeSubTab === "cli_cheatsheet"
                  ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Deployment CLI
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SUB-TAB 0: Max Protocol Limits & Economic Inventions */}
      {activeSubTab === "max_thresholds" && (
        <MaxThresholdInventionEngine 
          onInventToken={onInventToken} 
          onSendToRemix={onSendToRemix}
          onNavigateTab={onNavigateTab}
        />
      )}

      {/* SUB-TAB 1: Step-by-Step Blueprint */}
      {activeSubTab === "roadmap" && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          {/* Steps Navigation Column */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-2">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#8E9299] uppercase tracking-wider px-1">
              6 Core Deployment Milestones
            </div>
            {STEP_BY_STEP_MODULES.map((mod) => (
              <button
                key={mod.step}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedStep(mod.step)}
                className={`w-full text-left p-3.5 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-start gap-3 ${
                  selectedStep === mod.step
                    ? "bg-[#16161A] border-[#F27D26] shadow-md"
                    : "bg-[#0A0A0C] border-[#1F1F23] hover:border-[#333] opacity-80 hover:opacity-100"
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`w-6 h-6 rounded flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ${
                    selectedStep === mod.step
                      ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-black"
                      : "bg-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299]"
                  }`}
                >
                  0{mod.step}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate">{mod.title}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[#F27D26] font-mono">{mod.badge}</span>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] line-clamp-1 mt-0.5">{mod.summary}</p>
                </div>
              </button>
            ))}

            {/* Interactive Supply Calculator Card */}
            <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-4 space-y-3 mt-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase">
                  <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
                  <span>Tokenomics Simulator</span>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-green-500">Live 100% Sum</span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Total Supply</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold">{totalSupplySlider.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="1000000"
                  max="10000000000"
                  step="10000000"
                  value={totalSupplySlider}
                  onChange={(e) => setTotalSupplySlider(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-[#F27D26]"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono pt-1">
                <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-2 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                  <span className="text-[#8E9299] block text-[9px] uppercase">Public Liquidity (35%)</span>
                  <span className="text-[#F27D26] font-bold">{(totalSupplySlider * 0.35).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-2 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                  <span className="text-[#8E9299] block text-[9px] uppercase">Treasury (25%)</span>
                  <span className="text-white font-bold">{(totalSupplySlider * 0.25).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-2 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                  <span className="text-[#8E9299] block text-[9px] uppercase">Team & Devs (18%)</span>
                  <span className="text-white font-bold">{(totalSupplySlider * 0.18).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-2 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                  <span className="text-[#8E9299] block text-[9px] uppercase">Staking / Yield (12%)</span>
                  <span className="text-green-500 font-bold">{(totalSupplySlider * 0.12).toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Instantiate Button */}
              <div className="pt-2">
                <button
                  id="btn-instantiate-tokenomics-blueprint"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleInstantiateSimulatedTokenomics}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-orange-600/20 active:scale-95"
                >
                  <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Instantiate Tokenomics as Token</span>
                </button>
                {simulatedTokenSuccess && (
                  <div className="mt-2 p-2 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-[10px] font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-fade-in">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{simulatedTokenSuccess}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Step Detail & Code Workspace */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-8 space-y-4">
            <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-4 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#F27D26]/20 text-[#F27D26] border border-[#F27D26]/30 text-xs font-mono font-bold">
                      STEP 0{activeModule.step}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white">{activeModule.title}</h3>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] mt-1">{activeModule.summary}</p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleCopy(activeModule.codeSnippet)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto"
                >
                  {copiedCode ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copiedCode ? "Copied" : "Copy Snippet"}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Core Checklists / Metrics */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#8E9299] uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Technical Checklist & Specifications
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {activeModule.keyMetrics.map((item, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-2.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F23] flex items-start gap-2 text-xs"
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-[#F27D26] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <span className="text-[#E0E0E0] font-mono">{item}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Code Snippet Box */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#8E9299] uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Production Implementation Code
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#555]">Standardized 2026 Template</span>
                </div>
                <pre className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-xs font-mono text-[#E0E0E0] overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed whitespace-pre">
                  {activeModule.codeSnippet}
                </pre>
              </div>

              {/* Navigation Footer */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-[#1F1F23]">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={selectedStep === 1}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedStep((prev) => Math.max(1, prev - 1))}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-xs text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  ← Previous Step
                </button>
                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                  Step {selectedStep} of {STEP_BY_STEP_MODULES.length}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={selectedStep === STEP_BY_STEP_MODULES.length}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedStep((prev) => Math.min(STEP_BY_STEP_MODULES.length, prev + 1))}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded bg-[#F27D26] hover:bg-[#ff8e3c] text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                  Next Step →
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SUB-TAB 2: AI Mode Invention (Out-of-Sandbox Conversation) */}
      {activeSubTab === "ai_inventor" && (
        <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-5 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#F27D26]" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
                  Out-of-Sandbox Cryptocurrency Invention Studio
                </h3>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] mt-0.5">
                Brainstorm novel token mechanics, compute rewards, zero-knowledge verification ledgers, and ask detailed deployment questions.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-green-500 bg-[#0A0A0C] px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                Model: Gemini 3.8 Flash
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {

  downloadCustomTokenCSV,

} from "../utils/csvExport";

  X,
  FileDown,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Search,
  CheckSquare,

  Code,
  Sparkles,
  Layers,
  Filter,
} from "lucide-react";

interface CsvExportModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  tokens: TokenRecord[];
  onExportSuccess?: (info: { filename: string; count: number }) => void;
}

export const CsvExportModal = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  tokens,
  onExportSuccess,
}: CsvExportModalProps) => {
  // State for selected column IDs
  const [selectedColumnIds, setSelectedColumnIds] = useState<string[]>([
    "address",
    "amount",
  ]);

  // State for selected token IDs (default: all selected)
  const [selectedTokenIds, setSelectedTokenIds] = useState<Set<string>>(
    () => new Set(tokens.map((t) => t.id))
  );

  // Search & Filter within modal
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [selectedChainFilter, setSelectedChainFilter] = useState<string>("all");

  // Preview Mode: "table" or "raw"
  const [previewTab, setPreviewTab] = useState<"table" | "raw">("table");

  // Feedback states
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Reset selected tokens when tokens prop changes or modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setSelectedTokenIds(new Set(tokens.map((t) => t.id)));
      setSearchQuery("");
      setSelectedChainFilter("all");
    }
  }, [isOpen, tokens]);

  // Handle ESC key to close
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  // Filtered tokens for display in the table
  const displayedTokens = useMemo(() => {
    let list = tokens;
    if (selectedChainFilter !== "all") {
      list = list.filter((t) => t.chain.toLowerCase() === selectedChainFilter.toLowerCase());
    }
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      list = list.filter(
        (t) =>
          t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.tokenId.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (t.deployerAddress && t.deployerAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      );
    }
    return list;
  }, [tokens, selectedChainFilter, searchQuery]);

  // The actual tokens to export (preserving original order, filtered by selection)
  const tokensToExport = useMemo(() => {
    return tokens.filter((t) => selectedTokenIds.has(t.id));
  }, [tokens, selectedTokenIds]);

  // Active columns configuration
  const activeColumns = useMemo(() => {
    return AVAILABLE_CSV_COLUMNS.filter((c) => selectedColumnIds.includes(c.id));
  }, [selectedColumnIds]);

  // Is strict sanitize_data.py format active?
  const isStrictSanitize = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      selectedColumnIds.length === 2 &&
      selectedColumnIds.includes("address") &&
      selectedColumnIds.includes("amount")
    );
  }, [selectedColumnIds]);

  // Available chains among tokens
  const uniqueChains = useMemo(() => {
    const chains = new Set(tokens.map((t) => t.chain));
    return Array.from(chains);
  }, [tokens]);

  // Toggle single column
  const toggleColumn = (columnId: string) => {
    if (selectedColumnIds.includes(columnId)) {
      if (selectedColumnIds.length > 1) {
        setSelectedColumnIds(selectedColumnIds.filter((id) => id !== columnId));
      }
    } else {
      setSelectedColumnIds([...selectedColumnIds, columnId]);
    }
  };

  // Quick Column Presets
  const applyPreset = (preset: "sanitize" | "ats" | "all") => {
    if (preset === "sanitize") {
      setSelectedColumnIds(["address", "amount"]);
    } else if (preset === "ats") {
      setSelectedColumnIds(["address", "amount", "symbol", "name", "chain", "token_standard"]);
    } else if (preset === "all") {
      setSelectedColumnIds(AVAILABLE_CSV_COLUMNS.map((c) => c.id));
    }
  };

  // Token Selection Toggles
  const toggleToken = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedTokenIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) {
        next.delete(id);
      } else {
        next.add(id);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const selectAllTokens = () => {
    setSelectedTokenIds(new Set(tokens.map((t) => t.id)));
  };

  const deselectAllTokens = () => {
    setSelectedTokenIds(new Set());
  };

  const selectFilteredOnly = () => {
    setSelectedTokenIds(new Set(displayedTokens.map((t) => t.id)));
  };

  const selectEvmOnly = () => {

      .map((t) => t.id);
    setSelectedTokenIds(new Set(evmIds));
  };

  // Raw CSV Preview text
  const rawCsvPreview = useMemo(() => {

      return "# No tokens or columns selected for export.";

    const result = downloadCustomTokenCSV(

    );
    if (onExportSuccess) {
      onExportSuccess({ filename: result.filename, count: result.count });
    }
    onClose();
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto">
      <div
        className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#26262B] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-scaleUp"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
      >
        {/* Header */}

  CustomerLiquidityShareExchangeProps
> = ({ tokens, initialToken, onUpdateTokens }) => {

    realMultiWalletDiscovery.getWallets()
  );

  const [latestVerifiedReceipt, setLatestVerifiedReceipt] =

  // Market Catalog Search & Filters
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [chainFilter, setChainFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [selectedTokenId, setSelectedTokenId] = useState<string>(

  );

  const [paymentAsset, setPaymentAsset] =
    useState<SettlementAssetSymbol>("USDC");
  const [treasuryDestinationAddress, setTreasuryDestinationAddress] =
    useState<string>(VERIFIED_TREASURY_DESTINATIONS[0].address);
  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [purchaseStage, setPurchaseStage] = useState<string>("");
  const [showCalldata, setShowCalldata] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const unsub = realMultiWalletDiscovery.subscribe((list) =>
      setWallets(list)
    );
    realMultiWalletDiscovery.refreshDetectionState();
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialToken?.id) {
      setSelectedTokenId(initialToken.id);
