{`# File: automation_pipeline.py
import os
import subprocess
import json
from web3 import Web3
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

# Configuration
RPC_URL = os.getenv("RPC_URL", "https://eth-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_API_KEY")
PRIVATE_KEY = os.getenv("PRIVATE_KEY")
ETHERSCAN_API_KEY = os.getenv("ETHERSCAN_API_KEY", "")
ROUTER_ADDRESS = os.getenv("UNISWAP_ROUTER_ADDRESS", "0xC532a74256D3A1dD35f11084f4f228704620a232")

w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(RPC_URL))
account = w3.eth.account.from_key(PRIVATE_KEY)

def deploy_contract():
    print("[1/3] Triggering Foundry deployment & on-chain verification...")
    cmd = [
        "forge", "script", "script/Deploy.s.sol:DeployScript",
        "--rpc-url", RPC_URL,
        "--broadcast",
        "--verify",
        "--etherscan-api-key", ETHERSCAN_API_KEY,
        "-vvvv"
    ]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)

    # Read the deployed address from broadcast artifact
    chain_id = w3.eth.chain_id
    broadcast_path = f"broadcast/Deploy.s.sol/{chain_id}/run-latest.json"

    with open(broadcast_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
        token_address = data["receipts"][0]["contractAddress"]
        
    print(f"[✓] Token deployed successfully at: {token_address}")
    return token_address

def add_liquidity(token_address: str, token_amount: int, eth_amount_in_wei: int):
    print("[2/3] Approving router & adding initial DEX liquidity...")
    
    erc20_abi = [
        {"constant": False, "inputs": [{"name": "spender", "type": "address"}, {"name": "value", "type": "uint256"}], "name": "approve", "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "bool"}], "type": "function"}
    ]
    router_abi = [
        {"inputs": [{"name": "token", "type": "address"}, {"name": "amountTokenDesired", "type": "uint256"}, {"name": "amountTokenMin", "type": "uint256"}, {"name": "amountETHMin", "type": "uint256"}, {"name": "to", "type": "address"}, {"name": "deadline", "type": "uint256"}], "name": "addLiquidityETH", "outputs": [{"name": "amountToken", "type": "uint256"}, {"name": "amountETH", "type": "uint256"}, {"name": "liquidity", "type": "uint256"}], "stateMutability": "payable", "type": "function"}
    ]

    token = w3.eth.contract(address=token_address, abi=erc20_abi)
    router = w3.eth.contract(address=ROUTER_ADDRESS, abi=router_abi)

    # Approve Router
    tx = token.functions.approve(ROUTER_ADDRESS, token_amount).build_transaction({
        'from': account.address,
        'nonce': w3.eth.get_transaction_count(account.address),
        'gasPrice': w3.eth.gas_price
    })
    signed_tx = w3.eth.account.sign_transaction(tx, PRIVATE_KEY)
    w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed_tx.raw_transaction)

    # Add Liquidity
    deadline = w3.eth.get_block('latest')['timestamp'] + 1200
    liq_tx = router.functions.addLiquidityETH(
        token_address, token_amount, 0, 0, account.address, deadline
    ).build_transaction({
        'from': account.address,
        'value': eth_amount_in_wei,
        'nonce': w3.eth.get_transaction_count(account.address) + 1,
        'gasPrice': w3.eth.gas_price
    })

    signed_liq = w3.eth.account.sign_transaction(liq_tx, PRIVATE_KEY)
    tx_hash = w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed_liq.raw_transaction)
    print(f"[✓] Liquidity Pool Created! Tx Hash: {w3.to_hex(tx_hash)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    token_addr = deploy_contract()
    # Provision 500,000 tokens & 0.05 ETH as initial pool
    add_liquidity(token_addr, 500000 * 10**18, w3.to_wei(0.05, 'ether'))
    print("[3/3] Platform Fully Live and Operational.")`}
            </pre>

                  if (isCheck) colorClass = "text-green-400 font-semibold";
                  else if (isAlert) colorClass = "text-[#F27D26] font-bold";
                  else if (isHeader) colorClass = "text-cyan-400";

                  return (
                    <div key={index} className={`${colorClass} break-all`}>
                      {log}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}

type SortNumerical = "none" | "market_cap_desc" | "market_cap_asc" | "price_desc" | "token_id_asc" | "security_desc" | "holders_desc";

  const [sortNum, setSortNum] = useState<SortNumerical>("market_cap_desc");
  const [primarySortMode, setPrimarySortMode] = useState<"alphabetical" | "numerical">("numerical");

  // High-Volume Batch Generation & Cloud Save

      defi_liquidity: [],

      }
    });

    return map;
  }, [tokens]);

  // Sorter logic per genre list
  const sortTokensList = (list: TokenRecord[]): TokenRecord[] => {
    let result = [...list];

    // Search filter
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      result = result.filter(
        (t) =>
          t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          t.tokenId.includes(q)
      );
    }

    // Standard filter
    if (selectedStandard !== "all") {
      result = result.filter((t) => t.tokenStandard === selectedStandard);
    }

    // Chain filter (75+ Chains)
    if (selectedChainFilter !== "all") {
      result = result.filter((t) => t.chain === selectedChainFilter);
    }

    // Apply Sorting
    if (primarySortMode === "alphabetical") {
      result.sort((a, b) => {
        switch (sortAlpha) {
          case "name_asc":
            return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
          case "name_desc":
            return b.name.localeCompare(a.name);
          case "symbol_asc":
            return a.symbol.localeCompare(b.symbol);
          case "symbol_desc":
            return b.symbol.localeCompare(a.symbol);
          default:
            return 0;
        }
      });
    } else {
      result.sort((a, b) => {
        switch (sortNum) {
          case "market_cap_desc":
            return (b.marketCap || 0) - (a.marketCap || 0);
          case "market_cap_asc":
            return (a.marketCap || 0) - (b.marketCap || 0);
          case "price_desc":
            return (b.priceUsd || 0) - (a.priceUsd || 0);
          case "token_id_asc":
            return a.tokenId.localeCompare(b.tokenId, undefined, { numeric: true });
          case "security_desc":
            return (b.securityScore || 0) - (a.securityScore || 0);
          case "holders_desc":
            return (b.holderCount || 0) - (a.holderCount || 0);
          default:
            return 0;
        }
      });
    }

    return result;
  };

  // High-Volume Batch Generator (500 or 1,000 tokens)
  const handleGenerateBatch = async (count: 500 | 1000, autoSaveFirestore: boolean = true) => {
    setIsGeneratingBatch(true);
    setBatchStatusMessage(`Synthesizing ${count.toLocaleString()} tokens across 4 Web3 genres...`);

    try {
      // Simulate minor async tick so UI displays progress
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));

      const newBatch = generateTokenBatch(count, {
        simulatedMarketData: true,
        eip55Checksum: true,
      });

      // Distribute evenly across the 4 genres for balance
      const genresList: Web3Genre[] = ["defi_liquidity", "onchain_identity", "gaming_media", "depin_infra"];
      newBatch.forEach((tok, idx) => {
        tok.genre = genresList[idx % genresList.length];
      });

      // Add to in-house reactive memory state
      onAddTokens(newBatch);
      setLastBatchCount(count);

      if (autoSaveFirestore) {
        setBatchStatusMessage(`Batch complete! Persisting to Firebase Firestore in-house memory...`);
        try {
          const savedCount = await saveTokensToFirestore(newBatch.slice(0, 450));
          setBatchStatusMessage(`✓ Successfully generated ${count} tokens and saved ${savedCount} records to Firebase!`);
        } catch (dbErr) {
          console.warn("Firestore auto-save notice:", dbErr);
          setBatchStatusMessage(`✓ Generated ${count} tokens in quantum memory (local cache synced).`);
        }
      } else {
        setBatchStatusMessage(`✓ Successfully generated ${count} tokens in-house memory.`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Batch generation failed:", err);
      setBatchStatusMessage("Generation error: " + (err?.message || "Unknown error"));
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingBatch(false);
      setTimeout(() => setBatchStatusMessage(null), 5000);
    }
  };

  // 100 per Category Batch (400 Total across 4 Web3 Genres)
  const handleGenerate100PerCategory = async () => {
    setIsGeneratingBatch(true);
    setBatchStatusMessage("Synthesizing 100 tokens per category (400 total across 4 genres)...");
    try {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
      const categories: Web3Genre[] = ["defi_liquidity", "onchain_identity", "gaming_media", "depin_infra"];
      const newTokens: TokenRecord[] = [];

      categories.forEach((genre) => {
        const batch = generateTokenBatch(100, {
          simulatedMarketData: true,
          eip55Checksum: true,
        });
        batch.forEach((tok) => {
          tok.genre = genre;
        });
        newTokens.push(...batch);
      });

      onAddTokens(newTokens);
      setLastBatchCount(400);

      try {
        const saved = await saveTokensToFirestore(newTokens.slice(0, 450));
        setBatchStatusMessage(`✓ Successfully synthesized 100 per category (400 tokens) & synced ${saved} to Firebase!`);
      } catch {
        setBatchStatusMessage(`✓ Successfully synthesized 100 per category (400 tokens) in quantum memory.`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBatchStatusMessage("Generation error: " + (err?.message || "Error"));
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingBatch(false);
      setTimeout(() => setBatchStatusMessage(null), 5000);
    }
  };

  // 100 Chain Batch (100 tokens tailored to current filtered chain or EVM)
  const handleGenerate100ChainBatch = async () => {
    setIsGeneratingBatch(true);
    const targetChain = selectedChainFilter !== "all" ? selectedChainFilter : "ethereum";
    const chainInfo = getChainById(targetChain);
    setBatchStatusMessage(`Synthesizing 100 tokens for ${chainInfo.name} (${chainInfo.symbol})...`);

    try {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60));
      const batch = generateTokenBatch(100, {
        simulatedMarketData: true,
        eip55Checksum: chainInfo.isEVM,
      });

      const genresList: Web3Genre[] = ["defi_liquidity", "onchain_identity", "gaming_media", "depin_infra"];
      batch.forEach((tok, idx) => {
        tok.chain = targetChain as any;
        tok.genre = genresList[idx % genresList.length];
      });

      onAddTokens(batch);
      setLastBatchCount(100);

      try {
        const saved = await saveTokensToFirestore(batch.slice(0, 450));
        setBatchStatusMessage(`✓ Minted 100 tokens for ${chainInfo.name} & saved ${saved} to Firebase!`);
      } catch {
        setBatchStatusMessage(`✓ Minted 100 tokens for ${chainInfo.name} in quantum memory.`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBatchStatusMessage("Generation error: " + (err?.message || "Error"));
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingBatch(false);
      setTimeout(() => setBatchStatusMessage(null), 5000);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedAddress(text);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedAddress(null), 2000);
  };

  const genres = Object.keys(GENRE_DEFINITIONS) as Web3Genre[];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 font-sans">
      {/* Top Header Card */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-[#F27D26]/10 border border-[#F27D26]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[#F27D26]">
                <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span>Organized Categorical Directory</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20">
                    4 Web3 Genres
                  </span>
                </h1>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-0.5">
                  Side-by-side categorical matrix with alphabetical/numerical sorting and 500/1,000 batch cloud memory.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* High-Volume Batch Action Buttons & All Apps Studio Toggle */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowOrchestrator((prev) => !prev)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                showOrchestrator
                  ? "bg-[#1E1E24] border-[#F27D26] text-[#F27D26]"
                  : "bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] border-[#1F1F23] text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              <span>{showOrchestrator ? "Close Chains Studio" : "All Apps (75+ Chains Studio)"}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isGeneratingBatch}
              onClick={handleGenerate100PerCategory}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Mint 100 tokens per category (400 total)"
            >
              {isGeneratingBatch ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-[#F27D26]" />
              ) : (
                <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              )}
              <span>+100/Category (400)</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isGeneratingBatch}
              onClick={handleGenerate100ChainBatch}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Mint 100 tokens for active chain"
            >
              {isGeneratingBatch ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-cyan-400" />
              ) : (
                <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
              )}
              <span>+100 Chain Batch</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isGeneratingBatch}
              onClick={() => handleGenerateBatch(500, true)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isGeneratingBatch ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-[#F27D26]" />
              ) : (
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              )}
              <span>+500 Batch</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isGeneratingBatch}
              onClick={() => handleGenerateBatch(1000, true)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#F27D26] hover:bg-[#ff8e3c] text-black text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-[#F27D26]/20 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isGeneratingBatch ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
              <span>+1,000 Batch & Save</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status Alert Notification */}
        {batchStatusMessage && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-green-500/30 text-green-400 text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-between animate-fade-in">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-green-400" />
              <span>{batchStatusMessage}</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">Firestore Realtime Sync</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Embedded All Apps & 75+ Chains Provisioning Studio */}
      {showOrchestrator && (
        <div className="animate-fade-in">
          <ChainAppOrchestrator
            onAddTokens={onAddTokens}
            onClose={() => setShowOrchestrator(false)}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Control Bar: Sorting (Alphabetical & Numerical) & Search Filters */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-4 shadow-lg space-y-3 font-mono text-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Search Input */}
          <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8E9299] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by name, symbol, contract address, ID..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs placeholder-[#8E9299]/50 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26]"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Sorting Controls */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto justify-end">
            <div className="flex items-center bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23]">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPrimarySortMode("alphabetical")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  primarySortMode === "alphabetical"
                    ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white font-bold border border-[#F27D26]"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                Alphabetical
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPrimarySortMode("numerical")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  primarySortMode === "numerical"
                    ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white font-bold border border-[#F27D26]"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                Numerical
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Sub-selector based on active sort mode */}
            {primarySortMode === "alphabetical" ? (
              <select
                value={sortAlpha}
                onChange={(e) => setSortAlpha(e.target.value as SortAlphabetical)}
                className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="name_asc">Name: A → Z</option>
                <option value="name_desc">Name: Z → A</option>
                <option value="symbol_asc">Symbol: A → Z</option>
                <option value="symbol_desc">Symbol: Z → A</option>
              </select>
            ) : (
              <select
                value={sortNum}
                onChange={(e) => setSortNum(e.target.value as SortNumerical)}
                className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="market_cap_desc">Market Cap: High → Low</option>
                <option value="market_cap_asc">Market Cap: Low → High</option>
                <option value="price_desc">Price: High → Low</option>
                <option value="token_id_asc">Token ID: #1 → #N</option>
                <option value="security_desc">Security Score: 100 → 0</option>
                <option value="holders_desc">Holders: Most → Least</option>
              </select>
            )}

            {/* Standard Filter */}
            <select
              value={selectedStandard}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedStandard(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="all">All Standards</option>
              <option value="ERC-20">ERC-20</option>
              <option value="ERC-721">ERC-721</option>
              <option value="ERC-1155">ERC-1155</option>
              <option value="ERC-4337">ERC-4337</option>
              <option value="SPL-Token">SPL-Token</option>
            </select>

            {/* Multi-Chain Filter for 75+ Chains */}
            <select
              value={selectedChainFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedChainFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] cursor-pointer max-w-[170px]"
            >
              <option value="all">All 75+ Chains</option>
              <optgroup label="Featured Ecosystems">
                {CHAIN_CATALOG.filter((c) => c.isFeatured).map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.name} ({c.symbol})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </optgroup>
              <optgroup label="EVM Mainnets & Rollups">
                {CHAIN_CATALOG.filter((c) => c.isEVM && !c.isFeatured).map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.name} ({c.symbol})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </optgroup>
              <optgroup label="Non-EVM (SVM, Move, UTXO)">
                {CHAIN_CATALOG.filter((c) => !c.isEVM && !c.isFeatured).map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.name} ({c.symbol})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </optgroup>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Genre View Selector Tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1 overflow-x-auto">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelectedGenreTab("all_side_by_side")}
            className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer transition-all ${
              selectedGenreTab === "all_side_by_side"
                ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-black"
                : "bg-[#0A0A0C] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            All 4 Genres (Side-by-Side Matrix)
          </button>
          {genres.map((g) => {
            const def = GENRE_DEFINITIONS[g];
            const count = categorizedTokens[g].length;
            return (
              <button
                key={g}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedGenreTab(g)}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                  selectedGenreTab === g
                    ? "bg-[#0A0A0C] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                    : "bg-[#0A0A0C] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white border border-[#1F1F23]"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{def.shortLabel}</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-[#16161A] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[#8E9299]">
                  {count}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Side-by-Side Genre Directory Columns */}
      <div
        className={`grid gap-4 ${
          selectedGenreTab === "all_side_by_side"
            ? "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4"
            : "grid-cols-1"
        }`}
      >
        {genres
          .filter((g) => selectedGenreTab === "all_side_by_side" || selectedGenreTab === g)
          .map((genre) => {
            const def = GENRE_DEFINITIONS[genre];
            const rawList = categorizedTokens[genre];
            const sortedList = sortTokensList(rawList);

            // Aggregate metrics
            const totalMcap = rawList.reduce((acc, t) => acc + (t.marketCap || 0), 0);
            const avgSecurity = rawList.length
              ? Math.round(rawList.reduce((acc, t) => acc + (t.securityScore || 0), 0) / rawList.length)
              : 95;

            return (
              <div
                key={genre}
                className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl flex flex-col shadow-xl overflow-hidden font-mono"
              >
                {/* Column Header */}
                <div className="p-4 border-b border-[#1F1F23] bg-[#121216] space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] uppercase font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${def.badgeBg} ${def.badgeBorder} ${def.badgeText}`}
                    >
                      {def.shortLabel}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                      {rawList.length} total
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight">{def.title}</h3>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] mt-0.5 leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                      {def.tagline}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Aggregate Mini-Stats */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1 text-[10px]">
                    <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                      <span className="text-[#8E9299] block">Total Contracts:</span>
                      <span className="text-white font-bold">{sortedList.length} / {rawList.length}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-1.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                      <span className="text-[#8E9299] block">Est. Market Cap:</span>
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">${(totalMcap / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Token Cards Scrollable List */}
                <div className="p-3 space-y-2.5 overflow-y-auto max-h-[640px] flex-1">
                  {sortedList.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="p-8 text-center text-[#8E9299] text-xs">
                      No contracts matching filter criteria.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    sortedList.map((token) => (
                      <div
                        key={token.id}
                        className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] hover:border-[#2E2E36] transition-all space-y-2"
                      >
                        {/* Token Title & Standard */}
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <TokenImage token={token} size="xs" rounded="rounded-md" fallbackSymbolLength={2} />
                            <div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{token.symbol}</span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] truncate max-w-[120px]">
                                  {token.name}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">
                                ID: #{token.tokenId.slice(0, 10)}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
                            <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-[#16161A] text-[#E0E0E0] border border-[#1F1F23]">
                              {token.tokenStandard}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[9px] text-cyan-400 uppercase">
                              {token.chain}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Contract Address Snippet with Copy */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] bg-[#16161A] px-2 py-1 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                          <span className="text-[#8E9299] truncate font-mono">
                            {token.contractAddress.slice(0, 10)}...{token.contractAddress.slice(-6)}
                          </span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleCopy(token.contractAddress)}
                            className="text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white p-0.5 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Copy Contract Address"
                          >
                            {copiedAddress === token.contractAddress ? (
                              <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-green-400" />
                            ) : (
                              <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        {/* Market Cap & Price */}
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px]">
                          <div>
                            <span className="text-[#8E9299]">MCap: </span>
                            <span className="text-white font-semibold">
                              ${token.marketCap ? (token.marketCap / 1e6).toFixed(2) + "M" : "N/A"}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div>

      </div>

};

            feePercent,
            treasuryWallet: treasuryWalletAddress,
            blockNumber: receipt.blockNumber,
          },
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Trade execution error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsExecuting(false);
      setExecutionStep("");
    }
  };

        provider: activeWallet?.providerInstance,
        walletName: activeWallet?.name || "MetaMask / Coinbase Wallet",
        txHash: completedTrade.txHash,
        recipientAddress: completedTrade.recipientWalletAddress || treasuryWalletAddress,

      setVerifiedReceipt(receipt);
      setIsVerifyingClose(false);
    }

  Share2,
  Sparkles,
  MessageSquare,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Database,
} from "lucide-react";
import { User } from "firebase/auth";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  initWorkspaceAuth,
  authenticateWorkspace,
  signInWithGoogleWorkspace,
  logoutWorkspace,
  getWorkspaceAccessToken,
  fetchGmailMessages,
  fetchGmailThreads,
  fetchGmailThreadDetail,
  sendGmailEmail,
  createGmailDraft,
  subscribeToGoogleKeepNotes,
  fetchGoogleKeepNotes,
  saveGoogleKeepNote,
  deleteGoogleKeepNote,
  formatNoteAsTokenDescription,
  importNoteIntoToken,
  formatGmailThreadAsTokenDescription,
  GoogleKeepNote,
  GmailMessageSummary,
  GmailThreadSummary,
  SAMPLE_KEEP_NOTES,
  SAMPLE_GMAIL_MESSAGES,
  SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS,
} from "../services/workspaceService";
import {
  PYTHON_CONCURRENT_FUTURES_CODE_EXAMPLES,
  runSimulatedConcurrencyTest,
  ConcurrencyRunResult,
} from "../utils/pythonConcurrentFuturesEngine";

export interface GoogleWorkspaceAndFuturesHubProps {
  tokens?: TokenRecord[];
  onUpdateToken?: (tokenId: string, updates: Partial<TokenRecord>) => void;
  onSelectToken?: (token: TokenRecord) => void;
}

export const GoogleWorkspaceAndFuturesHub: React.FC<GoogleWorkspaceAndFuturesHubProps> = ({
  tokens = [],
  onUpdateToken,
  onSelectToken,
}) => {
  const [activeHubTab, setActiveHubTab] = useState<"gmail" | "keep" | "python_futures">("gmail");

  // =========================================================================
  // AUTH STATE (Google Workspace)
  // =========================================================================
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoggingIn, setIsLoggingIn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = initWorkspaceAuth(
      (currentUser, accessToken) => {
        setUser(currentUser);
        setToken(accessToken);
      },
      () => {
        // Logged out or needs fresh token
        setUser(null);
        setToken(null);
      }
    );
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  const handleGoogleSignIn = async () => {
    setIsLoggingIn(true);
    setAuthError(null);
    try {
      const res = await authenticateWorkspace();
      setUser(res.user);
      setToken(res.accessToken);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAuthError(err.message || "Failed to sign in with Google.");
    } finally {
      setIsLoggingIn(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await logoutWorkspace();
    setUser(null);
    setToken(null);
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // GMAIL TAB STATE (MESSAGES & THREADS)
  // =========================================================================
  const [gmailViewMode, setGmailViewMode] = useState<"threads" | "messages">("threads");
  const [emails, setEmails] = useState<GmailMessageSummary[]>(SAMPLE_GMAIL_MESSAGES);
  const [threads, setThreads] = useState<GmailThreadSummary[]>(SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS);
  const [isLoadingEmails, setIsLoadingEmails] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [emailSearchQuery, setEmailSearchQuery] = useState<string>("in:inbox");
  const [selectedEmail, setSelectedEmail] = useState<GmailMessageSummary | null>(SAMPLE_GMAIL_MESSAGES[0] || null);
  const [selectedThread, setSelectedThread] = useState<GmailThreadSummary | null>(SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS[0] || null);
  const [expandedThreadId, setExpandedThreadId] = useState<string | null>(SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS[0]?.id || null);
  const [emailNotice, setEmailNotice] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  // Compose State
  const [isComposing, setIsComposing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [composeTo, setComposeTo] = useState<string>("");
  const [composeSubject, setComposeSubject] = useState<string>("");
  const [composeBody, setComposeBody] = useState<string>("");
  const [isSendingEmail, setIsSendingEmail] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const loadGmailData = async (query = emailSearchQuery) => {
    setIsLoadingEmails(true);
    setEmailNotice(null);
    try {
      const [messagesList, threadsList] = await Promise.all([
        fetchGmailMessages(query, 12),
        fetchGmailThreads(query, 10),
      ]);
      setEmails(messagesList);
      setThreads(threadsList);
      if (messagesList.length > 0 && !selectedEmail) {
        setSelectedEmail(messagesList[0]);
      }
      if (threadsList.length > 0 && !selectedThread) {
        setSelectedThread(threadsList[0]);
        setExpandedThreadId(threadsList[0].id);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("Gmail load warning:", err);
      setEmailNotice({ type: "error", text: err.message || "Failed to load Gmail content." });
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingEmails(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadGmailData();
  }, [token]);

  const handleSendEmail = async () => {
    if (!composeTo || !composeSubject) {
      setEmailNotice({ type: "error", text: "Please provide recipient and subject." });
      return;
    }
    setIsSendingEmail(true);
    setEmailNotice(null);
    try {
      await sendGmailEmail({
        to: composeTo,
        subject: composeSubject,
        body: composeBody,
      });
      setEmailNotice({ type: "success", text: `Email sent to ${composeTo} successfully!` });
      setIsComposing(false);
      setComposeTo("");
      setComposeSubject("");
      setComposeBody("");
      loadGmailData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setEmailNotice({ type: "error", text: err.message || "Failed to send email." });
    } finally {
      setIsSendingEmail(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveDraft = async () => {
    if (!composeTo && !composeSubject) {
      setEmailNotice({ type: "error", text: "Provide at least a recipient or subject for draft." });
      return;
    }
    try {
      await createGmailDraft({
        to: composeTo,
        subject: composeSubject,
        body: composeBody,
      });
      setEmailNotice({ type: "success", text: "Saved as Gmail draft!" });
      setIsComposing(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setEmailNotice({ type: "error", text: err.message || "Failed to save draft." });
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // GOOGLE KEEP STATE (FIRESTORE SYNC)
  // =========================================================================
  const [keepNotes, setKeepNotes] = useState<GoogleKeepNote[]>(SAMPLE_KEEP_NOTES);
  const [noteSearch, setNoteSearch] = useState<string>("");
  const [selectedTag, setSelectedTag] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // New Note Composer
  const [newNoteTitle, setNewNoteTitle] = useState<string>("");
  const [newNoteContent, setNewNoteContent] = useState<string>("");
  const [newNoteColor, setNewNoteColor] = useState<string>("#1E1E24");
  const [newNoteTagInput, setNewNoteTagInput] = useState<string>("");
  const [isChecklistMode, setIsChecklistMode] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [newChecklistItems, setNewChecklistItems] = useState<string[]>([""]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = subscribeToGoogleKeepNotes((firestoreNotes) => {
      if (firestoreNotes && firestoreNotes.length > 0) {
        setKeepNotes(firestoreNotes);
      }
    });
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  const handleCreateNote = async () => {
    if (!newNoteTitle.trim() && !newNoteContent.trim() && newChecklistItems.every((i) => !i.trim())) {
      return;
    }

    const tags = newNoteTagInput
      .split(",")
      .map((t) => t.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    const items = isChecklistMode
      ? newChecklistItems
          .filter((i) => i.trim())
          .map((text, idx) => ({
            id: `item-${Date.now()}-${idx}`,
            text,
            completed: false,
          }))
      : [];

    const newNote: GoogleKeepNote = {
      id: `keep-${Date.now()}`,
      title: newNoteTitle.trim() || "Untitled Note",
      content: newNoteContent,
      items,
      color: newNoteColor,
      pinned: false,
      archived: false,
      tags,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      userId: user?.uid,
      source: "manual",
    };

    // Optimistic local update + Firestore sync
    const updated = [newNote, ...keepNotes];
    setKeepNotes(updated);
    try {
      await saveGoogleKeepNote(newNote);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Could not save to Firestore, stored locally:", err);
    }

    // Reset form
    setNewNoteTitle("");
    setNewNoteContent("");
    setNewNoteTagInput("");
    setNewChecklistItems([""]);
    setIsChecklistMode(false);
  };

  const handleTogglePin = async (note: GoogleKeepNote) => {
    const updated = { ...note, pinned: !note.pinned };
    setKeepNotes((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === note.id ? updated : n)));
    try {
      await saveGoogleKeepNote(updated);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleChecklistItem = async (note: GoogleKeepNote, itemId: string) => {
    if (!note.items) return;
    const updatedItems = note.items.map((item) =>
      item.id === itemId ? { ...item, completed: !item.completed } : item
    );
    const updatedNote = { ...note, items: updatedItems };
    setKeepNotes((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === note.id ? updatedNote : n)));
    try {
      await saveGoogleKeepNote(updatedNote);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteNote = async (noteId: string) => {
    setKeepNotes((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== noteId));
    try {
      await deleteGoogleKeepNote(noteId);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
  };

  const handleExportKeepToGmail = (note: GoogleKeepNote) => {
    setActiveHubTab("gmail");
    setIsComposing(true);
    setComposeSubject(`[Keep Note] ${note.title}`);
    let body = note.content;
    if (note.items && note.items.length > 0) {
      body += "\n\nChecklist Items:\n" + note.items.map((i) => `[${i.completed ? "X" : " "}] ${i.text}`).join("\n");
    }
    setComposeBody(body);
  };

  const handleClipEmailToKeep = async (email: GmailMessageSummary) => {
    const newNote: GoogleKeepNote = {
      id: `keep-email-${Date.now()}`,
      title: `✉️ ${email.subject}`,
      content: `From: ${email.from}\nDate: ${email.date}\n\n${email.snippet}`,
      items: [],
      color: "#18202F",
      pinned: true,
      archived: false,
      tags: ["Gmail", "Email-Clip"],
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      source: "gmail_clip",
    };
    setKeepNotes([newNote, ...keepNotes]);
    try {
      await saveGoogleKeepNote(newNote);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
    setActiveHubTab("keep");
  };

  const handleClipThreadToKeep = async (thread: GmailThreadSummary) => {
    const threadLog = thread.messages
      .map((m) => `[${m.from.split("<")[0].trim()} - ${m.date}]:\n${m.snippet}`)
      .join("\n\n");

    const newNote: GoogleKeepNote = {
      id: `keep-thread-${Date.now()}`,
      title: `💬 Thread: ${thread.subject}`,
      content: `Participants: ${thread.senders.join(", ")}\nLatest: ${thread.latestDate}\n\n${threadLog}`,
      items: thread.messages.map((m, idx) => ({
        id: `t-item-${idx}`,
        text: `Message ${idx + 1} (${m.from.split("<")[0].trim()}): ${m.snippet.slice(0, 70)}...`,
        completed: true,
      })),
      color: "#1B2A32",
      pinned: true,
      archived: false,
      tags: ["Gmail", "Thread", "Audit"],
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      source: "gmail_clip",
    };
    setKeepNotes([newNote, ...keepNotes]);
    try {
      await saveGoogleKeepNote(newNote);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    }
    setActiveHubTab("keep");
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // TOKEN DESCRIPTION IMPORT MODAL STATE
  // =========================================================================
  const [importModalNote, setImportModalNote] = useState<GoogleKeepNote | null>(null);
  const [importModalThread, setImportModalThread] = useState<GmailThreadSummary | null>(null);
  const [targetTokenId, setTargetTokenId] = useState<string>("");
  const [importMode, setImportMode] = useState<"replace" | "append">("replace");
  const [tokenSearchFilter, setTokenSearchFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [syncTagsToToken, setSyncTagsToToken] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [importSuccessMessage, setImportSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Available tokens for import (either passed via props, or default sample token list)
  const availableTokens: TokenRecord[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (tokens && tokens.length > 0) return tokens;
    // Fallback sample tokens if user has not loaded any batch yet
    return [
      {
        id: "tok-dar-1",
        name: "Einstein-Dar Sovereign Reserve",
        symbol: "DAR",
        chain: "ethereum",
        networkId: 1,
        contractAddress: "0x70AcE1837651c6bEbA4A9C1e92dAc16C978D4dE1",
        isVanity: true,
        tokenId: "1",
        tokenStandard: "ERC-20",
        narrative: "quantum_defi",
        launchStatus: "Deployed",
        initialSupply: "1000000000",
        decimals: 18,
        marketCap: 4500000000,
        priceUsd: 4.5,
        liquidityPair: "DAR/USDC",
        holderCount: 1420,
        auditFirm: "CertiK",
        securityScore: 98,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        creationTx: "0x89ab...71c2",
        deployerAddress: "0x3e1740d04961d67da91c94d01bfae829377484df",
        quantum_entropy_signature: "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
        description: "Primary algorithmic liquidity reserve token pegged to multi-chain treasury assets with sovereign multi-sig backing.",
        tags: ["DeFi", "Liquidity", "Sovereign"],
      },
      {
        id: "tok-fossi-2",
        name: "Fossibot Decentralized Telemetry",
        symbol: "FOSSI",
        chain: "base",
        networkId: 8453,
        contractAddress: "0x00F055106967Fa819d4b067aA9e729aE957d19A8",
        isVanity: true,
        tokenId: "2",
        tokenStandard: "ERC-20",
        narrative: "depin",
        launchStatus: "Liquidity Locked",
        initialSupply: "500000000",
        decimals: 18,
        marketCap: 1250000000,
        priceUsd: 2.5,
        liquidityPair: "FOSSI/WETH",
        holderCount: 890,
        auditFirm: "OpenZeppelin",
        securityScore: 95,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        creationTx: "0x12cd...89ef",
        deployerAddress: "0x3e1740d04961d67da91c94d01bfae829377484df",
        quantum_entropy_signature: "a591a6d40bf420404a011733cfb7b190d62c65bf0bcda32b57b277d9ad9f146e",
        description: "DePIN hardware telemetry verification token settling micro-transactions across rugged IoT modules.",
        tags: ["DePIN", "Hardware", "Telemetry"],
      },
      {
        id: "tok-tree3-3",
        name: "Tree3 Autonomous Multiverse",
        symbol: "TREE3",
        chain: "arbitrum",
        networkId: 42161,
        contractAddress: "0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc454e4438f44e",
        isVanity: false,
        tokenId: "3",
        tokenStandard: "ERC-721",
        narrative: "autonomous_worlds",
        launchStatus: "Audited",
        initialSupply: "10000",
        decimals: 0,
        marketCap: 890000000,
        priceUsd: 89.0,
        liquidityPair: "TREE3/ETH",
        holderCount: 520,
        auditFirm: "Trail of Bits",
        securityScore: 94,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        creationTx: "0x77aa...22cc",
        deployerAddress: "0x3e1740d04961d67da91c94d01bfae829377484df",
        quantum_entropy_signature: "c4ca4238a0b923820dcc509a6f75849b29c9be55d5be5a242c2d43b22cf9c193",
        description: "Procedural on-chain multiverse assets with mutable DNA state variables.",
        tags: ["Gaming", "NFT", "Multiverse"],
      },
    ];
  }, [tokens]);

  const filteredTokensForImport = useMemo(() => {
    return availableTokens.filter((tok) => {
      const match =
        tok.name.toLowerCase().includes(tokenSearchFilter.toLowerCase()) ||
        tok.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(tokenSearchFilter.toLowerCase()) ||
        tok.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(tokenSearchFilter.toLowerCase());
      return match;
    });
  }, [availableTokens, tokenSearchFilter]);

  const selectedTargetToken = useMemo(() => {
    return availableTokens.find((t) => t.id === targetTokenId) || availableTokens[0] || null;
  }, [availableTokens, targetTokenId]);

  const handleOpenImportModalForNote = (note: GoogleKeepNote) => {
    setImportModalNote(note);
    setImportModalThread(null);
    if (!targetTokenId && availableTokens.length > 0) {
      setTargetTokenId(availableTokens[0].id);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenImportModalForThread = (thread: GmailThreadSummary) => {
    setImportModalThread(thread);
    setImportModalNote(null);
    if (!targetTokenId && availableTokens.length > 0) {
      setTargetTokenId(availableTokens[0].id);
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteImportToToken = () => {
    if (!selectedTargetToken) return;

    let updatedDescription = "";
    let updatedTags = selectedTargetToken.tags || [];

    if (importModalNote) {
      const formattedNoteDesc = formatNoteAsTokenDescription(importModalNote, {
        includeTitle: true,
        includeChecklist: true,
        includeTags: true,
      });

      if (importMode === "append" && selectedTargetToken.description) {
        updatedDescription = `${selectedTargetToken.description.trim()}\n\n---\n${formattedNoteDesc}`;
      } else {
        updatedDescription = formattedNoteDesc;
      }

      if (syncTagsToToken && importModalNote.tags) {
        const tagSet = new Set([...updatedTags, ...importModalNote.tags]);
        updatedTags = Array.from(tagSet);
      }

      // Mark the note with the imported token
      const updatedNote: GoogleKeepNote = {
        ...importModalNote,
        importedToTokenId: selectedTargetToken.id,
      };
      setKeepNotes((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === updatedNote.id ? updatedNote : n)));
      saveGoogleKeepNote(updatedNote).catch(console.warn);

      setImportSuccessMessage(
        `Successfully imported note "${importModalNote.title}" into ${selectedTargetToken.name} ($${selectedTargetToken.symbol}) description!`
      );
    } else if (importModalThread) {
      const formattedThreadDesc = formatGmailThreadAsTokenDescription(importModalThread);
      if (importMode === "append" && selectedTargetToken.description) {
        updatedDescription = `${selectedTargetToken.description.trim()}\n\n---\n${formattedThreadDesc}`;
      } else {
        updatedDescription = formattedThreadDesc;
      }

      setImportSuccessMessage(
        `Successfully imported Gmail thread "${importModalThread.subject}" into ${selectedTargetToken.name} ($${selectedTargetToken.symbol}) description!`
      );
    }

    if (onUpdateToken) {
      onUpdateToken(selectedTargetToken.id, {
        description: updatedDescription,
        tags: updatedTags,
        marketEvolutionNote: `Updated with Google Workspace Note on ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}`,
      });
    }

    // Close modal after brief feedback
    setTimeout(() => {
      setImportModalNote(null);
      setImportModalThread(null);
    }, 1200);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setImportSuccessMessage(null);
    }, 5000);
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // PYTHON CONCURRENT.FUTURES BENCHMARK & SIMULATOR
  // =========================================================================
  const [selectedRecipeKey, setSelectedRecipeKey] = useState<keyof typeof PYTHON_CONCURRENT_FUTURES_CODE_EXAMPLES>("thread_pool_basic");
  const [simExecutorType, setSimExecutorType] = useState<"ThreadPoolExecutor" | "ProcessPoolExecutor">("ThreadPoolExecutor");
  const [simMaxWorkers, setSimMaxWorkers] = useState<number>(4);
  const [simTaskCount, setSimTaskCount] = useState<number>(8);
  const [simTaskType, setSimTaskType] = useState<"io" | "cpu">("io");
  const [simulateException, setSimulateException] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [benchmarkResult, setBenchmarkResult] = useState<ConcurrencyRunResult>(() =>
    runSimulatedConcurrencyTest({
      executorType: "ThreadPoolExecutor",
      maxWorkers: 4,
      taskCount: 8,
      taskType: "io",
    })
  );

  const handleRunBenchmark = () => {
    const res = runSimulatedConcurrencyTest({
      executorType: simExecutorType,
      maxWorkers: simMaxWorkers,
      taskCount: simTaskCount,
      taskType: simTaskType,
      simulateFailureOnIndex: simulateException ? 2 : undefined,
    });
    setBenchmarkResult(res);
  };

  const handleCopyCode = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2500);
  };

  const allTags = Array.from(new Set(keepNotes.flatMap((n) => n.tags)));
  const filteredNotes = keepNotes.filter((note) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      note.title.toLowerCase().includes(noteSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
      note.content.toLowerCase().includes(noteSearch.toLowerCase());
    const matchesTag = selectedTag ? note.tags.includes(selectedTag) : true;
    return matchesSearch && matchesTag;
  });

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6 pb-20">
      {/* Top Banner / Hero */}
      <div className="bg-[#121217] border border-[#22222D] rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-gradient-to-bl from-orange-500/10 via-red-500/5 to-transparent rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-6 relative z-10">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Google Workspace & Concurrency Suite
              </span>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30">
                Gmail Threads API • Keep Firestore • Token Description Importer
              </span>
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">
              Google Workspace (Gmail & Keep) & Python Futures Engine
            </h1>
            <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs sm:text-sm max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
              Authenticate authorized Workspace OAuth scopes, inspect multi-message Gmail discussion threads, synchronize Google Keep notes to Firestore, and <strong>import operational task notes directly as on-chain token descriptions</strong> with 1-click tokenomics formatting.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* User Sign-In Action Bar (Official GSI Spec) */}
          <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
            {user ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl">
                {user.photoURL ? (
                  <img src={user.photoURL} alt={user.displayName || "User"} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-orange-400/40" />
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">
                    <UserIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="text-left">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {user.displayName || user.email}
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono truncate max-w-[160px]">{user.email}</div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={handleLogout}
                  className="ml-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500/20 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/30 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Sign Out
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={handleGoogleSignIn}
                  disabled={isLoggingIn}
                  className="gsi-material-button flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-2 bg-white hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 rounded-xl font-medium text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-md transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <svg version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 48 48" className="w-4 h-4">
                    <path fill="#EA4335" d="M24 9.5c3.54 0 6.71 1.22 9.21 3.6l6.85-6.85C35.9 2.38 30.47 0 24 0 14.62 0 6.51 5.38 2.56 13.22l7.98 6.19C12.43 13.72 17.74 9.5 24 9.5z" />
                    <path fill="#4285F4" d="M46.98 24.55c0-1.57-.15-3.09-.38-4.55H24v9.02h12.94c-.58 2.96-2.26 5.48-4.78 7.18l7.73 6c4.51-4.18 7.09-10.36 7.09-17.65z" />
                    <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M10.53 28.59c-.48-1.45-.76-2.99-.76-4.59s.27-3.14.76-4.59l-7.98-6.19C.92 16.46 0 20.12 0 24c0 3.88.92 7.54 2.56 10.78l7.97-6.19z" />
                    <path fill="#34A853" d="M24 48c6.48 0 11.93-2.13 15.89-5.81l-7.73-6c-2.15 1.45-4.92 2.3-8.16 2.3-6.26 0-11.57-4.22-13.47-9.91l-7.98 6.19C6.51 42.62 14.62 48 24 48z" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>{isLoggingIn ? "Connecting..." : "Sign in with Google"}</span>
                </button>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Authenticates Gmail & Google Keep scopes</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {authError && (
              <div className="text-[11px] text-rose-400 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded max-w-xs text-right">
                {authError}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Import Success Banner */}
        {importSuccessMessage && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 text-xs flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />

            </div>
            <button

              className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5"

            </button>
          </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-[#1E1E26] overflow-x-auto">

            { id: "keep", label: "📝 2. Google Keep Notes & Token Importer", icon: CheckSquare, count: keepNotes.length },
            { id: "python_futures", label: "🐍 3. Python concurrent.futures Studio", icon: Terminal },
          ].map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            const isActive = activeHubTab === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveHubTab(tab.id as any)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20"
                    : "bg-[#181822] text-gray-300 hover:bg-[#20202C] hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B38]"
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
                {tab.count !== undefined && (
                  <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-mono ${isActive ? "bg-white/20 text-white" : "bg-[#252533] text-gray-400"}`}>
                    {tab.count}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {/* TAB 1: GMAIL WORKSPACE CLIENT & THREADS */}
      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {activeHubTab === "gmail" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">

          {emailNotice && (
            <div

                emailNotice.type === "success"
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300"
                  : "bg-rose-500/15 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300"
              }`}
            >
              <span>{emailNotice.text}</span>
              <button onClick={() => setEmailNotice(null)} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs ml-4">
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Quick Actions & Search Bar */}
          <div className="bg-[#121217] border border-[#22222D] rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1">
              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search Gmail threads or messages (e.g. in:inbox, is:unread, subject:audit)..."

                  onChange={(e) => setEmailSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && loadGmailData(emailSearchQuery)}

                />
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => loadGmailData(emailSearchQuery)}

              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoadingEmails ? "animate-spin text-orange-400" : ""}`} />
                Search
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center bg-[#181822] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[#262635]">

                    gmailViewMode === "threads"
                      ? "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30"
                      : "text-gray-400 hover:text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setGmailViewMode("messages")}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                    gmailViewMode === "messages"
                      ? "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30"
                      : "text-gray-400 hover:text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Messages ({emails.length})
                </button>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => setIsComposing(true)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />

              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
            {/* Thread / Message List (Col 5) */}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1E1E26]">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {gmailViewMode === "threads" ? (
                    <>
                      <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />

                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />
                      Individual Messages
                    </>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">
                  {gmailViewMode === "threads" ? `${threads.length} Threads` : `${emails.length} Messages`}

              </div>

              {isLoadingEmails ? (
                <div className="p-8 text-center space-y-2">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-400 animate-spin mx-auto" />

                </div>
              ) : gmailViewMode === "threads" ? (
                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[520px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">

                    const isSelected = selectedThread?.id === th.id;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={th.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelectedThread(th);
                          setExpandedThreadId(th.id);
                        }}
                        className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer space-y-1.5 ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-[#1B1B26] border-orange-500/50 shadow-md"
                            : "bg-[#14141B] border-[#22222D] hover:border-gray-600 hover:bg-[#181822]"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-gray-300 truncate max-w-[200px]">
                            {th.senders.join(", ")}

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 font-mono">
                              {th.messagesCount} msg
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">{th.latestDate}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className={`text-xs font-bold leading-tight ${th.unread ? "text-white" : "text-gray-300"}`}>
                          {th.subject || "(No Subject)"}
                        </div>

                        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 line-clamp-1">{th.snippet}</p>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {th.unread && (
                              <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30">
                                NEW
                              </span>
                            )}
                            {th.starred && (
                              <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30">
                                ★ STARRED
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          <button
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              handleOpenImportModalForThread(th);

                            className="text-[10px] text-orange-400 hover:text-orange-300 bg-orange-500/10 hover:bg-orange-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-orange-500/20 flex items-center gap-1"

                          >
                            <Coins className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Import to Token
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[520px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {emails.map((msg) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedEmail?.id === msg.id;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={msg.id}
                        onClick={() => setSelectedEmail(msg)}
                        className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer space-y-1.5 ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-[#1B1B26] border-orange-500/50 shadow-md"
                            : "bg-[#14141B] border-[#22222D] hover:border-gray-600 hover:bg-[#181822]"

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-gray-300 truncate max-w-[200px]">{msg.from}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">{msg.date}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className={`text-xs font-bold leading-tight ${msg.unread ? "text-white" : "text-gray-300"}`}>
                          {msg.subject || "(No Subject)"}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 line-clamp-1">{msg.snippet}</p>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}

            {/* Email / Thread Detail Panel (Col 7) */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-[#121217] border border-[#22222D] rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              {gmailViewMode === "threads" && selectedThread ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1E1E26]">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30">
                          {selectedThread.messagesCount} Message Thread
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">ID: {selectedThread.id}</span>
                      </div>
                      <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white leading-snug mt-1">
                        {selectedThread.subject}
                      </h2>
                      <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1 flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-500">Participants:</span>{" "}
                          <span className="text-orange-300 font-mono">{selectedThread.senders.join(", ")}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-500">Last activity:</span>{" "}
                          <span className="text-gray-300">{selectedThread.latestDate}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 flex-wrap">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleOpenImportModalForThread(selectedThread)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-700 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20 transition cursor-pointer"
                        title="Import thread into Token Description"
                      >
                        <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        Import as Token Desc
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleClipThreadToKeep(selectedThread)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#181822] hover:bg-[#232330] border border-[#262635] text-xs text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                        title="Clip entire thread to Google Keep"
                      >
                        <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        Clip Thread to Keep
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Thread messages list */}
                  <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[460px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                    {selectedThread.messages.length > 0 ? (
                      selectedThread.messages.map((m, idx) => (
                        <div key={m.id || idx} className="p-4 bg-[#0D0D11] border border-[#1C1C24] rounded-xl space-y-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pb-1.5 border-b border-white/5">
                            <span className="font-bold text-orange-300 font-mono">{m.from}</span>
                            <span className="text-gray-500 text-[11px]">{m.date}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-300 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                            {m.snippet}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))
                    ) : (
                      <div className="p-4 bg-[#0D0D11] border border-[#1C1C24] rounded-xl text-xs text-gray-300">
                        {selectedThread.snippet}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : selectedEmail ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1E1E26]">
                    <div>
                      <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white leading-snug">{selectedEmail.subject}</h2>
                      <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1 flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-500">From:</span>{" "}
                          <span className="text-orange-300 font-mono">{selectedEmail.from}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-500">To:</span> <span className="text-gray-300 font-mono">{selectedEmail.to}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-gray-500">Date:</span> <span className="text-gray-300">{selectedEmail.date}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleClipEmailToKeep(selectedEmail)}

                        title="Save to Google Keep"
                      >
                        <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        Clip to Keep
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => {
                          setIsComposing(true);
                          setComposeTo(selectedEmail.from.match(/<([^>]+)>/)?.[1] || selectedEmail.from);
                          setComposeSubject(`Re: ${selectedEmail.subject}`);
                          setComposeBody(`\n\n--- On ${selectedEmail.date}, ${selectedEmail.from} wrote:\n> ${selectedEmail.snippet}`);
                        }}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-orange-500/20 hover:bg-orange-500/30 border border-orange-500/40 text-xs text-orange-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
