                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Body Content */}
                  <div className="p-4 bg-[#0D0D11] border border-[#1C1C24] rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-300 leading-relaxed font-sans whitespace-pre-wrap min-h-[220px]">
                    {selectedEmail.snippet || "(No content in preview)"}
                  </div>

                  {/* Labels Tag Row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap pt-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">Labels:</span>
                    {selectedEmail.labelIds.map((lbl) => (
                      <span key={lbl} className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] text-gray-400">
                        {lbl}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-16 text-center text-xs text-gray-500 space-y-2">
                  <Mail className="w-10 h-10 text-gray-700 mx-auto" />
                  <p>Select a thread or message to view content.</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Compose Email Modal / Slide-out */}
          {isComposing && (
            <div className="p-6 bg-[#121217] border border-orange-500/30 rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-2xl relative">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#1E1E26]">
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Send className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
                  New Gmail Message
                </span>
                <button onClick={() => setIsComposing(false)} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold">
                  ✕ Close
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Recipient (To:)</label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    placeholder="recipient@example.com"
                    value={composeTo}
                    onChange={(e) => setComposeTo(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-gray-500 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500/50"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Subject</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Subject line..."
                    value={composeSubject}
                    onChange={(e) => setComposeSubject(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-gray-500 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500/50"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Email Body</label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={6}
                    placeholder="Compose message..."
                    value={composeBody}
                    onChange={(e) => setComposeBody(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-white placeholder-gray-500 font-sans focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500/50"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2">
                <button
                  onClick={handleSaveDraft}
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-[#181822] hover:bg-[#222230] text-gray-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border border-[#262635] transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Save as Draft
                </button>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSendEmail}
                    disabled={isSendingEmail}
                    className="px-5 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-700 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    {isSendingEmail ? "Sending..." : "Send Message"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {/* TAB 2: GOOGLE KEEP NOTES & TOKEN IMPORTER */}
      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {activeHubTab === "keep" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Keep New Note Creator Banner */}
          <div className="bg-[#121217] border border-[#22222D] rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1E1E26]">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                Google Keep Quick Note & Token Spec Creator
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">
                Persisted in Firestore &bull; Real-time Sync
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Title (e.g. ⚡ Tokenomics & Buyback Specification)..."
                value={newNoteTitle}
                onChange={(e) => setNewNoteTitle(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-white placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50"
              />

              {isChecklistMode ? (
                <div className="space-y-2 p-3 bg-[#0D0D11] border border-[#1E1E26] rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-gray-400">Checklist Items:</span>
                  {newChecklistItems.map((item, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded border border-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                        {idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        placeholder={`Milestone or specification item #${idx + 1}...`}
                        value={item}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const updated = [...newChecklistItems];
                          updated[idx] = e.target.value;
                          setNewChecklistItems(updated);
                        }}
                        className="flex-1 bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white font-mono"
                      />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setNewChecklistItems([...newChecklistItems, ""])}
                    className="text-xs text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono pt-1 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    + Add item
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  placeholder="Take a note or write token narrative / deliverables..."
                  value={newNoteContent}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewNoteContent(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-white placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50"
                />
              )}

              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-[#1E1E26]">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsChecklistMode(!isChecklistMode)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg border font-mono transition cursor-pointer ${
                      isChecklistMode
                        ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30 font-bold"
                        : "bg-[#181822] text-gray-400 border-[#262635] hover:text-white"
                    }`}

                    ☑️ {isChecklistMode ? "Checklist Mode Active" : "Convert to Checklist"}
                  </button>

                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Tags (comma separated)..."
                    value={newNoteTagInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewNoteTagInput(e.target.value)}
                    className="bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-gray-300 placeholder-gray-500 font-mono w-44"
                  />
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleCreateNote}
                  className="px-5 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-orange-500 hover:from-amber-600 hover:to-orange-600 text-black font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Save to Keep
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Filter & Tag Row */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                <Tag className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Filter:
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedTag(null)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg font-mono transition cursor-pointer ${
                  selectedTag === null ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-bold border border-amber-500/40" : "bg-[#181822] text-gray-400 border border-[#262635]"
                }`}
              >
                All ({keepNotes.length})
              </button>
              {allTags.map((tag) => (
                <button
                  key={tag}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedTag(tag === selectedTag ? null : tag)}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs rounded-lg font-mono transition cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedTag === tag ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-bold border border-amber-500/40" : "bg-[#181822] text-gray-400 border border-[#262635]"
                  }`}
                >
                  #{tag}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-56">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search notes..."
                value={noteSearch}
                onChange={(e) => setNoteSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl pl-8 pr-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-gray-500 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Notes Grid Display */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {filteredNotes.map((note) => {
              const linkedToken = availableTokens.find((t) => t.id === note.importedToTokenId);
              return (
                <div
                  key={note.id}
                  className="p-5 rounded-2xl border border-[#2A2A38] bg-[#14141B] space-y-3 relative group transition hover:border-amber-500/40 shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: note.color || "#14141B" }}
                >
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-sm leading-snug">{note.title}</h3>
                        {linkedToken && (
                          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 font-mono">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-400" />
                            Imported to ${linkedToken.symbol}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleTogglePin(note)}
                          className={`p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 transition cursor-pointer ${note.pinned ? "text-amber-400" : "text-gray-500"}`}
                          title={note.pinned ? "Unpin note" : "Pin note"}
                        >
                          <Pin className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteNote(note.id)}
                          className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-rose-500/20 text-gray-500 hover:text-rose-400 transition cursor-pointer"
                          title="Delete note"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {note.content && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">{note.content}</p>
                    )}

                    {note.items && note.items.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                        {note.items.map((item) => (
                          <div
                            key={item.id}
                            onClick={() => handleToggleChecklistItem(note, item.id)}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs cursor-pointer select-none"
                          >
                            <span className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded border flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] ${item.completed ? "bg-emerald-500/20 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-400" : "border-gray-500 text-transparent"}`}>
                              ✓
                            </span>
                            <span className={item.completed ? "line-through text-gray-500" : "text-gray-200"}>
                              {item.text}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/5 space-y-2.5">
                    {note.tags && note.tags.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        {note.tags.map((t) => (
                          <span key={t} className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/30 text-amber-300/80 border border-amber-500/20">
                            #{t}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Action Bar for Note: Import as Token Description + Export to Gmail */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1 border-t border-white/5">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleOpenImportModalForNote(note)}
                        className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-orange-500/20 hover:bg-orange-500/30 text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/40 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                        title="Import this note directly as an ERC-20 / NFT token description"
                      >
                        <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />

                      </button>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">
                          {new Date(note.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleExportKeepToGmail(note)}
                          className="text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 font-semibold text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Email <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {/* IMPORT NOTE / THREAD INTO TOKEN DESCRIPTION MODAL */}
      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {(importModalNote || importModalThread) && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-[#121217] border border-orange-500/40 rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl relative max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#1E1E26]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30">
                  <Coins className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white leading-tight">
                    Import to Token Description
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    Convert Google Workspace note/thread into structured Web3 token narrative & roadmap status.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setImportModalNote(null);
                  setImportModalThread(null);
                }}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1"
              >
                ✕ Close
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Source Item Overview */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-[#181822] border border-[#282836] rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-orange-400 font-bold block">
                Source Document:
              </span>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm text-white">
                {importModalNote ? importModalNote.title : importModalThread?.subject}
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-300 line-clamp-3">
                {importModalNote
                  ? importModalNote.content || `${importModalNote.items?.length || 0} checklist items`
                  : importModalThread?.snippet}
              </div>
              {importModalNote?.items && importModalNote.items.length > 0 && (
                <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-mono">
                  Contains {importModalNote.items.length} milestone checklist items (will be included as audited roadmap items).
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Target Token Selector */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-300 block">
                Target Token to Update:
              </label>

              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search token by name, symbol, or address..."
                  value={tokenSearchFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setTokenSearchFilter(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#282836] rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-gray-500 font-mono mb-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500/50"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {filteredTokensForImport.map((tok) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedTargetToken?.id === tok.id;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={tok.id}
                      onClick={() => setTargetTokenId(tok.id)}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer transition text-xs ${
                        isSelected
                          ? "bg-orange-500/15 border-orange-500/50 text-white font-semibold"
                          : "bg-[#14141B] border-[#22222D] text-gray-300 hover:bg-[#1A1A24]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                        <span className="font-bold text-orange-400 font-mono">${tok.symbol}</span>
                        <span className="truncate">{tok.name}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/40 text-gray-400">
                          {tok.chain}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                        {tok.description && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 italic">Has Description</span>
                        )}
                        <span className="text-xs text-orange-400 font-bold">{isSelected ? "✓ Selected" : "Select"}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Mode & Options */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="text-gray-400 font-mono block">Import Mode:</label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setImportMode("replace")}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg border font-semibold text-center transition cursor-pointer ${
                      importMode === "replace"
                        ? "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 border-orange-500/40"
                        : "bg-[#181822] text-gray-400 border-[#262635]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    Replace Description
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setImportMode("append")}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg border font-semibold text-center transition cursor-pointer ${
                      importMode === "append"
                        ? "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 border-orange-500/40"
                        : "bg-[#181822] text-gray-400 border-[#262635]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    Append to Existing
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col justify-end space-y-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-gray-300 select-none">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={syncTagsToToken}
                    onChange={(e) => setSyncTagsToToken(e.target.checked)}
                    className="rounded border-gray-600 text-orange-500 focus:ring-0"
                  />
                  <span>Sync note tags into token narrative tags</span>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Formatted Preview Box */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-gray-400">Formatted Token Description Preview:</span>
              <div className="p-3 bg-[#0A0A0E] border border-[#1E1E28] rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-gray-300 whitespace-pre-wrap max-h-36 overflow-y-auto leading-relaxed">
                {importModalNote
                  ? formatNoteAsTokenDescription(importModalNote, {
                      includeTitle: true,
                      includeChecklist: true,
                      includeTags: true,
                    })
                  : importModalThread
                  ? formatGmailThreadAsTokenDescription(importModalThread)
                  : ""}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Actions */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-[#1E1E26]">
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setImportModalNote(null);
                  setImportModalThread(null);
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-[#181822] hover:bg-[#20202C] text-gray-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border border-[#282836] transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={handleExecuteImportToToken}
                disabled={!selectedTargetToken}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-700 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/25 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                Confirm & Import into ${selectedTargetToken?.symbol || "TOKEN"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {/* TAB 3: PYTHON CONCURRENT.FUTURES STUDIO */}
      {/* ===================================================================== */}
      {activeHubTab === "python_futures" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Top Architectural Guide Overview (Mauro Lomibao Dar III) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className="p-4 bg-[#14141A] border border-[#22222D] rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
                ThreadPoolExecutor
              </div>
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-xs leading-relaxed">
                Manages a pool of threads. Ideal for <strong>I/O-bound</strong> tasks like Web3 RPC queries, network requests, and disk operations where threads spend time awaiting external latency.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-[#14141A] border border-[#22222D] rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-cyan-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                <Cpu className="w-4 h-4" />
                ProcessPoolExecutor
              </div>
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-xs leading-relaxed">
                Manages separate OS processes for true multi-core parallel execution. Bypasses Python’s <strong>Global Interpreter Lock (GIL)</strong> for CPU-bound cryptography & hashing.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-[#14141A] border border-[#22222D] rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
                as_completed & wait()
              </div>
              <p className="text-gray-300 text-xs leading-relaxed">
                <code className="text-emerald-300 font-mono">as_completed()</code> streams resolved Future instances as they finish. <code className="text-emerald-300 font-mono">wait(FIRST_COMPLETED)</code> enables ultra-fast failover across redundant relays.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive Concurrency Benchmark Runner */}
          <div className="bg-[#121217] border border-[#22222D] rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1E1E26]">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Play className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
                  Live Concurrent Benchmark Simulator
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                  Simulate async worker pool execution, task scheduling, exception handling, and speedup benchmarks.
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleRunBenchmark}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Run Benchmark
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Config Controls */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-gray-400 font-mono">Executor Type:</label>
                <select
                  value={simExecutorType}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimExecutorType(e.target.value as any)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white font-mono focus:outline-none"
                >
                  <option value="ThreadPoolExecutor">ThreadPoolExecutor (I/O Threads)</option>
                  <option value="ProcessPoolExecutor">ProcessPoolExecutor (CPU Multi-core)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-gray-400 font-mono">Max Workers Pool ({simMaxWorkers}):</label>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min={1}
                  max={16}
                  value={simMaxWorkers}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimMaxWorkers(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-orange-500 cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-gray-400 font-mono">Task Count ({simTaskCount}):</label>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min={2}
                  max={32}
                  value={simTaskCount}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimTaskCount(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-orange-500 cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-gray-400 font-mono">Task Type:</label>
                <select
                  value={simTaskType}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimTaskType(e.target.value as any)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white font-mono focus:outline-none"
                >
                  <option value="io">I/O Bound (RPC, Network Latency)</option>
                  <option value="cpu">CPU Bound (Keccak Hashing, Math)</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-1">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs text-gray-300 select-none">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={simulateException}
                  onChange={(e) => setSimulateException(e.target.checked)}
                  className="rounded border-gray-600 text-orange-500 focus:ring-0"
                />
                <span>Simulate Future Exception &amp; Graceful Error Handling</span>
              </label>
            </div>

            {/* Results Grid */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 pt-2">
              <div className="p-3 bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl text-center">
                <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono uppercase">Sequential Estimate</div>
                <div className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-gray-300 font-mono">
                  {benchmarkResult.sequentialTimeSec.toFixed(2)} s
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-[#181822] border border-orange-500/30 rounded-xl text-center">
                <div className="text-[10px] text-orange-400 font-mono uppercase">Parallel Wall Time</div>
                <div className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-orange-300 font-mono">
                  {benchmarkResult.executionTimeSec.toFixed(2)} s
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-[#181822] border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-xl text-center">
                <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono uppercase">Theoretical Speedup</div>
                <div className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-emerald-300 font-mono">
                  {benchmarkResult.speedupFactor.toFixed(2)}x
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-[#181822] border border-[#262635] rounded-xl text-center">
                <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono uppercase">GIL Bypass Status</div>
                <div className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-cyan-400 font-mono">
                  {simExecutorType === "ProcessPoolExecutor" ? "GIL Bypassed (Multi-core)" : "Thread-level (GIL Active)"}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Visual Task Execution Stream */}
            <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono">Worker Task Timeline Log:</span>
              <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {benchmarkResult.tasks.map((task) => (
                  <div
                    key={task.id}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-between border ${
                      task.status === "FAILED"
                        ? "bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300"
                        : "bg-[#181822] border-[#262635] text-gray-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${task.status === "FAILED" ? "bg-rose-500" : "bg-emerald-400"}`} />
                      <span className="font-bold">{task.name}</span>
                      <span className="text-gray-500">[{task.workerId ? `Worker ${task.workerId}` : "Queued"}]</span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span>{task.durationMs.toFixed(0)} ms</span>
                      <span className="text-gray-400 truncate max-w-xs">{task.result || task.error}</span>
                    </div>

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { harmonicsAudioEngine } from "../utils/harmonicsAudioEngine";

interface HarmonicsOscilloscopeProps {
  isPlaying: boolean;
  frequency: number;
  color?: string;
  className?: string;
  height?: number;
  showDetails?: boolean;
}

export const HarmonicsOscilloscope: React.FC<HarmonicsOscilloscopeProps> = ({
  isPlaying,
  frequency,
  color = "#F27D26",
  className = "",
  height = 140,
  showDetails = true,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const animFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    let phase = 0;

    const render = () => {
      const width = canvas.width;
      const h = canvas.height;

      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, h);

      // Background subtle grid
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      const gridSpacing = 24;

      for (let x = 0; x < width; x += gridSpacing) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(x, h);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      for (let y = 0; y < h; y += gridSpacing) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        ctx.lineTo(width, y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Center reference axis
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, h / 2);
      ctx.lineTo(width, h / 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      const waveData = isPlaying ? harmonicsAudioEngine.getWaveformData() : null;

      if (isPlaying && waveData && waveData.length > 0) {
        // Draw real Web Audio FFT Oscilloscope Waveform
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.strokeStyle = color;
        ctx.shadowColor = color;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 10;

        const sliceWidth = width / waveData.length;
        let x = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < waveData.length; i++) {
          const v = waveData[i] / 128.0; // 0 to 2, centered at 1
          const y = (v * h) / 2;

          if (i === 0) {
            ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          } else {
            ctx.lineTo(x, y);
          }

          x += sliceWidth;
        }

        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        // Draw Lissajous Sacred Geometric Spiral in center
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(width / 2, h / 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = `${color}40`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();

        const phi = 1.6180339887;
        const spiralPoints = 64;
        const radiusBase = Math.min(width, h) * 0.28;

        for (let i = 0; i < spiralPoints; i++) {
          const t = (i / spiralPoints) * Math.PI * 4 + phase;
          const r = radiusBase * Math.sin(t * phi) * 0.5 + radiusBase * 0.4;
          const sx = Math.cos(t) * r;
          const sy = Math.sin(t * phi) * r;

          if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
          else ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
        }

        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();

        phase += 0.035;
      } else {
        // Peaceful idle resting wave
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)";
        const sliceWidth = width / 100;

        for (let i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
          const x = i * sliceWidth;
          const y = h / 2 + Math.sin(i * 0.08 + phase) * 8;
          if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }

        ctx.stroke();
        phase += 0.015;
      }

      animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };

    render();

    return () => {
      if (animFrameRef.current) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [isPlaying, color]);

  // Compute acoustic physics parameters
  const periodMs = (1000 / (frequency || 1)).toFixed(2);
  const wavelengthCm = ((34300 / (frequency || 1))).toFixed(1); // Speed of sound in air ~343 m/s = 34,300 cm/s
  const phiConvergence = ((frequency * 1.6180339887) % 1000).toFixed(1);

  return (
    <div className={`relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0E] border border-[#1F1F24] ${className}`}>
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        width={720}
        height={height}
        className="w-full h-full block"
      />

      {showDetails && (
        <div className="absolute top-2 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono pointer-events-none">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/60 border border-white/10 text-white">
              <span
                className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                  isPlaying ? "animate-pulse" : "opacity-40"
                }`}
                style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
              />
              <span className="font-bold">{frequency} Hz</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[#8E9299] hidden sm:inline">
              Period: {periodMs} ms
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[#8E9299]">
            <span className="hidden md:inline">Air λ: ~{wavelengthCm} cm</span>
            <span className="text-amber-400/90 font-semibold">
              Φ Ratio: {phiConvergence}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

};

export default HarmonicsStudio;

    setSelectedEdition(1);
    setEngineLogs((prev) => [
      `[ArtEngine 2.0] Switched active token context to ${token.name} (${token.symbol})`,
      ...prev.slice(0, 14),
    ]);
  }, [token.symbol, token.name]);

  const pushLayerChange = (nextLayers: ArtEngineLayerConfig[], logMessage?: string) => {
    setHistory((prev) => [...prev.slice(-19), layers]);
    setRedoStack([]);
    setLayers(nextLayers);
    if (logMessage) {
      setEngineLogs((prev) => [`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${logMessage}`, ...prev.slice(0, 19)]);
    }
  };

  const handleUndo = () => {
    if (history.length === 0) return;
    const previous = history[history.length - 1];
    setRedoStack((prev) => [layers, ...prev]);
    setHistory((prev) => prev.slice(0, -1));
    setLayers(previous);
    setEngineLogs((prev) => [`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Undo layer state restored`, ...prev]);
  };

  const handleRedo = () => {
    if (redoStack.length === 0) return;
    const next = redoStack[0];
    setHistory((prev) => [...prev, layers]);
    setRedoStack((prev) => prev.slice(1));
    setLayers(next);
    setEngineLogs((prev) => [`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Redo layer state applied`, ...prev]);
  };

  const handleRandomizeLayers = () => {
    const randomized = layers.map((layer) => {
      const randomOpt = layer.options[Math.floor(Math.random() * layer.options.length)] || layer.options[0];
      const randomBlend = BLEND_MODES[Math.floor(Math.random() * BLEND_MODES.length)];
      return {
        ...layer,
        selectedTraitId: randomOpt.id,
        opacity: Number((0.75 + Math.random() * 0.25).toFixed(2)),
        blurIntensity: Math.random() > 0.75 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) : 0,
        blendMode: layer.id === 'layer-background' ? 'source-over' : randomBlend,
      };
    });
    pushLayerChange(randomized, `Randomized layer traits, weights & blend modes for ${token.symbol}`);
  };

  const handleMoveLayer = (index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    const sorted = [...layers].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    const targetIdx = direction === 'up' ? index - 1 : index + 1;
    if (targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= sorted.length) return;
    const tempOrder = sorted[index].order;
    sorted[index] = { ...sorted[index], order: sorted[targetIdx].order };
    sorted[targetIdx] = { ...sorted[targetIdx], order: tempOrder };
    pushLayerChange(
      sorted.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order),
      `Reordered layer "${sorted[index].name}" to position #${sorted[index].order}`
    );
  };

  const handleExportConfigJson = () => {
    const payload = JSON.stringify({ tokenSymbol: token.symbol, editionCount, contractStandard, layers }, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([payload], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${token.symbol.toLowerCase()}-hashlips-layers-config.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const { assets, ipfsManifest, validationReport } = useMemo(
    () => buildHashLipsBatchCollection(token, layers, editionCount, contractStandard, ipfsProvider),
    [token, layers, editionCount, contractStandard, ipfsProvider]
  );

  const activeAsset = useMemo(
    () => assets.find((a) => a.edition === selectedEdition) || assets[0],
    [assets, selectedEdition]
  );

  const nodeGeneratorScript = useMemo(
    () => generateHashLipsNodeScript(token, layers, ipfsManifest, editionCount),
    [token, layers, ipfsManifest, editionCount]
  );

  const solidityContractCode = useMemo(
    () => generateHashLipsSolidityContract(token, ipfsManifest, contractStandard),
    [token, ipfsManifest, contractStandard]
  );

  const generatedZipBlob = useMemo(
    () => buildHashLipsZipBlob(token, assets, ipfsManifest, layers),
    [token, assets, ipfsManifest, layers]
  );

  const filteredByRarityAssets = useMemo(() => {
    const maxRank = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((rarityPercentileFilter / 100) * assets.length));
    return assets.filter((a) => a.rarityRank <= maxRank);
  }, [assets, rarityPercentileFilter]);

  const handleExecuteAeRun = async () => {
    setIsExecutingEngine(true);
    setEngineLogs((prev) => [
      `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Executing ae.run() -> ImageLayersInput + Erc721MetadataExporter + ImagesExporter...`,
      ...prev,
    ]);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          symbol: token.symbol,
          name: token.name,
          editionCount,
          contractStandard,
          ipfsProvider,
          baseTokenURI: ipfsManifest.baseTokenURI,
          imagesFolderUri: ipfsManifest.imagesFolderUri,
        }),
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setEngineLogs((prev) => [
          `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ae.run() completed in ${data.executionMs || 42}ms • BaseURI: ${ipfsManifest.baseTokenURI}`,
          ...prev,
        ]);
      }
    } catch {
      setEngineLogs((prev) => [
        `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Local deterministic ae.run() synthesized ${editionCount} PNG/SVG + JSON files.`,
        ...prev,
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsExecutingEngine(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (key: string, text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(''), 1800);
  };

  const handleDeployAndSyncMarketplace = () => {
    const hash = `0x${Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) =>
      ((token.symbol.charCodeAt(i % token.symbol.length) + i * 17 + selectedEdition) % 16).toString(16)
    ).join('')}`;
    setDeployedTxHash(hash);
    setEngineLogs((prev) => [
      `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Deployed ${contractStandard} contract with baseTokenURI=${ipfsManifest.baseTokenURI} (Tx: ${hash.slice(0, 18)}...)`,
      ...prev,
    ]);
    if (onDeployNftToAts && activeAsset) {
      onDeployNftToAts({
        symbol: token.symbol,
        edition: activeAsset.edition,
        baseTokenURI: ipfsManifest.baseTokenURI,
        tokenURI: activeAsset.ipfsMetadataUri,
        contractStandard,
        priceUsd: Number(token.price || 100),
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-100">
      {/* Top Architecture Banner */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-950 via-emerald-950/30 to-slate-950 p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-300">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                @hashlips-lab/art-engine v2.0
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-sky-500/20 border border-sky-500/40 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-sky-300">
                {contractStandard} • IPFS CIDv1
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-300">
                TWE ATS DEPLOYABLE
              </span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="mt-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
              Dynamic Full-Stack NFT Art Engine 2.0 — {token.name} ({token.symbol})
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300">
              Modular plugin pipeline (<code className="text-emerald-300">imageLayersInput</code> →{' '}
              <code className="text-emerald-300">ImageLayersRenderer</code> →{' '}
              <code className="text-emerald-300">erc721MetadataExporter</code> &{' '}
              <code className="text-emerald-300">imagesExporter</code>) with IPFS pinning & OpenZeppelin{' '}
              <code className="text-sky-300">tokenURI(uint256)</code> marketplace integration.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            {allTokens.length > 0 && onSelectToken && (
              <select
                value={token.symbol}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const found = allTokens.find((t) => t.symbol === e.target.value);
                  if (found) onSelectToken(found);
                }}
                className="rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-400"
              >
                {allTokens.map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.id || t.symbol} value={t.symbol}>
                    {t.symbol} — {t.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={handleExecuteAeRun}
              disabled={isExecutingEngine}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-4 py-2 text-xs transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${isExecutingEngine ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              {isExecutingEngine ? 'Running ae.run()...' : 'Execute ae.run() Pipeline'}
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => downloadAllMetadataAsZip(token, assets, ipfsManifest, layers)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-sky-500/20 hover:bg-sky-500/30 border border-sky-400/40 text-sky-200 font-semibold px-3.5 py-2 text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
              Download ZIP Bundle ({assets.length} NFTs)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 4-Step Pipeline Navigation */}
        <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
          {[
            {
              id: 'step1_engine',
              step: 'STEP 1',
              title: 'Art Engine 2.0 & Layers',
              subtitle: 'imageLayersInput & Exporters',
              icon: Layers,
            },
            {
              id: 'step2_ipfs',
              step: 'STEP 2',
              title: 'IPFS / Arweave Hosting',
              subtitle: 'Pin Images & BaseURI CID',
              icon: UploadCloud,
            },
            {
              id: 'step3_contract',
              step: 'STEP 3',
              title: 'Smart Contract & ATS',
              subtitle: 'baseTokenURI & tokenURI()',
              icon: FileCode,
            },
            {
              id: 'step4_rarity',
              step: 'STEP 4',
              title: 'Rarity & Validator',
              subtitle: 'Heatmap & Integrity Checks',
              icon: ShieldCheck,
            },
          ].map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            const active = activePipelineTab === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActivePipelineTab(tab.id as typeof activePipelineTab)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-3 text-left border transition cursor-pointer ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-400 text-white shadow-md'
                    : 'bg-slate-900/70 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:border-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${
                    active ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950' : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">{tab.step}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold truncate">{tab.title}</div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate">{tab.subtitle}</div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Full-Stack HashLips Art Engine 2.0 Console & Multi-Token Orchestrator (POST /api/generate) */}
      <ArtEngineTrigger
        activeToken={token}
        allTokens={allTokens}
        onSelectToken={onSelectToken}
        tweEnvConfig={tweEnvConfig}
        onUpdateTweEnvConfig={onUpdateTweEnvConfig}
      />

      {/* Thirdweb v5 + All-In-One Roof NFT Marketplace (8 Venues) + uint256 Per-Batch Tokenomics */}
      <ThirdwebAllInOneNftMarketplaceHub
        token={token}
        allTokens={allTokens}
        assets={assets}
        ipfsManifest={ipfsManifest}
        onSelectToken={onSelectToken}
        onDeployNftToAts={onDeployNftToAts}
      />

      {/* Main Two-Column Interactive Workspace */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Column (5 cols): Live Dynamic NFT Previewer & Edition Selector */}
        <div className="xl:col-span-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                  HashLipsLayerPreviewer • 1024×1024 PX
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                  {activeAsset.metadata.name} (Rank #{activeAsset.rarityRank}/{assets.length})
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setHeatmapOverlayEnabled((v) => !v)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono border transition cursor-pointer ${
                  heatmapOverlayEnabled
                    ? 'bg-rose-500/20 border-rose-400 text-rose-200'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-slate-300'
                }`}
              >
                <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {heatmapOverlayEnabled ? 'Heatmap ON' : 'Rarity Heatmap'}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Artwork Viewport */}
            <div className="relative aspect-square w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-700 bg-slate-950 shadow-inner">
              <img
                src={activeAsset.svgDataUri}
                alt={activeAsset.metadata.name}
                className="w-full h-full object-contain"
              />
              {heatmapOverlayEnabled && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-950/75 via-fuchsia-900/45 to-amber-500/40 pointer-events-none p-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="rounded bg-black/80 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-300 border border-amber-400/40">
                      ART ENGINE RARITY HEATMAP OVERLAY
                    </span>
                    <span className="rounded bg-black/80 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-400/40">
                      SCORE: {activeAsset.rarityScore}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    {activeAsset.layerSnapshot.map((s) => (
                      <div
                        key={s.layerName}
                        className="rounded-lg bg-slate-950/85 border border-white/15 p-2 text-[11px] font-mono"
                      >
                        <div className="text-slate-400 truncate">{s.layerName}</div>
                        <div className="text-white font-bold truncate">{s.traitName}</div>
                        <div className="text-amber-300">
                          Frequency: {s.rarityPct}% • Opacity: {Math.round(s.opacity * 100)}%
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Edition Switcher Bar */}
            <div className="mt-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <span>Select Generated Token Edition (1.png .. {editionCount}.png)</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400">{activeAsset.rarityTier}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-8 gap-1.5">
                {assets.map((item) => (
                  <button
                    key={item.edition}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedEdition(item.edition);
                      setTokenIdQuery(item.edition);
                    }}
                    className={`rounded-lg py-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold border transition cursor-pointer ${
                      item.edition === selectedEdition
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 border-emerald-300'
                        : 'bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    #{item.edition}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick URI Telemetry Box */}
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-800 p-3 text-xs font-mono">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Image IPFS URI:</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-300 truncate max-w-[260px]">{activeAsset.ipfsImageUri}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Metadata JSON URI:</span>
                <span className="text-sky-300 truncate max-w-[260px]">{activeAsset.ipfsMetadataUri}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Merkle DNA:</span>
                <span className="text-amber-300 truncate max-w-[260px]">{activeAsset.dna}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* HashLipsGenerationLogger */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400">
                <Terminal className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                HashLipsGenerationLogger (Live Pipeline Stream)
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">{engineLogs.length} events</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-36 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 p-3 space-y-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-300">
              {engineLogs.map((log, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="leading-relaxed">
                  {log}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column (7 cols): Active Pipeline Step Content */}
        <div className="xl:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {activePipelineTab === 'step1_engine' && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 p-5 space-y-5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                    STEP 1 • ArtEngineLayerManager
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white">
                    Configure Layer Order, Weights, Opacity, Blur & Blend Modes
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleUndo}
                    disabled={history.length === 0}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Undo
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleRedo}
                    disabled={redoStack.length === 0}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Redo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Redo
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleRandomizeLayers}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 border border-emerald-400/40 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-300 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Shuffle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Randomize Composition
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleExportConfigJson}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Export Config
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Layer Stack Controls */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {[...layers]
                  .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)
                  .map((layer, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={layer.id}
                      className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/80 p-3.5 space-y-3"
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-300">
                            {layer.order}
                          </span>
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={layer.enabled}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const next = layers.map((l) =>
                                l.id === layer.id ? { ...l, enabled: e.target.checked } : l
                              );
                              pushLayerChange(next, `Toggled layer "${layer.name}" -> ${e.target.checked}`);
                            }}
                            className="rounded border-slate-600 text-emerald-500 focus:ring-emerald-500"
                          />
                          <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{layer.name}</span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleMoveLayer(idx, 'up')}
                            disabled={idx === 0}
                            className="p-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-30 text-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Move Layer Up"
                          >
                            <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleMoveLayer(idx, 'down')}
                            disabled={idx === layers.length - 1}
                            className="p-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-30 text-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Move Layer Down"
                          >
                            <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 items-center">
                        {/* Trait Selector */}
                        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                          <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">
                            Active Layer Asset & Rarity Weight
                          </label>
                          <select
                            value={layer.selectedTraitId}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const next = layers.map((l) =>
                                l.id === layer.id ? { ...l, selectedTraitId: e.target.value } : l
                              );
                              pushLayerChange(next, `Updated trait in "${layer.name}"`);
                            }}
                            className="w-full rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white font-mono"
                          >
                            {layer.options.map((opt) => (
                              <option key={opt.id} value={opt.id}>
                                {opt.name} (Weight: {opt.weight}%)
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </div>

                        {/* Blend Mode */}
                        <div>
                          <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mb-1">Blend Mode</label>
                          <select
                            value={layer.blendMode}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const next = layers.map((l) =>
                                l.id === layer.id ? { ...l, blendMode: e.target.value as BlendModeType } : l
                              );
                              pushLayerChange(next, `Set blendMode=${e.target.value} on "${layer.name}"`);
                            }}
                            className="w-full rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white font-mono"
                          >
                            {BLEND_MODES.map((bm) => (

          <HashLipsGenerationLogger />

};

export default HashLipsArtEngine2Suite;
