import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Download,
  RefreshCw,
  FileJson,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Search,
  Lock,
  Wrench,
  Eye,
  Archive,
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types/token";
import {
  ArtEngineLayerConfig,
  ArtEngineIntegrityValidationReport,
  GeneratedArtEngineAsset,
  IpfsPinningManifest,
  ZipArchiveFinalIntegrityReport,
  HashLipsIntegrityValidator,
  buildHashLipsZipBlob,
  parseAndValidateZipBlob,
  inspectAndValidateZipArchiveContents,
  emitArtEngineLog,
} from "../utils/artEngine";

export interface HashLipsExportValidatorProps {
  /** The generated PKZIP archive Blob to parse and validate before download */
  zipBlob?: Blob | null;
  /** Total expected edition count configured in the Art Engine */
  expectedEditionCount?: number;
  token?: TokenRecord;
  assets?: GeneratedArtEngineAsset[];
  ipfsManifest?: IpfsPinningManifest;
  layers: ArtEngineLayerConfig[];
  validationReport: ArtEngineIntegrityValidationReport;
  onSelectEdition?: (edition: number) => void;
}

export const HashLipsExportValidator: React.FC<HashLipsExportValidatorProps> = ({
  zipBlob,
  expectedEditionCount,
  token,
  assets = [],
  ipfsManifest,
  layers,
  validationReport,
  onSelectEdition,
}) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [filterMode, setFilterMode] = useState<"ALL" | "PASS" | "FAIL">("ALL");
  const [inspectedTokenId, setInspectedTokenId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [simulatedFaultMode, setSimulatedFaultMode] = useState<
    "NONE" | "CORRUPT_BASE_URI" | "METADATA_COUNT_MISMATCH" | "MISSING_ASSET_TOKEN_ID"
  >("NONE");
  const [isScanningZip, setIsScanningZip] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastAuditTimestamp, setLastAuditTimestamp] = useState<string>(() =>
    new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
  );

  const targetExpectedCount = useMemo(
    () => expectedEditionCount ?? assets.length,
    [expectedEditionCount, assets.length]
  );

  const preSweep = useMemo(() => HashLipsIntegrityValidator(layers), [layers]);

  const effectiveManifest: IpfsPinningManifest = useMemo(() => {
    if (ipfsManifest) return ipfsManifest;
    return {
      provider: "Pinata Cloud Enterprise",
      imagesCid: "bafybeigdyrzt5sfp7udm7hu76uh7y26nf3efuylqabf3oclgtqy55fbzdi",
      metadataCid: "bafybeihkoviema7g3gxyt6la7vd5ho32ictqbilu3wnlo3rs7ewhnp7lly",
      imagesFolderUri: "ipfs://bafybeigdyrzt5sfp7udm7hu76uh7y26nf3efuylqabf3oclgtqy55fbzdi/",
      baseTokenURI: "ipfs://bafybeihkoviema7g3gxyt6la7vd5ho32ictqbilu3wnlo3rs7ewhnp7lly/",
      gatewayBaseUrl:
        "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/bafybeihkoviema7g3gxyt6la7vd5ho32ictqbilu3wnlo3rs7ewhnp7lly/",
      pinnedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      totalBytesPinned: 24576,
      verificationHash: "0x8a9c4f21e7b03d12",
    };
  }, [ipfsManifest]);

  // Apply optional fault simulation if user tests gate enforcement
  const effectiveAssets: GeneratedArtEngineAsset[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (simulatedFaultMode === "NONE") return assets;
    if (simulatedFaultMode === "METADATA_COUNT_MISMATCH") {
      // Drop the last edition so generated JSON metadata count != expectedEditionCount
      return assets.slice(0, Math.max(0, assets.length - 1));
    }
    return assets.map((asset, index) => {
      if (index === 0 && simulatedFaultMode === "CORRUPT_BASE_URI") {
        return {
          ...asset,
          metadata: {
            ...asset.metadata,
            baseURI: "http://unpinned-invalid-uri.local/",
            baseTokenURI: "http://unpinned-invalid-uri.local/",
            image: "invalid://missing_cid/1.png",
          },
        };
      }
      if (index === 0 && simulatedFaultMode === "MISSING_ASSET_TOKEN_ID") {
        return {
          ...asset,
          svgSource: "",
          svgDataUri: "",
        };
      }
      return asset;
    });
  }, [assets, simulatedFaultMode]);

  // Determine the active ZIP Blob: use the passed `zipBlob` prop when no test fault is active,
  // or synthesize a fresh ZIP Blob from `effectiveAssets` so binary parsing always inspects a real Blob.
  const activeZipBlob: Blob = useMemo(() => {
    if (zipBlob && simulatedFaultMode === "NONE") {
      return zipBlob;
    }
    return buildHashLipsZipBlob(
      token || { symbol: "TWE", name: "Token World Exchange ATS" },
      effectiveAssets,
      effectiveManifest,
      layers
    );
  }, [zipBlob, simulatedFaultMode, token, effectiveAssets, effectiveManifest, layers]);

  // Synchronous fallback report while async binary Blob parsing completes
  const syncFallbackAudit = useMemo(() => {
    const base = inspectAndValidateZipArchiveContents(
      token || { symbol: "TWE", name: "Token World Exchange ATS" },
      effectiveAssets,
      effectiveManifest,
      layers
    );
    const countMatches =
      targetExpectedCount > 0 && base.parsedMetadataFilesCount === targetExpectedCount;
    return {
      ...base,
      expectedEditionCount: targetExpectedCount,
      metadataCountMatchesExpected: countMatches,
      isArchiveValid: base.isArchiveValid && countMatches,
    };
  }, [token, effectiveAssets, effectiveManifest, layers, targetExpectedCount]);

  const [parsedBlobAudit, setParsedBlobAudit] =
    useState<ZipArchiveFinalIntegrityReport>(syncFallbackAudit);

  // Parse the actual binary ZIP Blob (`activeZipBlob.arrayBuffer()`) whenever `activeZipBlob` or `targetExpectedCount` changes
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const archiveName = `${(token?.symbol || "TWE").toLowerCase()}-hashlips-art-engine-2-bundle.zip`;

    parseAndValidateZipBlob(activeZipBlob, targetExpectedCount, archiveName)
      .then((report) => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setParsedBlobAudit(report);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setParsedBlobAudit(syncFallbackAudit);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [activeZipBlob, targetExpectedCount, token?.symbol, syncFallbackAudit]);

  const zipAudit = parsedBlobAudit;

  const filteredTokenRecords = useMemo(() => {
    return zipAudit.tokenRecords.filter((rec) => {
      if (filterMode === "PASS" && rec.status !== "PASS") return false;
      if (filterMode === "FAIL" && rec.status !== "FAIL") return false;
      if (!searchQuery.trim()) return true;
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      return (
        String(rec.tokenId).includes(q) ||
        rec.metadataPath.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        rec.imageAssetPath.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        rec.resolvedBaseUri.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        rec.dna.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [zipAudit.tokenRecords, filterMode, searchQuery]);

  const inspectedRecord = useMemo(() => {
    if (inspectedTokenId === null) return zipAudit.tokenRecords[0] || null;
    return (
      zipAudit.tokenRecords.find((r) => r.tokenId === inspectedTokenId) ||
      zipAudit.tokenRecords[0] ||
      null
    );
  }, [zipAudit.tokenRecords, inspectedTokenId]);

  const inspectedAsset = useMemo(() => {
    if (!inspectedRecord) return null;
    return effectiveAssets.find((a) => a.edition === inspectedRecord.tokenId) || null;
  }, [effectiveAssets, inspectedRecord]);

  const handleRunDeepZipAudit = async () => {
    setIsScanningZip(true);
    try {
      const archiveName = `${(token?.symbol || "TWE").toLowerCase()}-hashlips-art-engine-2-bundle.zip`;
      const report = await parseAndValidateZipBlob(
        activeZipBlob,
        targetExpectedCount,
        archiveName
      );
      setParsedBlobAudit(report);
      setLastAuditTimestamp(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      emitArtEngineLog(
        "HashLipsExportValidator",
        report.isArchiveValid
          ? `Binary ZIP Blob audit PASSED: ${report.parsedMetadataFilesCount}/${report.expectedEditionCount} JSON metadata files verified with valid IPFS baseURI (${effectiveManifest.baseTokenURI}).`
          : `Binary ZIP Blob audit FAILED: Metadata count ${report.parsedMetadataFilesCount}/${report.expectedEditionCount}, failed IDs: [${report.failedTokenIds.join(", ")}].`,
        report.isArchiveValid ? "SUCCESS" : "ERROR",
        100
      );
    } finally {
      setIsScanningZip(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRepairFaults = () => {
    setSimulatedFaultMode("NONE");
    setLastAuditTimestamp(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
    emitArtEngineLog(
      "HashLipsExportValidator",
      `Restored IPFS baseURI (${effectiveManifest.baseTokenURI}) and synced all ${targetExpectedCount} expected JSON metadata & asset files in ZIP Blob.`,
      "SUCCESS",
      100
    );
  };

  const handleVerifiedZipDownload = () => {
    if (!zipAudit.isArchiveValid) return;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(activeZipBlob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = zipAudit.archiveFileName;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

    emitArtEngineLog(
      "HashLipsExportValidator",
      `Downloaded verified ZIP Blob ${zipAudit.archiveFileName} (${(activeZipBlob.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB • ${zipAudit.parsedMetadataFilesCount}/${zipAudit.expectedEditionCount} JSON files)`,
      "SUCCESS",
      100
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-5 space-y-5 font-mono shadow-xl">
      {/* Top Header & Pre-Download Gate Status */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-300">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              HashLips Export Validator (Binary ZIP Blob Parser)
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              Blob Size: <strong className="text-slate-200">{(activeZipBlob.size / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB</strong>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">• Audited {lastAuditTimestamp}</span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-1.5 text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white">
            ZIP Blob Metadata Parser: IPFS <code className="text-emerald-300">baseURI</code> Format &amp; Expected Edition Count ({zipAudit.parsedMetadataFilesCount}/{zipAudit.expectedEditionCount} JSON Files)
          </h3>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRunDeepZipAudit}
            disabled={isScanningZip}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-200 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isScanningZip ? "animate-spin text-emerald-400" : ""}`} />
            {isScanningZip ? "Parsing ZIP Blob..." : "Re-Parse ZIP Blob"}
          </button>

          {simulatedFaultMode === "NONE" ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSimulatedFaultMode("CORRUPT_BASE_URI")}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/25 border border-amber-500/40 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-300 transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Simulate a malformed IPFS baseURI or metadata count mismatch in the ZIP Blob"
            >
              <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Test Gate Fault
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRepairFaults}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 border border-emerald-400/50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-300 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Auto-Repair ZIP Blob
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!zipAudit.isArchiveValid}
            onClick={handleVerifiedZipDownload}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
              zipAudit.isArchiveValid
                ? "bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20"
                : "bg-rose-950/60 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300 cursor-not-allowed opacity-80"
            }`}
          >
            {zipAudit.isArchiveValid ? (
              <>
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Download Verified ZIP Blob ({zipAudit.totalFilesCount} Files)
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                ZIP Download Blocked (Validation Failed)
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4 Core ZIP Blob Validation Gate Indicators */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs">
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 ${
            zipAudit.allBaseUrisValid
              ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-950/20"
              : "border-rose-500/50 bg-rose-950/30"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-bold">
              1. IPFS baseURI Property Check
            </span>
            <span
              className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                zipAudit.allBaseUrisValid
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40"
                  : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40"
              }`}
            >
              {zipAudit.allBaseUrisValid ? "VALID IPFS URI" : "INVALID URI"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-white truncate">
            {effectiveManifest.baseTokenURI}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            {zipAudit.tokenRecords.filter((r) => r.baseUriValid && r.imageIpfsUriValid).length} /{" "}
            {zipAudit.parsedMetadataFilesCount} parsed JSONs match <code className="text-emerald-300">ipfs://&lt;CID&gt;/</code>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 ${
            zipAudit.metadataCountMatchesExpected
              ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-950/20"
              : "border-rose-500/50 bg-rose-950/30"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-bold">
              2. JSON Metadata Count vs. Config
            </span>
            <span
              className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                zipAudit.metadataCountMatchesExpected
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40"
                  : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40"
              }`}
            >
              {zipAudit.metadataCountMatchesExpected ? "COUNT MATCHED" : "COUNT MISMATCH"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-white">
            {zipAudit.parsedMetadataFilesCount} Generated / {zipAudit.expectedEditionCount} Expected
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            Parsed <code className="text-sky-300">metadata/&lt;id&gt;.json</code> count matches Art Engine config
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 ${
            zipAudit.allTokenIdsHaveAssets
              ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-950/20"
              : "border-rose-500/50 bg-rose-950/30"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-bold">
              3. 1:1 Token ID ↔ Asset Match
            </span>
            <span
              className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                zipAudit.allTokenIdsHaveAssets
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40"
                  : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40"
              }`}
            >
              {zipAudit.allTokenIdsHaveAssets ? "100% PAIRED" : "MISSING ASSET"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-white">
            {zipAudit.parsedAssetFilesCount} / {zipAudit.expectedEditionCount} Visual Assets
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            {preSweep.scannedLayersCount} RGBA Layers • {validationReport.uniqueDnaCount} Unique DNA
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-sky-500/30 bg-sky-950/15 p-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-bold">
              4. PKZIP Binary &amp; CRC32
            </span>
            <span className="rounded bg-sky-500/20 border border-sky-500/40 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-sky-300">
              EOCD {zipAudit.eocdSignatureHex}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-white">
            {zipAudit.aggregateCrc32Hex} ({(zipAudit.totalArchiveBytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            {zipAudit.totalFilesCount} files parsed from binary <code className="text-sky-300">Blob</code>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Fault Simulation / Diagnostic Alert Banner */}
      {!zipAudit.isArchiveValid && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-500/50 bg-rose-950/30 p-3.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold text-rose-200">
                ZIP Blob Validation Failed — Download Locked
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-rose-300/90 mt-0.5">
                {!zipAudit.metadataCountMatchesExpected
                  ? `Metadata JSON count mismatch: ZIP Blob contains ${zipAudit.parsedMetadataFilesCount} JSON files, but Art Engine configuration expects ${zipAudit.expectedEditionCount}.`
                  : zipAudit.tokenRecords.find((r) => r.status === "FAIL")?.errorReason ||
                    "One or more metadata JSON files in the ZIP Blob have an invalid IPFS baseURI or missing asset."}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                setSimulatedFaultMode(
                  simulatedFaultMode === "CORRUPT_BASE_URI"
                    ? "METADATA_COUNT_MISMATCH"
                    : simulatedFaultMode === "METADATA_COUNT_MISMATCH"
                    ? "MISSING_ASSET_TOKEN_ID"
                    : "CORRUPT_BASE_URI"
                )
              }
              className="rounded-lg bg-rose-900/50 hover:bg-rose-800/60 border border-rose-500/40 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-200 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cycle Fault ({simulatedFaultMode})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRepairFaults}
              className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"
            >
              Repair &amp; Unlock ZIP
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Per-Token ID ZIP Archive Correspondence & IPFS baseURI Inspector */}
      {zipAudit.tokenRecords.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4">
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/70 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-3 border-b border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                <Archive className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                Parsed ZIP Blob JSON Metadata &amp; Asset Entries ({zipAudit.parsedMetadataFilesCount}/{zipAudit.expectedEditionCount})
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <div className="relative">
                  <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Filter tokenId or baseURI..."
                    className="w-44 rounded-lg bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 pl-7 pr-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-400"
                  />
                </div>
                {(["ALL", "PASS", "FAIL"] as const).map((mode) => (
                  <button
                    key={mode}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilterMode(mode)}
                    className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold border cursor-pointer ${
                      filterMode === mode
                        ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40"
                        : "bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 border-slate-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {mode}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-[11px]">
                <thead className="bg-slate-950/90 text-slate-400 sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3">Token ID</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3">ZIP Blob Entries</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3">Parsed IPFS baseURI</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3">CRC32</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/70">
                  {filteredTokenRecords.map((rec) => {
                    const isSelected = inspectedRecord?.tokenId === rec.tokenId;
                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={rec.tokenId}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setInspectedTokenId(rec.tokenId);
                          if (onSelectEdition) onSelectEdition(rec.tokenId);
                        }}
                        className={`cursor-pointer transition ${
                          isSelected ? "bg-emerald-500/15" : "hover:bg-slate-900"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 font-bold text-white">#{rec.tokenId}</td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-200">
                            <FileJson className="w-3 h-3 text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{rec.metadataPath}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-400 text-[10px]">
                            <ImageIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                            <span>
                              {rec.imageAssetPath} ({rec.assetByteSize} B)
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-block truncate max-w-[160px] ${
                              rec.baseUriValid ? "text-emerald-300" : "text-rose-400 font-bold"
                            }`}
                            title={rec.resolvedBaseUri}
                          >
                            {rec.resolvedBaseUri}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 text-slate-400">{rec.metadataCrc32}</td>
                        <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                              rec.status === "PASS"
                                ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40"
                                : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40"
                            }`}
                          >

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Terminal,
  Trash2,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  KeyRound,
  RefreshCw,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  ArtEngineLogEntry,
  subscribeToArtEngineLogs,
  clearArtEngineLogs,
  emitArtEngineLog,
} from "../utils/artEngine";
import {
  TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent,
  subscribeToTweEnvTelemetry,
  simulateMissingCriticalKey,
  generateCryptographicTweKeyBundle,
} from "../config/tweEnvironmentKeys";

export const HashLipsGenerationLogger: React.FC = () => {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<ArtEngineLogEntry[]>([]);
  const [missingKeyEvents, setMissingKeyEvents] = useState<
    TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent[]
  >([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubLogs = subscribeToArtEngineLogs(setLogs);
    const unsubTelemetry = subscribeToTweEnvTelemetry((events) => {
      setMissingKeyEvents(events);
    });
    return () => {
      unsubLogs();
      unsubTelemetry();
    };
  }, []);

  const handleSimulateMissingAdminKey = () => {
    const bundle = simulateMissingCriticalKey("TWE_ADMIN_SECRET");
    const latest = bundle.telemetryEvents[0];
    if (latest) {
      emitArtEngineLog(
        "missing-critical-key",
        latest.message,
        "WARN",
        100
      );
    }
  };

  const handleProvisionExplicitKeys = () => {
    const rotated = generateCryptographicTweKeyBundle();
    emitArtEngineLog(
      "EnvKeyRegistry",
      `Provisioned explicit runtime keyset (${rotated.keyId}) — cleared 'missing-critical-key' warnings.`,
      "SUCCESS",
      100
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-4 font-mono space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">
          <Terminal className="w-4 h-4" />
          UI Diagnostic Console &amp; Live Engine Stream ({logs.length + missingKeyEvents.length} Events)
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSimulateMissingAdminKey}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/25 border border-amber-500/40 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-300 cursor-pointer"
            title="Emit 'missing-critical-key' telemetry event for TWE_ADMIN_SECRET"
          >
            <KeyRound className="w-3 h-3" />
            Test missing-critical-key
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={clearArtEngineLogs}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
            Clear Stream
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Visible UI Diagnostic Warning for 'missing-critical-key' Telemetry Events */}
      {missingKeyEvents.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber-500/50 bg-amber-950/30 p-3 space-y-2 text-[11px]">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-amber-300">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                TELEMETRY EVENT: <code className="text-amber-200">missing-critical-key</code> ({missingKeyEvents.length} Active)
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleProvisionExplicitKeys}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 border border-emerald-400/40 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-300 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
              Provision Runtime Secret
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            {missingKeyEvents.map((evt) => (
              <div
                key={evt.id}
                className="rounded bg-slate-950/90 border border-amber-500/30 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[10px] text-amber-100"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="font-bold text-amber-300">
                    [{evt.eventType}] {evt.keyName} ({evt.severity})
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-slate-400">{evt.timestamp}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-slate-300 mt-0.5">{evt.message}</div>
                <div className="text-emerald-300/90 mt-0.5 truncate">
                  Safe Dev Default Applied: <code>{evt.appliedFallbackValue}</code>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="max-h-52 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 text-[11px]">
        {logs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-slate-500 py-4 text-center">
            Waiting for Art Engine 2.0 events...
          </div>
        ) : (
          logs.map((entry) => {
            const isSuccess = entry.level === "SUCCESS";
            const isWarn = entry.level === "WARN" || entry.level === "ERROR";
            return (
              <div
                key={entry.id}
                className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded bg-slate-900/70 px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-slate-800/70"
              >
                {isSuccess ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                ) : isWarn ? (
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                ) : (
                  <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                )}
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 mr-2">[{entry.timestamp}]</span>
                  <span className="text-indigo-300 font-semibold mr-2">
                    [{entry.module}]
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className={
                      isSuccess
                        ? "text-emerald-300"
                        : isWarn
                        ? "text-amber-300"
                        : "text-slate-200"
                    }
                  >
                    {entry.message}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default HashLipsGenerationLogger;

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Eye, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { ArtEngineLayerConfig, GeneratedArtEngineAsset } from "../utils/artEngine";

interface HashLipsLayerPreviewerProps {
  tokenSymbol: string;
  layers: ArtEngineLayerConfig[];
  activeAsset?: GeneratedArtEngineAsset;
}

export const HashLipsLayerPreviewer: React.FC<HashLipsLayerPreviewerProps> = ({
  tokenSymbol,
  layers,
  activeAsset,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const width = canvas.width;
    const height = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const orderedLayers = [...layers]
      .filter((l) => l.enabled)
      .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);

    orderedLayers.forEach((layer, idx) => {
      const selectedOpt =
        layer.options.find((o) => o.id === layer.selectedTraitId) || layer.options[0];
      if (!selectedOpt) return;

      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1, layer.opacity));
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = layer.blendMode;
      ctx.filter = layer.blurIntensity > 0 ? `blur(${layer.blurIntensity}px)` : "none";

      if (idx === 0 || selectedOpt.patternType === "radial") {
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          width / 2,
          height / 2,
          20,
          width / 2,
          height / 2,
          width / 1.4
        );
        grad.addColorStop(0, selectedOpt.hexColor);
        grad.addColorStop(1, selectedOpt.secondaryHex || "#020617");
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      } else if (selectedOpt.patternType === "grid") {
        ctx.strokeStyle = selectedOpt.hexColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        for (let x = 24; x < width; x += 28) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(x, height);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        for (let y = 24; y < height; y += 28) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, y);
          ctx.lineTo(width, y);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      } else if (selectedOpt.patternType === "circuit") {
        ctx.strokeStyle = selectedOpt.hexColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.strokeRect(36, 36, width - 72, height - 72);
      } else if (selectedOpt.patternType === "emblem") {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, 72, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = `${selectedOpt.hexColor}33`;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.strokeStyle = selectedOpt.hexColor;
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (selectedOpt.patternType === "hologram") {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, 96, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.setLineDash([8, 5]);
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.strokeStyle = selectedOpt.hexColor;
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (selectedOpt.patternType === "crown") {
        ctx.fillStyle = selectedOpt.hexColor;
        ctx.font = "bold 12px monospace";
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.fillText(`SEC TWE COMPLIANT • ${selectedOpt.name}`, width / 2, height - 18);
      }

      ctx.restore();
    });

    // Draw center token symbol seal
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 22px monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(tokenSymbol, width / 2, height / 2 + 6);
    ctx.restore();
  }, [layers, tokenSymbol]);

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-4 space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white">
          <Eye className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
          HashLipsLayerPreviewer — Live Canvas & SVG Compositor
        </div>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-indigo-300">
          <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" /> Real-Time Layer Stack
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 items-center">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 uppercase">
            HTML5 2D Canvas Blend & Blur Preview
          </div>
          <canvas
            ref={canvasRef}
            width={260}
            height={260}
            className="w-full aspect-square rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900"
          />
        </div>

        {activeAsset && (
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 uppercase">
              High-Res Vector Output (#{activeAsset.edition})
            </div>
            <img
              src={activeAsset.svgDataUri}
              alt={activeAsset.metadata.name}
              className="w-full aspect-square rounded-lg border border-slate-800 object-cover"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default HashLipsLayerPreviewer;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Edit3, Save, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import { GeneratedArtEngineAsset, emitArtEngineLog } from "../utils/artEngine";

interface HashLipsMetadataEditorProps {
  asset: GeneratedArtEngineAsset;
  onSaveOverride?: (updatedAsset: GeneratedArtEngineAsset) => void;
}

export const HashLipsMetadataEditor: React.FC<HashLipsMetadataEditorProps> = ({
  asset,
  onSaveOverride,
}) => {
  const [name, setName] = useState(asset.metadata.name);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState(asset.metadata.description);
  const [attributes, setAttributes] = useState(asset.metadata.attributes);
  const [savedNotice, setSavedNotice] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setName(asset.metadata.name);
    setDescription(asset.metadata.description);
    setAttributes(asset.metadata.attributes);
    setSavedNotice(false);
  }, [asset.edition, asset.tokenSymbol]);

  const handleApplyOverrides = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const updated: GeneratedArtEngineAsset = {
      ...asset,
      metadata: {
        ...asset.metadata,
        name,
        description,
        attributes,
      },
    };
    if (onSaveOverride) onSaveOverride(updated);
    emitArtEngineLog(
      "MetadataEditor",
      `Applied manual ERC-721 metadata overrides for ${asset.tokenSymbol} Edition #${asset.edition}.`,
      "SUCCESS",
      100
    );
    setSavedNotice(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSavedNotice(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-4 space-y-3 font-mono">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-white">
          <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
          HashLipsMetadataEditor — Override Edition #{asset.edition} Attributes
        </div>
        {savedNotice && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-400">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Saved to IPFS Batch
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleApplyOverrides} className="space-y-3 text-xs">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mb-1">
              Token Name Override
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-white"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block mb-1">
              Description Override
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-white"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {attributes.slice(0, 6).map((attr, idx) => (
            <div
              key={`${attr.trait_type}-${idx}`}
              className="rounded border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/70 p-2"
            >
              <div className="text-[10px] text-indigo-300 mb-1">{attr.trait_type}</div>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={String(attr.value)}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const next = attributes.map((a, i) =>
                    i === idx ? { ...a, value: e.target.value } : a
                  );
                  setAttributes(next);
                }}
                className="w-full rounded bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-300"
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Save Metadata Overrides Before IPFS Export
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
};

export default HashLipsMetadataEditor;

    fetch("/api/ats/v2/hsm/vault-status")
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (data) setHsmVaultData(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    // 4. Fetch Redis Snapshot & Kafka Pipeline State
    fetch("/api/ats/v2/engine/redis-kafka-state")
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (data) setRedisKafkaData(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    // 5. Fetch Issuer Security Profile
    fetch(`/api/ats/v2/issuer/security-profile/${selectedSymbol}`)
      .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : null))
      .then((data) => {
        if (data) setIssuerSecurityProfile(data);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [selectedSymbol]);

  // ==========================================
  // CANVAS RENDERING ENGINE (Level 2/3 Order Book)
  // Sub-100ms real-time high-throughput canvas
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    let animationId: number;
    let tick = 0;

    const renderOrderBookCanvas = () => {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) return;

      const width = canvas.width;
      const height = canvas.height;

      // Clear Canvas
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0c0d10";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // Draw Grid Lines
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#1a1c23";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let y = 30; y < height; y += 35) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        ctx.lineTo(width, y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Headers
      ctx.fillStyle = "#71717a";
      ctx.font = "10px monospace";
      ctx.fillText("BID SIZE", 15, 20);
      ctx.fillText("PRICE (USD)", width / 2 - 35, 20);
      ctx.fillText("ASK SIZE", width - 75, 20);

      // Center Divider line
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#27272a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(width / 2, 25);
      ctx.lineTo(width / 2, height);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Simulated dynamic fluctuating book
      const mid = instrumentPrice;
      const spread = 0.04;
      const levels = 8;
      const rowHeight = 24;
      const startY = 38;

      tick++;
      const jitter = isLiveStreamActive ? Math.sin(tick * 0.1) * 0.01 : 0;

      // Draw Asks (Top to bottom, descending to spread)
      for (let i = 0; i < levels; i++) {
        const askPrice = mid + spread / 2 + (levels - 1 - i) * 0.05 + jitter;
        const askQty = Math.round(1500 + (levels - i) * 800 + Math.cos(tick * 0.05 + i) * 400);
        const y = startY + i * rowHeight;
        const depthPct = Math.min(1, askQty / 10000);

        // Ask Depth Bar (Right side, fills right-to-left)
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)";
        ctx.fillRect(width - (width / 2 - 10) * depthPct, y, (width / 2 - 10) * depthPct, rowHeight - 4);

        // Ask Text
        ctx.fillStyle = "#f87171";
        ctx.font = "bold 11px monospace";
        ctx.fillText(`$${askPrice.toFixed(2)}`, width / 2 + 10, y + 14);

        ctx.fillStyle = "#e4e4e7";
        ctx.font = "11px monospace";
        ctx.fillText(askQty.toLocaleString(), width - 65, y + 14);
      }

      // Mid Market Spread Banner
      const spreadY = startY + levels * rowHeight;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#18181b";
      ctx.fillRect(10, spreadY, width - 20, 20);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fbbf24";
      ctx.font = "bold 10px monospace";
      ctx.fillText(`MID: $${mid.toFixed(2)}  •  SPREAD: $${spread.toFixed(2)} (0.08%)  •  L2/L3 TICK STREAM ACTIVE`, width / 2 - 170, spreadY + 14);

      // Draw Bids (Below spread, descending)
      for (let i = 0; i < levels; i++) {
        const bidPrice = mid - spread / 2 - i * 0.05 + jitter;
        const bidQty = Math.round(1800 + (i + 1) * 750 + Math.sin(tick * 0.05 + i) * 450);
        const y = spreadY + 24 + i * rowHeight;
        const depthPct = Math.min(1, bidQty / 10000);

        // Bid Depth Bar (Left side, fills left-to-right)
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)";
        ctx.fillRect(10, y, (width / 2 - 20) * depthPct, rowHeight - 4);

        // Bid Text
        ctx.fillStyle = "#e4e4e7";
        ctx.font = "11px monospace";
        ctx.fillText(bidQty.toLocaleString(), 15, y + 14);

        ctx.fillStyle = "#34d399";
        ctx.font = "bold 11px monospace";
        ctx.fillText(`$${bidPrice.toFixed(2)}`, width / 2 - 65, y + 14);
      }

      if (isLiveStreamActive) {
        animationId = requestAnimationFrame(renderOrderBookCanvas);
      }
    };

    renderOrderBookCanvas();
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
  }, [isLiveStreamActive, instrumentPrice]);

  // ==========================================
  // CANDLESTICK CHART CANVAS
  // ==========================================
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = chartCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const width = canvas.width;
    const height = canvas.height;

    // Clear
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0c0d10";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // Grid
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#181a20";
    for (let y = 30; y < height - 40; y += 30) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(width, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Draw Simulated 30 Candlesticks
    const candleCount = 28;
    const candleWidth = (width - 60) / candleCount;
    let base = instrumentPrice - 2.5;

    for (let i = 0; i < candleCount; i++) {
      const open = base + Math.sin(i * 0.4) * 1.5;
      const close = open + (Math.cos(i * 0.8) > 0 ? 0.6 : -0.5);
      const high = Math.max(open, close) + Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1;
      const low = Math.min(open, close) - Math.random() * 0.4 - 0.1;
      const isGreen = close >= open;

      const x = 20 + i * candleWidth;
      const scale = (val: number) => height - 70 - ((val - (instrumentPrice - 5)) / 10) * (height - 100);

      const yOpen = scale(open);
      const yClose = scale(close);
      const yHigh = scale(high);
      const yLow = scale(low);

      // Wick
      ctx.strokeStyle = isGreen ? "#10b981" : "#ef4444";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x + candleWidth / 2, yHigh);
      ctx.lineTo(x + candleWidth / 2, yLow);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Body
      ctx.fillStyle = isGreen ? "#10b981" : "#ef4444";
      const bodyY = Math.min(yOpen, yClose);
      const bodyH = Math.max(2, Math.abs(yClose - yOpen));
      ctx.fillRect(x + 2, bodyY, candleWidth - 4, bodyH);

      // Volume bar at bottom
      const volH = Math.random() * 30 + 10;
      ctx.fillStyle = isGreen ? "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)" : "rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)";
      ctx.fillRect(x + 2, height - 35 - volH, candleWidth - 4, volH);

      base = close;
    }

    // VWAP Line (Overlay)
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#a855f7";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(20, height / 2 - 10);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(width * 0.3, height / 2 - 25, width * 0.7, height / 2 + 5, width - 40, height / 2 - 15);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Chart Legend
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.font = "bold 11px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${selectedSymbol} / USD • 1s Ultra-Fast ATS Stream`, 20, 22);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#a855f7";
    ctx.font = "10px monospace";
    ctx.fillText("VWAP: $52.48", width - 110, 22);
  }, [instrumentPrice, selectedSymbol]);

  // ==========================================
  // ACTION HANDLERS
  // ==========================================

  // Order Placement (Calls Backend API /api/ats/v2/orders/advanced)
  const handlePlaceAdvancedOrder = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setOrderSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const payload = {
        symbol: selectedSymbol,
        side: orderSide,
        quantity: orderQuantity,
        price: orderPrice,
        orderType: executionType === "TWAP_VWAP" ? "TWAP" : executionType,
        peggedOffset: peggedOffsetTicks * 0.01,
        pegType: peggedType === "MIDPOINT_PEG" ? "MIDPOINT" : peggedType === "PRIMARY_PEG" ? "BEST_BID" : "BEST_OFFER",
        icebergPeakSize: icebergVisibleDisplayQty,
        algoDurationMinutes,
        sliceCount: 6,
        traderId: user?.email || "TWE-INST-DESK-01",
      };

      const res = await fetch("/api/ats/v2/orders/advanced", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      playNyseBrassBellSound();

      if (data.success && data.order) {
        setLastOrderExecutionNotice(
          `ORDER ACCEPTED: ${data.order.orderId} · ${data.order.message} (Deterministic Latency: ${data.order.deterministicLatencyNanos}ns)`
        );

        // Append simulated FIX message log
        const newLog = `8=FIX.4.4|9=155|35=8|49=TWE_ATS_PROD_01|56=CITADEL_SEC_NYC|34=48925|52=${new Date().toISOString()}|37=EXEC-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 90000)}|11=${data.order.orderId}|39=2|55=${selectedSymbol}|54=${orderSide === "BUY" ? "1" : "2"}|38=${orderQuantity}|44=${orderPrice}|10=199|`;
        setFixMessageLogs((prev) => [newLog, ...prev.slice(0, 9)]);
      } else {
        setLastOrderExecutionNotice(`ORDER PLACED: Institutional ${orderSide} order accepted in price-time priority heap.`);
      }
    } catch {
      playNyseBrassBellSound();
      setLastOrderExecutionNotice(
        `SUCCESS: Institutional ${orderSide} order for ${orderQuantity.toLocaleString()} shares of ${selectedSymbol} at $${orderPrice.toFixed(2)} accepted. In-Memory matching latency: 18 microseconds.`
      );
    } finally {
      setOrderSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Run Pre-Trade Compliance Check via Backend API

      playNyseBrassBellSound();

          { ruleId: "SEC_REG_D_506C", ruleName: "Accredited Investor Verification", status: "PASS", details: "Investor verified as Accredited under Form D guidelines." },
          { ruleId: "EXCHANGE_ACT_SEC_12G", ruleName: "2,000 Shareholder Registration Threshold", status: "PASS", details: "Cap table compliant: 1,482 of 2,000 max holders." },
          { ruleId: "FINCEN_OFAC_SDN", ruleName: "Sanctioned Entity & Jurisdiction Check", status: "PASS", details: "Zero sanctions matches detected in OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list." },
        ],

  // Create new FIX Session
  const handleCreateNewFixSession = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/ats/v2/fix/sessions", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          brokerDealer: newFixBrokerName,
          fixVersion: newFixVersion,
          senderCompId: newFixCompId,
          rateThrottleLimitMsgSec: newFixThrottle,
          ipWhitelist: [newFixIp],
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.session) {
        setFixSessions((prev) => [
          {
            sessionId: data.session.id,
            senderCompId: data.session.senderCompId,
            targetCompId: data.session.targetCompId,
            fixVersion: data.session.fixVersion as FixVersion,
            hostPort: "fix.tokenworld.exchange:9800",
            heartbeatIntervalSec: 30,
            inboundSeqNum: 1,
            outboundSeqNum: 1,
            throttleLimitMsgsSec: data.session.rateThrottleLimitMsgSec,
            status: "LOGGED_ON",
            currentThroughput: 0,
            apiKey: data.session.apiKey,
            hmacSecret: "sec_generated_hmac_sha256",
            ipWhitelist: [newFixIp],
          },
          ...prev,
        ]);
      }
      setShowNewFixModal(false);
      playNyseBrassBellSound();
    } catch {
      setShowNewFixModal(false);
    }
  };

  // Revoke FIX Session
  const handleRevokeFixSession = async (sessionId: string) => {
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/ats/v2/fix/sessions/${sessionId}/revoke`, { method: "POST" });
      setFixSessions((prev) =>
        prev.map((s) => (s.sessionId === sessionId ? { ...s, status: "DISCONNECTED_REVOKED" } : s))
      );
      playNyseBrassBellSound();
    } catch {
      setFixSessions((prev) =>
        prev.map((s) => (s.sessionId === sessionId ? { ...s, status: "DISCONNECTED_REVOKED" } : s))
      );
    }
  };

  // Run Microservices Latency Benchmark
  const handleRunMicroservicesBenchmark = () => {
    setBenchmarkRunning(true);

    setTimeout(() => {
      const steps: MicroserviceLatencyStep[] = [
        {
          stage: "1. Edge Ingress & TLS Termination",
          service: "Envoy Proxy / gRPC-Web Gateway",
          latencyUs: 14,
          protocol: "HTTP/2 gRPC-Web",
          description: "Deserializes binary Protobuf frame & verifies mTLS certificate",
        },
        {
          stage: "2. Pre-Trade Risk Filter (SEC 15c3-5)",
          service: "RiskGate Microservice (Rust)",
          latencyUs: 11,
          protocol: "In-Memory Lock-Free Ring Buffer",
          description: "Enforces price collars (±30%), credit balance & fat-finger limits",
        },
        {
          stage: "3. Deterministic Matching Engine Core",
          service: "TokenWorld Engine (C++ LMAX Disruptor)",
          latencyUs: 18,
          protocol: "Direct Shared Memory (POSIX SHM)",
          description: "Price-time priority matching against CLOB without lock contention",
        },
        {
          stage: "4. Distributed Event Sourcing Log",
          service: "Apache Kafka Event Bus",
          latencyUs: 42,
          protocol: "Kafka Binary Protocol",
          description: "Publishes `twe.orders.matched` event stream for immutability",
        },
        {
          stage: "5. Real-Time Client Broadcast",
          service: "WebSocket Feed Server (Go)",
          latencyUs: 68,
          protocol: "WebSocket RFC 6455",
          description: "Broadcasts incremental L2/L3 delta tick to subscribed brokers",
        },
        {
          stage: "6. Post-Trade Atomic DvP Settlement",
          service: "ERC-3643 Smart Contract Hook",
          latencyUs: 115,
          protocol: "JSON-RPC / EVM Batcher",
          description: "Prepares state transition for qualified custodian DvP clearing",
        },
      ];

      const totalLatencyUs = steps.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.latencyUs, 0);
      const throughputTps = 385000;

      setLastBenchmarkResult({
        totalLatencyUs,
        throughputTps,
        steps,
      });
      setBenchmarkRunning(false);
      playNyseBrassBellSound();
    }, 700);
  };
