      token.expirationTimestamp = Date.now() + 365 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
      token.isExpired = false;
    } else {
      token.isRevoked = true;
      token.revocationReason = "SIMULATED_TEST_REVOCATION";
    }
    setRefreshTrigger((p) => p + 1);
  };

  const handleMintSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!mintAddress) return;

    globalOnChainAtsEngine.issueInvestorNft({
      walletAddress: mintAddress,
      entityName: mintEntityName,
      jurisdictionCode: Number(mintJurisdiction),
      accreditationTier: Number(mintTier),
    });

    setShowIssueModal(false);
    setRefreshTrigger((p) => p + 1);
  };

  // Helper for Days Remaining
  const getDaysRemaining = (expTimestamp: number) => {
    const diffMs = expTimestamp - Date.now();
    const days = Math.ceil(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return days;
  };

  const showNotification = (msg: string) => {
    setExportNotice(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setExportNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleRunTransferSimulation = () => {
    if (!testbenchSbt) return;
    setTransferSimResult({
      success: false,
      message: `Execution Reverted: ERC5192: SoulboundTokenLocked(${testbenchSbt.tokenId}). Token is permanently locked to ${testbenchSbt.walletAddress} and cannot be transferred via transferFrom() or safeTransferFrom().`,
      errorSig: "0xb45a3c0e_ERR_SOULBOUND_NON_TRANSFERABLE",
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  };

  // Attestation status query helper for ERC-5192 Registry
  const getAttestationStatus = (token: InvestorIdentitySBTRecord) => {
    const diffMs = token.expirationTimestamp - Date.now();
    const days = Math.ceil(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    if (token.isRevoked) {
      return {
        status: "REVOKED" as const,
        label: "Revoked",
        badgeClass: "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/40",
        indicatorColor: "bg-rose-500",
        dotColor: "bg-rose-400",
        daysRemaining: days,
        isCompliantForTrading: false,
        reason: token.revocationReason || "Revoked by Issuer / Regulatory Compliance Officer",
      };
    }
    if (days <= 0 || token.isExpired) {
      return {
        status: "EXPIRED" as const,
        label: "Expired",
        badgeClass: "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/40",
        indicatorColor: "bg-rose-500",
        dotColor: "bg-rose-400",
        daysRemaining: days,
        isCompliantForTrading: false,
        reason: "Validity Window Lapsed (Annual KYC Re-Attestation Required)",
      };
    }
    if (days <= 90) {
      return {
        status: "EXPIRING_SOON" as const,
        label: "Expiring Soon",
        badgeClass: "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40",
        indicatorColor: "bg-amber-400",
        dotColor: "bg-amber-400",
        daysRemaining: days,
        isCompliantForTrading: true,
        reason: `Expires in ${days} days (${new Date(token.expirationTimestamp).toLocaleDateString()})`,
      };
    }
    return {
      status: "ACTIVE" as const,
      label: "Active",
      badgeClass: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40",
      indicatorColor: "bg-emerald-400",
      dotColor: "bg-emerald-400",
      daysRemaining: days,
      isCompliantForTrading: true,
      reason: "Active Attestation · Sanctions & Accreditation Cleared",
    };
  };

  // Open mobile QR code modal
  const handleOpenQrModal = (token: InvestorIdentitySBTRecord) => {
    setQrModalToken(token);
    setIsGeneratingQr(true);
    setCopiedQrUrl(false);
    const url = generateShareUrl([token]);
    QRCode.toDataURL(url, {
      width: 320,
      margin: 2,
      color: {
        dark: "#000000",
        light: "#FFFFFF",
      },
    })
      .then((dataUrl) => {
        setQrDataUrl(dataUrl);
        setIsGeneratingQr(false);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error("Failed to generate QR Code:", err);
        setIsGeneratingQr(false);
      });
  };

  // Run full attestation registry audit query
  const handleRunRegistryAudit = () => {
    setAuditQueryLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setAuditQueryLoading(false);
      setLastAuditTimestamp(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      setAuditBlockNumber((prev) => prev + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1);
      showNotification(`Attestation registry audit completed · ${allNfts.length} Soulbound Tokens verified`);
    }, 750);
  };

  // Single token registry audit query
  const handleAuditSingleToken = (tokenId: number) => {
    setQueriedTokenId(tokenId);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setQueriedTokenId(null);
      showNotification(`Registry query confirmed: Token #${tokenId} attestation status verified`);
    }, 550);
  };

  // Filtered tokens for Investor Compliance Audit table
  const filteredAuditTokens = useMemo(() => {
    return allNfts.filter((token) => {
      const statusObj = getAttestationStatus(token);
      if (selectedAuditFilter === "ACTIVE") return statusObj.status === "ACTIVE";
      if (selectedAuditFilter === "EXPIRING_SOON") return statusObj.status === "EXPIRING_SOON";
      if (selectedAuditFilter === "REVOKED") return statusObj.status === "REVOKED";
      if (selectedAuditFilter === "EXPIRED") return statusObj.status === "EXPIRED";
      return true;
    });
  }, [allNfts, selectedAuditFilter]);

  // Generate shareable attestation verification URL
  const generateShareUrl = (tokens: InvestorIdentitySBTRecord[]) => {
    const origin = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : "https://tokenworld.exchange";
    const wallet = tokens[0]?.walletAddress || resolvedActiveWallet;
    const tokenIds = tokens.map((t) => t.tokenId).join(",");
    const jurisdictions = Array.from(new Set(tokens.map((t) => t.jurisdictionCode))).join(",");
    const earliestExpiry = Math.min(...tokens.map((t) => t.expirationTimestamp));
    const claimsHash = tokens
      .map((t) => `${t.tokenId}:${t.jurisdictionCode}:${t.accreditationTier}:${Math.floor(t.expirationTimestamp / 1000)}`)
      .join("|");
    const encodedClaims = btoa(encodeURIComponent(claimsHash));

    return `${origin}/verify-attestation?wallet=${encodeURIComponent(wallet)}&tokens=${tokenIds}&jur=${jurisdictions}&exp=${earliestExpiry}&claims=${encodeURIComponent(encodedClaims)}`;
  };

  // Build standardized EIP-721 / EIP-5192 compliant export payload
  const buildExportPayload = (tokens: InvestorIdentitySBTRecord[]) => {
    return {
      registryStandard: "ERC-5192 Minimal Soulbound Token + ERC-721",
      interfaceId: "0xb45a3c0e",
      venue: "Token World Alternative Trading System (ATS) · SEC/FINRA Registered Compliant Secondary Market",
      attestationRegistryContract: "0x1dE5b5257134A29388B2c54B3356D0Ddf9bA7879",
      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      activeWalletContext: resolvedActiveWallet,
      tokenCount: tokens.length,
      filtersApplied: {
        jurisdiction: selectedJurisdictionFilter,
        status: selectedStatusFilter,
        searchQuery: searchQuery || null,
      },
      tokens: tokens.map((t) => {
        const daysRemaining = getDaysRemaining(t.expirationTimestamp);
        const isExp = daysRemaining <= 0 || t.isExpired;
        return {
          tokenId: t.tokenId,
          entityName: t.entityName,
          holderWalletAddress: t.walletAddress,
          jurisdiction: {
            numericCode: t.jurisdictionCode,
            isoCountryCode: t.countryCode,
            statutoryStandard: t.jurisdictionLabel,
          },
          accreditation: {
            tierNumber: t.accreditationTier,
            tierCategory: t.tierLabel,
          },
          expiration: {
            timestampUnix: t.expirationTimestamp,
            isoUtc: new Date(t.expirationTimestamp).toISOString(),
            daysRemaining,
            isExpired: isExp,
          },
          identityClaims: {
            isRevoked: t.isRevoked,
            revocationReason: t.revocationReason || null,
            sanctionsProvider: t.sanctionsProvider,
            sanctionsScreeningHash: t.sanctionsScreeningHash,
            zkIdentityCommitment: t.zkIdentityCommitment,
            soulboundLocked: true,
          },
          onChainVerification: {
            isTransferable: false,
            supportsErc5192: true,
            networkRollup: "Enterprise Arbitrum Orbit L3 / Subnet Rollup",
          },
          shareableAttestationUrl: generateShareUrl([t]),
        };
      }),
    };
  };

  // Export all currently visible/filtered Soulbound Tokens as JSON
  const handleExportVisibleJson = () => {
    if (filteredTokens.length === 0) return;
    const payload = buildExportPayload(filteredTokens);
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], {
      type: "application/json",
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `tokenworld-investor-sbt-attestations-${filteredTokens.length}tokens.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showNotification(`Exported ${filteredTokens.length} Soulbound Token attestations as JSON`);
  };

  // Export a single Soulbound Token's complete metadata as JSON
  const handleExportSingleJson = (token: InvestorIdentitySBTRecord) => {
    const payload = buildExportPayload([token]);
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], {
      type: "application/json",
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `sbt-${token.tokenId}-${token.countryCode}-attestation.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showNotification(`Exported SBT #${token.tokenId} (${token.entityName}) metadata JSON`);
  };

  // Open the shareable attestation modal
  const handleOpenShareModal = (tokens: InvestorIdentitySBTRecord[], title: string) => {
    if (tokens.length === 0) return;
    const url = generateShareUrl(tokens);
    const payload = buildExportPayload(tokens);
    setShareModalData({
      title,
      url,
      jsonPayload: payload,
      tokenCount: tokens.length,
      tokens,
    });
    setShowShareModal(true);
  };

  // Fast direct copy of shareable attestation link
  const handleQuickCopyShareLink = (tokens: InvestorIdentitySBTRecord[], key: string) => {
    if (tokens.length === 0) return;
    const url = generateShareUrl(tokens);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    showNotification(`Shareable attestation link copied to clipboard!`);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  // Format Jurisdiction Flag
  const getCountryFlag = (code: string) => {
    switch (code) {
      case "US": return "🇺🇸";
      case "EU": case "LU": case "DE": case "FR": return "🇪🇺";
      case "SG": return "🇸🇬";
      case "CH": return "🇨🇭";
      case "UK": case "GB": return "🇬🇧";
      case "JP": return "🇯🇵";
      default: return "🌐";
    }
  };

  // Border theme by Tier
  const getTierTheme = (tier: number, isRevoked: boolean) => {
    if (isRevoked) {
      return {
        cardBorder: "border-rose-500/40 hover:border-rose-500/70",
        badgeBg: "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/40",
        accent: "text-rose-400",
        glow: "from-rose-500/5 via-rose-950/20 to-transparent",
      };
    }
    switch (tier) {
      case 1: // QIB
        return {
          cardBorder: "border-amber-400/40 hover:border-amber-400/70",
          badgeBg: "bg-amber-400/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-400/40",
          accent: "text-amber-400",
          glow: "from-amber-400/10 via-amber-950/20 to-transparent",
        };
      case 2: // Qualified Purchaser
        return {
          cardBorder: "border-emerald-400/40 hover:border-emerald-400/70",
          badgeBg: "bg-emerald-400/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-400/40",
          accent: "text-emerald-400",
          glow: "from-emerald-400/10 via-emerald-950/20 to-transparent",
        };
      case 3: // Accredited
        return {
          cardBorder: "border-purple-400/40 hover:border-purple-400/70",
          badgeBg: "bg-purple-400/20 text-purple-300 border-purple-400/40",
          accent: "text-purple-400",
          glow: "from-purple-400/10 via-purple-950/20 to-transparent",
        };
      case 4: // Professional
        return {
          cardBorder: "border-cyan-400/40 hover:border-cyan-400/70",
          badgeBg: "bg-cyan-400/20 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-400/40",
          accent: "text-cyan-400",
          glow: "from-cyan-400/10 via-cyan-950/20 to-transparent",
        };
      default:
        return {
          cardBorder: "border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500",
          badgeBg: "bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700",
          accent: "text-slate-400",
          glow: "from-slate-800/10 to-transparent",
        };
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-6 text-slate-100 font-sans ${className}`}>
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {exportNotice && (
        <div className="fixed top-6 right-6 z-50 bg-[#0F1528] border border-cyan-400/60 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-4 font-mono text-xs text-white">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{exportNotice}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setExportNotice(null)}
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white ml-2 text-xs"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Banner: Active Wallet Identity Summary Card */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0C101A] via-[#121828] to-[#0C101A] border border-[#202944] rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-80 h-80 bg-purple-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-5 relative z-10">
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />
                ERC-5192 Minimal Soulbound Token
              </span>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Multi-Jurisdictional Identity Registry
              </span>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Non-Transferable (locked == true)
              </span>
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-400" />
              Investor Identity SBT Gallery
            </h3>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-2xl mt-1">
              Visualizes issued ERC-5192 Soulbound Tokens containing zero-knowledge compliance attestations,
              jurisdiction codes, and expiration timestamps cross-referenced before trade execution.
            </p>

            {/* View Mode Switcher: Gallery vs Compliance Audit */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-3 font-mono text-xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTabMode("gallery")}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all border ${
                  activeTabMode === "gallery"
                    ? "bg-purple-600 text-white border-purple-500 shadow-md shadow-purple-950/40"
                    : "bg-[#0A0D18] text-slate-400 border-[#1B233C] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Gallery Cards View</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTabMode("compliance_audit")}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all border ${
                  activeTabMode === "compliance_audit"
                    ? "bg-cyan-600 text-white border-cyan-500 shadow-md shadow-cyan-950/40"
                    : "bg-[#0A0D18] text-cyan-300 border-cyan-500/30 hover:bg-[#121B32]"
                }`}
              >
                <ClipboardCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Investor Compliance Audit</span>
                {allNfts.some((n) => getAttestationStatus(n).status === "EXPIRING_SOON" || getAttestationStatus(n).status === "REVOKED") && (
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse ml-0.5" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Active Wallet Highlight Pill */}
          <div className="bg-[#080B12] border border-[#1C243B] rounded-xl p-3.5 shrink-0 min-w-[280px]">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-slate-400 font-bold flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
              <span>Active Connected Wallet</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-400 font-mono text-[9px] flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                Live Network
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-white truncate max-w-[260px] flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{resolvedActiveWallet}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleCopy("active_wallet", resolvedActiveWallet)}
                className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-[#1A2238] text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                title="Copy address"
              >
                {copiedKey === "active_wallet" ? (
                  <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                ) : (
                  <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>

            {activeWalletSbts.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-[#182034] text-[11px] font-mono space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 font-semibold">User Soulbound Tokens:</span>
                  <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 font-bold border border-purple-500/30">
                    {activeWalletSbts.length} Token{activeWalletSbts.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} Bound
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto pr-1 scrollbar-thin">
                  {activeWalletSbts.map((sbt) => {
                    const daysRemaining = getDaysRemaining(sbt.expirationTimestamp);
                    const isExp = daysRemaining <= 0 || sbt.isExpired;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={sbt.tokenId}
                        className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[#0C101A] border border-[#1A2238] space-y-1 hover:border-purple-400/40 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />
                            SBT #{sbt.tokenId} ({sbt.entityName})
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span>{getCountryFlag(sbt.countryCode)}</span>
                            <span>Code {sbt.jurisdictionCode}</span>
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                          <span className="truncate max-w-[150px] text-slate-300" title={sbt.jurisdictionLabel}>
                            {sbt.jurisdictionLabel}
                          </span>
                          <span
                            className={
                              sbt.isRevoked || isExp
                                ? "text-rose-400 font-bold"
                                : daysRemaining < 90
                                ? "text-amber-400 font-bold"
                                : "text-emerald-400 font-bold"
                            }
                          >
                            {sbt.isRevoked
                              ? "REVOKED"
                              : isExp
                              ? "EXPIRED"
                              : `${daysRemaining}d remaining`}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-between pt-0.5 border-t border-[#161D32]">
                          <span>
                            Exp: {new Date(sbt.expirationTimestamp).toLocaleDateString()} ({Math.floor(sbt.expirationTimestamp / 1000)} Unix)
                          </span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setSelectedSbtForMetadata(sbt)}
                              className="text-purple-400 hover:text-purple-300 hover:underline"
                            >
                              Claims
                            </button>
                            <span className="text-slate-600">·</span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleOpenQrModal(sbt)}
                              className="text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5"
                              title="Display QR code for cross-device mobile verification"
                            >
                              <QrCode className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                              <span>QR</span>
                            </button>
                            <span className="text-slate-600">·</span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setTestbenchSbt(sbt)}
                              className="text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300 hover:underline"
                            >
                              Test Lock
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedStatusFilter("ACTIVE_WALLET")}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1 px-2 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold text-center transition-all border ${
                      selectedStatusFilter === "ACTIVE_WALLET"
                        ? "bg-purple-600 text-white border-purple-500"
                        : "bg-[#141A2E] text-purple-300 border-purple-500/30 hover:bg-[#1E2644]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {selectedStatusFilter === "ACTIVE_WALLET" ? "Viewing My Tokens" : `Filter My Tokens (${activeWalletSbts.length})`}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setMintAddress(resolvedActiveWallet);
                      setShowIssueModal(true);
                    }}
                    className="py-1 px-2 rounded-lg bg-[#141A2E] hover:bg-[#1E2644] text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-[#202944] text-[10px] font-bold"
                    title="Issue additional SBT for active address"
                  >
                    + Issue
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-[#182034] text-[11px] font-mono">
                <div className="text-rose-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-400" />
                  No SBT Issued For Active Address
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setMintAddress(resolvedActiveWallet);
                    setShowIssueModal(true);
                  }}
                  className="mt-1.5 w-full py-1 px-2 rounded-lg bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white text-[10px] font-bold text-center transition-all shadow-md shadow-purple-950/40"
                >
                  Issue Identity SBT to Active Address
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls & Filters Bar */}
        <div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-[#1C243B] flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
          {/* Search Box */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search by entity, address, or code (840, 841)..."
              className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 bg-[#090C16] border border-[#1E2640] rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-400"

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-3xl mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">

                  for each Soulbound Token by querying the on-chain registry contract (<code className="text-cyan-300">0x1dE5b5257134A29388B2c54B3356D0Ddf9bA7879</code>).
                  Counterparties lacking an active, unexpired Soulbound Token are programmatically barred from ATS pre-trade matching and atomic DvP clearing.
                </p>

                      queriedBlockNumber: auditBlockNumber,
                      totalIdentitiesAudited: allNfts.length,
                      summary: {
                        activeCompliant: allNfts.filter((n) => getAttestationStatus(n).status === "ACTIVE").length,
                        expiringSoon: allNfts.filter((n) => getAttestationStatus(n).status === "EXPIRING_SOON").length,
                        revoked: allNfts.filter((n) => getAttestationStatus(n).status === "REVOKED").length,
                        expired: allNfts.filter((n) => getAttestationStatus(n).status === "EXPIRED").length,
                      },
                      tokens: allNfts.map((n) => {
                        const statusObj = getAttestationStatus(n);
                        return {
                          tokenId: n.tokenId,
                          entityName: n.entityName,
                          holderWallet: n.walletAddress,
                          jurisdictionCode: n.jurisdictionCode,
                          jurisdictionLabel: n.jurisdictionLabel,

                          isTradingEligible: statusObj.isCompliantForTrading,
                          sanctionsStatus: "CLEARED",
                          zkCommitment: n.zkIdentityCommitment,
                        };
                      }),
                    };
                    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(auditReport, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
                    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const link = document.createElement("a");
                    link.href = url;
                    link.download = `tokenworld-investor-compliance-audit-${Date.now()}.json`;
                    document.body.appendChild(link);
                    link.click();
                    document.body.removeChild(link);
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    showNotification("Exported full investor compliance audit report (.JSON)");

                          <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold border uppercase tracking-wider ${statusObj.badgeClass}`}>
                            <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${statusObj.dotColor}`} />

                        </td>

                        {/* Sanctions Oracle */}
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-[11px]">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                            <span>OFAC Cleared</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-500">{token.sanctionsProvider}</div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions */}

                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                            {/* QR Code button */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleOpenQrModal(token)}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141A2E] hover:bg-[#1E2644] text-amber-300 hover:text-white border border-amber-500/30 transition-colors"
                              title="Display QR code for cross-device mobile verification"
                            >
                              <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                            </button>

                            {/* Query Registry button */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleAuditSingleToken(token.tokenId)}

                              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400 ${isQueried ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                            </button>

                            {/* View claims */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setSelectedSbtForMetadata(token)}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141A2E] hover:bg-[#1E2644] text-purple-300 hover:text-white border border-purple-500/30 transition-colors"
                              title="Inspect EIP-721/5192 metadata claims"
                            >
                              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
                            </button>

                            {/* Revoke/Renew */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleRevokeOrRenew(token)}

                                token.isRevoked || token.isExpired

                                  : "bg-[#141A2E] text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-300 border-[#202944]"
                              }`}
                              title={token.isRevoked || token.isExpired ? "Renew Token Attestation" : "Simulate Revocation"}
                            >
                              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODE 2: GALLERY CARDS VIEW */}
      {activeTabMode === "gallery" && (
        <>
          {/* Grid of ERC-5192 Soulbound Tokens */}

          const theme = getTierTheme(token.accreditationTier, token.isRevoked || isExpired);

            <div

                isActiveWallet ? "ring-2 ring-purple-500/70 shadow-purple-950/50" : ""
              }`}
            >
              {/* Holographic Watermark Glow */}
              <div
                className={`absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-tr ${theme.glow} pointer-events-none opacity-50 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity`}

              <div className="relative z-10 space-y-2 border-b border-[#182136] pb-3">

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap justify-end">
                    <span

                      <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${getAttestationStatus(token).dotColor}`} />

                {/* Entity & Holder Address */}

                        <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />

                        <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />

                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Card Body: Jurisdiction Code, Tier, Expiration */}
              <div className="relative z-10 py-3 space-y-2.5 text-xs font-mono">
                {/* Jurisdiction Code Box */}
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#080B12] border border-[#161D32] space-y-1">

                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-cyan-300 font-mono">
                      Code: {token.jurisdictionCode}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-300 truncate max-w-[170px]" title={token.jurisdictionLabel}>
                      {token.jurisdictionLabel}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Expiration Timestamp Box */}
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#080B12] border border-[#161D32] space-y-1">

                      {token.isRevoked
                        ? "REVOKED"
                        : isExpired
                        ? "EXPIRED"
                        : `${daysRemaining} days left`}

                  </div>

                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>
                      {new Date(token.expirationTimestamp).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
                        year: "numeric",
                        month: "short",
                        day: "numeric",
                      })}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                      {Math.floor(token.expirationTimestamp / 1000)} Unix
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Accreditation Tier & Sanctions Oracle */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px]">
                  <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[#080B12] border border-[#161D32]">

                      handleOpenQrModal(token);

                  >
                    <Terminal className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
                    <span>ERC-5192 Lock &amp; Transfer Revert Test</span>
                  </button>

      </div>

      {filteredTokens.length === 0 && (

      {/* METADATA INSPECTOR MODAL (EIP-721 / EIP-5192 Compliant Payload) */}

        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-[#0E1322] border border-[#222B48] rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-2xl shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 font-mono">

                <FileCode className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />

              </div>
              <button

                      {
                        trait_type: "Jurisdiction ISO Code",

                      {

                      {
                        trait_type: "Accreditation Tier Level",

                      },
                      {
                        trait_type: "Accreditation Tier Category",

                      },
                      {
                        trait_type: "Expiration Timestamp",
                        value: selectedSbtForMetadata.expirationTimestamp,
                        display_type: "date",
                      },
                      {
                        trait_type: "Sanctions Oracle Provider",
                        value: selectedSbtForMetadata.sanctionsProvider,
                      },
                      {
                        trait_type: "Sanctions Attestation Hash",
                        value: selectedSbtForMetadata.sanctionsScreeningHash,
                      },
                      {
                        trait_type: "ZK Identity Commitment",
                        value: selectedSbtForMetadata.zkIdentityCommitment,
                      },
                      {
                        trait_type: "Revocation Status",
                        value: selectedSbtForMetadata.isRevoked ? "REVOKED" : "ACTIVE",
                      },
                    ],
                  },

                  2

              </pre>

      {/* ISSUE NEW INVESTOR IDENTITY SBT MODAL */}

  ArrowUpRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  Wallet,
  ExternalLink,
  PlusCircle,
  Copy,
  Check,
  RefreshCw,
  Zap,
  TrendingUp,
  Info,
  CircleDot
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  MarketplaceListing,
  getMarketplaceListings,
  getLicensePurchases
} from "../utils/tokenLicensingMarketplace";

interface LicensingRevenueGrowthChartProps {
  userMetaMaskAddress?: string;
  onNavigateToMarketplace?: () => void;
  className?: string;
  isCompact?: boolean;
}

type TimeHorizon = "7D" | "30D" | "90D" | "ALL";
type DataSourceMode = "user_only" | "all_active";

export interface RevenueTimeSeriesPoint {
  date: string;
  displayDate: string;
  fullDateStr: string;
  timestamp: number;
  cumulativeRevenueUsd: number;
  dailyInflowUsd: number;
  netMetaMaskPayoutUsd: number;
  platformFeeUsd: number;
  cumulativeLicensesSold: number;
  intervalLicensesSold: number;
  activeListingsCount: number;
  topAssetTitle: string;
  topAssetContract: string;
  topAssetType: string;
  topAssetPrice: number;
  topAssetCurrency: string;
  topAssetChain: string;
  ethEquivalent: number;
  polEquivalent: number;
  solEquivalent: number;
  velocityLabel: string;
  intervalIndex: number;
  totalIntervals: number;
}

export const LicensingRevenueGrowthChart: React.FC<LicensingRevenueGrowthChartProps> = ({
  userMetaMaskAddress,
  onNavigateToMarketplace,
  className = "",
  isCompact = false,
}) => {
  const [timeHorizon, setTimeHorizon] = useState<TimeHorizon>("30D");
  const [dataSourceMode, setDataSourceMode] = useState<DataSourceMode>("all_active");
  const [showDailyInflows, setShowDailyInflows] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showNetPayout, setShowNetPayout] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [copiedContract, setCopiedContract] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  // Animation state for smooth entrance animations on load, timeframe change, or manual trigger
  const [animationKey, setAnimationKey] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isReplayingAnimation, setIsReplayingAnimation] = useState<boolean>(false);
  
  // Live hover state for inspector bar
  const [hoveredPoint, setHoveredPoint] = useState<RevenueTimeSeriesPoint | null>(null);

  // 1. Pull active marketplace listings and recorded purchases
  const listings: MarketplaceListing[] = useMemo(() => {
    return getMarketplaceListings();
  }, []);

  const purchases = useMemo(() => {
    return getLicensePurchases();
  }, []);

  // Filter listings based on user MetaMask address or all active
  const relevantListings = useMemo(() => {
    if (dataSourceMode === "user_only") {
      const userListings = listings.filter((l) => {
        if (l.isUserListing) return true;
        if (
          userMetaMaskAddress &&
          l.sellerPayoutAddress.toLowerCase() === userMetaMaskAddress.toLowerCase()
        ) {
          return true;
        }
        return false;
      });
      // If user has no custom listings yet, include the first featured seed listing as an active benchmark
      return userListings.length > 0 ? userListings : listings.slice(0, 2);
    }
    return listings;
  }, [listings, dataSourceMode, userMetaMaskAddress]);

  // Total summary metrics from active listings
  const totalLicensingGrossUsd = useMemo(() => {
    return relevantListings.reduce(
      (sum, l) => sum + (l.totalEarningsUsd || (l.salesCount * l.priceUsdEstimate)),
      0
    );
  }, [relevantListings]);

  const totalLicensesSold = useMemo(() => {
    return relevantListings.reduce((sum, l) => sum + (l.salesCount || 0), 0);
  }, [relevantListings]);

  const averagePricePerLicense = useMemo(() => {
    if (relevantListings.length === 0) return 0;
    const sum = relevantListings.reduce((acc, l) => acc + l.priceUsdEstimate, 0);
    return sum / relevantListings.length;
  }, [relevantListings]);

  const topPerformingListing = useMemo(() => {
    if (relevantListings.length === 0) return null;
    return [...relevantListings].sort(
      (a, b) => (b.totalEarningsUsd || 0) - (a.totalEarningsUsd || 0)
    )[0];
  }, [relevantListings]);

  // Handle replaying the entrance animation
  const handleReplayAnimation = useCallback(() => {
    setIsReplayingAnimation(true);
    setAnimationKey((prev) => prev + 1);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsReplayingAnimation(false);
    }, 1500);
  }, []);

  const handleTimeHorizonChange = (hz: TimeHorizon) => {
    setTimeHorizon(hz);
    setAnimationKey((prev) => prev + 1);
  };

  const handleDataSourceToggle = (mode: DataSourceMode) => {
    setDataSourceMode(mode);
    setAnimationKey((prev) => prev + 1);
  };

  // Construct realistic, chronological growth trajectory data points with deep revenue details
  const chartData: RevenueTimeSeriesPoint[] = useMemo(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const dayMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    let daysCount = 30;

    if (timeHorizon === "7D") daysCount = 7;
    else if (timeHorizon === "30D") daysCount = 30;
    else if (timeHorizon === "90D") daysCount = 90;
    else if (timeHorizon === "ALL") daysCount = 180;

    const targetGrossUsd = Math.max(120, totalLicensingGrossUsd);
    const targetSales = Math.max(4, totalLicensesSold);
    const points: RevenueTimeSeriesPoint[] = [];

    const pointsCount = Math.min(daysCount, 30); // Max 30 points for crisp visual line balance
    const stepDays = daysCount / pointsCount;

    // Distribute contributing assets round-robin for realistic multi-asset curve contribution
    const activeAssetsPool = relevantListings.length > 0 ? relevantListings : listings;

    for (let i = 0; i <= pointsCount; i++) {
      const dayOffset = (pointsCount - i) * stepDays;
      const pointTime = new Date(now - dayOffset * dayMs);
      const progress = i / pointsCount;
      
      // S-Curve growth progression with realistic compounding adoption
      const curveFactor = Math.pow(progress, 1.35);
      const cumulativeUsd = Number((targetGrossUsd * curveFactor).toFixed(2));
      const previousUsd = i === 0 ? 0 : points[i - 1].cumulativeRevenueUsd;
      const dailyInflow = Math.max(0, Number((cumulativeUsd - previousUsd).toFixed(2)));
      
      // 97.5% net creator payout, 2.5% protocol integrator fee
      const netPayout = Number((cumulativeUsd * 0.975).toFixed(2));
      const platformFee = Number((cumulativeUsd * 0.025).toFixed(2));
      const cumSales = Math.max(0, Math.round(targetSales * curveFactor));
      const previousSales = i === 0 ? 0 : points[i - 1].cumulativeLicensesSold;
      const intervalSales = Math.max(0, cumSales - previousSales);

      // Current contributing asset for this interval
      const assetIndex = i % activeAssetsPool.length;
      const asset = activeAssetsPool[assetIndex] || topPerformingListing;

      const displayDate = pointTime.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
        month: "short",
        day: "numeric",
      });

      const fullDateStr = pointTime.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
        weekday: "short",
        month: "short",
        day: "numeric",
        year: "numeric",
      });

      // Dynamic velocity categorization
      let velocityLabel = "🌱 Baseline Volume";
      if (dailyInflow > targetGrossUsd * 0.08) {
        velocityLabel = "⚡ Surge Inflow Spike";
      } else if (dailyInflow > targetGrossUsd * 0.035) {
        velocityLabel = "🚀 Compounding Growth";
      } else if (dailyInflow > 0) {
        velocityLabel = "📈 Steady Inflow";
      }

      points.push({
        date: pointTime.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        displayDate,
        fullDateStr,
        timestamp: pointTime.getTime(),
        cumulativeRevenueUsd: cumulativeUsd,
        dailyInflowUsd: dailyInflow,
        netMetaMaskPayoutUsd: netPayout,
        platformFeeUsd: platformFee,
        cumulativeLicensesSold: cumSales,
        intervalLicensesSold: intervalSales,
        activeListingsCount: relevantListings.length,
        topAssetTitle: asset?.title || "0x7777 Vanity Contract ID Rights",
        topAssetContract: asset?.contractAddress || "0x7777Aa39B924fC3e12089Da071f654b41a8e8888",
        topAssetType: asset?.type || "contract_id_rights",
        topAssetPrice: asset?.priceAmount || 0.045,
        topAssetCurrency: asset?.priceCurrency || "ETH",
        topAssetChain: (asset?.chain || "base").toUpperCase(),
        ethEquivalent: Number((cumulativeUsd / 3450).toFixed(4)),
        polEquivalent: Number((cumulativeUsd / 0.52).toFixed(1)),
        solEquivalent: Number((cumulativeUsd / 195).toFixed(2)),
        velocityLabel,
        intervalIndex: i + 1,
        totalIntervals: pointsCount + 1,
      });
    }

    return points;
  }, [timeHorizon, totalLicensingGrossUsd, totalLicensesSold, relevantListings, listings, topPerformingListing]);

  // Projected growth rate
  const growthRatePercent = useMemo(() => {
    if (chartData.length < 2) return 145;
    const startVal = chartData[0]?.cumulativeRevenueUsd || 10;
    const endVal = chartData[chartData.length - 1]?.cumulativeRevenueUsd || 100;
    if (startVal === 0) return 210;
    return Math.round(((endVal - startVal) / Math.max(1, startVal)) * 100);
  }, [chartData]);

  const handleCopy = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedContract(text);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedContract(null), 2000);
  };

  // Custom Animated Active Dot for Line points on Hover
  const renderAnimatedActiveDot = (color: string) => (props: any) => {
    const { cx, cy } = props;
    if (!cx || !cy) return null;
    return (
      <g key={`active-dot-${cx}-${cy}`}>
        <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={12} fill={color} fillOpacity={0.25} className="animate-ping" />
        <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={6.5} fill="#0F172A" stroke={color} strokeWidth={2.5} />
        <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={2.5} fill="#FFFFFF" />
      </g>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 md:p-6 space-y-6 shadow-xl transition-all duration-500 animate-fadeIn ${className}`}
      id="token-licensing-revenue-growth-container"
    >
      
      {/* Top Header & Visualizer Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800 pb-5">
        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-400 relative">
              <Key className="w-5 h-5" />
              <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-2.5 w-2.5">
                <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75" />
                <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-emerald-500" />
              </span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  Token Licensing Revenue Growth Over Time
                </h3>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                  Interactive Recharts
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                Real-time compounding royalties from your active contract IDs, vanity rights, and synthetic dataset licensing.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Controls: Replay Animation, Data Source Toggle & Time Horizon */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          
          {/* Replay Animation Trigger */}
          <button
            onClick={handleReplayAnimation}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-slate-800 hover:border-indigo-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-all flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-sm"
            title="Replay entrance animations on the revenue curve"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400 ${isReplayingAnimation ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Replay Animation</span>
          </button>

          {/* Data Filter: User's vs All Active Listings */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs">
            <button
              onClick={() => handleDataSourceToggle("all_active")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all ${
                dataSourceMode === "all_active"
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title="Show all active marketplace listings growth curve"
            >
              All Listings ({listings.length})
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleDataSourceToggle("user_only")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all flex items-center space-x-1 ${
                dataSourceMode === "user_only"
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title="Filter strictly to your MetaMask address active listings"
            >
              <Wallet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>My Listings ({listings.filter((l) => l.isUserListing || (userMetaMaskAddress && l.sellerPayoutAddress.toLowerCase() === userMetaMaskAddress.toLowerCase())).length})</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Timeframe Buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono">
            {(["7D", "30D", "90D", "ALL"] as TimeHorizon[]).map((hz) => (
              <button
                key={hz}
                onClick={() => handleTimeHorizonChange(hz)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors font-semibold ${
                  timeHorizon === hz
                    ? "bg-slate-800 text-cyan-300 border border-slate-700 shadow-inner"
                    : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                {hz}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {onNavigateToMarketplace && (
            <button
              onClick={onNavigateToMarketplace}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600/20 hover:bg-emerald-600/30 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-sm"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Sell License</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Real-time KPI Metric Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5">
        
        {/* Metric 1: Total Cumulative Revenue */}
        <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>Cumulative Licensing Gross</span>
            <DollarSign className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-emerald-400 mt-1.5 font-mono">
            ${totalLicensingGrossUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-300/80 mt-1 flex items-center space-x-1">
            <ArrowUpRight className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>+{growthRatePercent}% velocity ({timeHorizon})</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metric 2: Net Creator Payout */}
        <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>Net MetaMask Payout (97.5%)</span>
            <Wallet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-cyan-300 mt-1.5 font-mono">
            ${(totalLicensingGrossUsd * 0.975).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1 truncate" title={userMetaMaskAddress || "MetaMask Payout Wallet"}>
            Payout: <span className="text-slate-300 font-mono">{userMetaMaskAddress ? `${userMetaMaskAddress.slice(0, 6)}...${userMetaMaskAddress.slice(-4)}` : "Connected Web3 Wallet"}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metric 3: Active Listings Count */}
        <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>Active Listed Assets</span>
            <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-white mt-1.5 font-mono">
            {relevantListings.length}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Avg. License: <strong className="text-indigo-300 font-mono">${averagePricePerLicense.toFixed(2)}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metric 4: Total Licenses Sold */}
        <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>Licenses Purchased</span>
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-amber-300 mt-1.5 font-mono">
            {totalLicensesSold} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">grants</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Settled via on-chain smart contracts
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Live Hover Inspector Bar */}
      <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
        {hoveredPoint ? (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 w-full animate-fadeIn font-mono">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-slate-300">
              <CircleDot className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-400 animate-ping" />
              <span className="font-bold text-white">{hoveredPoint.fullDateStr}</span>
              <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px]">({hoveredPoint.intervalIndex}/{hoveredPoint.totalIntervals})</span>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-slate-400">
              <span>Gross:</span>
              <strong className="text-indigo-400 font-bold">${hoveredPoint.cumulativeRevenueUsd.toFixed(2)}</strong>
              <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px]">({hoveredPoint.ethEquivalent} ETH)</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-slate-400">
              <span>Net to MetaMask:</span>
              <strong className="text-cyan-300 font-bold">${hoveredPoint.netMetaMaskPayoutUsd.toFixed(2)}</strong>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-slate-400">
              <span>Inflow:</span>
              <strong className="text-amber-400 font-bold">+${hoveredPoint.dailyInflowUsd.toFixed(2)}</strong>
            </div>

            <div className="ml-auto flex items-center space-x-2 text-[11px] font-sans">
              <span className="text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[200px]" title={hoveredPoint.topAssetTitle}>
                {hoveredPoint.topAssetTitle}
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleCopy(hoveredPoint.topAssetContract)}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white flex items-center space-x-1 font-mono text-[10px]"
                title="Copy active contract ID"
              >
                {copiedContract === hoveredPoint.topAssetContract ? (
                  <>
                    <Check className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Copied!</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Copy className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    <span>{hoveredPoint.topAssetContract.slice(0, 6)}...</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full text-slate-400 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
              <span>Hover over any data point on the curve to inspect granular revenue settlements, crypto conversions, and active token contract IDs.</span>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center space-x-3 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500">
              <span>ETH: $3,450</span>
              <span>POL: $0.52</span>
              <span>SOL: $195</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Main Recharts Line Chart Container with Entrance Animations */}
      <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4">
        
        {/* Chart Subtitle & Toggle Legend */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300 font-mono uppercase text-[11px] tracking-wide">
              Compounding Trajectory ({timeHorizon}):
            </span>
            <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px] font-mono">
              {chartData.length} timeline milestones
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <label className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={showNetPayout}
                onChange={(e) => setShowNetPayout(e.target.checked)}
                className="rounded border-slate-700 text-cyan-500 focus:ring-cyan-500 bg-slate-900 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="text-slate-300 font-mono text-[11px] flex items-center space-x-1">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-0.5 bg-cyan-400 rounded-full inline-block" />
                <span>Net MetaMask Payout ($)</span>
              </span>
            </label>

            <label className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={showDailyInflows}
                onChange={(e) => setShowDailyInflows(e.target.checked)}
                className="rounded border-slate-700 text-amber-500 focus:ring-amber-500 bg-slate-900 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="text-slate-300 font-mono text-[11px] flex items-center space-x-1">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-0.5 bg-amber-400 rounded-full inline-block" />
                <span>Period Inflows ($)</span>
              </span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Recharts ComposedChart with Entrance Animation Props */}
        <div key={`licensing-chart-wrapper-${animationKey}`} className="h-[300px] sm:h-[350px] w-full">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <ComposedChart
              data={chartData}
              margin={{ top: 15, right: 20, left: 10, bottom: 10 }}
              onMouseMove={(state: any) => {
                if (state && state.activePayload && state.activePayload.length > 0) {
                  setHoveredPoint(state.activePayload[0].payload as RevenueTimeSeriesPoint);
                }
              }}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredPoint(null)}
            >
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="licensingGrossGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#6366F1" stopOpacity={0.4} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#6366F1" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                </linearGradient>
                <linearGradient id="inflowBarGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#F59E0B" stopOpacity={0.6} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#F59E0B" stopOpacity={0.1} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>

              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1E293B" vertical={false} />

              <XAxis
                dataKey="displayDate"
                stroke="#64748B"
                fontSize={11}
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
              />

              <YAxis
                yAxisId="left"
                stroke="#64748B"

              </td>

              </td>
              <td className="p-3 font-bold text-white">
                +${Math.round(metricsB.periodYieldUsd).toLocaleString()} USD

                </span>
              </td>

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {

export interface LiquidityPoolDepthPreviewChartProps {
  poolParams: LiquidityPoolInitParameters;

  quoteAsset: SettlementAssetSymbol;
  feeTier: 500 | 3000 | 10000;

  liquidityPercent: number;
  slippagePercent: number;

}

interface DepthBin {
  price: number;
  priceRatio: number;
  diffPercent: number;
  type: "bid" | "ask" | "mid";
  inRange: boolean;
  density: number; // 0 to 1 relative height
  depthUsd: number;
  cumulativeDepthUsd: number;
}

interface SlippageTier {
  tradeSizeUsd: number;
  priceImpactPct: number;
  totalSlippagePct: number;
  effectivePriceUsd: number;
  depthConsumedPct: number;
  isWithinSlippageCollar: boolean;
  status: "SAFE" | "MODERATE" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL";
}

export const LiquidityPoolDepthPreviewChart: React.FC<
  LiquidityPoolDepthPreviewChartProps
> = ({
  poolParams,
  activeToken,
  quoteAsset,
  feeTier,

  className = "",

  // Active View Tab: "DEPTH" (AMM Liquidity Distribution) vs "SLIPPAGE" (Volume Impact Curve)

    return Math.max(10000, Math.round(poolParams.totalInitialLiquidityUsd * 0.02));
  });

  const midPrice = poolParams.impliedTokenUnitPriceUsd;
  const lowerBound = poolParams.priceLowerUsd;
  const upperBound = poolParams.priceUpperUsd;
  const totalPoolDepth = poolParams.totalInitialLiquidityUsd;
  const efficiencyMultiplier = poolParams.concentratedCapitalEfficiencyMultiplier;
  const virtualLiquidity = totalPoolDepth * efficiencyMultiplier;

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. GENERATE CONCENTRATED LIQUIDITY DEPTH BINS (31 BINS AROUND MID PRICE)
  // =========================================================================
  const depthBins: DepthBin[] = useMemo(() => {
    const bins: DepthBin[] = [];
    const spanPercent = rangeStrategy === "NARROW" ? 0.25 : rangeStrategy === "WIDE" ? 0.8 : 0.45;
    const steps = 15; // 15 bids + 1 mid + 15 asks = 31 total

    // Generate Bid side (Quote token collateral, price < mid)
    let cumulativeBids = 0;
    const rawBids: DepthBin[] = [];
    for (let i = steps; i >= 1; i--) {
      const diffPct = -((i / steps) * spanPercent * 100);
      const price = midPrice * (1 + diffPct / 100);
      const inRange = price >= lowerBound && price <= upperBound;
      
      // Concentrated Gaussian bell curve density
      const distFromMid = Math.abs(diffPct) / 100;
      const rawDensity = inRange ? Math.exp(-Math.pow(distFromMid / (spanPercent * 0.65), 2)) : 0.05;
      const depthUsd = (totalPoolDepth / 2) * (rawDensity / (steps * 0.7));
      cumulativeBids += depthUsd;

      rawBids.push({
        price,
        priceRatio: price / (VERIFIED_PRICE_MAP[quoteAsset] || 1.0),
        diffPercent: diffPct,
        type: "bid",
        inRange,
        density: Math.min(1, Math.max(0.08, rawDensity)),
        depthUsd,
        cumulativeDepthUsd: cumulativeBids,
      });
    }

    // Mid price bin (Zero point)
    const midBin: DepthBin = {
      price: midPrice,
      priceRatio: poolParams.initialPriceRatio,
      diffPercent: 0,
      type: "mid",
      inRange: true,
      density: 1.0,
      depthUsd: totalPoolDepth * 0.08,
      cumulativeDepthUsd: cumulativeBids,
    };

    // Generate Ask side (Base token inventory, price > mid)
    let cumulativeAsks = 0;
    const rawAsks: DepthBin[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
      const diffPct = (i / steps) * spanPercent * 100;
      const price = midPrice * (1 + diffPct / 100);
      const inRange = price >= lowerBound && price <= upperBound;

      const distFromMid = Math.abs(diffPct) / 100;
      const rawDensity = inRange ? Math.exp(-Math.pow(distFromMid / (spanPercent * 0.65), 2)) : 0.05;
      const depthUsd = (totalPoolDepth / 2) * (rawDensity / (steps * 0.7));
      cumulativeAsks += depthUsd;

      rawAsks.push({
        price,
        priceRatio: price / (VERIFIED_PRICE_MAP[quoteAsset] || 1.0),
        diffPercent: diffPct,
        type: "ask",
        inRange,
        density: Math.min(1, Math.max(0.08, rawDensity)),
        depthUsd,
        cumulativeDepthUsd: cumulativeAsks,
      });
    }

    return [...rawBids, midBin, ...rawAsks];
  }, [midPrice, lowerBound, upperBound, totalPoolDepth, rangeStrategy, quoteAsset, poolParams.initialPriceRatio]);

  // =========================================================================

    // Standard sizes based on pool scale

    const tradeSizes = [
      Math.round(baseScale * 0.5),
      Math.round(baseScale * 1),
      Math.round(baseScale * 2.5),
      Math.round(baseScale * 5),
      Math.round(baseScale * 10),
      Math.round(baseScale * 25),
      Math.round(baseScale * 50),
    ];

    const feePct = feeTier / 10000; // e.g. 0.30%

    return tradeSizes.map((size) => {
      // Concentrated liquidity formula: Price Impact ~ S / (VirtualLiquidity + S)
      const rawImpact = (size / (virtualLiquidity + size)) * 100 * 1.15;
      const totalSlippage = rawImpact + feePct;
      const depthConsumed = (size / totalPoolDepth) * 100;
      const isWithinSlippageCollar = totalSlippage <= slippagePercent;

      let status: SlippageTier["status"] = "SAFE";
      if (totalSlippage > 3.0 || depthConsumed > 25) {
        status = "CRITICAL";
      } else if (totalSlippage > 1.5 || depthConsumed > 10) {
        status = "HIGH";
      } else if (totalSlippage > slippagePercent) {
        status = "MODERATE";
      }

      return {
        tradeSizeUsd: size,
        priceImpactPct: rawImpact,
        totalSlippagePct: totalSlippage,
        effectivePriceUsd: midPrice * (1 + rawImpact / 100),
        depthConsumedPct: depthConsumed,
        isWithinSlippageCollar,
        status,
      };
    });
  }, [totalPoolDepth, virtualLiquidity, feeTier, slippagePercent, midPrice]);

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. INTERACTIVE CUSTOM TRADE IMPACT TESTER CALCULATION
  // =========================================================================
  const interactiveTradeImpact = useMemo(() => {
    const size = Math.max(100, testTradeAmountUsd);
    const feePct = feeTier / 10000;

    const totalSlippage = rawImpact + feePct;
    const tokensReceived = size / (midPrice * (1 + rawImpact / 200));
    const isCollarPassed = totalSlippage <= slippagePercent;

    return {
      sizeUsd: size,
      tokensReceived,
      priceImpactPct: rawImpact,
      totalSlippagePct: totalSlippage,
      postTradePriceUsd: midPrice * (1 + rawImpact / 100),
      isCollarPassed,
      depthConsumedPct: Math.min(100, (size / totalPoolDepth) * 100),
    };
  }, [testTradeAmountUsd, virtualLiquidity, totalPoolDepth, feeTier, midPrice, slippagePercent]);

    const targetMaxImpact = Math.max(0.05, slippagePercent - feeTier / 10000);
    // Solve: targetMaxImpact = S / (VirtualLiquidity + S) * 100
    const ratio = targetMaxImpact / 100;
    return Math.max(500, Math.round((virtualLiquidity * ratio) / (1 - ratio)));
  }, [slippagePercent, feeTier, virtualLiquidity]);

  return (

      className={`rounded-xl bg-[#0B0D18] border border-[#242944] p-4 space-y-4 font-mono shadow-xl ${className}`}
    >

          CHART HEADER & VIEW SELECTOR TABS
         ================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#1C2138] pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">

            <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                Post-Initialization Liquidity & Slippage Simulation
              </span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/25">
                {rangeStrategy} · {efficiencyMultiplier.toFixed(1)}x Efficiency
              </span>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-sans mt-0.5">

              {Math.round(totalPoolDepth).toLocaleString()} USD).
