```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Globe,
  Radio,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  Activity,
  ArrowRight,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  Zap,
  Server,
  Scale,
  Search,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Layers,
  BarChart2,
  Sliders,
  DollarSign,
  Key,
  Database,
  ArrowDownUp,
  Link as LinkIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";

export interface LiveTickerItem {
  symbol: string;
  name: string;
  priceUsd: number;
  change24h: number;
  volume24hUsd: number;
  high24h: number;
  low24h: number;
  lastUpdated: string;
}

export interface ArbitrageItem {
  symbol: string;
  name: string;
  exchanges: Array<{ exchange: string; price: number }>;
  lowestAsk: { exchange: string; price: number };
  highestBid: { exchange: string; price: number };
  spreadPercent: number;
  spreadUsd: number;
}

export interface ExchangePingItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: "CEX" | "DEX" | "Aggregator" | "Oracle";
  status: "Online" | "Degraded" | "Offline";
  httpCode: number;
  latencyMs: number;
  url: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export interface OrderBookEntry {
  price: number;
  size: number;
  totalUsd: number;
  cumulativeVolume: number;
}

export interface DexPairItem {
  chainId: string;
  dexId: string;
  url: string;
  pairAddress: string;
  baseToken: { address: string; name: string; symbol: string };
  quoteToken: { address: string; name: string; symbol: string };
  priceUsd: number;
  liquidityUsd: number;
  volume24hUsd: number;
  priceChange24h: number;
}

interface LiveMarketExchangeGatewayProps {
  tokens?: TokenRecord[];
  onSelectToken?: (token: TokenRecord) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const LiveMarketExchangeGateway: React.FC<LiveMarketExchangeGatewayProps> = ({
  tokens = [],
  className = "",
}) => {
  // Navigation Sub-Tabs
  const [subTab, setSubTab] = useState<"tickers" | "arbitrage" | "orderbook" | "health" | "dex_scanner" | "api_keys">("tickers");

  // Live Exchange Health Data
  const [exchangeHealth, setExchangeHealth] = useState<ExchangePingItem[]>([]);
  const [connectedCount, setConnectedCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [averageLatency, setAverageLatency] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isPinging, setIsPinging] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastPingTime, setLastPingTime] = useState<string>("");

  // Live Ticker Data
  const [tickers, setTickers] = useState<LiveTickerItem[]>([]);
  const [arbitrageList, setArbitrageList] = useState<ArbitrageItem[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingTickers, setIsLoadingTickers] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [autoRefreshInterval, setAutoRefreshInterval] = useState<number>(15); // seconds (0 = off)

  // Order Book Data
  const [orderBookPair, setOrderBookPair] = useState<string>("ETH-USD");
  const [orderBookBids, setOrderBookBids] = useState<OrderBookEntry[]>([]);
  const [orderBookAsks, setOrderBookAsks] = useState<OrderBookEntry[]>([]);
  const [orderBookMidPrice, setOrderBookMidPrice] = useState<number>(0);
  const [orderBookSpreadUsd, setOrderBookSpreadUsd] = useState<number>(0);
  const [orderBookSpreadPercent, setOrderBookSpreadPercent] = useState<number>(0);
  const [orderBookPressure, setOrderBookPressure] = useState<number>(50);
  const [isLoadingOrderBook, setIsLoadingOrderBook] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // DEX Token Scanner State
  const [dexSearchInput, setDexSearchInput] = useState<string>(
    tokens.length > 0 && tokens[0].contractAddress ? tokens[0].contractAddress : "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2"
  );
  const [dexPairs, setDexPairs] = useState<DexPairItem[]>([]);
  const [isSearchingDex, setIsSearchingDex] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [dexSearchError, setDexSearchError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Read-Only User API Keys (Local Storage)
  const [savedApiKeys, setSavedApiKeys] = useState<Array<{ exchange: string; keyMasked: string; dateAdded: string }>>(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem("outside_world_exchange_keys_v1");
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  });
  const [newKeyExchange, setNewKeyExchange] = useState<string>("Binance");
  const [newKeyInput, setNewKeyInput] = useState<string>("");

  // 1. Fetch Live Exchange Ping Latency
  const fetchHealthPing = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsPinging(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/exchange/health-ping");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          setExchangeHealth(data.results || []);
          setConnectedCount(data.connectedCount || 0);
          setAverageLatency(data.averageLatencyMs || 0);
          setLastPingTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to ping external exchanges:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsPinging(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // 2. Fetch Live Price Tickers & Arbitrage
  const fetchLiveTickers = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoadingTickers(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/exchange/live-tickers");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          setTickers(data.tickers || []);
          setArbitrageList(data.arbitrageComparison || []);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to fetch live tickers:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingTickers(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // 3. Fetch Live Order Book Depth
  const fetchOrderBook = useCallback(async (pair: string) => {
    setIsLoadingOrderBook(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/exchange/orderbook?pair=${pair}&limit=12`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          setOrderBookBids(data.bids || []);
          setOrderBookAsks(data.asks || []);
          setOrderBookMidPrice(data.midPrice || 0);
          setOrderBookSpreadUsd(data.spreadUsd || 0);
          setOrderBookSpreadPercent(data.spreadPercent || 0);
          setOrderBookPressure(data.bidPressurePercent || 50);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to fetch live order book:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoadingOrderBook(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // 4. Search DEX On-Chain Pairs via DEXScreener
  const handleSearchDex = async (addressToSearch: string) => {
    const cleanAddr = addressToSearch.trim();
    if (!cleanAddr) return;

    setIsSearchingDex(true);
    setDexSearchError(null);
    setDexPairs([]);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/exchange/dex-lookup?address=${encodeURIComponent(cleanAddr)}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          setDexPairs(data.pairs || []);
          if ((data.pairs || []).length === 0) {
            setDexSearchError("No active automated market maker (AMM) liquidity pools found on DEXScreener for this contract address yet.");
          }
        } else {
          setDexSearchError(data.error || "Lookup failed.");
        }
      } else {
        setDexSearchError("External DEX Screener network lookup failed.");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setDexSearchError(err?.message || "Error querying DEX pools.");
    } finally {
      setIsSearchingDex(false);
    }
  };

  // Initial Data Load
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchHealthPing();
    fetchLiveTickers();
    fetchOrderBook(orderBookPair);
  }, [fetchHealthPing, fetchLiveTickers, fetchOrderBook, orderBookPair]);

  // Auto Refresh Interval
  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoRefreshInterval <= 0) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetchLiveTickers();
      if (subTab === "orderbook") {
        fetchOrderBook(orderBookPair);
      }
    }, autoRefreshInterval * 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [autoRefreshInterval, fetchLiveTickers, fetchOrderBook, orderBookPair, subTab]);

  // Handle Adding Read-Only API Key
  const handleSaveApiKey = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newKeyInput.trim()) return;
    const masked = newKeyInput.slice(0, 4) + "••••••••••••" + newKeyInput.slice(-4);
    const updated = [
      ...savedApiKeys.filter((k) => k.exchange !== newKeyExchange),
      {
        exchange: newKeyExchange,
        keyMasked: masked,
        dateAdded: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
      },
    ];
    setSavedApiKeys(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("outside_world_exchange_keys_v1", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setNewKeyInput("");
  };

  const handleRemoveApiKey = (exchange: string) => {
    const updated = savedApiKeys.filter((k) => k.exchange !== exchange);
    setSavedApiKeys(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("outside_world_exchange_keys_v1", JSON.stringify(updated));
  };

  return (
    <div
      id="outside-world-exchange-gateway"
      className={`bg-[#0D0E12] border border-[#1E222D] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl space-y-4 ${className}`}
    >
      {/* 1. Real-Time Outside World Connectivity Header */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#12141A] via-[#161922] to-[#12141A] p-4 border-b border-[#1E222D]">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-950/40">
                <Globe className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-3 w-3">
                <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75" />
                <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-3 w-3 bg-emerald-500" />
              </span>
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-white tracking-wide">
                  Outside World Crypto Market Exchange Bridge
                </h3>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300">
                  LIVE FEED ACTIVE
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
```

```tsx
  // Dynamic Analytics Data for the 3 Manus Analytics Cards
  const analyticsSeries = useMemo(() => {
    const basePoints = 12;
    const executionRateData = [];
    const apiHitChartData = [];
    const totalApiHits = 148920 + tickCounter * 37;

    for (let i = 0; i < basePoints; i++) {
      const phase = (i + tickCounter) * 0.65;
      const execRate = Math.min(
        99.9,
        Math.max(91.5, Number((96.2 + Math.sin(phase) * 2.8).toFixed(1)))
      );
      const apiHits = Math.round(1150 + Math.cos(phase * 0.9) * 340 + i * 28);
      executionRateData.push({
        time: `${i * 5}m`,
        rate: execRate,
      });
      apiHitChartData.push({
        time: `${i * 5}m`,
        hits: apiHits,
        validated: Math.round(apiHits * 0.94),
      });
    }

    return {
      executionRateData,
      apiHitChartData,
      currentExecutionRate:
        executionRateData[executionRateData.length - 1]?.rate || 98.4,
      currentApiHitsPerSec:
        apiHitChartData[apiHitChartData.length - 1]?.hits || 1420,
      totalApiHits,
    };
  }, [tickCounter]);
```

```tsx
    string public constant CATEGORY_MINERAL_BULLION = "Refined Titanium & Gold Bullion";
    string public constant CATEGORY_RARE_EARTH_IP = "Rare Earth Intellectual Property";
    string public constant CATEGORY_CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE = "Carbon Credit Derivative";
    string public constant CATEGORY_SOVEREIGN_COMMODITY = "Sovereign RWA Commodity";

    /**
     * @dev On-chain PhysicalBacking struct supporting 'Rare Earth Intellectual Property'
     *      and 'Carbon Credit Derivative' types alongside statutory custody, verification hash,
     *      and specialized metadata fields for dynamic token classification.
     */
    struct PhysicalBacking {
        PhysicalBackingType backingType; // RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY | CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE | etc.
        string category;                 // e.g., "Rare Earth Intellectual Property" | "Carbon Credit Derivative"
        string varietyIdentifier;        // e.g., "RE-IP-NDPR-2026-V1" | "CARB-VCS-ART6-2026"
        string commodityType;            // Underlying physical, IP patent, or carbon removal specification
        string measurementUnit;          // e.g., "Patent Licensing Unit (10,000 bps)" | "1.00 Metric Tonne CO2e"
        string custodianRegistry;        // e.g., "WIPO PCT / USPTO" | "Verra Registry / UN Article 6.4"
        bytes32 auditorVerificationHash; // Cryptographic audit verification hash
        string specializedAttributes;    // Encoded Rare Earth IP or Carbon Credit Derivative traits
        string wipoPatentFilingId;       // Rare Earth IP: WIPO / PCT Patent Filing ID
        string lanthanideElementSymbols; // Rare Earth IP: Lanthanide Element Symbols
        uint256 separationPurityBps;     // Rare Earth IP: Separation Purity in bps (9999 = 99.99%)
        uint256 licensingRoyaltyBps;     // Rare Earth IP: IP Licensing Royalty in bps (450 = 4.50%)
        string carbonRegistryStandard;   // Carbon Credit Derivative: Verra VCS / UN Art. 6.4
        string serialBatchRange;         // Carbon Credit Derivative: Serial Retirement Batch Range
        uint256 vintageYear;             // Carbon Credit Derivative: Vintage Year
        uint256 co2TonnesPerToken;       // Carbon Credit Derivative: Metric Tonnes CO2e per Token
    }

    struct RareEarthIPAttributes {
        string wipoPatentFilingId;       // e.g., "PCT/US2026/084920"
        string lanthanideElementSymbols; // e.g., "Nd-Pr-Dy-Tb (Neodymium/Dysprosium)"
        uint256 separationPurityBps;     // e.g., 9999 (99.99% purity)
        uint256 licensingRoyaltyBps;     // e.g., 450 (4.50% gross IP royalty)
        bytes32 metallurgicalAuditSeal;
    }

    struct CarbonCreditAttributes {
        string registryStandard;         // e.g., "Verra VCS / UN Art. 6.4"
        string serialBatchRange;         // e.g., "VCS-2026-US-840-0001-9999"
        uint256 vintageYear;             // e.g., 2026
        uint256 co2TonnesPerToken;       // e.g., 1 (1 metric tonne CO2e per token)
        bytes32 additionalityProofHash;
        uint256 totalRetiredTonnes;
    }

    string public commodityMetadataURI;
    AssetClass public assetClass;
    string public assetCategory;
    PhysicalBacking public physicalBacking;
    RareEarthIPAttributes public rareEarthIPSpec;
    CarbonCreditAttributes public carbonCreditSpec;

    event MetadataUpdated(string newURI);
    event AssetCategoryClassified(AssetClass indexed assetClass, string assetCategory, string metadataURI);
    event PhysicalBackingConfigured(
        string category,
        string varietyIdentifier,
        string commodityType,
        string measurementUnit,
        string custodianRegistry,
        bytes32 auditorVerificationHash
    );
    event RareEarthIPConfigured(
        string wipoPatentFilingId,
        string lanthanideElementSymbols,
        uint256 separationPurityBps,
        uint256 licensingRoyaltyBps
    );
    event CarbonCreditConfigured(
        string registryStandard,
        string serialBatchRange,
        uint256 vintageYear,
        uint256 co2TonnesPerToken
    );
    event CarbonCreditRetired(
        address indexed holder,
        uint256 burnedTokenAmount,
        uint256 co2TonnesRetired,
        string beneficiary
    );

    constructor(
        string memory _name,
        string memory _symbol,
        uint256 _initialSupply,
        string memory _metadataURI,
        AssetClass _assetClass,
        address _initialOwner
    ) ERC20(_name, _symbol) Ownable(_initialOwner) {
        commodityMetadataURI = _metadataURI;
        assetClass = _assetClass;
        assetCategory = getAssetCategoryString(_assetClass);
        physicalBacking.backingType = getPhysicalBackingType(_assetClass);
        physicalBacking.category = assetCategory;
        _mint(_initialOwner, _initialSupply * (10 ** decimals()));
    }

    function getAssetCategoryString(AssetClass _class) public pure returns (string memory) {
        if (_class == AssetClass.RARE_EARTH_IP) {
            return CATEGORY_RARE_EARTH_IP;
        }
        if (_class == AssetClass.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE) {
            return CATEGORY_CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE;
        }
        if (_class == AssetClass.AEROSPACE_PROPULSION) {
            return CATEGORY_AEROSPACE_PROPULSION;
        }
        if (_class == AssetClass.MINERAL_BULLION) {
            return CATEGORY_MINERAL_BULLION;
        }
        return CATEGORY_SOVEREIGN_COMMODITY;
    }

    function getPhysicalBackingType(AssetClass _class) public pure returns (PhysicalBackingType) {
        if (_class == AssetClass.RARE_EARTH_IP) {
            return PhysicalBackingType.RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY;
        }
        if (_class == AssetClass.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE) {
            return PhysicalBackingType.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE;
        }
        if (_class == AssetClass.AEROSPACE_PROPULSION) {
            return PhysicalBackingType.AEROSPACE_PROPULSION_ELEMENT;
        }
        if (_class == AssetClass.MINERAL_BULLION) {
            return PhysicalBackingType.REFINED_MINERAL_BULLION;
        }
        return PhysicalBackingType.SOVEREIGN_RWA_COMMODITY;
    }

    function classifyTokenAssetCategory(
        AssetClass _newClass,
        string calldata _newMetadataURI
    ) external onlyOwner {
        assetClass = _newClass;
        assetCategory = getAssetCategoryString(_newClass);
        commodityMetadataURI = _newMetadataURI;
        physicalBacking.backingType = getPhysicalBackingType(_newClass);
        physicalBacking.category = assetCategory;
        emit AssetCategoryClassified(_newClass, assetCategory, _newMetadataURI);
    }

    function updateMetadataURI(string calldata _newURI) external onlyOwner {
        commodityMetadataURI = _newURI;
        emit MetadataUpdated(_newURI);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Configures the PhysicalBacking struct for any TWEAssetToken class,
     *         including Rare Earth Intellectual Property and Carbon Credit Derivative.
     */
    function configurePhysicalBacking(
        string calldata _category,
        string calldata _varietyIdentifier,
        string calldata _commodityType,
        string calldata _measurementUnit,
        string calldata _custodianRegistry,
        bytes32 _auditorVerificationHash,
        string calldata _specializedAttributes
    ) external onlyOwner {
        physicalBacking.backingType = getPhysicalBackingType(assetClass);
        physicalBacking.category = _category;
        physicalBacking.varietyIdentifier = _varietyIdentifier;
        physicalBacking.commodityType = _commodityType;
        physicalBacking.measurementUnit = _measurementUnit;
        physicalBacking.custodianRegistry = _custodianRegistry;
        physicalBacking.auditorVerificationHash = _auditorVerificationHash;
        physicalBacking.specializedAttributes = _specializedAttributes;
        emit PhysicalBackingConfigured(
            _category,
            _varietyIdentifier,
            _commodityType,
            _measurementUnit,
            _custodianRegistry,
            _auditorVerificationHash
        );
    }

    function getPhysicalBacking() external view returns (PhysicalBacking memory) {
        return physicalBacking;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Configures specialized attributes for Rare Earth Intellectual Property tokens
     */
    function configureRareEarthIP(
        string calldata _wipoPatentFilingId,
        string calldata _lanthanideElementSymbols,
        uint256 _separationPurityBps,
        uint256 _licensingRoyaltyBps,
        bytes32 _metallurgicalAuditSeal
    ) external onlyOwner {
        require(assetClass == AssetClass.RARE_EARTH_IP, "Invalid asset class: requires RARE_EARTH_IP");
        require(_separationPurityBps <= 10000, "Purity cannot exceed 10000 bps");
        rareEarthIPSpec = RareEarthIPAttributes({
            wipoPatentFilingId: _wipoPatentFilingId,
            lanthanideElementSymbols: _lanthanideElementSymbols,
            separationPurityBps: _separationPurityBps,
            licensingRoyaltyBps: _licensingRoyaltyBps,
            metallurgicalAuditSeal: _metallurgicalAuditSeal
        });
        physicalBacking.backingType = PhysicalBackingType.RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY;
        physicalBacking.category = CATEGORY_RARE_EARTH_IP;
        physicalBacking.wipoPatentFilingId = _wipoPatentFilingId;
        physicalBacking.lanthanideElementSymbols = _lanthanideElementSymbols;
        physicalBacking.separationPurityBps = _separationPurityBps;
        physicalBacking.licensingRoyaltyBps = _licensingRoyaltyBps;
        emit RareEarthIPConfigured(
            _wipoPatentFilingId,
            _lanthanideElementSymbols,
            _separationPurityBps,
            _licensingRoyaltyBps
        );
    }

    /**
     * @notice Configures specialized attributes for Carbon Credit Derivative tokens
     */
    function configureCarbonCreditDerivative(
        string calldata _registryStandard,
        string calldata _serialBatchRange,
        uint256 _vintageYear,
        uint256 _co2TonnesPerToken,
        bytes32 _additionalityProofHash
    ) external onlyOwner {
        require(
            assetClass == AssetClass.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE,
            "Invalid asset class: requires CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        );
        carbonCreditSpec = CarbonCreditAttributes({
            registryStandard: _registryStandard,
            serialBatchRange: _serialBatchRange,
            vintageYear: _vintageYear,
            co2TonnesPerToken: _co2TonnesPerToken,
            additionalityProofHash: _additionalityProofHash,
            totalRetiredTonnes: carbonCreditSpec.totalRetiredTonnes
        });
        physicalBacking.backingType = PhysicalBackingType.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE;
        physicalBacking.category = CATEGORY_CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE;
        physicalBacking.carbonRegistryStandard = _registryStandard;
        physicalBacking.serialBatchRange = _serialBatchRange;
        physicalBacking.vintageYear = _vintageYear;
        physicalBacking.co2TonnesPerToken = _co2TonnesPerToken;
        emit CarbonCreditConfigured(
            _registryStandard,
            _serialBatchRange,
            _vintageYear,
            _co2TonnesPerToken
        );
    }

    /**
     * @notice Permanently retires carbon credit derivatives on-chain by burning tokens
     */
    function retireCarbonCredits(
        uint256 _wholeTokenAmount,
        string calldata _beneficiaryStatement
    ) external {
        require(
            assetClass == AssetClass.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE,
            "Only CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE tokens can be retired"
        );
        uint256 burnAmountWei = _wholeTokenAmount * (10 ** decimals());
        _burn(msg.sender, burnAmountWei);
        uint256 tonnesOffset = _wholeTokenAmount *
            (carbonCreditSpec.co2TonnesPerToken > 0 ? carbonCreditSpec.co2TonnesPerToken : 1);
        carbonCreditSpec.totalRetiredTonnes += tonnesOffset;
        emit CarbonCreditRetired(msg.sender, burnAmountWei, tonnesOffset, _beneficiaryStatement);
    }
}

/**
 * @title TWETokenFactory
 * @dev Deterministic Factory utilizing CREATE2 for uniform multi-chain deployment across custom asset classes.
 */
contract TWETokenFactory is Ownable {
    event ArmoredTokenDeployed(
        address indexed tokenAddress,
        string name,
        string symbol,
        TWEAssetToken.AssetClass indexed assetClass,
        bytes32 indexed salt,
        string metadataURI
    );

    constructor() Ownable(msg.sender) {}

    function predictAddress(
        string memory _name,
        string memory _symbol,
        uint256 _initialSupply,
        string memory _metadataURI,
        TWEAssetToken.AssetClass _assetClass,
        address _tokenOwner,
        bytes32 _salt
    ) public view returns (address) {
        bytes memory bytecode = abi.encodePacked(
            type(TWEAssetToken).creationCode,
            abi.encode(_name, _symbol, _initialSupply, _metadataURI, _assetClass, _tokenOwner)
        );
        bytes32 hash = keccak256(
            abi.encodePacked(bytes1(0xff), address(this), _salt, keccak256(bytecode))
        );
        return address(uint160(uint256(hash)));
    }

    function deployToken(
        string memory _name,
        string memory _symbol,
        uint256 _initialSupply,
        string memory _metadataURI,
        TWEAssetToken.AssetClass _assetClass,
        address _tokenOwner,
        bytes32 _salt
    ) external onlyOwner returns (address tokenAddress) {
        bytes memory bytecode = abi.encodePacked(
            type(TWEAssetToken).creationCode,
            abi.encode(_name, _symbol, _initialSupply, _metadataURI, _assetClass, _tokenOwner)
        );

        assembly {
            tokenAddress := create2(0, add(bytecode, 0x20), mload(bytecode), _salt)
            if iszero(extcodesize(tokenAddress)) {
                revert(0, 0)
            }
        }

        emit ArmoredTokenDeployed(tokenAddress, _name, _symbol, _assetClass, _salt, _metadataURI);
    }
}`;

export const MAO_MAO_FACTORY_SOL_SOURCE = `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract MaoMaoToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    constructor(
        string memory name,
        string memory symbol,
        uint256 initialSupply,
        address owner
    ) ERC20(name, symbol) Ownable(owner) {
        _mint(owner, initialSupply * 10 ** decimals());
    }
}

contract MaoMaoFactory is Ownable {
    event TokenDeployed(address indexed tokenAddress, string name, string symbol, bytes32 salt);

    constructor() Ownable(msg.sender) {}

    /**
     * @notice Predicts the address of a token before deployment
     */
    function predictAddress(
        string memory name,
        string memory symbol,
        uint256 initialSupply,
        address tokenOwner,
        bytes32 salt
    ) public view returns (address) {
        bytes memory bytecode = abi.encodePacked(
            type(MaoMaoToken).creationCode,
            abi.encode(name, symbol, initialSupply, tokenOwner)
        );
        bytes32 hash = keccak256(
            abi.encodePacked(bytes1(0xff), address(this), salt, keccak256(bytecode))
        );
        return address(uint160(uint256(hash)));
    }

    /**
     * @notice Deploys a new token deterministically using CREATE2
     */
    function deployToken(
        string memory name,
        string memory symbol,
        uint256 initialSupply,
        address tokenOwner,
        bytes32 salt
    ) external onlyOwner returns (address tokenAddress) {
        bytes memory bytecode = abi.encodePacked(
            type(MaoMaoToken).creationCode,
            abi.encode(name, symbol, initialSupply, tokenOwner)
        );

        assembly {
            tokenAddress := create2(0, add(bytecode, 0x20), mload(bytecode), salt)
            if iszero(extcodesize(tokenAddress)) {
                revert(0, 0)
            }
        }

        emit TokenDeployed(tokenAddress, name, symbol, salt);
    }
}`;

function computeDeterministicHex(input: string, byteLength: number): string {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let h1 = 0x811c9dc5;
  let h2 = 0x01000193;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const ch = input.charCodeAt(i);
    h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ ch, 0x01000193);
    h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ ((ch << 3) | (i & 0xff)), 0x85ebca6b);
  }
  for (let b = 0; b < byteLength; b++) {
    h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ (b + 17), 0x27d4eb2d);
    h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ (h1 >>> 13), 0x165667b1);
    const byteVal = ((h1 >>> 8) ^ (h2 >>> 16) ^ (b * 31)) & 0xff;
    out.push(byteVal.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
  }
  return "0x" + out.join("");
}

export const MaoMaoTokenRegistrySuite: React.FC<MaoMaoTokenRegistrySuiteProps> = ({
  tweEnvKeyId,

    | "twe_execution_dashboard"
    | "action_1_factory"

  const [registryStatus, setRegistryStatus] = useState<
    "DESIGN PHASE" | "COMPILED & STAGED" | "MULTI-CHAIN ACTIVE"
```

```tsx
    }
    return tokens;

  const [deployedCount, setDeployedCount] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isCompleted, setIsCompleted] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [deploymentResult, setDeploymentResult] = useState<MarketDeploymentResult | null>(null);
  const [copiedTx, setCopiedTx] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [consoleLogs, setConsoleLogs] = useState<string[]>([

    `Target: ${tokensToDeploy.length} Token Inventions ready for on-chain market broadcast`,

    setIsDeploying(true);
    setDeployProgress(0);
    setDeployedCount(0);

      const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((currentIndex / total) * 100));
      setDeployProgress(pct);
      setDeployedCount(currentIndex);

      const logLines = chunk.map((tok) => {

              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#141418] hover:bg-[#1D1D24] border border-[#282832] text-white font-mono text-xs cursor-pointer transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {isCompleted ? "Close & View Explorer" : "Cancel"}
            </button>

            {!isCompleted ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                id="btn-execute-market-deployment-modal"
                disabled={isDeploying || tokensToDeploy.length === 0}
                onClick={handleStartMarketDeployment}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-600 via-orange-500 to-amber-500 hover:from-orange-500 hover:to-amber-400 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-orange-950/60 active:scale-95 transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isDeploying ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    <span>Deploying ({deployProgress}%)...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Rocket className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Deploy All to Blockchain Market</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                id="btn-done-market-deployment"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/40 active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Finished (View Inventions)</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  ResponsiveContainer,
  ComposedChart,
  Area,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
  ReferenceLine,
} from "recharts";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  TrendingDown,
  AlertTriangle,
  Layers,
  Scale,
  DollarSign,
  Activity,
  Sliders,
  CheckCircle2,
  Info,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldAlert,
} from "lucide-react";

export interface MarketImpactVisualizerProps {
  selectedTokens: TokenRecord[];
  className?: string;
}

export type AmmModelType = "cpmm" | "concentrated" | "stableswap";
export type PoolDepthTier = "auto" | "shallow" | "standard" | "deep" | "sovereign";

interface SimulationDataPoint {
  percentOfOrder: number;
  orderSizeUsd: number;
  orderSizeTokens: number;
  orderSizeUsdFormatted: string;
  poolPrice: number;
  poolPriceFormatted: string;
  execPrice: number;
  execPriceFormatted: string;
  priceImpact: number;
  priceImpactFormatted: string;
  slippageLossUsd: number;
  slippageLossUsdFormatted: string;
  quoteReceivedUsd: number;
}

export const MarketImpactVisualizer: React.FC<MarketImpactVisualizerProps> = ({
  selectedTokens,
  className = "",
}) => {
  // Active selected token to simulate (or "all" for composite portfolio basket)
  const [targetTokenId, setTargetTokenId] = useState<string>("all");

  // Hypothetical sell fraction of available holdings/supply: 1% to 100%
  const [sellPercentage, setSellPercentage] = useState<number>(15);

  // AMM Model
  const [ammModel, setAmmModel] = useState<AmmModelType>("cpmm");

  // Pool Depth Tier
  const [depthTier, setDepthTier] = useState<PoolDepthTier>("auto");

  // Determine active token or aggregated portfolio
  const activeToken = useMemo(() => {
    if (targetTokenId === "all" || selectedTokens.length === 1) {
      return null;
    }
    return selectedTokens.find((t) => t.id === targetTokenId) || null;
  }, [targetTokenId, selectedTokens]);

  // Derive initial price and baseline metrics
  const baseMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeToken) {
      const price = activeToken.priceUsd && activeToken.priceUsd > 0 ? activeToken.priceUsd : 1.0;
      const rawSupply = parseFloat(activeToken.initialSupply?.replace(/,/g, "") || "1000000");
      const supply = isNaN(rawSupply) || rawSupply <= 0 ? 1000000 : rawSupply;
      const mcap = activeToken.marketCap && activeToken.marketCap > 0 ? activeToken.marketCap : price * supply;
      
      return {
        name: activeToken.name,
        symbol: activeToken.symbol,
        price,
        supply,
        mcap,
        isBasket: false,
        tokenCount: 1,
      };
    }

    // Composite basket of all selected tokens
    let totalValue = 0;
    let totalPrice = 0;
    let totalEstimatedSupply = 0;
    let totalMcap = 0;

    selectedTokens.forEach((t) => {
      const p = t.priceUsd && t.priceUsd > 0 ? t.priceUsd : 1.0;
      const s = parseFloat(t.initialSupply?.replace(/,/g, "") || "1000000");
      const validS = isNaN(s) || s <= 0 ? 1000000 : s;
      const m = t.marketCap && t.marketCap > 0 ? t.marketCap : p * validS;

      totalPrice += p;
      totalEstimatedSupply += validS;
      totalMcap += m;
      totalValue += p * (validS * 0.1); // assume 10% tradable float
    });

    const count = Math.max(1, selectedTokens.length);
    const avgPrice = totalPrice / count;

    return {
      name: `Basket of ${count} Selected Tokens`,
      symbol: `${count} TOKENS`,
      price: avgPrice,
      supply: totalEstimatedSupply,
      mcap: totalMcap,
      isBasket: true,
      tokenCount: count,
    };
  }, [activeToken, selectedTokens]);

  // Calculate modeled pool liquidity depth (TVL)
  const poolTvlUsd = useMemo(() => {
    switch (depthTier) {
      case "shallow":
        return 250_000;
      case "standard":
        return 2_500_000;
      case "deep":
        return 25_000_000;
      case "sovereign":
        return 256_000_000; // 2^8 Million
      case "auto":
      default: {
        // Estimate DEX pool liquidity as ~6% to 10% of market capitalization, clamped to realistic bounds
        const estimatedFromMcap = baseMetrics.mcap * 0.08;
        return Math.max(150_000, Math.min(estimatedFromMcap, 150_000_000));
      }
    }
  }, [depthTier, baseMetrics.mcap]);

  // Order size in USD and token count based on sellPercentage
  // Assume a typical user/whale holding pool represents 2% of total supply or up to 50% of pool size
  const maxSimulatedOrderTokens = useMemo(() => {
    // Model total holding as 5% of total supply
    return baseMetrics.supply * 0.05;
  }, [baseMetrics.supply]);

  const currentOrderTokens = useMemo(() => {
    return maxSimulatedOrderTokens * (sellPercentage / 100);
  }, [maxSimulatedOrderTokens, sellPercentage]);

  const currentOrderUsdInitial = useMemo(() => {
    return currentOrderTokens * baseMetrics.price;
  }, [currentOrderTokens, baseMetrics.price]);

  // Calculate Market Impact Curve Data Points for Recharts
  const { chartData, currentOrderOutcome, safeLimitUsd } = useMemo(() => {
    const P0 = baseMetrics.price;
    const TVL = poolTvlUsd;

    // In a standard AMM (50/50 token and quote), quote reserve Y = TVL / 2
    // Token reserve X = Y / P0 = (TVL / 2) / P0
    const Y0 = TVL / 2;
    const X0 = Y0 / P0;
    const k = X0 * Y0;
    const feeRate = 0.003; // 0.3% standard LP fee

    // Generate 16 simulation intervals along sell size spectrum
    // from 0% up to 2.5x current sell order or pool saturation
    const maxOrderTokens = Math.max(currentOrderTokens * 2.2, X0 * 0.5);
    const steps = 18;
    const points: SimulationDataPoint[] = [];

    let safeLimit: number = currentOrderUsdInitial * 0.5;
    let foundSafeLimit = false;

    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const fraction = i / steps;
      const dxTokens = maxOrderTokens * fraction;
      const orderUsdBaseline = dxTokens * P0;

      if (dxTokens === 0) {
        points.push({
          percentOfOrder: 0,
          orderSizeUsd: 0,
          orderSizeTokens: 0,
          orderSizeUsdFormatted: "$0",
          poolPrice: Number(P0.toFixed(4)),
          poolPriceFormatted: `$${P0.toFixed(4)}`,
          execPrice: Number(P0.toFixed(4)),
          execPriceFormatted: `$${P0.toFixed(4)}`,
          priceImpact: 0,
          priceImpactFormatted: "0.00%",
          slippageLossUsd: 0,
          slippageLossUsdFormatted: "$0",
          quoteReceivedUsd: 0,
        });
        continue;
      }

      let newSpotPrice = P0;
      let quoteOut = 0;
      let impactPercent = 0;

      if (ammModel === "cpmm") {
        // Standard Uniswap v2 xy = k
        const dxEffective = dxTokens * (1 - feeRate);
        const newX = X0 + dxEffective;
        const newY = k / newX;
        quoteOut = Y0 - newY;

        // Spot price after swap = newY / newX
        newSpotPrice = newY / newX;
        impactPercent = Math.max(0, ((P0 - newSpotPrice) / P0) * 100);
      } else if (ammModel === "concentrated") {
        // Uniswap v3 concentrated liquidity within tick boundary
        // Virtual liquidity depth ~ 3.5x higher for small trades, then accelerates
        const virtFactor = 3.5;
        const virtX0 = X0 * virtFactor;
        const virtY0 = Y0 * virtFactor;
        const virtK = virtX0 * virtY0;

        const dxEffective = dxTokens * (1 - feeRate);
        const newVirtX = virtX0 + dxEffective;
        const newVirtY = virtK / newVirtX;
        quoteOut = Math.min(Y0 * 0.95, virtY0 - newVirtY);

        newSpotPrice = Math.max(P0 * 0.05, newVirtY / newVirtX);
        impactPercent = Math.max(0, ((P0 - newSpotPrice) / P0) * 100);
      } else {
        // StableSwap / Hybrid invariant: very low impact for small fraction, steep slope at threshold
        const ratio = dxTokens / X0;
        impactPercent = Math.min(95, Math.pow(ratio * 1.8, 1.6) * 100);
        newSpotPrice = Math.max(P0 * 0.05, P0 * (1 - impactPercent / 100));
        quoteOut = dxTokens * ((P0 + newSpotPrice) / 2) * (1 - feeRate);
      }

      // Clamp price impact to realistic max 98%
      impactPercent = Math.min(98.5, impactPercent);
      const avgExecPrice = dxTokens > 0 ? quoteOut / dxTokens : P0;
      const slippageLoss = Math.max(0, orderUsdBaseline - quoteOut);

      // Track 5% slippage threshold
      if (!foundSafeLimit && impactPercent >= 5.0) {
        safeLimit = orderUsdBaseline;
        foundSafeLimit = true;
      }

      const formattedOrderUsd =
        orderUsdBaseline >= 1e6
          ? `$${(orderUsdBaseline / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`
          : orderUsdBaseline >= 1e3
          ? `$${(orderUsdBaseline / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K`
          : `$${orderUsdBaseline.toFixed(0)}`;

      points.push({
        percentOfOrder: Number(((dxTokens / (currentOrderTokens || 1)) * 100).toFixed(0)),
        orderSizeUsd: Math.round(orderUsdBaseline),
        orderSizeTokens: Math.round(dxTokens),
        orderSizeUsdFormatted: formattedOrderUsd,
        poolPrice: Number(newSpotPrice.toFixed(4)),
        poolPriceFormatted: `$${newSpotPrice.toFixed(4)}`,
        execPrice: Number(avgExecPrice.toFixed(4)),
        execPriceFormatted: `$${avgExecPrice.toFixed(4)}`,
        priceImpact: Number(impactPercent.toFixed(2)),
        priceImpactFormatted: `${impactPercent.toFixed(2)}%`,
        slippageLossUsd: Math.round(slippageLoss),
        slippageLossUsdFormatted: `$${Math.round(slippageLoss).toLocaleString()}`,
        quoteReceivedUsd: Math.round(quoteOut),
      });
    }

    // Exact evaluation for the currently selected sell order size
    const currentDx = currentOrderTokens;
    let currentNewPrice = P0;
    let currentQuoteOut = 0;
    let currentImpact = 0;

    if (currentDx > 0) {
      if (ammModel === "cpmm") {
        const dxEff = currentDx * (1 - feeRate);
        const nX = X0 + dxEff;
        const nY = k / nX;
        currentQuoteOut = Y0 - nY;
        currentNewPrice = nY / nX;
        currentImpact = Math.max(0, ((P0 - currentNewPrice) / P0) * 100);
      } else if (ammModel === "concentrated") {
        const virtFactor = 3.5;
        const vX0 = X0 * virtFactor;
        const vY0 = Y0 * virtFactor;
        const vK = vX0 * vY0;
        const dxEff = currentDx * (1 - feeRate);
        const nVX = vX0 + dxEff;
        const nVY = vK / nVX;
        currentQuoteOut = Math.min(Y0 * 0.95, vY0 - nVY);
        currentNewPrice = Math.max(P0 * 0.05, nVY / nVX);
        currentImpact = Math.max(0, ((P0 - currentNewPrice) / P0) * 100);
      } else {
        const r = currentDx / X0;
        currentImpact = Math.min(95, Math.pow(r * 1.8, 1.6) * 100);
        currentNewPrice = Math.max(P0 * 0.05, P0 * (1 - currentImpact / 100));
        currentQuoteOut = currentDx * ((P0 + currentNewPrice) / 2) * (1 - feeRate);
      }
    }

    currentImpact = Math.min(98.5, currentImpact);
    const currentExecPrice = currentDx > 0 ? currentQuoteOut / currentDx : P0;
    const currentSlippageLoss = Math.max(0, currentOrderUsdInitial - currentQuoteOut);

    return {
      chartData: points,
      currentOrderOutcome: {
        orderUsd: currentOrderUsdInitial,
        orderTokens: currentOrderTokens,
        initialSpotPrice: P0,
        finalSpotPrice: currentNewPrice,
        execPrice: currentExecPrice,
        priceImpactPercent: currentImpact,
        slippageLossUsd: currentSlippageLoss,
        quoteReceivedUsd: currentQuoteOut,
      },
      safeLimitUsd: foundSafeLimit ? safeLimit : currentOrderUsdInitial * 1.5,
    };
  }, [baseMetrics, poolTvlUsd, currentOrderTokens, currentOrderUsdInitial, ammModel]);

  // Determine Impact Severity Level
  const impactSeverity = useMemo(() => {
    const impact = currentOrderOutcome.priceImpactPercent;
    if (impact < 1.5) {
      return {
        level: "Minimal",
        color: "text-emerald-400",
        badgeBg: "bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300",
        desc: "Optimal liquidity conditions. Minimal slippage expected.",
      };
    }
    if (impact < 5.0) {
      return {
        level: "Moderate",
        color: "text-amber-400",
        badgeBg: "bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300",
        desc: "Noticeable slippage. Safe for routine rebalancing.",
      };
    }
    if (impact < 15.0) {
      return {
        level: "High",
        color: "text-orange-400",
        badgeBg: "bg-orange-500/10 border-orange-500/30 text-orange-300",
        desc: "Significant price degradation. Consider splitting order into tranches.",
      };
    }
    return {
      level: "Severe",
      color: "text-rose-400",
      badgeBg: "bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300",
      desc: "Critical liquidity drain! Pool price collapses substantially.",
    };
  }, [currentOrderOutcome.priceImpactPercent]);

  return (
    <div
      id="market-impact-visualizer-container"
      className={`bg-[#0F1117] border border-[#1F2432] rounded-xl p-4 shadow-xl space-y-4 ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Header & Controls Strip */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1E2330]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/30 text-[#F27D26]">
            <TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono">
                <span>Liquidity Pool Market Impact</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-normal">• Recharts AMM Curve</span>
              </h4>
              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold border ${impactSeverity.badgeBg}`}>
                {impactSeverity.level} Impact ({currentOrderOutcome.priceImpactPercent.toFixed(2)}%)
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">
              Simulates automated market maker price slippage and pool depletion for hypothetical sell orders.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Config Toggles */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Target Token Selector (if multiple tokens selected) */}
          {selectedTokens.length > 1 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#161822] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-[#232838]">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Asset:</span>
              <select
                id="select-market-impact-target-token"
                aria-label="Select target asset for market impact simulation"
                value={targetTokenId}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetTokenId(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-transparent text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-white focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="all" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">
                  Composite Basket ({selectedTokens.length} Tokens)
                </option>
                {selectedTokens.map((t) => (
                  <option key={t.id} value={t.id} className="bg-[#161822] text-white">
                    {t.symbol} (${(t.priceUsd || 1).toFixed(2)})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* AMM Invariant Selector */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#161822] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-[#232838]">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">AMM:</span>
            <select
              id="select-market-impact-amm-model"
              aria-label="Select automated market maker curve model"
              value={ammModel}
              onChange={(e) => setAmmModel(e.target.value as AmmModelType)}
              className="bg-transparent text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-cyan-300 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="cpmm" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Uniswap v2 (CPMM xy=k)</option>
              <option value="concentrated" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Uniswap v3 (Concentrated)</option>
              <option value="stableswap" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Curve (StableSwap)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Pool Liquidity Depth Selector */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#161822] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-[#232838]">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] uppercase">Pool Depth:</span>
            <select
              id="select-market-impact-depth-tier"
              aria-label="Select liquidity pool depth tier"
              value={depthTier}
              onChange={(e) => setDepthTier(e.target.value as PoolDepthTier)}
              className="bg-transparent text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-amber-300 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="auto" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Auto (Market Cap %)</option>
              <option value="shallow" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Shallow ($250K TVL)</option>
              <option value="standard" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Standard ($2.5M TVL)</option>
              <option value="deep" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Deep ($25M TVL)</option>
              <option value="sovereign" className="bg-[#161822] text-white">Sovereign 2⁸ ($256M)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Hypothetical Order Size Slider & Preset Chips */}
      <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#141721] border border-[#1E2330] space-y-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[#8E9299] flex items-center gap-1">
              <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
              Hypothetical Sell Order Size:
            </span>
            <span className="text-white font-bold bg-[#1C202C] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#2B3245]">
              {sellPercentage}% of Position
            </span>
            <span className="text-cyan-400 font-semibold">
              ≈ {currentOrderOutcome.orderTokens.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} {baseMetrics.symbol}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[#8E9299]">
              (${Math.round(currentOrderOutcome.orderUsd).toLocaleString()})
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Presets */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            {[1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100].map((pct) => (
              <button
                key={pct}
                type="button"
                id={`btn-impact-preset-${pct}`}
                onClick={() => setSellPercentage(pct)}
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  sellPercentage === pct
                    ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-black font-bold shadow-sm"
                    : "bg-[#1B1E2B] hover:bg-[#252A3D] text-[#A2A7B5] border border-[#272D3D]"
                }`}
              >
                {pct}%
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Interactive Range Input */}
        <input
          id="range-hypothetical-sell-order"
          type="range"
          min="1"
          max="100"
          step="1"
          value={sellPercentage}
          onChange={(e) => setSellPercentage(Number(e.target.value))}
          className="w-full h-1.5 bg-[#232838] rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-[#F27D26]"
          aria-label="Hypothetical sell order percentage"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Recharts Graphical Visualization */}
      <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0C10] border border-[#1A1D27] space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-white font-semibold">
            <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
            Spot Price ($) vs. Price Impact (%) Across Sell Volume
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px]">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 inline-block" />
              <span className="text-[#A2A7B5]">Pool Spot Price ($)</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 inline-block" />
              <span className="text-[#A2A7B5]">Price Impact (%)</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-400">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-0.5 bg-amber-400 inline-block" />
              <span>5% Safe Threshold</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Chart Canvas */}
        <div className="w-full h-[270px]">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <ComposedChart
              data={chartData}
              margin={{ top: 12, right: 16, left: 4, bottom: 4 }}
            >
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="impactGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#F43F5E" stopOpacity={0.45} />
                  <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#F59E0B" stopOpacity={0.2} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.02} />
                </linearGradient>
                <linearGradient id="priceGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#06B6D4" stopOpacity={0.3} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#06B6D4" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>

              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1C212E" vertical={false} />

              {/* X-Axis: Sell Order Size */}
              <XAxis
                dataKey="orderSizeUsdFormatted"
                stroke="#5A6173"
                tick={{ fill: "#8E9299", fontSize: 10, fontFamily: "monospace" }}
                tickLine={{ stroke: "#2C3345" }}
```

```tsx
  const [newChain, setNewChain] = useState<ChainType>("ethereum");
```

```tsx
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Permit.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Burnable.sol";

/**

 * @notice EVM Uncapped Continuous Minting Invention (Solidity 0.8.24)
 * 
 * PROTOCOL LIMITS & ECONOMIC THRESHOLDS:
 * 1. Technical Limit: EVM uint256 max is 2^256 - 1 (~1.15792e77 raw units).
 *    With ${decimals} decimals, displayable limit is ~1.15792e59 tokens.
 * 2. Design Limit: This contract OMITS a hardcoded supply cap. Authorized minters
 *    can continually mint tokens up to type(uint256).max.
 * 3. Market Pricing: Configured target order book price: $${numericPrice.toLocaleString()} / token.
 */
contract UncappedERC20 is ERC20, ERC20Permit, ERC20Burnable, AccessControl {
    bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = keccak256("MINTER_ROLE");
    uint8 private immutable _customDecimals;

    // Technical 256-bit protocol limit
    uint256 public constant PROTOCOL_THEORETICAL_MAX = type(uint256).max;

    event ContinuousMint(address indexed minter, address indexed recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 newTotalSupply);
    event BatchContinuousMint(address indexed minter, uint256 totalRecipients, uint256 totalAmount);

    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_) 
        ERC20(name_, symbol_) 
        ERC20Permit(name_) 
    {
        _customDecimals = ${decimals};
        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
    }

    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {
        return _customDecimals;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Continually mints up to the 256-bit protocol ceiling (type(uint256).max)
     * @dev Solidity 0.8+ checked arithmetic naturally protects against integer overflow.
     */
    function continuousMint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) {
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= PROTOCOL_THEORETICAL_MAX, "EVM uint256 overflow limit reached");
        _mint(to, amount);
        emit ContinuousMint(msg.sender, to, amount, totalSupply());
    }

    /**
     * @notice Batch continuous distribution for high-volume liquidity provisioning
     */
    function batchContinuousMint(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) 
        external 
        onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) 
    {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "Length mismatch");
        uint256 totalBatch = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            totalBatch += amounts[i];
            _mint(recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
        emit BatchContinuousMint(msg.sender, recipients.length, totalBatch);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Returns remaining mint capacity under EVM 256-bit ceiling
     */
    function remainingMintCapacity() external view returns (uint256) {
        return PROTOCOL_THEORETICAL_MAX - totalSupply();
    }
}`;
```

```tsx
  const eliteFee = tradeVolumeUsd * eliteRate;
  const eliteSavings = standardFee - eliteFee;

  const vipFee = tradeVolumeUsd * vipRate;
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { AlertOctagon, ShieldAlert, Zap, X } from "lucide-react";
import {
  subscribeToMemoryHealth,
  startAutomatedHealthMonitoring,
  MemoryHealthReport,
  selfHealEncryptedVault,
} from "../utils/memoryHealthDiagnostics";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";

interface MemoryHealthAlertBannerProps {
  tokens: TokenRecord[];
  onOpenDiagnosticModal: () => void;
}

export const MemoryHealthAlertBanner: React.FC<MemoryHealthAlertBannerProps> = ({
  tokens,
  onOpenDiagnosticModal,
}) => {
  const [report, setReport] = useState<MemoryHealthReport | null>(null);
  const [isDismissed, setIsDismissed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isHealing, setIsHealing] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    startAutomatedHealthMonitoring(20);

    const unsub = subscribeToMemoryHealth((rep) => {
      setReport(rep);
      if (rep.overallStatus === "corrupted") {
        setIsDismissed(false);
      }
    });

    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  if (!report || report.overallStatus !== "corrupted" || isDismissed) {
    return null;
  }

  const handleSelfHealQuick = async () => {
    setIsHealing(true);
    try {
      await selfHealEncryptedVault(tokens);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Quick self heal error:", e);
    } finally {
      setIsHealing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      id="memory-health-alert-banner"
      className="bg-gradient-to-r from-red-950 via-[#2a0b12] to-red-950 border-y-2 border-red-500/80 px-4 py-3 text-white shadow-2xl animate-fade-in relative z-40"
    >
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/40 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 animate-pulse">
            <AlertOctagon className="w-5 h-5 text-red-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-red-200 flex items-center gap-2 uppercase tracking-wide">
              <span>Memory Health Alert: Encrypted Blob Decryption Failure Detected</span>
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-red-500/30 text-red-300">
                {report.corruptedBlobsCount} corrupted
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-red-300/80 mt-0.5">
              One or more local storage encrypted memory payloads failed AES-GCM verification. Checksum tag or ciphertext tampering detected.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={handleSelfHealQuick}
            disabled={isHealing}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-400 text-black font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
            <span>{isHealing ? "Healing..." : `Self-Heal Vault (${tokens.length} Tokens)`}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={onOpenDiagnosticModal}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#16161A] hover:bg-[#1F1F23] border border-red-500/40 text-red-300 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Inspect Diagnostics</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setIsDismissed(true)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-red-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-red-500/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            title="Dismiss Alert"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
  onHealed?: () => void;
}

  const [isRunningCheck, setIsRunningCheck] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [autoMonitorActive, setAutoMonitorActive] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

    if (!isOpen) return;

    runHealthCheck();

    const unsub = subscribeToMemoryHealth((newReport) => {
      setReport(newReport);

      startAutomatedHealthMonitoring(15);
    }

    return () => unsub();
  }, [isOpen]);

    setIsRunningCheck(true);
    try {
      const rep = await runCompleteMemoryHealthCheck(passphrase);
      setReport(rep);
      if (rep.overallStatus === "corrupted") {
        setNotification("⚠ Decryption Integrity Alert: One or more encrypted blobs failed verification!");
      } else {
        setNotification("✓ Diagnostic completed: Memory health checked across all storage keys.");
      }
      setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 4000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setNotification(`Diagnostic error: ${err?.message || "Execution failure"}`);
      setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 4000);
    } finally {
      setIsRunningCheck(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSelfHeal = async () => {
    setIsHealing(true);
    try {
      const healedReport = await selfHealEncryptedVault(tokens, passphrase);
      setReport(healedReport);
      setNotification(`✓ Self-Healing Complete: Re-encrypted ${tokens.length} working tokens with verified AES-GCM (256-bit)!`);
      if (onHealed) onHealed();
      setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 4500);
```

```tsx
async function addCustomTokenToMetaMask(params: {
  address: string;
  symbol: string;
  decimals: number;
  image?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && (window as any).ethereum) {
    try {
      const wasAdded = await (window as any).ethereum.request({
        method: "wallet_watchAsset",
        params: {
          type: "ERC20",
          options: {
            address: params.address,
            symbol: params.symbol,
            decimals: params.decimals,
            image: params.image,
          },
        },
      });
      return { success: Boolean(wasAdded) };
    } catch (error: any) {
      return { success: false, error: error?.message || "Failed to add token" };
    }
  }
  return { success: false, error: "MetaMask not detected" };
}

    if (success) {
      setSyncFeedback(`Token ${token.symbol} added to MetaMask assets!`);
      setTimeout(() => setSyncFeedback(null), 4000);
    }
  };

  // Block explorer url resolver
  const getExplorerAccountUrl = (addr: string) => {
    if (chainId === "0x2105") return `https://basescan.org/address/${addr}`;
    if (chainId === "0xa4b1") return `https://arbiscan.io/address/${addr}`;
    if (chainId === "0x89") return `https://polygonscan.com/address/${addr}`;
    if (chainId === "0xaa36a7") return `https://sepolia.etherscan.io/address/${addr}`;
    return `https://etherscan.io/address/${addr}`;
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (activeDeployerAddress) {
      QRCode.toDataURL(`ethereum:${MAO_MAO_CONTRACT_ADDRESS}@1/transfer?address=${activeDeployerAddress}`, {
        width: 160,
        margin: 1,
      }).then((url) => setMaoMaoQrUrl(url)).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [activeDeployerAddress]);

  const handleSendMaoMao = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setMaoMaoTransferResult(null);
    const num = parseFloat(maoMaoAmount);
    if (isNaN(num) || num <= 0) {
      setMaoMaoTransferResult("Error: Enter a valid Mao-Mao amount");
      return;
    }
    if (!ethers.isAddress(maoMaoRecipient.trim())) {
      setMaoMaoTransferResult("Error: Invalid recipient address (EIP-55)");
      return;
    }
    setMaoMaoSending(true);
    try {
      const res = await transferMaoMao({
        from: activeDeployerAddress,
        to: maoMaoRecipient.trim(),
        amount: num,
      });
      if (res.success) {
        setMaoMaoTransferResult(`✓ Sent ${num.toLocaleString()} $MAOMAO (Tx: ${res.txHash?.slice(0, 14)}...)`);
        setMaoMaoBalanceState(getMaoMaoBalance(activeDeployerAddress));
        setMaoMaoAmount("");
        setMaoMaoRecipient("");
      } else {
        setMaoMaoTransferResult(`Error: ${res.error || "Failed to send"}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMaoMaoTransferResult(`Error: ${err?.message || "Transfer error"}`);
    } finally {
      setMaoMaoSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClaimMaoMaoDeposit = () => {
    const res = receiveMaoMaoDeposit({
      to: activeDeployerAddress,
      amount: 25000,
      source: "0x70Ac9Bb89d5C3d4a47D5cd11B108Fea9ad4E94f0 (Mao-Mao Vault)",
    });
    setMaoMaoBalanceState(res.newBalance);
    setMaoMaoTransferResult(`✓ Received +25,000 $MAOMAO deposit into your wallet! (Tx: ${res.txHash.slice(0, 14)}...)`);
    setTimeout(() => setMaoMaoTransferResult(null), 5000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-[#1F1F23] bg-[#0A0A0C] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(242,125,38,0.25)]">
              {/* MetaMask Fox stylized representation */}
              <span className="text-xl select-none">🦊</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  MetaMask Deployer Synchronization
                </h2>
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono border flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                  isConnected
                    ? "bg-green-500/10 border-green-500/30 text-green-400"
                    : "bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-400"
                }`}>
                  <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${isConnected ? "bg-green-400 animate-pulse" : "bg-amber-400"}`} />
                  {isConnected ? "MetaMask Synced" : "Ready to Connect"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                Synchronize your MetaMask account as the authoritative contract deployer address across all tokens & scripts.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[#16161A] hover:bg-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close modal"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Global Alert / Feedback Banner */}
        {syncFeedback && (
          <div className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-green-500/15 border-b border-green-500/30 flex items-center gap-2 text-green-300 text-xs font-mono animate-fadeIn">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-green-400 flex-shrink-0" />
            <span>{syncFeedback}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-red-500/15 border-b border-red-500/30 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-red-300 text-xs font-mono animate-fadeIn">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 flex-shrink-0" />
              <span>{error}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={clearError}
              className="text-[10px] uppercase text-red-400 hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              Dismiss
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div className="px-6 border-b border-[#1F1F23] bg-[#0E0E12] flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("sync")}
            className={`pb-2.5 px-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "sync"
                ? "border-[#F27D26] text-white font-bold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Wallet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
            <span>Wallet &amp; Deployer Sync</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("security_guard")}
            className={`pb-2.5 px-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "security_guard"
                ? "border-emerald-400 text-emerald-300 font-bold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Security Shield ({securityAudit.securityScore}%)</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("attestation")}
            className={`pb-2.5 px-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "attestation"
                ? "border-purple-400 text-purple-300 font-bold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Key className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />

          </button>
          <button
            type="button"

              activeTab === "watch_assets"

                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}

            <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
            <span>Add Tokens to MetaMask</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"

            className={`pb-2.5 px-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "chains"

                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Switch Networks</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("mao_mao")}
            className={`pb-2.5 px-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "mao_mao"
                ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-300 font-bold"
                : "border-transparent text-amber-400/70 hover:text-amber-300"
            }`}
          >
            <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
            <span>🦊 Mao-Mao Transfers</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 flex-1 text-xs">
          {activeTab === "sync" && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              {/* Primary Connection State Card */}
              <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#16161A] border border-[#26262E] flex items-center justify-center text-2xl">
                      🦊
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white">MetaMask Account</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#16161A] border border-[#2A2A34] text-gray-300">

                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-0.5">

                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Connect / Disconnect Buttons */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {isConnected ? (

                        <button

                          title="Refresh live ETH balance"
                        >
                          <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
                          <span>Refresh</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={secureDisconnect}

                          <Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-red-400" />

                    ) : (

                        <button

                              <span>🦊</span>
                              <span>Enable MetaMask (Secured)</span>

                      </div>

                  </div>

                {/* Security Status Ribbon */}
                <div

                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <ShieldCheck className={`w-4 h-4 ${securityAudit.isSecured ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-amber-400"}`} />
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-white font-bold text-xs">
                        MetaMask Extension Security Guard:{" "}
                        <span className={securityAudit.isSecured ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-amber-400"}>
                          {securityAudit.status} ({securityAudit.securityScore}/100)
                        </span>
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                        EIP-6963 Anti-Spoofing · EIP-55 Checksum · Anti-Poisoning · Authorized Network Collar
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-amber-400 underline font-mono">
                    View 6-Point Audit →
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Account Details when Connected */}
                {isConnected && account ? (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-[#1F1F23]">
                    <div className="sm:col-span-2 bg-[#121216] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[#8E9299] text-[11px]">
                        <span>Connected Address (EIP-55):</span>
                        <a

                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="text-[#F27D26] hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[10px]"

                          <span>Explorer</span>
                          <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0A0A0C] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded font-mono text-xs text-white break-all">
                        <span className="text-[#00F0FF]">{account}</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(account, "account_addr")}

                        >

                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-[#121216] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1 flex flex-col justify-center">
                      <span className="text-[#8E9299] text-[11px]">Live Native Balance:</span>
                      <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1 font-mono">
                        <span className="text-base font-bold text-white">{balanceEth || "0.0000"}</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-[#F27D26]">ETH</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-[#121216] rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299] text-xs">
                    {isInstalled ? (
                      <p>MetaMask extension was detected in your browser! Click <strong>Connect MetaMask</strong> above to link your wallet address to the foundry.</p>
                    ) : (

                        <p className="text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">

                        <p className="text-[11px]">

                          >
                            metamask.io/download
                            <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5 inline" />
                          </a>

              </div>

              {/* Deployer Synchronization Action Card */}

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0A0A0C] px-3 py-2 rounded font-mono text-xs text-white break-all">

                      {copiedKey === "active_deployer" ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}

                {/* Batch Synchronization Triggers */}
                <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#E0E0E0]">Apply Deployer to Tokens in Foundry:</div>

                    <button

                    >
                      <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#F27D26] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />

                      </div>
                    </button>

                    <button

                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                      <div className="text-left">

                      </div>

                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Manual Address Input Fallback */}
              <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">EIP-55 Checksummed</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">
                  If using MetaMask on a mobile phone or hardware wallet (Ledger / Trezor) disconnected from this browser, paste your public address, or select the Foundry Sovereign Deployer:
                </p>

                {/* Quick Preset for Foundry Sovereign Deployer */}
                <div className="bg-[#121216] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#23232C] flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

                      <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">

                      </span>
                    </div>
```
