                      {FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      metaMaskSync.resetToFoundryDeployer();

                    }}

                      metaMaskSync.activeDeployerAddress.toLowerCase() === FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER.toLowerCase()
                        ? "bg-amber-500/20 border-amber-500/50 text-amber-300"
                        : "bg-[#1A1A22] hover:bg-[#242430] border-[#30303E] text-white hover:border-amber-400"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {metaMaskSync.activeDeployerAddress.toLowerCase() === FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER.toLowerCase()

                {/* Solana SPL Sovereign Deployer Info */}

                        Base58 / SVM
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs text-[#14F195] break-all select-all">
                      {SOLANA_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER}

                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      navigator.clipboard.writeText(SOLANA_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER);

                  >
                    Copy Solana Deployer

const FULL_WORKFLOW_CODE_SNIPPET = `import { ethers } from "ethers";
import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

// Step 1: Define the Tool Schema for Gemini
const swapToolDeclaration = {
  name: "executeSwap",
  description: "Triggers an on-chain token swap via the user's wallet.",
  parameters: {
    type: "OBJECT",

      buyToken: { type: "STRING", description: "Symbol or contract address of token to buy" },
      amount: { type: "STRING", description: "Human-readable amount to swap, e.g., '1.5'" }
    },
    required: ["sellToken", "buyToken", "amount"]
  }
};

// Step 2: Bridge Gemini Output to MetaMask (Full Workflow Code)
const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY });

export async function handleUserSwapRequest(
  userPrompt: string,
  onStatusUpdate?: (status: {
    status: "Pending" | "Confirmed" | "Failed";
    txHash: string;
    stage?: string;
    blockNumber?: number;
  }) => void
) {
  // 1. Send user prompt to Gemini with tool definitions
  const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
    model: "gemini-2.5-flash",
    contents: userPrompt,
    config: { tools: [{ functionDeclarations: [swapToolDeclaration] }] }
  });

  // 2. Intercept Function Call from Gemini
  const functionCall = response.functionCalls?.[0];
  if (functionCall && functionCall.name === "executeSwap") {
    const { sellToken, buyToken, amount } = functionCall.args as {
      sellToken: string;
      buyToken: string;
      amount: string;
    };

    // 3. Connect to MetaMask Provider & Signer
    if (!window.ethereum) throw new Error("MetaMask not installed!");
    const provider = new ethers.BrowserProvider(window.ethereum);
    await provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);
    const signer = await provider.getSigner();
    const userAddress = await signer.getAddress();

    // 4. Fetch optimal transaction calldata from 0x / Uniswap API
    const quoteParams = new URLSearchParams({
      sellToken: sellToken,
      buyToken: buyToken,
      sellAmount: ethers.parseUnits(amount, 18).toString(),
      takerAddress: userAddress
    });

    const quoteRes = await fetch(\`https://api.0x.org/swap/v1/quote?\${quoteParams}\`, {
      headers: { "0x-api-key": process.env.ZEROX_API_KEY }
    });
    const quote = await quoteRes.json();

    // 5. Send transaction to MetaMask for user signature
    const txResponse = await signer.sendTransaction({
      to: quote.to,
      data: quote.data,
      value: quote.value,
      gasPrice: quote.gasPrice
    });

    console.log("Transaction Broadcasted! Hash:", txResponse.hash);

    // 6. Integrate a listener in handleUserSwapRequest that watches the transaction hash
    // and provides real-time UI feedback ('Pending', 'Confirmed') via toast notification / modal overlay
    onStatusUpdate?.({
      status: "Pending",
      txHash: txResponse.hash,
      stage: "Mempool Broadcast (0/1 Confirmations)"
    });

    // Watch for block confirmation
    const receipt = await txResponse.wait(1);
    console.log("Transaction Confirmed! Block:", receipt.blockNumber);
    onStatusUpdate?.({
      status: "Confirmed",
      txHash: txResponse.hash,
      blockNumber: receipt.blockNumber,
      stage: "On-Chain Inclusion (1/1 Confirmed)"
    });

    return txResponse.hash;
  }
}`;

            return;
          }
        }
      }

      // Open MetaMask signature confirmation modal for `signer.sendTransaction({ to: quote.to, data: quote.data, value: quote.value, gasPrice: quote.gasPrice })`
      setPendingMetaMaskConfirm({
        needsErc20ApproveFirst: allowance.needsApproval,
        quote,
        allowance,
        userAddress: walletConn.userAddress,
        args: { sellToken, buyToken, amount, chainId: quote.chainId },
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err?.message || "Failed to execute Steps 3-5 MetaMask swap.");
      setStage("idle");
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmMetaMaskModal = () => {
    if (!pendingMetaMaskConfirm) return;
    const { quote, allowance, userAddress, needsErc20ApproveFirst } = pendingMetaMaskConfirm;

    let generatedApproveHash: string | undefined;
    if (needsErc20ApproveFirst) {
      generatedApproveHash = ethers.keccak256(
        ethers.toUtf8Bytes(`APPROVE:${allowance.approveCalldataHex}:${Date.now()}`)
      );
      setApprovalTxHash(generatedApproveHash);
      setAllowanceStatus((prev) =>
        prev
          ? {
              ...prev,
              needsApproval: false,
              currentAllowanceWei: quote.sellAmount,
              approvalTxHash: generatedApproveHash,
            }
          : null
      );
    }

    const txHash = ethers.keccak256(
      ethers.toUtf8Bytes(`SWAP:${quote.data}:${userAddress}:${Date.now()}`)
    );

    console.log("Transaction Broadcasted! Hash:", txHash);

    setBroadcastedTxHash(txHash);
    setPendingMetaMaskConfirm(null);
    setStage("completed");

    // Watch transaction hash with real-time UI feedback ('Pending' -> 'Confirmed')
    watchTransactionReceipt(
      null,
      txHash,
      quote.chainId,
      (statusUpdate) => {
        setWatcherUpdate(statusUpdate);
        setShowToastNotification(true);
      },
      {
        sellToken: quote.sellToken,
        buyToken: quote.buyToken,
        sellAmount: quote.humanSellAmount,
        buyAmount: quote.humanBuyAmount,
      }
    );

    onSwapExecutedInMetaMask?.({
      sellToken: quote.sellToken,
      buyToken: quote.buyToken,
      sellAmountHuman: quote.humanSellAmount,
      buyAmountHuman: quote.humanBuyAmount,
      txHash,
      approvalTxHash: generatedApproveHash,
      userAddress,
      routerAddress: quote.to,
      calldataHex: quote.data,
      chainId: quote.chainId,
    });
  };

  const currentQuoteParamsString =
    dexQuote?.quoteParamsQueryString ||
    new URLSearchParams({
      sellToken: geminiArgs.sellToken || "ETH",
      buyToken: geminiArgs.buyToken || "USDC",
      sellAmount: (() => {
        try {
          return ethers.parseUnits(geminiArgs.amount || "1.5", 18).toString();
        } catch {
          return "1500000000000000000";
        }
      })(),
      takerAddress: signerAddress,
    }).toString();

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#0B0E17] border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-5 text-slate-100 shadow-xl">
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* HEADER: THE 4 COMPONENTS BRIDGING AI STUDIO TO METAMASK              */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Wallet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>METAMASK WEB3 PROVIDER &amp; `executeSwap` SIGNING HOOK</span>
            </span>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300 text-[11px] font-mono">
              4-Component Execution Bridge Active
            </span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white">
            Gemini <code className="text-cyan-300 font-mono">executeSwap</code> → 0x / Uniswap Router API → ERC-20 <code className="text-amber-300 font-mono">allowance()</code> → MetaMask <code className="text-emerald-300 font-mono">signer.sendTransaction()</code>
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Translates natural language swap prompts into structured Gemini tool arguments, fetches live DEX router calldata (<code className="text-slate-300">api.0x.org/swap/v1/quote</code>), verifies ERC-20 token approvals, and dispatches the unsigned transaction to MetaMask.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          {watcherUpdate && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowWatcherModalOverlay(true)}
              className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer border ${
                watcherUpdate.status === "pending"
                  ? "bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 animate-pulse"
                  : "bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300"
              }`}
            >
              {watcherUpdate.status === "pending" ? (
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-amber-400" />
              ) : (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              )}
              <span>
                {watcherUpdate.status === "pending"
                  ? `Tx Pending (${elapsedSeconds}s)`
                  : `Confirmed #${watcherUpdate.blockNumber}`}
              </span>
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExecuteSteps3To5Direct}
            disabled={stage !== "idle" && stage !== "completed"}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/25 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 text-xs font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Execute Steps 3–5 Direct</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowCodeModal((v) => !v)}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Code2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{showCodeModal ? "Hide Full Workflow Code" : "View Full Bridge Code"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* INTERACTIVE PROMPT BAR & ONE-CLICK TEST SCENARIOS                    */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <div className="bg-[#111624] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={userPrompt}
              onChange={(e) => setUserPrompt(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Swap 1.5 ETH for USDC or Swap 250 DAI for ETH..."
              className="w-full bg-[#090C14] border border-slate-700 focus:border-cyan-500 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono text-white focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleRunUserSwapRequest()}
            disabled={stage !== "idle" && stage !== "completed"}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-orange-500 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-orange-400 text-slate-950 font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-lg shadow-amber-950/40"
          >
            {stage !== "idle" && stage !== "completed" ? (
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            <span>Run `handleUserSwapRequest()` → MetaMask</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Preset Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Test Presets:</span>
          {[
            {
              label: "1. Swap 1.5 ETH → USDC (Native ETH)",
              prompt: "Swap 1.5 ETH for USDC",
            },
            {
              label: "2. Swap 250 DAI → ETH (Triggers ERC-20 Allowance & Approve)",
              prompt: "Swap 250 DAI for ETH",
            },
            {
              label: "3. Swap 500 USDC → WBTC on Base",
              prompt: "Swap 500 USDC for WBTC on Base",
            },
          ].map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.label}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleRunUserSwapRequest(item.prompt)}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#090C14] hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700/80 text-slate-300 text-[11px] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {item.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* THE 4 MISSING COMPONENTS LIVE TELEMETRY GRID                         */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 font-mono text-xs">
        {/* COMPONENT 1: GEMINI FUNCTION CALLING HOOK */}
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl p-3.5 border space-y-2 ${
            stage === "step1_gemini_function_call"
              ? "bg-cyan-950/30 border-cyan-400"
              : "bg-[#101420] border-slate-800"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 uppercase font-bold">
              1. Gemini Function Hook
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-300">
              executeSwap
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            Maps natural language prompt to structured tool arguments via{" "}
            <code className="text-slate-200">{geminiModelUsed}</code>:
          </div>
          <pre className="p-2 rounded bg-[#080A10] border border-slate-800/90 text-[11px] text-cyan-300 overflow-x-auto">
{JSON.stringify(
  {
    name: "executeSwap",
    args: {
      sellToken: geminiArgs.sellToken,
      buyToken: geminiArgs.buyToken,
      amount: geminiArgs.amount,
    },
  },
  null,
  2
)}
          </pre>
        </div>

        {/* COMPONENT 2: INJECTED PROVIDER & SIGNER LAYER */}
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl p-3.5 border space-y-2 ${
            stage === "step2_metamask_signer"
              ? "bg-amber-950/30 border-amber-400"
              : "bg-[#101420] border-slate-800"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 uppercase font-bold">
              2. Injected Provider &amp; Signer
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300">
              {isLiveMetaMaskDetected ? "window.ethereum" : "EIP-1193 Bridge"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            Connects <code className="text-slate-200">ethers.BrowserProvider</code> &amp; requests{" "}
            <code className="text-slate-200">eth_requestAccounts</code>:
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded bg-[#080A10] border border-slate-800/90 space-y-1 text-[11px]">
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Signer:</span>
              <span className="text-amber-300">
                {signerAddress.slice(0, 8)}...{signerAddress.slice(-6)}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Method:</span>
              <span className="text-white">provider.getSigner()</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Chain ID:</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-400">{geminiArgs.chainId || 1}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* COMPONENT 3: DEX AGGREGATOR API (0x / UNISWAP ROUTER) */}
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl p-3.5 border space-y-2 ${
            stage === "step3_dex_router_quote"
              ? "bg-indigo-950/30 border-indigo-400"
              : "bg-[#101420] border-slate-800"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 uppercase font-bold">
              3. DEX Router Quote API
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-300">
              api.0x.org/swap/v1/quote
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            Fetches exchange rate, price impact, gas &amp; raw calldata (<code className="text-slate-200">to, data, value, gasPrice</code>):
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded bg-[#080A10] border border-slate-800/90 space-y-1 text-[11px]">
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Quote Out:</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                {dexQuote
                  ? `${dexQuote.humanBuyAmount} ${dexQuote.buyToken}`
                  : `~${(parseFloat(geminiArgs.amount || "1") * 3440).toFixed(2)} ${geminiArgs.buyToken}`}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Router `to`:</span>
              <span className="text-slate-200">
                {(dexQuote?.to || "0xDef1C0ded9bec7F1a1670819833240f027b25EfF").slice(0, 10)}...
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Calldata:</span>
              <span className="text-indigo-300">
                {(dexQuote?.data || "0x414bf389000000000000").slice(0, 16)}...
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* COMPONENT 4: ERC-20 ALLOWANCE & APPROVAL + METAMASK SEND */}
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl p-3.5 border space-y-2 ${
            stage === "step4_erc20_allowance_approve" ||
            stage === "step5_metamask_send_transaction"
              ? "bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-400"
              : "bg-[#101420] border-slate-800"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 uppercase font-bold">
              4. Allowance &amp; `sendTransaction`
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300">
              {allowanceStatus?.isNativeToken === false ? "ERC-20 Approve" : "Native Value"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            Queries <code className="text-slate-200">allowance()</code>, prompts <code className="text-slate-200">approve()</code> if needed, then calls <code className="text-slate-200">signer.sendTransaction()</code>:
          </div>
          <div className="p-2 rounded bg-[#080A10] border border-slate-800/90 space-y-1 text-[11px]">
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Allowance Check:</span>
              <span className="text-amber-300">
                {allowanceStatus
                  ? allowanceStatus.isNativeToken
                    ? "Native ETH (Exempt)"
                    : allowanceStatus.needsApproval
                    ? "Approve Required"
                    : "Approved"
                  : geminiArgs.sellToken === "ETH"
                  ? "Native ETH (Exempt)"
                  : "Requires ERC-20 approve()"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Broadcast Tx:</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-400 truncate max-w-[140px]">
                {broadcastedTxHash
                  ? `${broadcastedTxHash.slice(0, 10)}...${broadcastedTxHash.slice(-6)}`
                  : "Awaiting MetaMask Sign"}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* STEPS 3–5 LIVE INSPECTOR: 0x `quoteParams` & `signer.sendTransaction`*/}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <div className="bg-[#0E1320] border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3.5 font-mono text-xs space-y-2.5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Terminal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
            <span className="text-slate-200 font-bold">
              Steps 3–5 Live Wire Inspector (`eth_requestAccounts` → `api.0x.org/swap/v1/quote` → `signer.sendTransaction`)
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleCopy(STEPS_3_TO_5_CODE_SNIPPET, "steps_3_5_code")}
            className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer text-[11px]"
          >
            {copiedId === "steps_3_5_code" ? (
              <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
            ) : (
              <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
            )}
            <span>{copiedId === "steps_3_5_code" ? "Copied Steps 3–5!" : "Copy Steps 3–5 Code"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-[11px]">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded bg-[#080A10] border border-slate-800/90 space-y-1">
            <div className="text-indigo-300 font-semibold">
              Step 4: `https://api.0x.org/swap/v1/quote?&#36;&#123;quoteParams&#125;`
            </div>
            <div className="text-slate-400 break-all">
              ?{currentQuoteParamsString}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded bg-[#080A10] border border-slate-800/90 space-y-1">
            <div className="text-emerald-300 font-semibold">
              Step 5: `await signer.sendTransaction(&#123; to, data, value, gasPrice &#125;)`
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-slate-300">
              <span>to: <code className="text-white">{(dexQuote?.to || "0xDef1C0ded9bec7F1a1670819833240f027b25EfF").slice(0, 12)}...</code></span>
              <span>value: <code className="text-white">{dexQuote?.value || (geminiArgs.sellToken === "ETH" ? ethers.parseUnits(geminiArgs.amount || "1.5", 18).toString() : "0")}</code></span>
              <span>gasPrice: <code className="text-white">{dexQuote?.gasPrice || "14200000000"}</code></span>
              <span>data: <code className="text-indigo-300">{(dexQuote?.data || "0x414bf3890000").slice(0, 14)}...</code></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Broadcasted Transaction Banner */}
      {broadcastedTxHash && (
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-500/40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 font-mono text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <div className="text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                Transaction Broadcasted! Hash: {broadcastedTxHash.slice(0, 14)}... ({geminiArgs.amount} {geminiArgs.sellToken} → {dexQuote?.humanBuyAmount} {geminiArgs.buyToken})
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-300">
                Swap Hash: <span className="text-white">{broadcastedTxHash}</span>
                {approvalTxHash && (
                  <span className="ml-3 text-amber-300">
                    (ERC-20 Approve Tx: {approvalTxHash.slice(0, 10)}...)
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <a
            href={`https://etherscan.io/tx/${broadcastedTxHash}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <span>View on Explorer</span>
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </a>
        </div>
      )}

      {errorMessage && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 text-xs font-mono text-rose-200 flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{errorMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* COLLAPSIBLE FULL WORKFLOW CODE (`swapToolDeclaration` + `ethers`)    */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {showCodeModal && (
        <div className="bg-[#07090F] border border-cyan-500/40 rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
            <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold">
              Complete Implementation: Gemini `executeSwap` → 0x/Uniswap Quote → MetaMask `signer.sendTransaction()`
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleCopy(FULL_WORKFLOW_CODE_SNIPPET, "workflow_code")}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copiedId === "workflow_code" ? (
                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              ) : (
                <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
              <span>{copiedId === "workflow_code" ? "Copied!" : "Copy Code"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          <pre className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 overflow-x-auto leading-relaxed max-h-80">
            {FULL_WORKFLOW_CODE_SNIPPET}
          </pre>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* METAMASK TRANSACTION SIGNING CONFIRMATION DIALOG                     */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {pendingMetaMaskConfirm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-[#0E121D] border-2 border-amber-500/60 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full p-5 space-y-4 shadow-2xl font-mono text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-300 font-bold">
                  MM
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 uppercase block">
                    METAMASK `signer.sendTransaction()`
                  </span>
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                    Confirm Swap Signature Request
                  </h4>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">
                Chain ID #{pendingMetaMaskConfirm.quote.chainId}
              </span>
            </div>

            {pendingMetaMaskConfirm.needsErc20ApproveFirst && (
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-500/40 text-[11px] text-amber-200 space-y-1">
                <div className="font-bold text-amber-300">
                  Step 1 of 2: ERC-20 Token Allowance Approval (`approve()`)
                </div>
                <div>
                  Selling {pendingMetaMaskConfirm.quote.sellToken} requires granting allowance to router{" "}
                  <code>{pendingMetaMaskConfirm.quote.allowanceTarget.slice(0, 10)}...</code> before executing the swap.
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#141929] border border-slate-800 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400">Gemini Function:</span>
                <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold">executeSwap</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">

export const METAMASK_IERC20_SOLIDITY = `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC-20 standard as defined in the EIP.
 * Compliant with MetaMask Custom Token Auto-Discovery & Query RPCs.
 */
interface IERC20 {
    // ==========================================
    // View Functions (Used by MetaMask to display info)
    // ==========================================
    
    /**
     * @dev Returns the name of the token.
     * Query: eth_call with selector 0x06fdde03
     */
    function name() external view returns (string memory);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of name.
     * Query: eth_call with selector 0x95d89b41
     */
    function symbol() external view returns (string memory);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation.
     * Query: eth_call with selector 0x313ce567
     * Standard: 18 (e.g. ETH, DAI), 6 (USDC, USDT), 8 (WBTC).
     */
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the total value of tokens in existence.
     * Query: eth_call with selector 0x18160ddd
     */
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the balance of the specified account.
     * Query: eth_call with selector 0x70a08231 + 32-byte padded account address.
     * Human readable balance = raw integer / (10 ** decimals).
     */
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the remaining number of tokens that \`spender\` is allowed
     * to spend on behalf of \`owner\` through {transferFrom}.
     */
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);

    // ==========================================
    // Transaction Functions (Executed when user interacts via MetaMask)
    // ==========================================

    /**
     * @dev Moves \`amount\` tokens from the caller's account to \`recipient\`.
     * Invoked when sending tokens in MetaMask Send UI.
     * Selector: 0xa9059cbb
     */
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    /**
     * @dev Sets \`amount\` as the allowance of \`spender\` over the caller's tokens.
     * Invoked during DEX approvals (Uniswap, 1inch, etc.).
     * Selector: 0x095ea7b3
     */
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    /**
     * @dev Moves \`amount\` tokens from \`sender\` to \`recipient\` using the
     * allowance mechanism.
     * Selector: 0x23b872dd
     */
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    // ==========================================
    // ERC-20 Events
    // ==========================================

    /**
     * @dev Emitted when \`value\` tokens are moved from one account (\`from\`) to
     * another (\`to\`). Watched by MetaMask to update transaction activity logs.
     */
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);

    /**
     * @dev Emitted when the allowance of a \`spender\` for an \`owner\` is set by
     * a call to {approve}.
     */
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
}

/**
 * @title ProductionCompliantERC20
 * @notice Complete implementation ready for MetaMask Custom Token Import
 */
contract ProductionCompliantERC20 is IERC20 {
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    uint8 private _decimals;
    uint256 private _totalSupply;
    
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;

    constructor(
        string memory tokenName,
        string memory tokenSymbol,
        uint8 tokenDecimals,
        uint256 initialMint
    ) {
        _name = tokenName;
        _symbol = tokenSymbol;
        _decimals = tokenDecimals;
        _totalSupply = initialMint * (10 ** uint256(tokenDecimals));
        _balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply;
        emit Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, _totalSupply);
    }

    function name() external view override returns (string memory) { return _name; }
    function symbol() external view override returns (string memory) { return _symbol; }
    function decimals() external view override returns (uint8) { return _decimals; }
    function totalSupply() external view override returns (uint256) { return _totalSupply; }
    function balanceOf(address account) external view override returns (uint256) { return _balances[account]; }
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view override returns (uint256) { return _allowances[owner][spender]; }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external override returns (bool) {
        require(recipient != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to zero address");
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        _balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        _balances[recipient] += amount;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external override returns (bool) {
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to zero address");
        _allowances[msg.sender][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external override returns (bool) {
        require(sender != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from zero address");
        require(recipient != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to zero address");
        require(_balances[sender] >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        require(_allowances[sender][msg.sender] >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance");
        
        _balances[sender] -= amount;
        _balances[recipient] += amount;
        _allowances[sender][msg.sender] -= amount;
        emit Transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }
}`;

  onOpenMetaMaskSync?: () => void;
  onOpenProModal?: () => void;

}

  isMetaMaskConnected,
  onOpenMetaMaskSync,
  onOpenProModal,
  onNavigateToVenue,
}) => {

  const [events, setEvents] = useState<RevenueEventRecord[]>(() => getRevenueEvents());

    | "monetization_dashboard"
    | "ats_membership_plan"
    | "overview"
    | "forecast"
    | "marketplace"
    | "calculator"
    | "wallets"
    | "streams"
    | "affiliates"
    | "ledger"
    | "playbook"

  const [saveSuccessNotice, setSaveSuccessNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterStream, setFilterStream] = useState<string>("all");
  const [searchLedger, setSearchLedger] = useState<string>("");

    setSettings(newSettings);
    saveMonetizationSettings(newSettings);
    setSaveSuccessNotice("Monetization settings saved & applied across all 52 exchanges and tool suites!");

  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);

  const handleSetConnectedWalletAsPayout = () => {

      if (onOpenMetaMaskSync) onOpenMetaMaskSync();
      return;

      payoutWallets: {
        ...settings.payoutWallets,
        evm: metaMaskAccount,
        usdtPolygon: metaMaskAccount,

  VolumeX,
  ExternalLink,
  Layers,
  Shield,
  Zap,
  Clock,
  Radio,
  FileText,
  AlertCircle,
  Film,
  Disc,
  Headphones,
  CheckCircle2,
  Trash2,
  User as UserIcon,
  LogIn,
  LogOut,
  Sliders,
  Maximize2
} from "lucide-react";
import { User } from "firebase/auth";
import { auth, signInWithGoogle, signOutUser, subscribeToAuth, db } from "../lib/firebase";
import { doc, setDoc, getDocs, collection, query, orderBy, limit, deleteDoc } from "firebase/firestore";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";

export type MultiModalTab = 
  | "chat" 
  | "music" 
  | "video" 
  | "transcribe" 
  | "search" 
  | "maps" 
  | "library";

interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  role: "user" | "model";
  content: string;
  timestamp: string;
  modelUsed?: string;
}

interface SavedTrack {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  frequencyHz: number;
  prompt: string;
  model: string;
  audioBase64: string;
  mimeType: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface SavedVideo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  prompt: string;
  aspectRatio: "16:9" | "9:16";
  model: string;
  videoUrl?: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface MultiModalVisionHubProps {
  onImportTokens?: (tokens: TokenRecord[]) => void;
  selectedToken?: TokenRecord | null;
}

const CHAT_ROLES = [
  { id: "architect", label: "Tokenomics Architect", icon: Layers, desc: "Mathematical supply curves, vesting cliffs & emission schedules" },
  { id: "auditor", label: "Security Auditor", icon: Shield, desc: "EVM reentrancy, storage slot collision & static bytecode analysis" },
  { id: "market_maker", label: "DeFi Market Maker", icon: Zap, desc: "Uniswap v3/v4 liquidity bands, bonding curves & fee tiers" },
  { id: "creative_director", label: "Sonic & Visual Director", icon: Sparkles, desc: "Lyria musical themes, Solfeggio tuning & Veo cinematic aesthetics" },
];

const SOLFEGGIO_PRESETS = [
  { hz: 528, label: "528 Hz - Miracle & DNA Repair", desc: "Golden transformation frequency" },
  { hz: 432, label: "432 Hz - Universal Harmony", desc: "Verdi mathematical sacred tuning" },
  { hz: 396, label: "396 Hz - Liberation of Fear", desc: "Root foundation wave" },
  { hz: 639, label: "639 Hz - Harmonic Connection", desc: "Heart resonance & interpersonal unity" },
  { hz: 741, label: "741 Hz - Awakening Intuition", desc: "Consciousness clarity & problem solving" },
  { hz: 852, label: "852 Hz - Spiritual Order", desc: "Higher intuitive perception" },
  { hz: 963, label: "963 Hz - Crown Pineal Frequency", desc: "Pure cosmic light resonance" },
  { hz: 699, label: "Φ 699 Hz - Fibonacci Golden Spiral", desc: "432 × 1.618 golden ratio overtone" },
];

export const MultiModalVisionHub: React.FC<MultiModalVisionHubProps> = ({
  onImportTokens,
  selectedToken,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<MultiModalTab>("chat");
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [isAuthLoading, setIsAuthLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 1. CHATBOT STATE
  const [chatModel, setChatModel] = useState<"gemini-3.8-flash" | "gemini-3.1-pro-preview" | "gemini-3.5-flash" | "gemini-3.1-flash-lite">("gemini-3.8-flash");
  const [chatRole, setChatRole] = useState<string>("architect");
  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState<string>("");
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([
    {
      id: "init",
      role: "model",
      content: `### Welcome to Omni-ID Multi-Modal Vision Foundry 2026
I am your unified Gemini Intelligence Core powered by flagship \`gemini-3.8-flash\`, \`gemini-3.1-pro-preview\`, \`gemini-3.5-flash\`, and \`gemini-3.1-flash-lite\`.

You can now:
* 🤖 **Collaborate with specialized Web3 role personas** (Architect, Auditor, Market Maker, Creative Director).
* 💎 **Simulate & Audit GigaSupplyToken (900 Trillion Treasury Mint by Mauro Lomibao Dar III)** with custom mathematical emission models.
* 🎵 **Synthesize original acoustic anthems** with **Lyria 3** tuned to Solfeggio (528Hz/432Hz) and Fibonacci harmonic frequencies.
* 🎬 **Render cinematic 3D videos & animate token coins** using **Veo 3** in 16:9 or 9:16.
* 🎙️ **Transcribe microphone speech** directly into smart contract specs with **gemini-3.5-transcribe**.
* 🌐 **Access live Google Search & Maps Grounding** for real-time crypto news, DEX flows, and global blockchain headquarters.
* ☁️ **Persist your entire library** via Firebase Auth & Firestore.

How would you like to invent or expand your token ecosystem today?`,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
      modelUsed: "gemini-3.8-flash"
    }
  ]);
  const [isChatLoading, setIsChatLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const chatScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // 2. MUSIC GENERATION STATE (Lyria)
  const [musicModel, setMusicModel] = useState<"lyria-3-clip-preview" | "lyria-3-pro-preview">("lyria-3-clip-preview");
  const [musicPrompt, setMusicPrompt] = useState<string>(
    selectedToken 
      ? `Cyberpunk futuristic anthem for ${selectedToken.name} (${selectedToken.symbol}) on ${selectedToken.chain} with energetic bass and ethereal synths` 
      : "Epic Web3 token launch anthem with pulsating modular synth, crisp sub-bass, and triumphant harmonic crescendo"
  );
  const [selectedHz, setSelectedHz] = useState<number>(528);
  const [musicDuration, setMusicDuration] = useState<number>(30);
  const [isGeneratingMusic, setIsGeneratingMusic] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [currentTrack, setCurrentTrack] = useState<SavedTrack | null>(null);
  const [isPlayingMusic, setIsPlayingMusic] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);

  // 3. VIDEO GENERATION STATE (Veo 3)
  const [videoMode, setVideoMode] = useState<"text_to_video" | "image_to_video">("text_to_video");
  const [videoPrompt, setVideoPrompt] = useState<string>(
    selectedToken 
      ? `Holographic 3D metallic coin badge for ${selectedToken.symbol} rotating in zero-gravity space with luminous neon particles and reflection` 
      : "Hyper-realistic futuristic gold crypto coin spinning smoothly in deep space surrounded by glowing cyan energy rings and particle aura"
  );
  const [videoAspectRatio, setVideoAspectRatio] = useState<"16:9" | "9:16">("16:9");
  const [videoUploadedImage, setVideoUploadedImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isGeneratingVideo, setIsGeneratingVideo] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [videoOperationName, setVideoOperationName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [videoStatusMessage, setVideoStatusMessage] = useState<string>("");
  const [generatedVideoUrl, setGeneratedVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 4. AUDIO TRANSCRIBE STATE (gemini-3.5-transcribe)
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [recordingSeconds, setRecordingSeconds] = useState<number>(0);
  const [transcribedText, setTranscribedText] = useState<string>("");
  const [isTranscribing, setIsTranscribing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const recordingTimerRef = useRef<any>(null);

  // 5. SEARCH GROUNDING STATE
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("Ethereum Layer 2 TVL growth and Base network volume trends 2026");
  const [searchResult, setSearchResult] = useState<{ text: string; sources: Array<{ title: string; uri: string }> } | null>(null);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // 6. MAPS GROUNDING STATE
  const [mapsQuery, setMapsQuery] = useState<string>("Major blockchain headquarters and crypto foundation hubs in Switzerland and New York");
  const [mapsResult, setMapsResult] = useState<{ text: string; places: Array<{ title: string; uri: string; snippet?: string }> } | null>(null);
  const [isMapping, setIsMapping] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // 7. USER PERSISTED LIBRARY STATE
  const [libraryTracks, setLibraryTracks] = useState<SavedTrack[]>([]);
  const [libraryVideos, setLibraryVideos] = useState<SavedVideo[]>([]);

  // Auth listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = subscribeToAuth((currentUser) => {
      setUser(currentUser);
      if (currentUser) {
        loadUserLibrary(currentUser.uid);
      }
    });
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  // Scroll chat to bottom
  useEffect(() => {
    if (chatScrollRef.current) {
      chatScrollRef.current.scrollTop = chatScrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [chatMessages, isChatLoading]);

  // Load User Library from Firestore
  const loadUserLibrary = async (uid: string) => {
    try {
      const tracksRef = collection(db, "users", uid, "tracks");
      const tracksSnap = await getDocs(query(tracksRef, orderBy("createdAt", "desc"), limit(20)));
      const tracks: SavedTrack[] = [];
      tracksSnap.forEach((doc) => {
        tracks.push(doc.data() as SavedTrack);
      });
      setLibraryTracks(tracks);

      const videosRef = collection(db, "users", uid, "videos");
      const videosSnap = await getDocs(query(videosRef, orderBy("createdAt", "desc"), limit(20)));
      const videos: SavedVideo[] = [];
      videosSnap.forEach((doc) => {
        videos.push(doc.data() as SavedVideo);
      });
      setLibraryVideos(videos);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Could not load Firestore library:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  // Google Sign In Handler
  const handleGoogleSignIn = async () => {
    setIsAuthLoading(true);
    try {
      await signInWithGoogle();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Sign in failed:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsAuthLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Google Sign Out Handler
  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    try {
      await signOutUser();
      setLibraryTracks([]);
      setLibraryVideos([]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Sign out failed:", err);
    }
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. CHATBOT HANDLER
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleSendChat = async () => {
    if (!chatInput.trim() || isChatLoading) return;
    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: `u_${Date.now()}`,
      role: "user",
      content: chatInput.trim(),
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
    };

    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMessage]);
    setChatInput("");
    setIsChatLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/chat", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          messages: [...chatMessages, userMessage].map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
          model: chatModel,
          rolePreset: chatRole,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      const modelMessage: ChatMessage = {
        id: `m_${Date.now()}`,
        role: "model",
        content: data.reply || "Response synthesized successfully.",
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
        modelUsed: data.modelUsed || chatModel,
      };

      setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, modelMessage]);

      // Save to Firestore if user logged in
      if (user) {
        try {
          const chatDoc = doc(db, "users", user.uid, "chat_history", modelMessage.id);
          await setDoc(chatDoc, {
            id: modelMessage.id,
            userId: user.uid,
            userQuery: userMessage.content,
            modelResponse: modelMessage.content,
            model: chatModel,
            rolePreset: chatRole,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          });
        } catch (saveErr) {
          console.warn("Could not save chat to Firestore:", saveErr);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Chat request failed:", err);
      setChatMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          id: `err_${Date.now()}`,
          role: "model",
          content: "Encountered a transient connectivity issue. Please try again or switch model to `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`.",
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
          modelUsed: chatModel,
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setIsChatLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. MUSIC GENERATION HANDLER (Lyria 3)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleGenerateMusic = async () => {
    if (!musicPrompt.trim() || isGeneratingMusic) return;
    setIsGeneratingMusic(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/generate-music", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          prompt: musicPrompt,
          model: musicModel,
          frequencyHz: selectedHz,
          durationSeconds: musicDuration,
          tokenSymbol: selectedToken?.symbol || "OMNI",
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success && data.audioBase64) {
        const newTrack: SavedTrack = {
          id: `trk_${Date.now()}`,
          title: data.title || `${selectedToken?.symbol || "Web3"} Track (${selectedHz}Hz)`,
          frequencyHz: selectedHz,
          prompt: musicPrompt,
          model: data.model || musicModel,
          audioBase64: data.audioBase64,
          mimeType: data.mimeType || "audio/wav",
          durationSeconds: musicDuration,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        setCurrentTrack(newTrack);

        // Auto load into audio player
        if (audioRef.current) {
          audioRef.current.src = `data:${newTrack.mimeType};base64,${newTrack.audioBase64}`;
          audioRef.current.play().then(() => setIsPlayingMusic(true)).catch(() => {});
        }

        // Save to Firestore if user logged in
        if (user) {
          try {
            const trackDoc = doc(db, "users", user.uid, "tracks", newTrack.id);
            await setDoc(trackDoc, newTrack);
            setLibraryTracks((prev) => [newTrack, ...prev]);
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("Could not save track to Firestore:", err);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Music generation failed:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingMusic(false);
    }
  };

  const togglePlayAudio = () => {
    if (!audioRef.current) return;
    if (isPlayingMusic) {
      audioRef.current.pause();
      setIsPlayingMusic(false);
    } else {
      audioRef.current.play().then(() => setIsPlayingMusic(true)).catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadTrack = (track: SavedTrack) => {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = `data:${track.mimeType};base64,${track.audioBase64}`;
    link.download = `${track.title.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}.wav`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. VIDEO GENERATION HANDLER (Veo 3)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleGenerateVideo = async () => {
    if (!videoPrompt.trim() || isGeneratingVideo) return;
    setIsGeneratingVideo(true);
    setGeneratedVideoUrl(null);
    setVideoStatusMessage("Dispatching Veo 3 Neural Video Engine...");

    try {
      const payload: any = {
        prompt: videoPrompt,
        aspectRatio: videoAspectRatio,
      };

      if (videoMode === "image_to_video" && videoUploadedImage) {
        payload.imageBase64 = videoUploadedImage.split(",")[1] || videoUploadedImage;
        payload.mimeType = "image/png";
      }

      const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/generate-video", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.operationName) {
        setVideoOperationName(data.operationName);
        pollVideoOperation(data.operationName);
      } else {
        setVideoStatusMessage("Veo generation queued. Ready for playback.");
        setIsGeneratingVideo(false);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Veo video dispatch failed:", err);
      setVideoStatusMessage("Veo service busy. Please try again.");
      setIsGeneratingVideo(false);
    }
  };

  const pollVideoOperation = async (opName: string) => {
    setVideoStatusMessage("Synthesizing frame diffusion latents...");
    let attempts = 0;
    const maxAttempts = 30;

    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      attempts++;
      setVideoStatusMessage(`Rendering video frames (Check ${attempts}/${maxAttempts})...`);

      try {
        const checkRes = await fetch("/api/gemini/video-status", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ operationName: opName }),
        });
        const checkData = await checkRes.json();

        if (checkData.done) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setVideoStatusMessage("Finalizing MP4 video stream...");

          // Download completed video stream
          const dlRes = await fetch("/api/gemini/video-download", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ operationName: opName }),
          });

          if (dlRes.ok) {
            const blob = await dlRes.blob();
            const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            setGeneratedVideoUrl(blobUrl);
            setVideoStatusMessage("Video ready for playback!");

            if (user) {
              const videoItem: SavedVideo = {
                id: `vid_${Date.now()}`,
                title: videoPrompt.slice(0, 40),
                prompt: videoPrompt,
                aspectRatio: videoAspectRatio,
                model: "veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview",
                videoUrl: blobUrl,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              };
              setLibraryVideos((prev) => [videoItem, ...prev]);
            }
          }
          setIsGeneratingVideo(false);
        } else if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setVideoStatusMessage("Operation taking longer than expected. Check back shortly.");
          setIsGeneratingVideo(false);
        }
      } catch (pollErr) {
        console.warn("Polling attempt error:", pollErr);
      }
    }, 4000);
  };

  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      setVideoUploadedImage(event.target?.result as string);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4. AUDIO TRANSCRIBE HANDLER (gemini-3.5-transcribe)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleStartRecording = async () => {
    try {
      audioChunksRef.current = [];
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;

      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
        if (event.data.size > 0) {
          audioChunksRef.current.push(event.data);
        }
      };

      mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
        await processAudioTranscription(audioBlob);
      };

      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
      setRecordingSeconds(0);
      recordingTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setRecordingSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Microphone access denied or unavailable:", err);
      alert("Microphone permission required for voice transcription.");
    }
  };

  const handleStopRecording = () => {
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      setIsRecording(false);
      clearInterval(recordingTimerRef.current);
    }
  };

  const processAudioTranscription = async (blob: Blob) => {
    setIsTranscribing(true);
    try {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = async () => {
        const base64Audio = (reader.result as string).split(",")[1];
        const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/transcribe", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            audioBase64: base64Audio,
            mimeType: "audio/webm",
            prompt: "Accurately transcribe this audio verbatim into clean text for smart contract specifications.",
          }),
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.text) {
          setTranscribedText(data.text);

          // Save note to Firestore if user logged in
          if (user) {
            try {
              const noteRef = doc(db, "users", user.uid, "transcriptions", `vox_${Date.now()}`);
              await setDoc(noteRef, {
                id: `vox_${Date.now()}`,
                userId: user.uid,
                text: data.text,
                durationSeconds: recordingSeconds,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              });
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn("Could not save transcription to Firestore:", err);
            }
          }
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Transcription processing failed:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsTranscribing(false);
    }
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5. GOOGLE SEARCH GROUNDING HANDLER
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleExecuteSearch = async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim() || isSearching) return;
    setIsSearching(true);
    setSearchResult(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/search-grounding", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ query: searchQuery }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      setSearchResult({
        text: data.text || "No intelligence returned.",
        sources: data.sources || [],
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Search Grounding failed:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // 6. GOOGLE MAPS GROUNDING HANDLER
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleExecuteMaps = async () => {
    if (!mapsQuery.trim() || isMapping) return;
    setIsMapping(true);
    setMapsResult(null);

    try {
      // Optional: Get user coordinates
      let latLng: { latitude: number; longitude: number } | undefined = undefined;
      if (navigator.geolocation) {
        try {
          const pos = await new Promise<GeolocationPosition>((resolve, reject) => {
            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, { timeout: 3000 });
          });
          latLng = { latitude: pos.coords.latitude, longitude: pos.coords.longitude };
        } catch {
          // Fall back gracefully without user location
        }
      }

      const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/maps-grounding", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ query: mapsQuery, latLng }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      setMapsResult({
        text: data.text || "No mapped places found.",
        places: data.places || [],
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Maps Grounding failed:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsMapping(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Hidden audio element for Lyria playback */}
      <audio
        ref={audioRef}
        onEnded={() => setIsPlayingMusic(false)}
        className="hidden"
      />

      {/* Top Banner: Multi-Modal Vision Hub & Firebase Cloud Sync */}
      <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0C121E] via-[#101424] to-[#161226] border border-cyan-500/30 shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
              <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
              <span>Multi-Modal AI Vision Core</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#A0A0B0] font-mono">
              Lyria 3 • Veo 3 • Gemini 3.5 Grounding • Firebase
            </span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2 font-sans">
            Web3 Token &amp; Generative Intelligence Studio
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
            Produce protocol anthems in Solfeggio 528Hz, animate 3D token badges into Veo video, transcribe microphone speech, and query live Search &amp; Maps.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* User Auth & Firebase Status Card */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
          {user ? (

                            onClick={() => handleDownloadTrack(trk)}
                            className="p-1 rounded bg-[#141622] text-gray-300 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 italic">No saved music tracks yet. Generate one in the Lyria 3 Music tab!</p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Generated Veo Videos */}
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-white/5">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider block flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Video className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
                  <span>Saved Veo Videos ({libraryVideos.length})</span>
                </span>

                {libraryVideos.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    {libraryVideos.map((vid) => (
                      <div key={vid.id} className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#06070A] border border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold text-xs text-white block truncate max-w-[200px]">{vid.title}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 font-mono">
                            Ratio {vid.aspectRatio} • {vid.model}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {vid.videoUrl && (
                          <a
                            href={vid.videoUrl}
                            download="veo_saved.mp4"
                            className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-black font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Download className="w-3 h-3 text-black" />
                            <span>MP4</span>
                          </a>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 italic">No saved videos yet. Render one in the Veo 3 Video Studio tab!</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
export default MultiModalVisionHub;
