```tsx
import React from "react";
import {
  Layers,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Zap,
  CheckCircle2,
  RefreshCw,
  ExternalLink,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Sparkles,
  ShieldCheck,
  ShieldAlert,
  AlertTriangle,
  FileCode2,
  Wrench,
  Activity,
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  LiquidityPoolInitParameters,
  PoolRangeStrategy,
  SettlementAssetSymbol,
  VerifiedOnChainReceipt,
} from "../utils/treasuryCollateralSettlementEngine";

export const MAX_QUEUED_POOLS = 5;

export interface QueuedPoolDeploymentItem {
  id: string;
  token: TokenRecord;
  quoteAsset: SettlementAssetSymbol;
  feeTier: 500 | 3000 | 10000;
  rangeStrategy: PoolRangeStrategy;
  liquidityPercent: number;
  slippagePercent: number;
  recipientTreasuryAddress: string;
  params: LiquidityPoolInitParameters;
  status: "QUEUED" | "DEPLOYING" | "DEPLOYED" | "FAILED";
  deployedPoolAddress?: string;
  txHash?: string;
  receipt?: VerifiedOnChainReceipt;
}

export type ValidationSeverity = "PASS" | "WARNING" | "CRITICAL";

export interface ValidationFinding {
  code: string;
  severity: ValidationSeverity;
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  remediationHint?: string;
}

export interface PoolValidationItemResult {
  queueItemId: string;
  slotNumber: number;
  pairLabel: string;
  chain: string;
  overallStatus: ValidationSeverity;
  safetyScore: number; // 0 - 100
  simulated100kSlippagePct: number;
  simulatedPriceImpactPct: number;
  maxSafeTradeUsd: number;
  isTickAligned: boolean;
  isCalldataValid: boolean;
  findings: ValidationFinding[];
}

export interface BatchPoolValidationReport {
  timestamp: string;
  totalPoolsChecked: number;
  passedCount: number;
  warningCount: number;
  criticalCount: number;
  overallBatchScore: number;
  overallStatus: ValidationSeverity;
  aggregateLiquidityUsd: number;
  averageBatchSlippagePct: number;
  itemResults: PoolValidationItemResult[];
}

/**
 * Deterministic Automated Batch Validator for Queued Liquidity Pools
 * Checks for duplicate pairs, slippage collar breaches, shallow depth,
 * fee-tier/volatility mismatches, tick spacing alignment, and treasury address compatibility.
 */
export function evaluateBatchPoolValidation(
  queue: QueuedPoolDeploymentItem[]
): BatchPoolValidationReport {
  const seenPairs = new Map<string, number>();

  const itemResults: PoolValidationItemResult[] = queue.map((item, idx) => {
    const slotNumber = idx + 1;
    const pairLabel = `${item.token.symbol}/${item.quoteAsset}`;
    const pairKey = `${item.token.id.toLowerCase()}_${item.quoteAsset}_${item.feeTier}`;
    const findings: ValidationFinding[] = [];
    let score = 100;

    // 1. Check for duplicate token pair + fee tier collision in the same batch
    if (seenPairs.has(pairKey)) {
      const firstSlot = seenPairs.get(pairKey)!;
      findings.push({
        code: "DUPLICATE_POOL_COLLISION",
        severity: "CRITICAL",
        title: `Duplicate Pool Collision with Slot #${firstSlot}`,
        detail: `${pairLabel} (${(item.feeTier / 10000).toFixed(
          2
        )}%) is queued multiple times, which targets the same deterministic CREATE2 Uniswap V3 pool address.`,
        remediationHint:
          "Switch to a distinct quote asset (e.g., USDT/WETH) or alternate fee tier.",
      });
      score -= 35;
    } else {
      seenPairs.set(pairKey, slotNumber);
    }

    // 2. Slippage & Price Impact Stress Simulation ($100,000 benchmark swap)
    const totalDepthUsd = Math.max(1, item.params.totalInitialLiquidityUsd);
    const virtualLiquidityUsd =
      totalDepthUsd * item.params.concentratedCapitalEfficiencyMultiplier;
    const feePct = item.feeTier / 10000;
    const benchmarkTradeUsd = Math.min(
      100_000,
      Math.max(25_000, totalDepthUsd * 0.02)
    );
    const simulatedPriceImpactPct =
      (benchmarkTradeUsd / (virtualLiquidityUsd + benchmarkTradeUsd)) *
      100 *
      1.15;
    const simulated100kSlippagePct = simulatedPriceImpactPct + feePct;

    const targetMaxImpact = Math.max(0.05, item.slippagePercent - feePct);
    const ratio = targetMaxImpact / 100;
    const maxSafeTradeUsd = Math.max(
      500,
      Math.round((virtualLiquidityUsd * ratio) / (1 - ratio))
    );

    if (simulated100kSlippagePct > item.slippagePercent * 1.5) {
      findings.push({
        code: "CRITICAL_SLIPPAGE_EXCEEDED",
        severity: "CRITICAL",
        title: "High Execution Slippage Risk Detected",
        detail: `Simulated $${Math.round(
          benchmarkTradeUsd
        ).toLocaleString()} swap incurs ${simulated100kSlippagePct.toFixed(
          2
        )}% total slippage (exceeding the ${item.slippagePercent.toFixed(
          2
        )}% collar).`,
        remediationHint:
          "Increase liquidity backing ratio (% MCap) or select a lower fee tier / Balanced range.",
      });
      score -= 28;
    } else if (simulated100kSlippagePct > item.slippagePercent) {
      findings.push({
        code: "MODERATE_SLIPPAGE_DRIFT",
        severity: "WARNING",
        title: "Slippage Collar Near Threshold on Institutional Orders",
        detail: `Total slippage (${simulated100kSlippagePct.toFixed(
          2
        )}%) slightly exceeds ${item.slippagePercent.toFixed(
          2
        )}% tolerance due to ${feePct.toFixed(2)}% LP fee tier overhead.`,
        remediationHint:
          "Widen slippage collar to 0.80%+ or switch to 0.30% standard fee tier.",
      });
      score -= 12;
    }

    // 3. Fee Tier vs. Range Strategy & Market Cap Misconfiguration
    const mcap = item.token.marketCap || 25_000_000;
    if (item.rangeStrategy === "NARROW" && item.feeTier === 10000) {
      findings.push({
        code: "NARROW_EXOTIC_MISMATCH",
        severity: "WARNING",
        title: "Narrow Range (±10%) Paired with 1.00% Exotic Fee Tier",
        detail:
          "Concentrating ±10% ticks on a 1.00% high-volatility tier accelerates Impermanent Loss and out-of-range deactivation.",
        remediationHint:
          "Switch range strategy to BALANCED (±30%) or WIDE (±60%).",
      });
      score -= 15;
    } else if (item.feeTier === 500 && mcap < 100_000_000) {
      findings.push({
        code: "UNDERCOMPENSATED_FEE_TIER",
        severity: "WARNING",
        title: "Low 0.05% Fee Tier on Growth-Cap Token",
        detail: `Token market cap ($${(mcap / 1e6).toFixed(
          1
        )}M) exhibits higher volatility than 0.05% correlated pairs, reducing LP fee protection.`,
        remediationHint: "Upgrade fee tier to 0.30% (3000 bps) for optimal yield.",
      });
      score -= 10;
    }

    // 4. Shallow Liquidity Depth Check
    if (item.liquidityPercent < 2.0 && totalDepthUsd < 1_000_000) {
      findings.push({
        code: "SHALLOW_POOL_DEPTH",
        severity: "WARNING",
        title: "Shallow Initial Pool Depth (<$1M TVL)",
        detail: `Initial backing (${
          item.liquidityPercent
        }% MCap = $${Math.round(
          totalDepthUsd
        ).toLocaleString()}) may experience elevated price impact under arbitrage bursts.`,
        remediationHint: "Increase liquidity backing ratio to 5.0% MCap.",
      });
      score -= 12;
    }

    // 5. Chain vs. Settlement Beneficiary Verification
    const isSolanaQuote = item.quoteAsset === "SOL";
    const isEvmRecipient = item.recipientTreasuryAddress.startsWith("0x");
    if (isSolanaQuote && isEvmRecipient) {
      findings.push({
        code: "CROSS_CHAIN_SETTLEMENT_NOTE",
        severity: "WARNING",
        title: "SOL Quote Pair Routing to EVM Treasury Beneficiary",
        detail:
          "Wrapped SOL (Wormhole) on EVM will be used unless Solana Multisig Treasury is selected.",
        remediationHint:
          "Verify wrapped SOL settlement or switch quote currency to USDC.",
      });
      score -= 8;
    }

    // 6. Tick Spacing & Multicall Hex Verification
    const expectedSpacing =
      item.feeTier === 500 ? 10 : item.feeTier === 3000 ? 60 : 200;
    const isTickAligned =
      item.params.tickLower < item.params.tickUpper &&
      Math.abs(item.params.tickLower % expectedSpacing) === 0 &&
      Math.abs(item.params.tickUpper % expectedSpacing) === 0;
    const isCalldataValid =
      Boolean(item.params.encodedCalldataHex) &&
      item.params.encodedCalldataHex.startsWith("0x") &&
      item.params.encodedCalldataHex.length > 66;

    if (!isTickAligned || !isCalldataValid) {
      findings.push({
        code: "TICK_OR_CALLDATA_INVALID",
        severity: "CRITICAL",
        title: "Invalid Tick Spacing or Multicall Bytecode",
        detail: `Ticks [${item.params.tickLower}, ${item.params.tickUpper}] must align to spacing ${expectedSpacing}.`,
        remediationHint: "Re-run Smart Fill or Auto-Fix to regenerate ticks.",
      });
      score -= 40;
    }

    // If no issues found, record explicit PASS verification
    if (findings.length === 0) {
      findings.push({
        code: "VERIFIED_OPTIMAL",
        severity: "PASS",
        title: "Optimal AMM Configuration & Slippage Collar Verified",
        detail: `Q64.96 sqrtPriceX96, tick bounds [${
          item.params.tickLower
        }, ${
          item.params.tickUpper
        }], and ${simulated100kSlippagePct.toFixed(
          2
        )}% slippage pass all institutional checks.`,
      });
    }

    const clampedScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
    const hasCritical = findings.some((f) => f.severity === "CRITICAL");
    const hasWarning = findings.some((f) => f.severity === "WARNING");
    const overallStatus: ValidationSeverity = hasCritical
      ? "CRITICAL"
      : hasWarning
      ? "WARNING"
      : "PASS";

    return {
      queueItemId: item.id,
      slotNumber,
      pairLabel,
      chain: item.token.chain,
      overallStatus,
      safetyScore: clampedScore,
      simulated100kSlippagePct,
      simulatedPriceImpactPct,
      maxSafeTradeUsd,
      isTickAligned,
      isCalldataValid,
      findings,
    };
  });

  const passedCount = itemResults.filter(
    (r) => r.overallStatus === "PASS"
  ).length;
  const warningCount = itemResults.filter(
    (r) => r.overallStatus === "WARNING"
  ).length;
  const criticalCount = itemResults.filter(
    (r) => r.overallStatus === "CRITICAL"
  ).length;

  const overallBatchScore =
    itemResults.length > 0
      ? Math.round(
          itemResults.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.safetyScore, 0) /
            itemResults.length
        )
      : 100;

  const overallStatus: ValidationSeverity =
    criticalCount > 0 ? "CRITICAL" : warningCount > 0 ? "WARNING" : "PASS";

  const aggregateLiquidityUsd = queue.reduce(
    (acc, q) => acc + q.params.totalInitialLiquidityUsd,
    0
  );

  const averageBatchSlippagePct =
    itemResults.length > 0
      ? itemResults.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.simulated100kSlippagePct, 0) /
        itemResults.length
      : 0;

  return {
    timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
    totalPoolsChecked: queue.length,
    passedCount,
    warningCount,
    criticalCount,
    overallBatchScore,
    overallStatus,
    aggregateLiquidityUsd,
    averageBatchSlippagePct,
    itemResults,
  };
}

export interface MultiPoolBatchQueuePanelProps {
  queue: QueuedPoolDeploymentItem[];
  activeToken: TokenRecord | null;
  activeQuoteAsset: SettlementAssetSymbol;
  activeFeeTier: 500 | 3000 | 10000;
  activeLiquidityPercent: number;
  activePoolParams: LiquidityPoolInitParameters | null;
  isExecuting: boolean;
  executionStage: string;
  copiedKey: string | null;
  batchValidationReport: BatchPoolValidationReport | null;
  isValidatingBatch: boolean;
  onCopy: (text: string, key: string) => void;
  onAddCurrentPoolToQueue: () => void;
  onAutoFillTop5Pools: () => void;
  onRemovePoolFromQueue: (id: string) => void;
  onClearQueue: () => void;
  onValidateBatchQueue: () => void;
  onAutoRemediateBatchQueue: () => void;
  onDismissValidationReport: () => void;
  onExecuteBatchSequence: () => void;
}

export const MultiPoolBatchQueuePanel: React.FC<
  MultiPoolBatchQueuePanelProps
> = ({
  queue,
  activeToken,
  activeQuoteAsset,
  activePoolParams,
  isExecuting,
  executionStage,
  copiedKey,
  batchValidationReport,
  isValidatingBatch,
  onCopy,
  onAddCurrentPoolToQueue,
  onAutoFillTop5Pools,
  onRemovePoolFromQueue,
  onClearQueue,
  onValidateBatchQueue,
  onAutoRemediateBatchQueue,
  onDismissValidationReport,
  onExecuteBatchSequence,
}) => {
  const isQueueFull = queue.length >= MAX_QUEUED_POOLS;

  const totalBatchLiquidityUsd = queue.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.params.totalInitialLiquidityUsd,
    0
  );

  const deployedCount = queue.filter((q) => q.status === "DEPLOYED").length;

  return (
    <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#101528] via-[#0C1020] to-[#090C18] border border-[#283154] shadow-xl space-y-4 font-mono">
      {/* =================================================================
          HEADER & QUEUE CAPACITY BADGE (UP TO 5 POOLS)
         ================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#1E2542] pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-500/35 text-cyan-400">
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                Multi-Pool Batch Initialization Queue
              </span>
              <span
                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border uppercase ${
                  isQueueFull
                    ? "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40"
                    : "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-500/35"
                }`}
              >
                {queue.length} / {MAX_QUEUED_POOLS} Pools Queued
              </span>
              {batchValidationReport && (
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border uppercase flex items-center gap-1 ${
                    batchValidationReport.overallStatus === "PASS"
                      ? "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40"
                      : batchValidationReport.overallStatus === "WARNING"
                      ? "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40"
                      : "bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/40"
                  }`}
                >
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>
                    Batch Score: {batchValidationReport.overallBatchScore}/100
                  </span>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-sans mt-0.5">
              Queue up to 5 concentrated liquidity pools, run automated pre-deployment risk &amp; slippage validation, and deploy in a single sequence.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons: Add Current Pool, Auto-Queue 5 Pools, Batch Validate, Clear */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onAddCurrentPoolToQueue}
            disabled={
              isQueueFull || isExecuting || !activeToken || !activePoolParams
            }
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-500 hover:brightness-110 text-black font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            title={
              isQueueFull
                ? "Maximum of 5 pools reached in batch queue"
                : `Add ${activeToken?.symbol}/${activeQuoteAsset} to Batch Queue`
            }
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-black stroke-[2.5]" />
            <span>
              Queue {activeToken?.symbol}/{activeQuoteAsset} ({queue.length}/5)
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onAutoFillTop5Pools}
            disabled={isExecuting}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161C34] hover:bg-[#1F2748] text-amber-300 hover:text-white border border-amber-500/35 font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition"
            title="Automatically populate queue with up to 5 portfolio token pools"
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
            <span>Auto-Queue 5 Pools</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onValidateBatchQueue}
            disabled={isExecuting || isValidatingBatch}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-emerald-300 hover:text-black border border-emerald-500/45 font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition shadow-sm"
            title="Perform an automated pre-deployment check on all queued pools for misconfigurations or slippage risks"
          >
            {isValidatingBatch ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                <span>Validating...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Batch Validate</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>

          {queue.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClearQueue}
              disabled={isExecuting}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-950/40 hover:bg-rose-900/60 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition"
              title="Clear all queued pools"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Clear</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* =================================================================
          5-SLOT VISUAL PROGRESS TRACKER
         ================================================================= */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2">
        {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((slotIdx) => {
          const item = queue[slotIdx];
          if (!item) {
            return (
              <div
                key={`empty-slot-${slotIdx}`}
                className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#080B14] border border-dashed border-[#1E2540] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center min-h-[68px]"
              >
                <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase">
                  Slot #{slotIdx + 1}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 mt-0.5">
                  Available
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          }

          const isDeployed = item.status === "DEPLOYED";
          const isDeploying = item.status === "DEPLOYING";
          const itemValidation = batchValidationReport?.itemResults.find(
            (r) => r.queueItemId === item.id
          );

          return (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[68px] relative transition ${
                isDeployed
                  ? "bg-emerald-950/35 border-emerald-500/50"
                  : isDeploying
                  ? "bg-amber-950/35 border-amber-400 animate-pulse"
                  : itemValidation?.overallStatus === "CRITICAL"
                  ? "bg-rose-950/30 border-rose-500/50"
                  : itemValidation?.overallStatus === "WARNING"
                  ? "bg-amber-950/25 border-amber-500/45"
                  : itemValidation?.overallStatus === "PASS"
                  ? "bg-emerald-950/25 border-emerald-500/45"
                  : "bg-[#11162B] border-cyan-500/40"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-white truncate">
                  #{slotIdx + 1} {item.token.symbol}/{item.quoteAsset}
                </span>
                {!isExecuting && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onRemovePoolFromQueue(item.id)}
                    className="text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-400 cursor-pointer"
                    title="Remove from queue"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-bold truncate">
                ${Math.round(item.params.totalInitialLiquidityUsd).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[9px] text-gray-400">
                <span>{(item.feeTier / 10000).toFixed(2)}%</span>
                {itemValidation ? (
                  <span
                    className={
                      itemValidation.overallStatus === "PASS"
                        ? "text-emerald-400 font-bold"
                        : itemValidation.overallStatus === "WARNING"
                        ? "text-amber-300 font-bold"
                        : "text-rose-400 font-bold"
                    }
                  >
                    {itemValidation.overallStatus} ({itemValidation.safetyScore}%)
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span
                    className={
                      isDeployed
                        ? "text-emerald-300 font-bold"
                        : isDeploying
                        ? "text-amber-300 font-bold"
                        : "text-cyan-300"
                    }
                  >
                    {item.status}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* =================================================================
          AUTOMATED BATCH VALIDATION & SLIPPAGE AUDIT REPORT PANEL
         ================================================================= */}
      {batchValidationReport && (
        <div
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl border space-y-3.5 transition ${
            batchValidationReport.overallStatus === "PASS"
              ? "bg-emerald-950/25 border-emerald-500/45"
              : batchValidationReport.overallStatus === "WARNING"
              ? "bg-amber-950/25 border-amber-500/45"
              : "bg-rose-950/25 border-rose-500/45"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#1F2744] pb-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              {batchValidationReport.overallStatus === "PASS" ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : batchValidationReport.overallStatus === "WARNING" ? (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />

          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
export const Navbar: React.FC<NavbarProps> = ({ 
  activeTab, 
  setActiveTab, 
  totalTokensCount,
  vaultTokensCount = 0,
  theme = "dark",
  onToggleTheme,
  metaMaskAccount,
  isMetaMaskConnected,
  onOpenMetaMaskSync,
  onOpenUniversalWallet,
  onOpenMarketDeploy,
  onOpenGlobalSwapSell,
  onOpenProModal,
  onOpenWorldConnectivity,
  onOpenAuthGateway,
  onOpenMembershipPortal,
  onOpenDiscountCenter,
  onOpenMessageModal,
}) => {
  const scrollContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [canScrollLeft, setCanScrollLeft] = useState(false);
  const [canScrollRight, setCanScrollRight] = useState(true);
  const [isMobileMenuOpen, setIsMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [harmonicsState, setHarmonicsState] = useState(harmonicsAudioEngine.getState());
  const { currentLanguage, languageConfig } = useLanguage();
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsFullscreen(isFullscreenActive());
    return subscribeToFullscreen((active) => {
      setIsFullscreen(active);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return harmonicsAudioEngine.subscribe((s) => {
      setHarmonicsState(s);
    });
  }, []);

  // Check scroll positions to show/hide scroll arrows
  const checkScroll = () => {
    if (scrollContainerRef.current) {
      const { scrollLeft, scrollWidth, clientWidth } = scrollContainerRef.current;
      setCanScrollLeft(scrollLeft > 10);
      setCanScrollRight(scrollLeft < scrollWidth - clientWidth - 10);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    checkScroll();
    const el = scrollContainerRef.current;
    if (el) {
      el.addEventListener("scroll", checkScroll, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener("resize", checkScroll);
      return () => {
        el.removeEventListener("scroll", checkScroll);
        window.removeEventListener("resize", checkScroll);
      };
    }
  }, []);

  const handleScrollLeft = () => {
    if (scrollContainerRef.current) {
      scrollContainerRef.current.scrollBy({ left: -260, behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  };

  const handleScrollRight = () => {
    if (scrollContainerRef.current) {
      scrollContainerRef.current.scrollBy({ left: 260, behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  };

  const handleTabClick = (tabId: NavTabId) => {
    setActiveTab(tabId);
    setIsMobileMenuOpen(false);
    
    // Smoothly scroll to active module view if user is already browsing
    setTimeout(() => {
      const target = document.getElementById("active-module-view");
      if (target) {
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
    }, 50);
  };

  return (
    <header className="border-b border-[#1F1F23] bg-[#0A0A0C]/95 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-40">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">

            onClick={() => handleTabClick("generator")}

            title="Return to Main Foundry"
          >
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1C1C28] to-[#0D0D12] border border-amber-500/50 p-0.5 group-hover:border-[#F27D26] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(242,125,38,0.35)] group-hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(242,125,38,0.6)] flex items-center justify-center transition-all flex-shrink-0">
              <img
                src="/assets/aistudio/IMG_20261026_022436_ab42bf11.jpg"
                alt="Token World Exchange ATS®"
                className="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-lg group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                onError={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement).src = "/twe_logo.jpg";
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="font-bold text-sm tracking-tight text-[#F27D26]">
                  Token World Exchange (TWE) ATS®
                </span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-mono uppercase px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">
                  Sole Owner/ Creator: Mauro Lomibao Dar III®
                </span>

              >

              </button>

            <div
              ref={scrollContainerRef}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar scroll-smooth py-1 px-2 w-full"
              style={{ scrollbarWidth: "none", msOverflowStyle: "none" }}
            >
              {NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => {
                const isActive = activeTab === item.id;

                return (

                  >

            </div>

            {/* Right Scroll Arrow */}

              >
                <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Right Controls: Quick Mobile Menu & Theme Toggle */}
```

```tsx
        address to,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes32 tradeId
    ) external onlyOwner returns (bool) {
        require(isWhitelistedInvestor[from] && isWhitelistedInvestor[to], "Compliance: Non-whitelisted participant");
        _transfer(from, to, amount);
        emit AtomicSettlementExecuted(from, to, amount, tradeId);
        return true;
    }

    function stake(uint256 amount) external {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient TWE balance");
        _transfer(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        stakedBalance[msg.sender] += amount;
        emit TokensStaked(msg.sender, amount, stakedBalance[msg.sender]);
    }
}`;
```

```tsx
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/IERC721.sol";

interface IERC5192 {
    event Locked(uint256 tokenId);
    event Unlocked(uint256 tokenId);
    function locked(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool);
}

contract InvestorIdentityNFT is IERC5192 {
    string public name = "Token World Investor Identity SBT";
    string public symbol = "TW-ID-SBT";
    
    struct InvestorAttestation {
        address investorWallet;
        uint16 jurisdictionCode;     // 840 = US 506c, 841 = QIB, 276 = EU MiFID, 702 = SG MAS
        uint8 accreditationTier;      // 1 = QIB, 2 = QP, 3 = Accredited, 4 = Professional
        uint64 issuedAt;
        uint64 expirationTimestamp;
        bytes32 zkIdentityCommitment;   // Hashed Poseidon KYC proof commitment
        bytes32 sanctionsScreeningHash; // Chainalysis / OFAC oracle hash
        bool isRevoked;
        string revocationReason;
    }

    mapping(uint256 => bool) private _isLocked;
    mapping(uint256 => InvestorAttestation) public attestations;
    mapping(address => uint256) public walletToTokenId;

    function locked(uint256 tokenId) external view override returns (bool) {
        return _isLocked[tokenId];
    }

    // ERC-721 transfers always revert (Permanent Soulbound Token)
    function transferFrom(address, address, uint256) external pure {
        revert("ErrSoulboundLocked");
    }
}`}

                {selectedContractKey === "compliance_hook" && `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

interface IPreTradeComplianceHook {
    function validateOrderPlacement(
        address trader,
        string calldata symbol,
        bool isBuy,
        uint256 priceUsdMicros,
        uint256 quantityShares,
        uint256 referencePriceMicros,
        uint256 currentTraderOpenShares
    ) external view returns (bool approved, string memory failureReason);
}

contract PreTradeComplianceHook is IPreTradeComplianceHook {
    InvestorIdentityNFT public immutable identityNFT;

    function validateOrderPlacement(...) external view override returns (bool, string memory) {
        // 1. Identity SBT Verification
        (bool isVerified, string memory idReason) = identityNFT.isVerifiedInvestor(trader, requiredJur, minTier);
        if (!isVerified) return (false, idReason);

        // 2. SEC Rule 15c3-5 Price Collar (+/- 10% deviation band)
        if (priceDeviation > maxCollarBps) return (false, "RULE_15C3_5_PRICE_COLLAR_BREACH");

        // 3. Single Ticket & Aggregate Position Limits
        if (quantityShares > maxSingleOrderShares) return (false, "ORDER_SIZE_EXCEEDS_MAX_LIMIT");

        return (true, "PRE_EXECUTION_COMPLIANCE_PASSED");
    }
}`}

                {selectedContractKey === "orderbook" && `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

contract OnChainInstitutionalOrderBook {
    IPreTradeComplianceHook public complianceHook;

    function placeOrder(
        string calldata symbol,
        OrderSide side,
        uint256 priceMicros,
        uint256 quantityShares,
        bytes32 clientOrderId
    ) external returns (uint256 orderId) {
        // Pre-Execution Hook Interception
        (bool approved, string memory reason) = complianceHook.validateOrderPlacement(
            msg.sender, symbol, side == OrderSide.BUY, priceMicros, quantityShares, ...
        );
        require(approved, reason);

        // Self-Trade / Wash-Trading Prevention
        _preventSelfMatch(msg.sender, symbol, side, priceMicros);

        // Sub-second Price-Time Priority Ladder Insertion
        orderId = _insertAndMatch(symbol, side, priceMicros, quantityShares);
    }
}`}
```

```tsx
// Compact currency formatter
function formatCompactCurrency(val: number): string {
  if (!val || isNaN(val)) return "$0";
  if (val >= 1e12) return `$${(val / 1e12).toFixed(2)}T`;
  if (val >= 1e9) return `$${(val / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`;
  if (val >= 1e6) return `$${(val / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`;
  if (val >= 1e3) return `$${(val / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K`;
  return `$${val.toFixed(2)}`;
}

// Compact number formatter
function formatCompactNumber(val: number): string {
  if (!val || isNaN(val)) return "0";
  if (val >= 1e9) return `${(val / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`;
  if (val >= 1e6) return `${(val / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`;
  if (val >= 1e3) return `${(val / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K`;
  return val.toLocaleString();
}

// Pseudo-random deterministic hash for organic variance
function hashStringToFactor(str: string, seed: number): number {
  let hash = seed * 31;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash |= 0;
  }
  // Convert to 0..1
  const normalized = (Math.abs(hash) % 10000) / 10000;
  return normalized;
}

export const PerformanceHeatmap: React.FC<PerformanceHeatmapProps> = ({

  const [containerSize, setContainerSize] = useState({ width: 900, height: 520 });

        chains: [chain],
        includeVanity: i % 4 === 0,
        simulatedMarketData: true,
      });

    return samples;
  }, [rawTokens]);

    availableChains,
    availableNarratives,
  } = useMemo(() => {

    let sumCurrentMcap = 0;
    const rawMetricsList = activeTokens.map((t) => {
      const cap = t.marketCap > 0 ? t.marketCap : (t.priceUsd || 0.05) * 100_000_000;
      sumCurrentMcap += cap;
      return { token: t, marketCap: cap };
    });

    if (sumCurrentMcap <= 0) sumCurrentMcap = 1_000_000;

    // Regime baseline parameters
    let regimeBaseGrowth = 8.0; // Equilibrium
    let regimeBetaMultiplier = 1.0;
    if (regime === "bull") {
      regimeBaseGrowth = 24.5;
      regimeBetaMultiplier = 1.35;
    } else if (regime === "bear") {
      regimeBaseGrowth = -14.0;
      regimeBetaMultiplier = 0.85;
    } else if (regime === "quantum") {
      regimeBaseGrowth = 15.0;
      regimeBetaMultiplier = 2.1; // High volatility shock
    }

    // Horizon factor
    let horizonFactor = 1.0; // 30D
    if (horizon === "24H") horizonFactor = 0.12;
    else if (horizon === "7D") horizonFactor = 0.38;
    else if (horizon === "90D") horizonFactor = 1.75;
    else if (horizon === "1Y") horizonFactor = 3.1;

    // Pass 1: Compute individual simulated growth rates and total simulated market cap
    let sumSimulatedMcap = 0;
    const preliminaryList = rawMetricsList.map(({ token, marketCap }) => {
      const weight = marketCap / sumCurrentMcap;

      // Factors:
      const growthDrivers: string[] = [];

      // Narrative momentum factor
      let narrativeAlpha = 0;
      if (token.narrative === "quantum_defi") {
        narrativeAlpha = 11.5;
        growthDrivers.push("Quantum-Resistant Lattice Demand (+11.5%)");
      } else if (token.narrative === "ai_agents") {
        narrativeAlpha = 9.8;
        growthDrivers.push("Autonomous Agent Swarm Adoption (+9.8%)");
      } else if (token.narrative === "depin") {
        narrativeAlpha = 7.2;
        growthDrivers.push("DePIN Physical Node Deployment (+7.2%)");
      } else if (token.narrative === "rwa") {
        narrativeAlpha = 5.4;
        growthDrivers.push("Tokenized Treasury & Credit Inflow (+5.4%)");
      } else if (token.narrative === "liquid_restaking") {
        narrativeAlpha = 4.1;
        growthDrivers.push("AVS Staking Restake Multiplier (+4.1%)");
      } else {
        narrativeAlpha = 2.5;
        growthDrivers.push("Sector Organic Expansion (+2.5%)");
      }

      // Security / Audit factor
      let securityAlpha = 0;
      if (token.launchStatus === "Rug-Proof Vault" || token.launchStatus === "Audited") {
        securityAlpha = 5.2;
        growthDrivers.push(`Verified ${token.auditFirm || "Smart Contract"} Audit (+5.2%)`);
      } else if (token.launchStatus === "Liquidity Locked") {
        securityAlpha = 3.0;
        growthDrivers.push("Locked AMM Liquidity Reserves (+3.0%)");
      } else if (token.launchStatus === "Paused") {
        securityAlpha = -18.5;
        growthDrivers.push("Governance Pause Contract Penalty (-18.5%)");
      }

      // Security score adjustment
      const scoreAdj = ((token.securityScore || 85) - 80) * 0.25;
      if (Math.abs(scoreAdj) > 0.5) {
        growthDrivers.push(`Security Rating Score ${token.securityScore} (${scoreAdj > 0 ? "+" : ""}${scoreAdj.toFixed(1)}%)`);
      }

      // Chain ecosystem multiplier
      let chainAlpha = 0;
      if (token.chain === "base" || token.chain === "solana") {
        chainAlpha = 4.2;
        growthDrivers.push(`${token.chain.toUpperCase()} Low-Fee TPS Throughput (+4.2%)`);
      } else if (token.chain === "quantum") {
        chainAlpha = 6.8;
        growthDrivers.push("Post-Quantum Kyber Execution Mesh (+6.8%)");
      }

      // Vanity prefix bonus
      if (token.isVanity) {
        growthDrivers.push("Institutional Vanity Prefix Premium (+2.5%)");
      }

      // Deterministic idiosyncratic pseudo-random dispersion
      const noiseSeed = hashStringToFactor(token.id + (token.contractAddress || ""), seed);
      // noise in range -12% to +14%
      const idiosyncraticNoise = (noiseSeed * 26 - 12) * regimeBetaMultiplier;

      // Aggregate token raw growth percentage
      const rawGrowth =
        (regimeBaseGrowth +
          narrativeAlpha +
          securityAlpha +
          scoreAdj +
          chainAlpha +
          vanityAlpha +
          idiosyncraticNoise) *
        horizonFactor;

      const simulatedGrowth = Number(rawGrowth.toFixed(2));
      const simulatedNewMarketCap = Math.max(10_000, Math.round(marketCap * (1 + simulatedGrowth / 100)));
      const marketCapDelta = simulatedNewMarketCap - marketCap;

      sumSimulatedMcap += simulatedNewMarketCap;

      return {
        token,
        marketCap,
        portfolioWeight: weight,
        portfolioWeightPct: Number((weight * 100).toFixed(2)),
        simulatedGrowth,

        marketCapDelta,
        growthDrivers,

    });

    // 2. Portfolio-level weighted benchmark growth rate
    const portfolioDollarDelta = sumSimulatedMcap - sumCurrentMcap;
    const portfolioWeightedGrowth = Number(

    );

    // Pass 2: Calculate relative growth vs total portfolio (Alpha / Spread)
    const computedMetrics: TokenPerformanceMetric[] = preliminaryList.map((item) => {
      // Relative growth is the exact difference between this token's growth and the total portfolio benchmark
      const relativeGrowth = Number((item.simulatedGrowth - portfolioWeightedGrowth).toFixed(2));
      const portfolioContribution = Number((item.portfolioWeight * item.simulatedGrowth).toFixed(2));
      const visuals = getRelativePerformanceVisuals(relativeGrowth);

      return {
        ...item,
        portfolioGrowthBenchmark: portfolioWeightedGrowth,
        relativeGrowth,
        portfolioContribution,

    // Sort to find top and bottom performers
    const sortedByRelative = [...computedMetrics].sort((a, b) => b.relativeGrowth - a.relativeGrowth);
    const topPerformer = sortedByRelative[0] || null;
    const topDrag = sortedByRelative[sortedByRelative.length - 1] || null;

    const outperformingCount = computedMetrics.filter((m) => m.relativeGrowth > 0).length;
    const outperformerRatio = computedMetrics.length
      ? Math.round((outperformingCount / computedMetrics.length) * 100)
      : 0;

    // Available chains & narratives for filters
    const chainsSet = new Set<string>();
    const narrativesSet = new Set<string>();
    activeTokens.forEach((t) => {
      chainsSet.add(t.chain);
      narrativesSet.add(t.narrative);
    });

    return {
      metrics: computedMetrics,
      totalPortfolioMarketCap: sumCurrentMcap,
      portfolioWeightedGrowth,
      portfolioSimulatedMarketCap: sumSimulatedMcap,
      portfolioDollarDelta,
      topPerformer,
      topDrag,
      outperformerRatio,
      availableChains: Array.from(chainsSet),
      availableNarratives: Array.from(narrativesSet),
    };
  }, [activeTokens, horizon, regime, seed]);

  // Filtered and sorted metrics
  const displayedMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    let list = [...metrics];

    // Filter by Search
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      list = list.filter(
        (m) =>
          m.token.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          m.token.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          m.token.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }

    // Filter by Chain
    if (selectedChain !== "all") {
      list = list.filter((m) => m.token.chain === selectedChain);
    }

    // Filter by Narrative
    if (selectedNarrative !== "all") {
      list = list.filter((m) => m.token.narrative === selectedNarrative);
    }

    // Filter by Outperformers / Underperformers
    if (filterMode === "outperforming") {
      list = list.filter((m) => m.relativeGrowth > 0);
    } else if (filterMode === "underperforming") {
      list = list.filter((m) => m.relativeGrowth < 0);
    } else if (filterMode === "top10") {
      list = [...list].sort((a, b) => b.marketCap - a.marketCap).slice(0, 10);
    }

    // Sorting
    list.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === "relativeGrowthDesc") return b.relativeGrowth - a.relativeGrowth;
      if (sortBy === "relativeGrowthAsc") return a.relativeGrowth - b.relativeGrowth;
      if (sortBy === "marketCapDesc") return b.marketCap - a.marketCap;
      if (sortBy === "simulatedGrowthDesc") return b.simulatedGrowth - a.simulatedGrowth;
      if (sortBy === "symbol") return a.token.symbol.localeCompare(b.token.symbol);
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [metrics, searchQuery, selectedChain, selectedNarrative, filterMode, sortBy]);

  // Compute D3 squarified treemap layout when in treemap mode
  const treemapNodes = useMemo(() => {
    if (viewMode !== "treemap" || displayedMetrics.length === 0) return [];

    const rootData = {
      name: "Portfolio",
      children: displayedMetrics.map((m) => ({
        ...m,
        // D3 expects numeric value for squarified tile sizing
        value: Math.max(1, m.marketCap),
      })),
    };

    const root = d3
      .hierarchy(rootData)
      .sum((d: any) => d.value)
      .sort((a: any, b: any) => (b.value || 0) - (a.value || 0));

    const treemapLayout = d3
      .treemap<any>()
      .size([containerSize.width, containerSize.height])

      return {
        metric,
        x0: leaf.x0,
        y0: leaf.y0,
        x1: leaf.x1,
        y1: leaf.y1,
        width: Math.max(0, leaf.x1 - leaf.x0),
        height: Math.max(0, leaf.y1 - leaf.y0),
      };
    });
  }, [viewMode, displayedMetrics, containerSize]);

  // Trigger organic re-simulation
  const handleResimulate = () => {
    setIsSimulating(true);
    setSeed((prev) => prev + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000 + 1));
    setTimeout(() => setIsSimulating(false), 300);
  };

  // Copy address helper
  const handleCopy = (address: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(address);
    setCopiedAddress(address);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedAddress(null), 1800);
  };

  // Export CSV
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = [
      "Token Symbol",
      "Token Name",
      "Contract Address",
      "Chain",
      "Token Standard",
      "Launch Status",
      "Current Market Cap (USD)",
      "Portfolio Weight (%)",
      "Simulated Token Growth (%)",
      "Portfolio Benchmark Growth (%)",
      "Relative Growth vs Portfolio (Alpha %)",
      "Projected Market Cap (USD)",
      "Projected Value Delta (USD)",
      "Primary Growth Drivers",
    ];

    const rows = displayedMetrics.map((m) => [
      `"${m.token.symbol}"`,
      `"${m.token.name}"`,
      `"${m.token.contractAddress}"`,
      `"${m.token.chain}"`,
      `"${m.token.tokenStandard}"`,
      `"${m.token.launchStatus}"`,
      m.marketCap,
      m.portfolioWeightPct,
      m.simulatedGrowth,
      m.portfolioGrowthBenchmark,
      m.relativeGrowth,
      m.simulatedNewMarketCap,
      m.marketCapDelta,
      `"${m.growthDrivers.join("; ")}"`,
    ]);

    const csvContent = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8," + [headers.join(","), ...rows.map((e) => e.join(","))].join("\n");
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute("download", `token_world_performance_heatmap_${horizon}_${regime}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  // Groupings for sector and chain view modes
  const groupedBySector = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, TokenPerformanceMetric[]>();
    displayedMetrics.forEach((m) => {
      const narrative = m.token.narrative;
      if (!map.has(narrative)) map.set(narrative, []);
      map.get(narrative)!.push(m);
    });
    return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([sector, items]) => {
      const avgRelative = Number(
        (items.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.relativeGrowth, 0) / items.length).toFixed(2)
      );
      const sectorMcap = items.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.marketCap, 0);
      return { sector, items, avgRelative, sectorMcap };
    });
  }, [displayedMetrics]);

  const groupedByChain = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, TokenPerformanceMetric[]>();
    displayedMetrics.forEach((m) => {
      const chain = m.token.chain;
      if (!map.has(chain)) map.set(chain, []);
      map.get(chain)!.push(m);
    });
    return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([chain, items]) => {
      const avgRelative = Number(
        (items.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.relativeGrowth, 0) / items.length).toFixed(2)
      );
      const chainMcap = items.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.marketCap, 0);
      return { chain, items, avgRelative, chainMcap };
    });
  }, [displayedMetrics]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 space-y-5 shadow-2xl">
      {/* 1. Header Banner & Title */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400">
              <Flame className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight uppercase font-mono">
                  Performance Heatmap & Relative Portfolio Alpha
                </h3>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#F27D26]/10 text-[#F27D26] border border-[#F27D26]/30">
                  Relative Valuation Engine
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                Color-coded visualization benchmarking simulated market cap growth of each token against the value-weighted total portfolio growth.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Actions Bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResimulate}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] hover:border-[#F27D26] text-xs font-mono text-white transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              isSimulating ? "animate-pulse border-[#F27D26]" : ""
            }`}
            title="Re-run Monte Carlo simulation with organic entropy"
          >
            <Shuffle className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26] ${isSimulating ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
            <span>Re-Simulate Growth</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] hover:border-emerald-500 text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            title="Download formatted Heatmap dataset as CSV"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Export Heatmap CSV</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Institutional KPI Strip: Portfolio Benchmark Overview */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono text-[#8E9299] block">Total Portfolio MCap</span>
          <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-white">
            {formatCompactCurrency(totalPortfolioMarketCap)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block font-mono">
            {activeTokens.length} Token Assets
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono text-[#8E9299] block">
            Portfolio Growth Benchmark
          </span>
          <div
            className={`text-base font-bold font-mono flex items-center gap-1 ${
              portfolioWeightedGrowth >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-red-400"
            }`}
          >
            {portfolioWeightedGrowth >= 0 ? (
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 inline" />
            ) : (
              <TrendingDown className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 inline" />
            )}
            <span>
              {portfolioWeightedGrowth >= 0 ? `+${portfolioWeightedGrowth}%` : `${portfolioWeightedGrowth}%`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block font-mono">
            {horizon} Weighted Base
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono text-[#8E9299] block">Simulated Expansion</span>
          <div
            className={`text-base font-bold font-mono ${
              portfolioDollarDelta >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-red-400"
            }`}
          >
            {portfolioDollarDelta >= 0 ? `+${formatCompactCurrency(portfolioDollarDelta)}` : formatCompactCurrency(portfolioDollarDelta)}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block font-mono">
            Proj: {formatCompactCurrency(portfolioSimulatedMarketCap)}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono text-[#8E9299] block">Top Outperformer</span>
          {topPerformer ? (
            <div>
              <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400 truncate">
                {topPerformer.token.symbol}
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-300 block">
                +{topPerformer.relativeGrowth}% vs Port
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">-</span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono text-[#8E9299] block">Greatest Portfolio Drag</span>
          {topDrag ? (
            <div>
              <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-red-400 truncate">
                {topDrag.token.symbol}
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-red-300 block">
                {topDrag.relativeGrowth}% vs Port
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">-</span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] space-y-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-mono text-[#8E9299] block">Alpha Breadth</span>
          <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-cyan-400">
            {outperformerRatio}%
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] block font-mono">
            Beating Portfolio
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Heatmap Spectrum Legend Bar */}
      <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-3 space-y-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] gap-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
            <span className="text-white font-semibold">Relative Performance Color Legend:</span>
            <span>Simulated Token Growth vs Total Portfolio Baseline ({portfolioWeightedGrowth}%)</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[#8E9299]">
            Scale: <span className="text-red-400 font-bold">Lagging / Drag</span> ➔ <span className="text-slate-400">Neutral (0%)</span> ➔ <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">Leading / Alpha</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Visual gradient bar with segment badges */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 md:grid-cols-9 gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-center">
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-red-600/40 border border-red-500 text-red-200">
            &lt; -20%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Severe Drag</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-red-700/35 border border-red-600 text-red-300">
            -20% to -10%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Heavy Drag</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-red-800/30 border border-red-700 text-red-300">
            -10% to -3%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Underperforming</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-red-900/25 border border-red-800 text-red-300">
            -3% to -0.5%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Mild Lag</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-600 text-slate-300">
            ±0.5%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Benchmark</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-emerald-900/25 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-300">
            +0.5% to +3%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Mild Lead</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-emerald-800/30 border border-emerald-700 text-emerald-300">
            +3% to +10%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Outperforming</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-emerald-700/35 border border-emerald-600 text-emerald-300">
            +10% to +20%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Strong Alpha</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-1 rounded bg-emerald-600/40 border border-emerald-500 text-emerald-200">
            &ge; +20%
            <span className="block text-[8px] opacity-75">Super Alpha</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Interactive Simulation & Filter Controls */}
      <div className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-3 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Market Regime Knobs */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center gap-1">
              <Sliders className="w-3 h-3 text-[#F27D26]" />
              <span>Regime:</span>
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#16161A] p-0.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRegime("bull")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  regime === "bull"
                    ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 font-bold"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                🚀 Bull Expansion
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRegime("equilibrium")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  regime === "equilibrium"
                    ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/40 font-bold"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                ⚖️ Equilibrium
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRegime("bear")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  regime === "bear"
                    ? "bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/40 font-bold"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                📉 Stress Test
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRegime("quantum")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  regime === "quantum"
                    ? "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/40 font-bold"
                    : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                ⚡ High Volatility
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Time Horizon */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 ml-0 sm:ml-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299]">Horizon:</span>
              <div className="flex items-center bg-[#16161A] p-0.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                {(["24H", "7D", "30D", "90D", "1Y"] as SimulationHorizon[]).map((h) => (
                  <button
                    key={h}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setHorizon(h)}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                      horizon === h
                        ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-black font-bold"
                        : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {h}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* View Mode Buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 self-start lg:self-auto bg-[#16161A] p-0.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("treemap")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "treemap"
                  ? "bg-[#0A0A0C] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title="Weighted Treemap (Finviz style by market cap)"
            >
              <LayoutGrid className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              <span>Treemap</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("matrix")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "matrix"
                  ? "bg-[#0A0A0C] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title="Uniform Matrix Grid Cards"
            >
              <Grid className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Matrix</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("sector")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "sector"
                  ? "bg-[#0A0A0C] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title="Grouped by Narrative Sector"
            >
              <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Sectors</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode("chain")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === "chain"
                  ? "bg-[#0A0A0C] text-white border border-[#F27D26]"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
              title="Grouped by Blockchain Network"
            >
              <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Chains</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Secondary Filter & Search Row */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-[#1F1F23]">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {/* Search Input */}
            <div className="relative min-w-[180px]">
              <Search className="w-3 h-3 text-[#8E9299] absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search symbol, name, 0x..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded pl-7 pr-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-[#555] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26]"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Performance Filter Buttons */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setFilterMode("all")}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded border cursor-pointer ${
                  filterMode === "all"
                    ? "bg-[#16161A] text-white border-[#F27D26]"
                    : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                All ({metrics.length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setFilterMode("outperforming")}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded border cursor-pointer ${
                  filterMode === "outperforming"
                    ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/40"
                    : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-emerald-400"
                }`}
              >
                Alpha Leads ({metrics.filter((m) => m.relativeGrowth > 0).length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setFilterMode("underperforming")}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded border cursor-pointer ${
                  filterMode === "underperforming"
                    ? "bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/40"
                    : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-red-400"
                }`}
              >
                Portfolio Drags ({metrics.filter((m) => m.relativeGrowth < 0).length})
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setFilterMode("top10")}
                className={`px-2 py-1 rounded border cursor-pointer ${
                  filterMode === "top10"
                    ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/40"
                    : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-blue-400"
                }`}
              >
                Top 10 Weight
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Sort Dropdown */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
            <span className="text-[#8E9299] text-[11px]">Sort By:</span>
            <select
              value={sortBy}
              onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as SortOption)}
              aria-label="Sort heatmap tokens by metric"
              className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26]"
            >
              <option value="relativeGrowthDesc">Relative Alpha (Highest ➔ Lowest)</option>
              <option value="relativeGrowthAsc">Relative Drag (Lowest ➔ Highest)</option>
              <option value="marketCapDesc">Portfolio Market Cap (Largest First)</option>
              <option value="simulatedGrowthDesc">Individual Token Growth %</option>
              <option value="symbol">Token Symbol (A-Z)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5. VISUALIZATION CANVAS */}
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className="w-full relative min-h-[460px] bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl overflow-hidden p-2"
      >
        {displayedMetrics.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center space-y-3">
            <Filter className="w-8 h-8 text-[#555]" />
            <div className="text-sm font-mono text-white">No tokens matched your active criteria</div>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] max-w-sm">
              Adjust your search query or reset the filter to display tokens in the performance heatmap.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSearchQuery("");
                setFilterMode("all");
                setSelectedChain("all");
                setSelectedNarrative("all");
              }}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] hover:border-[#F27D26] text-xs font-mono text-white cursor-pointer"
            >
              Reset Filters
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : viewMode === "treemap" ? (
          /* SQUARIFIED TREEMAP (Area = Portfolio Weight, Color = Relative Growth vs Portfolio) */
          <div
            className="relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg select-none"
            style={{ height: `${containerSize.height}px` }}
          >
            {treemapNodes.map(({ metric, x0, y0, width, height }) => {
              const isLead = metric.relativeGrowth >= 0;
              const isLarge = width >= 110 && height >= 80;
              const isMedium = width >= 70 && height >= 50;

              return (
                <div
                  key={metric.token.id}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setInspectedToken(metric);
                    if (onSelectToken) onSelectToken(metric.token);
                  }}
                  style={{
                    position: "absolute",
                    left: `${x0}px`,
                    top: `${y0}px`,
                    width: `${width}px`,
                    height: `${height}px`,
                    backgroundColor: metric.visuals.bg,
                    borderColor: metric.visuals.border,
                  }}
```
