            status: "BLOCKED",
            message: `DOUBLE-SPEND DETECTED & BLOCKED: SELECT FOR UPDATE acquired exclusive lock on accounts [${involvedAccountIds.join(", ")}].`,
            details: `Safe Settlement Lock prevented race condition / double-spending on account '${acc?.name || line.accountId}'. Current locked balance ($${(acc?.balance || 0).toLocaleString()}) is insufficient for requested withdrawal -$${requiredAmount.toLocaleString()}. Transaction rolled back safely before commit. Zero state mutated.`,
            sqlTrace: `-- 1. Begin atomic transaction block\nBEGIN;\n\n-- 2. Sort & Acquire Exclusive Row-Level Lock (SELECT FOR UPDATE)\n-- Deterministic ID sorting eliminates deadlocks across concurrent searchers\nSELECT id, name, balance \nFROM accounts \nWHERE id IN ('${involvedAccountIds.join("', '")}') \nORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n\n-- 3. Verify available balance under exclusive row lock\n-- Balance check failed: Available ($${(acc?.balance || 0).toLocaleString()}) < Requested ($${requiredAmount.toLocaleString()})\nRAISE EXCEPTION 'Double-Spend Prevented: Account % has insufficient funds for withdrawal', '${acc?.id}';\n\n-- 4. Abort transaction cleanly\nROLLBACK; -- Double-spend prevented, zero state mutated!`,
            lockedAccounts: involvedAccountIds,
            timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
          });
          return;
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Without Safe Settlement, if double-spend is simulated, race condition slips through or overdraft occurs
      if (simulatedDoubleSpendAttempt) {
        const targetAcc = accounts.find((a) => a.id === txLines[0].accountId) || accounts[0];
        setLastExecutionResult({
          status: "DOUBLE_SPEND_ANOMALY",
          message: `CRITICAL DOUBLE-SPEND DRIFT! Safe Settlement (SELECT FOR UPDATE) was DISABLED.`,
          details: `Concurrent transaction executed without pessimistic row-level lock. Two competing searchers read stale balance simultaneously, bypassing serialization. Both withdrawals committed, creating -$${Math.abs(txLines[0].amount).toLocaleString()} phantom balance drift. Enable 'Safe Settlement' to enforce ACID isolation!`,
          sqlTrace: `-- UNSAFE CONCURRENT READ (NO PESSIMISTIC LOCK):\nBEGIN;\n-- Shared read lock only:\nSELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE id = '${targetAcc.id}'; -- Reads stale cached balance $${targetAcc.balance.toLocaleString()}\n-- Competing transaction executed concurrently on same account!\nINSERT INTO journal_entries (id, description) VALUES ('${entryId}', 'UNSAFE_CONCURRENT_RACE');\nINSERT INTO ledger_lines ...;\nCOMMIT; -- CATASTROPHIC DOUBLE-SPEND DRIFT COMMITTED!`,
          lockedAccounts: [],
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
        });

        // Mutate account into negative drift to visualize the damage
        setAccounts((prev) =>
          prev.map((a) =>
            a.id === targetAcc.id ? { ...a, balance: a.balance + Number(txLines[0].amount) * 2 } : a
          )
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    // 2. Simulate verify_journal_entry_balance() function
    if (balance !== 0) {
      setLastExecutionResult({
        status: "ERROR",
        message: `ERROR: Unbalanced journal entry ${entryId}: net balance is ${balance > 0 ? "+" : ""}${balance.toFixed(4)} (must be 0)`,
        details: `PostgreSQL Constraint Trigger 'check_journal_balance' ABORTED the transaction at COMMIT. The ledger lines sum to ${balance > 0 ? "+" : ""}${balance.toFixed(4)}, violating double-entry accounting equilibrium. Zero state mutated.`,
        sqlTrace: `BEGIN;\nINSERT INTO journal_entries (id, description) VALUES ('${entryId}', '${txDescription}');\nINSERT INTO ledger_lines (entry_id, account_id, amount) VALUES ...;\n\n-- Deferred trigger evaluation at COMMIT:\nSELECT SUM(amount) FROM ledger_lines WHERE entry_id = '${entryId}'; -- Result: ${balance}\nRAISE EXCEPTION 'Unbalanced journal entry %: net balance is % (must be 0)', '${entryId}', ${balance};\nROLLBACK; -- Zero balance drift guaranteed by constraint trigger!`,
        lockedAccounts: [],
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
      });
      return;
    }

    // 3. Success: Commit atomically with SELECT FOR UPDATE guarantees
    const formattedLines: LedgerLine[] = txLines.map((l, i) => {
      const acc = accounts.find((a) => a.id === l.accountId);
      return {
        id: `line-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
        accountId: l.accountId,
        accountName: acc?.name || l.accountId,
        amount: Number(l.amount),
      };
    });

    // Update account balances
    const updatedAccounts = accounts.map((acc) => {
      const delta = txLines
        .filter((l) => l.accountId === acc.id)
        .reduce((sum, l) => sum + Number(l.amount), 0);
      return {
        ...acc,
        balance: acc.balance + delta,
      };
    });

    const successSqlTrace = safeSettlementEnabled
      ? `BEGIN;\n-- 1. Acquire exclusive pessimistic row locks in deterministic ID order:\nSELECT id, name, balance FROM accounts WHERE id IN ('${involvedAccountIds.join("', '")}') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n\n-- 2. Insert Journal Entry Header:\nINSERT INTO journal_entries (id, description) VALUES ('${entryId}', '${txDescription}');\n\n-- 3. Insert Balanced Ledger Lines:\n${formattedLines.map((l) => `INSERT INTO ledger_lines (entry_id, account_id, amount) VALUES ('${entryId}', '${l.accountId}', ${l.amount});`).join("\n")}\n\n-- 4. Constraint Trigger 'check_journal_balance' verifies equilibrium:\n-- DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED: SUM(amount) = 0.0000 -> OK\nCOMMIT; -- Atomically persisted with Zero Double-Spending Risk!`
      : `BEGIN;\n-- UNSAFE READ (NO ROW-LEVEL LOCK ACQUIRED):\nINSERT INTO journal_entries (id, description) VALUES ('${entryId}', '${txDescription}');\nINSERT INTO ledger_lines ...;\nCOMMIT; -- (Warning: Safe Settlement was disabled)`;

    const newEntry: JournalEntry = {
      id: entryId,
      description: txDescription,
      postedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      lines: formattedLines,
      netBalance: 0,
      status: "POSTED",
      safeSettlementLocked: safeSettlementEnabled,
      sqlTrace: successSqlTrace,
    };

    setAccounts(updatedAccounts);
    setJournalEntries([newEntry, ...journalEntries]);
    setLastExecutionResult({
      status: "SUCCESS",
      message: `COMMIT SUCCESSFUL: Journal entry ${entryId} persisted atomically.`,
      details: safeSettlementEnabled
        ? `Row-level locks (SELECT FOR UPDATE) serialized account mutations across [${involvedAccountIds.join(", ")}]. Constraint trigger verified SUM(amount) === 0 across ${txLines.length} lines. Zero double-spending risk.`
        : `Transaction committed across ${txLines.length} lines without row locks. (Warning: Safe Settlement locking was inactive).`,
      sqlTrace: successSqlTrace,
      lockedAccounts: safeSettlementEnabled ? involvedAccountIds : [],
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
    });
  };

  // Run Concurrent 5-Worker Race Condition Stress Test
  const handleRunMultiWorkerRace = () => {
    setIsSimulatingRace(true);
    const cashAcc = accounts.find((a) => a.id === "acc-1010") || accounts[0];
    const initialCash = cashAcc.balance;
    const workerWithdrawal = 150000; // Each worker requests $150k

    setTimeout(() => {
      let currentRunningBalance = initialCash;
      const results: MultiWorkerResult[] = [];

      for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
        const lockWaitMs = Math.floor(Math.random() * 12) + i * 4;
        const balanceBefore = currentRunningBalance;

        if (safeSettlementEnabled) {
          // With SELECT FOR UPDATE: workers acquire exclusive lock sequentially
          if (currentRunningBalance >= workerWithdrawal) {
            currentRunningBalance -= workerWithdrawal;
            results.push({
              workerId: i,
              workerName: `MEV Searcher Worker #${i}`,
              status: "ACQUIRED_COMMIT",
              amount: workerWithdrawal,
              lockWaitMs,
              balanceBefore,
              balanceAfter: currentRunningBalance,
              message: `SELECT FOR UPDATE lock acquired (+${lockWaitMs}ms). Balance $${balanceBefore.toLocaleString()} >= $${workerWithdrawal.toLocaleString()}. COMMITTED.`,
            });
          } else {
            results.push({
              workerId: i,
              workerName: `MEV Searcher Worker #${i}`,
              status: "BLOCKED_ROLLBACK",
              amount: workerWithdrawal,
              lockWaitMs,
              balanceBefore,
              balanceAfter: currentRunningBalance,
              message: `SELECT FOR UPDATE serialized read: Insufficient balance ($${balanceBefore.toLocaleString()} < $${workerWithdrawal.toLocaleString()}). ROLLBACK EXECUTED (Double-Spend Prevented).`,
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Without SELECT FOR UPDATE: concurrent workers read initialCash simultaneously
          currentRunningBalance -= workerWithdrawal;
          results.push({
            workerId: i,
            workerName: `Unsafe Searcher #${i}`,
            status: "UNSAFE_DOUBLE_SPENT",
            amount: workerWithdrawal,
            lockWaitMs: 1,
            balanceBefore: initialCash,
            balanceAfter: currentRunningBalance,
            message: `Unsafe Read: Concurrently read stale balance ($${initialCash.toLocaleString()}) without lock. Double-spent $${workerWithdrawal.toLocaleString()}!`,
          });
        }
      }

      setMultiWorkerResults(results);
      setIsSimulatingRace(false);

      // If unsafe, update the account balance to reflect the overdraft
      if (!safeSettlementEnabled) {
        setAccounts((prev) =>
          prev.map((a) =>
            a.id === cashAcc.id ? { ...a, balance: currentRunningBalance } : a
          )
        );
      } else {
        setAccounts((prev) =>
          prev.map((a) =>
            a.id === cashAcc.id ? { ...a, balance: currentRunningBalance } : a
          )
        );
      }
    }, 600);
  };

  // Calculate Trial Balance
  const totalDebits = accounts
    .filter((a) => a.balance > 0)
    .reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.balance, 0);
  const totalCredits = accounts
    .filter((a) => a.balance < 0)
    .reduce((sum, a) => sum + Math.abs(a.balance), 0);
  const trialBalanceDiff = Math.abs(totalDebits - totalCredits);

  // Filtered Journal Entries
  const filteredJournalEntries = journalEntries.filter((entry) => {
    if (!journalSearch.trim()) return true;
    const query = journalSearch.toLowerCase();
    return (
      entry.id.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      entry.description.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      entry.lines.some((l) => l.accountName.toLowerCase().includes(query))
    );
  });

  // Export Journal to JSON
  const handleExportJournalJson = () => {
    const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(journalEntries, null, 2));
    const downloadAnchor = document.createElement("a");
    downloadAnchor.setAttribute("href", dataStr);
    downloadAnchor.setAttribute("download", `postgres_ledger_journal_${Date.now()}.json`);
    document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchor);
    downloadAnchor.click();
    downloadAnchor.remove();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-emerald-600/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400">
                <Scale className="w-5 h-5" />
              </span>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  PostgreSQL Double-Entry Ledger Studio
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono font-normal px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">
                    ACID & SELECT FOR UPDATE Locking
                  </span>
                  {safeSettlementEnabled ? (
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Lock className="w-3 h-3" /> Safe Settlement ON
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/40 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Unlock className="w-3 h-3" /> Safe Settlement OFF
                    </span>
                  )}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                  Schema-enforced double-entry financial ledger with <code className="text-emerald-300 font-mono">SELECT ... FOR UPDATE</code> pessimistic row locking to prevent double-spending and <code className="text-emerald-300 font-mono">DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED</code> triggers.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <button
              onClick={handleResetLedger}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1E1E24] hover:bg-[#25252D] text-gray-300 hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33] text-xs font-mono transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Reset accounts and journal entries to default genesis state"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400" />
              Reset Genesis
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleCopy(POSTGRES_DOUBLE_ENTRY_SCHEMA_SQL, "sql_schema")}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1E1E24] hover:bg-[#25252D] text-gray-200 border border-[#2B2B33] text-xs font-mono transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copiedKey === "sql_schema" ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />}
              Copy SQL Schema
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 3 Core Architecture Callouts */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-[#23232A]">
          <div className="p-3 bg-[#111115] border border-[#222228] rounded-xl space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <DollarSign className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              1. Signed Single-Column
            </span>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">
              Positive values represent <strong>Debits</strong>, negative values represent <strong>Credits</strong>. Eliminates duplicate columns and enforces equilibrium with <code className="text-emerald-300">SUM(amount) = 0</code>.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 bg-[#111115] border border-[#222228] rounded-xl space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-cyan-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              2. SELECT FOR UPDATE Locking
            </span>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">
              Acquires exclusive row-level locks on accounts in sorted order (<code className="text-cyan-300">ORDER BY id</code>). Serializes concurrent operations and eliminates double-spending race conditions.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 bg-[#111115] border border-[#222228] rounded-xl space-y-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              3. Deferred ACID Invariance
            </span>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">
              <code className="text-amber-300">DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED</code> verifies balance equilibrium at <code className="text-amber-300">COMMIT</code>. If lines are unbalanced by 1 cent, the entire transaction rolls back.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Trial Balance & Accounts Overview */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {/* Trial Balance Card */}
        <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Scale className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              Trial Balance Verification
            </h3>
            <span
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold ${
                trialBalanceDiff === 0
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30"
                  : "bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30"
              }`}
            >
              {trialBalanceDiff === 0 ? "IN EQUILIBRIUM" : "IMBALANCED"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#111115] border border-[#222228] rounded-xl flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-gray-400">Total Debits (+):</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                ${totalDebits.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#111115] border border-[#222228] rounded-xl flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-gray-400">Total Credits (-):</span>
              <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">
                ${totalCredits.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#111115] border border-[#222228] rounded-xl flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-gray-400">Net Ledger Variance:</span>
              <span className={`font-bold ${trialBalanceDiff === 0 ? "text-cyan-400" : "text-rose-400"}`}>
                ${trialBalanceDiff.toFixed(2)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 leading-relaxed">
            Assets = Liabilities + Equity + Retained Operating Margins. Double-entry equilibrium is verified across all accounts.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Ledger Accounts Table with Live Lock Status Indicator */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                General Ledger Chart of Accounts
              </h3>
              {activeLockedAccounts.length > 0 && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Lock className="w-3 h-3" /> {activeLockedAccounts.length} ROW(S) LOCKED
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono">{accounts.length} accounts</span>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-[#0B0B0E] border border-[#222228] rounded-xl overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs max-h-56 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-[#181820]">
            {accounts.map((acc) => {
              const isLocked = activeLockedAccounts.includes(acc.id);
              return (
                <div
                  key={acc.id}
                  className={`p-2.5 flex items-center justify-between transition ${
                    isLocked ? "bg-amber-500/10 border-l-2 border-amber-400" : "hover:bg-[#121217]"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] uppercase font-bold ${
                        acc.type === "asset"
                          ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300"
                          : acc.type === "liability"
                          ? "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300"
                          : acc.type === "equity"
                          ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300"
                          : acc.type === "revenue"
                          ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300"
                          : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {acc.type}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-gray-200">{acc.name}</span>
                    {isLocked && (
                      <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5">
                        <Lock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> FOR UPDATE
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`font-bold ${
                      acc.balance >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-amber-400"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {acc.balance >= 0
                      ? `+$${acc.balance.toLocaleString()}`
                      : `-$${Math.abs(acc.balance).toLocaleString()}`}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PRIMARY SAFE SETTLEMENT TOGGLE & CONTROLS BANNER */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border-2 border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-[#23232A]">
          <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSafeSettlementEnabled(!safeSettlementEnabled)}
              className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer focus:outline-none"
              title="Toggle Safe Settlement pessimistic row-level locking"
            >
              <div
                className={`w-14 h-7.5 rounded-full transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out p-1 ${
                  safeSettlementEnabled ? "bg-emerald-600" : "bg-gray-700"
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`w-5.5 h-5.5 bg-white rounded-full shadow-md transform transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out ${
                    safeSettlementEnabled ? "translate-x-6.5" : "translate-x-0"
                  }`}
                />
              </div>
            </button>

            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {safeSettlementEnabled ? (
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                  ) : (
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                  )}
                  Safe Settlement: SELECT FOR UPDATE Pessimistic Locking
                </span>
                <span
                  className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md ${
                    safeSettlementEnabled
                      ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40"
                      : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40"
                  }`}
                >
                  {safeSettlementEnabled ? "ACTIVE (PROTECTED)" : "DISABLED (VULNERABLE)"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
                {safeSettlementEnabled
                  ? "Uses PostgreSQL `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` to acquire exclusive row-level locks on accounts in deterministic order. Prevents race conditions and double-spending across parallel settlements."
                  : "Unsafe non-locking read (`SELECT balance`). Concurrent transactions can read stale balances simultaneously, causing critical double-spending drift."}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start md:self-center">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-gray-400 bg-[#0F0F13] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#23232C]">
              {safeSettlementEnabled
                ? "LOCK: EXCLUSIVE ROW (FOR UPDATE)"
                : "LOCK: NONE (SHARED READ)"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Scenario Preset Launchers */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 text-xs">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleLoadBalancedScenario}
            className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#111115] hover:bg-[#1A1A22] border border-[#23232C] text-left transition cursor-pointer group"
          >
            <div className="font-bold text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              1. Balanced Settlement ($0)
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
              Multi-row arbitrage lines with SUM = 0. Tests commit with row locks.
            </p>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleLoadUnbalancedScenario}
            className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#111115] hover:bg-[#1A1A22] border border-[#23232C] text-left transition cursor-pointer group"
          >
            <div className="font-bold text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-1">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              2. Unbalanced Imbalance
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
              Violates SUM(amount) = 0. Tests DEFERRABLE trigger rollback at COMMIT.
            </p>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleArmDoubleSpendAttack}
            className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer group ${
              simulatedDoubleSpendAttempt
                ? "bg-rose-500/15 border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300"
                : "bg-[#111115] hover:bg-[#1A1A22] border-[#23232C] text-gray-300"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="font-bold text-rose-400 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              3. Simulate Double-Spend Race
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
              Simulates 2 competing searchers draining identical funds simultaneously.

    description: "Massive liquidity inflows where perpetual commercial rights and exclusive vanity contracts command peak valuations.",
    color: "#10B981", // Emerald
  },

    icon: "🛡️",

    color: "#94A3B8", // Slate

};

interface MonthlyForecastPoint {
  monthIndex: number;
  monthLabel: string;
  basePassiveUsd: number;
  secondaryRoyaltiesUsd: number;
  renewalInflowsUsd: number;
  totalMonthlyPassiveUsd: number;
  cumulativePassiveUsd: number;
  projectedActiveDeals: number;
  ethEquivalent: number;
  polEquivalent: number;
}

export const PredictiveRevenueForecast: React.FC<PredictiveRevenueForecastProps> = ({
  userMetaMaskAddress,
  onNavigateToMarketplace,
  className = "",
}) => {
  // Load marketplace listings and purchases
  const listings = useMemo(() => getMarketplaceListings(), []);
  const purchases = useMemo(() => getLicensePurchases(), []);

  // Filter user's specific listings or fallback to all active listings if none yet
  const userListings = useMemo(() => {
    if (!userMetaMaskAddress) return listings;
    const lower = userMetaMaskAddress.toLowerCase();
    const filtered = listings.filter(
      (l) => l.sellerPayoutAddress?.toLowerCase() === lower || l.isUserListing
    );
    return filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : listings;
  }, [listings, userMetaMaskAddress]);

  // Forecast state controls
  const [selectedTrend, setSelectedTrend] = useState<MarketTrendMode>("baseline");
  const [forecastHorizonMonths, setForecastHorizonMonths] = useState<6 | 12 | 24>(12);
  const [royaltyCutPercent, setRoyaltyCutPercent] = useState<number>(5.0); // 5% default secondary protocol cut
  const [renewalRatePercent, setRenewalRatePercent] = useState<number>(75); // 75% license renewal retention
  const [customDealsCountOverride, setCustomDealsCountOverride] = useState<number>(0);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const activeTrend = TREND_MODE_CONFIGS[selectedTrend];

  // Number of effective active deals modeled
  const effectiveDealsCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (customDealsCountOverride > 0) return customDealsCountOverride;
    return Math.max(userListings.length, 6);
  }, [customDealsCountOverride, userListings.length]);

  // Average listing base price USD
  const averageDealPriceUsd = useMemo(() => {
    if (userListings.length === 0) return 145.0;
    const sum = userListings.reduce((acc, l) => acc + (l.priceUsdEstimate || 100), 0);
    return Math.round((sum / userListings.length) * 100) / 100;
  }, [userListings]);

  // Generate 12-month predictive passive cashflow projection
  const forecastData: MonthlyForecastPoint[] = useMemo(() => {
    const points: MonthlyForecastPoint[] = [];
    const now = new Date();
    let runningCumulative = 0;

    // Monthly baseline deal velocity based on trend
    const baseMonthlyDealsClosed = (effectiveDealsCount * 0.35) * activeTrend.dealVelocityMultiplier;

    for (let m = 1; m <= forecastHorizonMonths; m++) {
      const forecastDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + m, 1);
      const monthLabel = forecastDate.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", year: "2-digit" });

      // Compounded monthly growth multiplier
      const growthFactor = Math.pow(1 + activeTrend.monthlyGrowthRate, m - 1);

      // Monthly new deals passive volume (spread out as ongoing passive streams)
      const monthlyDeals = baseMonthlyDealsClosed * growthFactor;
      const basePassiveUsd = Math.round(monthlyDeals * averageDealPriceUsd * 0.45 * 100) / 100;

      // Ongoing secondary royalties (e.g. transfers, downstream token transactions, contract clones)
      const secondaryRoyaltiesUsd = Math.round(
        (monthlyDeals * averageDealPriceUsd * (royaltyCutPercent / 100) * activeTrend.secondaryRoyaltyMultiplier * 2.2) * 100
      ) / 100;

      // License renewals (compounding from prior months based on renewal rate)
      const renewalBase = m > 1 ? (points[m - 2]?.totalMonthlyPassiveUsd || 0) * (renewalRatePercent / 100) * 0.3 : 0;
      const renewalInflowsUsd = Math.round(renewalBase * 100) / 100;

      const totalMonthlyPassiveUsd = Math.round((basePassiveUsd + secondaryRoyaltiesUsd + renewalInflowsUsd) * 100) / 100;
      runningCumulative = Math.round((runningCumulative + totalMonthlyPassiveUsd) * 100) / 100;

      const ethEquivalent = Math.round((totalMonthlyPassiveUsd / 3450) * 1000) / 1000;
      const polEquivalent = Math.round((totalMonthlyPassiveUsd / 0.52) * 10) / 10;

      points.push({
        monthIndex: m,
        monthLabel,
        basePassiveUsd,
        secondaryRoyaltiesUsd,
        renewalInflowsUsd,
        totalMonthlyPassiveUsd,
        cumulativePassiveUsd: runningCumulative,
        projectedActiveDeals: Math.round(effectiveDealsCount * growthFactor),
        ethEquivalent,
        polEquivalent,
      });
    }

    return points;
  }, [
    forecastHorizonMonths,
    effectiveDealsCount,
    activeTrend,
    averageDealPriceUsd,
    royaltyCutPercent,
    renewalRatePercent,
  ]);

  // Aggregate metrics
  const currentMonthRunRate = forecastData[0]?.totalMonthlyPassiveUsd || 0;
  const endMonthRunRate = forecastData[forecastData.length - 1]?.totalMonthlyPassiveUsd || 0;
  const totalCumulativeEarnings = forecastData[forecastData.length - 1]?.cumulativePassiveUsd || 0;
  const annualizedRunRate = Math.round(endMonthRunRate * 12);
  const avgMonthlyPassivePerDeal = Math.round((currentMonthRunRate / effectiveDealsCount) * 100) / 100;

  // Handle export to CSV
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const headers = [
      "Month",
      "Base_Passive_USD",
      "Secondary_Royalties_USD",
      "Renewal_Inflows_USD",
      "Total_Monthly_Passive_USD",
      "Cumulative_Passive_USD",
      "ETH_Equiv",
      "Active_Deals_Count"
    ];
    const rows = forecastData.map((p) => [
      p.monthLabel,
      p.basePassiveUsd,
      p.secondaryRoyaltiesUsd,
      p.renewalInflowsUsd,
      p.totalMonthlyPassiveUsd,
      p.cumulativePassiveUsd,
      p.ethEquivalent,
      p.projectedActiveDeals,
    ]);

    const csvContent = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8," + [headers.join(","), ...rows.map(e => e.join(","))].join("\n");
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute("download", `predictive_revenue_forecast_${selectedTrend}_${forecastHorizonMonths}mo.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  const handleCopyValue = (val: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(val);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-8 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      {/* Decorative gradient ambient glows */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

      {/* Header section */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800 pb-6 relative z-10">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <span className="p-2.5 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500/20 to-purple-500/20 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-2xl text-indigo-400">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 flex-wrap">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">
                  Predictive Revenue Forecast
                </h3>
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-300">
                  Monthly Passive Licensing Deals
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-2xl">
                Simulates recurring monthly passive earnings potential from active token licensing contracts, developer seat renewals, and on-chain protocol royalties based on historical market trends.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 self-start md:self-center flex-wrap">
          <button
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-all shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
            title="Export 12-Month Predictive Cashflow to CSV"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-300" />
            <span>Export CSV</span>
          </button>

          {onNavigateToMarketplace && (
            <button
              onClick={onNavigateToMarketplace}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-indigo-500 hover:to-purple-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <PlusCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>List New Licensing Deal</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Market Trend Scenario Selector Cards */}
      <div className="space-y-3 relative z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center space-x-1.5">
            <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
            <span>Select Market Trend Environment</span>
          </label>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
            Active Trend: <strong className="text-white">{activeTrend.name}</strong> ({activeTrend.badge})
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          {(Object.keys(TREND_MODE_CONFIGS) as MarketTrendMode[]).map((modeKey) => {
            const cfg = TREND_MODE_CONFIGS[modeKey];
            const isSelected = selectedTrend === modeKey;
            return (
              <button
                key={modeKey}
                onClick={() => setSelectedTrend(modeKey)}
                className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border text-left transition-all relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                  isSelected
                    ? "bg-slate-800/90 border-indigo-500/80 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/10 ring-1 ring-indigo-500/50"
                    : "bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-800/40 hover:border-slate-700"
                }`}
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <span className="text-2xl">{cfg.icon}</span>
                    <span
                      className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold font-mono border"
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: `${cfg.color}15`,
                        borderColor: `${cfg.color}40`,
                        color: cfg.color,
                      }}
                    >
                      {cfg.badge}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">{cfg.name}</h4>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                    {cfg.tagline}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-800/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                  <span>Growth Velocity:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-200">
                    {cfg.dealVelocityMultiplier}x Normal
                  </span>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Top 4 Key Passive Metric Callouts */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 relative z-10">
        {/* Metric 1: Monthly Passive Run Rate */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-950/40 via-slate-900 to-slate-950 border border-indigo-500/30 relative">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">

          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-white font-mono flex items-baseline space-x-1.5">
            <span>${currentMonthRunRate.toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">/ mo</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-400 flex items-center space-x-1 mt-2 font-mono">

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metric 2: Annualized Passive Run Rate (ARR) */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-950/40 via-slate-900 to-slate-950 border border-emerald-500/30 relative">

            <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400">

          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-400 font-mono">
            ${annualizedRunRate.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-2 font-mono flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>Total {forecastHorizonMonths}M Cumulative:</span>
            <strong className="text-white">${totalCumulativeEarnings.toLocaleString()}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metric 3: Active Deals Modeled */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-950/40 via-slate-900 to-slate-950 border border-purple-500/30 relative">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Active Licensing Deals
            </span>
            <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400">
              <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-purple-300 font-mono">
            {effectiveDealsCount} Deals
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-2 font-mono">
            Avg. Passive Yield: <strong className="text-purple-400">${avgMonthlyPassivePerDeal}/deal/mo</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metric 4: Secondary Royalty Flow */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-950/40 via-slate-900 to-slate-950 border border-cyan-500/30 relative">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Protocol Cut & Royalties
            </span>
            <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400">
              <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-cyan-300 font-mono">
            {royaltyCutPercent.toFixed(1)}% Royalty
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-cyan-400 mt-2 font-mono flex items-center space-x-1">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
            <span>{renewalRatePercent}% Retention Renewal Rate</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Horizon & Model Adjustment Sliders */}
      <div className="bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-5 relative z-10">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" />
            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
              Fine-Tune Forecast Model Parameters
            </h4>
          </div>
          {/* Horizon toggle pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 bg-slate-900 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 self-start sm:self-auto">
            {([6, 12, 24] as const).map((hz) => (
              <button
                key={hz}
                onClick={() => setForecastHorizonMonths(hz)}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  forecastHorizonMonths === hz
                    ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm"
                    : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                }`}
              >
                {hz} Months
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {/* Slider 1: Active Deals Volume */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1.5">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Modeled Active Deals:</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-400">{effectiveDealsCount} Listings</span>
            </div>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="2"
              max="50"
              step="1"
              value={effectiveDealsCount}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomDealsCountOverride(parseInt(e.target.value, 10))}
              className="w-full accent-indigo-500 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-1">
              <span>Min: 2 deals</span>
              <span>Default: {userListings.length} deals</span>
              <span>Max: 50 deals</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Slider 2: Secondary Protocol Royalty Cut */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1.5">
              <span className="text-slate-400">Secondary Royalty Cut:</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-cyan-400">{royaltyCutPercent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
            </div>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="1.0"
              max="15.0"
              step="0.5"
              value={royaltyCutPercent}
              onChange={(e) => setRoyaltyCutPercent(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-1">
              <span>1.0% (Low)</span>
              <span>5.0% (Standard)</span>
              <span>15.0% (High)</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Slider 3: Annual License Renewal Retention */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1.5">
              <span className="text-slate-400">License Renewal Retention:</span>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400">{renewalRatePercent}% Retention</span>
            </div>
            <input
              type="range"
              min="30"
              max="95"
              step="5"
              value={renewalRatePercent}
              onChange={(e) => setRenewalRatePercent(parseInt(e.target.value, 10))}
              className="w-full accent-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono mt-1">
              <span>30% (Conservative)</span>
              <span>75% (Organic)</span>
              <span>95% (Enterprise)</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recharts 12-Month Passive Cashflow Visualization */}
      <div className="space-y-3 relative z-10">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span>12-Month Monthly Passive Inflow Trajectory</span>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 font-mono">
                USD & Crypto Equivalents
              </span>
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Interactive timeline showing base licensing inflows, secondary royalties, and cumulative passive balance growth.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" />
              <span>Monthly Passive ($/mo)</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
              <span>Cumulative ($)</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="h-[320px] sm:h-[380px] w-full bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <ComposedChart data={forecastData} margin={{ top: 15, right: 25, left: 5, bottom: 5 }}>
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="colorMonthlyPassive" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#6366F1" stopOpacity={0.4} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#6366F1" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                </linearGradient>
                <linearGradient id="colorCumulative" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.25} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>

              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1E293B" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis
                dataKey="monthLabel"
                stroke="#64748B"
                fontSize={11}
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
              />
              <YAxis
                yAxisId="monthly"
                stroke="#64748B"
                fontSize={11}
                tickFormatter={(val) => `$${val >= 1000 ? `${(val / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : val}`}
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
              />
              <YAxis
                yAxisId="cumulative"
                orientation="right"
                stroke="#10B981"
                fontSize={11}
                tickFormatter={(val) => `$${val >= 1000 ? `${(val / 1000).toFixed(0)}k` : val}`}
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#10B981" }}
              />

              <Tooltip
                content={({ active, payload }) => {
                  if (!active || !payload || !payload.length) return null;
                  const data = payload[0].payload as MonthlyForecastPoint;
                  return (
                    <div className="bg-slate-900/95 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md text-xs font-mono space-y-2 min-w-[240px]">

                        <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm">{data.monthLabel}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/30">

                        </span>

                      <div className="space-y-1.5 text-slate-300">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                          <span className="text-slate-400">Total Monthly Passive:</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-indigo-400 text-sm">

                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
                          <span className="text-slate-500 pl-2">↳ Base Inflows:</span>
                          <span className="text-slate-300">${data.basePassiveUsd.toLocaleString()}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
                          <span className="text-slate-500 pl-2">↳ Secondary Royalties:</span>

                        </div>
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">

              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-mono">

                  ) / 10;

                  return (

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3">

                          {deal.terms}
                        </span>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3 text-slate-200">

    monthlyGrowthMultiplier: 1.18,
    velocityMultiplier: 1.75,

  supercycle: {

    label: "AI Agent & DePIN Supercycle",
    shortLabel: "Supercycle (Exponential)",
    icon: "⚡",
    tagline: "Autonomous AI agents consuming synthetic datasets & backtest matrices at scale",
    description: "Machine-to-machine micro-licensing, massive programmatic demand for synthetic tokenomics matrices, and collision-resistant vanity salts.",
    monthlyGrowthMultiplier: 1.32,
    velocityMultiplier: 2.8,
    conversionMultiplier: 1.9,
    color: "#F59E0B",
  },
};

interface ForecastMilestonePoint {
  monthIndex: number;
  monthLabel: string;
  baselineUsd: number;
  optimisticUsd: number;
  conservativeUsd: number;
  cumulativeSales: number;
  netMetaMaskPayoutUsd: number;
  monthlyRevenueInflowUsd: number;
  ethEquivalent: number;
}

export const PredictiveRoiCalculator: React.FC<PredictiveRoiCalculatorProps> = ({

  onNavigateToMarketplace,
  className = "",
}) => {
  // 1. Data Source

  const [buyerConversionRatePercent, setBuyerConversionRatePercent] = useState<number>(3.2); // %
  const [priceMultiplier, setPriceMultiplier] = useState<number>(1.0); // 0.8x to 2.5x
  const [estimatedCreationGasCostUsd, setEstimatedCreationGasCostUsd] = useState<number>(65); // baseline deployment gas
  
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Active listings filtered by selected asset
  const targetListings = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedAssetId === "portfolio_all") return allListings;
    if (selectedAssetId === "portfolio_user") {
      const userItems = allListings.filter(
        (l) =>
          l.isUserListing ||
          (userMetaMaskAddress &&
            l.sellerPayoutAddress.toLowerCase() === userMetaMaskAddress.toLowerCase())
      );
      return userItems.length > 0 ? userItems : allListings.slice(0, 2);
    }
    const single = allListings.find((l) => l.id === selectedAssetId);
    return single ? [single] : allListings;
  }, [allListings, selectedAssetId, userMetaMaskAddress]);

  const currentBaselineRevenueUsd = useMemo(() => {
    return targetListings.reduce(
      (sum, l) => sum + (l.totalEarningsUsd || (l.salesCount * l.priceUsdEstimate)),

  // Horizon in months
  const horizonMonths = useMemo(() => {
    switch (projectionHorizon) {
      case "30D": return 1;
      case "90D": return 3;
      case "180D": return 6;
      case "365D": return 12;
    }
  }, [projectionHorizon]);

  const activeTrend = MARKET_TREND_CONFIGS[activeScenario];

  // Compute Predictive Forecast Milestones
  const forecastData = useMemo(() => {
    const points: ForecastMilestonePoint[] = [];
    const baseStart = Math.max(80, currentBaselineRevenueUsd);

    let cumulativeBaseline = baseStart;
    let cumulativeOptimistic = baseStart;
    let cumulativeConservative = baseStart;
    let cumulativeSales = targetListings.reduce((sum, l) => sum + (l.salesCount || 0), 0);

    // Initial point: Month 0 (Today)
    points.push({
      monthIndex: 0,
      monthLabel: "Today (M0)",
      baselineUsd: Number(baseStart.toFixed(2)),
      optimisticUsd: Number(baseStart.toFixed(2)),
      conservativeUsd: Number(baseStart.toFixed(2)),

      netMetaMaskPayoutUsd: Number((baseStart * 0.975).toFixed(2)),
      monthlyRevenueInflowUsd: 0,
      ethEquivalent: Number((baseStart / 3450).toFixed(4)),
    });

    // Monthly compound simulation
    for (let m = 1; m <= horizonMonths; m++) {
      // Monthly visitors with organic compound

      cumulativeSales += expectedSalesThisMonth;

      const inflowUsd = expectedSalesThisMonth * adjustedUnitPriceUsd;
      
      // Scenarios:
      // Baseline uses selected scenario
      cumulativeBaseline += inflowUsd;
      
      // Optimistic assumes 1.45x viral multiplier & lower price sensitivity
      cumulativeOptimistic += inflowUsd * 1.45;

      // Conservative assumes 0.65x floor & churn damping
      cumulativeConservative += inflowUsd * 0.65;

      const netPayout = cumulativeBaseline * 0.975; // 97.5% creator payout

      points.push({
        monthIndex: m,
        monthLabel: `M+${m}`,
        baselineUsd: Number(cumulativeBaseline.toFixed(2)),
        optimisticUsd: Number(cumulativeOptimistic.toFixed(2)),
        conservativeUsd: Number(cumulativeConservative.toFixed(2)),

        netMetaMaskPayoutUsd: Number(netPayout.toFixed(2)),
        monthlyRevenueInflowUsd: Number(inflowUsd.toFixed(2)),
        ethEquivalent: Number((cumulativeBaseline / 3450).toFixed(4)),
      });
    }

    return points;
  }, [
    currentBaselineRevenueUsd,
    targetListings,
    horizonMonths,
    activeTrend,
    monthlyDeveloperTraffic,
    buyerConversionRatePercent,
    adjustedUnitPriceUsd,
  ]);

  const finalPoint = forecastData[forecastData.length - 1];

  const projectedTotalSales = finalPoint?.cumulativeSales || 0;
  const optimisticGrossUsd = finalPoint?.optimisticUsd || 0;
  const conservativeGrossUsd = finalPoint?.conservativeUsd || 0;

  const incrementalRevenueEarnedUsd = Math.max(0, projectedGrossUsd - currentBaselineRevenueUsd);

                &nbsp;&nbsp;--purpose=asymmetric-signing \{'\n'}
                &nbsp;&nbsp;--default-algorithm=ec-sign-secp256k1-sha256 \{'\n'}
                &nbsp;&nbsp;--protection-level=hsm
              </pre>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>

}

  const setSelectedIds = (updater: Set<string> | ((prev: Set<string>) => Set<string>)) => {
    if (onSelectedTokenIdsChange) {
      onSelectedTokenIdsChange(updater);
    } else {
      setInternalSelectedIds(updater);
    }
  };

  // Pagination
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(25);

  // Copy Feedback
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedbackMsg, setFeedbackMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [isPingingAll, setIsPingingAll] = useState(false);

  // Ping a specific chain RPC
  const handlePingChain = useCallback(async (chain: string) => {
    setRpcStatusMap((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [chain]: {
        chain,
        rpcUrl: EXPLORER_CONFIG[chain]?.rpcUrl || "https://cloudflare-eth.com",
        reachable: false,
        latencyMs: 0,
        status: "degraded",
        lastChecked: Date.now(),
      },

  const handlePingAllRpcs = useCallback(async () => {
