    if (!data) return null;

    return (
      <div className="bg-[#0e1017]/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#242a3d] p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl font-mono text-xs z-50 min-w-[240px]">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1f2433] pb-2 mb-2">
          <span className="text-[#8E9299] flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
            {data.timeLabel}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#141722] text-[#8E9299]">
            {timeframe} Trajectory
          </span>
        </div>

        {displayMode === "comparison" ? (
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-semibold uppercase">Multi-Asset ROI %:</div>
            {enrichedHoldings.slice(0, 5).map((h) => {
              const val = data[`roi_${h.symbol}`];
              return (
                <div key={h.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4" }} />
                    <span className="text-white font-medium">{h.symbol}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`font-bold ${val >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"}`}>
                    {val >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{val}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Valuation:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-white">${data.value?.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Net PnL ($):</span>
              <span className={`font-bold ${data.pnl >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"}`}>
                {data.pnl >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${data.pnl?.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">ROI Return:</span>
              <span className={`font-bold ${data.roi >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"}`}>
                {data.roi >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{data.roi}%
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[#1f2433] pt-1.5 text-[11px]">
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Mock Market Cap:</span>
              <span className="text-cyan-400 font-semibold">{formatCurrency(data.mcap)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={`bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      {/* Background ambient lighting */}
      <div className={`absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-96 h-96 ${isNetPositive ? "bg-emerald-500/5" : "bg-rose-500/5"} rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none transition-colors duration-500`} />
      <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -left-24 w-96 h-96 bg-cyan-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

      {/* Header and Live Status Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-start lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#1f2433] pb-5 relative z-10">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl ${isNetPositive ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20" : "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20"}`}>
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold font-mono text-white tracking-tight">
                  Real-Time Profit &amp; Loss (PnL)
                </h2>
                {/* Live Stream Blinking Badge */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d]">
                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${isLiveStreaming ? "bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" : "bg-amber-400"}`} />
                  <span className={isLiveStreaming ? "text-emerald-400 font-semibold" : "text-amber-400"}>
                    {isLiveStreaming ? "LIVE TICK FEED" : "PAUSED"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[#8E9299]">({latencyMs}ms)</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-0.5">
                Dynamic valuation &amp; performance calculated from mock market cap history &amp; real-time on-chain pricing
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Real-Time Live Ticker Controls */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Pause / Resume Live Stream */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsLiveStreaming(!isLiveStreaming)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              isLiveStreaming
                ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/20"
                : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 hover:bg-amber-500/20"
            }`}
            title={isLiveStreaming ? "Pause real-time market ticks" : "Resume real-time market ticks"}
          >
            {isLiveStreaming ? <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            <span>{isLiveStreaming ? "Streaming" : "Resume"}</span>
          </button>

          {/* Speed Selector */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl p-0.5 font-mono text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStreamSpeedMs(1000)}
              className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${streamSpeedMs === 1000 ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-bold" : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"}`}
              title="1 second tick speed"
            >
              1s
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStreamSpeedMs(2000)}
              className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${streamSpeedMs === 2000 ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-bold" : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"}`}
              title="2 seconds tick speed (balanced)"
            >
              2s
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStreamSpeedMs(5000)}
              className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${streamSpeedMs === 5000 ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-bold" : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"}`}
              title="5 seconds tick speed (relaxed)"
            >
              5s
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Impulse Simulations */}
          <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] p-0.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleMarketImpulse(0.025)}
              className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              title="Simulate +2.5% market cap rally across all tokens"
            >
              +2.5% Bull
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleMarketImpulse(-0.02)}
              className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500/10 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              title="Simulate -2.0% market cap correction"
            >
              -2.0% Bear
            </button>
            {marketImpulseMultiplier !== 1.0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setMarketImpulseMultiplier(1.0)}
                className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-500/10 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                title="Reset simulation multiplier to neutral"
              >
                Reset
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Top Metrics Executive Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 mt-5">
        {/* Net Unrealized PnL */}
        <div className="bg-[#141722]/80 border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl p-3.5 relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>UNREALIZED PnL</span>
            {isNetPositive ? (
              <ArrowUpRight className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            ) : (
              <ArrowDownRight className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" />
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={`text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold font-mono mt-1 ${isNetPositive ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"}`}>
            {isNetPositive ? "+" : ""}${Math.abs(currentPnlValue).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1 font-mono text-xs">
            <span className={`font-semibold ${isNetPositive ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"}`}>
              {isNetPositive ? "+" : ""}{currentRoiValue.toFixed(2)}% ROI
            </span>
            {lastTickDelta !== 0 && (
              <span className={`text-[10px] px-1 rounded ${lastTickDelta > 0 ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300" : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300"}`}>
                {lastTickDelta > 0 ? "+" : ""}${lastTickDelta.toFixed(2)} tick
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Current Valuation vs Cost Basis */}
        <div className="bg-[#141722]/80 border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl p-3.5">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>VALUATION / COST BASIS</span>
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-white mt-1">
            ${(selectedHoldingId === "all" ? (latestPoint?.totalValueUsd || currentTotalValue) : (latestPoint?.tokenValues[selectedHoldingId] || 0)).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-1">
            Basis: ${(selectedHoldingId === "all" ? currentTotalCostBasis : (activeHolding?.estimatedCostBasis || 0)).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Aggregate Mock Market Cap */}
        <div className="bg-[#141722]/80 border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl p-3.5">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>MOCK MARKET CAP</span>
            <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-orange-400 mt-1 truncate">
            {formatCurrency(selectedHoldingId === "all" ? (latestPoint?.marketCapAggregate || 0) : (latestPoint?.tokenMcaps[selectedHoldingId] || activeHolding?.baselineMarketCap || 0))}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-orange-400" />
            <span>2026 Macro Trajectory</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Best Performer */}
        <div className="bg-[#141722]/80 border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl p-3.5">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>TOP ASSET RETURN</span>
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-white mt-1 truncate">
            {bestPerformer ? `${bestPerformer.symbol}` : "None"}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
            <span>+{bestPerformer?.unrealizedRoi.toFixed(1)}% ROI</span>
            <span className="text-[#8E9299] font-normal">(${bestPerformer?.unrealizedPnl.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} gain)</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Chart Filter Bar: Token Selector + Mode + Timeframes */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 mt-5 pt-3 border-t border-[#1f2433]">
        {/* Token Selector & Display Mode */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Token Focus Dropdown */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs">
            <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Focus:</span>
            <select
              value={selectedHoldingId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedHoldingId(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-transparent text-white font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="all" className="bg-[#0e1017] text-white">
                All Tokens (Combined Portfolio)
              </option>
              {enrichedHoldings.map((h) => (
                <option key={h.id} value={h.id} className="bg-[#0e1017] text-white">
                  {h.symbol} — {h.name} ({formatCurrency(h.baselineMarketCap)})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Display Mode Pills */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] p-0.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDisplayMode("pnl-usd")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                displayMode === "pnl-usd"
                  ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-bold border border-cyan-500/30"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              PnL ($)
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDisplayMode("roi-percent")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                displayMode === "roi-percent"
                  ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-bold border border-cyan-500/30"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              ROI (%)
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDisplayMode("total-value")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                displayMode === "total-value"
                  ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-bold border border-cyan-500/30"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Valuation
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDisplayMode("comparison")}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                displayMode === "comparison"
                  ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-bold border border-cyan-500/30"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Multi-Asset
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Timeframe Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] p-0.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs self-start sm:self-auto overflow-x-auto">
          {(["1H", "24H", "7D", "30D", "90D", "1Y", "ALL"] as PnLTimeframe[]).map((tf) => (
            <button
              key={tf}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTimeframe(tf)}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                timeframe === tf
                  ? "bg-cyan-500 text-black font-bold shadow-sm"
                  : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              {tf}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Interactive Recharts PnL Area Chart */}
      <div className="w-full h-80 mt-4 relative">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          {displayMode === "comparison" ? (
            <LineChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 12, right: 12, left: -10, bottom: 0 }}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1f2433" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis dataKey="timeLabel" stroke="#475569" tick={{ fill: "#8E9299", fontSize: 10 }} />
              <YAxis
                stroke="#475569"
                tick={{ fill: "#8E9299", fontSize: 10 }}
                tickFormatter={(v) => `${v}%`}
              />
              <Tooltip content={<CustomPnLTooltip />} />
              <ReferenceLine y={0} stroke="#475569" strokeDasharray="4 4" />
              <Legend
                wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 11, fontFamily: "monospace", paddingTop: 8 }}
                iconType="circle"
              />
              {enrichedHoldings.slice(0, 5).map((h) => (
                <Line
                  key={h.id}
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey={`roi_${h.symbol}`}
                  name={`${h.symbol} ROI%`}
                  stroke={h.color || "#06B6D4"}
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  dot={false}
                  activeDot={{ r: 5, fill: h.color || "#06B6D4" }}
                />
              ))}
            </LineChart>
          ) : (
            <AreaChart
              data={chartData}
              margin={{ top: 12, right: 12, left: -10, bottom: 0 }}
            >
              <defs>
                {/* Emerald Gradient for Profit */}
                <linearGradient id="pnlGreenGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.35} />
                  <stop offset="60%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.08} />
                  <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#10B981" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                </linearGradient>
                {/* Rose Gradient for Loss */}
                <linearGradient id="pnlRedGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#EF4444" stopOpacity={0.35} />
                  <stop offset="60%" stopColor="#EF4444" stopOpacity={0.08} />
                  <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#EF4444" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                </linearGradient>
                {/* Cyan Gradient for Valuation */}
                <linearGradient id="pnlCyanGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#06B6D4" stopOpacity={0.35} />
                  <stop offset="60%" stopColor="#06B6D4" stopOpacity={0.08} />
                  <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#06B6D4" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>

              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1f2433" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis dataKey="timeLabel" stroke="#475569" tick={{ fill: "#8E9299", fontSize: 10 }} />
              <YAxis
                stroke="#475569"
                tick={{ fill: "#8E9299", fontSize: 10 }}
                tickFormatter={(v) => {
                  if (displayMode === "roi-percent") return `${v}%`;
                  return formatCurrency(v, 0);
                }}
              />
              <Tooltip content={<CustomPnLTooltip />} />
              {displayMode !== "total-value" && (
                <ReferenceLine
                  y={0}
                  stroke="#475569"
                  strokeDasharray="4 4"
                  label={{
                    value: "Cost Basis Break-Even",
                    fill: "#64748B",
                    fontSize: 10,
                    position: "insideBottomLeft",
                  }}
                />
              )}
              <Area
                type="monotone"
                dataKey={displayMode === "roi-percent" ? "roi" : displayMode === "total-value" ? "value" : "pnl"}
                stroke={displayMode === "total-value" ? "#06B6D4" : primaryStrokeColor}
                strokeWidth={2.5}
                fill={
                  displayMode === "total-value"
                    ? "url(#pnlCyanGradient)"
                    : isNetPositive
                    ? "url(#pnlGreenGradient)"
                    : "url(#pnlRedGradient)"
                }
                activeDot={{
                  r: 6,
                  fill: displayMode === "total-value" ? "#06B6D4" : primaryStrokeColor,
                  stroke: "#0e1017",
                  strokeWidth: 2,
                }}
              />
            </AreaChart>
          )}
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

      {/* Performance Summary of Tokens Based on Mock Market Cap History */}
      <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
          <span className="font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
            Tokens Performance &amp; Mock Market Cap Trajectory
          </span>
          <span className="text-[11px]">
            {enrichedHoldings.length} Assets Tracked • Real-Time Engine Active
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#1f2433] bg-[#141722]/50">
          <table className="w-full text-left font-mono text-xs border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-[#1f2433] bg-[#141722] text-[#8E9299]">
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">TOKEN</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">MOCK MARKET CAP</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">HOLDING VALUE</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">EST. COST BASIS</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">UNREALIZED PnL</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3">RETURN (ROI)</th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">ACTION</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1f2433]">
              {enrichedHoldings.map((h) => {
                const isSelected = selectedHoldingId === h.id;
                const isPositive = h.unrealizedPnl >= 0;
                return (
                  <tr
                    key={h.id}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedHoldingId(isSelected ? "all" : h.id)}
                    className={`hover:bg-[#141722] transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected ? "bg-cyan-500/10 border-l-2 border-cyan-400" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Token Info */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span
                          className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0"
                          style={{ backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4" }}
                        />
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span>{h.symbol}</span>
                            {h.isFoundryToken && (
                              <span className="px-1 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30">
                                Foundry
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] truncate max-w-[120px]">
                            {h.name}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Mock Market Cap */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-white">
                        {formatCurrency(h.baselineMarketCap)}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">
                        @ ${h.priceUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 })}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Holding Value */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold text-white">
                      ${h.valueUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>

                    {/* Cost Basis */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-[#8E9299]">
                      ${h.estimatedCostBasis.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </td>

                    {/* Unrealized PnL */}
                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                      <span className={`font-bold ${isPositive ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"}`}>
                        {isPositive ? "+" : ""}${h.unrealizedPnl.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td className="py-2.5 px-3">

                      }`}>
                        {isPositive ? <ArrowUpRight className="w-3 h-3" /> : <ArrowDownRight className="w-3 h-3" />}

                          onClick={(e) => {

                          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono transition-colors ${
                            isSelected ? "bg-cyan-500 text-black font-bold" : "bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isSelected ? "Active" : "Chart"}
                        </button>

                        {onOpenGlobalSwapSell && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              onOpenGlobalSwapSell(h, "swap");
                            }}
                            className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-cyan-500/10 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 transition-colors"
                            title={`Swap / Trade ${h.symbol}`}
                          >
                            <ArrowDownUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

import { PortfolioTokenHolding } from "../utils/walletPortfolioService";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";

export type TimeInForce = "GTC" | "IOC" | "FOK";
export type TradeSide = "BUY" | "SELL";

export interface FilledPriceTier {
  tierId: string;
  tierName: string;
  depthLevel: string;
  badgeBg: string;
  badgeBorder: string;
  badgeText: string;

}

export interface SimulatedTradeExecution {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  timeFormatted: string;
  relativeTime: string;
  side: TradeSide;
  price: number;
  amountTokens: number;
  notionalUsd: number;
  filledPriceTier: FilledPriceTier;
  timeInForce: TimeInForce;
  executionVenue: string;
  liquidityRole: "Maker" | "Taker";
  slippagePct: number;
  isBlockOrder: boolean;
  txHash: string;
}

export interface RecentTradeExecutionHistoryProps {
  holding: PortfolioTokenHolding;
  token?: TokenRecord;
  currentPrice: number;
  currentMarketCap?: number;
  className?: string;
  onOpenGlobalSwapSell?: (token: any, initialMode?: "swap" | "send" | "sell") => void;
}

const PRICE_TIERS: FilledPriceTier[] = [
  {
    tierId: "TIER_1_TOP_OF_BOOK",
    tierName: "Tier 1: Inside Mid (Spread < 0.10%)",
    depthLevel: "Top of Book / Tightest Spread",
    badgeBg: "bg-emerald-500/15",
    badgeBorder: "border-emerald-500/40",
    badgeText: "text-emerald-300",
    priceOffsetPct: 0.05,
  },
  {
    tierId: "TIER_2_NEAR_MID",
    tierName: "Tier 2: Algorithmic Depth (0.10% – 0.45%)",
    depthLevel: "Near-Market Liquid Corridors",
    badgeBg: "bg-cyan-500/15",
    badgeBorder: "border-cyan-500/40",
    badgeText: "text-cyan-300",
    priceOffsetPct: 0.25,
  },
  {
    tierId: "TIER_3_INSTITUTIONAL_WALL",
    tierName: "Tier 3: Institutional Wall Sweep (0.45% – 0.95%)",
    depthLevel: "Institutional Block Resting Walls",
    badgeBg: "bg-purple-500/20",
    badgeBorder: "border-purple-500/50",
    badgeText: "text-purple-300",
    priceOffsetPct: 0.70,
  },
  {
    tierId: "TIER_4_DEEP_BOOK",
    tierName: "Tier 4: Deep Book Cross (> 0.95%)",
    depthLevel: "Deep Liquidity Absorb / Aggressive Sweep",
    badgeBg: "bg-amber-500/20",
    badgeBorder: "border-amber-500/50",
    badgeText: "text-amber-300",
    priceOffsetPct: 1.35,
  },
];

function generateSeedTrades(
  basePrice: number,
  symbol: string,
  count: number = 24
): SimulatedTradeExecution[] {
  const trades: SimulatedTradeExecution[] = [];
  const now = Date.now();

  const venues = [
    "TWE ATS Limit Heap #9450",
    "On-Chain DvP Order Bus",
    "Institutional Dark Pool Cross",
    "FAST Protocol Depository #9450",
  ];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const elapsedSec = (i * 38) + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25);
    const ts = now - elapsedSec * 1000;
    const isBuy = (i * 7 + Math.random()) % 2 > 0.95 ? true : i % 2 === 0;
    const side: TradeSide = isBuy ? "BUY" : "SELL";

    const tierIndex = i % 7 === 0 ? 3 : i % 4 === 0 ? 2 : i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    const tier = PRICE_TIERS[tierIndex];

    const priceOffset = (tier.priceOffsetPct * (side === "BUY" ? 1 : -1) * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4)) / 100;
    const execPrice = Math.max(0.0001, basePrice * (1 + priceOffset));

    // Realistic order sizes with occasional institutional whale block orders
    const isBlock = i % 5 === 0;
    const notionalUsd = isBlock
      ? Math.round(35000 + Math.random() * 125000)
      : Math.round(850 + Math.random() * 8500);

    const amountTokens = Number((notionalUsd / execPrice).toFixed(execPrice < 1 ? 2 : 4));
    const tif: TimeInForce = i % 6 === 0 ? "FOK" : i % 3 === 0 ? "IOC" : "GTC";
    const venue = venues[i % venues.length];
    const role = side === "BUY" && Math.random() > 0.4 ? "Taker" : "Maker";
    const slippage = Number((Math.abs(priceOffset) * 100).toFixed(2));

    const date = new Date(ts);
    const timeFormatted = date.toTimeString().split(" ")[0];

    const relSec = Math.floor((now - ts) / 1000);
    const relativeTime =
      relSec < 60
        ? `${relSec}s ago`
        : relSec < 3600
        ? `${Math.floor(relSec / 60)}m ago`
        : `${Math.floor(relSec / 3600)}h ago`;

    const txHex = ((ts * 1337) ^ (i * 99991)).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
    const txHash = `0x${txHex.slice(0, 4)}...${txHex.slice(-4)}`;

    trades.push({
      id: `TR-${ts}-${i}`,
      timestamp: ts,
      timeFormatted,
      relativeTime,
      side,
      price: execPrice,
      amountTokens,
      notionalUsd,
      filledPriceTier: tier,
      timeInForce: tif,
      executionVenue: venue,
      liquidityRole: role,
      slippagePct: slippage,
      isBlockOrder: isBlock,
      txHash,
    });
  }

  return trades;
}

export const RecentTradeExecutionHistory: React.FC<RecentTradeExecutionHistoryProps> = ({

  token,

  className = "",
  onOpenGlobalSwapSell,
}) => {

      }, 1800);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);

            relSec < 5
              ? "Just now"
              : relSec < 60
              ? `${relSec}s ago`
              : relSec < 3600
              ? `${Math.floor(relSec / 60)}m ago`
              : `${Math.floor(relSec / 3600)}h ago`;

      );

  // Filtered trade list
  const filteredTrades = useMemo(() => {

      if (filterSide === "BLOCK" && !t.isBlockOrder) return false;
      if (selectedTierFilter !== "ALL" && t.filledPriceTier.tierId !== selectedTierFilter) return false;
      if (activeTif !== "ALL" && t.timeInForce !== activeTif) return false;
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const matchHash = t.txHash.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchTier = t.filledPriceTier.tierName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchPrice = t.price.toString().includes(q);

  }, [trades, filterSide, selectedTierFilter, activeTif, searchQuery]);

  // Telemetry Aggregates
  const summaryStats = useMemo(() => {

    const buyVolumeUsd = trades.filter((t) => t.side === "BUY").reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.notionalUsd, 0);
    const sellVolumeUsd = trades.filter((t) => t.side === "SELL").reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.notionalUsd, 0);
    const totalVolumeUsd = buyVolumeUsd + sellVolumeUsd;
    const buyRatioPct = totalVolumeUsd > 0 ? (buyVolumeUsd / totalVolumeUsd) * 100 : 50;
    const avgSlippage = trades.length > 0 ? trades.reduce((acc, t) => acc + t.slippagePct, 0) / trades.length : 0;
    const largestBlock = trades.reduce((max, t) => (t.notionalUsd > max.notionalUsd ? t : max), trades[0] || null);

    return {
      totalCount,

    if (tif === "GTC") {

      if (size <= 10000) {

        slippage = 0.06;

        const canceledUsd = size - filledUsd;
        explanation = `IOC immediate fill executed $${filledUsd.toLocaleString()} USD (78%). Remaining $${canceledUsd.toLocaleString()} USD canceled to prevent excessive slippage.`;
      } else {
        fillRatio = 45;
        status = "PARTIAL_CANCEL";
        tier = "Tier 3: Institutional Sweep";
        slippage = 0.52;
        const filledUsd = Math.round(size * 0.45);

      }
    } else {

      if (size <= 50000) {

      } else {

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  ArrowUpRight,
  ArrowDownRight,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Pause,
  Play,
  Download,
  RefreshCw,
  Filter,
  Check,
  Radio,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  Layers,
  Sparkles,
  Info,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  liveMarketFeedService,
  LiveTrade,
} from "../services/liveMarketFeedService";

export interface RecentTradesProps {
  symbol: string;
  onPriceSelect?: (price: number) => void;
  compact?: boolean;
  maxTrades?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export const RecentTrades: React.FC<RecentTradesProps> = ({
  symbol,
  onPriceSelect,
  compact = false,
  maxTrades = 50,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [trades, setTrades] = useState<LiveTrade[]>(() =>
    liveMarketFeedService.getRecentTrades(symbol)
  );
  const [filterSide, setFilterSide] = useState<"ALL" | "BUY" | "SELL" | "WHALE">("ALL");
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isAudioEnabled, setIsAudioEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [flashTradeIds, setFlashTradeIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [selectedTrade, setSelectedTrade] = useState<LiveTrade | null>(null);
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Web Audio Context reference for zero-dependency execution ticks
  const audioCtxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);

  // Play subtle synth tick on new trade execution if enabled
  const playTradeAudioTick = (side: "BUY" | "SELL", isWhale: boolean) => {
    if (!isAudioEnabled) return;
    try {
      if (!audioCtxRef.current) {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
        if (AudioCtx) {
          audioCtxRef.current = new AudioCtx();
        }
      }
      const ctx = audioCtxRef.current;
      if (!ctx || ctx.state === "suspended") {
        ctx?.resume();
      }
      if (ctx) {
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = isWhale ? "triangle" : "sine";
        // Higher pitch for buys, lower for sells
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(
          side === "BUY" ? (isWhale ? 880 : 660) : isWhale ? 440 : 330,
          ctx.currentTime
        );
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.04, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + (isWhale ? 0.15 : 0.05));
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (isWhale ? 0.15 : 0.05));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Audio autoplay policy or unavailable
    }
  };

  // Subscribe to live trade feed from Binance / CoinGecko / TWE ATS
  useEffect(() => {
    // Clear flash IDs on symbol change
    setFlashTradeIds(new Set());
    setTrades(liveMarketFeedService.getRecentTrades(symbol));

    const unsubscribe = liveMarketFeedService.subscribeTrades(symbol, (updatedSymbol, incomingTrades) => {
      if (updatedSymbol !== symbol) return;

      if (!isPaused) {
        setTrades((prevTrades) => {
          // Detect newly arrived trades
          const prevTopId = prevTrades[0]?.id;
          const newTrades = incomingTrades.filter(
            (t) => !prevTrades.some((p) => p.id === t.id)
          );

          if (newTrades.length > 0) {
            const newest = newTrades[0];
            playTradeAudioTick(newest.side, !!newest.isWhale);

            // Add to flash IDs
            setFlashTradeIds((prev) => {
              const next = new Set(prev);
              newTrades.slice(0, 3).forEach((t) => next.add(t.id));
              return next;
            });

            // Clear flash after 800ms
            setTimeout(() => {
              setFlashTradeIds((prev) => {
                const next = new Set(prev);
                newTrades.forEach((t) => next.delete(t.id));
                return next;
              });
            }, 800);
          }

          return incomingTrades;
        });
      }
    });

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [symbol, isPaused, isAudioEnabled]);

  // Filtered trades list
  const filteredTrades = useMemo(() => {
    let list = trades;
    if (filterSide === "BUY") {
      list = list.filter((t) => t.side === "BUY");
    } else if (filterSide === "SELL") {
      list = list.filter((t) => t.side === "SELL");
    } else if (filterSide === "WHALE") {
      list = list.filter((t) => t.isWhale || t.totalUsd >= 10000);
    }
    return list.slice(0, maxTrades);
  }, [trades, filterSide, maxTrades]);

  // Aggregate Order Flow Metrics
  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
    const sample = trades.slice(0, 50);
    let buyVol = 0;
    let sellVol = 0;
    let whaleCount = 0;
    let maxTradeUsd = 0;

    sample.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.side === "BUY") buyVol += t.totalUsd;
      else sellVol += t.totalUsd;
      if (t.isWhale || t.totalUsd >= 10000) whaleCount++;
      if (t.totalUsd > maxTradeUsd) maxTradeUsd = t.totalUsd;
    });

    const totalVol = buyVol + sellVol;
    const buyPercent = totalVol > 0 ? Math.round((buyVol / totalVol) * 100) : 50;
    const sellPercent = 100 - buyPercent;

    return {
      buyVol,
      sellVol,
      totalVol,
      buyPercent,
      sellPercent,
      whaleCount,
      maxTradeUsd,
      tradeCount: sample.length,
    };
  }, [trades]);

  // Force manual refresh from Binance REST API
  const handleManualRefresh = async () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true);
    await liveMarketFeedService.fetchRecentTradesFromBinance(symbol);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsRefreshing(false);
      setTrades(liveMarketFeedService.getRecentTrades(symbol));
    }, 400);
  };

  // Export CSV for SEC Reg ATS audit trail
  const handleExportTrades = (format: "csv" | "json") => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const data = trades.map((t) => ({
        id: t.id,
        symbol: t.symbol,
        price: t.price,
        quantity: t.quantity,
        totalUsd: t.totalUsd,
        side: t.side,
        timestampIso: new Date(t.timestamp).toISOString(),
        source: t.source,
        isWhale: !!t.isWhale,
      }));

      let fileData: string;
      let mimeType: string;
      let filename = `trades_${symbol.replace("/", "_")}_${Date.now()}`;

      if (format === "csv") {
        const headers = ["ID", "SYMBOL", "PRICE", "QTY", "TOTAL_USD", "SIDE", "TIMESTAMP_ISO", "SOURCE", "IS_WHALE"];
        const rows = data.map((d) =>
          [d.id, d.symbol, d.price, d.quantity, d.totalUsd, d.side, d.timestampIso, d.source, d.isWhale].join(",")
        );
        fileData = [headers.join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
        mimeType = "text/csv";
        filename += ".csv";
      } else {
        fileData = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
        mimeType = "application/json";
        filename += ".json";
      }

      const blob = new Blob([fileData], { type: mimeType });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = url;
      link.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Export failed:", e);
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => setIsExporting(false), 600);
    }
  };

  const primarySource = useMemo(() => {
    const top = trades[0];
    if (!top) return "BINANCE_WS";
    if (top.source === "BINANCE_WEBSOCKET") return "BINANCE_WS";
    if (top.source === "BINANCE_REST") return "BINANCE_REST";
    if (top.source === "COINGECKO_FEED") return "COINGECKO";
    return "TWE_ATS";
  }, [trades]);

  return (
    <div
      className={`bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg flex flex-col backdrop-blur-sm ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Component Header Bar */}

              >

    const zkScore = j.zkIdentityEnabled ? 95 : 50;
    const latencyScore = Math.max(20, Math.min(100, 115 - j.latencyMs * 1.2));

      return tierThresholdsPct[j.tier] ?? velocityThresholdTargetPct;
    }
    return velocityThresholdTargetPct;
  };

  const belowThresholdAlerts = useMemo(() => {
    return un193States
      .map((j) => {
        const velocityPct = getStateAdoptionVelocityPct(j);
        const targetPct = getEffectiveTargetThresholdPct(j);
        const deficitPct = Number((targetPct - velocityPct).toFixed(1));
        const isBelowTarget = velocityPct < targetPct;
        const severity: "CRITICAL_BREACH" | "BELOW_TARGET_WARNING" | "COMPLIANT" =
          velocityPct < criticalVelocityFloorPct
            ? "CRITICAL_BREACH"
            : isBelowTarget
            ? "BELOW_TARGET_WARNING"
            : "COMPLIANT";
        return {
          jurisdiction: j,
          velocityPct,
          targetPct,
          deficitPct,
          isBelowTarget,
          severity,
        };
      })
      .filter((item) => item.isBelowTarget)
      .sort((a, b) => b.deficitPct - a.deficitPct);
  }, [
    un193States,
    velocityThresholdTargetPct,
    criticalVelocityFloorPct,
    tierSpecificThresholdsEnabled,
    tierThresholdsPct,
    customStateVelocityBoosts,
  ]);

  const handleRemediateLaggingState = (isoCode: string, targetPct: number) => {
    const boosted = Math.min(100, Math.max(targetPct + 4, 88));
    setCustomStateVelocityBoosts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [isoCode]: boosted,
    }));
    setUn193States((prev) =>
      prev.map((j) =>
        j.isoCode === isoCode
          ? { ...j, autoKycEnabled: true, nodeStatus: "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR" }
          : j
      )
    );
    showToast(
      `Remediated ${isoCode} compliance adoption velocity to ${boosted}% (above ${targetPct}% threshold).`
    );
  };

  const handleBulkRemediateTopLaggingStates = (count: number = 15) => {
    const targets = belowThresholdAlerts.slice(0, count);
    if (targets.length === 0) return;
    const nextBoosts: Record<string, number> = { ...customStateVelocityBoosts };
    const targetIsos = new Set<string>();
    targets.forEach((t) => {
      targetIsos.add(t.jurisdiction.isoCode);
      nextBoosts[t.jurisdiction.isoCode] = Math.min(100, Math.max(t.targetPct + 5, 90));
    });
    setCustomStateVelocityBoosts(nextBoosts);
    setUn193States((prev) =>
      prev.map((j) =>
        targetIsos.has(j.isoCode)
          ? { ...j, autoKycEnabled: true, nodeStatus: "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR" }
          : j
      )
    );
    showToast(
      `Boosted ${targets.length} lagging UN Member States above the ${velocityThresholdTargetPct}% compliance adoption velocity threshold.`
    );
  };

  const un193AuditTotals = useMemo(() => {

    un193States.forEach((j) => {

        fullyCompliant += 1;
      } else {
        pendingKyc += 1;
      }
    });
    const total = un193States.length || 193;
    return {
      total,
      fullyCompliant,
      pendingKyc,
      compliantPct: ((fullyCompliant / total) * 100).toFixed(1),
      pendingPct: ((pendingKyc / total) * 100).toFixed(1),
    };
  }, [un193States]);

          "30-Day Adoption Velocity (%)": Number(

          ),
          total: un193AuditTotals.pendingKyc,
        },
      ];
    }

    if (unChartAxisMode === "TIER") {
      const tiers: Array<{ id: "TIER_1" | "TIER_2" | "TIER_3"; label: string }> =
        [
          { id: "TIER_1", label: "Tier 1 Hubs" },
          { id: "TIER_2", label: "Tier 2 Hubs" },
          { id: "TIER_3", label: "Tier 3 Global" },

      return tiers.map((t) => {
        const subset = un193States.filter((j) => j.tier === t.id);
        const subTotal = Math.max(1, subset.length);
        const fc = subset.filter(
          (j) => getUnStateComplianceStatus(j) === "Fully Compliant"
        ).length;
        const pk = subset.length - fc;
        return {
          group: t.label,
          "Fully Compliant": fc,
          "Pending KYC": pk,
          "30-Day Adoption Velocity (%)": Number(
            (((fc + pk * 0.55) / subTotal) * 100).toFixed(1)
          ),
          total: subset.length,
        };
      });
    }

    const continents: Array<{ id: WorldContinentId; short: string }> = [
      { id: "North America", short: "N. America" },
      { id: "South America", short: "S. America" },
      { id: "Europe", short: "Europe" },
      { id: "Middle East & Africa", short: "MEA" },
      { id: "Asia", short: "Asia" },
      { id: "Oceania", short: "Oceania" },
    ];
    return continents.map((c) => {
      const subset = un193States.filter((j) => j.continent === c.id);
      const subTotal = Math.max(1, subset.length);
      const fc = subset.filter(
        (j) => getUnStateComplianceStatus(j) === "Fully Compliant"
      ).length;
      const pk = subset.length - fc;
      return {
        group: c.short,
        fullContinent: c.id,
        "Fully Compliant": fc,
        "Pending KYC": pk,
        "30-Day Adoption Velocity (%)": Number(
          (((fc + pk * 0.55) / subTotal) * 100).toFixed(1)

        total: subset.length,
      };
    });
  }, [un193States, unChartAxisMode, un193AuditTotals]);

  const playAlertChime = () => {
    try {
      const AudioCtx =
        window.AudioContext ||
        (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioCtx) return;
      const ctx = new AudioCtx();
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = "sine";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(440, ctx.currentTime + 0.28);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.28);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.29);
    } catch {
      // Audio playback might be restricted without user interaction
    }
  };

    showToast("Exported certified institutional SEC Compliance Dossier JSON.");
  };

  // Regulatory Submission: Download Audit Report (CSV)
  const handleDownloadAuditReport = () => {
    const reportDate = new Date();
    const batchId = `SEC-CAT-SPOOF-${reportDate.getTime().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`;

    const escapeCsv = (val: string | number | undefined | null) => {
      if (val === undefined || val === null) return '""';
      const str = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""');
      return `"${str}"`;
    };

    const headers = [
      "RECORD_TYPE",
      "INCIDENT_ALERT_ID",
      "FLAGGED_CANCELLATION_TIMESTAMP_UTC",
      "FLAGGED_TIMESTAMP_EPOCH_MS",
      "FLAGGED_TIME_EST",
      "BURST_SEQUENCE_ID",
      "SYMBOL",
      "ORDER_SIDE",
      "PRICE_LEVEL",
      "LIMIT_PRICE_USD",
      "CANCELLED_VOLUME",
      "CANCELLATIONS_IN_BURST",
      "EXECUTED_FILLS",
      "CANCEL_RATIO_PCT",
      "AVG_RESTING_TIME_MS",
      "RISK_SCORE",
      "SEVERITY",
      "DETECTED_SPOOFING_PATTERN",
      "PATTERN_FORENSIC_SUMMARY",
      "SUSPECT_PARTICIPANT_WALLET",
      "COMPLIANCE_DISPOSITION",
      "REGULATORY_FRAMEWORK",
      "EXCHANGE_VENUE",
      "CAT_SUBMISSION_BATCH_ID",
      "CHIEF_COMPLIANCE_OFFICER_SIGNATURE",
    ];

    const rows: string[][] = [];

    spoofingAlerts.forEach((alert) => {
      // 1. Primary Detected Spoofing Pattern Cluster Record
      rows.push([
        escapeCsv("DETECTED_SPOOFING_PATTERN_CLUSTER"),
        escapeCsv(alert.id),
        escapeCsv(new Date(alert.timestamp).toISOString()),
        escapeCsv(alert.timestamp),
        escapeCsv(new Date(alert.timestamp).toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "America/New_York" }) + " EST"),
        escapeCsv("CLUSTER_SUMMARY"),
        escapeCsv(alert.symbol),
        escapeCsv(alert.side),
        escapeCsv(alert.priceLevel),
        escapeCsv(alert.price.toFixed(2)),
        escapeCsv(alert.cancelledVolume),
        escapeCsv(alert.cancellationCount),
        escapeCsv(alert.fillCount),
        escapeCsv(`${alert.cancelToFillRatio.toFixed(1)}%`),
        escapeCsv(`${alert.avgRestingTimeMs}ms`),
        escapeCsv(alert.riskScore),
        escapeCsv(alert.severity),
        escapeCsv(alert.severity.replace(/_/g, " ")),
        escapeCsv(alert.patternDescription),
        escapeCsv(alert.suspectTrader),
        escapeCsv(alert.status),
        escapeCsv("SEC Reg ATS Rule 301(b)(10) / FINRA Rule 5210 / 15 U.S.C. § 78j(b) / CEA § 6c(a)(5)(C)"),
        escapeCsv("Token World Exchange (TWE) ATS®"),
        escapeCsv(batchId),
        escapeCsv(`Attested by ${OWNER_PROFILE.soleOwnerName}, Chief Compliance Officer`),
      ]);

      // 2. Granular Flagged Order Cancellation Timestamps Tape
      const granularCount = Math.min(alert.cancellationCount, 12);
      const avgVol = Math.round(alert.cancelledVolume / Math.max(1, alert.cancellationCount));
      for (let seq = 1; seq <= granularCount; seq++) {
        const orderTimeMs = alert.timestamp - (granularCount - seq) * Math.max(1, Math.round(alert.avgRestingTimeMs / 2));
        const restingMs = Math.max(14, Math.round(alert.avgRestingTimeMs + Math.cos(seq) * 5));
        rows.push([
          escapeCsv("FLAGGED_CANCELLATION_TIMESTAMP_EVENT"),
          escapeCsv(`${alert.id}-ORDER-${String(seq).padStart(3, "0")}`),
          escapeCsv(new Date(orderTimeMs).toISOString()),
          escapeCsv(orderTimeMs),
          escapeCsv(new Date(orderTimeMs).toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "America/New_York" }) + " EST"),
          escapeCsv(`CANCEL_ORDER_${seq}_OF_${alert.cancellationCount}`),
          escapeCsv(alert.symbol),
          escapeCsv(alert.side),
          escapeCsv(alert.priceLevel),
          escapeCsv(alert.price.toFixed(2)),
          escapeCsv(avgVol),
          escapeCsv(1),
          escapeCsv(0),
          escapeCsv("100.0%"),
          escapeCsv(`${restingMs}ms`),
          escapeCsv(alert.riskScore),
          escapeCsv(alert.severity),
          escapeCsv(`Rapid Quote Stuffing / Non-Bona Fide Withdrawal Event #${seq}`),
          escapeCsv(`Flagged top-of-book order withdrawn after ${restingMs}ms resting duration`),
          escapeCsv(alert.suspectTrader),
          escapeCsv(alert.status),
          escapeCsv("FINRA Rule 5210 Non-Bona Fide Order Withdrawal"),
          escapeCsv("Token World Exchange (TWE) ATS®"),
          escapeCsv(batchId),
          escapeCsv(`Attested by ${OWNER_PROFILE.soleOwnerName}, Chief Compliance Officer`),
        ]);
      }
    });

    const csvContent =
      "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8," + [headers.join(","), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(","))].join("\n");
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute("download", `TWE_ATS_Spoofing_Surveillance_Audit_Report_${Date.now()}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);

    showToast(`Downloaded official Spoofing Surveillance Audit Report CSV (${spoofingAlerts.length} patterns & flagged cancellation timestamps).`);
  };

  const unacknowledgedSpoofCount = useMemo(() => {
    return spoofingAlerts.filter((a) => a.status === "NEW").length;
  }, [spoofingAlerts]);

  const handleAcknowledgeSpoofAlert = (id: string) => {
    setSpoofingAlerts((prev) =>
      prev.map((a) => (a.id === id ? { ...a, status: "ACKNOWLEDGED", isRead: true } : a))
    );
    if (activeAlertBanner?.id === id) {
      setActiveAlertBanner(null);
    }
    showToast(`Acknowledged spoofing alert ${id}.`);
  };

  const handleFreezeTraderMarketAccess = (traderAddress: string, alertId: string) => {
    handleFlagKyc(traderAddress);
    setSpoofingAlerts((prev) =>
      prev.map((a) =>
        a.id === alertId || a.suspectTrader.includes(traderAddress)
          ? { ...a, status: "ACCESS_RESTRICTED", isRead: true }
          : a
      )
    );
    if (activeAlertBanner?.id === alertId) {
      setActiveAlertBanner(null);
    }
    showToast(`REVOKED ATS MATCHING ACCESS for ${traderAddress}. Placed under AML sanction freeze.`);
  };

  const handleFlagForSecTcr = (alert: SpoofingAlert) => {
    setSpoofingAlerts((prev) =>
      prev.map((a) => (a.id === alert.id ? { ...a, status: "FLAGGED_FOR_SEC", isRead: true } : a))
    );

    const report = {
      agency: "U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) - Division of Enforcement",
      form: "Form TCR (Tip, Complaint or Referral) - Market Manipulation / Spoofing Alert Dossier",
      venue: "Token World Exchange (TWE) ATS®",
      soleOwner: OWNER_PROFILE.soleOwnerName,
      headquarters: OWNER_PROFILE.headquarters,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      alertRecord: alert,
      statutoryViolations: [
        "15 U.S.C. § 78j(b) and 17 CFR § 240.10b-5 (Employment of Manipulative and Deceptive Devices)",
        "FINRA Rule 5210 (Publication of Transactions and Quotations - Non-Bona Fide Bids/Offers)",
        "Commodity Exchange Act 7 U.S.C. § 6c(a)(5)(C) (Prohibition against Spoofing and Layering)",
      ],
    };

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `SEC_Form_TCR_Spoofing_Alert_${alert.id}_${Date.now()}.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

    if (activeAlertBanner?.id === alert.id) {
      setActiveAlertBanner(null);
    }
    showToast(`Filed SEC Form TCR Referral and exported dossier for alert ${alert.id}.`);
  };

  const handleToggleAlertStatus = (alertId: string, nextStatus: SpoofingAlert["status"]) => {
    setSpoofingAlerts((prev) =>
      prev.map((a) => (a.id === alertId ? { ...a, status: nextStatus, isRead: true } : a))
    );
  };

  const handleSimulateBurstTrigger = () => {
    const burstVol = 48500 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 28000);
    const burstResting = 22 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25);
    const burstTrader = "0x44BcA912c98F9082A81B0941F480414B60Ef110C (HFT Layering Bot)";
    const alertId = `SPOOF-ALERT-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;

    const newAlert: SpoofingAlert = {
      id: alertId,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      symbol: "TW-EQ",
      side: "ASK",
      priceLevel: "$52.75 (Ask +1 / Top-of-Book)",
      price: 52.75,
      cancelledVolume: burstVol,
      cancellationCount: 28,
      fillCount: 0,
      cancelToFillRatio: 100,
      avgRestingTimeMs: burstResting,
      riskScore: 99,
      severity: "CRITICAL_SPOOFER",
      suspectTrader: burstTrader,
      patternDescription: `Real-time top-of-book spoofing cluster detected: ${burstVol.toLocaleString()} phantom shares flashed and withdrawn in ${burstResting}ms to manipulate NBBO spread.`,
      status: "NEW",
      isRead: false,
    };

    handleNewSpoofingAlert(newAlert);
    showToast(`Simulated high-volume cancellation cluster on TW-EQ: ${burstVol.toLocaleString()} shares in ${burstResting}ms!`);
  };

  const filteredKyc = useMemo(() => {
    return kycRecords.filter((k) => {
      const matchSearch =
        k.legalName.toLowerCase().includes(kycSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
        k.walletAddress.toLowerCase().includes(kycSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
        k.id.toLowerCase().includes(kycSearch.toLowerCase());
      const matchTier = kycTierFilter === "ALL" || k.tier === kycTierFilter;
      return matchSearch && matchTier;
    });
  }, [kycRecords, kycSearch, kycTierFilter]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans pb-16">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-5">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-cyan-400" />
              <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">
                Regulatory Compliance & SEC Audit Hub
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Token World Exchange (TWE) ATS® · Chief Compliance Terminal · Founder & Sole Owner: {OWNER_PROFILE.soleOwnerName}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              data-testid="open-velocity-threshold-modal-btn"
              onClick={() => setIsVelocityThresholdModalOpen(true)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded font-bold transition-colors shadow-sm whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
              title="Configure custom percentage-based threshold alerts for compliance adoption velocity"
            >
              <Sliders className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>
                Velocity Alert Threshold ({velocityThresholdTargetPct}%) ·{" "}
                {belowThresholdAlerts.length} Flagged
              </span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-testid="compliance-download-all-twe-code-link"
              onClick={async () => {
                const masterBtn = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
                  '[data-testid="one-click-download-all-everything-btn"]'
                );
                if (masterBtn) {
                  masterBtn.click();
                  showToast("Triggered 1-Click Download of all TWE Codes (.ZIP + .JSON + .MD + .ENV)!");
                  return;
                }
                try {
                  const res = await fetch("/api/twe/download-complete-archive?format=zip");
                  const blob = await res.blob();
                  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                  const a = document.createElement("a");
                  a.href = url;
                  a.download = "Token_World_Exchange_TWE_Complete_Fullstack_Archive.zip";
                  document.body.appendChild(a);
                  a.click();
                  document.body.removeChild(a);
                  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                  showToast("Downloaded Token_World_Exchange_TWE_Complete_Fullstack_Archive.zip!");
                } catch {
                  showToast("Download initiated.");
                }
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded font-semibold transition-colors shadow-sm whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
              title="Download all source codes, variables, integrations, and chat prompts & answers of Token World Exchange ATS (TWE) in 1 click"
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>⚡ 1-Click Download All TWE Code (.ZIP)</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleDownloadAuditReport}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded font-semibold transition-colors shadow-sm whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
              title="Download CSV Audit Report of detected spoofing patterns and flagged cancellation timestamps for regulatory submission"
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
              Download Audit Report (CSV)
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleExportCsvAudit}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded transition-colors whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              Export KYC Audit CSV
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleExportJsonDossier}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-white text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
              SEC Compliance JSON
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Compliance Adoption Velocity Threshold Warning Banner (Triggered when Member States fall below target %) */}
      {velocityAlertWarningEnabled && belowThresholdAlerts.length > 0 && (
        <div
          className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full px-4 mt-3"
          role="alert"
          data-testid="velocity-threshold-warning-banner"
        >
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-500/60 text-amber-100 space-y-3 shadow-lg">
            <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-400/50 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-300 shrink-0">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
                    <span className="font-bold text-amber-300 uppercase">
                      Compliance Adoption Velocity Threshold Warning
                    </span>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-bold tabular-nums">
                      Target Threshold: &ge;{velocityThresholdTargetPct}%
                    </span>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                    <span className="text-rose-300 font-bold tabular-nums">
                      {belowThresholdAlerts.length} / {un193States.length} Member States Below Target (
                      {
                        belowThresholdAlerts.filter(
                          (a) => a.severity === "CRITICAL_BREACH"
                        ).length
                      }{" "}
                      Critical &lt;{criticalVelocityFloorPct}%)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-1">
                    {belowThresholdAlerts.length} UN member state jurisdiction(s) are currently operating
                    below your configured {velocityThresholdTargetPct}% compliance adoption velocity
                    threshold. Review lagging nodes or adjust threshold rules in the configuration modal.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-testid="configure-velocity-thresholds-banner-btn"
                  onClick={() => setIsVelocityThresholdModalOpen(true)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer transition whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Configure Thresholds ({velocityThresholdTargetPct}%)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleBulkRemediateTopLaggingStates(15)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-semibold text-xs cursor-pointer transition whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Boost Top 15 Lagging States
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setVelocityAlertWarningEnabled(false)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-xs cursor-pointer transition"
                >
                  Mute Warning
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Top Lagging Member States Strip */}
            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-amber-500/30 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
              <span className="text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                Lowest Velocity States:
              </span>
              {belowThresholdAlerts.slice(0, 8).map((item) => (
                <button
                  key={item.jurisdiction.isoCode}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    handleRemediateLaggingState(
                      item.jurisdiction.isoCode,
                      item.targetPct
                    )
                  }
                  title={`Click to remediate ${item.jurisdiction.countryName} above ${item.targetPct}% threshold`}
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded border cursor-pointer transition tabular-nums ${
                    item.severity === "CRITICAL_BREACH"
                      ? "bg-rose-950/80 border-rose-500/60 text-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-900"
                      : "bg-amber-950/80 border-amber-500/50 text-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-900"
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.jurisdiction.countryName} ({item.jurisdiction.isoCode}):{" "}
                  {item.velocityPct}% / {item.targetPct}% ({-item.deficitPct}%)
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Toast */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full px-4 mt-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-cyan-950/60 border border-cyan-500/50 text-cyan-200 text-xs rounded flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{toastMessage}</span>
            </div>
            <button onClick={() => setToastMessage(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Live Real-Time Spoofing Alert Banner */}
      {activeAlertBanner && (
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full px-4 mt-3">
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-950/95 via-red-950/90 to-slate-900 border-2 border-rose-500/80 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-pulse">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0 shadow-lg shadow-rose-600/50">
                <Flame className="w-5 h-5 animate-bounce" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-300 font-mono">
                    [LIVE REAL-TIME SPOOFING ANOMALY TRIGGERED]
                  </span>
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-rose-600 text-white">
                    {activeAlertBanner.symbol} · {activeAlertBanner.severity.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-white font-medium mt-0.5">
                  Rapid high-volume cancellation cluster: <strong className="text-amber-300 font-mono">{activeAlertBanner.cancelledVolume.toLocaleString()} shares</strong> cancelled in <strong className="text-rose-300 font-mono">{activeAlertBanner.avgRestingTimeMs}ms</strong> at <strong className="text-cyan-300 font-mono">{activeAlertBanner.priceLevel}</strong> by <span className="font-mono text-slate-300">{activeAlertBanner.suspectTrader.split(" ")[0]}</span>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setActiveTab("SPOOFING_ALERTS");
                  setActiveAlertBanner(null);
                }}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white shadow-md transition-colors"
              >
                Investigate in Alert Log
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() =>
                  handleFreezeTraderMarketAccess(
                    activeAlertBanner.suspectTrader.split(" ")[0],
                    activeAlertBanner.id
                  )
                }
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-purple-900 hover:bg-purple-800 text-purple-200 border border-purple-600 transition-colors"
              >
                Freeze Trader Access
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveAlertBanner(null)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Interactive Recharts Bar Chart: 193-UN-Member-State 'Fully Compliant' vs 'Pending KYC' Visual Audit */}
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full px-4 pt-4">
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold">
                  193-UN-MEMBER-STATE VISUAL AUDIT
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-cyan-400">
                  Interactive Recharts BarChart Telemetry
                </span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white mt-1">
                193-UN-Member-State Compliance Audit — &apos;Fully Compliant&apos; vs. &apos;Pending KYC&apos; States
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUnChartAxisMode("CONTINENT")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded border cursor-pointer transition ${
                  unChartAxisMode === "CONTINENT"
                    ? "bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 font-bold border-cyan-400"
                    : "bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800"
                }`}
              >
                By 6 Continents
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUnChartAxisMode("TIER")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded border cursor-pointer transition ${
                  unChartAxisMode === "TIER"
                    ? "bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 font-bold border-cyan-400"
                    : "bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800"
                }`}
              >
                By Regulatory Tier
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUnChartAxisMode("DIRECT_COMPARISON")}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded border cursor-pointer transition ${
                  unChartAxisMode === "DIRECT_COMPARISON"
                    ? "bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 font-bold border-cyan-400"
                    : "bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800"
                }`}
              >
                Direct Status Totals
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleBatchApprove193PendingKyc(10)}

contract ${cleanSymbol}NFTCollection is ERC721Enumerable, Ownable2Step {
    using Strings for uint256;

    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 10000;
    uint256 public constant MINT_PRICE = 0.05 ether;
    string public baseTokenURI;
    bool public isMintActive;

    // Token metadata tracking
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _tokenURIs;

    event Minted(address indexed recipient, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event BaseURIUpdated(string newURI);

    constructor(address initialOwner, string memory _initialBaseURI) 
        ERC721("${cleanName}", "${cleanSymbol}") 
        Ownable(initialOwner) 
    {
        baseTokenURI = _initialBaseURI;
        isMintActive = true;
        
        // Genesis Mint #1 to Deployer
        _safeMint(initialOwner, 1);
    }

    function mint(uint256 quantity) external payable {
        require(isMintActive, "Minting is currently paused");
        require(totalSupply() + quantity <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Exceeds max collection supply");
        require(msg.value >= MINT_PRICE * quantity, "Insufficient ETH sent for mint");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            uint256 mintId = totalSupply() + 1;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, mintId);
            emit Minted(msg.sender, mintId);
        }
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        _requireOwned(tokenId);
        return bytes(baseTokenURI).length > 0 
            ? string(abi.encodePacked(baseTokenURI, tokenId.toString(), ".json")) 
            : "";
    }

    function setBaseURI(string memory _newURI) external onlyOwner {
        baseTokenURI = _newURI;
        emit BaseURIUpdated(_newURI);
    }

    function setMintActive(bool _active) external onlyOwner {
        isMintActive = _active;
    }

    function withdraw() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to withdraw");

    }

pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Permit.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Burnable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol";

/**
 * @title ${cleanName} Protocol (${cleanSymbol})
 * @author Mauro L. Dar III
 * @notice Invented and architected by Mauro L. Dar III
 * @notice 2026 EVM Cryptocurrency Invention - Uncapped Continuous Minting Protocol
 * 
 * PROTOCOL LIMIT SPECIFICATIONS:
 * 1. Maximum Mint Limit (Technical): EVM uint256 max = 2^256 - 1 (~1.15e77 raw units, ~1.15e59 tokens at 18 dec).
 * 2. Maximum Mint Limit (Design): Hardcoded supply cap is explicitly OMITTED. Authorized minters
 *    can continually mint up to type(uint256).max.
 * 3. Market Pricing: Target order book valuation: $${selectedToken.priceUsd.toLocaleString()} / token.
 */
contract ${cleanSymbol}UncappedProtocol is ERC20, ERC20Permit, ERC20Burnable, AccessControl {
    bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = keccak256("MINTER_ROLE");
    uint256 public constant PROTOCOL_THEORETICAL_MAX = type(uint256).max;

    event ContinuousMintExecuted(address indexed minter, address indexed recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 newTotalSupply);
    event BatchContinuousMintExecuted(address indexed minter, uint256 totalRecipients, uint256 totalAmount);

    constructor(address initialAdmin, address initialMinter) 
        ERC20("${cleanName}", "${cleanSymbol}") 
        ERC20Permit("${cleanName}") 
    {
        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, initialAdmin);
        _grantRole(MINTER_ROLE, initialMinter);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Continually mints without an arbitrary design cap up to the 256-bit technical limit
     */
    function continuousMint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) {
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= PROTOCOL_THEORETICAL_MAX, "EVM 256-bit integer overflow limit reached");
        _mint(to, amount);
        emit ContinuousMintExecuted(msg.sender, to, amount, totalSupply());
    }

    /**
     * @notice Batch distribution for order book liquidity provisioning
     */
    function batchContinuousMint(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) 
        external 
        onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) 
    {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "Mismatched array lengths");
        uint256 total = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            total += amounts[i];
            _mint(recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
        emit BatchContinuousMintExecuted(msg.sender, recipients.length, total);
    }

    function remainingMintCapacity() external view returns (uint256) {
        return PROTOCOL_THEORETICAL_MAX - totalSupply();
    }
}`;
