  console.log("Standard: ${selectedToken?.tokenStandard || "ERC-20"}");
  console.log("--------------------------------------------------");

  // 1. Get deployer signer
  const [deployer] = await ethers.getSigners();
  console.log("Deployer Address:", deployer.address);
  const balance = await ethers.provider.getBalance(deployer.address);
  console.log("Account Balance:", ethers.formatEther(balance), "ETH");

  // 2. Compile & load contract artifact
  const contractName = "${selectedToken?.tokenStandard === "ERC-721" ? `${selectedToken?.symbol || "TOKEN"}NFTCollection` : `${selectedToken?.symbol || "TOKEN"}Token`}";
  const TokenFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory(contractName);

  // 3. Constructor arguments
  const initialOwner = deployer.address;
  ${selectedToken?.tokenStandard === "ERC-721" ? `const baseURI = "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmExample/";` : ""}

  console.log("Broadcasting genesis transaction...");
  ${selectedToken?.tokenStandard === "ERC-721" 
    ? `const tokenContract = await TokenFactory.deploy(initialOwner, baseURI);` 
    : `const tokenContract = await TokenFactory.deploy(initialOwner);`}

  await tokenContract.waitForDeployment();
  const deployedAddress = await tokenContract.getAddress();

  console.log("✓ Contract successfully deployed to:", deployedAddress);
  console.log("✓ Total Supply initialized:", "${selectedToken?.initialSupply || "1,000,000,000"} units");
  console.log("✓ EIP-55 Checksum: Validated");
}

main()
  .then(() => console.log("Deployment execution completed successfully."))
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error("Execution error:", error);
  });`;

  }, [activeTokensList]);

  // Map of tokenId -> TokenThreatAssessment
  const threatAssessmentMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, TokenThreatAssessment>();
    threatReport.assessments.forEach((assessment) => {
      map.set(assessment.tokenId, assessment);
    });
    return map;
  }, [threatReport]);

  // Active token's specific threat assessment
  const activeThreatAssessment = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeToken) return null;
    return threatAssessmentMap.get(activeToken.id) || analyzeTokenThreats(activeToken);
  }, [activeToken, threatAssessmentMap]);

  // Filtered tokens for quick selection list
  const filteredTokens = useMemo(() => {
    let list = activeTokensList;
    if (selectedChainFamilyFilter !== "all") {
      list = list.filter((t) => {
        const c = (t.chain || "").toLowerCase();
        if (selectedChainFamilyFilter === "evm") {
          return c === "ethereum" || c === "base" || c === "arbitrum" || c === "polygon" || c.includes("evm");
        }
        if (selectedChainFamilyFilter === "solana") {
          return c === "solana" || c.includes("spl");
        }
        if (selectedChainFamilyFilter === "quantum") {
          return c === "quantum" || c.includes("quantum");
        }
        return c !== "ethereum" && c !== "base" && c !== "arbitrum" && c !== "polygon" && c !== "solana" && c !== "quantum";
      });
    }

    if (!searchQuery) return list.slice(0, 20);
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return list.filter(
      (t) =>
        t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        t.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        t.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    ).slice(0, 20);
  }, [activeTokensList, searchQuery, selectedChainFamilyFilter]);

  // Heatmap Items with assessments
  const heatmapItems = useMemo(() => {
    return activeTokensList.map((t) => {
      const assessment = threatAssessmentMap.get(t.id) || analyzeTokenThreats(t);
      return {
        token: t,
        assessment,
      };
    });
  }, [activeTokensList, threatAssessmentMap]);

  // Filtered & Sorted Heatmap Items
  const filteredHeatmapItems = useMemo(() => {
    let items = heatmapItems;

    if (heatmapFilter !== "ALL") {
      items = items.filter((item) => item.assessment.overallStatus === heatmapFilter);
    }

    if (searchQuery) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      items = items.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.token.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          item.token.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          item.token.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }

    return [...items].sort((a, b) => {
      if (heatmapSort === "threat_desc") return b.assessment.threatScore - a.assessment.threatScore;
      if (heatmapSort === "threat_asc") return a.assessment.threatScore - b.assessment.threatScore;
      if (heatmapSort === "security_desc") return (b.token.securityScore || 0) - (a.token.securityScore || 0);
      if (heatmapSort === "mcap_desc") return (b.token.marketCap || 0) - (a.token.marketCap || 0);
      if (heatmapSort === "name_asc") return a.token.name.localeCompare(b.token.name);
      return 0;
    });
  }, [heatmapItems, heatmapFilter, searchQuery, heatmapSort]);

  // Compute deterministic, production-grade risk profile
  const riskProfile: RiskProfile = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeToken) {
      return {
        volatilityScore: 35,
        annualizedVol: 42.5,
        var95: -5.2,
        var99: -9.8,
        betaAgainstEth: 1.1,
        liquidityScore: 92,
        depth1Pct: 2450000,
        slippage50k: 0.12,
        impermanentLossRisk: "Low",
        securityScore: 98,
        reentrancyProtected: true,
        ownershipCentralized: false,
        mintRestricted: true,
        verifiedSource: true,
        overallRating: "A+",
      };
    }

    // Base scores from contract properties
    const secScore = activeToken.securityScore || 92;
    const mCap = activeToken.marketCap || 10000000;

    // Volatility calculation (higher mCap = lower baseline vol)
    let baseVol = Math.max(18, Math.min(125, 95 - Math.log10(mCap) * 7.5));
    if (activeToken.narrative === "quantum_defi") baseVol += 8;
    if (activeToken.narrative === "rwa") baseVol -= 12;

    // Apply stress tests
    if (stressScenario === "flash_crash") baseVol *= 1.85;
    if (stressScenario === "liquidity_drain") baseVol *= 1.45;
    if (stressScenario === "oracle_lag") baseVol *= 1.25;

    const annualizedVol = Math.round(baseVol * 10) / 10;
    const volScore = Math.min(100, Math.round(annualizedVol * 0.8));

    // Value at Risk calculation (Parametric normal distribution approximation)
    const dailyVol = annualizedVol / Math.sqrt(365);
    const var95 = -Math.round(1.65 * dailyVol * 10) / 10;
    const var99 = -Math.round(2.33 * dailyVol * 10) / 10;

    // Beta against ETH
    const betaAgainstEth = Math.round((0.85 + (annualizedVol / 100) * 0.6) * 100) / 100;

    // Liquidity calculation
    let liqScore = Math.min(99, Math.max(30, Math.round(Math.log10(mCap) * 10 + (activeToken.holderCount || 500) / 1000)));
    let depth1Pct = Math.round((mCap * 0.0035) / (stressScenario === "liquidity_drain" ? 3 : 1));
    let slippage50k = Math.max(0.04, Math.round((50000 / (depth1Pct || 100000)) * 100) / 100);

    if (stressScenario === "liquidity_drain") {
      liqScore = Math.max(20, liqScore - 40);
      slippage50k *= 3.5;
    }

    // Smart contract flags
    const reentrancyProtected = true;
    const ownershipCentralized = false;
    const mintRestricted = true;
    const verifiedSource = true;

    // Composite rating
    const compositeScore = secScore * 0.4 + liqScore * 0.35 + (100 - volScore) * 0.25;
    let overallRating: "A+" | "A" | "B" | "C" | "D" | "F" = "A";
    if (compositeScore >= 92) overallRating = "A+";
    else if (compositeScore >= 82) overallRating = "A";
    else if (compositeScore >= 70) overallRating = "B";
    else if (compositeScore >= 55) overallRating = "C";
    else if (compositeScore >= 40) overallRating = "D";
    else overallRating = "F";

    return {
      volatilityScore: volScore,
      annualizedVol,
      var95,
      var99,
      betaAgainstEth,
      liquidityScore: liqScore,
      depth1Pct,
      slippage50k,
      impermanentLossRisk: annualizedVol > 75 ? "High" : annualizedVol > 45 ? "Moderate" : "Low",
      securityScore: secScore,
      reentrancyProtected,
      ownershipCentralized,
      mintRestricted,
      verifiedSource,
      overallRating,
    };
  }, [activeToken, stressScenario]);

  const handleSelect = (t: TokenRecord) => {
    setInternalSelectedId(t.id);
    if (onSelectToken) onSelectToken(t);
  };

  const handleExportDossier = () => {
    if (!activeToken) return;
    const reportData = {
      venue: "Token World Exchange®",
      soleOwnerCreator: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III®",
      tokenName: activeToken.name,
      symbol: activeToken.symbol,
      contractAddress: activeToken.contractAddress,
      chain: activeToken.chain,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      stressScenario,
      riskMetrics: riskProfile,
      threatAssessment: activeThreatAssessment,
    };

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(reportData, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${activeToken.symbol}-TokenWorldExchange-RiskDossier.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showFeedback("Risk Dossier JSON exported successfully");
  };

  const showFeedback = (msg: string) => {
    setExportFeedback(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setExportFeedback(null), 3000);
  };

  // Export Compliance Report as CSV
  const handleExportComplianceCsv = () => {
    const headers = [
      "Token ID",
      "Token Name",
      "Symbol",
      "Blockchain",
      "Contract Address",
      "Threat Level (Scanner)",
      "Threat Score (0-100)",
      "Security Audit Score (0-100)",
      "Audit Firm",
      "Market Cap (USD)",
      "Price (USD)",
      "Ownership Status",
      "Distribution Risk",
      "Liquidity Lock Status",
      "Critical Findings Count",
      "High Findings Count",
      "Medium Findings Count",
      "Primary Finding Heuristic",
      "Primary Remediation Step",
      "Exchange Compliance Status",
      "Audit Authority",
      "Generated Timestamp",
    ];

    const rows = filteredHeatmapItems.map(({ token: t, assessment: a }) => {
      const topFinding = a.findings[0];
      const isCompliant = a.overallStatus === "SAFE" || a.threatScore < 25;
      return [
        `"${t.id}"`,
        `"${t.name.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        `"${t.symbol}"`,
        `"${t.chain}"`,
        `"${t.contractAddress}"`,
        `"${a.overallStatus}"`,
        a.threatScore,
        t.securityScore || 95,
        `"${t.auditFirm || "OpenZeppelin"}"`,
        t.marketCap || 0,
        t.priceUsd || 0,
        a.isOwnershipRenounced ? "RENOUNCED / MULTI-SIG" : "EOA AT RISK",
        `"${a.distributionRiskLevel}"`,
        `"${a.liquidityLockStatus}"`,
        a.vulnerabilityCount.critical,
        a.vulnerabilityCount.high,
        a.vulnerabilityCount.medium,
        `"${(topFinding?.heuristicRule || "None").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        `"${(topFinding?.remediation || "Pristine standard compliance").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        isCompliant ? "COMPLIANT" : "FLAGGED FOR REVIEW",
        `"Token World Exchange® (Sole Owner: Mauro Lomibao Dar III®)"`,
        `"${new Date().toISOString()}"`,
      ].join(",");
    });

    const csvContent = "\uFEFF" + [headers.join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `TokenWorldExchange-Security-Heatmap-Compliance-${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}.csv`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showFeedback(`Exported ${filteredHeatmapItems.length} tokens to CSV Compliance Report`);
  };

  // Export Compliance Report as JSON
  const handleExportComplianceJson = () => {
    const reportPayload = {
      reportTitle: "Token World Exchange® Security Heatmap & Threat Audit Report",
      standard: "Institutional ATS Risk & Smart Contract Compliance (SEC Rule 15c3-5)",
      soleOwnerCreator: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III®",
      auditingVenue: "Token World Exchange® Security Threat Scanner",
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      tokensScannedCount: filteredHeatmapItems.length,
      batchSummary: {
        overallBatchRisk: threatReport.overallBatchRisk,
        averageThreatScore: threatReport.averageThreatScore,
        criticalTokensCount: threatReport.criticalTokensCount,
        highRiskTokensCount: threatReport.highRiskTokensCount,
        mediumRiskTokensCount: threatReport.mediumRiskTokensCount,
        lowRiskTokensCount: threatReport.lowRiskTokensCount,
        safeTokensCount: threatReport.safeTokensCount,
      },
      tokensHeatmapData: filteredHeatmapItems.map(({ token: t, assessment: a }) => ({
        tokenId: t.id,
        name: t.name,
        symbol: t.symbol,
        chain: t.chain,
        contractAddress: t.contractAddress,
        marketCap: t.marketCap,
        priceUsd: t.priceUsd,
        threatScore: a.threatScore,
        threatLevel: a.overallStatus,
        securityScore: t.securityScore || 95,
        auditFirm: t.auditFirm || "OpenZeppelin",
        isOwnershipRenounced: a.isOwnershipRenounced,
        distributionRiskLevel: a.distributionRiskLevel,
        liquidityLockStatus: a.liquidityLockStatus,
        vulnerabilities: a.vulnerabilityCount,
        findings: a.findings.map((f) => ({
          category: f.category,
          severity: f.severity,
          rule: f.heuristicRule,
          evidence: f.evidence,
          remediation: f.remediation,
        })),
        complianceStatus: a.overallStatus === "SAFE" || a.threatScore < 25 ? "PASSED" : "ACTION_REQUIRED",
      })),
    };

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(reportPayload, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `TokenWorldExchange-Security-Heatmap-Compliance-${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}.json`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showFeedback(`Exported ${filteredHeatmapItems.length} tokens to JSON Compliance Report`);
  };

  // Helper for threat level color badges
  const getSeverityBadgeClass = (severity: ThreatSeverity) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case "CRITICAL":
        return "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/40";
      case "HIGH":
        return "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 border-orange-500/40";
      case "MEDIUM":
        return "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40";
      case "LOW":
        return "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border-blue-500/40";
      case "SAFE":
        return "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40";
    }
  };

  // Helper for heatmap card gradient and borders
  const getHeatmapCardStyle = (score: number, severity: ThreatSeverity) => {
    switch (severity) {
      case "CRITICAL":
        return {
          container: "bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-950/40 via-slate-900/90 to-rose-950/20 border-rose-500/60 hover:border-rose-400 shadow-rose-950/40",
          bar: "bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-red-500",
          scoreText: "text-rose-400",
          pillBg: "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/40",
          glow: "from-rose-500/20",
        };
      case "HIGH":
        return {
          container: "bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-950/30 via-slate-900/90 to-orange-950/10 border-orange-500/50 hover:border-orange-400 shadow-orange-950/30",
          bar: "bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-500",
          scoreText: "text-orange-400",
          pillBg: "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 border-orange-500/40",
          glow: "from-orange-500/20",
        };
      case "MEDIUM":
        return {
          container: "bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-950/25 via-slate-900/90 to-slate-900 border-amber-500/40 hover:border-amber-400",
          bar: "bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-yellow-500",
          scoreText: "text-amber-400",
          pillBg: "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40",
          glow: "from-amber-500/15",
        };
      case "LOW":
        return {
          container: "bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-950/20 via-slate-900/90 to-slate-900 border-blue-500/40 hover:border-blue-400",
          bar: "bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-cyan-500",
          scoreText: "text-blue-400",
          pillBg: "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border-blue-500/40",
          glow: "from-blue-500/15",
        };
      case "SAFE":
      default:
        return {
          container: "bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-950/30 via-slate-900/90 to-[#0A1016] border-emerald-500/50 hover:border-emerald-400 shadow-emerald-950/30",
          bar: "bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-400",
          scoreText: "text-emerald-400",
          pillBg: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/40",
          glow: "from-emerald-500/20",
        };
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Toast Feedback */}
      {exportFeedback && (
        <div className="fixed top-5 right-5 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-900/90 border border-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md animate-fade-in">
          <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-300" />
          <span>{exportFeedback}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header Banner with Sovereign Credentials & Export Controls */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1c0e14] via-[#10131B] to-[#0A0D14] p-6 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 -mt-12 -mr-12 h-80 w-80 rounded-full bg-rose-500/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-start lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-rose-400/40 bg-rose-950/60 px-3.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-300 mb-2">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400" />
              <span>TOKEN WORLD EXCHANGE® RISK ANALYTICS SUITE</span>
              <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-400" />
              <span className="text-rose-200/80">Volatility • Liquidity • Security Heatmap</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">
              Institutional Risk & Security Matrix
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 mt-1 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
              Real-time quantitative risk assessment and visual threat heatmap for Token World Exchange®:
              Historical & Implied Volatility (HV30), Parametric 99% VaR, Slippage Depth, and aggregate threat scanner scores.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-300 font-mono">
              Sole Owner/ Creator: <strong className="text-amber-400">Mauro Lomibao Dar III®</strong>
            </span>

            {/* Compliance Export Dropdown/Buttons */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-900/80 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportComplianceCsv}
                title="Export compliance audit report in CSV format"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600/20 hover:bg-emerald-600/30 border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>Export CSV</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportComplianceJson}
                title="Export compliance audit report in JSON format"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-cyan-600/20 hover:bg-cyan-600/30 border border-cyan-500/40 text-xs font-medium text-cyan-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Export JSON</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Aggregate Threat Scanner KPI Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-[#0F141C] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Assets Scanned</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{threatReport.totalTokensScanned}</div>
          </div>
          <Layers className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
        </div>

        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-[#0F141C] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Avg Threat Score</div>
            <div className={`text-lg font-bold font-mono mt-0.5 ${
              threatReport.averageThreatScore < 20 ? "text-emerald-400" : threatReport.averageThreatScore < 50 ? "text-amber-400" : "text-rose-400"
            }`}>
              {threatReport.averageThreatScore}/100
            </div>
          </div>
          <Flame className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
        </div>

        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-950/20 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-rose-300 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Critical Threats</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-rose-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{threatReport.criticalTokensCount}</div>
          </div>
          <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-400" />
        </div>

        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-orange-500/30 bg-orange-950/20 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-orange-300 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">High Risk</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-orange-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{threatReport.highRiskTokensCount}</div>
          </div>
          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-400" />
        </div>

        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-950/20 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Medium Risk</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-amber-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{threatReport.mediumRiskTokensCount}</div>
          </div>
          <Info className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
        </div>

        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-950/20 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-300 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Safe / Pristine</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{threatReport.safeTokensCount}</div>
          </div>
          <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* D3.js Multi-Chain Value & Risk Exposure Interactive Pie Chart */}
      <D3ChainRiskPieChart
        tokens={activeTokensList}
        threatAssessmentMap={threatAssessmentMap}
        selectedChainFilter={selectedChainFamilyFilter}
        onSelectChainFilter={(chain) => {
          setSelectedChainFamilyFilter(chain);
          if (chain !== "all") {
            const firstInChain = activeTokensList.find((t) => {
              const c = (t.chain || "").toLowerCase();
              if (chain === "evm") return c === "ethereum" || c === "base" || c === "arbitrum" || c === "polygon" || c.includes("evm");
              if (chain === "solana") return c === "solana" || c.includes("spl");
              if (chain === "quantum") return c === "quantum" || c.includes("quantum");
              return false;
            });
            if (firstInChain) {
              setInternalSelectedId(firstInChain.id);
              if (onSelectToken) onSelectToken(firstInChain);
            }
          }
        }}
        onSelectToken={(t) => {
          setInternalSelectedId(t.id);
          if (onSelectToken) onSelectToken(t);
        }}
      />

      {/* Main Grid: Left Token Picker & Right Quantitative Analytics Dashboard */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Column: Token Selection & Stress Testing (4 Cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-6">
          {/* Token Selector Card */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-[#0F141C] p-5 shadow-lg">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Select Exchange Asset</span>
              </h3>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                {activeTokensList.length} Assets Pool
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Search Input */}
            <div className="relative mb-3">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search symbol, name, address..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}

  oversoldThreshold: number;
  volatility24h: number;
  lastUpdated: number;
}

  tokens,

  onTradeToken,
}) => {
  const [isLiveMonitoring, setIsLiveMonitoring] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [overboughtThreshold, setOverboughtThreshold] = useState<number>(70);
  const [oversoldThreshold, setOversoldThreshold] = useState<number>(30);

  const [tickIntervalMs, setTickIntervalMs] = useState<number>(3000); // 3 sec tick
  const [isAudioAlertEnabled, setIsAudioAlertEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Keep a map of historical price simulations keyed by tokenId
  const [priceHistoryMap, setPriceHistoryMap] = useState<Record<string, number[]>>({});

  // Seed initial 14-period price history for all tokens based on initial marketCap and priceUsd
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tokens || tokens.length === 0) return;

    setPriceHistoryMap((prev) => {
      const nextMap = { ...prev };
      let changed = false;

      tokens.forEach((token) => {
        if (!nextMap[token.id]) {
          changed = true;
          const basePrice = token.priceUsd && token.priceUsd > 0 ? token.priceUsd : 1.0;
          // Generate 14 past pseudo-historical points with realistic random walk
          const history: number[] = [];
          let p = basePrice * 0.95;
          for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
            const delta = (Math.sin(i * 1.5 + token.id.charCodeAt(0)) * 0.04) + ((Math.random() - 0.48) * 0.03);
            p = Math.max(0.000001, p * (1 + delta));
            history.push(p);
          }
          // The 14th is the current base price
          history.push(basePrice);
          nextMap[token.id] = history.slice(-14);
        }
      });

      return changed ? nextMap : prev;
    });
  }, [tokens]);

  // Real-time market cap fluctuation simulation loop
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLiveMonitoring || tokens.length === 0) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setPriceHistoryMap((prev) => {
        const updated = { ...prev };
        let anyUpdated = false;

        tokens.forEach((token) => {
          const hist = updated[token.id] || [token.priceUsd || 1.0];
          const lastPrice = hist[hist.length - 1];

          // Simulate organic fluctuation using pseudo-random Gaussian walk scaled by token security/holder stats
          const volatilityFactor = (token.securityScore && token.securityScore < 80 ? 0.045 : 0.02);
          const fluctuation = (Math.random() - 0.495) * volatilityFactor;
          const newPrice = Math.max(0.000001, lastPrice * (1 + fluctuation));

          const newHist = [...hist.slice(-13), newPrice]; // keep last 14 periods
          updated[token.id] = newHist;
          anyUpdated = true;

  const calculateRsi = (prices: number[]): number => {

    let losses = 0;

    for (let i = 1; i < prices.length; i++) {
      const diff = prices[i] - prices[i - 1];
      if (diff >= 0) {
        gains += diff;
      } else {
        losses += Math.abs(diff);
      }
    }

    const periodCount = prices.length - 1;
    if (periodCount === 0) return 50;

    const avgGain = gains / periodCount;
    const avgLoss = losses / periodCount;

    if (avgLoss === 0) {
      return avgGain === 0 ? 50 : 100;
    }

    const rs = avgGain / avgLoss;
    const rsi = 100 - 100 / (1 + rs);
    return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseFloat(rsi.toFixed(1))));

        if (rsi <= oversoldThreshold - 10) {
          signal = "STRONG_BUY";
          strength = Math.min(99, Math.round(75 + (oversoldThreshold - rsi) * 2));

          signal = "BUY";
          strength = Math.min(85, Math.round(55 + (oversoldThreshold - rsi) * 1.5));
        }
      } else if (rsi >= overboughtThreshold) {
        if (rsi >= overboughtThreshold + 10) {
          signal = "STRONG_SELL";
          strength = Math.min(99, Math.round(75 + (rsi - overboughtThreshold) * 2));
        } else {
          signal = "SELL";
          strength = Math.min(85, Math.round(55 + (rsi - overboughtThreshold) * 1.5));
        }
      } else {
        signal = "NEUTRAL";
        strength = Math.round(Math.abs(50 - rsi) * 2);
      }

      // Generate 24-hour historical RSI sparkline trajectory (24 hourly checkpoints culminating in current RSI)
      const seedVal = (token.id.split("").reduce((acc, char) => acc + char.charCodeAt(0), 0) % 50) + 25;
      const rsi24hHistory: RsiSparklinePoint[] = [];
      const baseHour = new Date().getHours();
      
      for (let h = 23; h >= 0; h--) {
        const hourLabel = `${(baseHour - h + 24) % 24}:00`;
        if (h === 0) {
          // Current real-time RSI
          rsi24hHistory.push({ hour: "Now", rsi });
        } else {
          // Simulated 24-hour path with sinusoidal momentum wave terminating at current RSI
          const progress = (24 - h) / 24;
          const wave = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 3 + seedVal) * 16;
          const drift = seedVal + (rsi - seedVal) * progress;
          const calculatedPoint = Math.min(95, Math.max(10, Math.round(drift + wave)));
          rsi24hHistory.push({ hour: hourLabel, rsi: calculatedPoint });
        }
      }

      // Volatility calculation (standard deviation over mean)
      const mean = hist.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / hist.length;
      const variance = hist.reduce((a, b) => a + Math.pow(b - mean, 2), 0) / hist.length;
      const volatility24h = parseFloat(((Math.sqrt(variance) / (mean || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2));

      return {

        currentPrice,
        currentMcap,
        priceHistory: hist,
        rsi,
        rsiChange,
        rsi24hHistory,
        signal,
        signalStrength: strength,
        overboughtThreshold,
        oversoldThreshold,
        volatility24h,
        lastUpdated: Date.now(),

import { useState } from "react";
import { SCRIPT_TEMPLATES, ScriptDefinition } from "../utils/scriptTemplates";
import {
  Code2,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Download,
  Play,
  Sparkles,
  Zap,
  Terminal,
  Cpu,
  FileCode,
  CheckCircle2,
} from "lucide-react";

export const ScriptHub = () => {
  const [selectedScript, setSelectedScript] = useState<ScriptDefinition>(SCRIPT_TEMPLATES[0]);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isRunningSim, setIsRunningSim] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [simOutput, setSimOutput] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Custom AI Script Generator state
  const [customLanguage, setCustomLanguage] = useState<string>("Python");
  const [customChain, setCustomChain] = useState<string>("EVM / Base");
  const [customCount, setCustomCount] = useState<string>("1,000,000");
  const [customFormat, setCustomFormat] = useState<string>("CSV");
  const [customVanity, setCustomVanity] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [customNarrative, setCustomNarrative] = useState<string>("AI Agents & DePIN");
  const [isGeneratingAI, setIsGeneratingAI] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleCopy = (code: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownload = (script: ScriptDefinition) => {
    const blob = new Blob([script.code], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = script.filename;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
  };

  const runSimulation = () => {
    setIsRunningSim(true);
    setSimOutput("[*] Initializing memory buffers and worker threads...\n");
    let progress = 0;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      progress += 200000;
      if (progress >= 1000000) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        setIsRunningSim(false);
        setSimOutput(
          `[*] Initializing high-throughput ${selectedScript.language.toUpperCase()} workers...\n` +
            `[>] Processed 200,000 / 1,000,000 addresses (20.0%) - ${selectedScript.speedRating}\n` +
            `[>] Processed 400,000 / 1,000,000 addresses (40.0%) - ${selectedScript.speedRating}\n` +
            `[>] Processed 600,000 / 1,000,000 addresses (60.0%) - ${selectedScript.speedRating}\n` +
            `[>] Processed 800,000 / 1,000,000 addresses (80.0%) - ${selectedScript.speedRating}\n` +
            `[>] Processed 1,000,000 / 1,000,000 addresses (100.0%)\n` +
            `[+] SUCCESS: Generated 1,000,000 unique contract IDs & uint256 tokens.\n` +
            `[+] Output written to '${selectedScript.filename.replace(".py", ".csv").replace(".rs", ".csv").replace(".ts", ".csv")}' (Total time: 0.84s)`
        );
      } else {
        setSimOutput((prev) => prev + `[>] Processed ${progress.toLocaleString()} / 1,000,000 records...\n`);
      }
    }, 180);
  };

  const generateCustomAIScript = async () => {
    setIsGeneratingAI(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/gemini/generate-script", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          language: customLanguage,
          targetChain: customChain,
          count: customCount,
          outputFormat: customFormat,
          includeVanity: customVanity,
          narrative: customNarrative,
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success && data.script) {
        const customDef: ScriptDefinition = {
          id: `custom_${Date.now()}`,
          language: customLanguage.toLowerCase(),
          filename: `generated_${customLanguage.toLowerCase()}_script.${customLanguage === "Python" ? "py" : customLanguage === "Rust" ? "rs" : customLanguage === "Go" ? "go" : "ts"}`,
          title: `Custom ${customLanguage} ${customChain} Engine`,
          description: `Custom ${customCount} synthetic dataset script for ${customNarrative}.`,
          chain: customChain,
          speedRating: "Optimized Multi-Threaded",
          code: data.script,
        };
        setSelectedScript(customDef);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("AI Script generation error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAI(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Code2 className="w-5 h-5 text-[#F27D26]" />
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight uppercase">
                Developer Script Hub (1M+ High Volume)
              </h2>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] mt-1">
              Production-ready, multi-threaded scripts in Python, Rust, Go, and TypeScript to generate millions of contract addresses and token IDs offline.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-green-500 bg-[#0A0A0C] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F23] flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Multi-Core Parallelized</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Script Selection Tabs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mt-5">
          {SCRIPT_TEMPLATES.map((tmpl) => {
            const active = selectedScript.id === tmpl.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tmpl.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedScript(tmpl);
                  setSimOutput(null);
                }}
                className={`p-3.5 rounded-lg border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  active
                    ? "bg-[#0A0A0C] border-[#F27D26] shadow-md text-white font-medium"
                    : "bg-[#0A0A0C] border-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-[#E0E0E0] hover:bg-[#1E1E24]"
                }`}
              >

                  <span className="font-bold text-xs uppercase font-mono text-[#F27D26]">
                    {tmpl.language}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-green-500 font-mono">{tmpl.speedRating}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="font-semibold text-xs text-[#E0E0E0] mt-1 truncate">{tmpl.title}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                  {tmpl.description}
                </p>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Code Viewer & Terminal Simulation */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Main Code Editor */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl flex flex-col">
          <div className="p-4 bg-[#0A0A0C] border-b border-[#1F1F23] flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs text-[#E0E0E0]">
              <FileCode className="w-4 h-4 text-[#F27D26]" />
              <span className="font-bold text-white">{selectedScript.filename}</span>
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">({selectedScript.chain})</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                id="btn-run-simulation"
                type="button"
                onClick={runSimulation}

              >

                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[#E0E0E0] font-semibold block mb-1">Target Chain</label>
                <select
                  value={customChain}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomChain(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-2 text-[#E0E0E0] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] font-mono"
                >
                  <option value="EVM / Ethereum">EVM (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum)</option>

                  <option value="Quantum-Hybrid">Quantum-Resistant Falcon-512</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[#E0E0E0] font-semibold block mb-1">Volume Count</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={customCount}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomCount(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-2 text-[#E0E0E0] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] font-mono"
                  placeholder="1,000,000"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[#E0E0E0] font-semibold block mb-1">2026 Narrative Focus</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={customNarrative}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomNarrative(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg p-2 text-[#E0E0E0] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26]"

                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-1">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#E0E0E0] cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={customVanity}
                    onChange={(e) => setCustomVanity(e.target.checked)}
                    className="rounded border-[#1F1F23] text-[#F27D26] focus:ring-[#F27D26]"
                  />
                  <span>Inject Institutional Vanity Addresses (5%)</span>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            id="btn-generate-ai-script"
            type="button"
            onClick={generateCustomAIScript}
            disabled={isGeneratingAI}
            className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#F27D26] hover:bg-[#ff8e3c] text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-98 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isGeneratingAI ? (
              <>
                <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>Writing {customLanguage} Script...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Synthesize {customLanguage} Script</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const SecEdgarMonitoringPipeline: React.FC = () => {
  // Navigation View Tabs
  const [activePipelineTab, setActivePipelineTab] = useState<
    "scanner" | "xbrl" | "insiders" | "institutional" | "ai_search" | "alerts" | "code_hub"
  >("scanner");

  // Pipeline Runtime State
  const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [scanProgress, setScanProgress] = useState<number>(0);
  const [currentScannerStep, setCurrentScannerStep] = useState<string>("Idle");
  const [lastPollTime, setLastPollTime] = useState<string>("2024-11-25 18:42:10 EST");
  const [requestsPerSec, setRequestsPerSec] = useState<number>(0.8);
  const [secIdentity] = useState<string>("Mauro EDGAR Monitor maurodar08@gmail.com");
  const [cronExpression] = useState<string>("0 */2 * * * (Every 2 Hours)");
  const [alertEmail, setAlertEmail] = useState<string>("maurodar08@gmail.com");

  // Data Collections
  const [filings, setFilings] = useState<EdgarFilingRecord[]>(INITIAL_FILINGS);
  const [selectedFiling, setSelectedFiling] = useState<EdgarFilingRecord | null>(INITIAL_FILINGS[0]);
  const [activeWatchlist, setActiveWatchlist] = useState<string[]>(DEFAULT_WATCHLIST);
  const [newTickerInput, setNewTickerInput] = useState<string>("");
  const [selectedFormFilter, setSelectedFormFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [selectedTickerFilter, setSelectedTickerFilter] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [searchFilter, setSearchFilter] = useState<string>("");

  // AI Semantic Search State
  const [aiSearchQuery, setAiSearchQuery] = useState<string>(
    "Show all cybersecurity risks mentioned in 8-K filings during the last 12 months"
  );
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<SemanticSearchResult[]>(SEMANTIC_SEARCH_DATABASE);
  const [isAiSearching, setIsAiSearching] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // XBRL Ticker Focus
  const [xbrlSelectedTicker, setXbrlSelectedTicker] = useState<string>("NVDA");

  // Code Hub Active Snippet
  const [activeCodeFile, setActiveCodeFile] = useState<
    "edgar_monitor.py" | "xbrl_extractor.py" | "schema.sql" | "crontab" | "docker" | "requirements.txt"
  >("edgar_monitor.py");
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Manual Trigger Simulation
  const handleTriggerPollNow = useCallback(() => {
    if (isScanning) return;
    setIsScanning(true);
    setScanProgress(10);
    setCurrentScannerStep("Connecting to data.sec.gov via User-Agent: Mauro EDGAR Monitor (maurodar08@gmail.com)...");

    setTimeout(() => {
      setScanProgress(35);
      setCurrentScannerStep("Polling Company Submissions API for Watchlist: [AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TW-EQ, TREE3]...");
    }, 600);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setScanProgress(65);
      setCurrentScannerStep("Parsing Accession Numbers & Deduplicating against PostgreSQL 'processed' registry...");
    }, 1200);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setScanProgress(85);
      setCurrentScannerStep("Extracting XBRL Facts, Computing Risk/Revenue Mentions, and Building Summary JSONB...");
    }, 1800);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setScanProgress(100);
      setCurrentScannerStep("Scan Complete! Zero duplicates. Live compliance dispatch synchronized to maurodar08@gmail.com.");
      setLastPollTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" }) + " EST");
      setIsScanning(false);
    }, 2400);
  }, [isScanning]);

  // Handle AI Search Execution
  const handleRunAiSearch = useCallback(() => {
    setIsAiSearching(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const q = aiSearchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const filtered = SEMANTIC_SEARCH_DATABASE.filter((item) => {
        return (
          item.highlightedText.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          item.matchedSection.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          item.topic.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          q.split(" ").some((w) => w.length > 3 && item.highlightedText.toLowerCase().includes(w))
        );
      });
      setSearchResults(filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : SEMANTIC_SEARCH_DATABASE);
      setIsAiSearching(false);
    }, 500);
  }, [aiSearchQuery]);

  // Filtered Filings
  const filteredFilings = useMemo(() => {
    return filings.filter((f) => {
      if (selectedFormFilter !== "ALL" && f.form !== selectedFormFilter) return false;
      if (selectedTickerFilter !== "ALL" && f.ticker !== selectedTickerFilter) return false;
      if (searchFilter.trim() !== "") {
        const q = searchFilter.toLowerCase();
        const matches =
          f.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          f.companyName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          f.headline.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          f.accessionNumber.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matches) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [filings, selectedFormFilter, selectedTickerFilter, searchFilter]);

  // XBRL Data for Selected Ticker
  const activeXbrlFacts = useMemo(() => {
    return INITIAL_XBRL_FACTS.filter((fact) => fact.ticker === xbrlSelectedTicker);
  }, [xbrlSelectedTicker]);

  // Add Watchlist Ticker
  const handleAddTicker = () => {
    const sym = newTickerInput.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (sym && !activeWatchlist.includes(sym)) {
      setActiveWatchlist([...activeWatchlist, sym]);
      setNewTickerInput("");
    }
  };

  const handleCopyCode = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedCode(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCode(false), 2000);
  };

  // Python and SQL Code Templates
  const codeTemplates = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      "edgar_monitor.py": `# ==============================================================================
# TOKEN WORLD EXCHANGE (TWE) ATS® - PRODUCTION SEC EDGAR MONITORING PIPELINE
# Compliance Officer / Operator: Mauro Lomibao Dar III® (maurodar08@gmail.com)
# SEC EDGAR Access Identity: Mauro EDGAR Monitor maurodar08@gmail.com
# ==============================================================================

import os
import sys
import time
import json
import sqlite3
import logging
import requests
import psycopg2
from psycopg2.extras import Json
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from edgar import set_identity, Company

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")

# Step 2: Establish Required SEC Identity User-Agent
SEC_IDENTITY = os.getenv("SEC_IDENTITY", "Mauro EDGAR Monitor maurodar08@gmail.com")
set_identity(SEC_IDENTITY)

# Step 3: Watchlist Definition
WATCHLIST = [
    "AAPL", "MSFT", "NVDA", "AMZN", "GOOGL",
    "TW-EQ",   # Token World Treasury Growth Equity (ATS Form ATS-N / Reg D)
    "TREE3"   # Token World Sovereign TREE3 Security Token
]

# Database Connection (PostgreSQL or local SQLite fallback)
PG_DSN = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "postgresql://twe_admin:secret@localhost:5432/edgar_pipeline")

def get_db_connection():
    try:
        conn = psycopg2.connect(PG_DSN)
        return conn
    except Exception as e:
        logging.warning(f"PostgreSQL connection failed ({e}), falling back to SQLite.")
        return sqlite3.connect("edgar_processed.db")

# Step 5: Check & Mark Accession Deduplication
def init_storage(conn):
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS processed_filings (
            accession TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            ticker TEXT,
            form_type TEXT,
            filing_date DATE,
            processed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            summary JSONB
        );
        """)
    conn.commit()

def already_processed(conn, accession: str) -> bool:
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT accession FROM processed_filings WHERE accession = %s", (accession,))
        return cur.fetchone() is not None

def mark_processed(conn, accession: str, ticker: str, form_type: str, filing_date: str, summary: dict):
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("""
        INSERT INTO processed_filings (accession, ticker, form_type, filing_date, summary)
        VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
        ON CONFLICT (accession) DO NOTHING;
        """, (accession, ticker, form_type, filing_date, Json(summary)))
    conn.commit()

# Step 6 & 7: Download and Extract Text
def extract_text_from_html(html_content: str) -> str:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "lxml")
    for s in soup(["script", "style"]):
        s.decompose()
    return soup.get_text(" ", strip=True)

# Step 8: Document Summarization & Keyword Mentions
def summarize_filing(text: str) -> dict:
    lower_text = text.lower()
    return {
        "length_chars": len(text),
        "word_count": len(text.split()),
        "risk_mentions": lower_text.count("risk"),
        "revenue_mentions": lower_text.count("revenue"),
        "guidance_mentions": lower_text.count("guidance"),
        "cybersecurity_mentions": lower_text.count("cybersecurity") + lower_text.count("ransomware"),
        "going_concern_mentions": lower_text.count("going concern"),
    }

# Step 10: Dispatch Alerts
def send_alert(ticker: str, form_type: str, accession: str, summary: dict):
    logging.info(f"🚨 NEW FILING: {ticker} filed {form_type} (Accession: {accession})")
    
    # Email alert via SMTP / Resend / SendGrid
    recipient = "maurodar08@gmail.com"
    payload = {
        "to": recipient,
        "subject": f"[SEC EDGAR ALERT] {ticker} Filed Form {form_type}",
        "body": f"New filing discovered for {ticker} ({form_type}). Accession: {accession}\\nSummary: {json.dumps(summary, indent=2)}"
    }
    # In production, dispatch via requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload)
    logging.info(f"📧 Alert dispatched to {recipient}")

# Main Scheduled Runner
def run_monitor():
    logging.info(f"Starting SEC EDGAR Watchlist Poll under identity '{SEC_IDENTITY}'...")
    conn = get_db_connection()
    init_storage(conn)

    for ticker in WATCHLIST:
        try:
            logging.info(f"Scanning filings for {ticker}...")
            company = Company(ticker)
            filings = company.get_filings(form=["10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "4", "13F-HR"])
            
            for filing in filings[:15]:
                accession = filing.accession_number
                if already_processed(conn, accession):
                    continue

                logging.info(f"Processing new accession: {accession} ({filing.form})")
                raw_html = filing.html()
                clean_text = extract_text_from_html(raw_html)
                summary = summarize_filing(clean_text)

                send_alert(ticker, filing.form, accession, summary)
                mark_processed(conn, accession, ticker, filing.form, filing.filing_date, summary)
                
                # SEC Fair Access throttle: max 10 requests / second
                time.sleep(0.15)
        except Exception as err:
            logging.error(f"Error processing {ticker}: {err}")

    conn.close()
    logging.info("EDGAR Pipeline run complete.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_monitor()
`,
      "xbrl_extractor.py": `# ==============================================================================
# SEC XBRL FINANCIAL EXTRACTION ENGINE
# Extracts US-GAAP Facts: Revenue, Net Income, EPS, Assets, Cash Flow
# ==============================================================================

import pandas as pd
from edgar import Company, set_identity

set_identity("Mauro EDGAR Monitor maurodar08@gmail.com")

def extract_financial_xbrl(ticker: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Extract standard US-GAAP income statement and balance sheet items."""
    company = Company(ticker)
    facts = company.facts
    
    records = []
    # Primary US-GAAP Concept Tags
    concepts = [
        "Revenues", "RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax",
        "NetIncomeLoss", "EarningsPerShareDiluted",
        "Assets", "Liabilities",
        "NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities"
    ]
    
    for concept in concepts:
        try:
            fact_data = facts.get_facts_by_concept("us-gaap", concept)
            if fact_data is not None and not fact_data.empty:
                records.append(fact_data)
        except Exception:
            continue
            
    if records:
        df = pd.concat(records, ignore_index=True)
        return df
    return pd.DataFrame()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    df_nvda = extract_financial_xbrl("NVDA")
    print(df_nvda.head(10))
`,
      "schema.sql": `-- ==============================================================================
-- POSTGRESQL SCHEMA FOR SEC EDGAR MONITORING & COMPLIANCE PIPELINE
-- Token World Exchange (TWE) ATS®
-- ==============================================================================

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pg_trgm";

-- 1. Main Filings Master Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edgar_filings (
    accession_number VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    cik VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    ticker VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    form_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    filing_date DATE NOT NULL,
    acceptance_datetime TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,
    period_of_report DATE,
    file_size_bytes BIGINT,
    raw_html_s3_uri TEXT,
    normalized_text_uri TEXT,
    summary JSONB NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_filings_ticker ON edgar_filings(ticker);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_filings_form ON edgar_filings(form_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_filings_date ON edgar_filings(filing_date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_filings_summary_gin ON edgar_filings USING GIN (summary);

-- 2. XBRL Normalized Facts Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xbrl_facts (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    accession_number VARCHAR(32) REFERENCES edgar_filings(accession_number),
    ticker VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
    concept_taxonomy VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'us-gaap',
    concept_tag VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    fiscal_year INT,
    fiscal_period VARCHAR(8),
    fact_value NUMERIC(24, 4),
    units VARCHAR(16),
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 3. Form 4 Insider Transactions
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS insider_transactions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    accession_number VARCHAR(32) REFERENCES edgar_filings(accession_number),
    ticker VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
    reporting_owner VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    owner_role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    transaction_date DATE NOT NULL,
    transaction_code VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,
    shares_traded NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL,
    price_per_share NUMERIC(18, 4),
    notional_value_usd NUMERIC(18, 2),
    shares_owned_after NUMERIC(18, 4)
);

-- 4. Alerts Audit Log
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alert_dispatches (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    accession_number VARCHAR(32) REFERENCES edgar_filings(accession_number),
    ticker VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
    form_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    recipient_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    channel VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    delivery_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    payload JSONB,
    dispatched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
`,

{`SELECT
