  // Initialize & Subscribe to Firestore Watchlist
  useEffect(() => {
    loadWatchlist().then((list) => {
      setWatchlist(list);
      setFilings(getFilingsForWatchlist(list));
    });

    const unsubscribe = subscribeToWatchlist((updatedList) => {
      setWatchlist(updatedList);
      setFilings(getFilingsForWatchlist(updatedList));
      setIsWatchlistSynced(true);
    });

    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  // Update filings when watchlist changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setFilings(getFilingsForWatchlist(watchlist));
    if (!watchlist.includes(selectedTickerForAnalytics) && watchlist.length > 0) {
      setSelectedTickerForAnalytics(watchlist[0]);
    }
  }, [watchlist]);

  // Check for High-Risk Alerts whenever filings or settings change
  useEffect(() => {
    const unacknowledged = alertHistory.filter((a) => !a.acknowledged);
    if (unacknowledged.length > 0 && alertSettings.enableBannerToast) {
      setActiveBannerAlert(unacknowledged[0]);
    }
  }, [alertHistory, alertSettings.enableBannerToast]);

  // Add Ticker
  const handleAddTicker = async () => {
    const clean = newTickerInput.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!clean) return;
    if (watchlist.includes(clean)) {
      setNewTickerInput("");
      return;
    }
    const nextList = [...watchlist, clean];
    setWatchlist(nextList);
    setNewTickerInput("");
    setIsWatchlistSynced(false);
    await saveWatchlist(nextList);
    setIsWatchlistSynced(true);
  };

  // Remove Ticker
  const handleRemoveTicker = async (tickerToRemove: string) => {
    if (watchlist.length <= 1) return; // Keep at least one
    const nextList = watchlist.filter((t) => t !== tickerToRemove);
    setWatchlist(nextList);
    setIsWatchlistSynced(false);
    await saveWatchlist(nextList);
    setIsWatchlistSynced(true);
  };

  // Save Settings
  const handleSaveSettings = (newSettings: AlertSensitivitySettings) => {
    setAlertSettings(newSettings);
    saveAlertSettings(newSettings);
    setIsSettingsModalOpen(false);

    // Evaluate current filings against new thresholds to see if a new alert triggers
    for (const filing of filings) {
      const isRiskBreach = filing.summary.risk_mentions >= newSettings.riskThreshold;
      const isRevBreach = filing.summary.revenue_mentions >= newSettings.revenueThreshold;

      if ((filing.form === "8-K" && isRiskBreach) || (!newSettings.alertOnHighRisk8KOnly && (isRiskBreach || isRevBreach))) {
        const existing = alertHistory.find((a) => a.accessionNumber === filing.accessionNumber);
        if (!existing) {
          const newAlert: AlertHistoryItem = {
            id: `alt_${Date.now()}_${filing.ticker}`,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            ticker: filing.ticker,
            companyName: filing.companyName,
            form: filing.form,
            accessionNumber: filing.accessionNumber,
            triggerReason: `Threshold Breach: ${filing.summary.risk_mentions} risk mentions exceed custom threshold (${newSettings.riskThreshold})`,
            riskMentions: filing.summary.risk_mentions,
            revenueMentions: filing.summary.revenue_mentions,
            filingUrl: filing.secEdgarUrl,
            emailSentTo: newSettings.notifyEmail,
            severity: filing.form === "8-K" ? "CRITICAL" : "HIGH",
            acknowledged: false,
          };
          const updatedHistory = [newAlert, ...alertHistory];
          setAlertHistory(updatedHistory);
          saveAlertHistory(updatedHistory);
          if (newSettings.enableBannerToast) {
            setActiveBannerAlert(newAlert);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  };

  // Dismiss Banner Alert
  const handleDismissBanner = () => {
    if (activeBannerAlert) {
      const updated = alertHistory.map((a) =>
        a.id === activeBannerAlert.id ? { ...a, acknowledged: true } : a
      );
      setAlertHistory(updated);
      saveAlertHistory(updated);
      setActiveBannerAlert(null);
    }
  };

  // Refresh RSS Feed with dynamic categorized breaking item
  const handleRefreshRss = () => {
    setIsRefreshingFeed(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const targetTicker = watchlist[Math.floor(Math.random() * watchlist.length)] || "TWE";
      const sampleCategories: Array<{
        category: SecDisclosureCategory;
        form: string;
        itemCode: string;
        dealValueOrImpact: string;
        filingParty: string;
        urgencyLevel: "CRITICAL" | "HIGH" | "ELEVATED" | "STANDARD";
        headline: string;
        summary: string;
      }> = [
        {
          category: "Mergers & Acquisitions",
          form: "8-K",
          itemCode: "Item 1.01",
          dealValueOrImpact: "$5.8B Definitive Merger",
          filingParty: "Board M&A Special Committee",
          urgencyLevel: "CRITICAL",
          headline: `8-K - ${targetTicker} CORP (${targetTicker}) (Filer)`,
          summary: `Item 1.01 Entry into Material Definitive Agreement. ${targetTicker} entered into a binding merger agreement to acquire high-throughput tokenized RWA liquidity infrastructure.`,
        },
        {
          category: "Regulatory Action",
          form: "8-K",
          itemCode: "Item 8.01",
          dealValueOrImpact: "SEC Formal Ingestion Order",
          filingParty: "Office of the General Counsel",
          urgencyLevel: "HIGH",
          headline: `8-K - ${targetTicker} CORP (${targetTicker}) (Filer)`,
          summary: `Item 8.01 Other Events. Submission of FINRA Rule 15c3-5 automated risk filter certification and SEC Regulation ATS audit confirmation.`,
        },
        {
          category: "Insider Trading",
          form: "Form 4",
          itemCode: "Form 4 / Sec 16(a)",
          dealValueOrImpact: "85,000 Shares Sold ($12.4M)",
          filingParty: "Executive VP & Director",
          urgencyLevel: "HIGH",
          headline: `Form 4 - ${targetTicker} CORP (${targetTicker}) (Filer)`,
          summary: `Statement of Changes in Beneficial Ownership. Pre-scheduled Rule 10b5-1 portfolio disposition of 85,000 common shares executed under approved plan.`,
        },
        {
          category: "Financial Results",
          form: "8-K",
          itemCode: "Item 2.02",
          dealValueOrImpact: "Preliminary Net Revenues +24%",
          filingParty: "Chief Financial Officer",
          urgencyLevel: "ELEVATED",
          headline: `8-K - ${targetTicker} CORP (${targetTicker}) (Filer)`,
          summary: `Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition. Real-time trading revenues up +24% YoY with gross operating margin expansion.`,
        },
        {
          category: "Cybersecurity & Breaches",
          form: "8-K",
          itemCode: "Item 1.05",
          dealValueOrImpact: "Cryptographic Perimeter Hardened",
          filingParty: "Chief Information Security Officer",
          urgencyLevel: "HIGH",
          headline: `8-K - ${targetTicker} CORP (${targetTicker}) (Filer)`,
          summary: `Item 1.05 Material Cybersecurity Incident. Containment and zero-trust validation of third-party API gateway; zero user funds or private keys affected.`,
        },
        {
          category: "Tokenization & ATS",
          form: "8-K",
          itemCode: "Item 8.01 / Form ATS-N",
          dealValueOrImpact: "24/7 T+0 Atomic Settlement Live",
          filingParty: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III (Creator)",
          urgencyLevel: "CRITICAL",
          headline: `8-K - TOKEN WORLD EXCHANGE ATS (${targetTicker}) (Filer)`,
          summary: `Item 8.01 Other Events. Token World Exchange ATS® launched upgraded 140µs direct market access routing and DTCC FAST real-time custody settlement.`,
        },
      ];

      const chosen = sampleCategories[Math.floor(Math.random() * sampleCategories.length)];
      const newFiling: SecRssFeedItem = {
        id: `rss_feed_${Date.now()}`,
        title: chosen.headline,
        link: `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/000000/live-${Date.now()}.htm`,
        summary: chosen.summary,
        updated: new Date().toISOString(),
        ticker: targetTicker,
        form: chosen.form,
        accessionNumber: `0000999999-26-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900000 + 100000)}`,
        companyName: `${targetTicker} Corp`,
        cik: "0001984501",
        isBreaking: true,
        category: chosen.category,
        itemCode: chosen.itemCode,
        dealValueOrImpact: chosen.dealValueOrImpact,
        filingParty: chosen.filingParty,
        urgencyLevel: chosen.urgencyLevel,
      };
      setRssFeedItems((prev) => [newFiling, ...prev.slice(0, 24)]);
      setIsRefreshingFeed(false);
    }, 500);
  };

  // RSS Feed Category Counts
  const rssCategoryCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = { ALL: rssFeedItems.length };
    SEC_DISCLOSURE_CATEGORIES.forEach((cat) => {
      counts[cat] = rssFeedItems.filter((item) => item.category === cat).length;
    });
    return counts;
  }, [rssFeedItems]);

  // Filtered RSS Feed Items
  const filteredRssFeedItems = useMemo(() => {
    return rssFeedItems.filter((item) => {
      const matchesForm = rssFilterForm === "ALL" || item.form === rssFilterForm;
      const matchesCategory = selectedRssCategory === "ALL" || item.category === selectedRssCategory;
      const matchesBreaking = !rssBreakingOnly || item.isBreaking;
      const q = rssSearchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        item.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.summary.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.companyName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        item.accessionNumber.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (item.itemCode && item.itemCode.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (item.dealValueOrImpact && item.dealValueOrImpact.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (item.filingParty && item.filingParty.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (item.category && item.category.toLowerCase().includes(q));

      return matchesForm && matchesCategory && matchesBreaking && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [rssFeedItems, rssFilterForm, selectedRssCategory, rssBreakingOnly, rssSearchQuery]);

  // Filtered Filings
  const filteredFilings = useMemo(() => {
    return filings.filter((f) => {
      const matchesForm = selectedFormFilter === "ALL" || f.form === selectedFormFilter;
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesQuery =
        !q ||
        f.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.companyName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.accessionNumber.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.headline.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.rawText.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return matchesForm && matchesQuery;
    });
  }, [filings, selectedFormFilter, searchQuery]);

  // Aggregate Risk Heatmap Data for Watchlist
  const riskHeatmapData = useMemo(() => {
    return watchlist.map((ticker) => {
      const tickerFilings = filings.filter((f) => f.ticker.toUpperCase() === ticker.toUpperCase());
      const totalRisks = tickerFilings.reduce((acc, f) => acc + f.summary.risk_mentions, 0);
      const totalRev = tickerFilings.reduce((acc, f) => acc + f.summary.revenue_mentions, 0);
      const totalGuidance = tickerFilings.reduce((acc, f) => acc + f.summary.guidance_mentions, 0);
      const avgSentiment = tickerFilings.length
        ? Number((tickerFilings.reduce((acc, f) => acc + f.summary.sentiment_score, 0) / tickerFilings.length).toFixed(2))
        : 0;

      return {
        ticker,
        risk_mentions: totalRisks || (ticker === "NVDA" ? 17 : ticker === "AAPL" ? 10 : 6),
        revenue_mentions: totalRev || 7,
        guidance_mentions: totalGuidance || 4,
        avgSentiment,
        filingCount: tickerFilings.length || 1,
      };
    });
  }, [watchlist, filings]);

  // XBRL Financial Trends Data for Selected Company
  const selectedXbrlData = useMemo(() => {
    return getOrCreateXbrlFacts(selectedTickerForAnalytics);
  }, [selectedTickerForAnalytics]);

  // Copy helper
  const handleCopy = (text: string, id: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedToken(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedToken(null), 2000);
  };

  // Interactive Keyword Highlighter
  const renderHighlightedContent = (htmlContent: string) => {
    let result = htmlContent;
    for (const kw of REGULATORY_RISK_KEYWORDS) {
      const regex = new RegExp(`\\b(${kw})\\b`, "gi");
      result = result.replace(
        regex,
        `<mark class="bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-300 font-semibold px-1 py-0.5 rounded border border-rose-500/40">$1</mark>`
      );
    }
    return <div className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-gray-300 space-y-3" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: result }} />;
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0A0A0C] text-[#E0E0E0] p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6">
      {/* Top Banner Alert (Triggered High-Risk 8-K or Threshold Breaches) */}
      {activeBannerAlert && (
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-950/80 via-red-900/50 to-[#121216] border border-rose-500/60 p-4 shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-300">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/40 flex-shrink-0 animate-pulse">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40 font-mono">
                  CRITICAL 8-K ALERT
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-rose-200 font-mono">
                  {new Date(activeBannerAlert.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono border border-amber-500/30">
                  {activeBannerAlert.ticker}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white mt-1">
                {activeBannerAlert.companyName} &mdash; {activeBannerAlert.triggerReason}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-rose-200/80 mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Mail className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400" />
                Notification dispatched to: <span className="font-mono text-white underline">{activeBannerAlert.emailSentTo}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 self-end md:self-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                const target = filings.find((f) => f.accessionNumber === activeBannerAlert.accessionNumber);
                if (target) setActiveFilingModal(target);
                else {
                  window.open(activeBannerAlert.filingUrl, "_blank");
                }
              }}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Inspect Filing
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleDismissBanner}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#16161A] hover:bg-[#202028] text-gray-400 hover:text-white border border-[#2A2A35] transition-all cursor-pointer"
              title="Acknowledge Alert"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Header Card */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-b from-[#141419] to-[#0E0E12] border border-[#1F1F28] p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-start lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#1F1F28] pb-5">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1C1C28] to-[#0D0D12] border-2 border-amber-500/50 p-1 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(242,125,38,0.35)] flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
              <img
                src="/assets/aistudio/IMG_20261026_022436_ab42bf11.jpg"
                alt="Token World Exchange ATS®"
                className="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-xl hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                onError={(e) => {
                  (e.currentTarget as HTMLImageElement).src = "/twe_logo.jpg";
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  SEC EDGAR Real-Time Filing & Financial Fact Monitor
                </h1>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                  EDGAR Next Active
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30">
                  edgartools 2.29.0
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#8E9299] mt-1 max-w-3xl">
                Real-time surveillance across 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K disclosures for institutional ATS compliance. Automated
                regulatory risk keyword extraction, multi-period XBRL financial trends, live RSS parsing, and instant alerts.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Actions (Settings, Export, Refresh) */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap self-end lg:self-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsSettingsModalOpen(true)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#181820] hover:bg-[#20202C] text-[#E0E0E0] border border-[#2A2A38] text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              Alert Sensitivity ({alertSettings.riskThreshold} Risk / {alertSettings.revenueThreshold} Rev)
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => exportFilingsToCsv(filings)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#181820] hover:bg-[#20202C] text-[#E0E0E0] border border-[#2A2A38] text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              title="Export filtered filings view as CSV"
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              Export CSV
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                triggerHybridSync();
                handleRefreshRss();
              }}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSyncingNow || isRefreshingFeed ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              Poll EDGAR
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Automated Ingestion Trigger & Hybrid Loop Status Controller */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#111117] border border-[#1E1E2C] text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg border ${isAutoPolling ? "bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/30" : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30"}`}>
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Radio className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400 ${isAutoPolling ? "animate-pulse" : ""}`} />
                  Automated EDGAR Ingestion Trigger (5-Minute Hybrid Loop)
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#1A1A26] text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/20 font-semibold">
                  data.sec.gov &amp; /Archives/edgar/daily-index/
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5 font-mono">
                {isAutoPolling ? (
                  <>
                    Next automatic poll in <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{Math.floor(pollingSecondsLeft / 60)}m {String(pollingSecondsLeft % 60).padStart(2, "0")}s</span> &bull; Last synchronized: <span className="text-gray-300">{lastSyncedTime}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-amber-400 font-semibold">Automated polling loop paused by compliance officer.</span>
                )}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-center">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsAutoPolling((p) => !p)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                isAutoPolling
                  ? "bg-[#161622] hover:bg-[#20202E] text-gray-300 border-[#2A2A3C]"
                  : "bg-cyan-500/20 hover:bg-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-500/40"
              }`}
            >
              {isAutoPolling ? <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              {isAutoPolling ? "Pause 5m Loop" : "Resume Loop"}
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={triggerHybridSync}
              disabled={isSyncingNow}
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-black text-xs font-bold font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSyncingNow ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              {isSyncingNow ? "Syncing..." : "Force Sync SEC RSS & Index"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Watchlist Bar with Firestore Persistence Status */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#A0A5B0] font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                Active SEC Watchlist ({watchlist.length} Tickers)
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#1A1A24] text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/20 flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${isWatchlistSynced ? "bg-cyan-400" : "bg-amber-400 animate-ping"}`} />
                {isWatchlistSynced ? "Firestore Synced" : "Saving..."}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Add Ticker Input */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
              <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-48">
                <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-500" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Add ticker (e.g. TSLA)..."
                  value={newTickerInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTickerInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter") handleAddTicker();
                  }}
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#0E0E12] border border-[#22223E] text-xs text-white placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500/50 uppercase font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAddTicker}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Add
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Watchlist Chips */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {watchlist.map((ticker) => {
              const count = filings.filter((f) => f.ticker === ticker).length;
              const hasAlert = alertHistory.some((a) => a.ticker === ticker && !a.acknowledged);
              const isSelected = selectedTickerForAnalytics === ticker;

              return (
                <div
                  key={ticker}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition-all border ${
                    isSelected

                      : "bg-[#14141C] text-gray-300 border-[#222230] hover:border-[#38384C]"
                  }`}
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"

                      setSelectedTickerForAnalytics(ticker);
                      setActiveSubTab("analytics");

                    )}

                  {watchlist.length > 1 && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveTicker(ticker)}
                      className="text-gray-500 hover:text-rose-400 p-0.5 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title={`Remove ${ticker} from watchlist`}
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>

                                ? "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30"
                                : "bg-[#1E1E28] text-gray-300"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {filing.summary.risk_mentions}

                        </td>

                        {/* Revenue Mentions */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">

                        {/* Sentiment */}

                                ? "text-rose-400"

                    </tr>

          </div>

      {activeSubTab === "postgres_workbench" && (

                  <button

                    }

                  </button>
                </div>

                <pre className="overflow-x-auto text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-gray-300">{`# 2. PostgreSQL Connection
import psycopg2

conn = psycopg2.connect(
    host="localhost",
    port=5432,
    database="edgar",
    user="postgres",
    password="password"
)
cur = conn.cursor()

# 3. Insert Filing Metadata
def insert_filing(filing):
    sql = """
    INSERT INTO filings (
        accession_number, cik, ticker, company_name, form_type, filing_date, filing_url
    )
    VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
    ON CONFLICT (accession_number) DO NOTHING;
    """
    cur.execute(sql, (
        filing.accession_number, filing.cik, filing.ticker,
        filing.company, filing.form, filing.filing_date, filing.url
    ))
    conn.commit()

# 4. Store Filing Text
def store_document(accession, html_content, plain_text):
    cur.execute("""
        INSERT INTO filing_documents(accession_number, document_type, html_content, plain_text)
        VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s)
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
    """, (accession, "primary", html_content, plain_text))
    conn.commit()

# 5. Store XBRL Facts
def store_fact(accession, concept, value, unit, period_end):
    cur.execute("""
        INSERT INTO financial_facts(accession_number, concept, value, unit, period_end)
        VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s);
    """, (accession, concept, value, unit, period_end))
    conn.commit()`}</pre>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-1.5">

                As explained below, there are two different API tokens: the <strong>filer API token</strong> and the <strong>user API token</strong>.
                For information about EDGAR Next APIs, refer to <em>How Do I Understand EDGAR Application Programming Interfaces (APIs)</em>, <em>Overview of EDGAR APIs</em>, and the <em>API Development Toolkit</em>.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Section 2: Create a Filer API Token */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <h5 className="font-bold text-white text-xs">Create a Filer API Token</h5>
              <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-gray-300 pl-1">
                <li>A filer must present a filer API token to connect to APIs.</li>
                <li>A filer API token is valid for <strong>one year</strong> from date of creation.</li>
                <li>Filer API tokens must be created by a filer’s technical administrator.</li>
                <li><strong>Each filer must have at least two technical administrators</strong> to connect to APIs.</li>
                <li>A filer’s technical administrators are responsible for managing the filer’s connections to APIs.</li>
                <li>Technical administrators may generate an unlimited number of filer API tokens on the dashboard.</li>
                <li>Multiple different filer API tokens can be used by the filer at any given time, and filer API tokens may overlap in duration.</li>
                <li><strong>Delegated entity exception:</strong> A filer may choose to use the filer API token and API connections of its delegated entity (so long as the delegated entity has authorized at least two technical administrators).</li>
              </ul>
            </div>

                <li><strong>Each individual may only have one active user API token at any given time.</strong></li>

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  ShieldAlert,
  ShieldCheck,
  ShieldX,
  AlertTriangle,
  Lock,
  Unlock,
  RefreshCw,
  Download,
  Filter,
  Search,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  ArrowUpDown,
  ExternalLink,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Flame,
  Zap,
  Check,
  Copy,
  Info,
  Layers,
  Scale,
  Binary,
  PieChart,
  FileSpreadsheet
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";
import {
  runBatchThreatScan,
  remediateToken,
  batchRemediateTokens,
  exportThreatReportToCsv,
  BatchThreatReport,
  TokenThreatAssessment,
  ThreatSeverity,
  ThreatCategory,
  CATEGORY_METADATA,
} from "../utils/securityThreatScanner";
import { ChainIcon } from "./ChainIcon";

interface SecurityThreatScannerProps {
  tokens: TokenRecord[];
  onUpdateTokens?: (updatedTokens: TokenRecord[]) => void;
  onSelectToken?: (token: TokenRecord) => void;
  onNavigateToTab?: (tab: string) => void;
}

export const SecurityThreatScanner: React.FC<SecurityThreatScannerProps> = ({
  tokens,
  onUpdateTokens,
  onSelectToken,
  onNavigateToTab,
}) => {
  const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState(false);
  const [scanProgress, setScanProgress] = useState(100);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedSeverity, setSelectedSeverity] = useState<ThreatSeverity | "ALL">("ALL");
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<ThreatCategory | "ALL">("ALL");
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<"threat_desc" | "threat_asc" | "mcap_desc" | "holders_asc" | "name_asc">("threat_desc");
  const [expandedTokenId, setExpandedTokenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedAddress, setCopiedAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [remediationFeedback, setRemediationFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Compute Batch Threat Report
  const report: BatchThreatReport = useMemo(() => {
    return runBatchThreatScan(tokens);
  }, [tokens]);

  const handleRunRescan = () => {
    setIsScanning(true);
    setScanProgress(0);
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setScanProgress((prev) => {
        if (prev >= 100) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setIsScanning(false);
          return 100;
        }
        return prev + 25;
      });
    }, 120);
  };

  const handleCopyAddress = (address: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(address);
    setCopiedAddress(address);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedAddress(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const csvContent = exportThreatReportToCsv(report);
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute("download", `security-threat-report-${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  const handleExportJson = () => {
    const jsonString = JSON.stringify(report, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([jsonString], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute("download", `security-threat-report-${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}.json`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  // Single Token Remediation
  const handleRemediateSingleToken = (
    tokenId: string,
    action: "all" | "renounce" | "lock_liquidity" | "vesting"
  ) => {
    if (!onUpdateTokens) return;
    const targetToken = tokens.find((t) => t.id === tokenId);
    if (!targetToken) return;

    let remediated: TokenRecord;
    if (action === "renounce") {
      remediated = remediateToken(targetToken, { lockLiquidity: false, vestDistribution: false });
    } else if (action === "lock_liquidity") {
      remediated = remediateToken(targetToken, { renounceOwnership: false, vestDistribution: false });
    } else if (action === "vesting") {
      remediated = remediateToken(targetToken, { renounceOwnership: false, lockLiquidity: false });
    } else {
      remediated = remediateToken(targetToken);
    }

    const updated = tokens.map((t) => (t.id === tokenId ? remediated : t));
    onUpdateTokens(updated);
    setRemediationFeedback(`Successfully secured ${remediated.symbol} (${remediated.name})`);
    setTimeout(() => setRemediationFeedback(null), 4000);
  };

  // Batch Remediation
  const handleBatchRemediateAll = () => {
    if (!onUpdateTokens) return;
    const vulnerableCount = report.assessments.filter((a) => a.overallStatus !== "SAFE").length;
    if (vulnerableCount === 0) {
      setRemediationFeedback("All tokens in the active batch already meet pristine security requirements.");
      setTimeout(() => setRemediationFeedback(null), 3500);
      return;
    }

    const remediated = batchRemediateTokens(tokens);
    onUpdateTokens(remediated);
    setRemediationFeedback(`Auto-Remediated ${vulnerableCount} vulnerable tokens! Ownership renounced to 0x0...dEaD, liquidity locked in Rug-Proof Vault, and 24m vesting applied.`);
    setTimeout(() => setRemediationFeedback(null), 6000);
  };

  // Filter & Sort assessments
  const filteredAssessments = useMemo(() => {
    let result = report.assessments;

    // Search query
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      result = result.filter(
        (a) =>
          a.token.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.token.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.token.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.token.chain.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.findings.some(
            (f) =>
              f.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
              f.heuristicRule.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
              f.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)
          )
      );
    }

    // Severity filter
    if (selectedSeverity !== "ALL") {
      result = result.filter((a) => a.overallStatus === selectedSeverity);
    }

    // Category filter
    if (selectedCategory !== "ALL") {
      result = result.filter((a) => a.findings.some((f) => f.category === selectedCategory));
    }

    // Sort
    return [...result].sort((a, b) => {
      switch (sortBy) {
        case "threat_desc":
          return b.threatScore - a.threatScore;
        case "threat_asc":
          return a.threatScore - b.threatScore;
        case "mcap_desc":
          return (b.token.marketCap || 0) - (a.token.marketCap || 0);
        case "holders_asc":
          return (a.token.holderCount || 0) - (b.token.holderCount || 0);
        case "name_asc":
          return a.token.name.localeCompare(b.token.name);
        default:
          return b.threatScore - a.threatScore;
      }
    });
  }, [report.assessments, searchQuery, selectedSeverity, selectedCategory, sortBy]);

  // Overall risk color helpers
  const getSeverityColor = (sev: ThreatSeverity) => {
    switch (sev) {
      case "CRITICAL":
        return {
          text: "text-rose-400",
          border: "border-rose-500/40",
          bg: "bg-rose-950/20",
          dot: "bg-rose-500",
        };
      case "HIGH":
        return {
          text: "text-orange-400",
          border: "border-orange-500/40",
          bg: "bg-orange-950/20",
          dot: "bg-orange-500",
        };
      case "MEDIUM":
        return {
          text: "text-amber-400",
          border: "border-amber-500/40",
          bg: "bg-amber-950/20",
          dot: "bg-amber-500",
        };
      case "LOW":
        return {
          text: "text-cyan-400",
          border: "border-cyan-500/40",
          bg: "bg-cyan-950/20",
          dot: "bg-cyan-500",
        };
      case "SAFE":
        return {
          text: "text-emerald-400",
          border: "border-emerald-500/40",
          bg: "bg-emerald-950/20",
          dot: "bg-emerald-500",
        };
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6">
      {/* Feedback Banner */}
      {remediationFeedback && (
        <div className="bg-[#121E1E] border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 text-emerald-200 text-sm shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/20 transition-all">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{remediationFeedback}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setRemediationFeedback(null)}
            className="text-xs text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-200 font-mono"
          >
            Dismiss
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Header & Heuristic Cockpit */}
      <div className="bg-[#0D1117] border border-[#21262D] rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        {/* Subtle accent glow */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-rose-500/5 blur-3xl pointer-events-none rounded-full" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-cyan-500/5 blur-3xl pointer-events-none rounded-full" />

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-6 relative z-10">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-rose-400 uppercase tracking-widest font-mono mb-2">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" />
              <span>Heuristic Vulnerability Intelligence Engine</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span className="text-[#8B949E]">Active Batch Diagnostics</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-3">
              Security Threat Scanner
              <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] text-[#C9D1D9] font-mono font-normal">
                {report.totalTokensScanned} Tokens Scanned
              </span>
            </h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-[#8B949E] mt-1.5 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
              Automated heuristic deep scan across metadata, ownership structures, and tokenomics distributions.
              Detects un-renounced single-key privileges, insider whale concentration without lockups, unprotected AMM liquidity pools, and deterministic key spoofing vectors.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
            <button
              onClick={handleRunRescan}
              disabled={isScanning}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#21262D] hover:bg-[#30363D] text-[#C9D1D9] hover:text-white border border-[#30363D] text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isScanning ? "animate-spin text-cyan-400" : ""}`} />
              <span>{isScanning ? `Scanning (${scanProgress}%)` : "Re-Scan Batch"}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={handleBatchRemediateAll}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-md shadow-emerald-950/30 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]"
            >
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-200" />
              <span>Auto-Remediate Batch</span>
            </button>

            {onNavigateToTab && (
              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigateToTab("maximum_security")}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950/60 hover:bg-emerald-900/80 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-sm"
                title="Open Enterprise Maximum Security Lifecycle Command Center (IaC, Zero Trust, SIEM, WORM)"
              >
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>Enterprise Max Security</span>
              </button>
            )}

            <div className="relative group">
              <button
                onClick={handleExportCsv}
                className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#161B22] hover:bg-[#21262D] text-[#8B949E] hover:text-[#C9D1D9] border border-[#30363D] text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                title="Export CSV Threat Report"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Export CSV</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleExportJson}
              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#161B22] hover:bg-[#21262D] text-[#8B949E] hover:text-[#C9D1D9] border border-[#30363D] text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              title="Export JSON Threat Report"
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>JSON</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Progress Bar (Visible during scan) */}
        {isScanning && (
          <div className="mt-4 w-full bg-[#161B22] rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-500 via-amber-500 to-cyan-500 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-150"
              style={{ width: `${scanProgress}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Metric Cards Row */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-[#21262D]">
          {/* Average Threat Score Card */}
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D]">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-[#8B949E] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              Batch Threat Index
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className={`text-2xl font-bold font-mono ${report.averageThreatScore >= 50 ? "text-rose-400" : report.averageThreatScore >= 25 ? "text-amber-400" : "text-emerald-400"}`}>
                {report.averageThreatScore}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-[#8B949E]">/ 100</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8B949E] mt-1 font-mono">
              Status: <span className={getSeverityColor(report.overallBatchRisk).text}>{report.overallBatchRisk}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Critical Risk Filter Card */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedSeverity(selectedSeverity === "CRITICAL" ? "ALL" : "CRITICAL")}
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
              selectedSeverity === "CRITICAL"
                ? "bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-rose-950/40 ring-1 ring-rose-500/50"
                : "bg-[#161B22] border-[#30363D] hover:border-rose-500/40 text-[#C9D1D9]"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              <span className="text-rose-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 inline-block" />
                Critical
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono">{report.criticalTokensCount}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
              {report.criticalTokensCount}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8B949E] mt-1">
              Requires immediate action
            </div>
          </button>

          {/* High Risk Filter Card */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedSeverity(selectedSeverity === "HIGH" ? "ALL" : "HIGH")}
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
              selectedSeverity === "HIGH"
                ? "bg-orange-950/40 border-orange-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-orange-950/40 ring-1 ring-orange-500/50"
                : "bg-[#161B22] border-[#30363D] hover:border-orange-500/40 text-[#C9D1D9]"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              <span className="text-orange-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-500 inline-block" />
                High Risk
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono">{report.highRiskTokensCount}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
              {report.highRiskTokensCount}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8B949E] mt-1">
              Significant exposure
            </div>
          </button>

          {/* Medium Risk Filter Card */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedSeverity(selectedSeverity === "MEDIUM" ? "ALL" : "MEDIUM")}
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
              selectedSeverity === "MEDIUM"
                ? "bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-amber-950/40 ring-1 ring-amber-500/50"
                : "bg-[#161B22] border-[#30363D] hover:border-amber-500/40 text-[#C9D1D9]"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              <span className="text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500 inline-block" />
                Medium
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono">{report.mediumRiskTokensCount}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
              {report.mediumRiskTokensCount}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8B949E] mt-1">
              Cautionary warnings
            </div>
          </button>

          {/* Low Risk Filter Card */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedSeverity(selectedSeverity === "LOW" ? "ALL" : "LOW")}
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
              selectedSeverity === "LOW"
                ? "bg-cyan-950/40 border-cyan-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-cyan-950/40 ring-1 ring-cyan-500/50"
                : "bg-[#161B22] border-[#30363D] hover:border-cyan-500/40 text-[#C9D1D9]"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              <span className="text-cyan-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-500 inline-block" />
                Low Risk
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono">{report.lowRiskTokensCount}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
              {report.lowRiskTokensCount}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8B949E] mt-1">
              Minor advisories
            </div>
          </button>

          {/* Safe Filter Card */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedSeverity(selectedSeverity === "SAFE" ? "ALL" : "SAFE")}
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
              selectedSeverity === "SAFE"
                ? "bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-emerald-950/40 ring-1 ring-emerald-500/50"
                : "bg-[#161B22] border-[#30363D] hover:border-emerald-500/40 text-[#C9D1D9]"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              <span className="text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 inline-block" />
                Safe / Pristine
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono">{report.safeTokensCount}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
              {report.safeTokensCount}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8B949E] mt-1">
              Full compliance verified
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Vulnerability Prevalence Breakdown Bar */}
        <div className="mt-6 pt-5 border-t border-[#21262D]">
          <div className="text-xs text-[#8B949E] font-medium mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#58A6FF]" />
              Active Heuristic Vulnerability Vector Prevalence:
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#8B949E]">
              Evaluated across 6 heuristic suites in {report.scanDurationMs}ms
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
            {(Object.entries(report.categoryBreakdown) as [ThreatCategory, typeof report.categoryBreakdown[ThreatCategory]][]).map(
              ([cat, stat]) => {
                const meta = CATEGORY_METADATA[cat];
                const isSelected = selectedCategory === cat;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={cat}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(isSelected ? "ALL" : cat)}
                    className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-left transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-[#1C2128] border-cyan-500/60 ring-1 ring-cyan-500/30"
                        : "bg-[#161B22] border-[#30363D] hover:border-[#8B949E]/40"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                      <span className="font-medium text-[#C9D1D9] truncate">
                        {meta.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`font-mono text-xs ${stat.affectedCount > 0 ? "text-amber-400 font-semibold" : "text-[#8B949E]"}`}>
                        {stat.affectedCount} ({stat.percentage}%)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-[#0D1117] h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className={`h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                          stat.maxSeverity === "CRITICAL"
                            ? "bg-rose-500"
                            : stat.maxSeverity === "HIGH"
                            ? "bg-orange-500"
                            : stat.maxSeverity === "MEDIUM"
                            ? "bg-amber-500"
                            : "bg-emerald-500"
                        }`}
                        style={{ width: `${Math.max(4, stat.percentage)}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              }
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Top Recurring Vulnerabilities Alert Strip */}
      {report.topVulnerabilities.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-[#12171F] border border-[#263040] rounded-xl p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#C9D1D9] uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 font-mono">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>Top Detected Threat Vectors in Active Batch</span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {report.topVulnerabilities.slice(0, 3).map((vuln, idx) => (
              <div
                key={idx}
                className="bg-[#161E2B] border border-[#2A374A] rounded-lg p-2.5 flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-xs"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="font-medium text-white line-clamp-1">{vuln.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-[#8B949E] mt-0.5">
                    Category: <span className="text-[#58A6FF]">{CATEGORY_METADATA[vuln.category]?.label || vuln.category}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
                  <span className={`text-[11px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${
                    vuln.severity === "CRITICAL"
                      ? "bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40"
                      : "bg-orange-950/60 text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/40"
                  }`}>
                    {vuln.count} tokens
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className="bg-[#0D1117] border border-[#21262D] rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#8B949E] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search token name, symbol, address, rule..."
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] text-[#C9D1D9] placeholder-[#8B949E] text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 transition-colors"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Severity Selector */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-[#161B22] rounded-lg border border-[#30363D] overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto">
          {(["ALL", "CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "SAFE"] as const).map((sev) => (
            <button
              key={sev}
              onClick={() => setSelectedSeverity(sev)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${
                selectedSeverity === sev
                  ? "bg-[#21262D] text-white shadow-sm font-semibold"
                  : "text-[#8B949E] hover:text-[#C9D1D9]"
              }`}
            >
              {sev === "ALL" ? "All Severities" : sev}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Sort Dropdown */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto justify-end">
          <span className="text-xs text-[#8B949E] whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1">
            <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Sort:
          </span>
          <select
            value={sortBy}
            onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as any)}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] text-[#C9D1D9] text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500"
          >
            <option value="threat_desc">Threat Score (Highest Risk)</option>
            <option value="threat_asc">Threat Score (Safest First)</option>
            <option value="mcap_desc">Market Cap (Highest)</option>
            <option value="holders_asc">Holder Count (Lowest float)</option>
            <option value="name_asc">Token Name (A-Z)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Active Filter Indicators */}
      {(selectedSeverity !== "ALL" || selectedCategory !== "ALL" || searchQuery.trim()) && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-[#8B949E] flex-wrap">
          <span>Active Filters:</span>
          {selectedSeverity !== "ALL" && (
            <span className="bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-white flex items-center gap-1">
              Severity: {selectedSeverity}
              <button onClick={() => setSelectedSeverity("ALL")} className="hover:text-rose-400">×</button>
            </span>
          )}
          {selectedCategory !== "ALL" && (
            <span className="bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-white flex items-center gap-1">
              Category: {CATEGORY_METADATA[selectedCategory]?.label}
              <button onClick={() => setSelectedCategory("ALL")} className="hover:text-rose-400">×</button>
            </span>
          )}
          {searchQuery.trim() && (
            <span className="bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-white flex items-center gap-1">
              Search: "{searchQuery}"
              <button onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")} className="hover:text-rose-400">×</button>
            </span>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setSelectedSeverity("ALL");
              setSelectedCategory("ALL");
              setSearchQuery("");
            }}
            className="text-cyan-400 hover:underline ml-2"
          >
            Reset All Filters
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Assessment List */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {filteredAssessments.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-[#0D1117] border border-[#21262D] rounded-2xl p-12 text-center">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-12 h-12 text-emerald-400 mx-auto mb-3" />
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">No Matching Vulnerabilities Found</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#8B949E] mt-1 max-w-md mx-auto">
              No tokens in the active batch match your filter criteria or all tokens meet clean security standards under this filter.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredAssessments.map((assessment) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedTokenId === assessment.tokenId;
            const sevColor = getSeverityColor(assessment.overallStatus);
            const token = assessment.token;

            return (
              <div
                key={assessment.tokenId}
                className={`bg-[#0D1117] border rounded-xl transition-all overflow-hidden ${
                  assessment.overallStatus === "CRITICAL"
                    ? "border-rose-900/40 hover:border-rose-500/50"
                    : assessment.overallStatus === "HIGH"
                    ? "border-orange-900/40 hover:border-orange-500/50"
                    : assessment.overallStatus === "MEDIUM"

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { TokenRecord, ChainType, TokenStandard } from "../types";

  SOVEREIGN_TREASURY_SHARES,
  SOVEREIGN_OWNER,
  buildMultiTokenDotEnv,
} from "../utils/cryptoGenerators";
import { downloadTokensCSV } from "../utils/csvExport";

  CheckSquare,
  Coins,

  TrendingDown,

  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Zap,

  Download,

} from "lucide-react";
import { MarketImpactVisualizer } from "./MarketImpactVisualizer";
import { BurnMechanismSimulator } from "./BurnMechanismSimulator";

interface SelectedTokenomicsDashboardProps {
  tokens: TokenRecord[];
  selectedTokenIds: Set<string>;
  onDeselectAll: () => void;
  onExpandSelectedToSovereign?: () => void;
  onSelectToken?: (token: TokenRecord) => void;
}

export function formatCompactCurrency(val: number): string {
  if (val >= 1e12) {
    return `$${(val / 1e12).toFixed(2)}T`;
  }
  if (val >= 1e9) {
    return `$${(val / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`;
  }
  if (val >= 1e6) {
    return `$${(val / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`;
  }
  if (val >= 1e3) {
    return `$${(val / 1e3).toFixed(2)}K`;
  }
  return `$${val.toFixed(2)}`;
}

export function formatCompactNumber(val: number): string {
  if (val >= 1e12) {
    return `${(val / 1e12).toFixed(2)}T`;
  }
  if (val >= 1e9) {
    return `${(val / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`;
  }
  if (val >= 1e6) {
    return `${(val / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M`;
  }
  if (val >= 1e3) {
    return `${(val / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K`;
  }
  return val.toLocaleString();
}

export const SelectedTokenomicsDashboard: React.FC<SelectedTokenomicsDashboardProps> = ({
  tokens,
  selectedTokenIds,
  onDeselectAll,
  onExpandSelectedToSovereign,
}) => {
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showMarketImpact, setShowMarketImpact] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showBurnMechanism, setShowBurnMechanism] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filter selected tokens
  const selectedTokens = useMemo(() => {
    return tokens.filter((t) => selectedTokenIds.has(t.id));
  }, [tokens, selectedTokenIds]);

  const count = selectedTokens.length;
  const totalTokens = tokens.length;
  const selectionPercentage = totalTokens > 0 ? ((count / totalTokens) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0";

  // Aggregated Tokenomics Metrics Calculations
  const tokenomicsMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedTokens.length === 0) {
      return {
        totalMarketCap: 0,
        avgMarketCap: 0,
        sovereignCount: 0,
        sovereignRatio: "0",
        totalEstimatedSupply: 0,
        avgPrice: 0,
        minPrice: 0,
        maxPrice: 0,
        totalHolders: 0,
        avgSecurityScore: 0,
        chainCounts: {} as Record<ChainType, number>,
        standardCounts: {} as Record<TokenStandard, number>,
        statusCounts: {} as Record<string, number>,
        powerOfTwoCompliantCount: 0,
        hasSovereignAllocationsCount: 0,
      };
    }

    let totalMarketCap = 0;
    let sovereignCount = 0;
    let totalSupplyNum = 0;
    let totalPrice = 0;
    let minPrice = Infinity;
    let maxPrice = -Infinity;
    let totalHolders = 0;
    let totalSecurityScore = 0;
    let powerOfTwoCompliantCount = 0;
    let hasSovereignAllocationsCount = 0;

    const chainCounts: Partial<Record<ChainType, number>> = {};
    const standardCounts: Partial<Record<TokenStandard, number>> = {};
    const statusCounts: Record<string, number> = {};

    selectedTokens.forEach((t) => {
      const mcap = t.marketCap || 0;
      totalMarketCap += mcap;
      if (mcap >= 3_000_000_000_000) {
        sovereignCount++;
      }

      // Initial Supply parse
      const rawSupply = parseFloat(t.initialSupply?.replace(/,/g, "") || "0");
      if (!isNaN(rawSupply) && isFinite(rawSupply)) {
        totalSupplyNum += rawSupply;
      }

      // Price
      const price = t.priceUsd || 0;
      totalPrice += price;
      if (price < minPrice) minPrice = price;
      if (price > maxPrice) maxPrice = price;

      // Holders & Security
      totalHolders += t.holderCount || 0;
      totalSecurityScore += t.securityScore || 0;

      // Sovereign Reserves 2^8 compliance
      if (t.powerOfTwoReserves === 256 || t.coinmarketcapMetric && t.coinmarketcapMetric >= 256) {
        powerOfTwoCompliantCount++;
      }
      if (
        t.reserveShares === SOVEREIGN_RESERVE_SHARES ||
        t.treasuryShares === SOVEREIGN_TREASURY_SHARES
      ) {
        hasSovereignAllocationsCount++;
      }

      // Distributions
      chainCounts[t.chain] = (chainCounts[t.chain] || 0) + 1;
      standardCounts[t.tokenStandard] = (standardCounts[t.tokenStandard] || 0) + 1;
      statusCounts[t.launchStatus] = (statusCounts[t.launchStatus] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const avgMarketCap = totalMarketCap / selectedTokens.length;
    const avgPrice = totalPrice / selectedTokens.length;
    const avgSecurityScore = totalSecurityScore / selectedTokens.length;
    const sovereignRatio = ((sovereignCount / selectedTokens.length) * 100).toFixed(1);

    return {
      totalMarketCap,
      avgMarketCap,
      sovereignCount,
      sovereignRatio,
      totalEstimatedSupply: totalSupplyNum,
      avgPrice,
      minPrice: minPrice === Infinity ? 0 : minPrice,
      maxPrice: maxPrice === -Infinity ? 0 : maxPrice,
      totalHolders,
      avgSecurityScore,
      chainCounts: chainCounts as Record<ChainType, number>,
      standardCounts: standardCounts as Record<TokenStandard, number>,
      statusCounts,
      powerOfTwoCompliantCount,
      hasSovereignAllocationsCount,
    };
  }, [selectedTokens]);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2500);
  };

  const handleCopyAddresses = () => {
    const addresses = selectedTokens.map((t) => t.contractAddress).join("\n");
    handleCopy(addresses, "addresses");
  };

  const handleCopyTokenIds = () => {
    const ids = selectedTokens.map((t) => t.tokenId).join("\n");
    handleCopy(ids, "token_ids");
  };

  const handleDownloadFoundryEnv = () => {
    const envContent = buildMultiTokenDotEnv(selectedTokens);
    const blob = new Blob([envContent], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute("download", `.env.selected_${selectedTokens.length}_tokens`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleDownloadCSV = () => {
    downloadTokensCSV(selectedTokens, `selected_${selectedTokens.length}_tokenomics`);
  };

  if (count === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div
      id="selected-tokens-summary-dashboard"
      className="bg-[#0D0E12] border-2 border-[#F27D26]/70 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-xl space-y-3.5 transition-all animate-in fade-in duration-200"
    >
      {/* Top Banner Bar: Count, Header, and Primary Actions */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1E222D]">
        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-2.5">
          <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#F27D26]/10 border border-[#F27D26]/30 text-[#F27D26]">
            <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Selected Tokens &amp; Contracts Summary</span>
              </h3>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-[#F27D26] text-black shadow-sm">
                {count.toLocaleString()} / {totalTokens.toLocaleString()} ({selectionPercentage}%)
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">
              Aggregated tokenomics valuation, initial supply volume, 2^8 reserve compliance, and multi-chain allocation.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
          {onExpandSelectedToSovereign && tokenomicsMetrics.sovereignCount < count && (
            <button
              type="button"
              id="btn-summary-elevate-sovereign"
              onClick={onExpandSelectedToSovereign}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/25 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-mono font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95"
              title="Elevate selected tokens to >= $3T CoinMarketCap with 9e20 Reserve and 9e21 Treasury"
            >

import { useMembership } from '../../context/MembershipContext';

export const MobileTerminalView: React.FC = () => {
  const { 
    syncedOrders, 
    submitCrossDeviceOrder, 
    latencyMs,
    simulateMobileTradePush 
  } = useShowroomSync();

  const { currentPlan } = useMembership();

  const [mobileTab, setMobileTab] = useState<'trade' | 'blotter' | 'security'>('trade');
  const [selectedTicker, setSelectedTicker] = useState<'TWE' | 'BTC' | 'ETH'>('TWE');
  const [side, setSide] = useState<'BUY' | 'SELL'>('BUY');
  const [qty, setQty] = useState<number>(1000);
  const [isExecuting, setIsExecuting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [orderToast, setOrderToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const priceMap = { TWE: 1.85, BTC: 64280.0, ETH: 3490.0 };
  const currentPrice = priceMap[selectedTicker];
  const orderTotal = Number((qty * currentPrice).toFixed(2));

  const handleMobileSubmit = () => {
    setIsExecuting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      submitCrossDeviceOrder({
        deviceOrigin: 'Mobile Native iOS/Android',
        symbol: selectedTicker,
        side,
        orderType: 'LIMIT',
        qty,
        price: currentPrice,
        totalUsd: orderTotal
      });
      setIsExecuting(false);
      setOrderToast(
        `${side} ${qty.toLocaleString()} ${selectedTicker} confirmed via Touch ID! Synced to Desktop blotter in ${latencyMs}ms.`

    }, 600);
