    metadataURI: "ipfs://QmTWESovereignCommodityBasket2026",
    description:
      "Institutional sovereign RWA commodity basket backed by strategic mineral reserves and cross-border settlement warrants.",
  },
};

interface TokenomicsEngineProps {
  tokens: TokenRecord[];
  onAddTokens?: (tokens: TokenRecord[]) => void;
  onBulkUpdateTokens?: (tokenIds: string[], updates: Partial<TokenRecord>) => void;
  onSelectToken?: (token: TokenRecord) => void;
  onGenerate1000More?: () => void;
  isGenerating?: boolean;
}

export const TokenomicsEngine: React.FC<TokenomicsEngineProps> = ({
  tokens,
  onAddTokens,
  onBulkUpdateTokens,
  onSelectToken,
  onGenerate1000More,
  isGenerating = false,
}) => {
  // Selected token for focused inspection
  const [selectedTokenId, setSelectedTokenId] = useState<string>(tokens[0]?.id || "");
  const activeToken = useMemo(() => {
    return tokens.find((t) => t.id === selectedTokenId) || tokens[0] || null;
  }, [tokens, selectedTokenId]);

  // Active tab within the Tokenomics engine
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<
    | "pillars"
    | "custom_asset_classes"
    | "power_of_two"
    | "contract_addresses"
    | "solidity_spec"
  >("custom_asset_classes");

  // State for Custom Asset Classes (Rare Earth IP, Carbon Credit Derivative, etc.)
  const [selectedAssetClass, setSelectedAssetClass] =
    useState<TweCustomAssetClassId>("RARE_EARTH_IP");
  const [customTokenName, setCustomTokenName] = useState<string>(
    TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS.RARE_EARTH_IP.defaultTokenName
  );
  const [customTokenSymbol, setCustomTokenSymbol] = useState<string>(
    TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS.RARE_EARTH_IP.defaultSymbol
  );
  const [customInitialSupply, setCustomInitialSupply] = useState<number>(
    TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS.RARE_EARTH_IP.defaultSupply
  );

  // State for TWEAssetToken.PhysicalBacking struct fields
  const [physicalVarietyIdentifier, setPhysicalVarietyIdentifier] =
    useState<string>(
      TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS.RARE_EARTH_IP.varietyIdentifier
    );
  const [physicalCommodityType, setPhysicalCommodityType] = useState<string>(
    TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS.RARE_EARTH_IP.commodityBacking
  );
  const [physicalMeasurementUnit, setPhysicalMeasurementUnit] = useState<string>(
    TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS.RARE_EARTH_IP.measurementUnit
  );
  const [physicalCustodianRegistry, setPhysicalCustodianRegistry] =
    useState<string>(
      TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS.RARE_EARTH_IP.custodianRegistry
    );
  const [physicalAuditorHash, setPhysicalAuditorHash] = useState<string>(
    "0x9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08"
  );

  // Specialized Rare Earth Intellectual Property Attributes
  const [wipoPatentFilingId, setWipoPatentFilingId] = useState<string>(
    "PCT/US2026/084920"
  );
  const [lanthanideElements, setLanthanideElements] = useState<string>(
    "Nd-Pr-Dy-Tb (Neodymium / Praseodymium / Dysprosium / Terbium)"
  );
  const [separationPurityBps, setSeparationPurityBps] = useState<number>(9999); // 99.99%
  const [licensingRoyaltyBps, setLicensingRoyaltyBps] = useState<number>(450); // 4.50%
  const [metallurgicalStandard, setMetallurgicalStandard] = useState<string>(
    "ISO-18118 / USGS Heavy Lanthanide Laser-Isotope Separation"
  );

  // Specialized Carbon Credit Derivative Attributes
  const [carbonRegistryStandard, setCarbonRegistryStandard] = useState<string>(
    "Verra VCS / UN Paris Agreement Article 6.4"
  );
  const [serialBatchRange, setSerialBatchRange] = useState<string>(
    "VCS-2026-US-840-0001-9999"
  );
  const [vintageYear, setVintageYear] = useState<number>(2026);
  const [co2TonnesPerToken, setCo2TonnesPerToken] = useState<number>(1);
  const [methodologyCode, setMethodologyCode] = useState<string>(
    "VM0042 / Direct Air Capture & Mineralization (DAC-01)"
  );
  const [retireSimulationAmount, setRetireSimulationAmount] = useState<number>(250);
  const [totalRetiredTonnes, setTotalRetiredTonnes] = useState<number>(1250);
  const [retirementBeneficiary, setRetirementBeneficiary] = useState<string>(
    "Token World Exchange ATS® Net-Zero Sovereign Settlement"
  );

  // Schema categories & trait labels extracted directly from src/config/metadata-schema.json
  const schemaSupportedCategories = useMemo<string[]>(() => {
    const rawEnum =
      tweMetadataSchema?.properties?.assetProperties?.properties?.category?.enum;
    return Array.isArray(rawEnum)
      ? rawEnum
      : Object.values(TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS).map((p) => p.categoryName);
  }, []);

  const schemaSupportedTraitLabels = useMemo<string[]>(() => {
    const rawTraits =
      tweMetadataSchema?.properties?.assetProperties?.properties?.traitLabel?.enum;
    return Array.isArray(rawTraits)
      ? rawTraits
      : Object.values(TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS).map(
          (p) => p.shortTraitLabel
        );
  }, []);

  const resolveAssetClassFromInput = (
    input: string
  ): TweCustomAssetClassId => {
    const normalized = input.trim();
    if (normalized in TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS) {
      return normalized as TweCustomAssetClassId;
    }
    const foundByTraitOrCat = (
      Object.values(
        TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS
      ) as TweCustomAssetClassPreset[]
    ).find(
      (p) =>
        p.shortTraitLabel.toLowerCase() === normalized.toLowerCase() ||
        p.categoryName.toLowerCase() === normalized.toLowerCase() ||
        p.label.toLowerCase() === normalized.toLowerCase()
    );
    return foundByTraitOrCat ? foundByTraitOrCat.id : "RARE_EARTH_IP";
  };

  // Build TWEAssetToken.PhysicalBacking struct for a given Asset Class
  const buildPhysicalBackingForClass = (
    classId: TweCustomAssetClassId
  ): TwePhysicalBackingStruct => {
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[classId];
    const isCurrentSelected = classId === selectedAssetClass;
    const specializedStr =
      classId === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
        ? `Rare Earth Intellectual Property | WIPO: ${wipoPatentFilingId} | Elements: ${lanthanideElements} | Purity: ${(
            separationPurityBps / 100
          ).toFixed(2)}% | Royalty: ${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(2)}%`
        : classId === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        ? `Carbon Credit Derivative | Standard: ${carbonRegistryStandard} | Batch: ${serialBatchRange} | Vintage: ${vintageYear} | Ratio: ${co2TonnesPerToken} tCO2e/Token`
        : `${preset.categoryName} | Variety: ${preset.varietyIdentifier} | Unit: ${preset.measurementUnit}`;

    const backingTypeEnum =
      classId === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY"
        : classId === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        : classId === "AEROSPACE_PROPULSION"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.AEROSPACE_PROPULSION_ELEMENT"
        : classId === "MINERAL_BULLION"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.REFINED_MINERAL_BULLION"
        : "PhysicalBackingType.SOVEREIGN_RWA_COMMODITY";

    return {
      backingType: backingTypeEnum,
      category: preset.categoryName,
      varietyIdentifier: isCurrentSelected
        ? physicalVarietyIdentifier
        : preset.varietyIdentifier,
      commodityType: isCurrentSelected
        ? physicalCommodityType
        : preset.commodityBacking,
      measurementUnit: isCurrentSelected
        ? physicalMeasurementUnit
        : preset.measurementUnit,
      custodianRegistry: isCurrentSelected
        ? physicalCustodianRegistry
        : preset.custodianRegistry,
      auditorVerificationHash: physicalAuditorHash,
      specializedAttributes: specializedStr,
      wipoPatentFilingId,
      lanthanideElementSymbols: lanthanideElements,
      separationPurityBps,
      licensingRoyaltyBps,
      carbonRegistryStandard,
      serialBatchRange,
      vintageYear,
      co2TonnesPerToken,
    };
  };

  // Build specialized trait record for a given Asset Class
  const buildTraitRecordForAssetClass = (
    tokenId: string,
    classId: TweCustomAssetClassId
  ): AssignedTokenTraitRecord => {
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[classId];
    const physicalBacking = buildPhysicalBackingForClass(classId);
    if (classId === "RARE_EARTH_IP") {
      return {
        tokenId,
        assetClassId: classId,
        shortTraitLabel: preset.shortTraitLabel,
        schemaCategory: preset.categoryName,
        solidityEnum: preset.solidityEnum,
        varietyIdentifier: physicalBacking.varietyIdentifier,
        custodianRegistry: physicalBacking.custodianRegistry,
        specializedSummary: `WIPO ${wipoPatentFilingId} · ${lanthanideElements} · ${(
          separationPurityBps / 100
        ).toFixed(2)}% Purity · ${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(
          2
        )}% Royalty`,
        physicalBacking,
        attributes: [
          {
            label: "Trait Classification",
            value: "Intellectual Property (Rare Earth IP)",
            accent: "emerald",
          },
          {
            label: "WIPO Patent Filing ID",
            value: wipoPatentFilingId,
            accent: "cyan",
          },
          {
            label: "Lanthanide Elements",
            value: lanthanideElements,
            accent: "purple",
          },
          {
            label: "Separation Purity",
            value: `${(separationPurityBps / 100).toFixed(2)}% (${separationPurityBps} bps)`,
            accent: "emerald",
          },
          {
            label: "IP Licensing Royalty",
            value: `${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(2)}% (${licensingRoyaltyBps} bps)`,
            accent: "amber",
          },
          {
            label: "Metallurgical Standard",
            value: metallurgicalStandard,
            accent: "cyan",
          },
        ],
        assignedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }

    if (classId === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE") {
      return {
        tokenId,
        assetClassId: classId,
        shortTraitLabel: preset.shortTraitLabel,
        schemaCategory: preset.categoryName,
        solidityEnum: preset.solidityEnum,
        varietyIdentifier: physicalBacking.varietyIdentifier,
        custodianRegistry: physicalBacking.custodianRegistry,
        specializedSummary: `${carbonRegistryStandard} · Vintage ${vintageYear} · ${co2TonnesPerToken} tCO2e/Token · Batch ${serialBatchRange}`,
        physicalBacking,
        attributes: [
          {
            label: "Trait Classification",
            value: "Carbon Credit (Carbon Credit Derivative)",
            accent: "cyan",
          },
          {
            label: "Registry Standard",
            value: carbonRegistryStandard,
            accent: "emerald",
          },
          {
            label: "Vintage Year",
            value: `${vintageYear}`,
            accent: "amber",
          },
          {
            label: "Carbon Ratio",
            value: `${co2TonnesPerToken} tCO2e / Token`,
            accent: "emerald",
          },
          {
            label: "Serial Retirement Batch",
            value: serialBatchRange,
            accent: "purple",
          },
          {
            label: "Methodology & Retired",
            value: `${methodologyCode} (${totalRetiredTonnes.toLocaleString()} tCO2e Retired)`,
            accent: "cyan",
          },
        ],
        assignedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }

    return {
      tokenId,
      assetClassId: classId,
      shortTraitLabel: preset.shortTraitLabel,
      schemaCategory: preset.categoryName,
      solidityEnum: preset.solidityEnum,
      varietyIdentifier: physicalBacking.varietyIdentifier,
      custodianRegistry: physicalBacking.custodianRegistry,
      specializedSummary: `${preset.categoryName} · ${physicalBacking.varietyIdentifier} · ${physicalBacking.commodityType}`,
      physicalBacking,
      attributes: [
        {
          label: "Trait Classification",
          value: preset.shortTraitLabel,
          accent: "amber",
        },
        {
          label: "Schema Category",
          value: preset.categoryName,
          accent: "emerald",
        },
        {
          label: "Variety Identifier",
          value: physicalBacking.varietyIdentifier,
          accent: "cyan",
        },
        {
          label: "Physical Backing",
          value: physicalBacking.commodityType,
          accent: "purple",
        },
        {
          label: "Measurement Unit",
          value: physicalBacking.measurementUnit,
          accent: "amber",
        },
        {
          label: "Custodian Registry",
          value: physicalBacking.custodianRegistry,
          accent: "cyan",
        },
      ],
      assignedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  };

  // Map of tokenId -> dynamically assigned Asset Class & Specialized Attributes
  const [assignedTokenTraits, setAssignedTokenTraits] = useState<
    Record<string, AssignedTokenTraitRecord>
  >(() => {
    const initialMap: Record<string, AssignedTokenTraitRecord> = {};
    const classKeys: TweCustomAssetClassId[] = [
      "RARE_EARTH_IP",
      "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE",
      "AEROSPACE_PROPULSION",
      "MINERAL_BULLION",
      "SOVEREIGN_COMMODITY",
    ];
    tokens.slice(0, 20).forEach((tok, idx) => {
      const cid = classKeys[idx % classKeys.length];
      const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[cid];
      const specSummary =
        cid === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
          ? "WIPO PCT/US2026/084920 · Nd-Pr-Dy-Tb · 99.99% Purity · 4.50% Royalty"
          : cid === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
          ? "Verra VCS / UN Art. 6.4 · Vintage 2026 · 1 tCO2e/Token · Batch VCS-2026-US-840"
          : `${preset.categoryName} · ${preset.varietyIdentifier} · ${preset.commodityBacking}`;
      initialMap[tok.id] = {
        tokenId: tok.id,
        assetClassId: cid,
        shortTraitLabel: preset.shortTraitLabel,
        schemaCategory: preset.categoryName,
        solidityEnum: preset.solidityEnum,
        varietyIdentifier: preset.varietyIdentifier,
        custodianRegistry: preset.custodianRegistry,
        specializedSummary: specSummary,
        physicalBacking: {
          backingType:
            cid === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
              ? "PhysicalBackingType.RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY"
              : cid === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
              ? "PhysicalBackingType.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
              : cid === "AEROSPACE_PROPULSION"
              ? "PhysicalBackingType.AEROSPACE_PROPULSION_ELEMENT"
              : cid === "MINERAL_BULLION"
              ? "PhysicalBackingType.REFINED_MINERAL_BULLION"
              : "PhysicalBackingType.SOVEREIGN_RWA_COMMODITY",
          category: preset.categoryName,
          varietyIdentifier: preset.varietyIdentifier,
          commodityType: preset.commodityBacking,
          measurementUnit: preset.measurementUnit,
          custodianRegistry: preset.custodianRegistry,
          auditorVerificationHash:
            "0x9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08",
          specializedAttributes: specSummary,
          wipoPatentFilingId: "PCT/US2026/084920",
          lanthanideElementSymbols: "Nd-Pr-Dy-Tb (Neodymium/Dysprosium)",
          separationPurityBps: 9999,
          licensingRoyaltyBps: 450,
          carbonRegistryStandard: "Verra VCS / UN Paris Agreement Art. 6.4",
          serialBatchRange: "VCS-2026-US-840-0001-9999",
          vintageYear: 2026,
          co2TonnesPerToken: 1,
        },
        attributes:
          cid === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
            ? [
                {
                  label: "Trait Classification",
                  value: "Intellectual Property (Rare Earth IP)",
                  accent: "emerald",
                },
                {
                  label: "WIPO Patent Filing ID",
                  value: "PCT/US2026/084920",
                  accent: "cyan",
                },
                {
                  label: "Lanthanide Elements",
                  value: "Nd-Pr-Dy-Tb",
                  accent: "purple",
                },
                {
                  label: "Purity & Royalty",
                  value: "99.99% Purity · 4.50% Royalty",
                  accent: "amber",
                },
              ]
            : cid === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
            ? [
                {
                  label: "Trait Classification",
                  value: "Carbon Credit (Carbon Credit Derivative)",
                  accent: "cyan",
                },
                {
                  label: "Registry Standard",
                  value: "Verra VCS / UN Art. 6.4",
                  accent: "emerald",
                },
                {
                  label: "Vintage & Ratio",
                  value: "Vintage 2026 · 1.00 tCO2e/Token",
                  accent: "amber",
                },
                {
                  label: "Serial Batch",
                  value: "VCS-2026-US-840-0001-9999",
                  accent: "purple",
                },
              ]
            : [
                {
                  label: "Trait Classification",
                  value: preset.shortTraitLabel,
                  accent: "amber",
                },
                {
                  label: "Variety Identifier",
                  value: preset.varietyIdentifier,
                  accent: "cyan",
                },
                {
                  label: "Physical Backing",
                  value: preset.commodityBacking,
                  accent: "emerald",
                },
                {
                  label: "Custodian Registry",
                  value: preset.custodianRegistry,
                  accent: "purple",
                },
              ],
        assignedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    });
    return initialMap;
  });

  // State for 2^8 address generation
  const [addressBatchCount, setAddressBatchCount] = useState<number>(256);
  const [generatedAddresses, setGeneratedAddresses] = useState<
    Array<{
      index: number;
      address: string;
      chain: ChainType;
      salt: string;
      standard: string;
      mathChecked: boolean;
    }>
  >(() => generateContractAddressBatch(256, "ethereum"));

  // State for tokenomics customization
  const [reserveSharesPower, setReserveSharesPower] = useState<number>(8); // 2^8 = 256
  const [reserveOwner, setReserveOwner] = useState<string>(SOVEREIGN_OWNER);
  const [cmcFloorMetric, setCmcFloorMetric] = useState<number>(256); // >= 2^8

  // Interactive UI feedback
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedJsonLd, setCopiedJsonLd] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedAddressIndex, setCopiedAddressIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [actionNotice, setActionNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Calculate power of two shares
  const computedReserveShares = Math.pow(2, reserveSharesPower);

  // Active token's tokenomics or generated fallback
  const currentTokenomics = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeToken?.tokenomics) return activeToken.tokenomics;
    if (activeToken) {
      return buildInstitutionalTokenomics(
        activeToken.name,
        activeToken.symbol,
        activeToken.chain,
        activeToken.tokenStandard
      );
    }
    return buildInstitutionalTokenomics(
      "Sovereign Protocol",
      "SOV",
      "ethereum",
      "ERC-20"
    );
  }, [activeToken]);

  const currentClassPreset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[selectedAssetClass];

  // Live computed TWEAssetToken.PhysicalBacking struct for the selected Asset Class
  const activePhysicalBackingStruct = useMemo<TwePhysicalBackingStruct>(() => {
    const specializedStr =
      selectedAssetClass === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
        ? `Rare Earth Intellectual Property | WIPO: ${wipoPatentFilingId} | Elements: ${lanthanideElements} | Purity: ${(
            separationPurityBps / 100
          ).toFixed(2)}% | Royalty: ${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(2)}%`
        : selectedAssetClass === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        ? `Carbon Credit Derivative | Standard: ${carbonRegistryStandard} | Batch: ${serialBatchRange} | Vintage: ${vintageYear} | Ratio: ${co2TonnesPerToken} tCO2e/Token`
        : `${currentClassPreset.categoryName} | Variety: ${physicalVarietyIdentifier} | Unit: ${physicalMeasurementUnit}`;

    const backingTypeEnum =
      selectedAssetClass === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY"
        : selectedAssetClass === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        : selectedAssetClass === "AEROSPACE_PROPULSION"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.AEROSPACE_PROPULSION_ELEMENT"
        : selectedAssetClass === "MINERAL_BULLION"
        ? "PhysicalBackingType.REFINED_MINERAL_BULLION"
        : "PhysicalBackingType.SOVEREIGN_RWA_COMMODITY";

    return {
      backingType: backingTypeEnum,
      category: currentClassPreset.categoryName,
      varietyIdentifier: physicalVarietyIdentifier,
      commodityType: physicalCommodityType,
      measurementUnit: physicalMeasurementUnit,
      custodianRegistry: physicalCustodianRegistry,
      auditorVerificationHash: physicalAuditorHash,
      specializedAttributes: specializedStr,
      wipoPatentFilingId,
      lanthanideElementSymbols: lanthanideElements,
      separationPurityBps,
      licensingRoyaltyBps,
      carbonRegistryStandard,
      serialBatchRange,
      vintageYear,
      co2TonnesPerToken,
    };
  }, [
    selectedAssetClass,
    currentClassPreset,
    physicalVarietyIdentifier,
    physicalCommodityType,
    physicalMeasurementUnit,
    physicalCustodianRegistry,
    physicalAuditorHash,
    wipoPatentFilingId,
    lanthanideElements,
    separationPurityBps,
    licensingRoyaltyBps,
    carbonRegistryStandard,
    serialBatchRange,
    vintageYear,
    co2TonnesPerToken,
  ]);

  // Active token's currently assigned trait record (or live preview from selectedAssetClass)
  const activeTokenTraitRecord = useMemo<AssignedTokenTraitRecord>(() => {
    if (activeToken && assignedTokenTraits[activeToken.id]) {
      return assignedTokenTraits[activeToken.id];
    }
    return buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(
      activeToken?.id || "preview",
      selectedAssetClass
    );
  }, [
    activeToken,
    assignedTokenTraits,
    selectedAssetClass,
    physicalVarietyIdentifier,
    physicalCommodityType,
    physicalMeasurementUnit,
    physicalCustodianRegistry,
    physicalAuditorHash,
    wipoPatentFilingId,
    lanthanideElements,
    separationPurityBps,
    licensingRoyaltyBps,
    metallurgicalStandard,
    carbonRegistryStandard,
    vintageYear,
    co2TonnesPerToken,
    serialBatchRange,
    methodologyCode,
    totalRetiredTonnes,
  ]);

  // Specialized JSON-LD Metadata Payload for the selected Custom Asset Class
  const specializedJsonLdMetadata = useMemo(() => {
    const basePayload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      $schema: tweMetadataSchema.$schema || "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
      title: tweMetadataSchema.title || "TWETokenMetadataSchema",
      "@context": "https://schema.org/",
      "@type": "FinancialProduct",
      exchangeATS: "Token World Exchange ATS® (TWE)",
      governingAuthority: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III (TAURUS-1987-05-06)",
      name: customTokenName,
      tickerSymbol: customTokenSymbol,
      assetProperties: {
        traitLabel: currentClassPreset.shortTraitLabel,
        category: currentClassPreset.categoryName,
        varietyIdentifier: activePhysicalBackingStruct.varietyIdentifier,
        physicalBacking: {
          backingType: activePhysicalBackingStruct.backingType,
          category: activePhysicalBackingStruct.category,
          varietyIdentifier: activePhysicalBackingStruct.varietyIdentifier,
          commodityType: activePhysicalBackingStruct.commodityType,
          measurementUnit: activePhysicalBackingStruct.measurementUnit,
          custodianRegistry: activePhysicalBackingStruct.custodianRegistry,
          auditorVerificationHash:
            activePhysicalBackingStruct.auditorVerificationHash,
          specializedAttributes:
            activePhysicalBackingStruct.specializedAttributes,
          wipoPatentFilingId: activePhysicalBackingStruct.wipoPatentFilingId,
          lanthanideElementSymbols:
            activePhysicalBackingStruct.lanthanideElementSymbols,
          separationPurityBps: activePhysicalBackingStruct.separationPurityBps,
          licensingRoyaltyBps: activePhysicalBackingStruct.licensingRoyaltyBps,
          carbonRegistryStandard:
            activePhysicalBackingStruct.carbonRegistryStandard,
          serialBatchRange: activePhysicalBackingStruct.serialBatchRange,
          vintageYear: activePhysicalBackingStruct.vintageYear,
          co2TonnesPerToken: activePhysicalBackingStruct.co2TonnesPerToken,
        },
        specializedClassAttributes: {
          assetClassEnum: selectedAssetClass,
          ...(selectedAssetClass === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
            ? {
                rareEarthIntellectualProperty: {
                  wipoPatentFilingId,
                  lanthanideElementSymbols: lanthanideElements,
                  separationPurityBps,
                  separationPurityPercent: `${(separationPurityBps / 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
                  licensingRoyaltyBps,
                  licensingRoyaltyPercent: `${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
                  metallurgicalProcessStandard: metallurgicalStandard,
                },
              }
            : {}),
          ...(selectedAssetClass === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
            ? {
                carbonCreditDerivative: {
                  carbonRegistryStandard,
                  vintageYear,
                  co2TonnesPerToken,
                  methodologyCode,
                  serialRetirementBatch: serialBatchRange,
                  cumulativeRetiredTonnes: totalRetiredTonnes,
                  isRetirableOnChain: true,
                },
              }
            : {}),
        },
        smartContractContext: {
          contractName: "TWEAssetToken",
          onChainStruct: "TWEAssetToken.PhysicalBacking",
          standard: "ERC-20 (OpenZeppelin v5.0 · Solc 0.8.26)",
          deploymentType: "CREATE2 Deterministic Factory",
          decimals: 18,
          initialSupplyWholeTokens: customInitialSupply,
          powerOfTwoReserves: computedReserveShares,
        },
      },
    };
    return JSON.stringify(basePayload, null, 2);
  }, [
    customTokenName,
    customTokenSymbol,
    currentClassPreset,
    activePhysicalBackingStruct,
    selectedAssetClass,
    wipoPatentFilingId,
    lanthanideElements,
    separationPurityBps,
    licensingRoyaltyBps,
    metallurgicalStandard,
    carbonRegistryStandard,
    vintageYear,
    co2TonnesPerToken,
    methodologyCode,
    serialBatchRange,
    totalRetiredTonnes,
    customInitialSupply,
    computedReserveShares,
  ]);

  // Specialized Solidity Contract Stub for the selected Custom Asset Class
  const specializedSolidityContract = useMemo(() => {
    return `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

/**
 * @title TWEAssetToken
 * @dev Standardized ERC-20 token with an on-chain PhysicalBacking struct supporting
 *      'Rare Earth Intellectual Property' and 'Carbon Credit Derivative' types
 *      for dynamic token classification.
 */
contract TWEAssetToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    enum AssetClass {
        AEROSPACE_PROPULSION,
        MINERAL_BULLION,
        RARE_EARTH_IP,
        CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE,
        SOVEREIGN_COMMODITY
    }

    enum PhysicalBackingType {
        RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY,
        CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE,
        AEROSPACE_PROPULSION_ELEMENT,
        REFINED_MINERAL_BULLION,
        SOVEREIGN_RWA_COMMODITY
    }

    string public constant CATEGORY_AEROSPACE_PROPULSION = "Aerospace Propulsion Element";
    string public constant CATEGORY_MINERAL_BULLION = "Refined Titanium & Gold Bullion";
    string public constant CATEGORY_RARE_EARTH_IP = "Rare Earth Intellectual Property";
    string public constant CATEGORY_CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE = "Carbon Credit Derivative";
    string public constant CATEGORY_SOVEREIGN_COMMODITY = "Sovereign RWA Commodity";

    struct PhysicalBacking {
        PhysicalBackingType backingType; // RARE_EARTH_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY | CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE
        string category;                 // "Rare Earth Intellectual Property" | "Carbon Credit Derivative"
        string varietyIdentifier;        // "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.varietyIdentifier}"
        string commodityType;            // "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.commodityType}"
        string measurementUnit;          // "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.measurementUnit}"
        string custodianRegistry;        // "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.custodianRegistry}"
        bytes32 auditorVerificationHash; // ${activePhysicalBackingStruct.auditorVerificationHash}
        string specializedAttributes;    // "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.specializedAttributes}"
        string wipoPatentFilingId;       // "${wipoPatentFilingId}"
        string lanthanideElementSymbols; // "${lanthanideElements}"
        uint256 separationPurityBps;     // ${separationPurityBps}
        uint256 licensingRoyaltyBps;     // ${licensingRoyaltyBps}
        string carbonRegistryStandard;   // "${carbonRegistryStandard}"
        string serialBatchRange;         // "${serialBatchRange}"
        uint256 vintageYear;             // ${vintageYear}
        uint256 co2TonnesPerToken;       // ${co2TonnesPerToken}
    }

    PhysicalBacking public physicalBacking;
    AssetClass public assetClass;
    string public assetCategory;
    string public commodityMetadataURI;
}

${TWE_MULTI_COMMODITY_FACTORY_SOL_SOURCE}

/* ============================================================================
 * ACTIVE ASSET CLASS & PHYSICAL BACKING CONFIGURATION (${currentClassPreset.label.toUpperCase()})
 * ============================================================================
 * Token Name:              "${customTokenName}"
 * Symbol:                  "${customTokenSymbol}"
 * AssetClass Enum:         TWEAssetToken.${currentClassPreset.solidityEnum}
 * Initial Supply:          ${customInitialSupply.toLocaleString()} (${customInitialSupply} * 10^18 Wei)
 * 2^8 Reserves:            ${computedReserveShares} Sovereign Reserve Shares
 * Metadata URI:            "${currentClassPreset.metadataURI}"
 *
 * --- TWEAssetToken.PhysicalBacking Struct Values ---
 * physicalBacking.backingType:             ${activePhysicalBackingStruct.backingType}
 * physicalBacking.category:                "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.category}"
 * physicalBacking.varietyIdentifier:       "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.varietyIdentifier}"
 * physicalBacking.commodityType:           "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.commodityType}"
 * physicalBacking.measurementUnit:         "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.measurementUnit}"
 * physicalBacking.custodianRegistry:       "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.custodianRegistry}"
 * physicalBacking.auditorVerificationHash: ${activePhysicalBackingStruct.auditorVerificationHash}
 * physicalBacking.specializedAttributes:   "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.specializedAttributes}"
${
  selectedAssetClass === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
    ? ` *
 * --- RareEarthIPAttributes Struct Values ---
 * WIPO Patent ID:   "${wipoPatentFilingId}"
 * Lanthanides:      "${lanthanideElements}"
 * Purity / Royalty: ${separationPurityBps} bps (${(
        separationPurityBps / 100
      ).toFixed(2)}%) | ${licensingRoyaltyBps} bps (${(
        licensingRoyaltyBps / 100
      ).toFixed(2)}%)`
    : selectedAssetClass === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
    ? ` *
 * --- CarbonCreditAttributes Struct Values ---
 * Carbon Standard:  "${carbonRegistryStandard}"
 * Serial Batch:     "${serialBatchRange}"
 * Vintage / Ratio:  ${vintageYear} | ${co2TonnesPerToken} tCO2e per Token
 * Retired Tonnes:   ${totalRetiredTonnes.toLocaleString()} tCO2e`
    : ` * Backing Spec:     "${activePhysicalBackingStruct.commodityType}"`
}
 * ============================================================================ */`;
  }, [
    currentClassPreset,
    activePhysicalBackingStruct,
    customTokenName,
    customTokenSymbol,
    customInitialSupply,
    computedReserveShares,
    selectedAssetClass,
    wipoPatentFilingId,
    lanthanideElements,
    separationPurityBps,
    licensingRoyaltyBps,
    carbonRegistryStandard,
    serialBatchRange,
    vintageYear,
    co2TonnesPerToken,
    totalRetiredTonnes,
  ]);

  const handleSelectAssetClassPreset = (id: TweCustomAssetClassId) => {
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[id];
    setSelectedAssetClass(id);
    setCustomTokenName(preset.defaultTokenName);
    setCustomTokenSymbol(preset.defaultSymbol);
    setCustomInitialSupply(preset.defaultSupply);
    setPhysicalVarietyIdentifier(preset.varietyIdentifier);
    setPhysicalCommodityType(preset.commodityBacking);
    setPhysicalMeasurementUnit(preset.measurementUnit);
    setPhysicalCustodianRegistry(preset.custodianRegistry);
  };

  // Filter state for Generated Portfolio Tokens trait table
  const [traitFilterClass, setTraitFilterClass] = useState<
    "ALL" | TweCustomAssetClassId
  >("ALL");

  const buildSpecializedAttributesMap = (
    classId: TweCustomAssetClassId
  ): Record<string, string | number | boolean> => {
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[classId];
    if (classId === "RARE_EARTH_IP") {
      return {
        assetClassEnum: classId,
        traitLabel: "Intellectual Property",
        schemaCategory: preset.categoryName,
        wipoPatentFilingId,
        lanthanideElements,
        separationPurityBps,
        separationPurityPercent: `${(separationPurityBps / 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
        licensingRoyaltyBps,
        licensingRoyaltyPercent: `${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
        metallurgicalStandard,
      };
    }
    if (classId === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE") {
      return {
        assetClassEnum: classId,
        traitLabel: "Carbon Credit",
        schemaCategory: preset.categoryName,
        carbonRegistryStandard,
        serialBatchRange,
        vintageYear,
        co2TonnesPerToken,
        methodologyCode,
        cumulativeRetiredTonnes: totalRetiredTonnes,
        isRetirableOnChain: true,
      };
    }
    return {
      assetClassEnum: classId,
      traitLabel: preset.shortTraitLabel,
      schemaCategory: preset.categoryName,
      varietyIdentifier: preset.varietyIdentifier,
      commodityBacking: preset.commodityBacking,
      measurementUnit: preset.measurementUnit,
      custodianRegistry: preset.custodianRegistry,
    };
  };

  // Assign a specific Asset Class directly to any token by ID
  const handleAssignClassToSpecificToken = (
    tokenId: string,
    classId: TweCustomAssetClassId
  ) => {
    const targetToken = tokens.find((t) => t.id === tokenId);
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[classId];
    const traitRecord = buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(tokenId, classId);

    setAssignedTokenTraits((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [tokenId]: traitRecord,
    }));

    if (targetToken && onBulkUpdateTokens) {
      const generated = buildInstitutionalTokenomics(
        targetToken.name,
        targetToken.symbol,
        targetToken.chain,
        targetToken.tokenStandard
      );
      onBulkUpdateTokens([tokenId], {
        assetClassEnum: classId,
        assetClassCategory: preset.categoryName,
        assetClassTrait: preset.shortTraitLabel,
        specializedAttributes: buildSpecializedAttributesMap(classId),
        description: `${preset.shortTraitLabel} — ${traitRecord.specializedSummary}`,
        tokenomics: {
          ...generated,
          tagline: `${preset.shortTraitLabel}: ${traitRecord.specializedSummary}`,
          solidityStub: specializedSolidityContract,
        },
      });
    }

    setActionNotice(
      `Assigned Asset Class '${preset.shortTraitLabel}' (${preset.categoryName}) to ${
        targetToken?.symbol || tokenId
      }!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  // Batch-assign the currently selected Asset Class to visible generated tokens
  const handleBatchAssignSelectedClassToAll = () => {
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[selectedAssetClass];
    const nextTraits: Record<string, AssignedTokenTraitRecord> = {
      ...assignedTokenTraits,
    };
    const targetSlice = tokens.slice(0, 25);
    targetSlice.forEach((tok) => {
      nextTraits[tok.id] = buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(
        tok.id,
        selectedAssetClass
      );
    });
    setAssignedTokenTraits(nextTraits);

    if (onBulkUpdateTokens && targetSlice.length > 0) {
      const sampleTrait = buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(
        targetSlice[0].id,
        selectedAssetClass
      );
      onBulkUpdateTokens(
        targetSlice.map((t) => t.id),
        {
          assetClassEnum: selectedAssetClass,
          assetClassCategory: preset.categoryName,
          assetClassTrait: preset.shortTraitLabel,
          specializedAttributes:
            buildSpecializedAttributesMap(selectedAssetClass),
          description: `${preset.shortTraitLabel} — ${sampleTrait.specializedSummary}`,
        }
      );
    }

    setActionNotice(
      `Dynamically assigned Asset Class '${preset.shortTraitLabel}' (${preset.categoryName}) across ${targetSlice.length} generated tokens!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  // Generate a new batch of tokens pre-assigned with the selected Asset Class & specialized attributes
  const handleGenerateBatchWithSelectedAssetClass = (batchCount: number = 10) => {
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[selectedAssetClass];
    const rawBatch = generateTokenBatch(batchCount, {
      chains: ["ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "solana"],
      narratives: ["rwa", "quantum_defi"],
      standards: ["ERC-20"],
      eip55Checksum: true,
    });

    const newTraitEntries: Record<string, AssignedTokenTraitRecord> = {};
    const enrichedBatch: TokenRecord[] = rawBatch.map((baseTok, idx) => {
      const traitRecord = buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(
        baseTok.id,
        selectedAssetClass
      );
      newTraitEntries[baseTok.id] = traitRecord;
      const tokName = `${preset.shortTraitLabel} ${baseTok.name}`;
      const tokSymbol = `${preset.defaultSymbol}-${idx + 1}`;
      const generated = buildInstitutionalTokenomics(
        tokName,
        tokSymbol,
        baseTok.chain,
        baseTok.tokenStandard
      );
      return {
        ...baseTok,
        name: tokName,
        symbol: tokSymbol,
        assetClassEnum: selectedAssetClass,
        assetClassCategory: preset.categoryName,
        assetClassTrait: preset.shortTraitLabel,
        specializedAttributes:
          buildSpecializedAttributesMap(selectedAssetClass),
        description: `${preset.shortTraitLabel} — ${traitRecord.specializedSummary}`,
        powerOfTwoReserves: computedReserveShares,
        coinmarketcapMetric: Math.max(cmcFloorMetric, 256),
        targetOwner: reserveOwner,
        tokenomics: {
          ...generated,
          tagline: `${preset.shortTraitLabel}: ${traitRecord.specializedSummary}`,
          solidityStub: specializedSolidityContract,
        },
        tokenomicsPillars: generated.pillars,
      };
    });

    setAssignedTokenTraits((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      ...newTraitEntries,
    }));

    if (onAddTokens) {
      onAddTokens(enrichedBatch);
    }
    if (enrichedBatch[0]) {
      setSelectedTokenId(enrichedBatch[0].id);
      if (onSelectToken) onSelectToken(enrichedBatch[0]);
    }

    setActionNotice(
      `Generated ${enrichedBatch.length} new tokens assigned with '${preset.shortTraitLabel}' (${preset.categoryName}) specialized schema attributes!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  // Export schema-compliant JSON-LD for a specific generated token
  const handleExportTokenSchemaJson = (tok: TokenRecord) => {
    const trait =
      assignedTokenTraits[tok.id] ||
      buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(tok.id, selectedAssetClass);
    const preset = TWE_CUSTOM_ASSET_CLASS_PRESETS[trait.assetClassId];
    const payload = {
      $schema:
        tweMetadataSchema.$schema ||
        "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
      title: tweMetadataSchema.title || "TWETokenMetadataSchema",
      "@context": "https://schema.org/",
      "@type": "FinancialProduct",
      exchangeATS: "Token World Exchange ATS® (TWE)",
      governingAuthority: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III (TAURUS-1987-05-06)",
      tokenId: tok.id,
      name: tok.name,
      tickerSymbol: tok.symbol,
      contractAddress: tok.contractAddress,
      chain: tok.chain,
      assetProperties: {
        category: preset.categoryName,
        traitLabel: preset.shortTraitLabel,
        varietyIdentifier: preset.varietyIdentifier,
        physicalBacking: {
          commodityType: preset.commodityBacking,
          measurementUnit: preset.measurementUnit,
          custodianRegistry: preset.custodianRegistry,
          auditorVerificationHash:
            "0x9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08",
        },
        specializedClassAttributes: buildSpecializedAttributesMap(
          trait.assetClassId
        ),
        attributesList: trait.attributes,
      },
    };
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], {
      type: "application/json;charset=utf-8;",
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute(
      "download",
      `TWE_${tok.symbol}_${trait.assetClassId}_Schema.json`
    );
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setActionNotice(
      `Exported TWETokenMetadataSchema JSON for ${tok.symbol} (${trait.shortTraitLabel})!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedCode(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCode(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleCopyJsonLd = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedJsonLd(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedJsonLd(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleMintCustomAssetClassToken = () => {
    const [baseToken] = generateTokenBatch(1, {
      chains: ["ethereum"],
      narratives: ["rwa"],
      standards: ["ERC-20"],
      eip55Checksum: true,
    });

    const generated = buildInstitutionalTokenomics(
      customTokenName,
      customTokenSymbol,
      "ethereum",
      "ERC-20"
    );

    const specializedDescription =
      selectedAssetClass === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
        ? `Rare Earth Intellectual Property (${wipoPatentFilingId} · ${lanthanideElements} · ${(
            separationPurityBps / 100
          ).toFixed(2)}% Purity · ${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(
            2
          )}% Royalty)`
        : selectedAssetClass === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
        ? `Carbon Credit Derivative (${carbonRegistryStandard} · Vintage ${vintageYear} · ${co2TonnesPerToken} tCO2e/Token · Batch ${serialBatchRange})`
        : `${currentClassPreset.categoryName} (${currentClassPreset.commodityBacking})`;

    const newRecord: TokenRecord = {
      ...baseToken,
      name: customTokenName,
      symbol: customTokenSymbol,
      initialSupply: `${customInitialSupply.toLocaleString()}`,
      assetClassEnum: selectedAssetClass,
      assetClassCategory: currentClassPreset.categoryName,
      assetClassTrait: currentClassPreset.shortTraitLabel,
      specializedAttributes: buildSpecializedAttributesMap(selectedAssetClass),
      description: specializedDescription,
      marketCap: Math.max(baseToken.marketCap, 3_500_000_000),
      powerOfTwoReserves: computedReserveShares,
      coinmarketcapMetric: Math.max(cmcFloorMetric, 256),
      targetOwner: reserveOwner,
      tokenomics: {
        ...generated,
        tagline: specializedDescription,
        solidityStub: specializedSolidityContract,
      },
      tokenomicsPillars: generated.pillars,
    };

    const traitRecord = buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(
      newRecord.id,
      selectedAssetClass
    );
    setAssignedTokenTraits((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [newRecord.id]: traitRecord,
    }));

    if (onAddTokens) {
      onAddTokens([newRecord]);
    }
    if (onSelectToken) {
      onSelectToken(newRecord);
    }
    setSelectedTokenId(newRecord.id);
    setActionNotice(
      `Minted & injected ${customTokenName} (${customTokenSymbol}) with Asset Class '${currentClassPreset.shortTraitLabel}' [${currentClassPreset.solidityEnum}] into portfolio!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleApplyAssetClassToActiveToken = () => {
    if (!activeToken) return;
    const traitRecord = buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(
      activeToken.id,
      selectedAssetClass
    );
    setAssignedTokenTraits((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [activeToken.id]: traitRecord,
    }));

    if (onBulkUpdateTokens) {
      const generated = buildInstitutionalTokenomics(
        customTokenName,
        customTokenSymbol,
        activeToken.chain,
        activeToken.tokenStandard
      );
      const specializedDescription =
        selectedAssetClass === "RARE_EARTH_IP"
          ? `Rare Earth Intellectual Property (${wipoPatentFilingId} · ${lanthanideElements} · ${(
              separationPurityBps / 100
            ).toFixed(2)}% Purity · ${(licensingRoyaltyBps / 100).toFixed(
              2
            )}% Royalty)`
          : selectedAssetClass === "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE"
          ? `Carbon Credit Derivative (${carbonRegistryStandard} · Vintage ${vintageYear} · ${co2TonnesPerToken} tCO2e/Token · Batch ${serialBatchRange})`
          : `${currentClassPreset.categoryName} (${currentClassPreset.commodityBacking})`;

      onBulkUpdateTokens([activeToken.id], {
        name: customTokenName,
        symbol: customTokenSymbol,
        initialSupply: `${customInitialSupply.toLocaleString()}`,
        assetClassEnum: selectedAssetClass,
        assetClassCategory: currentClassPreset.categoryName,
        assetClassTrait: currentClassPreset.shortTraitLabel,
        specializedAttributes:
          buildSpecializedAttributesMap(selectedAssetClass),
        description: specializedDescription,
        powerOfTwoReserves: computedReserveShares,
        coinmarketcapMetric: Math.max(cmcFloorMetric, 256),
        targetOwner: reserveOwner,
        tokenomics: {
          ...generated,
          tagline: specializedDescription,
          solidityStub: specializedSolidityContract,
        },
      });
    }
    setActionNotice(
      `Assigned Asset Class '${currentClassPreset.shortTraitLabel}' (${currentClassPreset.label}) & specialized metadata to ${activeToken.symbol}!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleSimulateCarbonRetirement = () => {
    const addedTonnes =
      retireSimulationAmount * Math.max(1, co2TonnesPerToken);
    setTotalRetiredTonnes((prev) => prev + addedTonnes);
    setCustomInitialSupply((prev) =>
      Math.max(0, prev - retireSimulationAmount)
    );
    setActionNotice(
      `Executed TWEAssetToken.retireCarbonCredits(${retireSimulationAmount}, "${retirementBeneficiary}") — permanently retired ${addedTonnes.toLocaleString()} tCO2e on-chain!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleRegenerateAddresses = () => {
    const count = Math.max(256, addressBatchCount);
    const newAddresses = generateContractAddressBatch(
      count,
      activeToken?.chain || "ethereum"
    );
    setGeneratedAddresses(newAddresses);
    setActionNotice(
      `Synthesized ${newAddresses.length} verified smart contract addresses (>= 2⁸)!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleApplyTokenomicsToAllTokens = () => {
    if (!onBulkUpdateTokens || tokens.length === 0) return;
    const allIds = tokens.map((t) => t.id);
    allIds.forEach((id) => {
      const token = tokens.find((t) => t.id === id);
      const generated = buildInstitutionalTokenomics(
        token?.name || "Asset",
        token?.symbol || "TOK",
        token?.chain || "ethereum",
        token?.tokenStandard || "ERC-20"
      );
      onBulkUpdateTokens([id], {
        powerOfTwoReserves: computedReserveShares,
        coinmarketcapMetric: Math.max(cmcFloorMetric, 256),
        reserveShares: `${computedReserveShares * 1e18}`,
        targetOwner: reserveOwner,
        tokenomics: generated,
        tokenomicsPillars: generated.pillars,
      });
    });
    setActionNotice(
      `Institutional 2⁸ Tokenomics applied across all ${tokens.length} cryptocurrencies in portfolio!`
    );
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  const handleDownloadAddressCSV = () => {
    const csvContent =
      "Index,Smart Contract Address,Chain,Standard,Deployment Salt,Math Checked\n" +
      generatedAddresses
        .map(
          (a) =>
            `${a.index},${a.address},${a.chain},${a.standard},${a.salt},true`
        )
        .join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute(
      "download",
      `contract_addresses_2exp8_batch_${Date.now()}.csv`
    );
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    setActionNotice("Downloaded 2⁸ Smart Contract Addresses CSV manifest!");
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3000);
  };

  return (
    <div id="tokenomics-engine-view" className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#121216] via-[#16161A] to-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400">
                <Scale className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2">
                INSTITUTIONAL TOKENOMICS, CUSTOM RWA CLASSES & 2⁸ RESERVE FOUNDRY
              </h1>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse font-mono text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-[#1F1F23] text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] uppercase">
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Token</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Chain / Standard</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Assigned Asset Class</th>

                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">
                      Asset Class Dropdown & Schema Export
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1F1F23]/60">
                  {tokens
                    .slice(0, 25)
                    .map((tok, index) => {
                      const fallbackIds: TweCustomAssetClassId[] = [
                        "RARE_EARTH_IP",
                        "CARBON_CREDIT_DERIVATIVE",
                        "AEROSPACE_PROPULSION",
                        "MINERAL_BULLION",
                        "SOVEREIGN_COMMODITY",
                      ];
                      const currentTrait =
                        assignedTokenTraits[tok.id] ||
                        buildTraitRecordForAssetClass(
                          tok.id,
                          tok.assetClassEnum ||
                            fallbackIds[index % fallbackIds.length]
                        );
                      return { tok, currentTrait };
                    })
                    .filter(({ currentTrait }) =>
                      traitFilterClass === "ALL"
                        ? true
                        : currentTrait.assetClassId === traitFilterClass
                    )
                    .slice(0, 15)
                    .map(({ tok, currentTrait }) => {
                      const isIp =
                        currentTrait.assetClassId === "RARE_EARTH_IP";
                      const isCarbon =

              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-orange-500/15 hover:bg-orange-500/25 border border-orange-500/40 text-[#F27D26] text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"

              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

            </button>

            <button
              id="btn-vault-validate-all-contracts"

              title="Validate All Token Contract IDs for Remix IDE, Etherscan.io & MetaMask"
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Validate Contract IDs</span>
            </button>

            <button
              id="btn-vault-batch-deploy-queue"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowBatchDeployModal(true)}
              title="Launch Single-Click Batch Deployment Queue & Script Generator"
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/20 to-orange-500/20 hover:from-amber-500/30 hover:to-orange-500/30 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-sm"
            >
              <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>
                Batch Deploy Queue
                {selectedVaultTokenIds.size > 0 ? ` (${selectedVaultTokenIds.size})` : ""}
              </span>
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0C]">
              <button
                id="btn-vault-export-json"
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportJSON}
                disabled={vaultTokens.length === 0}
                title="Export Vault as JSON"
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-[#1E1E24] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer border-r border-[#1F1F23] disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <FileCode className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              <button
                id="btn-vault-export-csv"
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportCSV}
                disabled={vaultTokens.length === 0}
                title="Export Vault as CSV"
                className="p-1.5 hover:bg-[#1E1E24] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback Alert if present */}
        {actionFeedback && (
          <div className="mt-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#F27D26]/15 border border-[#F27D26]/30 text-[#F27D26] text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-2 animate-fadeIn">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{actionFeedback}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Key Vault Metrics Row */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 pt-4">
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23]">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] mb-1">
              <span>Vault Tokens</span>
              <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
              {isLoading ? "..." : vaultTokens.length.toLocaleString()}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-green-500 font-mono flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
              <CloudCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Live in Firestore</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23]">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] mb-1">
              <span>Max List Limit</span>
              <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#F27D26]" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white">
                {workingTokens.length}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-[#666] font-mono">/ {maxCapacity}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono mt-0.5">
              {isListMaxReached ? (
                <span className="text-[#F27D26] font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                  Auto-Secured in Memory
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-[#8E9299]">
                  {maxCapacity - workingTokens.length} capacity left
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23]">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] mb-1">
              <span>Security Score</span>
              <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-500" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-green-400">
              {avgSecurity} <span className="text-xs text-[#666]">/ 100</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-0.5">
              Strict ABAC verification
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23]">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] mb-1">
              <span>Vault Snapshots</span>
              <Archive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-cyan-400">
              {snapshots.length}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-0.5">
              Audit memory checkpoints
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Treasury Wallet ID Protection Card */}
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-cyan-500/30 col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] mb-1">
              <span>Treasury Wallet ID</span>
              <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold font-mono text-cyan-300 truncate">
                {isTreasuryWalletHidden ? "••••••••••••••••" : "0x70Ac...94f0"}
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsTreasuryWalletHidden(!isTreasuryWalletHidden)}
                className="p-1 rounded text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title={isTreasuryWalletHidden ? "Reveal Treasury Wallet ID" : "Hide Treasury Wallet ID in Vault"}
              >
                {isTreasuryWalletHidden ? (
                  <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">
                {isTreasuryWalletHidden ? "Hidden in Vault (Protected)" : "Revealed (Admin Mode)"}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Encrypted Memory Health Check & Integrity Scan Dashboard Widget */}
        <div
          id="token-vault-memory-health-widget"
          className="mt-3 p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0C0D12] via-[#10121A] to-[#0C0D12] border border-[#222430] flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-inner"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div
              className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border ${
                healthReport?.overallStatus === "corrupted"
                  ? "bg-red-500/15 border-red-500/50 text-red-400"
                  : healthReport?.overallStatus === "healthy"
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400"
                  : "bg-cyan-500/15 border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-400"
              }`}
            >
              {healthReport?.overallStatus === "corrupted" ? (
                <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 animate-bounce" />
              ) : (
                <HeartPulse className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Memory Health Diagnostic:
                </span>
                {healthReport?.overallStatus === "corrupted" ? (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/40 flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-400"></span>
                    CORRUPTED ({healthReport.corruptedBlobsCount} fault{healthReport.corruptedBlobsCount > 1 ? "s" : ""})
                  </span>
                ) : healthReport?.overallStatus === "healthy" ? (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>
                    ALL BLOBS VERIFIED (AES-GCM-256)
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30">
                    {healthReport?.overallStatus?.toUpperCase() || "INITIALIZING..."}
                  </span>
                )}

                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                  {healthReport?.healthyBlobsCount || 0}/{healthReport?.totalBlobsChecked || 0} Blobs Decryptable
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299] mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span>
                  Last Health Check:{" "}
                  <strong className="text-gray-200">
                    {healthReport?.timestamp
                      ? new Date(healthReport.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()
                      : "Never run"}
                  </strong>
                </span>
                <span>•</span>
                <span className="text-cyan-400/90 font-mono">
                  {healthReport?.cryptoApiAvailable ? "Web Crypto Subtle Active" : "No Crypto API"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end md:self-center shrink-0">
            <button
              id="btn-vault-manual-integrity-scan"
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRunManualIntegrityScan}
              disabled={isScanningHealth}
              title="Validate AES-GCM tags, Base64 IV/Salt lengths, and JSON decryptability on encrypted memory blobs"
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#16161A] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] border border-[#2A2A35] hover:border-cyan-500/50 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 active:scale-95 shadow-sm"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400 ${isScanningHealth ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              <span>{isScanningHealth ? "Scanning Blobs..." : "Run Integrity Scan"}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              id="btn-vault-view-diagnostics"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowHealthModal(true)}
              title="Open Comprehensive Encrypted Memory Health Diagnostics Tool"
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#16161A] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] border border-[#2A2A35] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white text-xs font-mono font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
              <span>Diagnostics Inspector</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Generation Controller Strip: Enforces "Don't generate when not on start loop OR token generate 100 IDS" */}
        <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-[#1F1F23] flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-[#0E0E10] p-3 rounded-lg">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${constantLoopActive ? "bg-green-500 animate-pulse" : "bg-[#666]"}`} />
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-medium text-white">
              Generation Policy:
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
              {constantLoopActive 
                ? "Constant Loop Active (Continuous Auto-Save to Vault)" 
                : "Loop Idle — Generation strictly triggered via 'Generate 100 IDs' or Loop Start"}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            {/* Max List Capacity Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md">
              <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Max List:</span>
              <select
                id="select-max-list-capacity"
                value={maxCapacity}
                onChange={(e) => onMaxCapacityChange(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="bg-transparent text-white font-bold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value={50} className="bg-[#16161A]">50 IDs</option>
                <option value={100} className="bg-[#16161A]">100 IDs (Standard)</option>
                <option value={250} className="bg-[#16161A]">250 IDs</option>
                <option value={500} className="bg-[#16161A]">500 IDs</option>
                <option value={1000} className="bg-[#16161A]">1,000 IDs</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Generate 100 IDs Trigger */}
            <button
              id="btn-vault-generate-100"
              type="button"
              onClick={onGenerate100}
              disabled={isGenerating}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-md bg-[#F27D26]/20 hover:bg-[#F27D26]/30 border border-[#F27D26] text-[#F27D26] text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Cpu className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Generate 100 IDs</span>
            </button>

            {/* Constant Loop Toggle */}
            <button
              id="btn-vault-toggle-loop"
              type="button"
              onClick={onToggleConstantLoop}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                constantLoopActive
                  ? "bg-red-500/20 border-red-500 text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/30"
                  : "bg-green-500/20 border-green-500 text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500/30"
              }`}
            >
              {constantLoopActive ? (
                <>
                  <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                  <span>Stop Loop</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                  <span>Start Constant Loop</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Navigation Sub-Tabs: Tokens vs Audit Snapshots */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1F1F23] pb-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            id="tab-vault-tokens"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab("tokens")}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeSubTab === "tokens"
                ? "bg-[#16161A] text-[#F27D26] border border-[#1F1F23]"
                : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Vaulted Token Records ({vaultTokens.length})</span>
          </button>

          <button
            id="tab-vault-snapshots"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveSubTab("snapshots");
              loadSnapshots();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeSubTab === "snapshots"
                ? "bg-[#16161A] text-cyan-400 border border-[#1F1F23]"
                : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Archive className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Memory Snapshots ({snapshots.length})</span>
          </button>

          <button
            id="tab-vault-chunk-engine"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveSubTab("chunk_engine");
              fetchSystemConfig();
              fetchLockedVaultPage(null, 0);
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeSubTab === "chunk_engine"
                ? "bg-[#16161A] text-purple-400 border border-[#1F1F23]"
                : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Server className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Chunk Engine & Rules (/tokenVault)</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {activeSubTab === "tokens" && vaultTokens.length > 0 && (
          <button
            id="btn-purge-vault-prompt"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowPurgeConfirm(true)}
            className="text-[11px] font-mono text-red-400/80 hover:text-red-400 flex items-center gap-1 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>Purge Vault</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Confirmation Modal for Purge */}
      {showPurgeConfirm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
          <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-red-500/40 rounded-xl p-5 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-red-400">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" />
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                Confirm Purge Firebase Token Vault
              </h3>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] leading-relaxed">
              This will permanently delete up to 500 token documents currently stored in your Firebase Cloud Firestore database. Active working tokens in memory will remain untouched.
            </p>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPurgeConfirm(false)}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-xs text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white font-mono cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                id="btn-confirm-purge-vault"
                type="button"
                onClick={handlePurgeVault}
                className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white text-xs font-bold font-mono uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
              >
                Purge All Documents
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 1: Tokens Table */}
      {activeSubTab === "tokens" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Search & Filters Toolbar */}
          <div className="bg-[#0E0E10] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#8E9299] absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                id="input-vault-search"
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search vaulted tokens by address, name, or symbol..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] focus:border-[#F27D26] text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-[#666] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <select
                id="select-vault-chain"
                value={selectedChain}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedChain(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[#E0E0E0] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] font-mono cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="all">All Chains</option>
                <option value="ethereum">Ethereum</option>
                <option value="base">Base</option>
                <option value="arbitrum">Arbitrum</option>
                <option value="polygon">Polygon</option>
                <option value="solana">Solana</option>
                <option value="quantum">Quantum-Hybrid</option>
              </select>

              <select
                id="select-vault-standard"
                value={selectedStandard}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedStandard(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-[#E0E0E0] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F27D26] font-mono cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="all">All Standards</option>
                <option value="ERC-20">ERC-20</option>
                <option value="ERC-721">ERC-721</option>
                <option value="ERC-1155">ERC-1155</option>
                <option value="SPL">SPL</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tokens Table Card */}
          <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
            {isLoading ? (
              <div className="p-12 text-center space-y-3">
                <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-[#F27D26] animate-spin mx-auto" />
                <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                  Loading secured tokens from Firebase Cloud Firestore...
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : filteredTokens.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-12 text-center space-y-3">
                <Shield className="w-8 h-8 text-[#666] mx-auto" />
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white font-mono uppercase">
                  No Tokens Found In Vault
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] max-w-md mx-auto">
                  Tokens generated via Constant Loop or "Generate 100 IDs" are automatically saved here. You can also click "Secure Current List" above to snapshot your active workspace.
                </p>
                <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onGenerate100}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#F27D26] text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Generate 100 IDs Now
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
                  <thead className="bg-[#0E0E10] border-b border-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299] text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Token & Symbol</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Enterprise Contract Address</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Chain & Standard</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Initial Supply</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Security Score</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1F1F23]/60">
                    {filteredTokens.map((token) => (
                      <tr
