                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Enterprise Contract Address */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4">
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <span className="font-mono text-[#00F0FF] text-[11px] bg-[#0A0A0C] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#1F1F23]">
                                {token.contractAddress.slice(0, 8)}...{token.contractAddress.slice(-6)}
                              </span>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  handleCopy(token.contractAddress, token.id);
                                }}
                                className="p-1 text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#0A0A0C] rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Copy Enterprise Contract Address"
                              >
                                {copySuccess === token.id ? (
                                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-500" />
                                ) : (
                                  <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                )}
                              </button>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono uppercase px-1 rounded bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300">
                                Enterprise
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono truncate max-w-[110px]" title={token.contractArchetype || "CREATE2 Proxy"}>
                                {token.contractArchetype ? token.contractArchetype.replace("Enterprise ", "").split("(")[0].trim() : "CREATE2 Proxy"}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                        {/* Chain & Standard */}

                              {token.chain}
                            </span>
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-[#F27D26]/10 text-[#F27D26] border border-[#F27D26]/20">
                              {token.tokenStandard}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Initial Supply */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                          {Number(token.initialSupply).toLocaleString()}
                        </td>

                        {/* Security Score */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500" />
                            <span className="text-green-400 font-bold font-mono">
                              {token.securityScore}/100
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#666] hidden sm:inline">
                              ({token.auditFirm})
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Action buttons */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                onSelectToken(token);
                              }}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#1E1E24] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white border border-[#1F1F23] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title="View Token Specification"
                            >
                              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => handleDeleteToken(token.id, e)}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-red-500/20 text-[#8E9299] hover:text-red-400 border border-[#1F1F23] hover:border-red-500/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title="Delete from Firestore"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Memory Snapshots */}
      {activeSubTab === "snapshots" && (
        <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-xl space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">

          {snapshots.length === 0 ? (

                      <span>Saved: {new Date(snap.savedAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
                      <span>Checksum: {snap.checksum}</span>
                    </div>
                    {snap.sampleTokens && snap.sampleTokens.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-[#666] pt-1">

                <div className="text-[10px] text-[#666]">Safe Firestore 500-op limit</div>

                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"

                  {isBatchGenerating ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      <span>Chunking...</span>

                  ) : (

                      <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Execute Batch ({batchCountInput})</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Error or Success feedback from Batch Execution */}
            {batchError && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-400 text-xs font-mono flex items-start gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold uppercase">Execution Blocked / Error:</div>

              </div>

            {batchResult && (

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-green-400 font-bold">

                  <div>Chunks: <span className="font-bold text-purple-400">{batchResult.chunksProcessed} sub-batches</span></div>
                  <div>Chunk Size: <span className="font-bold text-white">{batchResult.chunkSize} docs</span></div>
                  <div>Status: <span className="font-bold text-green-400">Unused (Secured)</span></div>

              </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-[#0E0E10] border-b border-[#1F1F23] flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase font-mono flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
                  <span>Dynamic Cursor Pagination: /tokenVault ({lockedVaultTotal} records)</span>
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                  Proxied securely via backend cursor (<code className="text-[#00F0FF]">GET /api/vault/tokens</code>) since direct client access is locked down.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePrevPage}
                  disabled={cursorIndex === 0 || isFetchingLockedVault}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white hover:bg-[#1E1E24] disabled:opacity-30 cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Prev Page</span>
                </button>
                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] px-2">
                  Page {cursorIndex + 1}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleNextPage}
                  disabled={!nextCursor || isFetchingLockedVault}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-white hover:bg-[#1E1E24] disabled:opacity-30 cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                  <span>Next Page</span>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {isFetchingLockedVault ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-purple-400" />
                <span>Reading locked vault via cursor...</span>
              </div>
            ) : lockedVaultTokens.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                No records found in server Token Vault. Click "Execute Batch" above to populate chunked tokens.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs font-mono">
                  <thead className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border-b border-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299] text-[10px] uppercase">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Token ID (UUID)</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Contract Address</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Standard</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Batch ID</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Status</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right">Created</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1F1F23]/60">
                    {lockedVaultTokens.map((item) => (
                      <tr key={item.tokenId} className="hover:bg-[#1E1E24]/50 transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 font-mono text-purple-300 font-bold">
                          {item.tokenId.slice(0, 18)}...
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-[#00F0FF]">
                          {item.contractAddress.slice(0, 10)}...{item.contractAddress.slice(-6)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-white">
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F23] text-[10px]">
                            {item.tokenStandard}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-[#8E9299] text-[11px]">
                          {item.batchId.slice(0, 10)}...
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 uppercase">
                            {item.status}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[#8E9299] text-[10px]">
                          {new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString()}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Universal Contract Validation Matrix Modal */}
      <UniversalContractValidationModal
        isOpen={showValidationModal}
        onClose={() => setShowValidationModal(false)}
        tokens={workingTokens && workingTokens.length > 0 ? workingTokens : vaultTokens}
      />

      {/* Memory Health Check & Diagnostic Tool Modal */}
      <MemoryHealthCheckModal
        isOpen={showHealthModal}
        onClose={() => setShowHealthModal(false)}
        tokens={workingTokens && workingTokens.length > 0 ? workingTokens : vaultTokens}
        onHealed={() => {
          runCompleteMemoryHealthCheck().then((rep) => setHealthReport(rep));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

interface ExecutionRecord {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  symbol: string;
  side: "BUY" | "SELL";
  orderType: "LIMIT" | "MARKET";
  price: number;
  qty: number;
  weiQty: string;
  totalUsd: number;
  clientId: string;
  rule15c35Status: "VERIFIED" | "COLLAR_PASS";
}

// Convert decimal number to 18-decimal uint256 string
function toUint256WeiString(val: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(val) || val <= 0) return "0";
  try {
    const fixed = val.toFixed(6);
    const [whole, frac = ""] = fixed.split(".");
    const paddedFrac = (frac + "000000000000000000").slice(0, 18);
    const combined = (whole === "0" ? "" : whole) + paddedFrac;
    return combined.replace(/^0+/, "") || "0";
  } catch {
    return "1000000000000000000";
  }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Burnable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol";

/**
 * @title Token World Exchange ATS® (Ticker: TWE)
 * @notice Sole Owner & Creator: Mauro Lomibao Dar III (maurodar08@gmail.com)
 * @dev 18-Decimal uint256 Institutional ATS Settlement & SEC Rule 15c3-5 Collar Engine

contract TokenWorldExchangeATS is ERC20, ERC20Burnable, Pausable, AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {
    bytes32 public constant ATS_OPERATOR_ROLE = keccak256("ATS_OPERATOR_ROLE");
    bytes32 public constant COMPLIANCE_OFFICER_ROLE = keccak256("COMPLIANCE_OFFICER_ROLE");

    event AtomicDvPExecuted(
        string indexed clientId,
        string symbol,
        uint256 priceUsdScaled,
        uint256 quantityWei,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    constructor(address initialOwner) ERC20("Token World Exchange ATS", "TWE") {
        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, initialOwner);
        _grantRole(ATS_OPERATOR_ROLE, initialOwner);
        _grantRole(COMPLIANCE_OFFICER_ROLE, initialOwner);
        _mint(initialOwner, 100_000_000 * 10 ** decimals()); // 10^18 Wei Precision
    }

    function settleAtomicTrade(
        string calldata clientId,
        string calldata symbol,
        uint256 priceUsdScaled,
        uint256 quantityWei
    ) external onlyRole(ATS_OPERATOR_ROLE) whenNotPaused nonReentrant {
        require(quantityWei > 0, "Rule 15c3-5: Zero uint256 quantity rejected");
        emit AtomicDvPExecuted(clientId, symbol, priceUsdScaled, quantityWei, block.timestamp);
    }
}`}

function playRiskEngineAlertChime(isCritical: boolean = false) {
  try {
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return;
    const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();

    osc1.type = isCritical ? "sawtooth" : "sine";
    osc2.type = "triangle";

    if (isCritical) {
      // Rapid dual-tone alarm for automated circuit breaker trading halt
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, now);
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now + 0.15);
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(1320, now);
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(660, now + 0.15);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.65);
    } else {
      // Crisp rejection alert tone
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(587.33, now);
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now + 0.12);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.4);
    }

    osc1.connect(gain);
    osc2.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);

    osc1.start(now);
    osc2.start(now);
    osc1.stop(now + (isCritical ? 0.65 : 0.4));
    osc2.stop(now + (isCritical ? 0.65 : 0.4));
  } catch {
    // Ignore audio restrictions
  }
}

    const aMax = asks.length ? Math.max(...asks.map((a) => a.quantity)) : 1000;
    return Math.max(1, bMax, aMax);
  }, [bids, asks]);

  // Handlers for Order Submission
  const handlePlaceOrder = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const priceNum = parseFloat(orderPrice);
    const qtyNum = parseInt(orderQuantity, 10);
    if (!priceNum || priceNum <= 0 || !qtyNum || qtyNum <= 0) return;

    // 1. Check if trading venue is currently halted under SEC Rule 15c3-5
    if (riskHaltState.isHalted) {
      playRiskEngineAlertChime(true);
      setLastMatchNotice(`🚫 TRADING VENUE HALTED: SEC Rule 15c3-5 Pre-Trade Risk Halt Active (${riskHaltState.haltCode}). Clearance required to resume.`);
      setIsRiskHaltModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Validate order compliance against centralized SEC Rule 15c3-5 Moving Average price collars
    const ref = movingAverageCollar.movingAveragePrice;
    const traderAddr = metaMaskAccount || "0x3A9F1B229D48C1C82902bC017845fD24E67Ac08E";
    const evaluation = secRule15c35RiskEngine.evaluateOrder({
      symbol: selectedSymbol,
      side: orderSide,
      price: priceNum,
      quantity: qtyNum,
      referencePrice: ref,
      traderAddress: traderAddr,
    });

    if (!evaluation.compliant && evaluation.breach) {
      secRule15c35RiskEngine.recordBreach(evaluation.breach, evaluation.willTriggerHalt);
      playRiskEngineAlertChime(evaluation.willTriggerHalt);
      if (evaluation.willTriggerHalt) {
        setLastMatchNotice(`🚨 AUTOMATED CIRCUIT BREAKER HALT (±5% Collar Exceeded): ${evaluation.explanation}`);
        setIsRiskHaltModalOpen(true);
      } else {
        setLastMatchNotice(`❌ SEC RULE 15c3-5 PRE-TRADE REJECTED: ${evaluation.explanation}`);
      }
      setTimeout(() => setLastMatchNotice(null), 8000);
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmittingOrder(true);

    // Attempt backend server POST first, with resilient fallback to local engine
    try {
      const resp = await fetch("/api/ats/order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          traderAddress: traderAddr,
          side: orderSide,
          price: priceNum,
          quantity: qtyNum,
          symbol: selectedSymbol,
          orderType: "LIMIT",
          investorTier: orderTier,
        }),
      });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (data.success) {
        // Refresh local engine state
        const res = globalAtsEngine.addOrder({
          traderAddress: traderAddr,
          side: orderSide,
          price: priceNum,
          quantity: qtyNum,
          symbol: selectedSymbol,
          orderType: "LIMIT",
          investorTier: orderTier,
        });
        refreshActiveBook(selectedSymbol);
        setVenueStats(globalAtsEngine.getGlobalVenueStats());

        if (res.matchedTrades.length > 0) {
          res.matchedTrades.forEach((mt) => triggerSettlementTransition(mt.id));
          setLastMatchNotice(
            `Matched ${res.matchedTrades[0].quantity.toLocaleString()} ${selectedSymbol} units @ $${res.matchedTrades[0].price.toFixed(
              2
            )}! Transitioning settlement to Atomic Clearing Verified...`
          );
        } else {
          setLastMatchNotice(`Order posted to ${selectedSymbol} ${orderSide} book at $${priceNum.toFixed(2)} (${qtyNum.toLocaleString()} units).`);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Local fallback
      const res = globalAtsEngine.addOrder({
        traderAddress: traderAddr,
        side: orderSide,
        price: priceNum,
        quantity: qtyNum,
        symbol: selectedSymbol,
        orderType: "LIMIT",
        investorTier: orderTier,
      });
      refreshActiveBook(selectedSymbol);
      setVenueStats(globalAtsEngine.getGlobalVenueStats());

      if (res.matchedTrades.length > 0) {
        res.matchedTrades.forEach((mt) => triggerSettlementTransition(mt.id));
        setLastMatchNotice(
          `Executed: ${res.matchedTrades[0].quantity.toLocaleString()} ${selectedSymbol} @ $${res.matchedTrades[0].price.toFixed(2)} (Transitioning to Atomic Clearing Verified)`
        );
      } else {
        setLastMatchNotice(`Order registered in ${selectedSymbol} ${orderSide} book at $${priceNum.toFixed(2)} (${qtyNum.toLocaleString()} units).`);
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingOrder(false);
      setTimeout(() => setLastMatchNotice(null), 6000);
    }
  };

  // DTCC FAST Bridge Wrap/Unwrap Handlers
  const handleExecuteBridgeAction = async (type: "WRAP" | "UNWRAP") => {
    const wrapAmt = type === "WRAP" ? parseInt(wrapAmountInput, 10) || 0 : 0;
    const unwrapAmt = type === "UNWRAP" ? parseInt(unwrapAmountInput, 10) || 0 : 0;

    try {
      const resp = await fetch("/api/ats/dtcc-reconciliation", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          wrapDelta: wrapAmt,
          unwrapDelta: unwrapAmt,
        }),
      });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (data.success && data.record) {
        setDtccState(data.record);
        setBridgeNotice(
          type === "WRAP"
            ? `Successfully wrapped ${wrapAmt.toLocaleString()} NYSE shares into Token World ERC-3643 tokens!`
            : `Successfully unwrapped ${unwrapAmt.toLocaleString()} ERC-3643 tokens back to NYSE DTC depository!`
        );
      }
    } catch {
      // Local calculation
      setDtccState((prev) => {
        let nyse = prev.nysePublicFloatDtcShares;
        let token = prev.tokenWorldWrappedShares;
        if (type === "WRAP" && wrapAmt <= nyse) {
          nyse -= wrapAmt;
          token += wrapAmt;
        } else if (type === "UNWRAP" && unwrapAmt <= token) {
          token -= unwrapAmt;
          nyse += unwrapAmt;
        }
        return {
          ...prev,
          nysePublicFloatDtcShares: nyse,
          tokenWorldWrappedShares: token,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        };
      });
      setBridgeNotice(`Reconciliation balanced with 0 variance.`);
    }
    setTimeout(() => setBridgeNotice(null), 5000);

  const handleSubscribeRound = (roundId: string) => {

    setIssuances((prev) =>

        if (r.id !== roundId) return r;
        const addShares = Math.floor(amt / r.sharePriceUsd);
        return {
          ...r,
          raisedCapitalUsd: Math.min(r.targetCapitalUsd, r.raisedCapitalUsd + amt),
          sharesAllocated: Math.min(r.totalSharesOffered, r.sharesAllocated + addShares),
          investorCount: r.investorCount + 1,
        };
      })
    );
    setSubscribedRoundId(roundId);

    const records: { address: string; amount: string }[] = [];
    const startIdx = lines.length > 0 && lines[0].toLowerCase().includes("address") ? 1 : 0;
    for (let i = startIdx; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const parts = lines[i].split(",").map((p) => p.trim());
      records.push({ address: parts[0] || "", amount: parts[1] || "" });
    }
    const { valid, rejected } = sanitizeCsvRecords(records);
    setCsvSanitizedStats({
      validCount: valid.length,
      rejectedCount: rejected.length,
      validRows: valid,
      rejectedRows: rejected,
    });
  };

    const csvContent = ["address,amount", ...csvSanitizedStats.validRows.map((r) => `${r.address},${r.amount}`)].join("\n");
    downloadDocumentFile("token_sanitized.csv", csvContent, "text/csv");

    if (countdown !== null) return;
    setCountdown(10);

      setCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev === null || prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(countdownIntervalRef.current);

          setMarketOpenCelebrated(true);

          setTimeout(() => playNyseBrassBellSound(), 2400);
          setTimeout(() => playNyseBrassBellSound(), 3600);
          setTimeout(() => setIsBellRinging(false), 5000);

          // Ping server endpoint
          fetch("/api/ats/bell-ceremony", {
            method: "POST",

            body: JSON.stringify({ action: "RING_BELL", celebrant: OWNER_PROFILE.name }),
          }).catch(() => {});

          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

DOCUMENT: ${d.title} (${d.secFormCode})
CATEGORY: ${d.category}
FILING ENTITY: Token World ATS / Mauro Lomibao Dar III
HEADQUARTERS: 945 Westholme Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90024 | (310) 904-5646
================================================================================\n\n${d.content}\n\n`;

    downloadDocumentFile(

  // Text-to-speech teleprompter for Mauro Lomibao Dar III remarks

        setTeleprompterPlaying(false);
      } else {
        const text = `Today, we bridge the timeless bedrock of the New York Stock Exchange with the borderless efficiency of Token World. From 945 Westholme Avenue in Los Angeles to 11 Wall Street in New York, we have built an Alternative Trading System that captures primary capital, empowers innovators, and unites global liquidity under strict regulatory trust. Let the bell ring for every entrepreneur, investor, and builder around the world! Acknowledged by Mauro Lomibao Dar the Third, Sovereign Owner.`;
        const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
        utterance.rate = 0.95;
        utterance.pitch = 1.0;
        utterance.onend = () => setTeleprompterPlaying(false);
        utterance.onerror = () => setTeleprompterPlaying(false);
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
        setTeleprompterPlaying(true);
      }
    }

  // Handle KYC Eligibility Simulation

      const isAccredited = netWorthNum >= 1000000 || annualIncomeNum >= 200000 || kycIsQib;
      const assignedTier = kycIsQib
        ? "QIB_RULE_144A"
        : isAccredited
        ? "ACCREDITED_REG_D"
        : "RETAIL_UNQUALIFIED";

      const certHash = (
        kycWalletAddress.slice(2, 8) + Date.now().toString(16).slice(-6)
      ).toUpperCase();

      // Attempt to register in Treasury whitelist if eligible
      let whitelisted = false;
      if (isAccredited && isValidEvmAddress(kycWalletAddress)) {
        try {

      setKycResult({

        whitelistedOnChain: whitelisted,

    } finally {
      setKycLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle FastAPI Matching Simulation
  const handleFastApiOrderSimulation = async () => {
    setFastApiSimulating(true);
    const p = parseFloat(fastApiPrice);
    const q = parseInt(fastApiQuantity, 10);
    const nowStr = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();

    const ref = selectedTokenObj.priceUsd > 0 ? selectedTokenObj.priceUsd : 52.50;
    const newLog = `[${nowStr}] INGEST: ${fastApiOrderSide} ${q} ${selectedSymbol} @ $${p.toFixed(2)} from ${fastApiWallet.slice(0, 8)}...`;
    setFastApiLogs((prev) => [newLog, ...prev.slice(0, 20)]);

    try {
      // Pre-trade checks
      if (p < ref * 0.70 || p > ref * 1.30) {
        throw new Error(`SEC Rule 15c3-5 REJECTED: Price collar exceeded (±30% from $${ref.toFixed(2)} benchmark)`);
      }
      if (p * q > 10000000) {
        throw new Error("SEC Rule 15c3-5 REJECTED: Order exceeds maximum single capital limit ($10,000,000)");
      }

      const res = await fetch("/api/ats/order", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          traderAddress: fastApiWallet,
          side: fastApiOrderSide,
          price: p,
          quantity: q,
          symbol: selectedSymbol,
          investorTier: "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
        }),
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setFastApiLogs((prev) => [
          `[${nowStr}] SUCCESS: Order ${data.order?.id || "ORD-OK"} queued to memory heap`,
          ...(data.executedTrades?.length
            ? [`[${nowStr}] MATCHED: ${data.executedTrades.length} trade(s) executed via Price-Time Priority! DvP hash generated.`]
            : [`[${nowStr}] RESTING: Order resting on order book depth`]),
          ...prev.slice(0, 20),
        ]);
        if (data.executedTrades?.length) {
          setFastApiLastTrade(data.executedTrades[0]);
        }
      } else {
        const err = await res.json();
        setFastApiLogs((prev) => [`[${nowStr}] ERROR: ${err.error || "Order rejected"}`, ...prev]);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setFastApiLogs((prev) => [`[${nowStr}] ERROR: ${e.message}`, ...prev]);
    } finally {
      setFastApiSimulating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
      {/* 🚨 Global Trade Velocity 3-Sigma Anomaly Alert Banner */}
      {globalVelocitySpikeToast && (
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-950 via-red-900/90 to-black border-2 border-rose-500 p-4 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(244,63,94,0.45)] flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-black bg-rose-500 text-black uppercase tracking-wider">
                  3σ Trade Velocity Alert
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-rose-200 font-mono font-bold">

                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-200 mt-1 font-mono">
                Order book volume spiked to <strong className="text-white font-bold">{globalVelocitySpikeToast.currentVelocity.toLocaleString()} shares/s</strong> (+{globalVelocitySpikeToast.zScore}σ deviation, +{globalVelocitySpikeToast.excessFactor}% above 3-sigma ceiling of {globalVelocitySpikeToast.threshold3Sigma.toLocaleString()} shares/s).
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end md:self-center shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveMode("trade_velocity_alert");

                  const lowerPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((lowerPrice - minRange) / totalSpan) * 100));

                    <option value="QIB_RULE_144A">Rule 144A Qualified Institutional Buyer (QIB)</option>

                    {lastMatchNotice}

                    riskHaltState.isHalted
                      ? "bg-rose-950/80 border-2 border-rose-600 text-rose-300 cursor-not-allowed animate-pulse shadow-lg shadow-rose-950/60"
                      : !liveOrderEvaluation.compliant
                      ? "bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white shadow-md shadow-rose-900/40"
                      : orderSide === "BUY"
                      ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white"
                      : "bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white"
                  }`}
                >

                    ? "⛔ TRADING HALTED (SEC 15c3-5 CIRCUIT ACTIVE)"

                      CCO Clearance Key &rarr;

                )}

            {/* CLOB Order Book Ladder */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-8 bg-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1F1F23] pb-3 gap-2">

                  </span>

                  <span className="text-[#8E9299]">
                    Best Ask: <strong className="text-rose-400 font-mono">${asks[0]?.price.toFixed(selectedTokenObj.priceUsd < 1 ? 4 : 2) || "—"}</strong>
                  </span>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>

                </div>

                            <span className="text-slate-300 text-[11px] truncate max-w-[85px]">{b.traderAddress.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                            <span className="text-[9px] px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-black/50 text-[#8E9299] border border-[#2B2B36]">
                              {mmLabel}
                            </span>

                          <span className="relative z-10 text-emerald-400 font-semibold tabular-nums">
                            ${b.price.toFixed(selectedTokenObj.priceUsd < 1 ? 4 : 2)}
                          </span>

                            {b.quantity.toLocaleString()}

                    <span className="hidden sm:inline text-[#3F4248]">|</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />

                    </span>
                  </div>

                      title="Simulate transition from 'Matched' to 'Atomic Clearing Verified' with subtle pulses"

                        <th className="py-2 px-3">Total Value</th>
                        <th className="py-2 px-3">Cryptographic Tx Hash</th>
                        <th className="py-2 pl-3">Settlement Status</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1F1F23]">

                        const isPulsing = pulsingTradeIds.has(t.id);
                        const isMatched = status === "Matched";

                        return (
                          <tr
                            key={t.id}
                            className="hover:bg-[#18181D] transition-colors group cursor-pointer"
                            onClick={() => setSelectedReceiptTrade(t)}
                          >
                            <td className="py-2.5 pr-3 text-white font-medium">
                              <span className="text-[#8E9299] group-hover:text-cyan-400 mr-1 transition-colors">#</span>
                              {t.id}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-white tabular-nums">{t.quantity.toLocaleString()}</td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">
                              ${t.price.toFixed(selectedTokenObj.priceUsd < 1 ? 4 : 2)}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-white tabular-nums">${t.totalUsd.toLocaleString()}</td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-cyan-400 truncate max-w-[200px]" title={isVIP ? t.txHash : "Obfuscated via Zero-Knowledge (ZK) State Proof"}>
                              {maskTxHash(t.txHash, isVIP)}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2.5 pl-3">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  triggerSettlementTransition(t.id);
                                }}
                                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold font-mono transition-all duration-500 cursor-pointer select-none text-left ${
                                  isMatched
                                    ? "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.25)]"
                                    : isPulsing
                                    ? "bg-emerald-500/25 text-emerald-200 border border-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)] scale-105"
                                    : "bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 hover:border-emerald-500/60"
                                }`}
                                title="Click to test subtle pulse animation moving from 'Matched' to 'Atomic Clearing Verified'"
                              >
                                {isMatched ? (
                                  <>
                                    <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2 shrink-0">
                                      <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-amber-400 opacity-75" />
                                      <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-amber-500" />
                                    </span>
                                    <Clock
                                      className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400 animate-spin shrink-0 text-opacity-90"
                                      style={{ animationDuration: "3s" }}
                                    />
                                    <span className="tracking-wide">Matched</span>
                                  </>
                                ) : (
                                  <>
                                    <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                                      {/* Subtle pulse ring on transition */}
                                      {isPulsing && (
                                        <>
                                          <span className="absolute -inset-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-400/40 animate-ping opacity-75 pointer-events-none" />
                                          <span className="absolute -inset-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 animate-pulse pointer-events-none" />
                                        </>
                                      )}
                                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse mr-0.5" />
                                      <ShieldCheck
                                        className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 transition-transform duration-300 ${
                                          isPulsing ? "scale-110" : ""
                                        }`}
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                    <span className="tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap">
                                      Atomic Clearing Verified
                                    </span>
                                  </>
                                )}
                              </button>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

      {/* MODE: ATS MEMBERSHIP FEE SCHEDULE & $93M REVENUE BLUEPRINT */}
      {activeMode === "ats_membership_plan" && (
        <AtsMembershipMonetizationPlan
          onNavigateToVenue={() => setActiveMode("trading_portal")}
        />
      )}

      {/* MODE: TRADE VELOCITY 3-SIGMA ALERT RADAR */}
      {activeMode === "trade_velocity_alert" && (
        <TradeVelocityAlertMonitor
          selectedSymbol={selectedSymbol}
          referencePrice={selectedTokenObj.priceUsd}
          bids={bids}
          asks={asks}
          trades={trades}
          compact={false}
          onTriggerGlobalToast={handleTriggerGlobalVelocityToast}
        />
      )}

      {/* MODE: VENUE LIQUIDITY MATRIX & ALL TOKENS ALLOCATION */}
      {activeMode === "liquidity_matrix" && (
        <AtsLiquidityMatrix
          tokens={allVenueTokens}

            handleSelectSymbol(sym);
            setActiveMode("trading_portal");
          }}
          onBoostTokenLiquidity={handleBoostTokenLiquidity}
          onAllocateAllLiquidity={handleAllocateMaxLiquidityAll}

          onNavigatePrimary={(sym) => {
            handleSelectSymbol(sym);
            setActiveMode("primary_issuances");
          }}
          onNavigateDtcc={(sym) => {
            handleSelectSymbol(sym);
            setActiveMode("nyse_dtcc_bridge");
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* MODE 2: PRIMARY ISSUANCES ENGINE */}
      {activeMode === "primary_issuances" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-[#121216] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-xl p-5">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#1F1F23] pb-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Coins className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />

                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                  Direct exempt capital raises under SEC Regulation D 506(c), Rule 144A, and Regulation S
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <div className="relative">
                  <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#8E9299] absolute left-2.5 top-2" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={primaryIssuanceSearch}
                    onChange={(e) => setPrimaryIssuanceSearch(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search offerings by token..."
                    className="pl-8 pr-3 py-1 bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B] rounded-lg text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-[#8E9299] focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                  Issuer: <strong className="text-white">Token World LLC (Mauro Lomibao Dar III)</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mt-6">
              {issuances.filter((r) => {
                const q = primaryIssuanceSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
                return !q || r.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.assetName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
              }).map((round) => {
                const percentRaised = Math.round((round.raisedCapitalUsd / round.targetCapitalUsd) * 100);
                return (
                  <div
                    key={round.id}
                    className="bg-[#18181D] border border-[#26262B] rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4"
                  >
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-white">{round.symbol}</span>
                        <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono">{round.exemption}</span>
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">{round.assetName}</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                        Target Capital: ${(round.targetCapitalUsd / 1000000).toFixed(1)}M USD @ ${round.sharePriceUsd.toFixed(2)}/share
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Progress Bar */}
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-mono">
                        <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Raised: ${(round.raisedCapitalUsd / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M</span>
                        <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">{percentRaised}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full bg-[#26262B] rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="bg-emerald-500 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                          style={{ width: `${percentRaised}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[#26262B] space-y-2 text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Min Investment:</span>
                        <span className="text-white font-mono">${round.minimumInvestmentUsd.toLocaleString()}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Subscribers:</span>
                        <span className="text-white font-mono">{round.investorCount} Qualified</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Escrow Trustee:</span>
                        <span className="text-white truncate max-w-[150px]">{round.escrowAgent}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {subscribedRoundId === round.id ? (
                      <div className="bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs text-emerald-300 text-center font-medium">
                        Subscription Allocation Confirmed!
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleSubscribeRound(round.id)}
                        disabled={round.status === "SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED"}
                        className={`w-full py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                          round.status === "SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED"
                            ? "bg-[#26262B] text-[#8E9299] cursor-not-allowed"
                            : "bg-white text-black hover:bg-slate-200"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {round.status === "SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED"
                          ? "Offering Fully Subscribed"
                          : `Subscribe $${subscriptionAmount} Allocation`}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

// RFC 7636 PKCE Helpers
function generateRandomString(length = 48) {
  const array = new Uint8Array(length);
  window.crypto.getRandomValues(array);
  return Array.from(array, (dec) => ("0" + dec.toString(16)).substr(-2)).join("");
}

async function generateCodeChallenge(codeVerifier: string) {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const data = encoder.encode(codeVerifier);
  const digest = await window.crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
  return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(digest)))
    .replace(/\+/g, "-")
    .replace(/\//g, "_")
    .replace(/=+$/, "");
}

  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<UnifiedAuthUser | null>(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem("twe_unified_auth_session");
      return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  });

  const [copiedToken, setCopiedToken] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // 30s Countdown timer for TOTP RFC 6238
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: any = null;
    if (adminStep === "2fa" && !currentUser) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setTimerSeconds((prev) => {
          if (prev <= 1) {
            return 30; // Auto-regenerate next TOTP time-window window
          }
          return prev - 1;
        });
      }, 1000);
    }
    return () => {
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [adminStep, currentUser]);

  const showAlert = (message: string, type: "success" | "error" | "info" = "info") => {
    setAlert({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => {
      setAlert((current) => (current?.message === message ? null : current));
    }, 5000);
  };

  // 1. TWE ATS SSO Direct Connect
  const handleTweSsoLogin = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    const verifier = generateRandomString(48);
    const challenge = await generateCodeChallenge(verifier);

    showAlert(`Initiating RFC 7636 PKCE Handshake with Token World Exchange ATS® SSO...`, "info");

    setTimeout(() => {
      const sessionUser: UnifiedAuthUser = {
        name: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III (Institutional VIP)",
        email: "maurodar08@gmail.com",
        role: "MEMBER",
        provider: "TWE ATS SSO",
        scopes: ["twe:ats:trade", "twe:ats:read", "twe:ats:settle", "openid", "profile"],
        sessionToken: `twe_sso_${generateRandomString(24)}`,
        clearance: "Direct Market Access (DMA Tier 4 - 140µs)",
        authenticatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      setCurrentUser(sessionUser);
      localStorage.setItem("twe_unified_auth_session", JSON.stringify(sessionUser));
      setIsProcessing(false);
      showAlert(`Authenticated successfully via Token World Exchange ATS® SSO!`, "success");
    }, 1000);
  };

  // 2. Social OAuth Handler
  const handleSocialAuth = (providerName: string) => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    showAlert(`Opening ${providerName} OAuth 2.0 authorization dialog...`, "info");

    setTimeout(() => {
      const sessionUser: UnifiedAuthUser = {
        name: `${providerName} Institutional Subscriber`,
        email: `subscriber@${providerName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "")}.institutional.com`,
        role: "MEMBER",
        provider: `${providerName} OAuth 2.0` as any,
        scopes: ["twe:ats:read", "twe:ats:trade", "openid"],
        sessionToken: `soc_${providerName.toLowerCase().slice(0, 3)}_${generateRandomString(20)}`,
        clearance: "Standard Trading Venue (ATS)",
        authenticatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      setCurrentUser(sessionUser);
      localStorage.setItem("twe_unified_auth_session", JSON.stringify(sessionUser));
      setIsProcessing(false);
      showAlert(`Connected securely via ${providerName} OAuth 2.0!`, "success");
    }, 800);
  };

  // 3. Member Email/Password Form
  const handleMemberSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!memberEmail || !memberPassword) {
      showAlert("Please enter your Subscriber Email and Password.", "error");
      return;
    }
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const sessionUser: UnifiedAuthUser = {
        name: memberEmail.split("@")[0].toUpperCase() + " (ATS Member)",
        email: memberEmail,
        role: "MEMBER",
        provider: "ATS Subscriber Credential",
        scopes: ["twe:ats:trade", "twe:ats:read", "openid"],
        sessionToken: `twe_sub_${generateRandomString(24)}`,
        clearance: "Standard Trading Venue (ATS)",
        authenticatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      setCurrentUser(sessionUser);
      localStorage.setItem("twe_unified_auth_session", JSON.stringify(sessionUser));
      setIsProcessing(false);
      showAlert(`Signed in successfully to Member Portal.`, "success");
    }, 600);
  };

  // 4. Admin Step 1: Credentials
  const handleAdminCredsSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!adminUser || !adminPassword) {
      showAlert("Please enter your ATS Operator ID and Master Password.", "error");
      return;
    }
    showAlert("Step 1 Credentials verified. Please enter 6-digit TOTP code.", "info");
    setAdminStep("2fa");
    // Pre-fill demo OTP or focus first input
    setTimeout(() => {
      otpInputRefs.current[0]?.focus();
    }, 100);
  };

  // 5. Admin Step 2: OTP Handling
  const handleOtpChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    if (!/^\d*$/.test(value)) return;
    const nextDigits = [...otpDigits];
    nextDigits[index] = value.slice(-1);
    setOtpDigits(nextDigits);

    if (value && index < 5) {
      otpInputRefs.current[index + 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleOtpKeyDown = (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Backspace" && !otpDigits[index] && index > 0) {
      otpInputRefs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleOtpPaste = (e: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pasted = e.clipboardData.getData("text").replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6);
    if (pasted.length > 0) {
      const nextDigits = [...otpDigits];
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        nextDigits[i] = pasted[i] || "";
      }
      setOtpDigits(nextDigits);
      const focusIndex = Math.min(pasted.length, 5);
      otpInputRefs.current[focusIndex]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyOtp = () => {
    const code = otpDigits.join("");
    if (code.length < 6) {
      // Auto-populate sample code if user clicks without entering for ease of use
      const demoCode = ["7", "2", "8", "9", "4", "1"];
      setOtpDigits(demoCode);
      showAlert("Pre-populating verified RFC 6238 TOTP Authenticator code (728941)...", "info");
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const sessionUser: UnifiedAuthUser = {
        name: "Master ATS Operator (Mauro Lomibao Dar III)",
        email: adminUser,
        role: "ADMIN_OPERATOR",
        provider: "Master Operator ID",
        scopes: [
          "twe:ats:admin",
          "twe:ats:trade",
          "twe:ats:settle",
          "twe:ats:compliance",
          "twe:finra:15c3-5",
          "openid",

        sessionToken: `twe_admin_totp_${generateRandomString(28)}`,
        clearance: "Level 4 Sovereign Administrator & FINRA Designated Principal",
        authenticatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      setCurrentUser(sessionUser);
      localStorage.setItem("twe_unified_auth_session", JSON.stringify(sessionUser));
      setIsProcessing(false);
      showAlert("Administrator 2FA Handshake Complete! Full exchange privileges unlocked.", "success");
    }, 700);
  };

  // 6. Logout
  const handleLogout = () => {
    showAlert("Revoking OAuth 2.0 Bearer token and ending session...", "info");
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentUser(null);
      localStorage.removeItem("twe_unified_auth_session");
      setAdminStep("creds");
      setOtpDigits(["", "", "", "", "", ""]);
      showAlert("Logged out securely. Handshake terminated.", "success");

  };

  const handleCopyToken = () => {
    if (currentUser?.sessionToken) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentUser.sessionToken);
      setCopiedToken(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedToken(false), 2000);

  const content = (

      <div className="absolute -top-32 -left-32 w-80 h-80 bg-emerald-600/20 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-emerald-600 via-teal-500 to-amber-500 shadow-xl shadow-emerald-950/80 mb-3 border border-emerald-400/30">

        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
          Token World Exchange{" "}
          <span className="text-xs bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono font-bold tracking-normal shadow-sm">
            ATS®
          </span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold font-mono">

      {/* Alert Box for Notifications */}
      {alert && (

          className={`mb-4 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-300 flex items-center gap-2.5 shadow-lg ${

              : alert.type === "error"
              ? "bg-rose-500/20 border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300"

          AUTHENTICATED ACTIVE DASHBOARD (IF LOGGED IN)

      {currentUser ? (

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div
                className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg text-white shadow-md ${
                  currentUser.role === "ADMIN_OPERATOR"
                    ? "bg-gradient-to-tr from-amber-600 to-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black shadow-amber-950/50"
                    : "bg-gradient-to-tr from-emerald-600 to-teal-500 shadow-emerald-950/50"
                }`}
              >
                {currentUser.name.charAt(0)}
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {currentUser.name}
                  {currentUser.role === "ADMIN_OPERATOR" && (
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                  )}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider mt-0.5">
                  {currentUser.role === "ADMIN_OPERATOR" ? "Master ATS Operator" : "Member Account"}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              Connected
            </span>

          {/* ATS Session Spec Details */}
          <div className="bg-slate-950/90 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 space-y-2.5 font-mono text-xs">

              <span className="text-slate-200 truncate max-w-[220px]">{currentUser.email}</span>

            <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-1 border-b border-slate-900">
              <span className="text-slate-500">OAuth Access Scopes:</span>
              <span className="text-slate-300 text-right">{currentUser.scopes.join(", ")}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-1 border-b border-slate-900">
              <span className="text-slate-500">Session ID (Bearer):</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[150px] sm:max-w-[180px]">
                  {currentUser.sessionToken}

                <button

            <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-1">
              <span className="text-slate-500">Security Clearance:</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold text-right">{currentUser.clearance}</span>

          {/* Quick Action Buttons */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <button

                if (onNavigateToTab) onNavigateToTab("ats_nyse_exchange");

      ) : (
        /* =========================================================================
            UNAUTHENTICATED GATEWAY: MEMBER VS ADMIN

        <div className="bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl space-y-6">

                activePortalTab === "member"
                  ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-950"

            >

            <button

                    <path
