    if (allPageSelected) {
      for (const id of pageIds) {
        selectedRecordsMapRef.current.delete(id);
      }
      setSelectedIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !pageIds.includes(id)));
    } else {
      for (const item of assets) {
        selectedRecordsMapRef.current.set(item.id, item);
      }
      setSelectedIds((prev) => Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...pageIds])));
    }
  };

  const isBatchRunning =
    batchProgress.visible && batchProgress.status === "running";

  const runBatchOperation = async (operation: BatchOperationKind) => {
    const selectedSet = new Set(selectedIds);
    const currentById = new Map(assets.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
    const targets = selectedIds
      .map((id) => currentById.get(id) ?? selectedRecordsMapRef.current.get(id))
      .filter((item): item is AssetReference => Boolean(item));

    if (targets.length === 0 || isBatchRunning) {
      return;
    }

    if (dismissTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(dismissTimerRef.current);
      dismissTimerRef.current = null;
    }

    setConfirmBatchDelete(false);
    setBatchProgress({
      visible: true,
      operation,
      processed: 0,
      total: targets.length,
      currentLabel: targets[0]?.name ?? "",
      status: "running",
    });

    let completedCount = 0;
    try {
      for (const item of targets) {
        setBatchProgress((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          currentLabel: item.name,
        }));

        if (operation === "duplicate") {
          await batchCreate.mutateAsync({
            kind: item.kind,
            name: `${item.name} (Copy)`,
            symbol: item.symbol ? `${item.symbol}-COPY` : null,
            description: item.description ?? "",
            chain: item.chain ?? null,
            standard: item.standard ?? null,
            contractAddress: item.contractAddress ?? null,
            metadata: {
              ...(item.metadata ?? {}),
              duplicatedFromId: item.id,
            },
          });
        } else {
          await batchRemove.mutateAsync({ id: item.id });
        }

        completedCount += 1;
        setBatchProgress({
          visible: true,
          operation,
          processed: completedCount,
          total: targets.length,
          currentLabel: item.name,
          status: "running",
        });

        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 160));
      }

      await refresh();

      for (const id of selectedSet) {
        selectedRecordsMapRef.current.delete(id);
      }
      setSelectedIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !selectedSet.has(id)));
      setBatchProgress({
        visible: true,
        operation,
        processed: completedCount,
        total: targets.length,
        currentLabel: `${completedCount} record${completedCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} finalized`,
        status: "completed",
      });

      dismissTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setBatchProgress((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }));
      }, 3200);
    } catch (err) {
      setBatchProgress({
        visible: true,
        operation,
        processed: completedCount,
        total: targets.length,
        currentLabel: "Operation halted",
        status: "error",
        errorMessage:
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Batch operation failed",
      });
    }
  };

  const icon = title.toLowerCase().includes("nft") ? (
    <Gem size={17} />
  ) : (
    <Coins size={17} />
  );

  return (
    <>
      <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
        <div className="twe-between" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <div className="twe-row">
            <span className="twe-module-icon" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
              {icon}
            </span>
            <div>
              <div className="twe-panel-title">{title}</div>
              <div style={{ color: "#7d848e", fontSize: 10, marginTop: 4 }}>
                {watchlistOnly
                  ? "Saved to your personal watchlist"
                  : "Records owned by your account"}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <span className="twe-tag gold">
                  {selectedIds.length} selected
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="twe-btn secondary"
                  style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                  disabled={!authenticated || isBatchRunning}
                  onClick={() => void runBatchOperation("duplicate")}
                  title="Duplicate selected records"
                >
                  <Copy size={12} /> Duplicate ({selectedIds.length})
                </button>
                {confirmBatchDelete ? (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="twe-btn danger"
                      style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                      disabled={!authenticated || isBatchRunning}
                      onClick={() => void runBatchOperation("delete")}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={12} /> Confirm Delete ({selectedIds.length})
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="twe-btn ghost"
                      style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 8px" }}
                      disabled={isBatchRunning}
                      onClick={() => setConfirmBatchDelete(false)}
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="twe-btn danger"
                    style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                    disabled={!authenticated || isBatchRunning}
                    onClick={() => setConfirmBatchDelete(true)}
                    title="Delete selected records"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={12} /> Delete ({selectedIds.length})
                  </button>
                )}
              </>
            )}
            <button
              className="twe-btn"
              disabled={!authenticated || isBatchRunning}
              onClick={() => {
                setEditingAsset(null);
                setModalOpen(true);
              }}
            >
              <Plus size={14} /> New record
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <BatchHeaderProgressBar
            progress={batchProgress}
            onDismiss={() =>
              setBatchProgress((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))
            }
          />
        </div>

        <div className="twe-toolbar">
          <label className="twe-search">
            <Search size={14} />
            <input
              className="twe-input"
              placeholder="Search your records…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setSearch(event.target.value);
                setPage(0);
              }}
            />
          </label>
          <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <span className="twe-tag">
              <Archive size={11} /> {total} records
            </span>
            <span className="twe-tag gold" title="Click Name, Kind, or Chain table headers to sort">
              {sortOrder === "asc" ? <ArrowUp size={11} /> : <ArrowDown size={11} />}
              Sorted by {sortBy === "name" ? "Name" : sortBy === "kind" ? "Kind" : "Chain"} (
              {sortOrder.toUpperCase()})
            </span>
            {!createKind && (
              <label className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                <span className="twe-panel-kicker">TYPE</span>
                <select
                  className="twe-select"
                  style={{ width: 180, minHeight: 34 }}
                  value={kindFilter}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setKindFilter(event.target.value as AssetKind | "all");
                    setPage(0);
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="all">All types</option>
                  {(kinds ?? KINDS).map((value) => (
                    <option key={value} value={value}>
                      {KIND_LABEL[value]}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <ChevronDown
                  size={12}
                  style={{
                    marginLeft: -28,
                    pointerEvents: "none",
                    color: "#9a9da2",
                  }}
                />
              </label>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {pendingDeleteAsset && (
          <div
            className="twe-status-banner"
            style={{
              marginTop: 12,
              marginBottom: 12,
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              alignItems: "center",
            }}
          >
            <div>
              <strong>
                Remove “{pendingDeleteAsset.name}” from your private records?
              </strong>
              <p>This cannot be undone.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="twe-row">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                onClick={() => setPendingDeleteAsset(null)}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn"
                disabled={remove.isPending}
                onClick={() => remove.mutate({ id: pendingDeleteAsset.id })}
              >
                Confirm remove
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {!authenticated ? (
          <div className="twe-empty">
            <div className="twe-empty-icon">
              <CircleAlert size={20} />
            </div>
            <strong>Sign in to access saved records</strong>
            <p>
              TWE does not create a temporary or sample account. Sign in with your
              real account to add or view your private workspace records.
            </p>
            <button
              className="twe-btn"
              style={{ marginTop: 14 }}
              onClick={() => startLogin()}
            >
              Sign in securely
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : query.isLoading ? (
          <div className="twe-empty">
            <span>Loading your records…</span>
          </div>
        ) : query.error ? (
          <div className="twe-empty">
            <div className="twe-alert">{query.error.message}</div>
          </div>
        ) : !assets.length ? (
          <div className="twe-empty">
            <div className="twe-empty-icon">{icon}</div>
            <strong>
              {watchlistOnly ? "Your watchlist is empty" : "No records yet"}
            </strong>
            <p>
              {watchlistOnly
                ? "Star a saved record to place it in your watchlist. No external account or balance is implied."
                : "Create a record or import an authorized source. Token references stay unverified until checked against an actual provider."}
            </p>
            {!watchlistOnly && authenticated && (
              <button
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                style={{ marginTop: 14 }}
                onClick={() => {
                  setEditingAsset(null);
                  setModalOpen(true);
                }}
              >
                <Plus size={13} /> Create first record
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="twe-table-wrap">
            <table className="twe-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={{ width: 38, textAlign: "center" }}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      className="twe-checkbox"
                      checked={allPageSelected}
                      disabled={assets.length === 0 || isBatchRunning}
                      onChange={toggleSelectPage}
                      aria-label="Select all records on current page"
                      title="Select all records on current page"
                    />
                  </th>
                  <th
                    aria-sort={
                      sortBy === "name"
                        ? sortOrder === "asc"
                          ? "ascending"
                          : "descending"
                        : "none"
                    }
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`twe-sort-btn ${sortBy === "name" ? "active" : ""}`}
                      onClick={() => handleSortColumn("name")}
                      title="Sort by Name"
                    >
                      <span>Name</span>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          display: "inline-flex",
                          flexDirection: "column",
                          lineHeight: 0,
                          marginLeft: 2,
                        }}
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        <ChevronUp
                          size={11}
                          style={{
                            marginBottom: -3,
                            color:
                              sortBy === "name" && sortOrder === "asc"
                                ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                                : "currentColor",
                            opacity:
                              sortBy === "name" && sortOrder === "asc" ? 1 : 0.38,
                          }}
                        />
                        <ChevronDown
                          size={11}
                          style={{
                            color:
                              sortBy === "name" && sortOrder === "desc"
                                ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                                : "currentColor",
                            opacity:
                              sortBy === "name" && sortOrder === "desc" ? 1 : 0.38,
                          }}
                        />
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </th>
                  <th
                    aria-sort={
                      sortBy === "kind"
                        ? sortOrder === "asc"
                          ? "ascending"
                          : "descending"
                        : "none"
                    }
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`twe-sort-btn ${sortBy === "kind" ? "active" : ""}`}
                      onClick={() => handleSortColumn("kind")}
                      title="Sort by Kind"
                    >
                      <span>Kind</span>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          display: "inline-flex",
                          flexDirection: "column",
                          lineHeight: 0,
                          marginLeft: 2,
                        }}
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        <ChevronUp
                          size={11}
                          style={{
                            marginBottom: -3,
                            color:
                              sortBy === "kind" && sortOrder === "asc"
                                ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                                : "currentColor",
                            opacity:
                              sortBy === "kind" && sortOrder === "asc" ? 1 : 0.38,
                          }}
                        />
                        <ChevronDown
                          size={11}
                          style={{
                            color:
                              sortBy === "kind" && sortOrder === "desc"
                                ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                                : "currentColor",
                            opacity:
                              sortBy === "kind" && sortOrder === "desc" ? 1 : 0.38,
                          }}
                        />
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </th>
                  <th
                    aria-sort={
                      sortBy === "chain"
                        ? sortOrder === "asc"
                          ? "ascending"
                          : "descending"
                        : "none"
                    }
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`twe-sort-btn ${sortBy === "chain" ? "active" : ""}`}
                      onClick={() => handleSortColumn("chain")}
                      title="Sort by Chain"
                    >
                      <span>Chain</span>
                      <span
                        style={{
                          display: "inline-flex",
                          flexDirection: "column",
                          lineHeight: 0,
                          marginLeft: 2,
                        }}
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        <ChevronUp
                          size={11}
                          style={{
                            marginBottom: -3,
                            color:
                              sortBy === "chain" && sortOrder === "asc"
                                ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                                : "currentColor",
                            opacity:
                              sortBy === "chain" && sortOrder === "asc" ? 1 : 0.38,
                          }}
                        />
                        <ChevronDown
                          size={11}
                          style={{
                            color:
                              sortBy === "chain" && sortOrder === "desc"
                                ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                                : "currentColor",
                            opacity:
                              sortBy === "chain" && sortOrder === "desc" ? 1 : 0.38,
                          }}
                        />
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </th>
                  <th>Status</th>
                  <th>Source</th>
                  <th>Saved</th>
                  <th aria-label="Actions" />
                </tr>
                <TableHeaderProgressRow progress={batchProgress} colSpan={8} />
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {assets.map((item) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(item.id);
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={item.id}
                      className={isSelected ? "selected" : undefined}
                    >
                      <td style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          className="twe-checkbox"
                          checked={isSelected}
                          disabled={isBatchRunning}
                          onChange={() => toggleSelectRow(item.id)}
                          aria-label={`Select ${item.name}`}
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td>
                      <div className="twe-asset-name">{item.name}</div>
                      <div className="twe-asset-symbol">
                        {item.symbol ||
                          (item.contractAddress
                            ? item.contractAddress
                            : `TWE-${String(item.id).padStart(6, "0")}`)}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className="twe-tag">
                        {KIND_LABEL[item.kind as AssetKind] ?? "Asset"}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      {[item.chain, item.standard].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || (
                        <span style={{ color: "#666d77" }}>Not specified</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span
                        className={`twe-tag ${
                          item.status === "user_entered_unverified" ? "gold" : ""
                        }`}
                      >
                        {String(item.status ?? "user_entered_unverified").replaceAll(
                          "_",
                          " "
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      {item.sourceName ||
                        (item.status === "user_entered_unverified"
                          ? "User-entered"
                          : "User-authored")}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      {item.createdAt
                        ? new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()
                        : "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <div className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
                        <button
                          className="twe-btn ghost"
                          aria-label={
                            item.isWatchlisted
                              ? "Remove from watchlist"
                              : "Add to watchlist"
                          }
                          title={
                            item.isWatchlisted
                              ? "Remove from watchlist"
                              : "Add to watchlist"
                          }
                          disabled={toggleWatch.isPending}
                          onClick={() =>
                            toggleWatch.mutate({
                              id: item.id,
                              isWatchlisted: !item.isWatchlisted,
                            })
                          }
                        >
                          <Star
                            size={14}
                            fill={item.isWatchlisted ? "currentColor" : "none"}
                          />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="twe-btn ghost"
                          aria-label={`QR Code for ${item.name}`}
                          title="Generate Contract Address QR Code"
                          onClick={() => setQrAsset(item)}
                        >
                          <QrCode size={13} />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="twe-btn ghost"
                          aria-label={`Edit ${item.name}`}
                          title="Edit record"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setEditingAsset(item);
                            setModalOpen(true);
                          }}
                        >
                          <Pencil size={13} />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="twe-btn ghost"
                          aria-label={`Remove ${item.name}`}
                          title="Remove record"
                          disabled={remove.isPending || isBatchRunning}
                          onClick={() => deleteAsset(item)}
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={13} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {authenticated && query.data && total > 0 && (
          <div
            className="twe-between"
            style={{ marginTop: 14, flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}
          >
            <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}>
              <span className="twe-panel-kicker">
                SHOWING {safePage * pageSize + 1}–
                {Math.min((safePage + 1) * pageSize, total)} OF {total}
              </span>
              <label className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
                <span className="twe-panel-kicker">ROWS</span>
                <select
                  className="twe-select"
                  style={{ width: 92, minHeight: 32, padding: "4px 8px" }}
                  value={pageSize}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setPageSize(Number(event.target.value) || DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE);
                    setPage(0);
                  }}
                  aria-label="Rows per page"
                >
                  {PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS.map((size) => (
                    <option key={size} value={size}>
                      {size} / page
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>
            </div>
            <nav
              className="twe-row"
              style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}
              aria-label={`${title} pagination`}
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                disabled={safePage === 0}
                onClick={() => setPage(0)}
                title="First page"
                aria-label="First page"
              >
                <ChevronsLeft size={13} />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 11px" }}
                disabled={safePage === 0}
                onClick={() => setPage((current) => Math.max(0, current - 1))}
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={13} /> Previous
              </button>
              {visiblePageNumbers.map((pageIndex) => (
                <button
                  key={pageIndex}
                  type="button"
                  className={`twe-btn ${safePage === pageIndex ? "" : "secondary"}`}
                  style={{ minHeight: 32, minWidth: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                  onClick={() => setPage(pageIndex)}
                  aria-current={safePage === pageIndex ? "page" : undefined}
                >
                  {pageIndex + 1}
                </button>
              ))}
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 11px" }}
                disabled={safePage + 1 >= pageCount}
                onClick={() =>
                  setPage((current) => Math.min(pageCount - 1, current + 1))
                }
              >
                Next <ChevronRight size={13} />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                disabled={safePage + 1 >= pageCount}
                onClick={() => setPage(pageCount - 1)}
                title="Last page"
                aria-label="Last page"
              >
                <ChevronsRight size={13} />
              </button>
              <span className="twe-tag">
                Page {safePage + 1} / {pageCount}
              </span>
            </nav>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="twe-notice" style={{ marginTop: 13 }}>
          <Check
            size={12}
            style={{ display: "inline", marginRight: 5, color: "var(--twe-gold)" }}
          />
          Records are private to your signed-in account. User-entered addresses are
          not chain-verified; metadata records are not minted, listed, or redeemable.
        </div>
      </section>

      {modalOpen && (
        <div
          className="twe-modal-backdrop"
          role="presentation"
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
              setModalOpen(false);
              setEditingAsset(null);
            }
          }}
        >
          <section
            className="twe-modal"
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="asset-form-title"
          >
            <div className="twe-modal-head">
              <div>
                <h2 id="asset-form-title">
                  {editingAsset ? "Edit an asset record" : "Create an asset record"}
                </h2>
                <p>
                  {editingAsset
                    ? "Changes are saved to your account."
                    : "Saved to your account. This does not issue, mint, list, or deploy an asset."}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                className="twe-btn ghost"
                aria-label="Close"
                onClick={() => {
                  setModalOpen(false);
                  setEditingAsset(null);
                }}
              >
                <X size={17} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <form
              key={editingAsset?.id ?? "new-asset"}
              onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)}
            >
              <div className="twe-form-grid">
                {!editingAsset && (!createKind || (kinds?.length ?? 0) > 1) && (
                  <div className="twe-field">
                    <label htmlFor="asset-kind">Record type</label>
                    <select
                      id="asset-kind"
                      className="twe-select"
                      name="kind"
                      defaultValue={
                        createKind ?? (kindFilter === "all" ? "token" : kindFilter)
                      }
                    >
                      {(kinds ?? KINDS).map((value) => (
                        <option key={value} value={value}>
                          {KIND_LABEL[value]}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className={`twe-field ${createKind ? "full" : ""}`}>
                  <label htmlFor="asset-name">Name *</label>
                  <input
                    className="twe-input"
                    id="asset-name"
                    name="name"
                    maxLength={160}
                    placeholder="Asset or collection name"
                    defaultValue={editingAsset?.name ?? ""}
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="twe-field">
                  <label htmlFor="asset-symbol">Symbol / ticker</label>
                  <input
                    className="twe-input"
                    id="asset-symbol"
                    name="symbol"
                    maxLength={24}
                    placeholder="Optional"
                    defaultValue={editingAsset?.symbol ?? ""}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="twe-field">
                  <label htmlFor="asset-chain">Network / chain</label>
                  <input
                    className="twe-input"
                    id="asset-chain"
                    name="chain"
                    maxLength={80}
                    placeholder="For example, Ethereum"
                    defaultValue={editingAsset?.chain ?? ""}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="twe-field">
                  <label htmlFor="asset-standard">Standard</label>
                  <input
                    className="twe-input"
                    id="asset-standard"
                    name="standard"
                    maxLength={60}

                  />

                <div className="twe-field full">

                  <input

                    name="contractAddress"
                    maxLength={255}

                  />
                </div>
                <div className="twe-field full">
                  <label htmlFor="asset-description">Description</label>
                  <textarea

                    placeholder="Describe the record and its source or intended use."

                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              {create.error && (

              {update.error && (

              {remove.error && (
                <div className="twe-alert" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                  {remove.error.message}

              <div
                className="twe-row"
                style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", marginTop: 18 }}
              >
                <button
                  className="twe-btn secondary"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setModalOpen(false);
                    setEditingAsset(null);
                  }}
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  className="twe-btn"
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={create.isPending || update.isPending}
                >
                  {create.isPending || update.isPending
                    ? "Saving…"
                    : editingAsset
                      ? "Save changes"
                      : "Save record"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </section>
        </div>
      )}

      {qrAsset && (
        <div
          className="twe-modal-backdrop"
          role="presentation"
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
              setQrAsset(null);
            }
          }}
        >
          <section
            className="twe-modal"
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="asset-qr-title"
          >
            <div className="twe-modal-head">
              <div>
                <h2 id="asset-qr-title">

                </h2>

      )}

import { CheckCircle2, Loader2, X } from "lucide-react";

export type BatchOperationKind = "duplicate" | "delete";

export interface BatchProgressState {
  visible: boolean;
  operation: BatchOperationKind;
  processed: number;
  total: number;
  currentLabel: string;
  status: "running" | "completed" | "error";
  errorMessage?: string;
}

export const INITIAL_BATCH_PROGRESS: BatchProgressState = {
  visible: false,
  operation: "duplicate",
  processed: 0,
  total: 0,
  currentLabel: "",
  status: "completed",
};

export function computeBatchProgressPercent(progress: BatchProgressState): number {
  if (progress.total <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.min(100, Math.round((progress.processed / progress.total) * 100));
}

export function BatchHeaderProgressBar({
  progress,
  onDismiss,
}: {
  progress: BatchProgressState;
  onDismiss: () => void;
}) {
  if (!progress.visible) return null;

  const pct = computeBatchProgressPercent(progress);
  const visualPct =
    progress.status === "running" ? Math.max(6, pct) : pct;
  const actionVerb =
    progress.operation === "delete"
      ? progress.status === "completed"
        ? "Deleted"
        : "Deleting"
      : progress.status === "completed"
      ? "Duplicated"
      : "Duplicating";

  return (
    <div
      className={`twe-batch-progress-card ${
        progress.status === "completed"
          ? "completed"
          : progress.status === "error"
          ? "error"
          : ""
      }`}
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
    >
      <div className="twe-between" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
        <div className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
          {progress.status === "running" ? (
            <Loader2
              size={14}
              className="animate-spin"
              color="var(--twe-gold-bright)"
            />
          ) : progress.status === "completed" ? (
            <CheckCircle2 size={14} color="var(--twe-green)" />
          ) : (
            <X size={14} color="var(--twe-red)" />
          )}
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: 600,
              color:
                progress.status === "completed"
                  ? "var(--twe-green)"
                  : progress.status === "error"
                  ? "var(--twe-red)"
                  : "var(--twe-gold-bright)",
            }}
          >
            {progress.status === "error"
              ? `Batch ${progress.operation} interrupted (${progress.processed}/${progress.total})`
              : `${actionVerb} ${progress.processed} of ${progress.total} record${
                  progress.total === 1 ? "" : "s"
                }`}
          </span>
          {progress.currentLabel ? (
            <span className="twe-panel-kicker" style={{ color: "#9da3ad" }}>
              · {progress.currentLabel}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
          <span
            className={`twe-tag ${progress.status === "running" ? "gold" : ""}`}
            aria-label={`Batch progress ${pct}%`}
          >
            {pct}%
          </span>
          {progress.status !== "running" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="twe-btn ghost"
              style={{ minHeight: 24, padding: "0 6px" }}
              onClick={onDismiss}
              aria-label="Dismiss batch progress indicator"
            >
              <X size={12} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div
        className="twe-batch-progress-track"
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={progress.total}
        aria-valuenow={progress.processed}
        aria-label={`Batch ${progress.operation} progress`}
      >
        <div
          className={`twe-batch-progress-fill ${
            progress.status === "completed"
              ? "completed"
              : progress.status === "error"
              ? "error"
              : ""
          }`}
          style={{ width: `${visualPct}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      {progress.errorMessage ? (
        <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: 10, color: "var(--twe-red)" }}>
          {progress.errorMessage}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TableHeaderProgressRow({
  progress,
  colSpan,
}: {
  progress: BatchProgressState;
  colSpan: number;
}) {
  if (!progress.visible) return null;

  const pct = computeBatchProgressPercent(progress);
  const visualPct =
    progress.status === "running" ? Math.max(6, pct) : pct;
  const statusClass =
    progress.status === "completed"
      ? "completed"
      : progress.status === "error"
      ? "error"
      : "";

  return (
    <tr className="twe-thead-progress-row">
      <th colSpan={colSpan}>
        <div
          className="twe-thead-progress-track"
          role="progressbar"
          aria-label={`Table header batch ${progress.operation} progress (${pct}%)`}
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={progress.total}
          aria-valuenow={progress.processed}
        >
          <div
            className={`twe-thead-progress-bar ${statusClass}`}
            style={{ width: `${visualPct}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </th>
    </tr>
  );
}

function triggerClientDownload(filename: string, content: string, mime = "application/json") {
  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: `${mime};charset=utf-8` });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

    const compositeSemiFungibleRatio =

    const baseStackValue = selectedLayers.reduce((acc, l) => acc + l.baseUnitValuationUsd, 0);

    );
    const singleNftValuation = Math.round(baseStackValue * (compositeSemiFungibleRatio / 2.5) * (rarityMultiplier / 2));
    const totalLotValuation = singleNftValuation * lotQuantity;

      totalRawKg,

    }

    function mintPairedCmdtxAsset(
        address recipient,
        uint256 tokenId,
        string memory metadataFilename
    ) external onlyRole(COMPLIANCE_OFFICER_ROLE) {
        _safeMint(recipient, tokenId);

            rawMaterialWeightKg: ${valuationSummary.totalRawKg},

            unitValuationUsd: ${valuationSummary.singleNftValuation},
            informationBarrierTier: keccak256("SOVEREIGN_CLEARING_VAULT"),
            naturalEffectsExcluded: true
        });
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId)
        public
        view
        override(ERC721URIStorage, ERC2981, AccessControl)
        returns (bool)
    {
        return super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);
    }
}`;

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Building2, ExternalLink, Plus, Search, Download } from "lucide-react";
import { trpc } from "@/lib/trpc";
import { TweCompanyReference } from "./tweCatalogTypes";

interface CompanyWorkspaceProps {
  authenticated: boolean;
  companies?: TweCompanyReference[];
  onAddCompany?: (draft: Omit<TweCompanyReference, "id" | "ownerId">) => void;
}

export const CompanyWorkspace: React.FC<CompanyWorkspaceProps> = ({
  authenticated,
  companies: propCompanies,
  onAddCompany,
}) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [showAddForm, setShowAddForm] = useState(false);

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [ticker, setTicker] = useState("");
  const [sector, setSector] = useState("Financial Infrastructure");
  const [rank, setRank] = useState<string>("7");
  const [sourceName, setSourceName] = useState("SEC EDGAR 10-K Annual Report Archive");
  const [sourceUrl, setSourceUrl] = useState(
    "https://www.sec.gov/edgar/searchedgar/companysearch"
  );
  const [sourceYear, setSourceYear] = useState<number>(2026);

  const utils = trpc.useUtils();
  const companiesQuery = trpc.twe.companies.list.useQuery(undefined, {
    enabled: authenticated,
    retry: false,
  });
  const createCompany = trpc.twe.companies.create.useMutation({
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await Promise.all([
        utils.twe.companies.list.invalidate(),
        utils.twe.overview.invalidate(),
      ]);
    },
  });

  const companies = propCompanies ?? companiesQuery.data ?? [];

  const filteredCompanies = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return companies;
    return companies.filter(
      (c) =>
        c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (c.ticker && c.ticker.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (c.sector && c.sector.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        c.sourceName.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [companies, search]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) return;
    const draft = {
      name: name.trim(),
      ticker: ticker.trim() || null,
      sector: sector.trim() || null,
      rank: rank ? Number(rank) : null,
      sourceName: sourceName.trim() || "User-Provided Reference",
      sourceUrl: sourceUrl.trim() || "https://www.sec.gov/edgar",
      sourceYear: Number(sourceYear) || 2026,
    };
    if (onAddCompany) {
      onAddCompany(draft);
    } else {
      createCompany.mutate(draft);
    }
    setName("");
    setTicker("");
    setShowAddForm(false);
  };

  const handleExportCompanies = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(filteredCompanies, null, 2)], {
      type: "application/json;charset=utf-8",
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "TWE_Company_Directory_References.json";
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 14 }}>
      <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
        <div
          className="twe-between"
          style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12, marginBottom: showAddForm ? 16 : 0 }}
        >
          <div className="twe-row" style={{ flex: "1 1 280px" }}>
            <Search size={15} color="var(--twe-gold)" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search Company Directory by name, ticker, sector, or source..."
              className="twe-input"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="twe-row">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="twe-btn secondary"
              onClick={handleExportCompanies}
            >
              <Download size={13} /> Export Directory
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="twe-btn"
              disabled={!authenticated}
              onClick={() => setShowAddForm((prev) => !prev)}
            >
              <Plus size={14} />{" "}
              {showAddForm ? "Hide Form" : "Import Company Reference"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {showAddForm && (
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            style={{
              paddingTop: 16,
              borderTop: "1px solid var(--twe-line-cool)",
              display: "grid",
              gap: 12,
            }}
          >
            <div className="twe-between">
              <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
                IMPORT SOURCE-ATTRIBUTED COMPANY REFERENCE ·{" "}
                {authenticated ? "ACCOUNT SCOPED" : "LOCAL SESSION"}
              </div>
              <span className="twe-tag gold">Source Year Required</span>
            </div>

            <div className="twe-grid three">
              <div className="twe-field">
                <label>Company Legal Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={name}
                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., JPMorgan Chase & Co."
                  className="twe-input"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label>Ticker Symbol</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={ticker}
                  onChange={(e) => setTicker(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., JPM"
                  className="twe-input"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label>Sector</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={sector}
                  onChange={(e) => setSector(e.target.value)}
                  className="twe-input"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label>Authoritative Source Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={sourceName}
                  onChange={(e) => setSourceName(e.target.value)}
                  className="twe-input"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label>Source URL</label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  required
                  value={sourceUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setSourceUrl(e.target.value)}
                  className="twe-input"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-grid two">
                <div className="twe-field">
                  <label>Source Year</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={sourceYear}
                    onChange={(e) => setSourceYear(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="twe-input"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="twe-field">
                  <label>Rank (Optional)</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={rank}
                    onChange={(e) => setRank(e.target.value)}
                    className="twe-input"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="twe-between">
              <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
                Source attribution and publication year are stored alongside each
                company record.
              </span>
              <button type="submit" className="twe-btn">
                Save Company Reference
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </section>

      <div className="twe-grid three">
        {filteredCompanies.map((comp) => (
          <article key={comp.id} className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
            <div className="twe-between">
              <span className="twe-module-icon">
                <Building2 size={15} />
              </span>
              <span className="twe-tag gold">
                {comp.rank ? `Rank #${comp.rank} · ` : ""}
                {comp.sourceYear}
              </span>
            </div>

            <h3
              style={{
                fontSize: 15,
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: "var(--twe-ink)",
                margin: "10px 0 4px",
              }}
            >
              {comp.name}
            </h3>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
              <strong
                style={{ color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)", fontFamily: "monospace" }}
              >
                {comp.ticker || "PRIVATE"}
              </strong>{" "}
              · {comp.sector || "General"}
            </div>

            <div className="twe-metal-line" />

            <div
              className="twe-between"
              style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}
            >
              <span
                style={{
                  overflow: "hidden",
                  textOverflow: "ellipsis",
                  whiteSpace: "nowrap",
                }}
              >
                Source: {comp.sourceName}
              </span>
              <a
                href={comp.sourceUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="twe-tag gold"
                style={{ textDecoration: "none", flexShrink: 0 }}
              >
                Verify <ExternalLink size={11} />
              </a>
            </div>
          </article>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  },
  {
    domain: "2. AI Generation & Invention Workflows",
    rule: "Bounded, cancellable batches with worker leases, checkpoints & idempotency.",
    tables: [
      "projects",
      "generation_jobs",
      "generation_attempts",
      "usage_events",
      "generated_artifacts",
    ],
  },
  {
    domain: "3. Application Credits",
    rule: "Integer smallest units in an append-only ledger; pre-job reservation holds.",
    tables: [
      "credit_accounts",
      "credit_transactions",
      "credit_entries",
      "credit_reservations",
    ],
  },
  {
    domain: "4. Digital Assets & Cryptocurrency Tokens",
    rule: "Separates off-chain DB ownership from on-chain finality & reorg reconciliation.",
    tables: [
      "asset_definitions",
      "asset_issuances",
      "asset_transfers",
      "wallet_links",
      "chain_events",
    ],
  },
  {
    domain: "5. Shared Operations & Reliability",
    rule: "At-least-once outbox delivery, idempotency deduplication, and security audit trail.",
    tables: ["audit_events", "idempotency_records", "outbox_events"],
  },
];

export const FourTokenSystemsPlatform: React.FC = () => {
  const [activePage, setActivePage] = useState<FourTokensPageKey>("dashboard");
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<FourTokensSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [statusBanner, setStatusBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // AI Generation Job Form State
  const [jobTitle, setJobTitle] = useState(
    "Cross-Chain Zero-Knowledge DvP Liquidity & Collateral Verification"
  );
  const [jobBatches, setJobBatches] = useState<number>(4);
  const [jobItemsPerBatch, setJobItemsPerBatch] = useState<number>(25);
  const [jobModel, setJobModel] = useState<"gemini-3.8-flash" | "gemini-3.1-flash-lite">(
    "gemini-3.8-flash"
  );
  const [idempotencyKeyInput, setIdempotencyKeyInput] = useState(
    "idem_batch_invention_2026_alpha"
  );

  // Credits Grant State
  const [grantUnits, setGrantUnits] = useState<number>(5000);
  const [grantReason, setGrantReason] = useState("Quarterly Sovereign Compute Credit Grant");

  // Asset Creation & Transfer State
  const [newAssetSymbol, setNewAssetSymbol] = useState("TWE-GOLD-LOT");
  const [newAssetName, setNewAssetName] = useState("TWE Vaulted Gold Bullion Reference");
  const [newAssetMode, setNewAssetMode] = useState<"OFF_CHAIN_DB" | "ON_CHAIN_CONTRACT">(
    "ON_CHAIN_CONTRACT"
  );
  const [newAssetSupply, setNewAssetSupply] = useState("1000000000000000000000000");
  const [selectedTransferAssetId, setSelectedTransferAssetId] = useState("ast_def_01");
  const [transferRecipient, setTransferRecipient] = useState(
    "0x4F96Fe3b7A6Cf9725f59d353F723c1bDb64CA6Aa"
  );
  const [transferQuantity, setTransferQuantity] = useState("2500");

  // Developer API Key State
  const [apiKeyName, setApiKeyName] = useState("Production Batch Worker & Asset Indexer");
  const [oneTimeSecretBanner, setOneTimeSecretBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadState = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/four-tokens/state");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = (await res.json()) as FourTokensSnapshot;
        setSnapshot(data);
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore transient fetch error
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadState();
  }, []);

  const copyText = (id: string, value: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 1600);
  };

  const handleCreateJob = async (useSameIdempotencyKey = false) => {
    const keyToUse = useSameIdempotencyKey
      ? idempotencyKeyInput
      : `idem_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    if (!useSameIdempotencyKey) {
      setIdempotencyKeyInput(keyToUse);
    }

    const res = await fetch("/api/generation/jobs", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        title: jobTitle,
        modelAlias: jobModel,
        itemsPerBatch: jobItemsPerBatch,
        totalBatchesPlanned: jobBatches,
        idempotencyKey: keyToUse,
      }),
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) {
      setStatusBanner(`Guardrail Rejected Request: ${payload.error}`);
      return;
    }
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    setStatusBanner(
      payload.idempotentReplay
        ? `Idempotent Replay Verified (Key: ${keyToUse}) — Returned existing job ${payload.job.id} with zero duplicate credit reservation.`
        : `Created Job ${payload.job.id} — Reserved ${payload.job.reservedCredits} integer credits and published transactional outbox event.`
    );
  };

  const handleAdvanceBatch = async (jobId: string) => {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/generation/jobs/${jobId}/advance`, {
      method: "POST",
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    if (payload.job) {
      setStatusBanner(
        `Job ${jobId} checkpointed batch ${payload.job.completedBatches}/${payload.job.totalBatchesPlanned} (${payload.job.status}).`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleCancelJob = async (jobId: string) => {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/generation/jobs/${jobId}/cancel`, {
      method: "POST",
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    if (payload.job) {
      setStatusBanner(
        `Cancelled Job ${jobId} — Settled ${payload.job.consumedCredits} used credits and released ${payload.job.refundedCredits} unused reserved credits.`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleGrantCredits = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await fetch("/api/credits/grant", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ amountUnits: grantUnits, reason: grantReason }),
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    setStatusBanner(
      `Appended +${grantUnits.toLocaleString()} integer credit units to append-only ledger.`
    );
  };

  const handleCreateAsset = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await fetch("/api/assets", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        symbol: newAssetSymbol,
        name: newAssetName,
        recordingMode: newAssetMode,
        chainName:
          newAssetMode === "ON_CHAIN_CONTRACT"
            ? "Ethereum / Base (Chain ID 8453)"
            : "PostgreSQL Internal Ledger",
        maxSupplyExact: newAssetSupply,
      }),
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    if (payload.asset) {
      setStatusBanner(
        `Created ${payload.asset.recordingMode} asset ${payload.asset.symbol}.`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleInitiateTransfer = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await fetch(`/api/assets/${selectedTransferAssetId}/transfers`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        toHolder: transferRecipient,
        quantityExact: transferQuantity,
      }),
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    if (payload.transfer) {
      setStatusBanner(
        `Submitted transfer ${payload.transfer.id} (${payload.transfer.status}). On-chain transfers require ${payload.transfer.requiredConfirmations} block confirmations before final ownership.`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmOrReorgTransfer = async (
    transferId: string,
    simulateReorg: boolean
  ) => {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/assets/transfers/${transferId}/confirm`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ simulateReorg }),
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    if (payload.transfer) {
      setStatusBanner(
        simulateReorg
          ? `Simulated Chain Reorganization on ${transferId}: rolled back unfinalized confirmations and triggered re-indexing.`
          : `Advanced confirmations on ${transferId}: ${payload.transfer.confirmations}/${payload.transfer.requiredConfirmations} (${payload.transfer.status}).`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleIssueApiKey = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await fetch("/api/developer/api-keys", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: apiKeyName,
        scopes: ["generation:write", "credits:read", "assets:transfer"],
      }),
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    if (payload.oneTimePlaintextSecret) {
      setOneTimeSecretBanner(payload.oneTimePlaintextSecret);
      setStatusBanner(
        `Generated CSPRNG API Key (${payload.apiKeyRecord.keyPrefix}). Raw secret displayed once below; only SHA-256 verification hash stored in DB.`
      );
    }
  };

  const handleRevokeApiKey = async (id: string) => {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/developer/api-keys/${id}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
    });
    const payload = await res.json();
    if (payload.snapshot) setSnapshot(payload.snapshot);
    setStatusBanner(`Revoked API key ${id} and recorded security audit event.`);
  };

  if (!snapshot) {
    return (
      <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
        <div className="twe-empty">
          <span>Loading Four-Token-Systems Modular Monolith…</span>
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
      {/* Top Architecture Header */}
      <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
        <div
          className="twe-between"
          style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 14, alignItems: "flex-start" }}
        >
          <div style={{ maxWidth: 780 }}>
            <div className="twe-eyebrow">
              MODULAR MONOLITH · 4 DISTINCT TOKEN SYSTEMS · 22 DOMAIN TABLES
            </div>
            <h2
              className="twe-title"
              style={{ fontSize: "clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px)", marginTop: 10 }}
            >
              Four-Token-Systems Full-Stack Platform
            </h2>
            <p className="twe-subtitle" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              Shared interface and infrastructure with strictly separated security and
              accounting rules for <strong>(A) AI Text Tokens &amp; Bounded Batch Generation</strong>,{" "}
              <strong>(B) Authentication Tokens</strong>,{" "}
              <strong>(C) Off-Chain &amp; On-Chain Digital Assets</strong>, and{" "}
              <strong>(D) Append-Only Application Credits</strong>.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <span className="twe-tag gold">
              <Check size={12} /> Ledger Reconciled:{" "}
              {snapshot.credits.account.ledgerReconciled ? "TRUE (0 Drift)" : "MISMATCH"}
            </span>
            <span className="twe-tag">
              Max Batch: {snapshot.limits.generation.maxItemsPerBatch} items ×{" "}
              {snapshot.limits.generation.maxBatchesPerJob} batches
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {statusBanner && (
          <div
            className="twe-status-banner"
            style={{
              marginTop: 14,
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              alignItems: "center",
            }}
          >
            <div>
              <strong>Platform Execution Telemetry</strong>
              <p>{statusBanner}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="twe-btn ghost"
              onClick={() => setStatusBanner(null)}
            >
              Dismiss
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Section 5 Main Pages Navigation Bar */}
        <div
          className="twe-row"
          style={{
            marginTop: 16,
            flexWrap: "wrap",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--twe-line)",
            paddingBottom: 10,
          }}
        >
          {[
            { id: "dashboard", label: "1. Dashboard", icon: Activity },
            { id: "ai_studio", label: "2. AI Studio (Bounded Batches)", icon: Sparkles },
            { id: "credits", label: "3. Credits (Append-Only Ledger)", icon: CreditCard },
            { id: "assets", label: "4. Digital Assets (Off/On-Chain)", icon: Coins },
            { id: "developer_settings", label: "5. Developer API Keys", icon: KeyRound },
            { id: "organization_settings", label: "6. Organization & Auth", icon: Users },
            { id: "administration", label: "7. Admin, Quotas & 22 Tables", icon: ShieldCheck },
          ].map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            const active = activePage === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                className={`twe-btn ${active ? "" : "secondary"}`}
                onClick={() => setActivePage(tab.id as FourTokensPageKey)}
              >
                <Icon size={13} />
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* PAGE 1: DASHBOARD */}
      {activePage === "dashboard" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          <div className="twe-grid stats">
            <article className="twe-panel twe-stat">
              <div className="twe-stat-top">
                <span>A. AI Generation Jobs</span>
                <Sparkles size={15} className="twe-stat-icon" />
              </div>
              <div className="twe-stat-value">{snapshot.generation.jobs.length}</div>
              <div className="twe-stat-caption">
                Bounded batches ({snapshot.limits.generation.maxItemsPerBatch} items/batch max)
              </div>
            </article>

            <article className="twe-panel twe-stat">
              <div className="twe-stat-top">
                <span>B. Auth &amp; Hashed API Keys</span>
                <KeyRound size={15} className="twe-stat-icon" />
              </div>
              <div className="twe-stat-value">
                {snapshot.identity.apiKeys.filter((k) => !k.revokedAt).length} Active
              </div>
              <div className="twe-stat-caption">
                HttpOnly Session + SHA-256 CSPRNG Keys (Not spendable)
              </div>
            </article>

            <article className="twe-panel twe-stat">
              <div className="twe-stat-top">
                <span>C. Digital Assets (Off &amp; On-Chain)</span>
                <Coins size={15} className="twe-stat-icon" />
              </div>
              <div className="twe-stat-value">{snapshot.assets.definitions.length}</div>
              <div className="twe-stat-caption">
                {snapshot.assets.transfers.length} tracked transfers with finality checks
              </div>
            </article>

            <article className="twe-panel twe-stat">
              <div className="twe-stat-top">
                <span>D. Available Application Credits</span>
                <CreditCard size={15} className="twe-stat-icon" />
              </div>
              <div className="twe-stat-value">
                {snapshot.credits.account.availableUnits.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div className="twe-stat-caption">
                Ledger: {snapshot.credits.account.cachedBalanceUnits.toLocaleString()} int · Hold:{" "}
                {snapshot.credits.account.reservedUnits.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            </article>
          </div>

          <div className="twe-grid two">
            <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
              <div className="twe-panel-head">
                <div>
                  <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
                    FOUR TOKEN SYSTEMS · SEPARATION OF CONCERNS
                  </div>
                  <div className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                    Why Four Separate Accounting &amp; Security Domains Matter
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="twe-tag gold">Modular Monolith</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 10 }}>
                {DOMAIN_SCHEMA_MAP.map((d) => (
                  <div key={d.domain} className="twe-provider-mini">
                    <div className="twe-between" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
                      <strong>{d.domain}</strong>
                      <span className="twe-tag">{d.tables.length} tables</span>
                    </div>
                    <p style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)", margin: "6px 0" }}>
                      {d.rule}
                    </p>
                    <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
                      {d.tables.map((tbl) => (
                        <code
                          key={tbl}
                          className="twe-mono"
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 10,
                            padding: "2px 6px",
                            borderRadius: 4,
                            background: "#090a0c",
                            border: "1px solid var(--twe-line)",
                            color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)",
                          }}
                        >
                          {tbl}
                        </code>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>

            <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
              <div className="twe-panel-head">
                <div>
                  <div className="twe-panel-kicker">AUTHENTICATED REST API BOUNDARIES</div>
                  <div className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                    Live Server-Side Endpoints &amp; Guardrail Config
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Terminal size={16} color="var(--twe-gold)" />
              </div>

              <div
                className="twe-mono"
                style={{
                  padding: 12,
                  background: "#090a0c",
                  border: "1px solid var(--twe-line)",
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: "var(--twe-platinum)",
                  display: "grid",
                  gap: 5,
                }}
              >
                <div>POST   /api/generation/jobs           (Reserves credits + Outbox + Idempotency)</div>
                <div>GET    /api/generation/jobs/:id       (Org-scoped job &amp; invention evaluation)</div>
                <div>POST   /api/generation/jobs/:id/cancel(Cancels &amp; releases unused credit hold)</div>
                <div>GET    /api/generation/jobs/:id/events(Batch checkpoint &amp; worker lease stream)</div>
                <div>GET    /api/credits/balance           (Integer units + live ledger reconciliation)</div>
                <div>GET    /api/credits/transactions      (Append-only credit_entries &amp; holds)</div>
                <div>POST   /api/assets                    (Off-chain DB vs On-chain contract asset)</div>
                <div>POST   /api/assets/:id/transfers      (Confirmation finality &amp; reorg guard)</div>
                <div>POST   /api/developer/api-keys        (CSPRNG one-time secret + SHA-256 hash)</div>
                <div>DELETE /api/developer/api-keys/:id    (Instant revocation + audit_events log)</div>
              </div>

              <pre
                className="twe-mono"
                style={{
                  marginTop: 12,
                  padding: 12,
                  background: "#090a0c",
                  border: "1px solid var(--twe-line)",
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)",
                  overflow: "auto",
                }}
              >
                {JSON.stringify(snapshot.limits, null, 2)}
              </pre>
            </section>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* PAGE 2: AI STUDIO (BOUNDED BATCHES & INVENTION WORKFLOW) */}
      {activePage === "ai_studio" && (
        <div className="twe-grid two">
          <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
            <div className="twe-panel-head">
              <div>
                <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
                  SAFE BATCH GENERATION · FINITE QUOTAS &amp; CREDIT RESERVATIONS
                </div>
                <div className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                  Submit Bounded Batch Job (`POST /api/generation/jobs`)
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="twe-tag gold">250 Credits / Batch</span>
            </div>

            <div className="twe-form-grid">
              <div className="twe-field full">
                <label className="twe-label">Invention / Generation Topic</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="twe-input"
                  value={jobTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setJobTitle(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">Model Alias (Context/Output Limits)</label>
                <select
                  className="twe-select"
                  value={jobModel}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setJobModel(
                      e.target.value as "gemini-3.8-flash" | "gemini-3.1-flash-lite"
                    )
                  }
                >
                  <option value="gemini-3.8-flash">gemini-3.8-flash (Max 4,096 output tokens)</option>
                  <option value="gemini-3.1-flash-lite">
                    gemini-3.1-flash-lite (Fast batch critique)
                  </option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">Idempotency-Key Header</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="twe-input twe-mono"
                  value={idempotencyKeyInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setIdempotencyKeyInput(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">
                  Items per Batch (Max {snapshot.limits.generation.maxItemsPerBatch})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={snapshot.limits.generation.maxItemsPerBatch}
                  className="twe-input"
                  value={jobItemsPerBatch}
                  onChange={(e) => setJobItemsPerBatch(Number(e.target.value) || 25)}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">
                  Total Batches (Max {snapshot.limits.generation.maxBatchesPerJob})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={snapshot.limits.generation.maxBatchesPerJob}
                  className="twe-input"
                  value={jobBatches}
                  onChange={(e) => setJobBatches(Number(e.target.value) || 4)}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="twe-row" style={{ marginTop: 14, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn"
                onClick={() => void handleCreateJob(false)}
              >
                <Plus size={13} /> Reserve {jobBatches * 250} Credits &amp; Queue Job
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                onClick={() => void handleCreateJob(true)}
                title="Sends the exact same Idempotency-Key to verify zero duplicate job creation"
              >
                <RefreshCw size={13} /> Test Idempotent Replay ({idempotencyKeyInput})
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="twe-notice" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <strong>Important Note on AI Tokens vs. Batch Items:</strong> Requesting a token
              count sets an upper bound and does not guarantee exact output length. Generated
              ideas are engineering candidates—not proof of novelty, feasibility,
              patentability, or safety.
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
            <div className="twe-panel-head">
              <div>
                <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
                  WORKER LEASES, CHECKPOINTS &amp; INVENTION WORKFLOW
                </div>
                <div className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                  Active &amp; Completed Generation Jobs ({snapshot.generation.jobs.length})
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12, maxHeight: 540, overflow: "auto" }}>
              {snapshot.generation.jobs.map((job) => {
                const isRunning =
                  job.status === "RUNNING_BATCH" || job.status === "QUEUED";
                return (
                  <div key={job.id} className="twe-provider-mini">
                    <div className="twe-between" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
                      <strong>{job.title}</strong>
                      <span className={`twe-tag ${isRunning ? "gold" : ""}`}>
                        {job.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div
                      className="twe-grid three"
                      style={{ marginTop: 8, fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}
                    >
                      <div>
                        Batches:{" "}
                        <strong style={{ color: "var(--twe-ink)" }}>
                          {job.completedBatches} / {job.totalBatchesPlanned}
                        </strong>{" "}
                        ({job.itemsPerBatch} items/batch)
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        Credits:{" "}
                        <strong style={{ color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)" }}>
                          {job.consumedCredits} used / {job.reservedCredits} reserved
                        </strong>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        AI Tokens:{" "}
                        <strong style={{ color: "var(--twe-emerald)" }}>
                          {job.actualAiTokensProcessed.toLocaleString()}
                        </strong>{" "}
                        (cap {job.requestedMaxOutputTokens})

                      className="twe-mono"

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="twe-btn secondary"
                          onClick={() => void handleCancelJob(job.id)}
                        >
                          <Square size={12} /> Cancel Job &amp; Release Unused Credits
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );

            </div>
          </section>

      {/* PAGE 3: APPLICATION CREDITS (APPEND-ONLY INTEGER LEDGER) */}

                      </td>

function deterministicSha256Preview(raw: string): string {
  let h1 = 0xdeadbeef ^ raw.length;
  let h2 = 0x41c6ce57 ^ raw.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
    const ch = raw.charCodeAt(i);
    h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ ch, 2654435761);
    h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ ch, 1597334677);
  }
  const p1 = (h1 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  const p2 = (h2 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  return `sha256:${p1}${p2}9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822c`;
}
