  generateTweSessionArchiveMarkdown,
  generateTweImplementationPlanExtractMarkdown,
} from "./projectArchiveContent";

interface ProjectArchiveProps {
  isDarkTheme?: boolean;
  onOpenSourcesStudio?: () => void;
}

export const ProjectArchive: React.FC<ProjectArchiveProps> = ({
  isDarkTheme = false,
  onOpenSourcesStudio,
}) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>("All");
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeDocPreview, setActiveDocPreview] = useState<"archive" | "pdf-extract">("archive");

  const handleCopyText = (text: string, id: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 1800);
  };

  const handleDownloadMarkdown = (filename: string, content: string) => {
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: "text/markdown;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const filteredFiles = useMemo(() => {
    return TWE_INDEXED_SOURCE_FILES.filter((file) => {
      const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === "All" || file.category === selectedCategory;
      const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!q) return matchesCategory;
      return (
        matchesCategory &&
        (file.path.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          file.moduleName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          file.summary.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      );
    });
  }, [searchQuery, selectedCategory]);

  const filteredPdfSections = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return TWE_PDF_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_SECTIONS;
    return TWE_PDF_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_SECTIONS.filter(
      (sec) =>
        sec.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        sec.summary.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        sec.details.some((d) => d.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }, [searchQuery]);

  const categories = [
    "All",
    "Core Workspace",
    "Sources & Studio",
    "Archive & Docs",
    "Sovereign Wealth & ATS",
    "Quantitative Signals",
  ];

  const cardSurface = isDarkTheme
    ? "bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-800 text-slate-100"
    : "bg-white border-slate-200/90 text-slate-900";
  const mutedText = isDarkTheme ? "text-slate-400" : "text-slate-500";
  const subtleSurface = isDarkTheme
    ? "bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-800/80"
    : "bg-[#F8FAFC] border-slate-200/70";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header & Markdown Export Actions */}
      <div className={`rounded-2xl border p-6 ${cardSurface}`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5 max-w-3xl">
            <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium ${mutedText}`}>
              <span>Project Archive</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>Session Documentation</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>4-Page PDF Plan Extract</span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">
              TWE Session Archive & Canonical Architecture Index
            </h2>
            <p className={`text-sm leading-relaxed ${mutedText}`}>
              Indexes available Token World Exchange (TWE) workspaces, source modules, user-supplied prompts,
              and the searchable 4-page PDF implementation plan extract. Hidden prompts and raw credentials are
              excluded.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                handleDownloadMarkdown("TWE_SESSION_ARCHIVE.md", generateTweSessionArchiveMarkdown())
              }
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#2563EB] hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Download TWE_SESSION_ARCHIVE.md
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                handleDownloadMarkdown(
                  "TWE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_EXTRACT.md",
                  generateTweImplementationPlanExtractMarkdown()
                )
              }
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                isDarkTheme
                  ? "bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border-slate-700 text-slate-100"
                  : "bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border-slate-900 text-white"
              }`}
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Download Plan Extract (.md)
            </button>
            {onOpenSourcesStudio && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenSourcesStudio}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                  isDarkTheme
                    ? "border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-200"
                    : "border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"
                }`}
              >
                <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Open Sources & Studio
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Filter Bar */}
        <div className="mt-5 pt-5 border-t border-slate-200/70 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[240px]">
            <Search className={`w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 ${mutedText}`} />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search archive modules, PDF plan sections, or session links..."
              className={`w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2563EB] ${
                isDarkTheme
                  ? "bg-slate-950 border-slate-800 text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500"
                  : "bg-[#F8FAFC] border-slate-200 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400"
              }`}
            />
          </div>

          <div
            className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 p-1 rounded-xl border ${
              isDarkTheme ? "bg-slate-950 border-slate-800" : "bg-slate-100 border-slate-200/70"
            }`}
          >
            {categories.map((cat) => (
              <button
                key={cat}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                  selectedCategory === cat
                    ? isDarkTheme
                      ? "bg-[#2563EB] text-white"
                      : "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs"
                    : mutedText
                }`}
              >
                {cat}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Workspace & External Reference Links Grid */}
      <div className={`rounded-2xl border p-6 ${cardSurface}`}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold">01. Indexed Workspaces & Manus Session Routes</h3>
            <p className={`text-xs mt-0.5 ${mutedText}`}>
              Direct reference links comparing private authenticated sessions (/app/) and public shared tasks (/share/)
            </p>
          </div>
          <span className={`text-xs font-mono tabular-nums ${mutedText}`}>
            {TWE_WORKSPACE_LINKS.length} routes indexed
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {TWE_WORKSPACE_LINKS.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className={`rounded-xl border p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 ${subtleSurface}`}
            >
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] ${mutedText}`}>
                  <span className="font-medium text-[#2563EB]">{item.routeType}</span>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                  <span>{item.accessStatus}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm font-bold">{item.title}</div>
                <p className={`text-xs leading-relaxed ${mutedText}`}>{item.description}</p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/80">
                <code className={`text-[11px] font-mono truncate max-w-[260px] ${mutedText}`}>
                  {item.url}
                </code>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleCopyText(item.url, item.id)}
                    className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      isDarkTheme
                        ? "border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300"
                        : "border-slate-200 hover:bg-white text-slate-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {copiedId === item.id ? (
                      <>
                        <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-500" />
                        Copied
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                        Copy URL
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                  <a
                    href={item.url}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#2563EB] hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                  >
                    Open Link
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </a>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4-Page PDF Implementation Plan Full-Text Extraction */}
      <div className={`rounded-2xl border p-6 ${cardSurface}`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-4">
          <div>
            <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-xs ${mutedText}`}>
              <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#2563EB]" />
              <span>TWE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_EXTRACT.md</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>Four-Page PDF Review</span>
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold mt-1">

            </h3>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

              <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono ${mutedText}`}>

                    </td>
                    <td className={`py-3 px-3 align-top whitespace-nowrap ${mutedText}`}>
                      {file.category}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 pl-3 align-top text-right font-mono tabular-nums font-semibold">
                      {file.linesOfCode}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* User-Supplied Prompt Ledger & Live Markdown Preview */}
        <div className={`lg:col-span-5 rounded-2xl border p-6 space-y-5 ${cardSurface}`}>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Terminal className="w-4 h-4 text-[#10B981]" />
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold">04. User Prompt & Artifact Ledger</h3>
              </div>
              <span className={`text-xs font-mono tabular-nums ${mutedText}`}>

              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-[320px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {TWE_USER_PROMPT_HISTORY.map((entry) => (
                <div key={entry.turn} className={`rounded-xl border p-3 space-y-1 ${subtleSurface}`}>

                  <div className="text-xs font-bold">{entry.title}</div>
                  <p className={`text-[11px] leading-relaxed ${mutedText}`}>{entry.promptSummary}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Live Markdown Document Inspector */}
          <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200/70 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"

                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium cursor-pointer ${
                    activeDocPreview === "archive"
                      ? "bg-[#2563EB] text-white"
                      : `${mutedText} hover:underline`
                  }`}
                >
                  TWE_SESSION_ARCHIVE.md
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveDocPreview("pdf-extract")}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium cursor-pointer ${
                    activeDocPreview === "pdf-extract"
                      ? "bg-[#2563EB] text-white"
                      : `${mutedText} hover:underline`
                  }`}
                >
                  PLAN_EXTRACT.md
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <pre className="rounded-xl bg-[#0F172A] text-slate-200 p-3.5 text-[11px] font-mono overflow-x-auto max-h-48 leading-relaxed">
              {activeDocPreview === "archive"
                ? generateTweSessionArchiveMarkdown()
                : generateTweImplementationPlanExtractMarkdown()}
            </pre>

            <div className={`flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] ${mutedText}`}>
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>
                Security hygiene: Hidden prompts and credentials are excluded from archive exports. Rotate
                any previously pasted secret keys before publishing to an external repository.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

    "115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935"
  );
  const [draftChainId, setDraftChainId] = useState(1);

  // 3. AMM Liquidity Calculator State
  const [reserveToken, setReserveToken] = useState<number>(1000000);
  const [reserveUsd, setReserveUsd] = useState<number>(2500000);
  const [tradeTokenAmount, setTradeTokenAmount] = useState<number>(25000);

  // 4. Lattice Sketch State
  const latticeCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const [latticeNodes, setLatticeNodes] = useState<number>(14);
  const [latticePhase, setLatticePhase] = useState<number>(24);

  // 5. Contract-Notes & Calldata Audit State
  const [calldataInput, setCalldataInput] = useState<string>(SAMPLE_SEPOLIA_CONFLICT_CALLDATA);
  const [intendedRecipient, setIntendedRecipient] = useState<string>(
    "0x0153056e0CE139B152e0aA660A4B6D80D8694F00"
  );
  const [statedQuantity, setStatedQuantity] = useState<string>(
    "69,696,969,696,979,697,979,796,979,790"
  );
  const [contractAddressNote, setContractAddressNote] = useState<string>(
    "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
  );

  const handleCopy = (value: string, id: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 1800);
  };

  // Render Artwork Canvas & Compute Web Crypto SHA-256
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = artworkCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const w = canvas.width;
    const h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Deep obsidian background
    const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h);
    bgGrad.addColorStop(0, "#0F172A");
    bgGrad.addColorStop(1, "#1E293B");
    ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Subtle geometric rings
    const cx = w / 2;
    const cy = h / 2 - 14;
    for (let i = 1; i <= artRings; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, i * 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? `${artAccent}66` : "#94A3B833";
      ctx.lineWidth = i === artRings ? 2 : 1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Crosshairs
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - 110, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + 110, cy);
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - 110);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + 110);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#47556955";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Center emblem
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = artAccent;
    ctx.fill();

    // Typography overlay
    ctx.fillStyle = "#F8FAFC";
    ctx.font = "bold 13px monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText(artTitle.slice(0, 38), cx, h - 42);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#94A3B8";
    ctx.font = "11px monospace";
    ctx.fillText(artSubtitle.slice(0, 44), cx, h - 22);

    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    computeSha256Hex(`${dataUrl}|${artTitle}|${artSubtitle}|${artAccent}|${artRings}`).then(
      (digest) => setArtSha256(digest)
    );
  }, [artTitle, artSubtitle, artAccent, artRings]);

  // Render Interactive Lattice Sketch Canvas
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = latticeCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const w = canvas.width;
    const h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#0F172A";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    const cx = w / 2;
    const cy = h / 2;
    const radius = Math.min(w, h) * 0.37;
    const phaseRad = (latticePhase * Math.PI) / 180;

    const points: { x: number; y: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < latticeNodes; i++) {
      const angle = (i / latticeNodes) * Math.PI * 2 + phaseRad;
      points.push({
        x: cx + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        y: cy + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
      });
    }

    // Draw chords
    for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < points.length; j++) {
        if ((i + j) % 2 === 0 || j - i === 1) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(points[i].x, points[i].y);
          ctx.lineTo(points[j].x, points[j].y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = (i + j) % 3 === 0 ? "#2563EB55" : "#10B98144";
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    // Draw vertices
    points.forEach((pt, idx) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = idx % 2 === 0 ? "#2563EB" : "#10B981";
      ctx.fill();
    });
  }, [latticeNodes, latticePhase]);

  const handleDownloadArtworkPng = () => {
    const canvas = artworkCanvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const url = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `TWE_Composite_Artwork_${artSha256.slice(0, 12)}.png`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
  };

  const metadataDraftJson = useMemo(() => {
    return JSON.stringify(
      {
        schema: "twe.token-metadata-draft.v1",

        symbol: draftSymbol,

        artworkSha256: artSha256,

        ownerName: "Mauro Dar",
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      null,
      2
    );
  }, [draftName, draftSymbol, draftDecimals, draftSupply, draftChainId, artSha256]);

  const handleDownloadDraftJson = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([metadataDraftJson], { type: "application/json;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${draftSymbol.toLowerCase()}_metadata_draft.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const liquidityMetrics = useMemo(
    () => calculateConstantProductLiquidity(reserveToken, reserveUsd, tradeTokenAmount),

  const calldataAudit = useMemo(

  const cardSurface = isDarkTheme
    ? "bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-800 text-slate-100"
    : "bg-white border-slate-200/90 text-slate-900";
  const mutedText = isDarkTheme ? "text-slate-400" : "text-slate-500";
  const subtleSurface = isDarkTheme
    ? "bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-800/80"
    : "bg-[#F8FAFC] border-slate-200/70";
  const inputSurface = isDarkTheme
    ? "bg-slate-950 border-slate-800 text-slate-100"
    : "bg-[#F8FAFC] border-slate-200 text-slate-900";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Reference Studio & Session Audit Dashboard (8 Manus Sessions Synced) */}
      <div className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
        <div className="twe-panel-head">
          <div>
            <span className="twe-eyebrow">Session Aggregator</span>
            <h2 className="twe-panel-title">Reference Studio &amp; Build Provenance</h2>
          </div>
          <div className="twe-tag gold">
            <ShieldCheck size={12} /> {MANUS_SESSIONS.length} Active Sessions Synced
          </div>
        </div>

        <p className="twe-subtitle" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
          Cross-reference active Manus share builds with running local environments. All external
          assets fallback to authenticated local memory streams when public Netlify or cloud
          endpoints return 404.
        </p>

        <div className="twe-grid two">
          {/* Left Column: Session Selector List */}
          <div className="twe-grid" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
            {MANUS_SESSIONS.map((session) => (
              <div
                key={session.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveSession(session)}
                className={`twe-panel twe-panel-pad cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                  activeSession.id === session.id
                    ? "border-[#d8b66a] bg-[rgba(216,182,106,0.06)]"
                    : "hover:border-[rgba(202,210,220,0.3)]"
                }`}
                style={{ padding: "12px 14px", borderRadius: 12 }}
              >
                <div className="twe-between">
                  <span className="twe-asset-name text-[12px]">{session.title}</span>
                  <span className="twe-tag text-[9px]">{session.status}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="twe-row" style={{ marginTop: 6, gap: 6 }}>
                  <span className="twe-panel-kicker text-[8px] font-mono">
                    {session.id.slice(0, 10)}…
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[#676e78] text-[9px]">·</span>
                  <span className="text-[#aeb3bc] text-[10px]">
                    {session.features.join(" • ")}

              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Right Column: Deep Inspection Panel */}
          <div className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad" style={{ background: "#0e1116" }}>
            <div className="twe-between">
              <span className="twe-panel-kicker">Session Inspector</span>
              <a

              </a>
            </div>

            <h3 className="twe-title" style={{ fontSize: 20, marginTop: 12 }}>
              {activeSession.title}
            </h3>

            <div className="twe-notice" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
              <strong>Operational Constraint:</strong>
              <p style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", fontSize: 11, color: "#9ca2ac" }}>

            <div style={{ marginTop: 18 }}>

            <div className="twe-metal-line" style={{ margin: "18px 0" }} />

            <div className="twe-between">

              <button

      {/* Header & Linked References Launch Cards */}

          {onOpenProjectArchive && (

        {/* Direct Launch Cards for Manus & External Sources */}

          <div className={`rounded-xl border p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3 ${subtleSurface}`}>

                <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span>Public /share/ Route</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm font-bold">manus.im/share/DRKqxy5haFhuVB96KsQTYx</div>

export interface CalldataAuditResult {
  selector: string;
  methodName: string;
  encodedRecipient: string;
  intendedRecipient: string;
  recipientMatches: boolean;
  rawAmountHex: string;
  rawAmountBaseUnits: string;
  formattedAmount18Decimals: string;
  statedHumanQuantity: string;
  quantityMatches: boolean;
  warnings: string[];
}

export interface LiquidityCalculationResult {
  reserveToken: number;
  reserveUsd: number;
  invariantK: number;
  spotPriceUsd: number;
  tradeTokenAmount: number;
  estimatedUsdOut: number;
  executionPriceUsd: number;
  priceImpactPercent: number;
  lpSharesMinted: number;
}

export async function computeSha256Hex(input: string | Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
  const bytes =
    typeof input === "string" ? new TextEncoder().encode(input) : input;
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.crypto?.subtle) {
    const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(bytes.byteLength);
    new Uint8Array(buffer).set(bytes);
    const hashBuffer = await window.crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buffer);
    const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
    return hashArray.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  }
  // Deterministic fallback if subtle crypto is unavailable
  let h1 = 0xdeadbeef ^ bytes.length;
  let h2 = 0x41c6ce57 ^ bytes.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    const ch = bytes[i];
    h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ ch, 2654435761);
    h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ ch, 1597334677);
  }
  h1 = Math.imul(h1 ^ (h1 >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(h2 ^ (h2 >>> 13), 3266489909);
  h2 = Math.imul(h2 ^ (h2 >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(h1 ^ (h1 >>> 13), 3266489909);
  const hex = ((h1 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0") + (h2 >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).repeat(4);
  return hex.slice(0, 64);
}

export function formatBigIntUnits(value: bigint, decimals = 18): string {
  const s = value.toString().padStart(decimals + 1, "0");
  const whole = s.slice(0, s.length - decimals) || "0";
  const fraction = s.slice(s.length - decimals).replace(/0+$/, "");
  const formattedWhole = whole.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
  return fraction ? `${formattedWhole}.${fraction}` : formattedWhole;
}

export function decodeAndAuditErc20TransferCalldata(
  calldataHex: string,
  intendedRecipient: string,
  statedHumanQuantity: string,
  decimals = 18
): CalldataAuditResult {
  const cleanHex = calldataHex.trim().replace(/^0x/i, "").toLowerCase();
  const selector = "0x" + cleanHex.slice(0, 8);
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  if (cleanHex.length < 136 || selector !== "0xa9059cbb") {
    warnings.push("Calldata does not match standard 68-byte ERC-20 transfer(address,uint256) selector 0xa9059cbb.");
  }

  const recipientSlot = cleanHex.slice(8, 72);
  const encodedRecipient =
    recipientSlot.length >= 40 ? "0x" + recipientSlot.slice(-40) : "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";

  const amountSlot = cleanHex.slice(72, 136) || "0";
  let rawAmountBigInt = 0n;
  try {
    rawAmountBigInt = BigInt("0x" + amountSlot);
  } catch {
    rawAmountBigInt = 0n;
    warnings.push("Failed to parse uint256 quantity slot as valid hexadecimal.");
  }

  const formattedAmount = formatBigIntUnits(rawAmountBigInt, decimals);
  const cleanIntended = intendedRecipient.trim().toLowerCase();
  const recipientMatches = encodedRecipient.toLowerCase() === cleanIntended;

  if (!recipientMatches) {
    warnings.push(
      `Recipient mismatch: Intended ${intendedRecipient} does NOT match calldata recipient ${encodedRecipient}.`
    );
  }

  const normalizedStated = statedHumanQuantity.replace(/,/g, "").trim();
  const normalizedDecoded = formattedAmount.replace(/,/g, "").trim();
  const quantityMatches = normalizedStated === normalizedDecoded;

  if (!quantityMatches) {
    warnings.push(
      `Quantity mismatch: Stated quantity (${statedHumanQuantity}) does NOT match calldata quantity (${formattedAmount}).`
    );
  }

  return {
    selector,
    methodName: selector === "0xa9059cbb" ? "transfer(address,uint256)" : "unknown",
    encodedRecipient,
    intendedRecipient,
    recipientMatches,
    rawAmountHex: "0x" + amountSlot,
    rawAmountBaseUnits: rawAmountBigInt.toString(),
    formattedAmount18Decimals: formattedAmount,
    statedHumanQuantity,
    quantityMatches,
    warnings,
  };
}

export function calculateConstantProductLiquidity(
  reserveToken: number,
  reserveUsd: number,
  tradeTokenAmount: number
): LiquidityCalculationResult {
  const safeToken = Math.max(reserveToken, 0.000001);
  const safeUsd = Math.max(reserveUsd, 0.000001);
  const safeTrade = Math.max(tradeTokenAmount, 0);

  const invariantK = safeToken * safeUsd;
  const spotPriceUsd = safeUsd / safeToken;

  const newTokenReserve = safeToken + safeTrade;
  const newUsdReserve = invariantK / newTokenReserve;
  const estimatedUsdOut = Math.max(0, safeUsd - newUsdReserve);
  const executionPriceUsd = safeTrade > 0 ? estimatedUsdOut / safeTrade : spotPriceUsd;
  const priceImpactPercent =
    spotPriceUsd > 0 ? Math.max(0, ((spotPriceUsd - executionPriceUsd) / spotPriceUsd) * 100) : 0;
  const lpSharesMinted = Math.sqrt(invariantK);

  return {
    reserveToken: safeToken,
    reserveUsd: safeUsd,
    invariantK,
    spotPriceUsd,
    tradeTokenAmount: safeTrade,
    estimatedUsdOut,
    executionPriceUsd,
    priceImpactPercent,
    lpSharesMinted,
  };
}

    <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad" style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
      <div className="twe-between" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12 }}>
        <div>
          <div className="twe-eyebrow">
            DRIZZLE ORM + TRPC V10 EXTENSION · COMPILER · REBATES · CREDENTIALS · BARRIERS
          </div>
          <h3 className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: 20 }}>
            Solidity 0.8.24 Compiler, Maker-Rebate Schedule, Credentials Boundary &amp; Unit Information Barriers
          </h3>
        </div>
        <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          {[
            { id: "compiler", label: "Solidity Compiler & Logs", icon: Cpu },
            { id: "rebates", label: "Maker-Rebate Schedule", icon: Percent },
            { id: "credentials", label: "Credentials Boundary", icon: KeyRound },
            { id: "barriers", label: "Unit Information Barriers", icon: Lock },
          ].map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                className={`twe-btn ${activeTab === tab.id ? "" : "secondary"}`}
                onClick={() =>
                  setActiveTab(
                    tab.id as "compiler" | "rebates" | "credentials" | "barriers"
                  )
                }
              >
                <Icon size={13} />
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 1. SOLIDITY COMPILER & BUILD LOGS */}
      {activeTab === "compiler" && (
        <div className="twe-grid two">
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
            <div className="twe-form-grid">
              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">Contract Filename</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="twe-input"
                  value={contractName}
                  onChange={(e) => setContractName(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">Compiler Version</label>
                <select
                  className="twe-select"
                  value={compilerVersion}
                  onChange={(e) => setCompilerVersion(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="solc v0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9">solc v0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9</option>
                  <option value="solc v0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a">solc v0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">EVM Target</label>
                <select
                  className="twe-select"
                  value={evmTarget}
                  onChange={(e) => setEvmTarget(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="cancun">cancun (EIP-4844)</option>
                  <option value="shanghai">shanghai</option>
                  <option value="paris">paris</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="twe-field">
                <label className="twe-label">Optimizer Runs</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  className="twe-input"
                  value={optimizerRuns}
                  onChange={(e) => setOptimizerRuns(Number(e.target.value) || 200)}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <textarea
              className="twe-textarea twe-mono"
              style={{ minHeight: 250, fontSize: 11 }}
              value={sourceCode}
              onChange={(e) => setSourceCode(e.target.value)}
            />

            <div className="twe-between" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn"
                disabled={compileMutation.isLoading}
                onClick={() =>
                  compileMutation.mutate({
                    contractName,
                    compilerVersion,
                    evmTarget,
                    optimizerRuns,
                    sourceCode,
                  })
                }
              >
                <Play size={13} />
                <span>
                  {compileMutation.isLoading
                    ? "Compiling Bytecode..."
                    : "Compile & Persist Build Log"}
                </span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                onClick={handleDownloadSolidity}
              >
                <Download size={13} /> Download {contractName}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 10 }}>
            <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
              DRIZZLE TABLE: tweSolidityBuildLogs ({compilerLogs?.items.length ?? 0} BUILDS)
            </div>
            <div className="twe-table-wrap">
              <table className="twe-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Contract</th>
                    <th>Target</th>
                    <th>Bytecode</th>
                    <th>SHA-256 Source Digest</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {(compilerLogs?.items ?? []).map((log) => (
                    <tr key={log.id}>
                      <td>
                        <div className="twe-asset-name">{log.contractName}</div>
                        <div className="twe-asset-symbol">
                          {log.compilerVersion} · {log.abiMethodCount} ABI fns
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span className="twe-tag">{log.evmTarget}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="twe-mono">{log.bytecodeSizeBytes.toLocaleString()} B</td>
                      <td className="twe-mono" style={{ color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)" }}>
                        {log.sourceHashSha256.slice(0, 18)}…
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span className="twe-tag gold">{log.status}</span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. MAKER-REBATE SCHEDULE */}
      {activeTab === "rebates" && (
        <div className="twe-grid two">
          <div>

              DRIZZLE TABLE: tweFeeRebateSchedules
            </div>
            <div className="twe-table-wrap">
              <table className="twe-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Schedule Tier</th>
                    <th>Volume Floor</th>
                    <th>Maker Rebate</th>
                    <th>Taker Fee</th>
                    <th>Settlement Rail</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {(feeSchedules?.items ?? []).map((tier) => (
                    <tr
                      key={tier.id}
                      style={{
                        cursor: "pointer",
                        background:
                          selectedTier?.id === tier.id
                            ? "rgba(201, 168, 106, 0.08)"
                            : undefined,
                      }}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedTierId(tier.id)}
                    >
                      <td>
                        <div className="twe-asset-name">{tier.tierName}</div>
                        <div className="twe-asset-symbol">{tier.assetClass}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="twe-mono">
                        ${tier.monthlyVolumeFloorUsd.toLocaleString()}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span className="twe-tag gold">{tier.makerRebateBps} bps</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="twe-mono">{tier.takerFeeBps} bps</td>
                      <td style={{ color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>{tier.settlementRail}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
            <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
              MAKER-REBATE &amp; TAKER-FEE EXECUTION CALCULATOR
            </div>
            <div className="twe-form-grid">
              <label className="twe-field">
                <span className="twe-label">Matched Order Notional (USD)</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={1000}
                  step={50000}
                  className="twe-input"
                  value={tradeNotionalUsd}
                  onChange={(e) => setTradeNotionalUsd(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value) || 0))}
                />
              </label>
              <label className="twe-field">
                <span className="twe-label">Active Schedule Tier</span>
                <select
                  className="twe-select"
                  value={selectedTier?.id ?? 1}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedTierId(Number(e.target.value))}
                >
                  {(feeSchedules?.items ?? []).map((t) => (
                    <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                      {t.tierName} ({t.makerRebateBps} bps / +{t.takerFeeBps} bps)
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>
            </div>

            <div className="twe-grid three">
              <div className="twe-provider-mini">
                <span>Maker Rebate Credit</span>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: 18, color: "var(--twe-emerald)" }}>
                  +${rebateMath.makerCreditUsd.toLocaleString()}
                </strong>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
                  Paid to resting CLOB liquidity maker ({selectedTier?.makerRebateBps ?? 0} bps)
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="twe-provider-mini">
                <span>Taker Execution Fee</span>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: 18, color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)" }}>
                  ${rebateMath.takerFeeUsd.toLocaleString()}
                </strong>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
                  Charged on liquidity removal (+{selectedTier?.takerFeeBps ?? 0} bps)
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="twe-provider-mini">
                <span>Net ATS Clearing Spread</span>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: 18, color: "var(--twe-ink)" }}>
                  ${rebateMath.netExchangeSpreadUsd.toLocaleString()}
                </strong>
                <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
                  Retained by TWE Clearing Treasury
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. CREDENTIALS BOUNDARY & ACCESS KEYS */}
      {activeTab === "credentials" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
          <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
            DRIZZLE TABLE: tweAccessKeys · EXCHANGE CONTRACT ADDRESS CREDENTIALS BOUNDARY
          </div>
          <div className="twe-grid three">
            {(accessKeys?.items ?? []).map((k) => (
              <div key={k.id} className="twe-provider-mini">
                <div className="twe-between">
                  <strong>{k.keyAlias}</strong>
                  <span className="twe-tag gold">{k.status}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="twe-mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)" }}>
                  Key Prefix: {k.keyPrefix}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
                  Scope: <strong style={{ color: "var(--twe-ink)" }}>{k.scope}</strong>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
                  Barrier Zone: <span className="twe-mono">{k.barrierZoneCode}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)" }}>
                  Allowlist CIDR: <span className="twe-mono">{k.ipAllowlistCidr}</span>
                </div>
                <div
                  className="twe-mono"
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,
                    color: "var(--twe-platinum)",
                    wordBreak: "break-all",
                    marginTop: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  Contract: {k.boundContractAddress}
                </div>
                <div className="twe-row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="twe-btn ghost"
                    onClick={() => copyValue(`key-${k.id}`, k.boundContractAddress)}
                  >
                    {copiedKey === `key-${k.id}` ? <Check size={11} /> : <Copy size={11} />}
                    <span>Copy Contract</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="twe-btn ghost"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setQrKeyTarget({
                        alias: k.keyAlias,
                        address: k.boundContractAddress,
                        zone: k.barrierZoneCode,
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    <QrCode size={11} />
                    <span>Contract QR</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. CHINESE WALL / UNIT INFORMATION BARRIERS */}
      {activeTab === "barriers" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
          <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
            DRIZZLE TABLE: tweInformationBarriers · CHINESE WALL COMPARTMENT ZONES
          </div>
          <div className="twe-grid three">
            {(barriers?.items ?? []).map((b) => (
              <div key={b.id} className="twe-provider-mini">
                <div className="twe-between">
                  <span className="twe-tag gold">{b.zoneCode}</span>
                  <span className="twe-tag">{b.crossWallTransferPolicy}</span>
                </div>
                <strong style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 6 }}>{b.zoneTitle}</strong>
                <div
                  className="twe-mono"
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 10,
                    color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)",
                    wordBreak: "break-all",
                    marginTop: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  Isolated Units: {b.isolatedUnits}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--twe-muted)", marginTop: 4 }}>
                  Regulatory Anchor: <strong style={{ color: "var(--twe-ink)" }}>{b.secRuleReference}</strong>
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--twe-muted)", marginTop: 4 }}>
                  Permitted Roles: {b.permittedRoles.join(", ")}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {qrKeyTarget && (
        <div className="twe-modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setQrKeyTarget(null)}>
          <div
            className="twe-modal"
            style={{ maxWidth: 560 }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="twe-between" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <div>
                <div className="twe-eyebrow">BOUND CONTRACT CREDENTIAL QR</div>
                <h3 style={{ margin: "6px 0 0", fontSize: 18 }}>{qrKeyTarget.alias}</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="twe-btn ghost"
                onClick={() => setQrKeyTarget(null)}
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
            <ContractAddressQrGenerator
              contractAddress={qrKeyTarget.address}
              tokenSymbol="TWE-CRED"
              tokenName={qrKeyTarget.alias}
              network={qrKeyTarget.zone}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

const KIND_DISPLAY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  token: "Token",

function SortHeaderButton({
  label,
  column,
  activeColumn,
  direction,
  onToggle,
}: {
  label: string;
  column: AssetSortField;
  activeColumn: AssetSortField;
  direction: AssetSortOrder;
  onToggle: (col: AssetSortField, explicitDirection?: AssetSortOrder) => void;
}) {
  const isActive = activeColumn === column;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={`twe-sort-btn ${isActive ? "active" : ""}`}
      onClick={() => onToggle(column)}
      title={`Sort by ${label} (${isActive && direction === "asc" ? "descending" : "ascending"})`}
      aria-label={`Sort by ${label} ${
        isActive
          ? direction === "asc"
            ? "(currently ascending, click for descending)"
            : "(currently descending, click for ascending)"
          : "(click to sort ascending)"
      }`}
    >
      <span>{label}</span>
      <span
        style={{
          display: "inline-flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: 3,
          marginLeft: 2,
        }}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <span
          style={{
            display: "inline-flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            lineHeight: 0,
          }}
        >
          <ChevronUp
            size={11}
            onClick={(event) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
              onToggle(
                column,
                isActive && direction === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc"
              );
            }}
            style={{
              marginBottom: -3,
              color:
                isActive && direction === "asc"
                  ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                  : "currentColor",
              opacity: isActive && direction === "asc" ? 1 : 0.38,
            }}
          />
          <ChevronDown
            size={11}
            onClick={(event) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
              onToggle(
                column,
                isActive && direction === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc"
              );
            }}
            style={{
              color:
                isActive && direction === "desc"
                  ? "var(--twe-gold-bright)"
                  : "currentColor",
              opacity: isActive && direction === "desc" ? 1 : 0.38,
            }}
          />
        </span>
        {isActive ? (
          <span
            style={{
              fontSize: 9,
              fontWeight: 600,
              letterSpacing: "0.08em",
              color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)",
            }}
          >
            {direction === "asc" ? "ASC" : "DESC"}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <ArrowUpDown size={11} style={{ opacity: 0.35 }} />
        )}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

const OVERVIEW_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS = [5, 10, 20, 25, 50] as const;

export function FooterPaginationControls({
  page,
  pageSize,
  total,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
}: {
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  total: number;
  onPageChange: (nextPage: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange: (nextPageSize: number) => void;
}) {
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize));
  const safePage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
  const startRow = total === 0 ? 0 : safePage * pageSize + 1;
  const endRow = Math.min((safePage + 1) * pageSize, total);

  const visiblePageNumbers = useMemo(() => {
    const windowSize = 5;
    let start = Math.max(0, safePage - Math.floor(windowSize / 2));
    const end = Math.min(pageCount, start + windowSize);
    if (end - start < windowSize) {
      start = Math.max(0, end - windowSize);
    }
    const pages: number[] = [];
    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
      pages.push(i);
    }
    return pages;
  }, [safePage, pageCount]);

  return (
    <footer
      className="twe-between"
      style={{
        marginTop: 14,
        paddingTop: 12,
        borderTop: "1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07)",
        flexWrap: "wrap",
        gap: 10,
      }}
      aria-label="Table pagination footer"
    >
      <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 10 }}>
        <span className="twe-panel-kicker">
          SHOWING {startRow}–{endRow} OF {total} RECORDS (OFFSET{" "}
          {safePage * pageSize} · CHUNK {pageSize})
        </span>
        <label className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
          <span className="twe-panel-kicker">PAGE SIZE</span>
          <select
            className="twe-select"
            style={{ width: 96, minHeight: 32, padding: "4px 8px" }}
            value={pageSize}
            onChange={(event) => {
              onPageSizeChange(Number(event.target.value) || 5);
            }}
            aria-label="Rows per page"
          >
            {OVERVIEW_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS.map((size) => (
              <option key={size} value={size}>
                {size} / page
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
      <nav
        className="twe-row"
        style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}
        aria-label="Token table pagination"
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className="twe-btn secondary"
          style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
          disabled={safePage === 0}
          onClick={() => onPageChange(0)}
          title="First page"
          aria-label="First page"
        >
          <ChevronsLeft size={13} />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="twe-btn secondary"
          style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 11px" }}
          disabled={safePage === 0}
          onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(0, safePage - 1))}
        >
          <ChevronLeft size={13} /> Previous
        </button>
        {visiblePageNumbers.map((pageIndex) => (
          <button
            key={pageIndex}
            type="button"
            className={`twe-btn ${safePage === pageIndex ? "" : "secondary"}`}
            style={{ minHeight: 32, minWidth: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(pageIndex)}
            aria-current={safePage === pageIndex ? "page" : undefined}
          >
            {pageIndex + 1}
          </button>
        ))}
        <button
          type="button"
          className="twe-btn secondary"
          style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 11px" }}
          disabled={safePage + 1 >= pageCount}
          onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(pageCount - 1, safePage + 1))}
        >
          Next <ChevronRight size={13} />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="twe-btn secondary"
          style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
          disabled={safePage + 1 >= pageCount}
          onClick={() => onPageChange(pageCount - 1)}
          title="Last page"
          aria-label="Last page"
        >
          <ChevronsRight size={13} />
        </button>
        <span className="twe-tag">
          Page {safePage + 1} / {pageCount}
        </span>
      </nav>
    </footer>
  );
}

export function AssetClassificationSummary({
  kindCounts,
  total,
  isFiltered,
}: {
  kindCounts: Record<AssetKind, number>;
  total: number;
  isFiltered: boolean;
}) {
  const tokenCount = kindCounts.token ?? 0;
  const nftCollectionCount = kindCounts.nft_collection ?? 0;
  const nftItemCount = kindCounts.nft_item ?? 0;
  const nftTotalCount = nftCollectionCount + nftItemCount;
  const commodityCount = kindCounts.commodity_reference ?? 0;
  const currencyCount = kindCounts.currency_reference ?? 0;
  const otherCount = kindCounts.other ?? 0;

  const summaryItems = [
    {
      key: "tokens",
      label: "Tokens",
      count: tokenCount,
      icon: Coins,
      accent: true,
      title: `${tokenCount} fungible token records`,
    },
    {
      key: "nfts",
      label: "NFTs",
      count: nftTotalCount,
      icon: Gem,
      accent: nftTotalCount > 0,
      title: `${nftCollectionCount} NFT collections + ${nftItemCount} NFT items`,
    },
    {
      key: "commodities",
      label: "Commodities",
      count: commodityCount,
      icon: Layers3,
      accent: false,
      title: `${commodityCount} commodity references`,
    },
    {
      key: "currencies",
      label: "Currencies",
      count: currencyCount,
      icon: CircleDollarSign,
      accent: false,
      title: `${currencyCount} currency references`,
    },
    ...(otherCount > 0
      ? [
          {
            key: "other",
            label: "Other",
            count: otherCount,
            icon: Archive,
            accent: false,
            title: `${otherCount} other asset references`,
          },
        ]
      : []),
  ];

  return (
    <div
      className="twe-between"
      style={{
        marginBottom: 12,
        padding: "8px 12px",
        borderRadius: 10,
        border: "1px solid rgba(203, 209, 218, 0.11)",
        background: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)",
        flexWrap: "wrap",
        gap: 8,
      }}
      role="region"
      aria-label="Asset classification summary"
    >
      <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
        <span className="twe-panel-kicker" style={{ marginRight: 2 }}>
          {isFiltered ? "FILTERED SUMMARY" : "CLASSIFICATION SUMMARY"}
        </span>
        {summaryItems.map((entry) => {
          const EntryIcon = entry.icon;
          return (
            <span
              key={entry.key}
              className={`twe-tag ${entry.accent && entry.count > 0 ? "gold" : ""}`}
              title={entry.title}
            >
              <EntryIcon size={11} />
              <span>
                {entry.label}: <strong>{entry.count}</strong>
              </span>
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <span className="twe-panel-kicker">
        {total} {total === 1 ? "ASSET" : "ASSETS"} IN VIEW
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Overview({
  authenticated,
  onNavigate,
  page,
  pageSize,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
}: {
  authenticated: boolean;
  onNavigate: (key: WorkspaceKey) => void;
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  onPageChange: (nextPage: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange: (nextPageSize: number) => void;
}) {
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<AssetSortField>("name");
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<AssetSortOrder>("asc");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [confirmBatchDelete, setConfirmBatchDelete] = useState(false);
  const [batchProgress, setBatchProgress] = useState<BatchProgressState>(
    INITIAL_BATCH_PROGRESS
  );
  const selectedRecordsMapRef = useRef<Map<number, any>>(new Map());
  const dismissTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const utils = trpc.useUtils();
  const createAsset = trpc.twe.assets.create.useMutation();
  const removeAsset = trpc.twe.assets.remove.useMutation();

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (dismissTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(dismissTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const handleSortToggle = (
    column: AssetSortField,
    explicitDirection?: AssetSortOrder
  ) => {
    if (explicitDirection) {
      setSortBy(column);
      setSortOrder(explicitDirection);
    } else if (sortBy === column) {
      setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc"));
    } else {
      setSortBy(column);
      setSortOrder("asc");
    }
    onPageChange(0);
  };

  const overview = trpc.twe.overview.useQuery(undefined, {
    enabled: authenticated,
    retry: false,
  });
  const integrations = trpc.twe.integrations.status.useQuery(undefined, {
    retry: false,
  });
  const assetListQuery = trpc.twe.assets.list.useQuery(
    {
      search,
      sortBy,
      sortOrder,
      page,
      pageSize,
      limit: pageSize,
      offset: page * pageSize,
    },
    {
      enabled: authenticated,
      retry: false,
    }
  );

  const totalTokens = assetListQuery.data?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalTokens / pageSize));

  const kindCounts = useMemo<Record<AssetKind, number>>(() => {
    if (assetListQuery.data?.kindCounts) {
      return assetListQuery.data.kindCounts;
    }
    const counts: Record<AssetKind, number> = {
      token: 0,
      nft_collection: 0,
      nft_item: 0,
      commodity_reference: 0,
      currency_reference: 0,
      other: 0,
    };
    for (const item of assetListQuery.data?.items ?? []) {
      counts[item.kind] = (counts[item.kind] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    return counts;
  }, [assetListQuery.data?.kindCounts, assetListQuery.data?.items]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (page > 0 && page >= totalPages) {
      onPageChange(Math.max(0, totalPages - 1));
    }
  }, [page, totalPages, onPageChange]);

  const sortedTokens = useMemo(() => {
    const items = assetListQuery.data?.items ?? [];
    const factor = sortOrder === "desc" ? -1 : 1;
    return [...items].sort((a, b) => {
      const valA =
        sortBy === "name"
          ? a.name ?? ""
          : sortBy === "kind"
          ? KIND_DISPLAY_LABELS[a.kind] ?? a.kind ?? ""
          : a.chain ?? "";
      const valB =
        sortBy === "name"
          ? b.name ?? ""
          : sortBy === "kind"
          ? KIND_DISPLAY_LABELS[b.kind] ?? b.kind ?? ""
          : b.chain ?? "";
      const cmp = valA.localeCompare(valB, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" });
      if (cmp !== 0) return cmp * factor;
      return (a.id - b.id) * factor;
    });
  }, [assetListQuery.data?.items, sortBy, sortOrder]);

  const pageIds = useMemo(
    () => sortedTokens.map((item) => item.id),
    [sortedTokens]
  );
  const allPageSelected =
    pageIds.length > 0 && pageIds.every((id) => selectedIds.includes(id));

  useEffect(() => {
    for (const item of sortedTokens) {
      if (selectedIds.includes(item.id)) {
        selectedRecordsMapRef.current.set(item.id, item);
      }
    }
  }, [sortedTokens, selectedIds]);

  const toggleSelectRow = (id: number) => {
    setConfirmBatchDelete(false);
    const match = sortedTokens.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (selectedIds.includes(id)) {
      selectedRecordsMapRef.current.delete(id);
    } else if (match) {
      selectedRecordsMapRef.current.set(id, match);
    }
    setSelectedIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const toggleSelectPage = () => {
    setConfirmBatchDelete(false);
    if (allPageSelected) {
      for (const id of pageIds) {
        selectedRecordsMapRef.current.delete(id);
      }
      setSelectedIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !pageIds.includes(id)));
    } else {
      for (const item of sortedTokens) {
        selectedRecordsMapRef.current.set(item.id, item);
      }
      setSelectedIds((prev) => Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...pageIds])));
    }
  };

  const runBatchOperation = async (operation: BatchOperationKind) => {
    const selectedSet = new Set(selectedIds);
    const currentById = new Map(sortedTokens.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
    const targets = selectedIds
      .map((id) => currentById.get(id) ?? selectedRecordsMapRef.current.get(id))
      .filter((item): item is (typeof sortedTokens)[number] => Boolean(item));
    if (
      targets.length === 0 ||
      (batchProgress.status === "running" && batchProgress.visible)
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (dismissTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(dismissTimerRef.current);
      dismissTimerRef.current = null;
    }

    setConfirmBatchDelete(false);
    setBatchProgress({
      visible: true,
      operation,
      processed: 0,
      total: targets.length,
      currentLabel: targets[0]?.name ?? "",
      status: "running",
    });

    let completedCount = 0;
    try {
      for (const item of targets) {
        setBatchProgress((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          currentLabel: item.name,
        }));

        if (operation === "duplicate") {
          await createAsset.mutateAsync({
            kind: item.kind,
            name: `${item.name} (Copy)`,
            symbol: item.symbol ? `${item.symbol}-COPY` : null,
            description: item.description ?? "",
            chain: item.chain ?? null,
            standard: item.standard ?? null,
            contractAddress: item.contractAddress ?? null,
            metadata: {
              ...(item.metadata ?? {}),
              duplicatedFromId: item.id,
            },
          });
        } else {
          await removeAsset.mutateAsync({ id: item.id });
        }

        completedCount += 1;
        setBatchProgress({
          visible: true,
          operation,
          processed: completedCount,
          total: targets.length,
          currentLabel: item.name,
          status: "running",
        });

        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 160));
      }

      await Promise.all([
        utils.twe.assets.list.invalidate(),
        utils.twe.overview.invalidate(),
      ]);

      for (const id of selectedSet) {
        selectedRecordsMapRef.current.delete(id);
      }
      setSelectedIds((prev) => prev.filter((id) => !selectedSet.has(id)));
      setBatchProgress({
        visible: true,
        operation,
        processed: completedCount,
        total: targets.length,
        currentLabel: `${completedCount} record${completedCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} finalized`,
        status: "completed",
      });

      dismissTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setBatchProgress((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }));
      }, 3200);
    } catch (err) {
      setBatchProgress({
        visible: true,
        operation,
        processed: completedCount,
        total: targets.length,
        currentLabel: "Operation halted",
        status: "error",
        errorMessage:
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Batch operation failed",
      });
    }
  };

  const isBatchRunning =
    batchProgress.visible && batchProgress.status === "running";

  const count = overview.data;
  const open = (key: WorkspaceKey) => () => onNavigate(key);

  return (
    <>
      <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <div
          className="twe-between"
          style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 22, flexWrap: "wrap" }}
        >
          <div style={{ maxWidth: 660 }}>
            <Eyebrow>THE TOKEN WORLD · PROVENANCE FIRST</Eyebrow>
            <h2
              className="twe-title"
              style={{ fontSize: "clamp(27px, 4vw, 45px)", marginTop: 12 }}
            >
              A world of assets.
              <br />
              <span style={{ color: "var(--twe-gold-bright)" }}>
                One refined exchange.
              </span>
            </h2>
            <p className="twe-subtitle" style={{ maxWidth: 570, marginTop: 12 }}>
              An extensible workbench for token records, NFT metadata, and
              sourced company references—designed in graphite, gold, and
              platinum.
            </p>
            <div className="twe-row" style={{ marginTop: 18, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              <button className="twe-btn" onClick={open("four_token_systems")}>
                <Layers3 size={14} /> Open 4-Token Systems Platform{" "}
                <ArrowUpRight size={13} />
              </button>
              <button className="twe-btn secondary" onClick={open("foundry")}>
                <Sparkles size={14} /> Create token record
              </button>
              <button className="twe-btn secondary" onClick={open("nft")}>
                <Gem size={14} /> Open NFT Studio
              </button>
              <button
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                onClick={open("cmdtx_codex")}
              >
                <Layers3 size={14} /> CMDTX &amp; NFT Codex
              </button>
              <button
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                onClick={open("sources_studio")}
              >
                <Palette size={14} /> Sources &amp; Studio
              </button>
              <button
                className="twe-btn secondary"
                onClick={open("project_archive")}
              >
                <BookOpen size={14} /> Project Archive
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ minWidth: 210, flex: "0 1 270px" }}>
            <div className="twe-status-banner">
              <Radio size={15} color="var(--twe-gold)" />
              <div>
                <strong>Live exchange not connected</strong>
                <p>
                  Trading, custody, and asset issuance remain unavailable until
                  authorized providers and operating scope are verified.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="twe-metal-line" />
            <div
              className="twe-row"
              style={{
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                color: "#858b95",
                fontSize: 10,
              }}
            >
              <span>Exchange provider</span>
              <span className="twe-tag">
                {integrations.data?.exchange ?? "Not configured"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div
              className="twe-row"
              style={{
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                marginTop: 9,
                color: "#858b95",
                fontSize: 10,
              }}
            >
              <span>Market data</span>
              <span className="twe-tag">
                {integrations.data?.marketData ?? "Not configured"}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="twe-grid stats" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
        <Metric
          icon={Coins}
          label="Your asset records"
          value={authenticated && count ? String(count.assets) : "—"}
          caption={
            authenticated ? "User-owned records" : "Sign in to view your records"
          }
        />
        <Metric
          icon={Layers3}
          label="Token references"
          value={authenticated && count ? String(count.tokenAssets) : "—"}
          caption="User-entered; provider verification separate"
        />
        <Metric
          icon={Gem}
          label="NFT metadata"
          value={
            authenticated && count
              ? String(count.nftCollections + count.nftItems)
              : "—"
          }
          caption="Collection & item records; not minted"
        />
        <Metric
          icon={Building2}
          label="Company references"
          value={authenticated && count ? String(count.companies) : "—"}
          caption="Source-attributed imports"
        />
      </div>
      {!authenticated && (
        <div className="twe-status-banner" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
          <LockKeyhole size={15} color="var(--twe-gold)" />
          <div>
            <strong>Sign in to save records</strong>
            <p>
              Browsing the workspaces is open. Creating assets, importing a
              directory, and saving a personal watchlist require your real
              account.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="twe-grid two">
        <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
          <div className="twe-panel-head">
            <div>
              <div className="twe-panel-kicker">REFERENCE PRODUCT MAP</div>
              <div className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
                Explore the TWE workspaces
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="twe-tag gold">17 modules</span>
          </div>
          <div className="twe-grid three">
            {[
              [
                "4-Token Systems",
                "AI Batches, Auth, Assets & Credit Ledger.",
                Layers3,
                "four_token_systems",
              ],
              [
                "Token Atlas",
                "Search and organize your token records.",
                Coins,
                "atlas",
              ],
              [
                "NFT Studio",
                "Store collection and item metadata.",
                Gem,
                "nft",
              ],
              [
                "CMDTX & NFT Codex",
                "IPFS Auto-Pin, OpenZeppelin & Valuation.",
                Layers3,
                "cmdtx_codex",
              ],
              [
                "Company Directory",
                "Import source-attributed references.",
                Building2,
                "companies",
              ],
              [
                "Portfolio",
                "Personal watchlist, not custody.",
                Wallet,
                "portfolio",
              ],
              [
                "Market Center",
                "Provider readiness; no fabricated quotes.",
                BarChart3,
                "market",
              ],
              [
                "Build & Security",
                "Contract, chain, audit, and policy hubs.",
                ShieldCheck,
                "deploy",
              ],
            ].map(([title, desc, Icon, key]) => {
              const ModuleIcon = Icon as typeof Gem;
              return (
                <button
                  key={String(key)}
                  className="twe-panel twe-module-card"
                  style={{ textAlign: "left", cursor: "pointer" }}

                  <span className="twe-module-icon">
                    <ModuleIcon size={16} />

                  <p>{String(desc)}</p>
                  <span className="twe-tag">

                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
        <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad">
          <div className="twe-panel-head">
            <div>
              <div className="twe-panel-kicker">CONNECTION READINESS</div>
              <div className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
                Production integrations
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="twe-tag">No providers configured</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 10 }}>
            {[
              [
                "Execution & settlement",
                "Exchange/broker provider and approved settlement path",
                CircleDollarSign,
              ],
              [
                "Wallet & custody",
                "Custody model, signing policy, and supported wallets",
                Wallet,
              ],
              [
                "Market & chain data",
                "Named market data, chain RPC, and indexer providers",
                Network,
              ],
              [
                "Company universe",
                "Authoritative source file and ranking year",
                Landmark,
              ],
            ].map(([title, desc, Icon]) => {
              const RowIcon = Icon as typeof Gem;
              return (
                <div className="twe-provider-mini" key={String(title)}>
                  <div className="twe-between">
                    <div className="twe-row">
                      <RowIcon size={15} color="var(--twe-gold)" />

                    </div>
                    <span className="twe-tag">Not configured</span>
                  </div>
                  <span

                      marginTop: 7,
                      color: "#7e858f",
                      fontSize: 10,
                    }}
