                    {String(desc)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
      <section className="twe-panel twe-panel-pad" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="twe-panel-head" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
          <div>
            <div className="twe-panel-kicker">
              INTERACTIVE TOKEN &amp; ASSET TABLE · SORTABLE &amp; PAGINATED
            </div>
            <div className="twe-panel-title" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              Token &amp; Asset Records ({totalTokens})
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <span className="twe-tag gold">
                  {selectedIds.length} selected
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="twe-btn secondary"
                  style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                  disabled={!authenticated || isBatchRunning}
                  onClick={() => void runBatchOperation("duplicate")}
                  title="Duplicate selected token records"
                >
                  <Copy size={12} /> Duplicate ({selectedIds.length})
                </button>
                {confirmBatchDelete ? (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="twe-btn danger"
                      style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                      disabled={!authenticated || isBatchRunning}
                      onClick={() => void runBatchOperation("delete")}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={12} /> Confirm Delete ({selectedIds.length})
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="twe-btn ghost"
                      style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 8px" }}
                      disabled={isBatchRunning}
                      onClick={() => setConfirmBatchDelete(false)}
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="twe-btn danger"
                    style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                    disabled={!authenticated || isBatchRunning}
                    onClick={() => setConfirmBatchDelete(true)}
                    title="Delete selected token records"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={12} /> Delete ({selectedIds.length})
                  </button>
                )}
              </>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="twe-tag gold"
              style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}
              onClick={() => handleSortToggle(sortBy)}
              title="Click to toggle ascending / descending sort order"
            >
              {sortOrder === "asc" ? (
                <ChevronUp size={12} />
              ) : (
                <ChevronDown size={12} />
              )}
              Sorted by{" "}
              {sortBy === "name" ? "Name" : sortBy === "kind" ? "Kind" : "Chain"} (
              {sortOrder.toUpperCase()})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="twe-btn secondary"
              onClick={open("atlas")}
            >
              Open Full Token Atlas <ChevronRight size={12} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <BatchHeaderProgressBar
          progress={batchProgress}
          onDismiss={() =>
            setBatchProgress((prev) => ({ ...prev, visible: false }))
          }
        />

        <div className="twe-toolbar">
          <label className="twe-search">
            <Search size={14} />
            <input
              className="twe-input"
              placeholder="Filter tokens by name, symbol, kind, chain, or contract…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setSearch(event.target.value);
                onPageChange(0);
              }}
            />
          </label>
          <div className="twe-row" style={{ flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <span className="twe-tag">
              <Archive size={11} /> {totalTokens} total
            </span>
            <div className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
              <span className="twe-panel-kicker">SORT BY</span>
              {(["name", "kind", "chain"] as AssetSortField[]).map((col) => {
                const activeCol = sortBy === col;
                const colLabel =
                  col === "name" ? "Name" : col === "kind" ? "Kind" : "Chain";
                return (
                  <button
                    key={col}
                    type="button"
                    className={`twe-btn ${activeCol ? "" : "secondary"}`}
                    style={{ minHeight: 32, padding: "0 10px" }}
                    onClick={() => handleSortToggle(col)}
                    title={`Sort by ${colLabel} (${
                      activeCol && sortOrder === "asc"
                        ? "descending"
                        : "ascending"
                    })`}
                  >
                    {colLabel}
                    {activeCol ? (
                      sortOrder === "asc" ? (
                        <ChevronUp size={12} />
                      ) : (
                        <ChevronDown size={12} />
                      )
                    ) : (
                      <ArrowUpDown size={11} style={{ opacity: 0.5 }} />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <label className="twe-row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
              <span className="twe-panel-kicker">ROWS PER PAGE</span>
              <select
                className="twe-select"
                style={{ width: 96, minHeight: 34 }}
                value={pageSize}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  onPageSizeChange(Number(event.target.value) || 5);
                  onPageChange(0);
                }}
                aria-label="Rows per page"
              >
                {OVERVIEW_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS.map((size) => (
                  <option key={size} value={size}>
                    {size} / page
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <AssetClassificationSummary
          kindCounts={kindCounts}
          total={totalTokens}
          isFiltered={search.trim().length > 0}
        />

        <div className="twe-table-wrap">
          <table className="twe-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style={{ width: 38, textAlign: "center" }}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    className="twe-checkbox"
                    checked={allPageSelected}
                    disabled={sortedTokens.length === 0 || isBatchRunning}
                    onChange={toggleSelectPage}
                    aria-label="Select all records on current page"
                    title="Select all records on current page"
                  />
                </th>
                <th
                  aria-sort={
                    sortBy === "name"
                      ? sortOrder === "asc"
                        ? "ascending"
                        : "descending"
                      : "none"
                  }
                >
                  <SortHeaderButton
                    label="Name"
                    column="name"
                    activeColumn={sortBy}
                    direction={sortOrder}
                    onToggle={handleSortToggle}
                  />
                </th>
                <th
                  aria-sort={
                    sortBy === "kind"
                      ? sortOrder === "asc"
                        ? "ascending"
                        : "descending"
                      : "none"
                  }
                >
                  <SortHeaderButton
                    label="Kind"
                    column="kind"
                    activeColumn={sortBy}
                    direction={sortOrder}
                    onToggle={handleSortToggle}
                  />
                </th>
                <th
                  aria-sort={
                    sortBy === "chain"
                      ? sortOrder === "asc"
                        ? "ascending"
                        : "descending"
                      : "none"
                  }
                >
                  <SortHeaderButton
                    label="Chain"
                    column="chain"
                    activeColumn={sortBy}
                    direction={sortOrder}
                    onToggle={handleSortToggle}
                  />
                </th>
                <th>Standard</th>
                <th>Contract / Identifier</th>
                <th>Status</th>
              </tr>
              <TableHeaderProgressRow progress={batchProgress} colSpan={7} />
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {sortedTokens.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td
                    colSpan={7}
                    style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 24, color: "#858b95" }}
                  >
                    No token records match the current filter.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                sortedTokens.map((item) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(item.id);
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={item.id}
                      className={isSelected ? "selected" : undefined}
                    >
                      <td style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          className="twe-checkbox"
                          checked={isSelected}
                          disabled={isBatchRunning}
                          onChange={() => toggleSelectRow(item.id)}
                          aria-label={`Select ${item.name}`}
                        />
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <div className="twe-asset-name">{item.name}</div>
                        <div className="twe-asset-symbol">
                          {item.symbol ||
                            `TWE-${String(item.id).padStart(6, "0")}`}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span className="twe-tag">
                          {KIND_DISPLAY_LABELS[item.kind] ?? item.kind}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {item.chain || (
                          <span style={{ color: "#666d77" }}>
                            Not specified
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td>{item.standard || "—"}</td>
                      <td
                        style={{
                          fontFamily: "ui-monospace, monospace",
                          fontSize: 10,
                        }}
                      >
                        {item.contractAddress || "—"}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span
                          className={`twe-tag ${
                            item.status === "user_entered_unverified"
                              ? "gold"
                              : ""
                          }`}
                        >
                          {String(
                            item.status ?? "user_entered_unverified"
                          ).replaceAll("_", " ")}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <FooterPaginationControls
          page={page}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          total={totalTokens}
          onPageChange={onPageChange}
          onPageSizeChange={(nextSize) => {
            onPageSizeChange(nextSize);
            onPageChange(0);
          }}
        />
      </section>

      <div style={{ marginTop: 16, display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
        <FourTokenSystemsPlatform />
        <ComplianceHub />
      </div>
      <div className="twe-footer-note">
        TWE WORKSPACE · NO LIVE TRADING, CUSTODY, OR MAINNET OPERATIONS ARE
        ENABLED
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export interface TWEWorkspaceProps {
  tokens?: TokenRecord[];
  onSelectToken?: (token: TokenRecord) => void;
  onTradeToken?: (token: TokenRecord, mode: "swap" | "sell") => void;
  onNavigateToClassicTab?: (tabId: string) => void;
}

export function TWEWorkspace({
  tokens = [],
  onSelectToken = () => {},
  onTradeToken = () => {},
  onNavigateToClassicTab,
}: TWEWorkspaceProps = {}) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const [active, setActive] = useState<WorkspaceKey>("overview");
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState<number>(5);
  const activePage = pageCopy[active];
  const groups = Array.from(new Set(navigation.map((item) => item.group)));
  const navigate = (key: WorkspaceKey) => {
    setActive(key);
    setMobileOpen(false);
  };

  const renderWorkspace = () => {
    switch (active) {
      case "overview":
        return (
          <Overview
            authenticated={auth.isAuthenticated}
            onNavigate={navigate}
            page={page}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            onPageChange={setPage}
            onPageSizeChange={(nextSize) => {
              setPageSize(nextSize);
              setPage(0);
            }}
          />
        );
      case "four_token_systems":
        return <FourTokenSystemsPlatform />;
      case "atlas":
        return (
          <AssetWorkspace
            authenticated={auth.isAuthenticated}
            title="Token Atlas"
            kinds={[
              "token",
              "commodity_reference",
              "currency_reference",
              "other",
            ]}
          />
        );
      case "foundry":
        return (
          <AssetWorkspace
            authenticated={auth.isAuthenticated}
            title="Token Foundry"
            kinds={["token"]}
            createKind="token"
          />
        );
      case "vault":
        return (
          <AssetWorkspace
            authenticated={auth.isAuthenticated}
            title="Asset Vault"
          />
        );
      case "nft":
        return (
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
            <AssetWorkspace
              authenticated={auth.isAuthenticated}
              title="NFT Studio"
              kinds={["nft_collection", "nft_item"]}
              createKind="nft_collection"
            />
            <CmdtxNftLayerValuationCodex />
          </div>
        );
      case "cmdtx_codex":
        return (
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
            <CmdtxNftLayerValuationCodex />
            <TweAtsCompilerBarriersRebateHub />
          </div>
        );
      case "companies":
        return <CompanyWorkspace authenticated={auth.isAuthenticated} />;
      case "sources_studio":
        return (
          <ReferenceStudio
            isDarkTheme={true}
            onOpenProjectArchive={() => navigate("project_archive")}
          />
        );
      case "project_archive":
        return (
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
            <ProjectArchive
              isDarkTheme={true}
              onOpenSourcesStudio={() => navigate("sources_studio")}
            />
            <TweCompleteMasterArchiveDownloadHub tokens={tokens} />
          </div>
        );
      case "portfolio":
        return (
          <AssetWorkspace
            authenticated={auth.isAuthenticated}
            title="Portfolio & Watchlist"
            watchlistOnly
          />
        );
      default:
        return (
          <FeatureHub
            section={active}
            integrations={undefined}
            tokens={tokens}
            onSelectToken={onSelectToken}
            onTradeToken={onTradeToken}
            onNavigateToClassicTab={onNavigateToClassicTab}
          />
        );
    }
  };

  const triggerHeaderOneClickDownload = () => {
    const downloadBlob = (filename: string, text: string, mime: string) => {
      const blob = new Blob([text], { type: `${mime};charset=utf-8` });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    };

    downloadBlob(
      "TWE_SESSION_ARCHIVE.md",
      generateTweSessionArchiveMarkdown(),
      "text/markdown"
    );
    setTimeout(() => {
      downloadBlob(

      "Middle East & Africa": [22, 6, 34, 30],
      Asia: [92, 32, 46, 22],
      Oceania: [142, -22, 28, 14],
    };
    const [baseLon, baseLat, spreadLon, spreadLat] =
      continentAnchors[j.continent] || [0, 20, 30, 20];
    const hashA =
      (j.isoCode.charCodeAt(0) * 31 + (j.isoCode.charCodeAt(1) || 17) * 13 + index * 7) %
      100;
    const hashB =
      (j.isoCode.charCodeAt(0) * 19 + (j.isoCode.charCodeAt(1) || 23) * 29 + index * 11) %
      100;
    const lon = baseLon + ((hashA / 100) - 0.5) * spreadLon * 2;
    const lat = Math.max(-58, Math.min(72, baseLat + ((hashB / 100) - 0.5) * spreadLat * 2));
    return [lon, lat];
  };

  const getJurisdictionVelocityScore = (j: UnMemberJurisdiction) => {
    const activationPct = getNodeActivationProgress(j);
    const tierScore = j.tier === "TIER_1" ? 100 : j.tier === "TIER_2" ? 80 : 62;
    const kycScore = j.autoKycEnabled ? 100 : 40;
    const zkScore = j.zkIdentityEnabled ? 100 : 45;
    const latencyScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 118 - j.latencyMs * 1.4));
    const statusBonus =
      j.nodeStatus === "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR"
        ? 100
        : j.nodeStatus === "STAGING_SYNC"
        ? 55
        : 12;
    const rawVelocityScore =
      activationPct * 0.44 +
      kycScore * 0.18 +
      tierScore * 0.14 +
      zkScore * 0.08 +
      latencyScore * 0.08 +
      statusBonus * 0.08;
    const velocityScore =
      Math.round(Math.max(4, Math.min(100, rawVelocityScore)) * 10) / 10;

    // Regulatory Risk Intensity (0..100): higher indicates greater regulatory/sanctions/KYC risk friction
    const geoPenalty =
      j.nodeStatus === "GEO_FENCED_RESTRICTED"
        ? 44
        : j.nodeStatus === "STAGING_SYNC"
        ? 22
        : 4;
    const kycPenalty = j.autoKycEnabled ? 5 : 26;
    const zkPenalty = j.zkIdentityEnabled ? 3 : 12;
    const tierRisk = j.tier === "TIER_1" ? 4 : j.tier === "TIER_2" ? 9 : 14;
    const rawRiskScore =
      geoPenalty +
      kycPenalty +
      zkPenalty +
      tierRisk +
      (100 - activationPct) * 0.38;
    const riskIntensityScore =
      Math.round(Math.max(4, Math.min(98, rawRiskScore)) * 10) / 10;

    const isRiskMode = d3HeatmapMetricMode === "REGULATORY_RISK_INTENSITY";
    const activeScore = isRiskMode ? riskIntensityScore : velocityScore;
    const heatColor = isRiskMode
      ? d3RiskHeatScale(riskIntensityScore)
      : d3HeatScale(velocityScore);
    const riskClassification =
      riskIntensityScore >= 75
        ? "Critical Risk"
        : riskIntensityScore >= 50
        ? "Elevated Risk"
        : riskIntensityScore >= 25
        ? "Moderate Risk"
        : "Low Sovereign Risk";

    const isHighActivityTransition = Boolean(
      j.complianceCheckHighlighted ||
        !j.autoKycEnabled ||
        j.nodeStatus === "STAGING_SYNC" ||
        simulatedComplianceIso === j.isoCode ||
        selectedCountryIso === j.isoCode ||
        j.tier === "TIER_1"
    );

    // Rapid status shift states use a faster pulsate-to-steady easing function to represent regulatory change velocity
    const isRapidStatusShift = Boolean(
      j.complianceCheckHighlighted ||
        simulatedComplianceIso === j.isoCode ||
        selectedCountryIso === j.isoCode ||
        velocityScore >= 78 ||
        riskIntensityScore >= 68 ||
        (!j.autoKycEnabled && j.nodeStatus === "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR")
    );
    const staggerDelayMs = Math.min(480, Math.round(j.index * (isRapidStatusShift ? 3.5 : 8.5)));
    const transitionDurationMs = isRapidStatusShift ? 420 : 820;
    const easingFunctionName = isRapidStatusShift
      ? "pulsate-to-steady-fast (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1))"
      : "pulsate-to-steady-standard (cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1))";

    return {
      score: activeScore,
      velocityScore,
      riskIntensityScore,
      riskClassification,
      isHighActivityTransition,
      isRapidStatusShift,
      staggerDelayMs,
      transitionDurationMs,
      easingFunctionName,
      activeMetricLabel: isRiskMode
        ? "Regulatory Risk Intensity"
        : "Adoption Velocity",
      heatColor,
    };
  };

  // D3 Voronoi Compliance Heatmap Cells for all 193 UN Member States
  const d3InlineVoronoiCells = useMemo(() => {
    const projectedItems = jurisdictions
      .map((j, idx) => {
        const [lon, lat] = getJurisdictionLonLat(j, idx);
        const projected = d3GlobalProjection([lon, lat]);
        if (!projected) return null;
        return {
          jurisdiction: j,
          idx,
          cx: projected[0],
          cy: projected[1],
        };
      })
      .filter((item): item is NonNullable<typeof item> => item !== null);

    const points: [number, number][] = projectedItems.map((item) => [item.cx, item.cy]);
    const delaunay = d3.Delaunay.from(points);
    const voronoi = delaunay.voronoi([18, 14, 942, 466]);
    return projectedItems.map((item, cellIdx) => ({
      ...item,
      pathD: voronoi.renderCell(cellIdx),
    }));
  }, [jurisdictions, d3GlobalProjection]);

  // D3 30-Day Regulatory Risk Intensity Sparkline Generator for each UN Member State
  const buildJurisdiction30DayRiskSparkline = (j: UnMemberJurisdiction) => {
    const telemetry = getJurisdictionVelocityScore(j);
    const currentRisk = telemetry.riskIntensityScore;
    const currentVelocity = telemetry.velocityScore;
    const seed =
      j.isoCode.charCodeAt(0) * 17 +
      (j.isoCode.charCodeAt(1) || 13) * 29 +
      j.index * 7;

    // 30 daily points (D-29 through Today)
    const startRiskOffset =
      j.nodeStatus === "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR"
        ? 14 + (seed % 11)
        : j.nodeStatus === "STAGING_SYNC"
        ? 9 + (seed % 8)
        : -6 + (seed % 9);
    const d30StartRisk = Number(
      Math.max(5, Math.min(98, currentRisk + startRiskOffset)).toFixed(1)
    );

    const width = 320;
    const height = 76;
    const padX = 10;
    const padY = 10;

    const dailySeries = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, idx) => {
      const progress = idx / 29;
      const wave =
        Math.sin((idx + (seed % 7)) * 0.55) * 3.4 +
        Math.cos((idx + (seed % 5)) * 0.9) * 1.8;
      const interpolated =
        d30StartRisk + (currentRisk - d30StartRisk) * progress + (idx === 29 ? 0 : wave * (1 - progress * 0.4));
      const riskScore = Number(
        Math.max(4, Math.min(98, idx === 29 ? currentRisk : interpolated)).toFixed(1)
      );
      const velocityScore = Number(
        Math.max(
          4,
          Math.min(100, currentVelocity - (1 - progress) * 11 + wave * 0.4)
        ).toFixed(1)
      );
      return {
        idx,
        dayLabel: idx === 29 ? "Today" : `D-${29 - idx}`,
        riskScore,
        velocityScore,
        color: d3RiskHeatScale(riskScore),
      };
    });

    const xScale = d3
      .scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, 29])
      .range([padX, width - padX]);
    const yScale = d3
      .scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, 100])
      .range([height - padY, padY]);

    const lineGenerator = d3
      .line<(typeof dailySeries)[number]>()
      .x((d) => xScale(d.idx))
      .y((d) => yScale(d.riskScore))
      .curve(d3.curveMonotoneX);

    const areaGenerator = d3
      .area<(typeof dailySeries)[number]>()
      .x((d) => xScale(d.idx))
      .y0(height - padY)
      .y1((d) => yScale(d.riskScore))
      .curve(d3.curveMonotoneX);

    const sparklinePathD = lineGenerator(dailySeries) || "";
    const sparklineAreaD = areaGenerator(dailySeries) || "";
    const thresholdY = yScale(50);

    const minRisk = Math.min(...dailySeries.map((d) => d.riskScore));
    const maxRisk = Math.max(...dailySeries.map((d) => d.riskScore));
    const thirtyDayRiskDelta = Number((currentRisk - d30StartRisk).toFixed(1));

    const points = dailySeries.map((d) => ({
      ...d,
      x: xScale(d.idx),
      y: yScale(d.riskScore),
    }));

    return {
      width,
      height,
      sparklinePathD,
      sparklineAreaD,
      thresholdY,
      points,
      d30StartRisk,
      currentRisk,
      thirtyDayRiskDelta,
      minRisk,
      maxRisk,
      strokeColor: d3RiskHeatScale(currentRisk),
    };
  };

  const toggleExpandRow = (isoCode: string) => {
    setExpandedIsos((prev) =>
      prev.includes(isoCode)
        ? prev.filter((item) => item !== isoCode)
        : [...prev, isoCode]
    );
  };

  const handleSetCustomNodeActivationPct = (isoCode: string, pct: number) => {
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(pct)));
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    setCustomActivationPcts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [isoCode]: clamped }));
    setSimulatedComplianceIso(isoCode);
    setJurisdictions((prev) =>
      prev.map((j) => {
        if (j.isoCode !== isoCode) return j;
        if (clamped === 100) {
          return {
            ...j,
            nodeStatus: "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR",
            autoKycEnabled: true,
            complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
            lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
          };
        }
        if (clamped >= 50) {
          return {
            ...j,
            nodeStatus: "STAGING_SYNC",
            autoKycEnabled: false,
            complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
            lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
          };
        }
        return {
          ...j,
          nodeStatus: "GEO_FENCED_RESTRICTED",
          autoKycEnabled: false,
          complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
          lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
        };
      })
    );
  };

  const handleSetJurisdictionBadgeMode = (
    isoCode: string,
    mode: "Fully Compliant" | "Pending KYC" | "Restricted"
  ) => {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    setSimulatedComplianceIso(isoCode);
    setCustomActivationPcts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [isoCode]:
        mode === "Fully Compliant" ? 100 : mode === "Pending KYC" ? 68 : 25,
    }));
    setJurisdictions((prev) =>
      prev.map((j) => {
        if (j.isoCode !== isoCode) return j;
        if (mode === "Fully Compliant") {
          notify(
            `${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) set to Fully Compliant (100% Node Activation · Auto-KYC ON).`
          );
          return {
            ...j,
            nodeStatus: "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR",
            autoKycEnabled: true,
            complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
            lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
          };
        }
        if (mode === "Pending KYC") {
          notify(
            `${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) set to Pending KYC (68% Node Activation · Awaiting KYC/GDPR Attestation).`
          );
          return {
            ...j,
            nodeStatus: "STAGING_SYNC",
            autoKycEnabled: false,
            complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
            lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
          };
        }
        notify(
          `${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) set to Restricted (25% Node Activation · Smart-Contract Geo-Fence Enforced).`
        );
        return {
          ...j,
          nodeStatus: "GEO_FENCED_RESTRICTED",
          autoKycEnabled: false,
          complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
          lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
        };
      })
    );
  };

  // Filtered 193 Countries (by Tier, Map Continent, Multi-Select Regulatory Blocks, Selected Country Pin, Status Badge, or Search)
  const filteredJurisdictions = useMemo(() => {
    const q = countrySearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    return jurisdictions.filter((j) => {
      if (selectedCountryIso && j.isoCode !== selectedCountryIso) return false;
      if (tierFilter !== "ALL" && j.tier !== tierFilter) return false;
      if (selectedContinent !== "ALL" && j.continent !== selectedContinent) return false;
      if (!matchesRegulatoryBlockFilter(j)) return false;
      if (statusBadgeFilter !== "ALL") {
        const badge = getDynamicComplianceBadge(j);
        if (badge !== statusBadgeFilter) return false;
      }
      if (!q) return true;
      const regBlock = getJurisdictionRegulatoryBlock(j).toLowerCase();
      return (
        j.countryName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        j.isoCode.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        j.continent.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        regBlock.includes(q) ||
        j.primaryRegulator.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        j.regulatoryFramework.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [
    jurisdictions,
    tierFilter,
    selectedContinent,
    selectedRegulatoryBlocks,
    selectedCountryIso,
    statusBadgeFilter,
    countrySearch,
    customActivationPcts,
  ]);

  const tierStats = useMemo(() => {
    const tier1 = jurisdictions.filter((j) => j.tier === "TIER_1").length;
    const tier2 = jurisdictions.filter((j) => j.tier === "TIER_2").length;
    const tier3 = jurisdictions.filter((j) => j.tier === "TIER_3").length;
    const activeNodes = jurisdictions.filter(
      (j) => j.nodeStatus === "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR"
    ).length;
    const autoKycCount = jurisdictions.filter((j) => j.autoKycEnabled).length;
    const fullyCompliantCount = jurisdictions.filter(
      (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Fully Compliant"
    ).length;
    const pendingKycCount = jurisdictions.filter(
      (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Pending KYC"
    ).length;
    const restrictedCount = jurisdictions.filter(
      (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Restricted"
    ).length;
    return {
      total: jurisdictions.length,
      tier1,
      tier2,
      tier3,
      activeNodes,
      autoKycCount,
      fullyCompliantCount,
      pendingKycCount,
      restrictedCount,
    };
  }, [jurisdictions, customActivationPcts]);

  const compliancePieData = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        name: "Fully Compliant",
        value: tierStats.fullyCompliantCount,
        pct: ((tierStats.fullyCompliantCount / Math.max(1, tierStats.total)) * 100).toFixed(1),
        color: "#10B981",
      },
      {
        name: "Pending KYC",
        value: tierStats.pendingKycCount,
        pct: ((tierStats.pendingKycCount / Math.max(1, tierStats.total)) * 100).toFixed(1),
        color: "#F59E0B",
      },
      {
        name: "Restricted",
        value: tierStats.restrictedCount,
        pct: ((tierStats.restrictedCount / Math.max(1, tierStats.total)) * 100).toFixed(1),
        color: "#F43F5E",
      },
    ],
    [tierStats]
  );

  const complianceBarData = useMemo(() => {
    const totalStates = Math.max(1, jurisdictions.length);
    const currentCompliant = tierStats.fullyCompliantCount;
    const currentPending = tierStats.pendingKycCount;

    if (chartGroupingMode === "30D_VELOCITY") {
      const checkpoints = [
        { dayOffset: 30, label: "D-30 (Oct 8)", progressFactor: 0.42 },
        { dayOffset: 27, label: "D-27 (Oct 11)", progressFactor: 0.48 },
        { dayOffset: 24, label: "D-24 (Oct 14)", progressFactor: 0.54 },
        { dayOffset: 21, label: "D-21 (Oct 17)", progressFactor: 0.61 },
        { dayOffset: 18, label: "D-18 (Oct 20)", progressFactor: 0.68 },
        { dayOffset: 15, label: "D-15 (Oct 23)", progressFactor: 0.74 },
        { dayOffset: 12, label: "D-12 (Oct 26)", progressFactor: 0.81 },
        { dayOffset: 9, label: "D-9 (Oct 29)", progressFactor: 0.87 },
        { dayOffset: 5, label: "D-5 (Nov 2)", progressFactor: 0.94 },
        { dayOffset: 0, label: "Today (Nov 7)", progressFactor: 1.0 },
      ];
      const rawPoints = checkpoints.map((cp, idx) => {
        const compliantAtDay =
          cp.dayOffset === 0
            ? currentCompliant
            : Math.max(12, Math.round(currentCompliant * cp.progressFactor));
        const pendingAtDay =
          cp.dayOffset === 0
            ? currentPending
            : Math.min(
                totalStates - compliantAtDay,
                Math.max(
                  10,
                  Math.round(
                    currentPending + (currentCompliant - compliantAtDay) * 0.65
                  )
                )
              );
        const restrictedAtDay = Math.max(
          0,
          totalStates - compliantAtDay - pendingAtDay
        );
        const adoptionVelocityPct = Number(
          (
            ((compliantAtDay + pendingAtDay * 0.5) / totalStates) *
            100
          ).toFixed(1)
        );
        return {
          idx,
          group: cp.label,
          "Fully Compliant": compliantAtDay,
          "Pending KYC": pendingCountOrVal(pendingAtDay),
          Restricted: restrictedAtDay,
          velocity: adoptionVelocityPct,
          "30-Day Adoption Velocity (%)": adoptionVelocityPct,
          total: totalStates,
        };
      });

      const firstVel = rawPoints[0].velocity;
      const lastVel = rawPoints[rawPoints.length - 1].velocity;
      const slope = (lastVel - firstVel) / Math.max(1, rawPoints.length - 1);

      const firstStates = rawPoints[0]["Fully Compliant"];
      const lastStates = rawPoints[rawPoints.length - 1]["Fully Compliant"];
      const statesSlope =
        (lastStates - firstStates) / Math.max(1, rawPoints.length - 1);

      return rawPoints.map((pt, i) => {
        const trendVal = Number((firstVel + slope * i).toFixed(1));
        const statesTrend = Math.round(firstStates + statesSlope * i);
        return {
          ...pt,
          trendline: trendVal,
          "30-Day Trendline Trajectory (%)": trendVal,
          statesTrendline: statesTrend,
          "30-Day Compliant States Trendline": statesTrend,
        };
      });
    }

    if (chartGroupingMode === "TIER") {
      const tiers: {
        id: GlobalRegulatoryTier;
        label: string;
        velocityBaselineBoost: number;
      }[] = [
        { id: "TIER_1", label: "Tier 1 Hubs", velocityBaselineBoost: 8.4 },
        { id: "TIER_2", label: "Tier 2 Hubs", velocityBaselineBoost: 5.2 },
        { id: "TIER_3", label: "Tier 3 Global", velocityBaselineBoost: 3.8 },
      ];
      return tiers.map((t, idx) => {
        const subset = jurisdictions.filter((j) => j.tier === t.id);
        const subTotal = Math.max(1, subset.length);
        const compliantCount = subset.filter(
          (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Fully Compliant"
        ).length;
        const pendingCount = subset.filter(
          (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Pending KYC"
        ).length;
        const restrictedCount = subset.filter(
          (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Restricted"
        ).length;
        const adoptionVelocityPct = Number(
          Math.min(
            100,
            ((compliantCount + pendingCount * 0.55) / subTotal) * 100 +
              t.velocityBaselineBoost * 0.25
          ).toFixed(1)
        );
        const trendlinePct = Number(
          Math.min(100, adoptionVelocityPct - (idx - 1) * 1.8 + 2.4).toFixed(1)
        );
        const statesTrend = Math.round(compliantCount + pendingCount * 0.35);
        return {
          group: t.label,
          "Fully Compliant": compliantCount,
          "Pending KYC": pendingCount,
          Restricted: restrictedCount,
          velocity: adoptionVelocityPct,
          trendline: trendlinePct,
          statesTrendline: statesTrend,
          "30-Day Adoption Velocity (%)": adoptionVelocityPct,
          "30-Day Trendline Trajectory (%)": trendlinePct,
          "30-Day Compliant States Trendline": statesTrend,
          total: subset.length,
        };
      });
    }

    const continents: { id: WorldContinentId; shortLabel: string }[] = [
      { id: "North America", shortLabel: "N. America" },
      { id: "South America", shortLabel: "S. America" },
      { id: "Europe", shortLabel: "Europe" },
      { id: "Middle East & Africa", shortLabel: "MEA" },
      { id: "Asia", shortLabel: "Asia" },
      { id: "Oceania", shortLabel: "Oceania" },
    ];
    const basePoints = continents.map((c) => {
      const subset = jurisdictions.filter((j) => j.continent === c.id);
      const subTotal = Math.max(1, subset.length);
      const compliantCount = subset.filter(
        (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Fully Compliant"
      ).length;
      const pendingCount = subset.filter(
        (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Pending KYC"
      ).length;
      const restrictedCount = subset.filter(
        (j) => getDynamicComplianceBadge(j) === "Restricted"
      ).length;
      const adoptionVelocityPct = Number(
        Math.min(
          100,
          ((compliantCount + pendingCount * 0.55) / subTotal) * 100
        ).toFixed(1)
      );
      return {
        group: c.shortLabel,
        fullContinent: c.id,
        "Fully Compliant": compliantCount,
        "Pending KYC": pendingCount,
        Restricted: restrictedCount,
        velocity: adoptionVelocityPct,
        "30-Day Adoption Velocity (%)": adoptionVelocityPct,
        total: subset.length,
      };
    });

    // Compute Least-Squares Trendline across the groups
    const n = basePoints.length;
    const sumX = basePoints.reduce((acc, _, i) => acc + i, 0);
    const sumY = basePoints.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.velocity, 0);
    const sumXY = basePoints.reduce((acc, p, i) => acc + i * p.velocity, 0);
    const sumX2 = basePoints.reduce((acc, _, i) => acc + i * i, 0);
    const denom = n * sumX2 - sumX * sumX || 1;
    const m = (n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / denom;
    const b = (sumY - m * sumX) / n;

    return basePoints.map((pt, i) => {
      const trendVal = Number(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, b + m * i)).toFixed(1));
      const statesTrend = Math.round(
        pt["Fully Compliant"] + pt["Pending KYC"] * 0.35
      );
      return {
        ...pt,
        trendline: trendVal,
        statesTrendline: statesTrend,
        "30-Day Trendline Trajectory (%)": trendVal,
        "30-Day Compliant States Trendline": statesTrend,
      };
    });
  }, [jurisdictions, customActivationPcts, chartGroupingMode, tierStats]);

  function pendingCountOrVal(val: number): number {
    return val;
  }

  const thirtyDayVelocityTelemetry = useMemo(() => {
    const total = Math.max(1, tierStats.total);
    const currentCompliant = tierStats.fullyCompliantCount;
    const d30Compliant = Math.max(12, Math.round(currentCompliant * 0.42));
    const netAddedStates = Math.max(0, currentCompliant - d30Compliant);
    const dailyRate = (netAddedStates / 30).toFixed(2);
    const currentPct = (currentCompliant / total) * 100;
    const thirtyDaysAgoPct = (d30Compliant / total) * 100;
    const deltaPct = (currentPct - thirtyDaysAgoPct).toFixed(1);
    return {
      d30Compliant,
      currentCompliant,
      netAddedStates,
      dailyRate,
      deltaPct,
      currentVelocityPct: (
        ((currentCompliant + tierStats.pendingKycCount * 0.5) / total) *
        100
      ).toFixed(1),
    };
  }, [tierStats]);

  const thirtyDayVelocityDeltaPct = thirtyDayVelocityTelemetry.deltaPct;

  const activeSimulatedJurisdiction = useMemo(() => {
    const targetIso = selectedCountryIso || simulatedComplianceIso || "US";
    return (
      jurisdictions.find((j) => j.isoCode === targetIso) || jurisdictions[0]
    );
  }, [jurisdictions, selectedCountryIso, simulatedComplianceIso]);

  const handleToggleAutoKycAndSimulate = (isoCode: string) => {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    setSimulatedComplianceIso(isoCode);
    setExpandedIsos((prev) =>
      prev.includes(isoCode) ? prev : [...prev, isoCode]
    );
    setJurisdictions((prev) =>
      prev.map((j) => {
        if (j.isoCode !== isoCode) return j;
        const nextAutoKyc = !j.autoKycEnabled;
        const nextNodeStatus = nextAutoKyc
          ? "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR"
          : j.nodeStatus === "GEO_FENCED_RESTRICTED"
          ? "GEO_FENCED_RESTRICTED"
          : "STAGING_SYNC";
        setCustomActivationPcts((pctPrev) => ({
          ...pctPrev,
          [isoCode]: nextAutoKyc
            ? 100
            : nextNodeStatus === "GEO_FENCED_RESTRICTED"
            ? 25
            : 68,
        }));
        notify(
          `${
            nextAutoKyc ? "Enabled" : "Paused"
          } Automated KYC/Compliance for ${j.countryName} (${
            j.isoCode
          }) & expanded Regulatory Compliance Snapshot — Docs: ${j.requiredRegulatoryDocs.join(
            ", "
          )}.`
        );
        return {
          ...j,
          autoKycEnabled: nextAutoKyc,
          nodeStatus: nextNodeStatus,
          complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
          lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
        };
      })
    );
  };

  const handleSimulateComplianceCheckOnly = (isoCode: string) => {
    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    setSimulatedComplianceIso(isoCode);
    setExpandedIsos((prev) =>
      prev.includes(isoCode) ? prev : [...prev, isoCode]
    );
    setCustomActivationPcts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [isoCode]: 100 }));
    setJurisdictions((prev) =>
      prev.map((j) => {
        if (j.isoCode !== isoCode) return j;
        notify(
          `Simulated Compliance Check & expanded Regulatory Compliance Snapshot for ${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) [${
            j.primaryRegulator
          }] — Required Docs: ${j.requiredRegulatoryDocs.join(" · ")}.`
        );
        return {
          ...j,
          nodeStatus: "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR",
          autoKycEnabled: true,
          complianceCheckHighlighted: true,
          lastComplianceAuditIso: nowIso,
        };
      })
    );
  };

  const handleToggleNodeStatus = (isoCode: string) => {
    setJurisdictions((prev) =>
      prev.map((j) => {
        if (j.isoCode !== isoCode) return j;
        const nextStatus =
          j.nodeStatus === "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR"
            ? "GEO_FENCED_RESTRICTED"
            : "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR";
        setCustomActivationPcts((pctPrev) => ({
          ...pctPrev,
          [isoCode]: nextStatus === "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR" ? (j.autoKycEnabled ? 100 : 68) : 25,
        }));
        notify(
          `Updated ${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) smart-contract geo-fence state to ${nextStatus} [${tweEnvConfig.keyId}].`
        );
        return { ...j, nodeStatus: nextStatus };
      })
    );

  const handleActivateAll193Nodes = () => {

    setJurisdictions((prev) =>

        nodeStatus: "ACTIVE_VALIDATOR",

        autoKycEnabled: true,

  const handleExport193Csv = () => {

      "Fiat_CBDC_Bridge",
      "Node_Status",
      "Latency_ms",
      "TWE_Env_Key",

    const rows = jurisdictions.map((j) =>

        j.isoNumericCode,
        `"${j.countryName}"`,
        `"${j.region}"`,
        j.tier,

    downloadDocumentFile(

    notify("Exported 193 UN Member States Regulatory Matrix CSV.");

  const handleExportAll193StatesJson = () => {
    const exportedAtIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const statesArray = jurisdictions.map((j) => {
      const badgeLabel = getDynamicComplianceBadge(j);
      const activationPct = getNodeActivationProgress(j);
      const velocityTelemetry = getJurisdictionVelocityScore(j);
      return {
        unMemberIndex: j.index,
        isoCode: j.isoCode,
        isoNumericCode: j.isoNumericCode,
        countryName: j.countryName,
        continent: j.continent,
        region: j.region,
        regulatoryTier: j.tier,
        complianceMetrics: {
          complianceStatus: badgeLabel,
          adoptionVelocityScore: velocityTelemetry.velocityScore,
          regulatoryRiskIntensityScore: velocityTelemetry.riskIntensityScore,
          regulatoryRiskClassification: velocityTelemetry.riskClassification,
          d3HeatColorHex: velocityTelemetry.heatColor,
          nodeActivationProgressPercent: activationPct,
          automatedKycComplianceEnabled: j.autoKycEnabled,
          zkIdentityEnabled: j.zkIdentityEnabled,
          primaryRegulator: j.primaryRegulator,
          regulatoryFramework: j.regulatoryFramework,

          validatorUptime: j.validatorUptime,
          latencyMs: j.latencyMs,
          syncedBlockHeight: j.syncedBlockHeight,
        },
      };
    });

    const totalCount = Math.max(1, statesArray.length);
    const meanVelocity = Number(
      (
        statesArray.reduce(
          (acc, s) => acc + s.complianceMetrics.adoptionVelocityScore,
          0
        ) / totalCount
      ).toFixed(1)
    );
    const meanRisk = Number(
      (
        statesArray.reduce(
          (acc, s) => acc + s.complianceMetrics.regulatoryRiskIntensityScore,
          0
        ) / totalCount
      ).toFixed(1)
    );

    const bulkDatabasePayload = {
      schema:
        "https://tokenworld.exchange/schemas/bulk-193-member-states-compliance-database/v1",
      exportedAtIso,
      tweEnvironmentKeyId: tweEnvConfig.keyId,
      leadSystemsArchitect: "Mauro Lomibao Dar III (TAURUS-1987-05-06)",

        pendingKycCount: statesArray.filter(
          (s) => s.complianceMetrics.complianceStatus === "Pending KYC"
        ).length,
        restrictedCount: statesArray.filter(
          (s) => s.complianceMetrics.complianceStatus === "Restricted"

        meanAdoptionVelocityScore: meanVelocity,
        meanRegulatoryRiskIntensityScore: meanRisk,
        activeHeatmapMetricMode:
          d3HeatmapMetricMode === "REGULATORY_RISK_INTENSITY"
            ? "Regulatory Risk Intensity"
            : "Adoption Velocity",
      },
      memberStates: statesArray,
    };

    const jsonString = JSON.stringify(bulkDatabasePayload, null, 2);
    const filename = "TWE_All_193_UN_Member_States_Compliance_Database.json";

    try {
      const blob = new Blob([jsonString], {
        type: "application/json;charset=utf-8",
      });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = url;
      link.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch {
      downloadDocumentFile(
        filename,
        jsonString,
        "application/json;charset=utf-8"
      );
    }

    notify(
      `Exported bulk JSON compliance database for all ${statesArray.length} UN Member States (${filename}).`

            >

                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Regulatory Block Focus (Multi-Select):
                </span>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-cyan-300 text-[10px] font-bold tabular-nums">
                  {selectedRegulatoryBlocks.length}/4 Blocks ·{" "}
                  {heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.length} / {jurisdictions.length} States Active
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {regulatoryBlockOptions.map((block) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedRegulatoryBlocks.includes(block.id);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={block.id}
                      type="button"
                      role="checkbox"
                      aria-checked={isSelected}
                      data-testid={`regulatory-block-chip-${block.id.toLowerCase()}`}
                      onClick={() => handleToggleRegulatoryBlock(block.id)}
                      title={`${block.label} Regulatory Block (${block.count} States) — ${block.frameworks}`}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-mono transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 ${
                        isSelected
                          ? `${block.activeClass} font-bold`
                          : "bg-[#0B0F19] border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/70 hover:text-slate-200 opacity-65"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span
                        className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                          isSelected ? block.dotClass : "bg-slate-600"
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span>{block.label}</span>
                      <span
                        className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] tabular-nums ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "bg-slate-950/60 text-white"
                            : "bg-slate-900 text-slate-500"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {block.count}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] opacity-80">
                        {isSelected ? "✓" : "+"}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-testid="regulatory-block-chip-reset-all"
                  onClick={handleResetAllRegulatoryBlocks}
                  disabled={selectedRegulatoryBlocks.length === 4}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-mono transition cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedRegulatoryBlocks.length === 4
                      ? "bg-[#0B0F19] border-slate-800/60 text-slate-600 cursor-default"
                      : "bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white border-slate-600 font-bold"
                  }`}
                >
                  All Blocks (4/4)
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Analytical Insight Telemetry Strip for Active D3 Metric (Focused on Selected Regulatory Blocks) */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 font-mono text-xs">
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#111622] border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">Active D3 Metric:</span>
                <span
                  className={`font-bold ${
                    d3HeatmapMetricMode === "REGULATORY_RISK_INTENSITY"
                      ? "text-rose-400"
                      : "text-emerald-400"
                  }`}
                >
                  {d3HeatmapMetricMode === "REGULATORY_RISK_INTENSITY"
                    ? "Regulatory Risk Intensity"
                    : "Adoption Velocity"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#111622] border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                  Mean Adoption Velocity:
                </span>
                <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold tabular-nums">
                  {(
                    heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.reduce(
                      (acc, item) =>
                        acc + getJurisdictionVelocityScore(item).velocityScore,
                      0
                    ) / Math.max(1, heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.length)
                  ).toFixed(1)}{" "}
                  / 100
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#111622] border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                  Mean Risk Intensity:
                </span>
                <span className="text-amber-300 font-bold tabular-nums">
                  {(
                    heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.reduce(
                      (acc, item) =>
                        acc +
                        getJurisdictionVelocityScore(item).riskIntensityScore,
                      0
                    ) / Math.max(1, heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.length)
                  ).toFixed(1)}{" "}
                  / 100
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#111622] border border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                  Elevated/Critical Risk States:
                </span>
                <span className="text-rose-400 font-bold tabular-nums">
                  {
                    heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.filter(
                      (item) =>
                        getJurisdictionVelocityScore(item).riskIntensityScore >=
                        50
                    ).length
                  }{" "}
                  / {heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.length}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-[#050811] p-2">
              <svg
                ref={inlineD3MapSvgRef}
                viewBox="0 0 960 480"
                className="w-full h-auto min-w-[640px]"
                role="img"
                aria-label={`Interactive D3 Global Map coloring ${heatmapFocusedJurisdictions.length} focused UN member states by ${
                  d3HeatmapMetricMode === "REGULATORY_RISK_INTENSITY"
                    ? "Regulatory Risk Intensity"
                    : "Adoption Velocity"
                } score`}
              >
                <defs>
                  <clipPath id="d3-inline-sphere-clip">
                    <path d={d3SpherePathD} />
                  </clipPath>
                </defs>
                <path
                  d={d3SpherePathD}
                  fill="#060A14"
                  stroke="#1E293B"
                  strokeWidth={1.2}
                />
                {/* Staggered D3 Voronoi Compliance Heatmap Cells with Pulsate-to-Steady Easing */}
                <g clipPath="url(#d3-inline-sphere-clip)">
                  {d3InlineVoronoiCells.map(({ jurisdiction: j, pathD }) => {
                    const isBlockFocused = matchesRegulatoryBlockFilter(j);
                    if (!isBlockFocused) return null;
                    const regBlock = getJurisdictionRegulatoryBlock(j);
                    const {
                      score,
                      velocityScore,
                      riskIntensityScore,
                      isRapidStatusShift,
                      staggerDelayMs,
                      easingFunctionName,
                      activeMetricLabel,
                      heatColor,
                    } = getJurisdictionVelocityScore(j);
                    const isSelected = selectedCountryIso === j.isoCode;
                    const isHovered = hoveredMapStateIso === j.isoCode;
                    return (
                      <path
                        key={`inline-cell-${j.isoCode}-${staggerWaveEpoch}`}
                        d={pathD}
                        data-iso={j.isoCode}
                        data-regulatory-block={regBlock}
                        data-selected={isSelected || isHovered ? "true" : "false"}
                        data-rapid-shift={isRapidStatusShift ? "true" : "false"}
                        data-stagger-delay={staggerDelayMs}
                        data-easing={easingFunctionName}
                        fill={heatColor}
                        fillOpacity={
                          isSelected || isHovered
                            ? 0.56
                            : isRapidStatusShift
                            ? 0.34
                            : 0.22
                        }
                        stroke={isSelected || isHovered ? "#FFFFFF" : "#0F172A"}
                        strokeWidth={isSelected || isHovered ? 1.2 : 0.45}
                        style={{
                          animationDelay: `${staggerDelayMs}ms`,
                          transitionDelay: `${Math.min(320, staggerDelayMs)}ms`,
                        }}
                        className={`d3-inline-heatmap-cell cursor-pointer ${
                          isRapidStatusShift
                            ? "animate-d3-pulsate-steady-fast"
                            : "animate-d3-pulsate-steady-standard"
                        }`}
                        onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredMapStateIso(j.isoCode)}
                        onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredMapStateIso(null)}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelectedCountryIso(
                            isSelected ? null : j.isoCode
                          );
                          setSimulatedComplianceIso(j.isoCode);
                        }}
                      >
                        <title>{`${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) [${regBlock}] — ${activeMetricLabel}: ${score}/100 · Velocity: ${velocityScore} · Risk: ${riskIntensityScore} · Stagger: ${staggerDelayMs}ms · Easing: ${easingFunctionName}`}</title>
                      </path>
                    );
                  })}
                </g>
                <path
                  d={d3GraticulePathD}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="#1E293B"
                  strokeWidth={0.5}
                  strokeDasharray="2 3"
                  opacity={0.7}
                  className="pointer-events-none"
                />
                {jurisdictions.map((j, idx) => {
                  if (!matchesRegulatoryBlockFilter(j)) return null;
                  const regBlock = getJurisdictionRegulatoryBlock(j);
                  const [lon, lat] = getJurisdictionLonLat(j, idx);
                  const projected = d3GlobalProjection([lon, lat]);
                  if (!projected) return null;
                  const [cx, cy] = projected;
                  const {
                    score,
                    velocityScore,
                    riskIntensityScore,
                    isHighActivityTransition,
                    isRapidStatusShift,
                    staggerDelayMs,
                    easingFunctionName,
                    activeMetricLabel,
                    heatColor,
                  } = getJurisdictionVelocityScore(j);
                  const isSelected = selectedCountryIso === j.isoCode;
                  const isHovered = hoveredMapStateIso === j.isoCode;
                  const pinRadius = isSelected || isHovered ? 6.5 : 4.2;
                  const shouldBreathe =
                    showBreathingAnimation && isHighActivityTransition;
                  return (
                    <g
                      key={j.isoCode}
                      transform={`translate(${cx}, ${cy})`}
                      data-regulatory-block={regBlock}
                      className="cursor-pointer"
                      onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredMapStateIso(j.isoCode)}
                      onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredMapStateIso(null)}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedCountryIso(
                          isSelected ? null : j.isoCode
                        );
                        setSimulatedComplianceIso(j.isoCode);
                      }}
                    >
                      {shouldBreathe && (
                        <circle
                          r={isSelected || isHovered ? 15 : 10.5}
                          fill="none"
                          stroke={heatColor}
                          strokeWidth={1.25}
                          strokeOpacity={0.65}
                          className="d3-breathing-transition-ring animate-d3-compliance-breathe pointer-events-none"
                        >
                          <animate
                            attributeName="r"
                            values={
                              isSelected || isHovered
                                ? "11;16.5;11"
                                : "7.5;12.2;7.5"
                            }
                            dur={isRapidStatusShift ? "1.6s" : "2.8s"}
                            repeatCount="indefinite"
                          />
                          <animate
                            attributeName="stroke-opacity"
                            values="0.72;0.18;0.72"
                            dur={isRapidStatusShift ? "1.6s" : "2.8s"}
                            repeatCount="indefinite"
                          />
                        </circle>
                      )}
                      <circle
                        r={isSelected || isHovered ? 12 : 7.5}
                        fill={heatColor}
                        fillOpacity={0.25}
                        style={{
                          animationDelay: `${staggerDelayMs}ms`,
                          transitionDelay: `${Math.min(320, staggerDelayMs)}ms`,
                        }}
                        className={`d3-inline-heatmap-halo ${
                          isRapidStatusShift
                            ? "animate-d3-pulsate-steady-fast"
                            : "animate-d3-pulsate-steady-standard"
                        } ${shouldBreathe ? "animate-d3-compliance-breathe" : ""}`}
                      />
                      <circle
                        r={pinRadius}
                        data-base-r={pinRadius}
                        data-regulatory-block={regBlock}
                        data-rapid-shift={isRapidStatusShift ? "true" : "false"}
                        data-stagger-delay={staggerDelayMs}
                        fill={heatColor}
                        stroke={isSelected || isHovered ? "#FFFFFF" : "#050811"}
                        strokeWidth={isSelected || isHovered ? 1.8 : 0.9}
                        style={{
                          animationDelay: `${staggerDelayMs}ms`,
                          transitionDelay: `${Math.min(320, staggerDelayMs)}ms`,
                        }}
                        className={`d3-inline-heatmap-pin ${
                          isRapidStatusShift
                            ? "animate-d3-pulsate-steady-fast"
                            : "animate-d3-pulsate-steady-standard"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <title>{`${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) [${regBlock}] — ${activeMetricLabel}: ${score}/100 (Velocity: ${velocityScore}, Risk Intensity: ${riskIntensityScore}) · Stagger: ${staggerDelayMs}ms · Easing: ${easingFunctionName}${
                          isHighActivityTransition
                            ? " · High-Activity Compliance Transition"
                            : ""
                        }`}</title>
                      </circle>
                      {(isSelected || isHovered || j.tier === "TIER_1") && (
                        <text
                          y={-8}
                          textAnchor="middle"
                          fill="#F8FAFC"
                          fontSize={8.5}
                          fontFamily="monospace"
                          fontWeight="bold"
                          className="transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out"
                        >
                          {j.isoCode} ({score})
                        </text>
                      )}
                    </g>
                  );
                })}
              </svg>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive D3 Global Heat Map for 193 UN Member State Compliance Adoption Velocity & Regulatory Risk Intensity */}
          <D3GlobalComplianceVelocityMap
            jurisdictions={jurisdictions}
            customActivationPcts={customActivationPcts}
            selectedContinent={selectedContinent}
            selectedRegulatoryBlocks={selectedRegulatoryBlocks}
            onToggleRegulatoryBlock={handleToggleRegulatoryBlock}
            onResetRegulatoryBlocks={handleResetAllRegulatoryBlocks}
            selectedCountryIso={selectedCountryIso}
            tierFilter={tierFilter}
            heatmapMetricMode={d3HeatmapMetricMode}
            onChangeHeatmapMetricMode={setD3HeatmapMetricMode}
            onSelectContinent={(continent) => {
              setSelectedContinent(continent);
              if (continent === "ALL") {
                setSelectedCountryIso(null);
              }
            }}
            onSelectCountry={(isoCode) => {
              setSelectedCountryIso(isoCode);
              if (isoCode) {
                setSimulatedComplianceIso(isoCode);
                if (!expandedIsos.includes(isoCode)) {
                  setExpandedIsos((prev) => [...prev, isoCode]);
                }
              }
            }}
            onUpdateNodeActivationPct={handleSetCustomNodeActivationPct}
            onExportJurisdictionSnapshot={handleExportJurisdictionSnapshotJson}
          />

          {/* Filter & Search Toolbar for All 193 Countries */}
          <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              {[
                { id: "ALL", label: `All UN States (${tierStats.total})` },
                { id: "TIER_1", label: `Tier 1 Hubs (${tierStats.tier1})` },
                { id: "TIER_2", label: `Tier 2 Hubs (${tierStats.tier2})` },
                { id: "TIER_3", label: `Tier 3 Global Ring (${tierStats.tier3})` },
              ].map((t) => (
                <button
                  key={t.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTierFilter(t.id as "ALL" | GlobalRegulatoryTier)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
                    tierFilter === t.id
                      ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 font-semibold"
                      : "bg-[#111622] text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {t.label}
                </button>
              ))}

              <select
                value={selectedContinent}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSelectedContinent(e.target.value as "ALL" | WorldContinentId);
                  setSelectedCountryIso(null);
                }}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#111622] border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono text-slate-200"
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Continents (193)</option>
                <option value="North America">North America</option>
                <option value="South America">South America</option>
                <option value="Europe">Europe</option>
                <option value="Middle East & Africa">Middle East & Africa</option>
                <option value="Asia">Asia</option>
                <option value="Oceania">Oceania</option>
              </select>

              <select
                value={statusBadgeFilter}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setStatusBadgeFilter(
                    e.target.value as
                      | "ALL"
                      | "Fully Compliant"
                      | "Pending KYC"
                      | "Restricted"
                  )
                }
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#111622] border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono text-slate-200"
              >
                <option value="ALL">
                  All Statuses ({tierStats.total})
                </option>
                <option value="Fully Compliant">
                  Fully Compliant ({tierStats.fullyCompliantCount})
                </option>
                <option value="Pending KYC">
                  Pending KYC ({tierStats.pendingKycCount})
                </option>
                <option value="Restricted">
                  Restricted ({tierStats.restrictedCount})
                </option>
              </select>

              {selectedCountryIso && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCountryIso(null)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                >
                  Showing Country: {selectedCountryIso} (Click to Show All)
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <div className="relative w-full sm:w-60">
                <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={countrySearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setCountrySearch(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search 193 countries, regulator..."
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#111622] border border-slate-800 text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  setExpandedIsos(
                    expandedIsos.length > 0
                      ? []
                      : filteredJurisdictions.slice(0, 5).map((j) => j.isoCode)
                  )
                }
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
              >
                {expandedIsos.length > 0
                  ? `Collapse Snapshots (${expandedIsos.length})`
                  : "Expand Top 5 Snapshots"}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-testid="table-export-all-states-btn"
                onClick={handleExportAll193StatesJson}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-semibold bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Export All States</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleActivateAll193Nodes}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-semibold bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
              >
                Activate All 193 Nodes
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* High-Density 193 UN Member States Table with Automated KYC/Compliance Toggle & Expandable Regulatory Compliance Snapshot */}
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-800 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="max-h-[640px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-[#111622] border-b border-slate-800 text-slate-300 font-mono z-10">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Regulatory Compliance Snapshot</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">ISO / Numeric</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">UN Member State & Continent</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Compliance Status Badge</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Node Activation Progress</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">
                      Required Regulatory Docs (Highlighted on Check)
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                      Automated KYC/Compliance
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">
                      Geo-Fence / Node Action &amp; Export Snapshot
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 font-mono">
                  {filteredJurisdictions.map((j) => {
                    const isExpanded = expandedIsos.includes(j.isoCode);
                    const isRowSelected =
                      selectedCountryIso === j.isoCode ||
                      simulatedComplianceIso === j.isoCode ||
                      isExpanded;
                    const badgeLabel = getDynamicComplianceBadge(j);
                    const activationPct = getNodeActivationProgress(j);
                    const velocityTelemetry = getJurisdictionVelocityScore(j);

                    return (
                      <React.Fragment key={j.isoCode}>
                        <tr
                          data-testid={`country-table-row-${j.isoCode}`}
                          onClick={() => {
                            toggleExpandRow(j.isoCode);
                            setSimulatedComplianceIso(j.isoCode);
                            setSlideOutDrawerIso(j.isoCode);
                          }}
                          className={`transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                            isRowSelected || slideOutDrawerIso === j.isoCode
                              ? "bg-amber-500/15"
                              : "hover:bg-slate-900/70"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <td
                            className="py-2.5 px-3 text-slate-300 tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap"
                            data-testid={`regulatory-compliance-snapshot-row-${j.isoCode}`}
                          >
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  aria-expanded={isExpanded}
                                  aria-label={`${
                                    isExpanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand"
                                  } Regulatory Compliance Snapshot for ${j.countryName}`}
                                  onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    toggleExpandRow(j.isoCode);
                                    setSimulatedComplianceIso(j.isoCode);
                                  }}
                                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
                                    isExpanded
                                      ? "bg-amber-500 text-slate-950"
                                      : "bg-[#111622] text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800"
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  <span>{isExpanded ? "▼" : "▶"}</span>
                                  <span>#{j.index} Snapshot</span>
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  data-testid={`export-snapshot-btn-${j.isoCode}`}
                                  title={`Export Regulatory Compliance Snapshot JSON for ${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode})`}
                                  aria-label={`Export Snapshot for ${j.countryName}`}
                                  onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    handleExportJurisdictionSnapshotJson(j);
                                  }}
                                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 transition cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  <Download className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>Export Snapshot</span>
                                </button>
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span>
                                  {j.isoCode} · {badgeLabel} ({activationPct}%)
                                </span>
                                {exportedSnapshotIso === j.isoCode && (
                                  <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                                    ✓ JSON Saved
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-bold text-amber-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                            {j.isoCode}{" "}
                            <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal text-[10px]">
                              (#{j.isoNumericCode})
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-sans font-medium text-white">
                            <div>
                              {j.countryName}
                              <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] ml-1.5">
                                · {j.continent} ({j.tier})
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate max-w-xs">
                              {j.primaryRegulator} · {j.regulatoryFramework}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">

                              <span

                                <span
                                  className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full shrink-0"
                                  style={{
                                    backgroundColor: velocityTelemetry.heatColor,
                                    boxShadow: `0 0 6px ${velocityTelemetry.heatColor}`,

                                <span>
                                  D3 Heat: {velocityTelemetry.score.toFixed(1)}/100
                                </span>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 min-w-[165px]">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] mb-1 tabular-nums">

                                className={
                                  activationPct === 100
                                    ? "text-emerald-400 font-bold"
                                    : activationPct >= 50
                                    ? "text-amber-300 font-bold"

                                    : activationPct >= 50
                                    ? "bg-amber-400"

                                      : "bg-slate-800/90 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700"
