                                >
                                  {doc}
                                </span>
                              ))}

                          </td>
                          <td

                                    : "bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-700"
                                }`}
                              >
                                <span
                                  className={`w-6 h-3.5 rounded-full relative transition-colors inline-flex items-center p-0.5 ${
                                    j.autoKycEnabled ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-slate-600"

                                >
                                  <span

                                    : "bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-300 border border-amber-700/60 hover:bg-amber-900"

                              >
                                <Download className="w-3 h-3" />
                                <span>Export Snapshot</span>
                              </button>

                        </tr>

                        {/* Expandable Regulatory Compliance Snapshot Drawer */}
                        {isExpanded && (
                          <tr className="bg-[#0B0F1A] border-b border-slate-800">

                              <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-[#101624] p-4 space-y-4">
                                <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                                    <div>
                                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-amber-400">

                                      </div>
                                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mt-0.5">
                                        {j.countryName} — {j.primaryRegulator} ({j.regulatoryFramework})

                                    </div>
                                    <span
                                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold ${
                                        badgeLabel === "Fully Compliant"
                                          ? "bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-600/80"
                                          : badgeLabel === "Pending KYC"
                                          ? "bg-amber-950 text-amber-300 border border-amber-600/80"
                                          : "bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-600/80"
                                      }`}
                                    >
                                      {badgeLabel === "Fully Compliant"
                                        ? "● Fully Compliant"
                                        : badgeLabel === "Pending KYC"
                                        ? "◐ Pending KYC"
                                        : "✕ Restricted"}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>

                                  {/* Quick Status Mode Switcher */}
                                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[11px]">
                                    <span className="text-slate-400 mr-1">

                                    </span>

                                      [
                                        "Fully Compliant",
                                        "Pending KYC",
                                        "Restricted",
                                      ] as const
                                    ).map((mode) => (
                                      <button
                                        key={mode}
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() =>
                                          handleSetJurisdictionBadgeMode(j.isoCode, mode)
                                        }
                                        className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded cursor-pointer transition ${
                                          badgeLabel === mode
                                            ? mode === "Fully Compliant"
                                              ? "bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 font-bold"
                                              : mode === "Pending KYC"
                                              ? "bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-bold"
                                              : "bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold"
                                            : "bg-[#0A0D14] text-slate-300 border border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800"
                                        }`}
                                      >
                                        {mode}
                                      </button>
                                    ))}
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      aria-label={`Export Snapshot for ${j.countryName}`}
                                      onClick={() =>
                                        handleExportJurisdictionSnapshotJson(j)
                                      }
                                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold cursor-pointer transition ml-1"
                                    >
                                      <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                      <span>Export Snapshot</span>
                                    </button>
                                    {exportedSnapshotIso === j.isoCode && (
                                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-700/70 text-[10px] font-mono">
                                        ✓ JSON Downloaded
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>

                                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-xs">
                                  {/* Col 1: Statutory Mandate, Localized SEC Status & D3 30-Day Regulatory Risk Sparkline */}
                                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0D14] border border-slate-800 space-y-2.5">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                                        01. Statutory Mandate &amp; D3 30d Risk Sparkline
                                      </span>
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => setSlideOutDrawerIso(j.isoCode)}
                                        className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 font-mono text-[10px] cursor-pointer"
                                      >
                                        Open Deep-Dive Drawer →
                                      </button>
                                    </div>
                                    <p className="text-slate-200 leading-relaxed">
                                      {j.onboardingComplianceRule}
                                    </p>
                                    <div className="pt-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-cyan-300">
                                      Settlement Rail: {j.fiatOrCbdcBridge}
                                    </div>

                                    {/* Inline D3 30-Day Regulatory Risk Intensity Sparkline */}
                                    {(() => {
                                      const spark = buildJurisdiction30DayRiskSparkline(j);
                                      return (
                                        <div
                                          className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#070A10] border border-slate-800/90 space-y-1.5"
                                          data-testid={`d3-row-risk-sparkline-${j.isoCode}`}
                                        >
                                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-[10px]">
                                            <span className="text-rose-300 font-semibold">
                                              D3 30-Day Regulatory Risk Intensity Trend
                                            </span>
                                            <span
                                              className={`font-bold tabular-nums ${
                                                spark.thirtyDayRiskDelta <= 0
                                                  ? "text-emerald-400"
                                                  : "text-rose-400"
                                              }`}
                                            >
                                              {spark.d30StartRisk} → {spark.currentRisk} (
                                              {spark.thirtyDayRiskDelta > 0
                                                ? `+${spark.thirtyDayRiskDelta}`
                                                : spark.thirtyDayRiskDelta}{" "}
                                              / 30d)
                                            </span>
                                          </div>
                                          <svg
                                            viewBox={`0 0 ${spark.width} ${spark.height}`}
                                            className="w-full h-16 overflow-visible"
                                            role="img"
                                            aria-label={`D3 30-day regulatory risk intensity sparkline for ${j.countryName}`}
                                          >
                                            <defs>
                                              <linearGradient
                                                id={`risk-spark-grad-${j.isoCode}`}
                                                x1="0"
                                                y1="0"
                                                x2="0"
                                                y2="1"
                                              >
                                                <stop
                                                  offset="0%"
                                                  stopColor={spark.strokeColor}
                                                  stopOpacity={0.42}
                                                />
                                                <stop
                                                  offset="100%"
                                                  stopColor={spark.strokeColor}
                                                  stopOpacity={0.03}
                                                />
                                              </linearGradient>
                                            </defs>
                                            <line
                                              x1={10}
                                              x2={spark.width - 10}
                                              y1={spark.thresholdY}
                                              y2={spark.thresholdY}
                                              stroke="#475569"
                                              strokeDasharray="3 3"
                                              strokeWidth={0.8}
                                            />
                                            <path
                                              d={spark.sparklineAreaD}
                                              fill={`url(#risk-spark-grad-${j.isoCode})`}
                                            />
                                            <path
                                              d={spark.sparklinePathD}
                                              fill="none"
                                              stroke={spark.strokeColor}
                                              strokeWidth={2}
                                            />
                                            {spark.points
                                              .filter(
                                                (pt) =>
                                                  pt.idx === 0 ||
                                                  pt.idx === 14 ||
                                                  pt.idx === 29
                                              )
                                              .map((pt) => (
                                                <circle
                                                  key={pt.idx}
                                                  cx={pt.x}
                                                  cy={pt.y}
                                                  r={pt.idx === 29 ? 3.5 : 2.5}
                                                  fill={pt.color}
                                                  stroke="#070A10"
                                                  strokeWidth={1}
                                                >
                                                  <title>{`${pt.dayLabel}: Risk Intensity ${pt.riskScore}/100`}</title>
                                                </circle>
                                              ))}
                                          </svg>
                                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-[9px] text-slate-400 tabular-nums">
                                            <span>D-29 ({spark.d30StartRisk})</span>
                                            <span>30d Range: {spark.minRisk}–{spark.maxRisk}</span>
                                            <span className="text-white font-semibold">
                                              Today ({spark.currentRisk}/100)
                                            </span>
                                          </div>
                                        </div>
                                      );
                                    })()}
                                  </div>

                                  {/* Col 2: Node Activation Progress & Enclave Telemetry */}
                                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0D14] border border-slate-800 space-y-2 font-mono text-[11px]">

                                      <span>02. Node Activation Progress</span>
                                      <span className="tabular-nums">{activationPct}% Activated</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="w-full h-2.5 rounded-full bg-slate-800 overflow-hidden">
                                      <div
                                        className={`h-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                                          activationPct === 100
                                            ? "bg-emerald-500"
                                            : activationPct >= 50
                                            ? "bg-amber-400"
                                            : "bg-rose-500"
                                        }`}
                                        style={{ width: `${activationPct}%` }}
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="pt-0.5">
                                      <input
                                        type="range"
                                        min={0}
                                        max={100}
                                        value={activationPct}
                                        aria-label={`Adjust Node Activation Progress for ${j.countryName}`}
                                        onChange={(e) =>
                                          handleSetCustomNodeActivationPct(
                                            j.isoCode,
                                            Number(e.target.value)
                                          )
                                        }
                                        className="w-full accent-amber-500 cursor-pointer h-1.5"
                                      />
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 tabular-nums">
                                      <span>25% Restricted</span>
                                      <span>68% Pending KYC</span>
                                      <span>100% Compliant</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 pt-1 text-slate-300">
                                      <div>
                                        Node ID: <span className="text-white">{j.nodeId}</span>
                                      </div>
                                      <div>
                                        HSM: <span className="text-amber-300">{j.hsmKeySlot}</span>
                                      </div>
                                      <div>
                                        Uptime: <span className="text-emerald-400">{j.validatorUptime}</span>
                                      </div>
                                      <div>
                                        Block: <span className="text-cyan-300">#{j.syncedBlockHeight.toLocaleString()}</span>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">
                                      Enclave: {j.azureEnclaveZone}
                                    </div>
                                  </div>

                                  {/* Col 3: Required Regulatory Documentation & JSON Snapshot Export */}
                                  <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0D14] border border-slate-800 space-y-2.5">
                                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-cyan-300 font-semibold">
                                        03. Required Filings & JSON Export
                                      </span>
                                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                        TWE_Regulatory_Compliance_Snapshot_{j.isoCode}.json
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 font-mono text-[11px]">
                                      {j.requiredRegulatoryDocs.map((doc) => (
                                        <span
                                          key={doc}
                                          className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-200"
                                        >
                                          ✓ {doc}
                                        </span>
                                      ))}
                                    </div>
                                    <pre className="p-2 rounded bg-[#070A10] border border-slate-800 text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-300 overflow-x-auto max-h-24 leading-tight">
                                      {JSON.stringify(
                                        {
                                          isoCode: j.isoCode,
                                          countryName: j.countryName,
                                          statusBadge: badgeLabel,
                                          velocityScore: velocityTelemetry.score,
                                          autoKycEnabled: j.autoKycEnabled,
                                          nodeActivationPct: activationPct,
                                          regulator: j.primaryRegulator,
                                          requiredDocs: j.requiredRegulatoryDocs,
                                        },
                                        null,
                                        2
                                      )}
                                    </pre>
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1 font-mono text-[11px]">
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        aria-label={`Export Snapshot for ${j.countryName}`}
                                        onClick={() =>
                                          handleExportJurisdictionSnapshotJson(j)
                                        }
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 cursor-pointer font-semibold"
                                      >
                                        <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                        <span>Export Snapshot</span>
                                      </button>
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() =>
                                          handleCopy(
                                            JSON.stringify(
                                              {
                                                isoCode: j.isoCode,
                                                countryName: j.countryName,
                                                statusBadge: badgeLabel,
                                                velocityScore: velocityTelemetry.score,
                                                autoKycEnabled: j.autoKycEnabled,
                                                nodeActivationPct: activationPct,
                                                regulator: j.primaryRegulator,
                                                regulatoryFramework:
                                                  j.regulatoryFramework,
                                                requiredDocs:
                                                  j.requiredRegulatoryDocs,
                                              },
                                              null,
                                              2
                                            ),
                                            `snapshot_json_${j.isoCode}`,
                                            `${j.isoCode} Compliance Snapshot JSON`
                                          )
                                        }
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 cursor-pointer"
                                      >
                                        {copiedKey === `snapshot_json_${j.isoCode}` ? (
                                          <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                                        ) : (
                                          <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                                        )}
                                        <span>Copy JSON</span>
                                      </button>
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => {
                                          setSelectedCountryIso(j.isoCode);
                                          setSelectedContinent(j.continent);
                                          notify(
                                            `Focused ${j.countryName} (${j.isoCode}) on the Interactive D3 & Vector World Maps.`
                                          );
                                        }}
                                        className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 cursor-pointer"
                                      >
                                        Focus on Map
                                      </button>
                                      <button
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => {
                                          setCommoditySpec((prev) => ({
                                            ...prev,
                                            isoCountryCode: j.isoNumericCode,
                                          }));
                                          setActiveTab("qamm_bitmask_azure");
                                          notify(
                                            `Packed ${j.countryName} ISO-3166 #${j.isoNumericCode} into TWECommodityEncoder.sol [Bits 0–15].`
                                          );
                                        }}
                                        className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-cyan-500/20 hover:bg-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 cursor-pointer"
                                      >
                                        Pack ISO #{j.isoNumericCode} in uint256
                                      </button>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        )}
                      </React.Fragment>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Slide-Out Drawer for Clicked Country Row: D3 30-Day Regulatory Risk Intensity Sparkline, Deep-Dive Compliance History, Localized SEC Filing Status & Recent Adoption Metrics */}
          {slideOutDrawerIso &&
            (() => {
              const drawerState =
                jurisdictions.find((item) => item.isoCode === slideOutDrawerIso) ||
                jurisdictions[0];
              if (!drawerState) return null;
              const drawerBadge = getDynamicComplianceBadge(drawerState);
              const drawerActivationPct = getNodeActivationProgress(drawerState);
              const drawerTelemetry = getJurisdictionVelocityScore(drawerState);
              const drawerSparkline =
                buildJurisdiction30DayRiskSparkline(drawerState);

              return (
                <div
                  className="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0B0F19]/98 border-l border-slate-700/90 shadow-2xl overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-4 transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out"
                  role="dialog"
                  aria-label={`Deep-Dive Regulatory Compliance Slide-Out Drawer for ${drawerState.countryName}`}
                  data-testid={`country-slide-out-drawer-${drawerState.isoCode}`}
                >
                  {/* Drawer Header */}
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3.5">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap font-mono text-[10px]">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 font-bold">
                          UN STATE #{drawerState.index} · {drawerState.isoCode} (ISO-3166 #{drawerState.isoNumericCode})
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${
                            drawerBadge === "Fully Compliant"
                              ? "bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-600/70"
                              : drawerBadge === "Pending KYC"
                              ? "bg-amber-950 text-amber-300 border border-amber-600/70"
                              : "bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border border-rose-600/70"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {drawerBadge}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white mt-1">
                        {drawerState.countryName} — Deep-Dive Regulatory &amp; SEC Dossier
                      </h3>
                      <p className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
                        {drawerState.primaryRegulator} · {drawerState.regulatoryFramework}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"

/**
 * Native CRC-32 + Binary PKZIP Archive Builder for packaging all TWE Official Filings,
 * Patents, and Whitepapers into a single verifiable .zip download.
 */
function buildPkZipFromDocuments(files: { name: string; content: string }[]): Blob {
  const crcTable = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
    let c = n;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
    }
    crcTable[n] = c >>> 0;
  }

  const crc32 = (bytes: Uint8Array): number => {
    let c = 0xffffffff;
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
      c = crcTable[(c ^ bytes[i]) & 0xff] ^ (c >>> 8);
    }
    return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
  };

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const localParts: Uint8Array[] = [];
  const centralParts: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let offset = 0;

  for (const file of files) {
    const nameBytes = encoder.encode(file.name);
    const dataBytes = encoder.encode(file.content);
    const crc = crc32(dataBytes);

    // Local file header (30 bytes + filename)
    const localHeader = new Uint8Array(30 + nameBytes.length);
    const lv = new DataView(localHeader.buffer);
    lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true); // PK\x03\x04
    lv.setUint16(4, 20, true); // version needed
    lv.setUint16(6, 0, true); // flags
    lv.setUint16(8, 0, true); // compression (0 = store)
    lv.setUint16(10, 0, true); // mod time
    lv.setUint16(12, 0, true); // mod date
    lv.setUint32(14, crc, true);
    lv.setUint32(18, dataBytes.length, true);
    lv.setUint32(22, dataBytes.length, true);
    lv.setUint16(26, nameBytes.length, true);
    lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
    localHeader.set(nameBytes, 30);

    localParts.push(localHeader, dataBytes);

    // Central directory header (46 bytes + filename)
    const centralHeader = new Uint8Array(46 + nameBytes.length);
    const cv = new DataView(centralHeader.buffer);
    cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true); // PK\x01\x02
    cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
    cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
    cv.setUint16(8, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(12, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(14, 0, true);
    cv.setUint32(16, crc, true);
    cv.setUint32(20, dataBytes.length, true);
    cv.setUint32(24, dataBytes.length, true);
    cv.setUint16(28, nameBytes.length, true);
    cv.setUint16(30, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(32, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(34, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(36, 0, true);
    cv.setUint32(38, 0, true);
    cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
    centralHeader.set(nameBytes, 46);

    centralParts.push(centralHeader);
    offset += localHeader.length + dataBytes.length;
  }

  const centralSize = centralParts.reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0);
  const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
  const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
  ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true); // PK\x05\x06
  ev.setUint16(4, 0, true);
  ev.setUint16(6, 0, true);
  ev.setUint16(8, files.length, true);
  ev.setUint16(10, files.length, true);
  ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
  ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
  ev.setUint16(20, 0, true);

  return new Blob([...localParts, ...centralParts, eocd], { type: "application/zip" });
}

  onSelectContractAddress?: (address: string, tokenId: string) => void;
  onOpenBytecodeInspector?: (address: string) => void;
}

  onOpenBytecodeInspector,
}) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterZeroTier, setFilterZeroTier] = useState<"ALL" | "VANITY" | "EXTREME_10_PLUS" | "NULL">("ALL");
  const [activeActionModal, setActiveActionModal] = useState<Uint256ContractAddressEntry | null>(null);
  const [selectedSdkTab, setSelectedSdkTab] = useState<"ethers_v6" | "web3_py" | "viem" | "cast">("ethers_v6");
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Format dataset
  const formattedEntries = useMemo(() => {
    return UINT256_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_DATASET.map((raw, idx) =>
      formatUint256AddressEntry(raw, idx + 1)
    );
  }, []);

  // Filter entries
  const filteredEntries = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return formattedEntries.filter((entry) => {
      // Zero tier filter
      if (filterZeroTier === "VANITY" && entry.leadingZeros < 3) return false;
      if (filterZeroTier === "EXTREME_10_PLUS" && entry.leadingZeros < 10) return false;
      if (filterZeroTier === "NULL" && entry.contractAddress !== "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000") return false;

      // Text query
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        entry.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        entry.uint256TokenId.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        entry.hexTokenId.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        entry.tokenSymbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        entry.tokenName.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [formattedEntries, searchQuery, filterZeroTier]);

  const copyToClipboard = (text: string, key: string, label: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setStatusMsg(`Copied ${label} to clipboard!`);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedKey(null);
      setStatusMsg(null);
    }, 2500);
  };

      "contract_address",
      "token_id",
      "network_id",
      "leading_zeros",
      "hex_token_id",
      "suggested_symbol",
      "suggested_name",
    ];
    const rows = filteredEntries.map((e) =>
      [
        e.contractAddress,
        e.uint256TokenId,
        e.networkId,
        e.leadingZeros,
        e.hexTokenId,
        e.tokenSymbol,
        `"${e.tokenName}"`,
      ].join(",")
    );
    const csvContent = [headers.join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `UINT256_Contract_Addresses_Export_${Date.now()}.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

  onClose: () => void;

    return validateAllTokensUniversal(tokens);

    return certificate.records.filter((rec) => {
      if (filterType === "enterprise" && rec.idType !== "Enterprise CREATE2 Proxy") return false;
      if (filterType === "public" && rec.idType !== "Public Standard Token") return false;
      if (searchQuery) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        return (
          rec.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          rec.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          rec.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          rec.chain.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }
      return true;
    });

    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
  };

    const text = generateVerificationCertificateText(certificate);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedCert(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCert(false), 2000);
  };

    dl.setAttribute("download", `contract-verification-audit-${Date.now()}.json`);
    dl.click();
  };

          method: "wallet_watchAsset",
          params: {
            type: rec.standard === "ERC-721" ? "ERC721" : "ERC20",
            options: {
              address: rec.contractAddress,
              symbol: rec.symbol,
              decimals: 18,
            },

        if (wasAdded) {
          setMetaMaskNotification(`Successfully registered ${rec.symbol} to MetaMask!`);
        } else {

    }

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  Binary,
  ShieldAlert,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertTriangle,
  Terminal,
  Search,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Download,
  Flame,
  Zap,
  Lock,
  Cpu,
  Layers,
  Database,
  RefreshCw,
  ExternalLink,
  Sliders,
  FileCode,
  Info,
  Globe,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  analyzeUnverifiedBytecode,
  BytecodeAnalysisReport,
  BytecodeVulnerability,
  SAMPLE_BYTECODE_PRESETS,
  SampleBytecodePreset,
  cleanHexBytecode,
} from "../utils/unverifiedBytecodeInspectorEngine";
import { UINT256_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_DATASET } from "../data/uint256ContractAddressData";

interface Props {
  compiledBytecode?: string;
  compiledContractName?: string;
  onOpenCompilerTab?: () => void;
  initialContractAddress?: string;
}

export const UnverifiedBytecodeInspectorPanel: React.FC<Props> = ({
  compiledBytecode,
  compiledContractName,
  onOpenCompilerTab,
  initialContractAddress,
}) => {
  // Input State
  const [bytecodeInput, setBytecodeInput] = useState<string>(
    SAMPLE_BYTECODE_PRESETS[0].bytecode
  );
  const [selectedPresetId, setSelectedPresetId] = useState<string>("vuln_reentrancy_dao");
  const [selectedUint256Address, setSelectedUint256Address] = useState<string>(
    initialContractAddress || UINT256_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_DATASET[0].contractAddress
  );
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeInspectorView, setActiveInspectorView] = useState<"findings" | "disassembly" | "selectors" | "storage">("findings");

  // Opcode search filter
  const [opcodeSearch, setOpcodeSearch] = useState<string>("");
  const [onlyVulnerableOpcodes, setOnlyVulnerableOpcodes] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Copy state
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2500);
  };

  // Perform static analysis
  const analysisReport: BytecodeAnalysisReport = useMemo(() => {
    return analyzeUnverifiedBytecode(bytecodeInput);
  }, [bytecodeInput]);

  // Load preset
  const handleSelectPreset = (preset: SampleBytecodePreset) => {
    setSelectedPresetId(preset.id);
    setBytecodeInput(preset.bytecode);
  };

  // Load from compiled contract
  const handleLoadCompiledContract = () => {
    if (compiledBytecode) {
      setSelectedPresetId("compiled_current");
      setBytecodeInput(compiledBytecode);
    }
  };

  // Format hex input
  const handleFormatHex = () => {
    const cleaned = cleanHexBytecode(bytecodeInput);
    setBytecodeInput("0x" + cleaned);
  };

  // Filtered opcodes
  const filteredInstructions = useMemo(() => {
    return analysisReport.instructions.filter((instr) => {
      if (onlyVulnerableOpcodes && !instr.vulnerabilityTag) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!opcodeSearch.trim()) return true;
      const q = opcodeSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
      const pcHex = "0x" + instr.pc.toString(16).toLowerCase();
      const mnemonic = instr.mnemonic.toLowerCase();
      const pushData = (instr.pushData || "").toLowerCase();
      return mnemonic.includes(q) || pcHex.includes(q) || pushData.includes(q);
    });
  }, [analysisReport.instructions, opcodeSearch, onlyVulnerableOpcodes]);

  // Generate Markdown report for download
  const handleExportMarkdownReport = () => {
    const reportMd = `# EVM Unverified Bytecode Static Analysis Report
**Timestamp**: ${new Date().toISOString()}
**Bytecode Size**: ${analysisReport.rawBytecodeLength} bytes (${analysisReport.instructionCount} instructions)
**Overall Security Rating**: ${analysisReport.overallRiskGrade} (Risk Score: ${analysisReport.overallRiskScore}/100)

## Executive Summary
${analysisReport.summaryText}

## Storage & External Call Footprint
- SLOAD Count: ${analysisReport.storageStats.sloadCount}
- SSTORE Count: ${analysisReport.storageStats.sstoreCount}
- Transient Storage (EIP-1153): ${analysisReport.storageStats.hasTransientStorage ? `Active (${analysisReport.storageStats.tloadCount} TLOAD, ${analysisReport.storageStats.tstoreCount} TSTORE)` : "None"}
- External CALL: ${analysisReport.callStats.callCount}
- DELEGATECALL: ${analysisReport.callStats.delegatecallCount}
- SELFDESTRUCT: ${analysisReport.callStats.selfdestructCount}

## Identified Vulnerabilities (${analysisReport.vulnerabilities.length})
${analysisReport.vulnerabilities.map((v, i) => `
### ${i + 1}. [${v.severity}] ${v.title}
- **Category**: ${v.category.toUpperCase()}
- **Estimated CVSS**: ${v.cvssEstimate}
- **Affected PC Offsets**: ${v.affectedPcs.map(pc => "0x" + pc.toString(16)).join(", ")}
- **Description**: ${v.summary}
- **Exploit Scenario**:
${v.exploitScenario}
- **Recommended Remediation**:
${v.remediation}
`).join("\n")}

## Extracted Function Dispatcher Selectors (${analysisReport.extractedSelectors.length})
${analysisReport.extractedSelectors.map(s => `- \`${s.selectorHex}\` -> Jump PC: 0x${s.jumpDestPc.toString(16)} (${s.probableSignature || "Unmapped"})`).join("\n")}

---
*Generated by Unverified Bytecode Inspector - Token World Exchange & Solidity Studio*
`;

    const blob = new Blob([reportMd], { type: "text/markdown;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `EVM_Bytecode_Audit_Report_${Date.now()}.md`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const reentrancyVulns = analysisReport.vulnerabilities.filter((v) => v.category === "reentrancy");
  const selfdestructVulns = analysisReport.vulnerabilities.filter((v) => v.category === "selfdestruct");
  const delegatecallVulns = analysisReport.vulnerabilities.filter((v) => v.category === "delegatecall");

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-red-600/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-400">
                <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5" />
              </span>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                  Unverified Bytecode Inspector
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono font-normal px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30">
                    EVM Static Analysis Engine
                  </span>
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                  Analyze unverified raw EVM runtime bytecode to spot potential reentrancy (CALL → SSTORE), unprotected selfdestruct (0xFF), and arbitrary delegatecall (0xF4) vectors.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <button
              onClick={handleExportMarkdownReport}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1E1E24] hover:bg-[#25252D] text-gray-200 border border-[#2B2B33] text-xs font-mono transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />
              Export Audit Report
            </button>
            {compiledBytecode && (
              <button
                onClick={handleLoadCompiledContract}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/15 hover:bg-orange-500/25 text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/30 text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Load Compiled ({compiledContractName || "Contract"})
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Preset Selector Bar */}
        <div className="mt-5 pt-4 border-t border-[#23232A]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />
              1-Click Vulnerability Archetypes & Test Presets:
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-gray-500">
              Loaded: {cleanHexBytecode(bytecodeInput).length / 2} bytes
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
            {SAMPLE_BYTECODE_PRESETS.map((preset) => {
              const isSelected = selectedPresetId === preset.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={preset.id}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectPreset(preset)}
                  className={`text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between ${
                    isSelected
                      ? "bg-red-500/15 border-red-500/40 text-white shadow-sm"
                      : "bg-[#101014] border-[#222228] text-gray-400 hover:border-gray-600 hover:text-gray-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 mb-1">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-gray-200 truncate">
                      {preset.name.split(" ")[0]} {preset.name.split(" ")[1]}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono ${
                        preset.expectedRisk === "CRITICAL"
                          ? "bg-red-500/20 text-red-400"
                          : preset.expectedRisk === "HIGH"
                          ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400"
                          : "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {preset.expectedRisk}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 line-clamp-1">
                    {preset.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Quick UINT256 Smart Contract Address Direct Loader */}
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-[#1C1C24] flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono">
                <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Inspect 49 UINT256 Contract Addresses:
              </span>
              <select
                value={selectedUint256Address}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const addr = e.target.value;
                  setSelectedUint256Address(addr);
                  const entry = UINT256_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_DATASET.find(u => u.contractAddress === addr);
                  if (entry) {
                    // Generate mock/deterministic runtime bytecode snippet reflecting the contract's zero prefix
                    const isBurn = addr === "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
                    if (isBurn) {
                      setBytecodeInput("608060405234801561001057600080fd5b50600080fd");
                    } else {
                      // Load standard ERC-20 with leading zeroes reflected
                      setBytecodeInput(SAMPLE_BYTECODE_PRESETS[4].bytecode);
                    }
                    setSelectedPresetId(`uint256_${addr.slice(0, 8)}`);
                  }
                }}
                className="bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#2B2B33] text-gray-200 text-xs rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 max-w-xs truncate"
              >
                {UINT256_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_DATASET.map((u, i) => (
                  <option key={u.contractAddress} value={u.contractAddress}>
                    #{i + 1} {u.contractAddress.slice(0, 8)}...{u.contractAddress.slice(-4)} ({u.suggestedSymbol})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <a
                href={`https://etherscan.io/address/${selectedUint256Address}`}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noreferrer"
                className="text-xs text-orange-400 hover:text-orange-300 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono transition"
              >
                <span>Etherscan</span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
              </a>
              <span className="text-gray-600">•</span>
              <a
                href={`https://tokensniffer.com/token/eth/${selectedUint256Address}`}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noreferrer"
                className="text-xs text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono transition"
              >
                <span>TokenSniffer</span>
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Raw Bytecode Input Panel */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Terminal className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-200">
              Raw EVM Bytecode Input (Runtime / Deployed Code)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleFormatHex}
              className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#202026] text-gray-300 hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33] transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              Format 0x Hex
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleCopy(bytecodeInput, "bytecode_input")}
              className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#202026] text-gray-300 hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33] flex items-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              {copiedKey === "bytecode_input" ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
              Copy
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setBytecodeInput("")}
              className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#202026] text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/20 border border-[#2B2B33] transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="relative">
          <textarea
            rows={4}
            value={bytecodeInput}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSelectedPresetId("custom");
              setBytecodeInput(e.target.value);
            }}
            placeholder="Paste raw EVM bytecode (e.g. 0x608060405234801561001057600080fd5b50...)"
            className="w-full bg-[#0E0E12] border border-[#26262E] rounded-xl p-3.5 text-xs font-mono text-cyan-300 placeholder-gray-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500/60 resize-y break-all"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-400">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span>
              Hex Chars: <strong className="text-gray-200">{bytecodeInput.trim().replace(/^0x/i, "").length}</strong>
            </span>
            <span>
              Bytes: <strong className="text-gray-200">{analysisReport.rawBytecodeLength}</strong>
            </span>
            <span>
              Opcodes: <strong className="text-gray-200">{analysisReport.instructionCount}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 font-mono">
            Analyzed dynamically in real-time
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* High-Level Risk & KPI Dashboard */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        {/* Overall Risk Score */}
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between ${
          analysisReport.overallRiskGrade === "CRITICAL"
            ? "bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30 text-red-300"
            : analysisReport.overallRiskGrade === "HIGH"
            ? "bg-orange-500/10 border-orange-500/30 text-orange-300"
            : analysisReport.overallRiskGrade === "MEDIUM"
            ? "bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300"
            : "bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300"
        }`}>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium opacity-80">Risk Assessment</span>
          <div className="mt-1">
            <span className="text-lg font-bold font-mono tracking-tight block">
              {analysisReport.overallRiskGrade}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono opacity-80">
              Score: {analysisReport.overallRiskScore}/100
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Reentrancy Status */}
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between ${
          reentrancyVulns.length > 0
            ? "bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30 text-red-300"
            : "bg-[#16161A] border-[#222228] text-gray-300"
        }`}>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400">Reentrancy Risk</span>
          <div className="mt-1">
            <span className="text-lg font-bold font-mono">
              {reentrancyVulns.length > 0 ? "VULNERABLE" : "PROTECTED"}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] block font-mono text-gray-400">
              {reentrancyVulns.length} trigger pair{reentrancyVulns.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Selfdestruct Status */}
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between ${
          selfdestructVulns.length > 0
            ? "bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30 text-red-300"
            : "bg-[#16161A] border-[#222228] text-gray-300"
        }`}>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400">Selfdestruct (0xFF)</span>
          <div className="mt-1">
            <span className="text-lg font-bold font-mono">
              {analysisReport.callStats.selfdestructCount > 0 ? `${analysisReport.callStats.selfdestructCount} DETECTED` : "NONE"}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] block font-mono text-gray-400">
              {selfdestructVulns.some(v => v.severity === "CRITICAL") ? "Unprotected suicide" : selfdestructVulns.length > 0 ? "Gated execution" : "Clean"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Delegatecall Status */}
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between ${
          delegatecallVulns.length > 0
            ? "bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300"
            : "bg-[#16161A] border-[#222228] text-gray-300"
        }`}>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400">Delegatecall (0xF4)</span>
          <div className="mt-1">
            <span className="text-lg font-bold font-mono">
              {analysisReport.callStats.delegatecallCount > 0 ? `${analysisReport.callStats.delegatecallCount} DETECTED` : "NONE"}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] block font-mono text-gray-400">
              {delegatecallVulns.some(v => v.severity === "CRITICAL") ? "Arbitrary target" : delegatecallVulns.length > 0 ? "Proxy pattern" : "Clean"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Storage State Footprint */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border bg-[#16161A] border-[#222228] text-gray-300 flex flex-col justify-between">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400">Storage Footprint</span>
          <div className="mt-1">
            <span className="text-lg font-bold font-mono text-cyan-300">
              {analysisReport.storageStats.sstoreCount} SSTORE
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] block font-mono text-gray-400">
              {analysisReport.storageStats.sloadCount} SLOAD
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Transient Storage (EIP-1153) */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border bg-[#16161A] border-[#222228] text-gray-300 flex flex-col justify-between">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-400">EIP-1153 Transient</span>
          <div className="mt-1">
            <span className={`text-lg font-bold font-mono ${analysisReport.storageStats.hasTransientStorage ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-gray-500"}`}>
              {analysisReport.storageStats.hasTransientStorage ? "ACTIVE" : "INACTIVE"}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] block font-mono text-gray-400">
              {analysisReport.storageStats.tstoreCount} TSTORE / {analysisReport.storageStats.tloadCount} TLOAD
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Summary Banner */}
      <div className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-xs leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-3 ${
        analysisReport.overallRiskGrade === "CRITICAL"
          ? "bg-red-950/20 border-red-500/30 text-red-200"
          : analysisReport.overallRiskGrade === "HIGH"
          ? "bg-orange-950/20 border-orange-500/30 text-orange-200"
          : analysisReport.overallRiskGrade === "MEDIUM"
          ? "bg-amber-950/20 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-200"
          : "bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200"
      }`}>
        <Info className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <span className="font-semibold block">Static Analysis Assessment Summary:</span>
          <p className="text-gray-300">{analysisReport.summaryText}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sub-view Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-[#222228] pb-2 overflow-x-auto">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveInspectorView("findings")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition cursor-pointer ${
            activeInspectorView === "findings"
              ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20"
              : "bg-[#1E1E24] text-gray-300 hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33]"
          }`}
        >
          <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Security Findings ({analysisReport.vulnerabilities.length})
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveInspectorView("disassembly")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition cursor-pointer ${
            activeInspectorView === "disassembly"
              ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20"
              : "bg-[#1E1E24] text-gray-300 hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33]"
          }`}
        >
          <Terminal className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Opcode Disassembler ({analysisReport.instructionCount})
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveInspectorView("selectors")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition cursor-pointer ${
            activeInspectorView === "selectors"
              ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20"
              : "bg-[#1E1E24] text-gray-300 hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33]"
          }`}
        >
          <FileCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Function Selectors ({analysisReport.extractedSelectors.length})
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveInspectorView("storage")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition cursor-pointer ${
            activeInspectorView === "storage"
              ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20"
              : "bg-[#1E1E24] text-gray-300 hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33]"
          }`}
        >
          <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Storage & Call Graph
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* VIEW 1: SECURITY FINDINGS & EXPLOIT WALKTHROUGHS */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {activeInspectorView === "findings" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {analysisReport.vulnerabilities.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-2xl p-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-12 h-12 text-emerald-400 mx-auto" />
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white">No Vulnerabilities Identified</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 max-w-lg mx-auto">
                Static heuristic analysis verified that this bytecode contains no raw CALL-before-SSTORE reentrancy sequences, no unauthenticated SELFDESTRUCT opcodes, and no calldata-controlled DELEGATECALL targets.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            analysisReport.vulnerabilities.map((vuln) => (
              <div
                key={vuln.id}
                className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#23232A] rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4 transition hover:border-[#33333E]"
              >
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-[#23232A] pb-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold ${
                        vuln.severity === "CRITICAL"
                          ? "bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30"
                          : vuln.severity === "HIGH"
                          ? "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30"
                          : vuln.severity === "MEDIUM"
                          ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30"
                          : "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {vuln.severity}
                    </span>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{vuln.title}</h4>
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-gray-400">
                        Category: {vuln.category.toUpperCase()} | CVSS Estimate: {vuln.cvssEstimate}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-gray-400">
                      Affected PCs:
                    </span>
                    {vuln.affectedPcs.map((pc) => (
                      <span
                        key={pc}
                        className="text-xs font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#202028] text-cyan-300 border border-[#2E2E38]"
                      >
                        0x{pc.toString(16)} ({pc})
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Summary */}
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 leading-relaxed">
                  {vuln.summary}
                </p>

                {/* Offending Disassembly Snippet */}
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Terminal className="w-3 h-3 text-orange-400" />
                    Offending EVM Instruction Sequence:
                  </span>
                  <div className="bg-[#0B0B0E] border border-[#23232A] rounded-xl p-3 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto space-y-1">
                    {vuln.disassemblySnippet.map((instr) => {
                      const isAffected = vuln.affectedPcs.includes(instr.pc);
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={instr.pc}
                          className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-2 py-1 rounded transition ${
                            isAffected
                              ? "bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 font-semibold border-l-2 border-red-500"
                              : "text-gray-400 hover:bg-[#15151B]"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="text-gray-600 w-16 select-none">
                            0x{instr.pc.toString(16).padStart(4, "0")}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-cyan-400 w-10 font-bold select-none">
                            0x{instr.opcode.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}
                          </span>
                          <span className={`w-32 ${isAffected ? "text-red-400 font-bold" : "text-gray-200"}`}>
                            {instr.mnemonic}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-amber-300 flex-1 truncate">
                            {instr.pushData || ""}
                          </span>
                          {instr.vulnerabilityTag && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-950/60 text-red-400 border border-red-800/40 font-mono">
                              {instr.vulnerabilityTag}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>

  onTokensUpdated,
}) => {
  const [saverState, setSaverState] = useState<ContinuousSaverState>(continuousVaultSaver.getState());
  const [powerMode, setPowerMode] = useState<"standard" | "quadrillion" | "septillion" | "octillion">("octillion");

  const [quantumTelemetry, setQuantumTelemetry] = useState<QuantumVaultTelemetry>(getQuantumVaultTelemetry());
  const [isExpanding, setIsExpanding] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [expansionCount, setExpansionCount] = useState<number>(1000);

  // Subscribe to continuous saver updates
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = continuousVaultSaver.subscribe((state) => {
      setSaverState(state);
      if (state.promptText) {
        setPromptInput(state.promptText);
      }
      setQuantumTelemetry(getQuantumVaultTelemetry());
    });
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  const handleToggleContinuousSaving = () => {
    continuousVaultSaver.toggle(promptInput);
    const nextState = continuousVaultSaver.getState();
    setFeedbackNotice(
      nextState.isActive
        ? "Continuous Vault Saving: ACTIVE (Secured across tab exit and reload)"
        : "Continuous Vault Saving: PAUSED"
    );
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handlePromptChange = (val: string) => {
    setPromptInput(val);
    continuousVaultSaver.updatePrompt(val);
  };

  const handleMaximizeVaultMemory = () => {
    setBoostAnimation(true);
    setPowerMode("octillion");
    setIsMaximized(true);
    
    // Scale capacity to Octillion Hyper Tier (1,000,000 tokens)
    const targetCapacity = 1000000;
    onMaxCapacityChange(targetCapacity);
    setVaultCapacityTier("octillion", targetCapacity);

    // If continuous saving is off, turn it on
    if (!saverState.isActive) {
      continuousVaultSaver.start(promptInput);
    }

    // Encrypt all working tokens in quantum memory with stack immunity
    saveWorkingTokensToQuantumVault(tokens).then(() => {
      setQuantumTelemetry(getQuantumVaultTelemetry());
    }).catch(() => {});

    setFeedbackNotice("⚡ VAULT MEMORY MAXIMIZED: 1 Octillion Hyper Tier Enclave Engaged! 1,000,000 Token Capacity & Zero Stack Size Overflow!");
    setTimeout(() => {
      setBoostAnimation(false);
      setTimeout(() => setFeedbackNotice(null), 4500);

    if (!saverState.isActive) {

    continuousVaultSaver.saveTokensToDurableStorage(tokens, maxCapacity);

    // 3. Encrypt into client-side quantum memory enclave (AES-GCM 256-bit with safe chunking)
    try {
      await saveWorkingTokensToQuantumVault(tokens);
      setQuantumTelemetry(getQuantumVaultTelemetry());
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not save to quantum memory:", e);
    }

    setFeedbackNotice(`✓ All ${tokens.length} working tokens automatically saved to vault & encrypted with AES-GCM (256-bit)!`);
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackNotice(null), 4000);
  };

    } else if (mode === "quadrillion") {
      target = 250000;
    } else if (mode === "septillion") {
      target = 500000;
    } else {
      target = 1000000;

    onMaxCapacityChange(target);
    setVaultCapacityTier(mode, target);
    setFeedbackNotice(`Preset Switched: ${mode.toUpperCase()} Tier (${target.toLocaleString()} Token Enclave Allocation)`);
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackNotice(null), 3000);

        tier: powerMode,

      if (onTokensUpdated) {

      setTimeout(() => setFeedbackNotice(null), 5500);
    }

    >

      <div className={`absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none transition-all duration-700 ${
        isMaximized

          : "bg-emerald-500/5 opacity-50"
      }`} />

      {/* Header & Status Indicator */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 relative z-10 border-b border-[#1F1F23] pb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${
            boostAnimation ? "scale-110 rotate-12" : ""
          } ${
            isMaximized
              ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-[#F27D26] to-amber-500 text-black shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(242,125,38,0.4)]"
              : "bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] text-[#8E9299]"
          }`}>
            <Zap className="w-6 h-6 fill-current" />
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2">
                ACTIVE VAULT MEMORY COCKPIT
              </h3>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500/20 to-amber-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-orange-400 animate-ping" />
                {powerMode === "octillion" ? "1 Octillion Hyper Tier (1M Max)" : powerMode === "septillion" ? "500 Septillion Max Power Tier" : `${powerMode.toUpperCase()} Tier`}
              </span>
              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono border ${
                saverState.isActive
                  ? "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30"

                Auto-Save: {saverState.isActive ? "ACTIVE" : "PAUSED"}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { 
  Database, 
  Sparkles,

  X,

  ShieldCheck,
  Minimize2,
  Maximize2
} from "lucide-react";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";

export interface VaultSavePromptState {
  isOpen: boolean;
  tokenCount: number;
  tokenSample?: TokenRecord;
  source: string;
  timestamp: string;
  associatedPrompt?: string;
  savedPromptId?: string;
}

interface VaultSavePromptBannerProps {
  promptState: VaultSavePromptState | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onContinueSaving: () => void;
  isContinuing?: boolean;
  constantLoopActive: boolean;
  onToggleConstantLoop: () => void;
  onViewVault: () => void;
  onSavePromptToVault?: (prompt: string) => Promise<void>;
  vaultTokensCount: number;
}

export const VaultSavePromptBanner: React.FC<VaultSavePromptBannerProps> = ({
  promptState,
  onClose,
  onContinueSaving,
  isContinuing = false,
  constantLoopActive,
  onToggleConstantLoop,
  onViewVault,
  onSavePromptToVault,
  vaultTokensCount,
}) => {
  const [isMinimized, setIsMinimized] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedPrompt, setCopiedPrompt] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [customPrompt, setCustomPrompt] = useState<string>("");
  const [isCustomizing, setIsCustomizing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [manualSaved, setManualSaved] = useState<boolean>(false);

  if (!promptState || !promptState.isOpen) {
    return null;
  }

  const promptText = customPrompt || promptState.associatedPrompt || "Synthesize high-entropy Web3 token contracts with vanity salt and institutional audit proofs.";

  const handleCopyPrompt = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(promptText);
    setCopiedPrompt(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedPrompt(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleSaveCustomPrompt = async () => {
    if (!promptText || !onSavePromptToVault) return;
    try {
      await onSavePromptToVault(promptText);
      setManualSaved(true);
      setTimeout(() => setManualSaved(false), 2500);
      setIsCustomizing(false);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not manually save prompt:", e);
    }
  };

  // Minimized floating pill view
  if (isMinimized) {
    return (
      <div 
        id="vault-save-prompt-minimized"
        className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex items-center gap-2.5 bg-[#0D0D11]/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#F27D26]/50 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(242,125,38,0.25)] rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-white animate-fadeIn"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-400 animate-ping" />
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-500 absolute" />
          <span className="text-[#F27D26] font-bold ml-1">Vault Sync:</span>
          <span className="text-gray-300">+{promptState.tokenCount} IDs Secured</span>
        </div>

        <div className="h-3.5 w-px bg-[#26262E]" />

        <button
          type="button"
          id="btn-vault-prompt-min-continue"
          onClick={onContinueSaving}
          disabled={isContinuing}
          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#F27D26] hover:bg-[#ff8e3c] text-black font-bold text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {isContinuing ? (
            <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Zap className="w-3 h-3" />
          )}
          <span>Continue Saving</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsMinimized(false)}
          title="Expand Details"
          className="p-1 hover:text-[#F27D26] text-gray-400 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          title="Dismiss Banner"
          className="p-1 hover:text-red-400 text-gray-400 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div 
      id="vault-save-prompt-dock"
      className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 md:left-auto md:right-6 md:max-w-2xl z-50 bg-[#0D0D11]/98 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#F27D26]/60 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8),0_0_24px_rgba(242,125,38,0.2)] rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 text-white animate-slideUp font-sans"
    >
      {/* Top Status Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#1F1F26]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#F27D26]/15 border border-[#F27D26]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#F27D26]">
            <Database className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-green-400 bg-green-500/10 border border-green-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-400 animate-pulse" />
                Live in Firestore Vault
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                {promptState.timestamp}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>Token Generated & Saved in Vault</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-normal text-[#F27D26]">
                (+{promptState.tokenCount} IDs • {promptState.source})

          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            id="btn-minimize-vault-prompt"
            onClick={() => setIsMinimized(true)}
            className="p-1 rounded text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A22] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Minimize"
          >
            <Minimize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            id="btn-close-vault-prompt"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded text-gray-400 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-[#1A1A22] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Dismiss Prompt"

            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

      {/* Center: Token Sample & Saved Prompt Information */}
      <div className="py-3 space-y-2.5">

              {promptState.tokenSample.contractAddress}

        )}

        {/* Prompt Saved in Vault Area */}
        <div className="bg-[#121216] p-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1F1F24] space-y-1.5">

            <span className="text-[#8E9299] flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Terminal className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
              <span>GENERATION PROMPT (SAVED IN VAULT):</span>

    setIsResolving(true);

        setResolutionFeedback(`Push error: ${res.error || "Unknown error"}`);

      setResolutionFeedback(`Error: ${e.message}`);
