```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import jsQR from "jsqr";
import QRCode from "qrcode";
import {
  X,
  Camera,
  ScanLine,
  Upload,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  RefreshCw,
  Copy,
  Check,
  QrCode,
  ShieldCheck,
  ExternalLink,
  Sparkles,
  Layers,
  ArrowRight,
  Bookmark,
} from "lucide-react";

export interface ScannedAddressResult {
  raw: string;
  address: string;
  network: "ethereum" | "solana";
  amount?: string;
  label: string;
  isValid: boolean;
}

interface WalletCameraScannerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAddressImported: (
    address: string,
    network: "ethereum" | "solana",
    label: string,
    setAsActive: boolean
  ) => void;
  onOpenQrGenerator?: () => void;
}

export const WalletCameraScannerModal: React.FC<WalletCameraScannerModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAddressImported,
  onOpenQrGenerator,
}) => {
  const [cameraActive, setCameraActive] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [scannedResult, setScannedResult] = useState<ScannedAddressResult | null>(null);
  const [customLabel, setCustomLabel] = useState<string>("");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isProcessingFile, setIsProcessingFile] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"camera" | "upload">("camera");

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Play audio chime upon successful scan
  const playScanBeep = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioCtx) return;
      const ctx = new AudioCtx();
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.type = "sine";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime); // A5 note
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1760, ctx.currentTime + 0.12); // chirp to A6
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
    } catch {
      // Audio autoplay policy may block in some browsers; ignore silently
    }
  }, []);

  // Parse scanned raw QR text into address, network, amount
  const parseScannedData = (text: string): ScannedAddressResult | null => {
    if (!text || typeof text !== "string") return null;
    const trimmed = text.trim();

    // 1. Ethereum EIP-681 or standard 0x address
    // ethereum:0x123...?value=0.5
    const ethUriMatch = trimmed.match(/^ethereum:(0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40})/i);
    const ethPlainMatch = trimmed.match(/(0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40})/i);

    if (ethUriMatch || ethPlainMatch) {
      const address = ethUriMatch ? ethUriMatch[1] : ethPlainMatch![1];
      let amount: string | undefined;

      // Extract amount if present in query string
      const urlParts = trimmed.split("?");
      if (urlParts.length > 1) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(urlParts[1]);
        if (params.get("value")) amount = params.get("value")!;
      }

      return {
        raw: trimmed,
        address,
        network: "ethereum",
        amount,
        label: `Scanned EVM (${address.slice(0, 6)}...${address.slice(-4)})`,
        isValid: /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/i.test(address),
      };
    }

    // 2. Solana Pay or Base58 public address (32 to 44 chars)
    // solana:9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM?amount=1.5
    const solUriMatch = trimmed.match(/^solana:([1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44})/i);
    const solPlainMatch = trimmed.match(/\b([1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44})\b/);

    if (solUriMatch || solPlainMatch) {
      const address = solUriMatch ? solUriMatch[1] : solPlainMatch![1];
      let amount: string | undefined;

      const urlParts = trimmed.split("?");
      if (urlParts.length > 1) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(urlParts[1]);
        if (params.get("amount")) amount = params.get("amount")!;
      }

      return {
        raw: trimmed,
        address,
        network: "solana",
        amount,
        label: `Scanned Solana (${address.slice(0, 4)}...${address.slice(-4)})`,
        isValid: /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$/.test(address),
      };
    }

    // If it's a general string but looks like a public key
    return {
      raw: trimmed,
      address: trimmed,
      network: trimmed.startsWith("0x") ? "ethereum" : "solana",
      label: "Custom Scanned Input",
      isValid: false,
    };
  };

  // Start Camera Stream
  const startCamera = useCallback(async () => {
    setCameraError(null);
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
        throw new Error("Camera API is not supported in this browser environment.");
      }

      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          facingMode: { ideal: "environment" },
          width: { ideal: 1280 },
          height: { ideal: 720 },
        },
        audio: false,
      });

      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.setAttribute("playsinline", "true");
        await videoRef.current.play();
        setCameraActive(true);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.warn("Camera access failed:", err);
      const msg =
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Camera permission denied or camera device not found.";
      setCameraError(
        msg.includes("Permission") || msg.includes("NotAllowedError")
          ? "Camera permission was denied. Please allow camera access or use Image Upload."
          : "No active camera found. You can upload an image of a QR code below or test presets."
      );
      setCameraActive(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Stop Camera Stream
  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (animationFrameRef.current) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
      animationFrameRef.current = null;
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    if (videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
    }
    setCameraActive(false);
  }, []);

  // Video Frame Scanning Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !cameraActive || scannedResult) return;

    let isScanning = true;

    const tick = () => {
      if (!isScanning) return;

      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;

      if (video && video.readyState === video.HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA && canvas) {
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
        if (ctx) {
          canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
          canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
          ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

          const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          const code = jsQR(imageData.data, imageData.width, imageData.height, {
            inversionAttempts: "dontInvert",
          });

          if (code && code.data) {
            const parsed = parseScannedData(code.data);
            if (parsed) {
              playScanBeep();
              setScannedResult(parsed);
              setCustomLabel(parsed.label);
              isScanning = false;
              return;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };

    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);

    return () => {
      isScanning = false;
      if (animationFrameRef.current) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [isOpen, cameraActive, scannedResult, playScanBeep]);

  useEffect(() => {

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = img.width;
        canvas.height = img.height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx) {
          setIsProcessingFile(false);
          return;
        }

        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, img.width, img.height);
        const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, img.width, img.height);
        const code = jsQR(imageData.data, imageData.width, imageData.height);

        if (code && code.data) {

          } else {

          }
        } else {
          setCameraError("No valid QR code pattern detected in the uploaded image.");
        }
        setIsProcessingFile(false);
      };
      img.src = event.target?.result as string;
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    e.target.value = "";
```

```tsx
          chain: safeInitialChain,
          networkId: 1,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          isVanity: false,
        };
      }
    }
    return generateFunctionalWalletKey(safeInitialChain);
  });

  const [showPrivateKey, setShowPrivateKey] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [qrCodeUrl, setQrCodeUrl] = useState<string>("");
  const [copiedField, setCopiedField] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSigningTest, setIsSigningTest] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [signTestResult, setSignTestResult] = useState<SignatureTestResult | null>(null);

  // Keystore V3 Export State
  const [keystorePassword, setKeystorePassword] = useState<string>("walletpass123");
  const [isExportingKeystore, setIsExportingKeystore] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [keystoreError, setKeystoreError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Validator State
  const [validateInput, setValidateInput] = useState<string>(
    initialPrivateKey || currentWallet.privateKey
  );
  const [validationResult, setValidationResult] = useState<KeyValidationResult>(() =>
    deriveWalletFromPrivateKey(initialPrivateKey || currentWallet.privateKey)
  );

  // Batch Generator State
  const [batchCount, setBatchCount] = useState<number>(25);
  const [batchChain, setBatchChain] = useState<ChainType>("ethereum");
  const [batchWallets, setBatchWallets] = useState<FunctionalWallet[]>([]);
  const [isGeneratingBatch, setIsGeneratingBatch] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Vanity Miner State
  const [vanityPrefix, setVanityPrefix] = useState<string>("000");
  const [isMining, setIsMining] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [miningAttempts, setMiningAttempts] = useState<number>(0);
  const [miningCurrentAddr, setMiningCurrentAddr] = useState<string>("");
  const [minedResult, setMinedResult] = useState<{ wallet: FunctionalWallet; attempts: number } | null>(
    null
  );

  // Generate QR Code whenever currentWallet changes
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    generateWalletQrCode(currentWallet.privateKey)
      .then((url) => {
        if (isMounted) setQrCodeUrl(url);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [currentWallet]);

  // Copy Helper
  const copyToClipboard = (text: string, fieldId: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedField(fieldId);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedField(null), 2500);
  };

  // Generate a fresh functional wallet key
  const handleGenerateFresh = () => {
    const fresh = generateFunctionalWalletKey(selectedChain);
    setCurrentWallet(fresh);
    setSignTestResult(null);
  };

  // Run in-browser EIP-191 signature test
  const handleRunSignatureTest = async () => {
    if (currentWallet.chain === "solana") return;
    setIsSigningTest(true);
    try {
      const res = await testWalletSignature(
        currentWallet.privateKey,
        `Web3 Token Studio Key Test • Address: ${currentWallet.address} • Nonce: ${Date.now()}`
      );
      setSignTestResult(res);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setIsSigningTest(false);
    }
  };

  // Export JSON Keystore v3
  const handleDownloadKeystore = async () => {
    if (!keystorePassword) {
      setKeystoreError("Please provide a decryption password");
      return;
    }
    setIsExportingKeystore(true);
    setKeystoreError(null);
    try {
      const jsonStr = await exportKeystoreJson(currentWallet.privateKey, keystorePassword);
      const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: "application/json" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `keystore-${currentWallet.address.slice(0, 10)}.json`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setKeystoreError(err.message || "Failed to encrypt keystore");
    } finally {
      setIsExportingKeystore(false);
    }
  };

  // Download .env file
  const handleDownloadEnv = () => {
    const content = `# Web3 Token Studio - Functional Wallet Credentials
# Address: ${currentWallet.address}
# Generated: ${currentWallet.createdAt}
# Target Chain: ${currentWallet.chain}

PRIVATE_KEY=${currentWallet.privateKey}
PUBLIC_ADDRESS=${currentWallet.address}
RPC_URL=${DEFAULT_RPC_URLS[currentWallet.chain] || "https://eth.llamarpc.com"}
${currentWallet.mnemonic ? `MNEMONIC_PHRASE="${currentWallet.mnemonic}"` : ""}
DERIVATION_PATH="${currentWallet.derivationPath}"
COMPRESSED_PUBLIC_KEY="${currentWallet.compressedPublicKey}"
`;
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: "text/plain" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `deployer-${currentWallet.address.slice(0, 8)}.env`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Run Batch Generation
  const handleRunBatch = () => {
    setIsGeneratingBatch(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const keys = generateBatchWalletKeys(batchCount, batchChain);
      setBatchWallets(keys);
      setIsGeneratingBatch(false);
    }, 150);
  };

  // Export Batch as CSV
  const handleExportBatchCSV = () => {
    if (batchWallets.length === 0) return;
    let csv = "Index,Address,PrivateKey,CompressedPublicKey,Mnemonic,DerivationPath,Chain\n";
    batchWallets.forEach((w, idx) => {
      csv += `${idx + 1},"${w.address}","${w.privateKey}","${w.compressedPublicKey}","${w.mnemonic || ""}","${w.derivationPath}","${w.chain}"\n`;
    });
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `batch-wallets-${batchWallets.length}-${batchChain}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Export Batch as JSON
  const handleExportBatchJSON = () => {
    if (batchWallets.length === 0) return;
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(batchWallets, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `batch-wallets-${batchWallets.length}-${batchChain}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Run Vanity Miner
  const handleStartMining = () => {
    setIsMining(true);
    setMinedResult(null);
    setMiningAttempts(0);

    setTimeout(() => {
      const res = mineVanityWalletKey(
        vanityPrefix,
        selectedChain,
        25000,
        (attempts, currentAddr) => {
          setMiningAttempts(attempts);
          setMiningCurrentAddr(currentAddr);
        }
      );
      if (res) {
        setMinedResult(res);
        setCurrentWallet(res.wallet);
      }
      setIsMining(false);
    }, 50);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-5xl bg-[#0F0F12] border border-[#1F1F24] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto max-h-[95vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Top Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-[#1F1F24] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#121217] to-[#0A0A0C]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500/20 to-yellow-600/20 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-400 shadow-inner">
              <Key className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  Private Key Wallet Studio &amp; Generator
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-green-500/15 text-green-300 border border-green-500/30 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> 100% Wallet Import Ready
                </span>
                {initialTokenName && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-[#8E9299]">
                    for <span className="text-white font-medium">{initialTokenName}</span>
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] mt-0.5">
                Cryptographically derived secp256k1 keys that derive the exact address when added to MetaMask, Rabby, Rainbow, Phantom, or Foundry.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#1E1E24] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Close"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation Bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 px-6 border-b border-[#1F1F24] bg-[#0A0A0C] overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("generator")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === "generator"
                ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/5 font-semibold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Key className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Instant Wallet Generator &amp; QR
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("validator")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === "validator"
                ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/5 font-semibold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Key Validator &amp; Deriver
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("batch")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === "batch"
                ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/5 font-semibold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            High-Volume Batch Generator
            {batchWallets.length > 0 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300">
                {batchWallets.length}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("vanity")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === "vanity"
                ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/5 font-semibold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <Cpu className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Working Vanity Key Miner
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("guides")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === "guides"
                ? "border-amber-400 text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/5 font-semibold"
                : "border-transparent text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Wallet Import Guides
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body Content */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-6">
          {/* TAB 1: INSTANT WALLET GENERATOR */}
          {activeTab === "generator" && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              {/* Chain Selection and Generate Button */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#23232A]">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Target Network:
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {(["ethereum", "base", "arbitrum", "polygon", "solana"] as ChainType[]).map(
                      (chain) => (
                        <button
                          key={chain}
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSelectedChain(chain);
                            const w = generateFunctionalWalletKey(chain);
                            setCurrentWallet(w);
                            setSignTestResult(null);
                          }}
                          className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium capitalize transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                            selectedChain === chain
                              ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 font-semibold"
                              : "bg-[#1E1E24] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white border border-transparent"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {chain}
                        </button>
                      )
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleGenerateFresh}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-yellow-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-yellow-500 text-black text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    Generate New Keypair
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Main Card: Private Key, Derived Address & Mobile QR Code */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                {/* Left 2 Cols: Key Details */}
                <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
                  {/* Derived Public Address */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#23232A] space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#8E9299] uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Derived Public Wallet Address (EOA)
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20">
                          EIP-55 Checksum
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => copyToClipboard(currentWallet.address, "address")}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 font-medium cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {copiedField === "address" ? (
                          <>
                            <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> Copied!
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy Address
                          </>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] font-mono text-sm text-white break-all flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span>{currentWallet.address}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-green-400/90 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      When you add the private key below to MetaMask or Rabby, your wallet will display this EXACT address.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Private Key with Mask/Unmask and Direct Wallet Import Actions */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-amber-500/30 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Private Key (Secp256k1 Scalar)
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/20">
                          32 Bytes • 256 Bits
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setShowPrivateKey(!showPrivateKey)}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#1E1E24] border border-[#2B2B33] cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          {showPrivateKey ? (
                            <>
                              <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Mask Key
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Reveal Key
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => copyToClipboard(currentWallet.privateKey, "privkey")}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold border border-amber-500/40 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          {copiedField === "privkey" ? (
                            <>
                              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> Copied!
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy for MetaMask
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] font-mono text-sm break-all">
                      {showPrivateKey ? (
                        <span className="text-amber-200">{currentWallet.privateKey}</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-[#8E9299] tracking-widest">
                          {currentWallet.privateKey.slice(0, 6)}••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••{currentWallet.privateKey.slice(-4)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Quick Format Copy Buttons */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">Copy Formats:</span>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => copyToClipboard(currentWallet.privateKey, "with0x")}
                        className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#1E1E24] text-white hover:text-amber-300 border border-[#2B2B33] cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {copiedField === "with0x" ? "✓ Copied" : "With 0x (MetaMask/Foundry)"}
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => copyToClipboard(currentWallet.rawPrivateKey, "rawHex")}
                        className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#1E1E24] text-white hover:text-amber-300 border border-[#2B2B33] cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {copiedField === "rawHex" ? "✓ Copied" : "Raw 64-Hex (Hardware/Cli)"}
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() =>
                          copyToClipboard(
                            `cast wallet import deployer --private-key ${currentWallet.privateKey}`,
                            "castCommand"
                          )
                        }
                        className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#1E1E24] text-white hover:text-amber-300 border border-[#2B2B33] cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {copiedField === "castCommand" ? "✓ Copied" : "Foundry Cast Command"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* BIP-39 Mnemonic Phrase (if available) */}
                  {currentWallet.mnemonic && (
                    <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#23232A] space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#8E9299] uppercase tracking-wider">
                          BIP-39 Mnemonic Recovery Seed (12 Words)
                        </span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => copyToClipboard(currentWallet.mnemonic || "", "mnemonic")}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          {copiedField === "mnemonic" ? (
                            <>
                              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> Copied!
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy Mnemonic
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                        {currentWallet.mnemonic.split(" ").map((word, idx) => (
                          <div
                            key={idx}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#1F1F24] text-xs font-mono"
                          >
                            <span className="text-[#8E9299] text-[10px]">{idx + 1}.</span>
                            <span className="text-white font-medium">{word}</span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] font-mono">
                        HD Derivation Path: {currentWallet.derivationPath}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* In-Browser Signature Test */}
                  {currentWallet.chain !== "solana" && (
                    <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#23232A] space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> Test In-Browser
                            ECDSA Signature
                          </span>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] mt-0.5">
                            Signs an EIP-191 personal message with this private key and verifies address recovery in real-time.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <button
                          onClick={handleRunSignatureTest}
                          disabled={isSigningTest}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-green-500/20 hover:bg-green-500/30 text-green-300 text-xs font-semibold border border-green-500/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                          <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          {isSigningTest ? "Signing..." : "Sign & Verify Test"}
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {signTestResult && (
                        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-green-500/10 border border-green-500/30 text-xs space-y-1.5">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-green-400 font-bold">
                            <span>✓ ECDSA Signature &amp; Recovered Address Validated</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono">{signTestResult.timestamp}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] break-all">
                            <span className="text-white">Signature (r, s, v):</span> {signTestResult.signature}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-green-300">
                            <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Recovered Signer:</span> {signTestResult.recoveredAddress} (Matches Wallet EOA)
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Right 1 Col: Mobile QR Code, Export & Keystore */}
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {/* QR Code Card for Mobile Wallet Scan */}
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141418] border border-[#23232A] flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                      <QrCode className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                      Mobile Wallet Import QR
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">
                      Scan with MetaMask Mobile, Rainbow, or Trust Wallet to import instantly.
                    </p>

                    <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md">
                      {qrCodeUrl ? (
                        <img
                          src={qrCodeUrl}
                          alt="Private Key QR Code"
                          className="w-44 h-44 object-contain"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-44 h-44 bg-gray-100 animate-pulse rounded-lg" />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                      Payload: 32-Byte Secp256k1 Key
                    </span>
                  </div>
```

```tsx
  // Volatility Alert System (triggers visual pulse effect on asset cards upon 2-sigma standard deviation spike)
  const [volatilityAlertEnabled, setVolatilityAlertEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [filterOnlyTwoSigmaSpikes, setFilterOnlyTwoSigmaSpikes] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Copy Feedback
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  // Modals
  const [isSendModalOpen, setIsSendModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isReceiveModalOpen, setIsReceiveModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [sendSelectedHolding, setSendSelectedHolding] = useState<PortfolioTokenHolding | null>(null);
  const [sendRecipient, setSendRecipient] = useState<string>("");
  const [sendAmount, setSendAmount] = useState<string>("");
  const [isSendingTx, setIsSendingTx] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [sendTxFeedback, setSendTxFeedback] = useState<{ success: boolean; msg: string; txHash?: string } | null>(null);

  // QR Code for Receive Modal
  const [receiveQrUrl, setReceiveQrUrl] = useState<string>("");

  // 30-Day Performance Breakdown Modal State
  const [is30DayModalOpen, setIs30DayModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [performanceModalHolding, setPerformanceModalHolding] = useState<PortfolioTokenHolding | null>(null);
  const [performanceModalToken, setPerformanceModalToken] = useState<TokenRecord | undefined>(undefined);

  const handleOpen30DayBreakdown = (h: PortfolioTokenHolding, t?: TokenRecord) => {
    setPerformanceModalHolding(h);
    setPerformanceModalToken(t);
    setIs30DayModalOpen(true);
  };

  // Custom Token Importer State
  const [importAddressInput, setImportAddressInput] = useState<string>("");
  const [importStatus, setImportStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [importedTokenPreview, setImportedTokenPreview] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isImporting, setIsImporting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Watch Asset Feedback
  const [watchingId, setWatchingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [watchFeedback, setWatchFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Load Portfolio Data
  const loadPortfolioData = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true);
    try {
      const data = await fetchWalletPortfolio(viewAddress, selectedChainKey, tokens);
      setHoldings(data.holdings);
      setSummary(data.summary);

      const txs = await fetchWalletTransactions(viewAddress, selectedChainKey);
      setTransactions(txs);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Failed to load portfolio:", e);
    } finally {
      setIsRefreshing(false);
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [viewAddress, selectedChainKey, tokens]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadPortfolioData();
  }, [loadPortfolioData]);

  // Generate QR Code when Receive Modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isReceiveModalOpen && viewAddress) {
      QRCode.toDataURL(viewAddress, {
        width: 220,
        margin: 1,
        color: { dark: "#06B6D4", light: "#0A0A0C" },
      })
        .then((url) => setReceiveQrUrl(url))
        .catch((err) => console.warn("QR generation error:", err));
    }
  }, [isReceiveModalOpen, viewAddress]);

  // Pre-calculate 7-Day D3 Volatility Metrics and 2-Sigma Spikes for all assets
  const holdingsVolatilityMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, TokenVolatilityMetrics>();
    for (const h of holdings) {
      const matchedToken = tokens.find(
        (t) =>
          t.contractAddress.toLowerCase() === h.contractAddress.toLowerCase() ||
          t.symbol.toLowerCase() === h.symbol.toLowerCase()
      );
      const metrics = computeTokenVolatilityMetrics(h, matchedToken);
      map.set(h.id, metrics);
    }
    return map;
  }, [holdings, tokens]);

  // Count active 2-sigma standard deviation spikes across all portfolio holdings
  const totalTwoSigmaSpikesCount = useMemo(() => {
    let count = 0;
    for (const metrics of holdingsVolatilityMap.values()) {
      if (metrics.hasTwoSigmaSpike) {
        count++;
      }
    }
    return count;
  }, [holdingsVolatilityMap]);

  // Filtered Holdings
  const filteredHoldings = useMemo(() => {
    return holdings.filter((h) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        searchQuery === "" ||
        h.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        h.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        h.contractAddress.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
      if (!matchesSearch) return false;

      if (filterOnlyTwoSigmaSpikes && volatilityAlertEnabled) {
        const metrics = holdingsVolatilityMap.get(h.id);
        return metrics?.hasTwoSigmaSpike ?? false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [holdings, searchQuery, filterOnlyTwoSigmaSpikes, volatilityAlertEnabled, holdingsVolatilityMap]);

  // Filtered Transactions
  const filteredTransactions = useMemo(() => {
    return transactions.filter((t) => {
      if (txFilter === "all") return true;
      return t.type === txFilter;
    });
  }, [transactions, txFilter]);

  // Handle Watch Asset in MetaMask
  const handleWatchToken = async (h: PortfolioTokenHolding) => {
    if (h.isNative) return;
    setWatchingId(h.id);
    const res = await addCustomTokenToMetaMask({
      address: h.contractAddress,
      symbol: h.symbol,
      decimals: h.decimals,
    });
    if (res.success) {
      setWatchFeedback(`Added ${h.symbol} to your MetaMask wallet!`);
    } else {
      setWatchFeedback(res.error || `Could not add ${h.symbol}`);
    }
    setWatchingId(null);
    setTimeout(() => setWatchFeedback(null), 3500);
  };

  // Handle Send Transaction Submit
  const handleSendSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSendTxFeedback(null);
    if (!sendRecipient || !sendRecipient.startsWith("0x") || sendRecipient.length !== 42) {
      setSendTxFeedback({ success: false, msg: "Invalid EVM recipient address (must start with 0x and be 42 characters)" });
      return;
    }
    if (!sendAmount || parseFloat(sendAmount) <= 0) {
      setSendTxFeedback({ success: false, msg: "Please enter a valid amount greater than 0" });
      return;
    }

    setIsSendingTx(true);
    try {
      const res = await sendMetaMaskTransaction(
        sendRecipient,
        sendAmount,
        sendSelectedHolding?.symbol || "ETH"
      );
      if (res.success && res.txHash) {
        setSendTxFeedback({
          success: true,
          msg: `Transaction broadcast successfully! Tx Hash: ${res.txHash.slice(0, 10)}...`,
          txHash: res.txHash,
        });
        setSendAmount("");
        // Reload balances
        setTimeout(() => {
          loadPortfolioData();
          refreshBalance();
        }, 1500);
      } else {
        setSendTxFeedback({
          success: false,
          msg: res.error || "Transaction was rejected or failed",
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSendTxFeedback({ success: false, msg: err?.message || "Failed to broadcast transaction" });
    } finally {
      setIsSendingTx(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle Import Custom Token
  const handleImportLookup = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setImportStatus(null);
    setImportedTokenPreview(null);
    const clean = importAddressInput.trim();

    if (!clean.startsWith("0x") || clean.length !== 42) {
      setImportStatus("Please enter a valid 42-character ERC-20 contract address starting with 0x");
      return;
    }

    setIsImporting(true);
    try {
      const result = await queryOnChainErc20Balance(clean, viewAddress);
      if (result) {
        setImportedTokenPreview({
          contractAddress: clean,
          balance: result.balance,
          decimals: result.decimals,
          symbol: "CUSTOM",
          name: "Imported Token",
        });
        setImportStatus(`Found on-chain token! Balance: ${result.balance.toLocaleString()} (Decimals: ${result.decimals})`);
      } else {
        setImportStatus("Queried contract. Ready to track or add to MetaMask wallet.");
        setImportedTokenPreview({
          contractAddress: clean,
          balance: 0,
          decimals: 18,
          symbol: "TOKEN",
          name: "Custom Token",
        });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setImportStatus("Could not query token info: " + (e?.message || "Unknown error"));
    } finally {
      setIsImporting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
      {/* Top Header Card */}
      <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-cyan-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-start lg:items-center justify-between gap-6 relative z-10">
          {/* Address & Meta */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-500/20 to-blue-500/20 border border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-400">
                <Wallet className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <h1 className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white tracking-tight">
                    Wallet Portfolio
                  </h1>
                  {isConnected ? (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                      MetaMask Synced
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">
                      Deployer View
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-0.5">
                  Real-world EVM token holdings, live valuations, and verified transaction ledger
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Address Row & Quick Selector */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs">
                <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Active Address:</span>
                <span className="text-white font-semibold">{viewAddress}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleCopy(viewAddress, "top-address")}
                  className="p-1 hover:text-cyan-400 text-[#8E9299] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Copy Full Address"
                >
                  {copiedKey === "top-address" ? (
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  ) : (
                    <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                </button>
                <a
                  href={getExplorerUrl(selectedChainKey, viewAddress, "address")}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="p-1 hover:text-cyan-400 text-[#8E9299] transition-colors"
                  title="View on Explorer"
                >
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </a>
              </div>

              {/* Toggle to Sovereign Foundry Deployer or Connected */}
              {isConnected && account && viewAddress.toLowerCase() !== account.toLowerCase() && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setViewAddress(account)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/10 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300 font-mono text-xs cursor-pointer transition-all"
                >
                  Switch to My MetaMask ({account.slice(0, 6)}...{account.slice(-4)})
                </button>
              )}

              {viewAddress.toLowerCase() !== FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER.toLowerCase() && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setViewAddress(FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white font-mono text-xs cursor-pointer transition-all"
                >
                  View Sovereign Deployer ({FOUNDRY_SOVEREIGN_DEPLOYER.slice(0, 6)}...)
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action CTAs */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            {/* Refresh */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                loadPortfolioData();
                refreshBalance();
              }}
              disabled={isRefreshing}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-white font-mono text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Refresh live on-chain balances"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400 ${isRefreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              <span>{isRefreshing ? "Syncing..." : "Refresh"}</span>
            </button>

            {/* Send */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSendSelectedHolding(holdings[0] || null);
                setIsSendModalOpen(true);
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-white font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
              <span>Send</span>
            </button>

            {/* Receive */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsReceiveModalOpen(true)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-white font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Receive</span>
            </button>

            {/* Swap & Sell (52 Exchanges) */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (onOpenGlobalSwapSell) {
                  onOpenGlobalSwapSell(undefined, "swap");
                }
              }}
              title="Universal Token Swap (Connected to Treasury: 0x70Ac9Bb89d5C3d4a47D5cd11B108Fea9ad4E94f0)"
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-600 via-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-500 hover:to-blue-500 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-md shadow-cyan-950/40 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              <ArrowDownUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              <span>Universal Swap (Treasury Synced)</span>
            </button>

            {/* Connect MetaMask if not connected */}
            {!isConnected && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={connect}
                disabled={isConnecting}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-amber-500 hover:from-amber-500 hover:to-amber-400 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-md shadow-amber-950/40 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              >
                <Radio className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{isConnecting ? "Connecting..." : "Connect MetaMask"}</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Watch Feedback Alert */}
      {watchFeedback && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-cyan-950/40 border border-cyan-500/40 rounded-xl text-cyan-300 font-mono text-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{watchFeedback}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Metrics Banner */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Net Worth */}
        <div
          onClick={() => setActiveTab("pnl")}
          className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] hover:border-cyan-500/40 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-all group"
          title="Click to view Real-Time Profit and Loss (PnL) Graph"
        >
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="group-hover:text-cyan-300 transition-colors">TOTAL NET WORTH</span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-400">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 font-semibold hidden sm:inline group-hover:underline">PnL Graph</span>
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold font-mono text-white mt-2">
            ${summary ? summary.totalValueUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : "0.00"}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2 font-mono text-xs">
            <span
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 font-semibold ${
                (summary?.change24hPercent || 0) >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"
              }`}
            >
              {(summary?.change24hPercent || 0) >= 0 ? (
                <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              ) : (
                <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
              {summary && summary.change24hPercent >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
              {summary?.change24hPercent.toFixed(2)}% (24h)
            </span>
            <span className="text-[#8E9299]">
              ({summary && summary.change24hUsd >= 0 ? "+$" : "-$"}
              {Math.abs(summary?.change24hUsd || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Native ETH Balance */}
        <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>NATIVE {summary?.nativeSymbol || "ETH"} BALANCE</span>
            <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold font-mono text-white mt-2">
            {summary ? summary.nativeBalance.toFixed(4) : "0.0000"} {summary?.nativeSymbol || "ETH"}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span>≈ ${( (summary?.nativeBalance || 0) * (REAL_WORLD_PRICES.ETH.price) ).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} USD</span>
            <span className="text-emerald-400">(@ ${REAL_WORLD_PRICES.ETH.price.toLocaleString()})</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Assets Held */}
        <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>ASSETS IN PORTFOLIO</span>
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold font-mono text-white mt-2">
            {holdings.length} Tokens
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span>Native + Real ERC-20 + Foundry</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Network & Gas */}
        <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>ACTIVE EVM NETWORK</span>
            <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-white mt-2 truncate">
            {METAMASK_CHAINS[selectedChainKey]?.chainName || "Ethereum Mainnet"}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400" />
            <span>Chain ID: {METAMASK_CHAINS[selectedChainKey]?.chainIdDec || 1}</span>
            <span className="text-cyan-400 font-medium">RPC Active</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Asset Distribution Bar */}
      {holdings.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-lg space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
            <span className="font-semibold text-white">Asset Allocation Breakdown</span>
            <span>{holdings.length} Position{holdings.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full h-3 rounded-full bg-[#141722] overflow-hidden flex">
            {holdings.map((h, i) => {
              if (h.portfolioPercent < 0.5) return null;
              return (
                <div
                  key={h.id}
                  style={{
                    width: `${h.portfolioPercent}%`,
                    backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4",
                  }}
                  className="h-full transition-all hover:opacity-80"
                  title={`${h.symbol}: ${h.portfolioPercent.toFixed(1)}% ($${h.valueUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })})`}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-1">
            {holdings.slice(0, 6).map((h) => (
              <div key={h.id} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-xs">
                <span
                  className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4" }}
                />
                <span className="text-white font-medium">{h.symbol}</span>
                <span className="text-[#8E9299]">{h.portfolioPercent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main Tab Controller & Chain Selector */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-[#1f2433] pb-3">
        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 sm:pb-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("pnl")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "pnl"
                ? "bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30 shadow-sm shadow-cyan-950/20"
                : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#141722]"
            }`}
          >
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Real-Time PnL Graph</span>
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("holdings")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "holdings"
                ? "bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30"
                : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#141722]"
            }`}
          >
            <Coins className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Token Holdings ({holdings.length})</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab("transactions")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === "transactions"
                ? "bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30"
                : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#141722]"
            }`}
          >
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Recent History ({transactions.length})</span>
          </button>

          <button

                ? "bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30"
                : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#141722]"

              const nextKey = e.target.value;
              setSelectedChainKey(nextKey);

                switchChain(nextKey as any);
              }

              <option key={key} value={key}>
                {cfg.chainName} ({cfg.nativeCurrency.symbol})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TAB 0: REAL-TIME PROFIT AND LOSS (PNL) GRAPH */}
      {activeTab === "pnl" && (
        <RealTimePnLGraph
          holdings={holdings}
          summary={summary}
          tokens={tokens}
          onOpenGlobalSwapSell={onOpenGlobalSwapSell}
        />

      {/* TAB 1: TOKEN HOLDINGS */}
      {activeTab === "holdings" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#8E9299] absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"

                }`}
                title={
                  volatilityAlertEnabled

                <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">

                    <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-3 w-3 rounded-full bg-rose-400 opacity-75"></span>

                      volatilityAlertEnabled

                {/* Visual toggle pill */}
                <div

                  <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm" />

              {volatilityAlertEnabled && totalTwoSigmaSpikesCount > 0 && (
                <button

                  className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-[11px] border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    filterOnlyTwoSigmaSpikes
                      ? "bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-200 border-rose-500 font-bold shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(244,63,94,0.3)]"
                      : "bg-[#141722] text-rose-300 hover:text-white border-rose-500/30"
                  }`}
                  title={filterOnlyTwoSigmaSpikes ? "Showing only 2σ spike tokens. Click to show all." : "Filter down to only tokens with 2-sigma spikes"}
                >
                  <Zap className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-400" />

                </button>

                <button

                      : "text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white"

              ) : (

                          ? "border-2 border-rose-500/85 ring-2 ring-rose-500/60 shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(244,63,94,0.45)] animate-[pulse_1.75s_cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1)_infinite]"
                          : "border border-[#1f2433] hover:border-cyan-500/40"

                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-600/15 via-rose-500/5 to-transparent pointer-events-none rounded-2xl animate-pulse z-0" />
                      ) : (
                        <div
                          className="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-36 h-36 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none opacity-10 group-hover:opacity-20 transition-opacity"
                          style={{ backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4" }}

                      {isSpikeAlertActive && (
                        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-950/90 via-rose-900/50 to-rose-950/90 border border-rose-500/60 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-rose-200 font-mono text-[11px] shadow-lg animate-pulse relative z-10">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold tracking-wide">
                            <span className="relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5">
                              <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-rose-400 opacity-75"></span>
                              <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-rose-500"></span>
                            </span>
                            <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400 fill-rose-500/40 animate-bounce" />
                            <span>2σ VOLATILITY SPIKE ALERT</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-100 font-bold border border-rose-500/50 text-[10px]">
                              {volatilityMetrics?.maxZScore}σ Shock
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-300/80 hidden sm:inline">
                              ({volatilityMetrics?.twoSigmaSpikeCount} spike{volatilityMetrics?.twoSigmaSpikeCount === 1 ? "" : "s"})
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Card Header: Identity & Price */}
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                            <div
                              className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm text-white shadow-lg"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4" }}
                            >
                              {h.symbol.slice(0, 3)}
                            </div>
                            {isSpikeAlertActive && (
                              <>
                                <div className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-rose-600 border-2 border-[#0e1017] animate-ping pointer-events-none" />
                                <div
                                  className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-rose-600 border-2 border-[#0e1017] flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-md"
                                  title={`2-Sigma Spike Alert: Peak ${volatilityMetrics?.maxZScore}σ`}
                                >
                                  <Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-white" />
                                </div>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                              <span className="font-bold text-white text-base tracking-tight">{h.symbol}</span>
                              {h.isNative && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30">
                                  Native
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {h.isFoundryToken && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30">
                                  Foundry
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                              <span className="truncate max-w-[120px]">{h.name}</span>
                              {!h.isNative && (
                                <>
                                  <span>•</span>
                                  <span>{h.contractAddress.slice(0, 4)}...{h.contractAddress.slice(-4)}</span>

                                    className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                    title="Copy contract address"
                                  >
                                    {copiedKey === `card-${h.id}` ? (
                                      <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                                    ) : (
                                      <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                                    )}
                                  </button>
                                </>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Price & 24h Change */}
                        <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
                          <div className="font-bold font-mono text-white text-sm">

                          </div>
                          <div
                            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-semibold ${
                              h.change24h >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {h.change24h >= 0 ? <TrendingUp className="w-3 h-3" /> : <TrendingDown className="w-3 h-3" />}
                            {h.change24h >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{h.change24h.toFixed(2)}%
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Position Value & Balance Summary */}
                      <div className="bg-[#141722]/80 border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between font-mono relative z-10">
                        <div>

                          <div className="text-lg font-bold text-white">
                            ${h.valueUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299] uppercase tracking-wider">Holding Balance</div>

                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* D3.JS 7-DAY PROFIT/LOSS SPARKLINE & VOLATILITY HEATMAP (STANDARD DEVIATION SPIKES) */}
                      <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-0.5 relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-[#8E9299]">
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-white font-medium">
                            <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />

                          </span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Flame className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-400" />

                            </span>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();

                              <span>30D View</span>
                              <Maximize2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Interactive D3 Sparkline Container with Click-to-Expand 30D Breakdown */}
                        <div
                          onClick={() => handleOpen30DayBreakdown(h, matchedToken)}
                          className="bg-[#141722]/60 border border-[#1f2433] hover:border-cyan-500/50 hover:bg-[#141722]/90 rounded-xl p-2 relative transition-all cursor-pointer group/sparkline shadow-sm"
                          title="Click sparkline to expand 30-day performance breakdown modal"
                        >
                          {/* Hover Prompt Ribbon */}
                          <div className="absolute top-1.5 left-2 z-20 opacity-0 group-hover/sparkline:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-950/90 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-cyan-500/40 shadow-lg">
                            <Maximize2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-cyan-400" />
                            <span>Click to Expand 30-Day Breakdown</span>
                          </div>

                          <D3TokenPnLSparkline
                            holding={h}
                            token={matchedToken}
                            height={66}
                            showBadge={true}
                            showTooltip={true}
                            showZeroBaseline={true}
                            showVolatilityHeatmap={true}
                            volatilityAlertEnabled={volatilityAlertEnabled}
                            pulseEffectActive={isSpikeAlertActive}
                            overlayMode={true}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Portfolio Allocation Progress Bar */}
                      <div className="space-y-1 font-mono text-xs relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-[#8E9299]">
                          <span>Portfolio Weight</span>
                          <span className="text-white font-semibold">{h.portfolioPercent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#141722] overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className="h-full rounded-full transition-all"
                            style={{
                              width: `${Math.min(h.portfolioPercent, 100)}%`,
                              backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4",
                            }}

                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Card Action CTAs */}
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-[#1f2433] flex items-center justify-between gap-2 relative z-10">

                              onOpenGlobalSwapSell(
                                {
                                  id: h.id,
                                  symbol: h.symbol,
                                  name: h.name,
                                  contractAddress: h.contractAddress,
                                  decimals: h.decimals,
                                  chain: h.chain,
                                  priceUsd: h.priceUsd,
                                },
                                "swap"
                              );
                            }}
                            className="flex-1 py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/10 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 font-mono text-xs font-semibold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                            title="Swap on 52 World Exchanges"
                          >
                            <ArrowDownUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>Swap / Trade</span>
                          </button>
                        )}

                        {!h.isNative && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleWatchToken(h)}
```
