```tsx
                          >
                            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSendSelectedHolding(h);
                            setIsSendModalOpen(true);
                          }}
                          className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          title="Send / Transfer token"
                        >
                          <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>

                        <a
                          href={h.explorerUrl}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors"
                          title="Inspect contract on Block Explorer"
                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* VIEW 2: HOLDINGS TABLE (WITH D3 7D SPARKLINE COLUMN) */}
          {holdingsLayoutMode === "table" && (
            <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left font-mono text-xs border-collapse">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-[#1f2433] bg-[#141722]/50 text-[#8E9299]">
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">ASSET</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">PRICE (USD)</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">24H CHANGE</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">7D PnL TREND (D3)</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">BALANCE</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">VALUE (USD)</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">PORTFOLIO %</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">ACTIONS</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#1f2433]">
                    {isLoading ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={8} className="py-8 text-center text-[#8E9299]">
                          <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-cyan-400" />

                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : filteredHoldings.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={8} className="py-8 text-center text-[#8E9299]">
                          No holdings found matching query.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredHoldings.map((h) => {
                        const matchedToken = tokens.find(
                          (t) =>
                            t.contractAddress.toLowerCase() === h.contractAddress.toLowerCase() ||
                            t.symbol.toLowerCase() === h.symbol.toLowerCase()
                        );
                        const volatilityMetrics = holdingsVolatilityMap.get(h.id);
                        const hasTwoSigma = volatilityMetrics?.hasTwoSigmaSpike ?? false;
                        const isSpikeAlertActive = volatilityAlertEnabled && hasTwoSigma;

                        return (
                          <tr
                            key={h.id}
                            className={`transition-colors ${
                              isSpikeAlertActive
                                ? "bg-rose-950/20 hover:bg-rose-950/30 border-l-2 border-l-rose-500"
                                : "hover:bg-[#141722]/40"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {/* Asset */}
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div className="relative">
                                  <div
                                    className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs text-white shadow-inner flex-shrink-0"
                                    style={{ backgroundColor: h.color || "#06B6D4" }}
                                  >
                                    {h.symbol.slice(0, 3)}
                                  </div>
                                  {isSpikeAlertActive && (
                                    <div className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-rose-600 border border-[#0e1017] flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-sm animate-ping" />
                                  )}
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                    <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm">{h.symbol}</span>
                                    {isSpikeAlertActive && (
                                      <span
                                        className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] bg-rose-500/25 text-rose-200 border border-rose-500/50 font-bold animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1"
                                        title={`2-Sigma Volatility Shock (${volatilityMetrics?.maxZScore}σ)`}
                                      >
                                        <Flame className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-rose-400" />
                                        <span>2σ Alert</span>
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                    {h.isNative && (
                                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30">
                                        Native
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                    {h.isFoundryToken && (
                                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30">
                                        Foundry
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="text-[11px] text-[#8E9299] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span>{h.name}</span>
                                    {!h.isNative && (
                                      <>
                                        <span>•</span>
                                        <span>{h.contractAddress.slice(0, 6)}...{h.contractAddress.slice(-4)}</span>
                                        <button
                                          type="button"
                                          onClick={() => handleCopy(h.contractAddress, h.id)}
                                          className="hover:text-white transition-colors"
                                          title="Copy contract address"
                                        >
                                          {copiedKey === h.id ? (
                                            <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                                          ) : (
                                            <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                                          )}
                                        </button>
                                      </>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            {/* Price */}
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-semibold text-white">
                              ${h.priceUsd >= 1 ? h.priceUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : h.priceUsd.toFixed(6)}
                            </td>

                            {/* 24h Change */}
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                              <span
                                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold ${
                                  h.change24h >= 0 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {h.change24h >= 0 ? "+" : ""}
                                {h.change24h.toFixed(2)}%
                              </span>
                            </td>

                            {/* 7D D3 PnL Sparkline Column */}
                            <td className="py-2 px-4">
                              <div
                                onClick={() => handleOpen30DayBreakdown(h, matchedToken)}
                                className="w-36 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
                                title="Click to view full 30-day performance breakdown"
                              >
                                <D3TokenPnLSparkline
                                  holding={h}
                                  token={matchedToken}
                                  height={40}
                                  showBadge={true}
                                  showTooltip={true}
                                  showVolatilityHeatmap={true}
                                  volatilityAlertEnabled={volatilityAlertEnabled}
                                  pulseEffectActive={isSpikeAlertActive}
                                />
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            {/* Balance */}
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                              <div className="text-white font-semibold">{h.balanceFormatted}</div>
                              <div className="text-[10px] text-[#8E9299]">{h.symbol}</div>
                            </td>

                            {/* Value USD */}
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                              <div className="text-white font-bold text-sm">
                                ${h.valueUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            {/* Portfolio % */}
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span className="text-[#8E9299] font-medium">{h.portfolioPercent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                                <div className="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#1f2433] overflow-hidden">
                                  <div
                                    className="h-full bg-cyan-400 rounded-full"
                                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(h.portfolioPercent, 100)}%` }}
                                  />
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </td>

                            {/* Actions */}
                            <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                                {/* Swap & Sell button */}
                                {onOpenGlobalSwapSell && (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      onOpenGlobalSwapSell(
                                        {
                                          id: h.id,
                                          symbol: h.symbol,
                                          name: h.name,
                                          contractAddress: h.contractAddress,
                                          decimals: h.decimals,
                                          chain: h.chain,
                                          priceUsd: h.priceUsd,
                                        },
                                        "swap"
                                      );
                                    }}
                                    className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cyan-500/10 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center gap-1"
                                    title="Swap or Sell on 52 World Exchanges"
                                  >
                                    <ArrowDownUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                                    <span>Swap</span>
                                  </button>
                                )}

                                {/* Watch in MetaMask */}
                                {!h.isNative && (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleWatchToken(h)}
                                    disabled={watchingId === h.id}
                                    className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                    title="Add / Watch token in MetaMask extension"
                                  >
                                    <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </button>
                                )}

                                {/* Send CTA */}
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setSendSelectedHolding(h);
                                    setIsSendModalOpen(true);
                                  }}
                                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  title="Send / Transfer token"
                                >
                                  <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </button>

                                {/* Explorer */}
                                <a
                                  href={h.explorerUrl}
                                  target="_blank"
                                  rel="noreferrer"
                                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors"
                                  title="Inspect on Block Explorer"
                                >
                                  <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </a>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: RECENT TRANSACTION HISTORY */}
      {activeTab === "transactions" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Sub Filters */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {(
              [
                { id: "all", label: "All Transactions" },
                { id: "receive", label: "Received" },
                { id: "send", label: "Sent" },
                { id: "swap", label: "Swaps" },
                { id: "deploy", label: "Contract Deploys" },
                { id: "approve", label: "Approvals" },
              ] as const
            ).map((f) => (
              <button
                key={f.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTxFilter(f.id)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                  txFilter === f.id
                    ? "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40"
                    : "bg-[#0e1017] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white border border-[#1f2433]"
                }`}
              >
                {f.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Transactions List */}
          <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
            <div className="divide-y divide-[#1f2433]">
              {filteredTransactions.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-12 text-center text-[#8E9299] font-mono text-xs">
                  No transactions found for filter "{txFilter}".
                </div>
              ) : (
                filteredTransactions.map((tx) => (
                  <div key={tx.hash} className="p-4 hover:bg-[#141722]/50 transition-colors flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 font-mono text-xs">
                    {/* Left Icon & Details */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div
                        className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 ${
                          tx.type === "receive"
                            ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20"
                            : tx.type === "send"
                            ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20"
                            : tx.type === "swap"
                            ? "bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/20"
                            : tx.type === "deploy"
                            ? "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/20"
                            : "bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {tx.type === "receive" && <ArrowDownLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
                        {tx.type === "send" && <ArrowUpRight className="w-4 h-4" />}
                        {tx.type === "swap" && <ArrowDownUp className="w-4 h-4" />}
                        {tx.type === "deploy" && <FileCode className="w-4 h-4" />}
                        {tx.type === "approve" && <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />}
                        {tx.type === "mint" && <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />}
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm capitalize">{tx.methodName || tx.type}</span>
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                            Confirmed
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[#8E9299] text-[11px] flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                          <span>{new Date(tx.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</span>
                          <span>•</span>
                          <span>Block #{tx.blockNumber.toLocaleString()}</span>
                          <span>•</span>
                          <span className="text-[#5d6373]">
                            {tx.type === "receive" ? "From: " : "To: "}
                            {(tx.type === "receive" ? tx.from : tx.to).slice(0, 6)}...{(tx.type === "receive" ? tx.from : tx.to).slice(-4)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right Value & Hash */}
                    <div className="flex md:flex-col items-center md:items-end justify-between md:justify-center gap-1">
                      <div
                        className={`text-sm font-bold ${
                          tx.type === "receive" ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-white"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {tx.type === "receive" ? "+" : "-"}
                        {tx.amountFormatted} {tx.tokenSymbol}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[#8E9299] text-[11px] flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>≈ ${tx.valueUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
                        <span>•</span>
                        <a
                          href={tx.explorerUrl}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          <span>{tx.hash.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: IMPORT CUSTOM TOKEN */}
      {activeTab === "import" && (
        <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#1f2433] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl space-y-6">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Plus className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
              Import &amp; Watch Custom ERC-20 Token
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#8E9299] font-mono mt-1">
              Add any ERC-20 contract address from Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, or Polygon to query its live balance and watch it in MetaMask.
            </p>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleImportLookup} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-[#8E9299] mb-1.5">
                Token Contract Address (0x...)
              </label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="0x..."
                  value={importAddressInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setImportAddressInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 font-mono text-xs text-white placeholder-[#5d6373] focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500"
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isImporting}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {isImporting ? "Querying..." : "Scan On-Chain"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>

          {importStatus && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] text-xs font-mono text-cyan-300">
              {importStatus}
            </div>
          )}

          {importedTokenPreview && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#141722] border border-cyan-500/30 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-xs">
                <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Discovered Contract:</span>
                <span className="text-white font-semibold">{importedTokenPreview.contractAddress}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-xs">
                <span className="text-[#8E9299]">Your Balance:</span>
                <span className="text-cyan-400 font-bold">{importedTokenPreview.balance}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  addCustomTokenToMetaMask({
                    address: importedTokenPreview.contractAddress,
                    symbol: importedTokenPreview.symbol,
                    decimals: importedTokenPreview.decimals,
                  });
                  setWatchFeedback(`Added ${importedTokenPreview.contractAddress.slice(0, 8)} to MetaMask!`);
                  setTimeout(() => setWatchFeedback(null), 3500);
                }}
                className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-500 hover:to-blue-500 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Watch Token in MetaMask Wallet
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 4: MULTI-CHAIN DISTRIBUTION */}
      {activeTab === "chains" && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {Object.entries(METAMASK_CHAINS).map(([key, cfg]) => {
            const isCurrent = key === selectedChainKey;
            const chainVal = summary?.chainDistribution[cfg.chainName] || (isCurrent ? summary?.totalValueUsd || 0 : 0);

            return (
              <div
                key={key}
                className={`bg-[#0e1017] border rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3 shadow-lg transition-all ${
                  isCurrent ? "border-cyan-500/50 bg-cyan-950/10" : "border-[#1f2433]"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
                    <span className="font-bold font-mono text-sm text-white">{cfg.chainName}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isCurrent && (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30">
                      Active
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1 font-mono text-xs">
                  <div className="text-[#8E9299]">Native Currency: <span className="text-white font-semibold">{cfg.nativeCurrency.symbol}</span></div>
                  <div className="text-[#8E9299]">Chain ID: <span className="text-white font-semibold">{cfg.chainIdDec}</span></div>
                  <div className="text-[#8E9299]">Allocated Value: <span className="text-cyan-400 font-bold">${chainVal.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span></div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedChainKey(key);
                      if (isConnected && switchChain) {
                        switchChain(key as any);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-white font-mono text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                  >
                    Switch to {cfg.chainName}
                  </button>
                  <a
                    href={cfg.blockExplorerUrls[0]}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noreferrer"
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#141722] hover:bg-[#1a1e2c] border border-[#242a3d] text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors"
                    title="View Explorer"
                  >
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </a>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL: SEND ASSETS */}
      {isSendModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#242a3d] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5 relative">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1f2433] pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Send className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
                <h3 className="font-bold font-mono text-base text-white">Send / Transfer Asset</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setIsSendModalOpen(false);
                  setSendTxFeedback(null);
                }}
                className="text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors p-1"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSendSubmit} className="space-y-4 font-mono text-xs">
              {/* Asset Select */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[#8E9299] mb-1.5">Asset to Transfer</label>
                <select
                  value={sendSelectedHolding?.id || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const sel = holdings.find((h) => h.id === e.target.value);
                    if (sel) setSendSelectedHolding(sel);
                  }}
                  className="w-full bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {holdings.map((h) => (
                    <option key={h.id} value={h.id}>
                      {h.symbol} - Available: {h.balanceFormatted} (${h.valueUsd.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Recipient Address */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[#8E9299] mb-1.5">Recipient Address (0x...)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="0x..."
                  value={sendRecipient}
                  onChange={(e) => setSendRecipient(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-white placeholder-[#5d6373] focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Amount */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[#8E9299] mb-1.5">
                  <span>Amount to Send</span>
                  {sendSelectedHolding && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSendAmount(sendSelectedHolding.balance.toString())}
                      className="text-cyan-400 hover:underline"
                    >
                      MAX ({sendSelectedHolding.balanceFormatted})
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step="any"
                    placeholder="0.0"
                    value={sendAmount}
                    onChange={(e) => setSendAmount(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-[#141722] border border-[#242a3d] rounded-xl pl-4 pr-16 py-2.5 text-white placeholder-[#5d6373] focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500"
                  />
                  <span className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-cyan-400 font-bold">
                    {sendSelectedHolding?.symbol || "ETH"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Status / Feedback */}
              {sendTxFeedback && (
                <div
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs ${
                    sendTxFeedback.success
                      ? "bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300"
                      : "bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  <p>{sendTxFeedback.msg}</p>
                  {sendTxFeedback.txHash && (
                    <a
                      href={getExplorerUrl(selectedChainKey, sendTxFeedback.txHash, "tx")}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="text-cyan-400 underline mt-1 inline-block"
                    >
                      View on Explorer &rarr;
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Action Button */}
              <div className="pt-2">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSendingTx}
                  className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-500 hover:to-blue-500 text-white font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-cyan-950/50 active:scale-98 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {isSendingTx ? "Signing & Broadcasting via MetaMask..." : "Confirm & Send"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL: RECEIVE ASSETS */}
      {isReceiveModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="bg-[#0e1017] border border-[#242a3d] rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5 relative text-center">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1f2433] pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <QrCode className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
                <h3 className="font-bold font-mono text-base text-white">Receive EVM Assets</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsReceiveModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-[#8E9299] hover:text-white transition-colors p-1"
```

```tsx
  const activeTech = activeLayer.technologies.find((t) => t.id === selectedTechId) || activeLayer.technologies[0];

  const [actionNotification, setActionNotification] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, label: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedLabel(label);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedLabel(null), 2500);
  };

  const handleSaveTechToFossibot = (tech: TechItem) => {
    try {
      fossibotMemoryCardClient.saveArtifactToMemoryCard(
        `${tech.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_")}_snippet.${tech.language}`,
        "SOLIDITY_SRC",
        tech.codeSnippet,
        false
      );
      setActionNotification(`Saved ${tech.name} configuration directly to Fossibot MicroSD Card!`);
      setTimeout(() => setActionNotification(null), 3500);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setActionNotification(`Error saving to Fossibot: ${e?.message}`);
      setTimeout(() => setActionNotification(null), 4000);
    }
  };

  const handleValidateUserOp = () => {
    const userOp = {
      sender: userOpSender,
      nonce: "0x1",
      initCode: "0x",
      callData: userOpCallData,
      callGasLimit: "0x186a0",
      verificationGasLimit: "0x249f0",
      preVerificationGas: "0xc350",
      maxFeePerGas: "0x4a817c800",
      maxPriorityFeePerGas: "0x59682f00",
      paymasterAndData: userOpPaymasterEnabled ? "0x70Ac8a93DAe2F7B8D4151a6C4980665Tree3MaoMao" : "0x",
      signature: "0x70ac...secp256k1",
    };
    const res = validateUserOperationFormat(userOp);
    setUserOpValidation(res);
  };

  const handleGenerateIpfsCid = () => {
    const cid = computeSimulatedIpfsCid(ipfsContentInput);
    setGeneratedCid(cid);
  };

  const handleSimulateCcip = () => {
    const messageId = `0x70ac${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10)}${Date.now().toString(16)}ccipmsg`;
    setCcipSimulatedResult({
      messageId,
      source: ccipSourceChain,
      destination: ccipDestChain,
      tokens: `${ccipTokenAmount.toLocaleString()} TREE3 / USDC`,
      feeUsd: 1.84,
      status: "SUCCESS_DELIVERED",
      executionTimeSeconds: 4.2,
    });
  };

  const handleRefreshPyth = () => {
    setPythPriceStream({
      ethPrice: Number((3440 + Math.random() * 25).toFixed(2)),
      tree3Price: Number((104 + Math.random() * 2).toFixed(2)),
      conf: Number((0.08 + Math.random() * 0.08).toFixed(3)),
      latencyMs: Math.floor(320 + Math.random() * 90),
    });
  };

  const handleSimulateCctp = () => {
    const burnTx = `0x70ac${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10)}burn`;
    const mintTx = `0x70ac${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10)}mint`;
    setCctpSimResult({
      burnTx,
      mintTx,
      amount: cctpAmountUsdc,
      attestationHash: `0xcircleattest${Date.now().toString(16)}`,
      timeSeconds: 6.8,
      status: "NATIVELY_MINTED_DESTINATION",
    });
  };

  const handleExecuteZkvmProof = () => {
    const proofHash = `0x70ac${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10)}${Date.now().toString(16)}zkstark`;
    setZkvmProofResult({
      proofHash,
      cycles: 184920,
      proverTimeMs: 410,
      verifierGas: 94200,
      resultEnergy: (zkvmInputInt * Math.pow(299792, 2)) / 1e10,
    });
  };

  // Automated 6-step flow runner
  const handleRunFullEndToEndSimulation = () => {
    setIsAutomatingFlow(true);
    setFlowStep(1);
    const logs: string[] = [
      `[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ▶ INITIATING FULL-STACK END-TO-END WEB3 LIFECYCLE`,
    ];
    setFlowTelemetry(logs);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setFlowStep(2);
      logs.unshift(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Stage 1: Authenticated via Privy (${onboardingAuthMethod}). Embedded ERC-4337 Smart Account derived: ${userSmartAccount.slice(0, 10)}...`);
      setFlowTelemetry([...logs]);

      setTimeout(() => {
        setFlowStep(3);
        logs.unshift(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Stage 2: React 19 Frontend + Viem queries indexed reserves from The Graph Subgraph (Latency: 14ms).`);
        setFlowTelemetry([...logs]);

        setTimeout(() => {
          setFlowStep(4);
          logs.unshift(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Stage 3: SP1 zkVM executes off-chain Rust compute. Generated STARK proof (${sp1Cycles.toLocaleString()} cycles).`);
          setFlowTelemetry([...logs]);

          setTimeout(() => {
            setFlowStep(5);
            logs.unshift(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Stage 4: Sub-second Pyth Network price stream injected ($${pythEthPrice} ± 0.12, 380ms latency).`);
            setFlowTelemetry([...logs]);

            setTimeout(() => {
              setFlowStep(6);
              logs.unshift(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Stage 5: MetaMask signs offline via secp256k1; Infura broadcasts to Arbitrum Orbit L3; contract verifies ZK proof & settles on block #${settlementBlock}.`);
              setFlowTelemetry([...logs]);

              setTimeout(() => {
                logs.unshift(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] Stage 6: Rollup batch published to Celestia DA (Height #${celestiaBlobHeight}, 99.3% cost reduction). PIPELINE COMPLETE.`);
                setFlowTelemetry([...logs]);
                setIsAutomatingFlow(false);
              }, 800);
            }, 800);
          }, 800);
        }, 800);
      }, 800);
    }, 800);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {actionNotification && (
        <div className="bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-emerald-300 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold flex items-center justify-between shadow-lg">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{actionNotification}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setActionNotification(null)} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white text-xs">
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Overview Banner */}
      <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-2 max-w-3xl">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Crypto / Web3 Full-Stack Architecture
              </span>
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30">
                End-to-End Technology Spectrum
              </span>
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30">
                L1/L2/L3 • DA • ZK • AA
              </span>
            </div>

            <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">
              Web3 Full-Stack Architectural Engine
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">
              Synthesizes smart contracts at the execution layer, middleware and data indexing, reactive frontends,
              off-chain compute via SP1 zkVMs, Chainlink & Pyth oracles, EigenLayer restaking, Celestia modular DA,
              and Circle CCTP financial rails.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row md:flex-col gap-2.5 min-w-[200px]">
            {onOpenSolidityCompiler && (
              <button
                onClick={onOpenSolidityCompiler}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-[#F27D26] hover:bg-[#ff8f3d] text-white border border-orange-400/30 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20"
              >
                <Code2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                Open Solidity Studio
              </button>
            )}
            {onOpenMetaMaskTransferModal && (
              <button
                onClick={() => onOpenMetaMaskTransferModal("send")}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-[#1E1E24] hover:bg-[#25252D] text-gray-200 border border-[#2B2B33] transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
                MetaMask Web3 Gateway
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* View Mode Mode Switcher */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-6 pt-5 border-t border-[#1F1F23] overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
          {[
            { id: "end_to_end_flow", label: "⚡ End-to-End User Flow (6 Stages)", icon: Workflow },
            { id: "system_topology", label: "🗺️ System Architecture Overview & Topology", icon: Network },
            { id: "key_patterns", label: "💎 4 Key Architectural Patterns", icon: Sparkles },
            { id: "architecture_layers", label: "📚 11 Technology Layers Deep-Dive", icon: Layers },
          ].map((mode) => {
            const Icon = mode.icon;
            const isActive = activeViewMode === mode.id;
            return (
              <button

                  isActive
                    ? "bg-[#F27D26] text-white shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20"
                    : "bg-[#1E1E24] text-gray-300 hover:bg-[#25252D] hover:text-white border border-[#2B2B33]"
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                {mode.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* VIEW 1: END-TO-END USER FLOW SIMULATOR */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {activeViewMode === "end_to_end_flow" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-5">

              <button

              >
                <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isAutomatingFlow ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />

            </div>

            {/* 6-Stage Progress Stepper */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-2.5 pt-2">

                { step: 1, title: "1. Onboarding", tech: "Privy / Dynamic", desc: "Passkey & ERC-4337" },
                { step: 2, title: "2. Frontend Read", tech: "Wagmi + Viem", desc: "The Graph / Alchemy" },
                { step: 3, title: "3. zkVM Proof", tech: "SP1 (Succinct)", desc: "Off-chain Rust compute" },
                { step: 4, title: "4. Oracle Feed", tech: "Pyth Network", desc: "Sub-second Hermes feed" },
                { step: 5, title: "5. Settlement", tech: "Arbitrum Orbit L3", desc: "MetaMask / Infura RPC" },

                const isCurrent = flowStep === s.step;

                return (
                  <button

                    className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition flex flex-col justify-between ${
                      isCurrent

                        : isPassed
                        ? "bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-gray-300"
                        : "bg-[#0A0A0C] border-[#1F1F23] text-gray-500"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold font-mono ${isCurrent ? "text-orange-400" : isPassed ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-gray-500"}`}>
                          {s.title}
                        </span>
                        {isPassed && <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white leading-tight">{s.tech}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-2">{s.desc}</div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Stage Detail Card */}
            <div className="p-5 bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#2B2B33] rounded-xl space-y-4">
              {flowStep === 1 && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-orange-400">
                      Stage 1: Embedded Onboarding & Account Abstraction (Privy / Dynamic)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">ERC-4337 Smart Account</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    User authenticates via Privy using passkeys (WebAuthn) or social accounts. An embedded non-custodial
                    ERC-4337 smart account is created without seed phrase friction.
                  </p>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
                    <div className="p-3 bg-[#16161A] rounded-lg">
                      <span className="text-gray-500 block">Auth Method:</span>
                      <span className="text-cyan-400 font-bold uppercase">{onboardingAuthMethod}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-3 bg-[#16161A] rounded-lg">
                      <span className="text-gray-500 block">Derived Smart Account:</span>
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{userSmartAccount}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {flowStep === 2 && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-cyan-400">
                      Stage 2: Frontend Query via Wagmi & The Graph Protocol
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">Decentralized Indexing</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    A Next.js interface using Viem & Wagmi reads historical balances and pool reserves indexed in
                    real time by The Graph subgraphs and Alchemy RPC node cache.
                  </p>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-[#16161A] rounded-lg font-mono text-xs text-gray-300">
                    Status: <strong className="text-emerald-400">{indexedQueryStatus}</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {flowStep === 3 && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-400">
                      Stage 3: Off-Chain Compute & Proof Generation (SP1 zkVM by Succinct)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">Succinct STARK Prover</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    Heavy relativistic logic and invariant checks run off-chain in an SP1 zkVM executing arbitrary Rust code.
                    A succinct cryptographic proof is generated for verification on-chain at low gas cost.
                  </p>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-[#16161A] rounded-lg font-mono text-xs text-gray-300 space-y-1">
                    <div>Proof Hash: <span className="text-amber-400">{sp1ProofHash}</span></div>
                    <div>Prover Cost: <span className="text-cyan-400">{sp1Cycles.toLocaleString()} RISC-V cycles</span></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {flowStep === 4 && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-400">
                      Stage 4: Low-Latency Financial Price Feeds (Pyth Network)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">Sub-Second Pull Oracle</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    Financial market prices are dynamically pulled via Pyth Hermes streams directly into the transaction payload,
                    ensuring accurate pricing without stale on-chain oracle latency.
                  </p>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-[#16161A] rounded-lg font-mono text-xs text-gray-300 flex justify-between">
                    <span>ETH / USD: <strong className="text-white">${pythEthPrice}</strong></span>
                    <span>Latency: <strong className="text-emerald-400">{pythLatencyMs} ms</strong></span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {flowStep === 5 && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">

                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">MetaMask & Infura RPC</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">

                    and finalizes state changes.
                  </p>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-[#16161A] rounded-lg font-mono text-xs text-gray-300 space-y-1">

                    <div>Block Height: <span className="text-emerald-400">#{settlementBlock.toLocaleString()}</span></div>
                  </div>

              {flowStep === 6 && (

                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-mono">2D Erasure Coding (DAS)</span>
                  </div>

                    <span>Cost Savings: <strong className="text-emerald-400">{celestiaGasSavingsPercent}% lower</strong></span>
                  </div>

            {/* Live Pipeline Telemetry Log */}
            <div className="space-y-2">

          </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* VIEW 2: SYSTEM TOPOLOGY & ARCHITECTURE MAP */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {activeViewMode === "system_topology" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-[#16161A] border border-[#1F1F23] rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-[#1F1F23]">
              <div>

              </div>

                End-to-End Topology
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Visual Topography Diagram */}
            <div className="p-6 bg-[#0A0A0C] border border-[#2B2B33] rounded-xl space-y-4 font-mono text-xs">
              {/* Box 1: Application & Frontend */}
              <div className="p-4 bg-[#16161A] border-2 border-cyan-500/40 rounded-xl text-center space-y-1 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/10">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-cyan-400 uppercase tracking-widest block">
                  1. Application & Frontend
                </span>
                <div className="text-white font-bold text-sm">
                  Next.js / React 19 / Vue • Viem / Wagmi / Ethers.js v6 • RainbowKit / AppKit
                </div>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-sans">
                  User interfaces, responsive state hooks, wallet connectors, and multi-chain network switchers
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Arrow */}
              <div className="text-center text-gray-500 font-bold">│ ▼</div>

              {/* Box 2: Split Rows - Onboarding vs Middleware */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="p-4 bg-[#16161A] border border-orange-500/40 rounded-xl space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-orange-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                    2A. Onboarding & Account Layer
                  </span>
                  <div className="text-white font-bold">Privy • Dynamic • AppKit • Safe • Biconomy (ERC-4337)</div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-sans">
                    Passkey authentication, session keys, gas sponsorship paymasters, and multi-sig smart accounts
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 bg-[#16161A] border border-purple-500/40 rounded-xl space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                    2B. Middleware & Data Indexing
                  </span>
                  <div className="text-white font-bold">The Graph • Goldsky • Alchemy • QuickNode • Infura</div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-sans">

                  </p>

              </div>

              {/* Arrow */}
              <div className="text-center text-gray-500 font-bold">│ ▼</div>

              {/* Box 3: Off-Chain Compute, Oracles & Storage */}
              <div className="p-4 bg-[#16161A] border border-indigo-500/40 rounded-xl text-center space-y-1">

                </span>

                </div>

                </p>

              {/* Arrow */}
```

```tsx
};

/**
 * Higher-Order Component (HOC) wrapping components with Auth0 VIP Claim Protection
 */
export function withVIPProtection<P extends object>(
  WrappedComponent: React.ComponentType<P>,
  featureName: string = "Institutional Module"
): React.FC<P> {
  const VIPProtectedComponent: React.FC<P> = (props: P) => {
    const { isVIP } = useAuth0Membership();

    if (!isVIP) {
      return <VIPUpgradePrompt featureName={featureName} />;
    }

    return <WrappedComponent {...props} />;
  };

  VIPProtectedComponent.displayName = `withVIPProtection(${WrappedComponent.displayName || WrappedComponent.name || "Component"})`;
  return VIPProtectedComponent;
}

/**
 * Protective Guard component for JSX wrapper usage
 */
export const VIPProtectionGuard: React.FC<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
  featureName?: string;
}> = ({ children, featureName = "Institutional Trading Suite" }) => {
  const { isVIP } = useAuth0Membership();

  if (!isVIP) {
    return <VIPUpgradePrompt featureName={featureName} />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
};
```

### File: `/src/config/tweEnvironmentKeys.ts` (416 lines)
```ts
/**
 * Token World Exchange ATS (TWE) — Official Environment & Cryptographic Key Registry
 * Retrieves and validates VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY, TWE_ADMIN_SECRET,
 * and VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID at runtime.
 * If any key is missing or null, triggers a 'missing-critical-key' telemetry event via
 * console.warn (and UI diagnostic subscribers) and returns secure fallback defaults for each.
 */

export type TweCriticalKeyName =
  | "VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY"
  | "NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY"
  | "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET"
  | "VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID";

export const TWE_CRITICAL_KEYS: readonly TweCriticalKeyName[] = [
  "VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY",
  "NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY",
  "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET",
  "VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID",
] as const;

export interface TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent {
  id: string;
  eventType: "missing-critical-key";
  keyName: TweCriticalKeyName;
  severity: "CRITICAL" | "WARNING";
  environmentMode: string;
  rawProvidedValue: string;
  appliedFallbackValue: string;
  message: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export interface GesNsaSecurityProfile {
  cnsaSuiteVersion: string;
  enclaveClearanceLevel: string;
  aesGcmMode: string;
  pqKemAlgorithm: string;
  pqSignatureAlgorithm: string;
  shaDigestStandard: string;
  activeDefensePosture: "DEFCON-1-ZERO-TRUST-LOCKED" | "CNSA-2.0-ENFORCED" | "QUANTUM-SHIELD-ACTIVE";
  sacredApiEndpoint: string;
  fipsLevel: string;
  deterministicSessionSeal: string;
}

export interface TweEnvironmentKeyBundle {
  VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY: string;
  NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY: string;
  TWE_ADMIN_SECRET: string;
  VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID: string;
  generatedAt: string;
  keyId: string;
  isValidated: boolean;
  environmentMode: string;
  missingCriticalKeys: TweCriticalKeyName[];
  telemetryEvents: TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent[];
  gesNsaSecurityProfile: GesNsaSecurityProfile;
}

export interface ValidateTweEnvOptions
  extends Partial<Record<TweCriticalKeyName, unknown>> {
  emitTelemetry?: boolean;
}

export const TWE_MISSING_KEY_EVENT_NAME = "missing-critical-key";

export const TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS: Record<TweCriticalKeyName, string> = {
  VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY: "twe_live_pk_9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c_2026",
  NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY: "twe_live_pk_9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c_2026",
  TWE_ADMIN_SECRET: "twe_live_sk_admin_9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c9b8a7f6e5d4c_2026",
  VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID: "G-ZDKV0H9LXT",
} as const;

type TelemetrySubscriber = (events: TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent[]) => void;

const telemetrySubscribers = new Set<TelemetrySubscriber>();
let telemetryEventBuffer: TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent[] = [];

export function getTweMissingKeyTelemetryEvents(): TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent[] {
  return [...telemetryEventBuffer];
}

export function subscribeToTweEnvTelemetry(
  callback: TelemetrySubscriber
): () => void {
  telemetrySubscribers.add(callback);
  callback([...telemetryEventBuffer]);
  return () => {
    telemetrySubscribers.delete(callback);
  };
}

export function clearTweEnvTelemetryEvents(): void {
  telemetryEventBuffer = [];
  telemetrySubscribers.forEach((cb) => cb([]));
}

export function emitMissingCriticalKeyTelemetry(
  event: Omit<TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent, "id" | "eventType" | "timestamp">
): TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent {
  const fullEvent: TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent = {
    ...event,
    id: `twe-telemetry-${event.keyName}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()
      .toString(36)
      .slice(2, 6)}`,
    eventType: "missing-critical-key",
    timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
  };

  // Deduplicate by keyName + rawProvidedValue so repeated bootstrap calls stay clean
  const existingIdx = telemetryEventBuffer.findIndex(
    (e) =>
      e.keyName === fullEvent.keyName &&
      e.rawProvidedValue === fullEvent.rawProvidedValue
  );
  if (existingIdx !== -1) {
    telemetryEventBuffer[existingIdx] = fullEvent;
  } else {
    telemetryEventBuffer = [fullEvent, ...telemetryEventBuffer].slice(0, 50);
  }

  // Trigger 'missing-critical-key' telemetry warning via console.warn
  console.warn(
    `[${TWE_MISSING_KEY_EVENT_NAME}] ${fullEvent.message}`,
    fullEvent
  );

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent(TWE_MISSING_KEY_EVENT_NAME, { detail: fullEvent })
      );
    } catch {
      // Ignore if CustomEvent is restricted
    }
  }

  telemetrySubscribers.forEach((cb) => cb([...telemetryEventBuffer]));
  return fullEvent;
}

/**
 * Checks whether a raw environment value is missing, null, undefined, or a stringified null/undefined.
 */
export function isTweEnvValueMissing(rawValue: unknown): boolean {
  if (rawValue === null || rawValue === undefined) {
    return true;
  }
  const str = String(rawValue).trim();
  return (
    str === "" ||
    str.toLowerCase() === "null" ||
    str.toLowerCase() === "undefined"
  );
}

/**
 * Sanitizes any environment variable value, ensuring null / "null" / "undefined" / undefined
 * are replaced with a safe fallback default.
 */
export function sanitizeTweEnvValue(
  rawValue: unknown,
  fallbackPlaceholder = ""
): string {
  if (isTweEnvValueMissing(rawValue)) {
    return fallbackPlaceholder;
  }
  return String(rawValue).trim();
}

const metaEnv: Record<string, unknown> = (import.meta as any).env || {};
const procEnv: Record<string, unknown> =
  typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env ? process.env : {};

function detectRuntimeMode(): string {
  const mode = String(
    metaEnv.MODE || procEnv.NODE_ENV || "development"
  ).toLowerCase();
  return mode || "development";
}

/**
 * Retrieves and validates VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY, TWE_ADMIN_SECRET,
 * and VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID.
 * If any key is missing or null, triggers a 'missing-critical-key' telemetry event via
 * console.warn and returns secure fallback defaults for each.
 */
export function validateAndInitializeTweEnv(
  options?: ValidateTweEnvOptions
): TweEnvironmentKeyBundle {
  const environmentMode = detectRuntimeMode();
  const shouldEmit = options?.emitTelemetry !== false;

  const rawValues: Record<TweCriticalKeyName, unknown> = {
    VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY:
      options && "VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY" in options
        ? options.VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY
        : metaEnv.VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY ?? procEnv.VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY,
    NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY:
      options && "NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY" in options
        ? options.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY
        : metaEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY ?? procEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY,
    TWE_ADMIN_SECRET:
      options && "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET" in options
        ? options.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET
        : metaEnv.VITE_TWE_ADMIN_SECRET ??
          procEnv.VITE_TWE_ADMIN_SECRET ??
          metaEnv.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET ??
          procEnv.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET,
    VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID:
      options && "VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID" in options
        ? options.VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID
        : metaEnv.VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID ??
          procEnv.VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID,
  };

  const explicitAdminSecretProvided =
    (options &&
      "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET" in options &&
      !isTweEnvValueMissing(options.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET)) ||
    !isTweEnvValueMissing(metaEnv.VITE_TWE_ADMIN_SECRET) ||
    !isTweEnvValueMissing(procEnv.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET) ||
    (typeof window !== "undefined" &&
      Boolean((window as any).__TWE_ROTATED_ADMIN_SECRET__));

  const missingCriticalKeys: TweCriticalKeyName[] = [];
  const emittedEvents: TweMissingCriticalKeyTelemetryEvent[] = [];

  const checkAndResolveKey = (keyName: TweCriticalKeyName): string => {
    const rawVal = rawValues[keyName];
    const missing =
      isTweEnvValueMissing(rawVal) ||
      (keyName === "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET" &&
        !explicitAdminSecretProvided &&
        String(rawVal) === TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET);

    const fallback = TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS[keyName];

    if (missing) {
      missingCriticalKeys.push(keyName);
      if (shouldEmit) {
        const rawLabel =
          rawVal === undefined
            ? "undefined"
            : rawVal === null
            ? "null"
            : String(rawVal) === TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET
            ? "unconfigured (using default fallback)"
            : `"${String(rawVal)}"`;

        const evt = emitMissingCriticalKeyTelemetry({
          keyName,
          severity: keyName === "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET" ? "CRITICAL" : "WARNING",
          environmentMode,
          rawProvidedValue: rawLabel,
          appliedFallbackValue: fallback,
          message: `Critical TWE key "${keyName}" is ${rawLabel} in [${environmentMode}] mode. Triggered 'missing-critical-key' telemetry event and applied secure fallback default (${fallback.slice(
            0,
            22
          )}...).`,
        });
        emittedEvents.push(evt);
      }
      return fallback;
    }

    return sanitizeTweEnvValue(rawVal, fallback);
  };

  const safeViteKey = checkAndResolveKey("VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY");
  const safeNextPublicKey = checkAndResolveKey("NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY");
  const safeAdminSecret = checkAndResolveKey("TWE_ADMIN_SECRET");
  const safeMeasurementId = checkAndResolveKey("VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID");

  const validatedBundle: TweEnvironmentKeyBundle = {
    VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY: safeViteKey,
    NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY: safeNextPublicKey,
    TWE_ADMIN_SECRET: safeAdminSecret,
    VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID: safeMeasurementId,
    generatedAt: "2026-11-04T06:05:48Z",
    keyId: "TWE-KEYSET-2026-GENESIS",
    isValidated: missingCriticalKeys.length === 0,
    environmentMode,
    missingCriticalKeys,
    telemetryEvents:
      emittedEvents.length > 0 ? emittedEvents : getTweMissingKeyTelemetryEvents(),
    gesNsaSecurityProfile: {
      cnsaSuiteVersion: "NSA-CNSA-2.0-FIPS-203-204-205",
      enclaveClearanceLevel: "GES-SACRED-TIER-0-SOVEREIGN-CRYPTO",
      aesGcmMode: "AES-256-GCM-96IV-128TAG",
      pqKemAlgorithm: "ML-KEM-1024 (Kyber-1024)",
      pqSignatureAlgorithm: "ML-DSA-87 (Dilithium-5) + XMSS-SHA2_20_512",
      shaDigestStandard: "SHA-512 / SHA-384 (FIPS 180-4)",
      activeDefensePosture: "DEFCON-1-ZERO-TRUST-LOCKED",
      sacredApiEndpoint: "wss://ges-nsa-sacred-enclave.tokenworld.exchange/v2/cnsa2",
      fipsLevel: "FIPS 140-3 Level 4 Quantum HSM",
      deterministicSessionSeal: `0xGES_NSA_${safeViteKey.slice(-16).toUpperCase()}_CNSA2`,
    },
  };

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    (window as any).__TWE_VALIDATED_ENV__ = validatedBundle;
  }

  return validatedBundle;
}

export const DEFAULT_TWE_ENV_KEYS: TweEnvironmentKeyBundle =
  validateAndInitializeTweEnv();

/**
 * Simulates a missing critical runtime key (e.g. TWE_ADMIN_SECRET = undefined)
 * to verify 'missing-critical-key' telemetry dispatch in the UI diagnostic console.
 */
export function simulateMissingCriticalKey(
  keyName: TweCriticalKeyName = "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET"
): TweEnvironmentKeyBundle {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && keyName === "TWE_ADMIN_SECRET") {
    delete (window as any).__TWE_ROTATED_ADMIN_SECRET__;
  }
  return validateAndInitializeTweEnv({
    [keyName]: undefined,
  });
}

/**
 * Generates a fresh cryptographic keyset for TWE Art Engine 2.0 & Firebase Analytics
 * and clears any 'missing-critical-key' warnings by provisioning explicit runtime keys.
 */
export function generateCryptographicTweKeyBundle(
  customMeasurementId?: string
): TweEnvironmentKeyBundle {
  const randomBytes = new Uint8Array(16);
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.crypto?.getRandomValues) {
    window.crypto.getRandomValues(randomBytes);
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      randomBytes[i] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
    }
  }
  const hexToken = Array.from(randomBytes)
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join("");

  const secretBytes = new Uint8Array(16);
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.crypto?.getRandomValues) {
    window.crypto.getRandomValues(secretBytes);
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      secretBytes[i] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
    }
  }
  const secretHex = Array.from(secretBytes)
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join("");

  const publicDevKey = `twe_live_pk_${hexToken}_2026`;
  const adminSecret = `twe_live_sk_admin_${secretHex}_2026`;

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    (window as any).__TWE_ROTATED_ADMIN_SECRET__ = adminSecret;
  }

  clearTweEnvTelemetryEvents();

  return {
    VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY: publicDevKey,
    NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY: publicDevKey,
    TWE_ADMIN_SECRET: adminSecret,
    VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID: sanitizeTweEnvValue(
      customMeasurementId,
      DEFAULT_TWE_ENV_KEYS.VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID
    ),
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    keyId: `TWE-KEYSET-${hexToken.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
    isValidated: true,
    environmentMode: detectRuntimeMode(),
    missingCriticalKeys: [],
    telemetryEvents: [],
    gesNsaSecurityProfile: {
      cnsaSuiteVersion: "NSA-CNSA-2.0-FIPS-203-204-205",
      enclaveClearanceLevel: "GES-SACRED-TIER-0-SOVEREIGN-CRYPTO",
      aesGcmMode: "AES-256-GCM-96IV-128TAG",
      pqKemAlgorithm: "ML-KEM-1024 (Kyber-1024)",
      pqSignatureAlgorithm: "ML-DSA-87 (Dilithium-5) + XMSS-SHA2_20_512",
      shaDigestStandard: "SHA-512 / SHA-384 (FIPS 180-4)",
      activeDefensePosture: "QUANTUM-SHIELD-ACTIVE",
      sacredApiEndpoint: "wss://ges-nsa-sacred-enclave.tokenworld.exchange/v2/cnsa2",
      fipsLevel: "FIPS 140-3 Level 4 Quantum HSM",
      deterministicSessionSeal: `0xGES_NSA_${hexToken.slice(0, 16).toUpperCase()}_CNSA2`,
    },
  };
}

export function formatEnvFileBlock(bundle: TweEnvironmentKeyBundle): string {
  return [
    `VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY="${sanitizeTweEnvValue(
      bundle.VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY,
      TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS.VITE_TWE_DEV_KEY
    )}"`,
    `NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY="${sanitizeTweEnvValue(
      bundle.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY,
      TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS.NEXT_PUBLIC_TWE_DEV_KEY
    )}"`,
    `TWE_ADMIN_SECRET="${sanitizeTweEnvValue(
      bundle.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET,
      TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS.TWE_ADMIN_SECRET
    )}"`,
    `VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID="${sanitizeTweEnvValue(
      bundle.VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID,
      TWE_SAFE_PLACEHOLDERS.VITE_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID
    )}"`,
  ].join("\n");
}
```

```ts
      window.localStorage.setItem(TWE_AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, "true");
    } catch {
      // ignore storage errors
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent(TWE_AUTH_EVENT, { detail: { isAuthenticated: true } })
```
