  private generateInitialTradeBatch(symbol: string, basePrice: number): LiveTrade[] {
    const trades: LiveTrade[] = [];
    const now = Date.now();
    const count = 25;
    const isCrypto = symbol.startsWith("BTC") || symbol.startsWith("ETH") || symbol.startsWith("SOL");

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const timeOffset = i * (1200 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2500));
      const variation = (Math.random() - 0.49) * 0.003 * basePrice;
      const tradePrice = parseFloat((basePrice + variation).toFixed(basePrice < 10 ? 4 : 2));
      
      let qty = 1;
      if (symbol.startsWith("BTC")) {
        qty = parseFloat((0.015 + Math.random() * 0.45).toFixed(4));
      } else if (symbol.startsWith("ETH")) {
        qty = parseFloat((0.25 + Math.random() * 3.5).toFixed(3));
      } else if (symbol.startsWith("SOL")) {
        qty = parseFloat((2.5 + Math.random() * 45).toFixed(2));
      } else if (symbol.startsWith("TREE3")) {
        qty = parseFloat((10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 150)).toFixed(0));
      } else {
        qty = parseFloat((25 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 250)).toFixed(0));
      }

      const totalUsd = parseFloat((tradePrice * qty).toFixed(2));
      const side: "BUY" | "SELL" = Math.random() > 0.48 ? "BUY" : "SELL";
      const isWhale = totalUsd >= 10000;

      trades.push({
        id: `seed-${symbol.replace("/", "")}-${now - timeOffset}-${i}`,
        symbol,
        price: tradePrice,
        quantity: qty,
        totalUsd,
        side,
        timestamp: now - timeOffset,
        source: isCrypto ? "BINANCE_REST" : "TWE_ATS_MATCH",
        isBuyerMaker: side === "SELL",
        isWhale,
      });
    }

    return trades;
  }

  public start() {
    this.connectBinanceWebSocket();
    this.startCoinGeckoPoller();
    this.startNativeLiquidityEngine();
    // Proactively fetch real Binance REST trades for major pairs
    this.fetchRecentTradesFromBinance("BTC/USDT");
    this.fetchRecentTradesFromBinance("ETH/USDT");
    this.fetchRecentTradesFromBinance("SOL/USDT");
  }

  public stop() {
    if (this.ws) {
      try {
        this.ws.close();
      } catch (e) {
        // ignore
      }
      this.ws = null;
    }
    if (this.reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    if (this.coinGeckoInterval) clearInterval(this.coinGeckoInterval);
    if (this.nativeTradesInterval) clearInterval(this.nativeTradesInterval);
  }

  private setStatus(status: FeedConnectionStatus, ping: number = 24) {
    this.status = status;
    this.pingMs = ping;
    this.statusListeners.forEach((l) => l(status, ping));
  }

  private notifyTickers() {
    const copy = { ...this.tickers };
    this.tickerListeners.forEach((l) => l(copy));
  }

  private notifyTrades(symbol: string) {
    const list = this.recentTrades[symbol] || [];
    this.tradeListeners.forEach((l) => l(symbol, [...list]));
  }

  /**
   * Pushes a new trade into the live trade buffer and notifies subscribers
   */
  public pushTrade(symbol: string, trade: LiveTrade) {
    if (!this.recentTrades[symbol]) {
      this.recentTrades[symbol] = [];
    }

    // Prepend new trade and keep up to 100 recent trades
    this.recentTrades[symbol] = [trade, ...this.recentTrades[symbol]].slice(0, 100);
    this.notifyTrades(symbol);
  }

  /**
   * Ingests an ATS-executed or externally matched trade
   */
  public addExecutedTrade(trade: LiveTrade) {
    this.pushTrade(trade.symbol, trade);
  }

  /**
   * Connect to Binance Public WebSocket
   * Multiplexes combined stream:
   * - !miniTicker@arr (24h tickers)
   * - btcusdt@trade, ethusdt@trade, solusdt@trade (real-time individual executions)
   */
  private connectBinanceWebSocket() {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || !("WebSocket" in window)) {
      this.fallbackToCoinGecko();
      return;
    }

    try {
      this.setStatus("CONNECTING", 45);
      const wsUrl = "wss://stream.binance.com:9443/stream?streams=!miniTicker@arr/btcusdt@trade/ethusdt@trade/solusdt@trade";
      this.ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);

      const connectStart = performance.now();

      this.ws.onopen = () => {
        this.wsConnected = true;
        this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
        const latency = Math.max(12, Math.round(performance.now() - connectStart));
        this.setStatus("CONNECTED_BINANCE_WS", latency);
      };

      this.ws.onmessage = (event) => {
        try {
          const raw = JSON.parse(event.data);

          // Case A: Combined stream wrapper { stream, data }
          if (raw && raw.stream && raw.data) {
            const streamName = raw.stream as string;
            const streamData = raw.data;

            // Handle individual trade event from Binance WebSocket
            if (streamName.includes("@trade") || streamData.e === "trade") {
              const pairSymbol = streamData.s;
              let mappedKey: string | null = null;
              if (pairSymbol === "BTCUSDT") mappedKey = "BTC/USDT";
              else if (pairSymbol === "ETHUSDT") mappedKey = "ETH/USDT";
              else if (pairSymbol === "SOLUSDT") mappedKey = "SOL/USDT";

              if (mappedKey) {
                const price = parseFloat(streamData.p);
                const qty = parseFloat(streamData.q);
                const totalUsd = parseFloat((price * qty).toFixed(2));
                // In Binance: 'm' is isBuyerMaker. If true, buyer was maker -> sell market order. If false, buy market order.
                const side: "BUY" | "SELL" = streamData.m ? "SELL" : "BUY";
                const isWhale = totalUsd >= 10000;

                const liveTrade: LiveTrade = {
                  id: `binance-ws-${streamData.t || Date.now()}`,
                  symbol: mappedKey,
                  price,
                  quantity: qty,
                  totalUsd,
                  side,
                  timestamp: streamData.T || Date.now(),
                  source: "BINANCE_WEBSOCKET",
                  isBuyerMaker: streamData.m,
                  isWhale,
                };

                this.pushTrade(mappedKey, liveTrade);
              }
              return;
            }

            // Handle !miniTicker@arr in combined stream
            if (Array.isArray(streamData)) {
              this.processMiniTickers(streamData);
              return;
            }
          }

          // Case B: Direct miniTicker array fallback
          if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
            this.processMiniTickers(raw);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // ignore parsing error
        }
      };

      this.ws.onerror = () => {
        this.wsConnected = false;
        this.fallbackToCoinGecko();
      };

      this.ws.onclose = () => {
        this.wsConnected = false;
        if (this.status !== "FALLBACK_ACTIVE") {
          this.setStatus("RECONNECTING", 120);
        }
        this.scheduleReconnect();
      };
    } catch (err) {
      this.fallbackToCoinGecko();
    }
  }

  private processMiniTickers(items: any[]) {
    let updated = false;
    items.forEach((item: any) => {
      const pairSymbol = item.s;
      let mappedKey: string | null = null;
      let name = "";
      if (pairSymbol === "BTCUSDT") {
        mappedKey = "BTC/USDT";
        name = "Bitcoin";
      } else if (pairSymbol === "ETHUSDT") {
        mappedKey = "ETH/USDT";
        name = "Ethereum";
      } else if (pairSymbol === "SOLUSDT") {
        mappedKey = "SOL/USDT";
        name = "Solana";
      }

      if (mappedKey) {
        const closePrice = parseFloat(item.c);
        const openPrice = parseFloat(item.o);
        const highPrice = parseFloat(item.h);
        const lowPrice = parseFloat(item.l);
        const volume = parseFloat(item.q);
        const changePct = openPrice > 0 ? ((closePrice - openPrice) / openPrice) * 100 : 0;
        const spreadUnit = closePrice * 0.0001;

        this.tickers[mappedKey] = {
          symbol: mappedKey,
          baseAsset: mappedKey.split("/")[0],
          quoteAsset: mappedKey.split("/")[1],
          name,
          price: closePrice,
          change24h: parseFloat(changePct.toFixed(2)),
          high24h: highPrice,
          low24h: lowPrice,
          volume24h: volume,
          source: "BINANCE_WEBSOCKET",
          lastUpdated: Date.now(),
          bidPrice: parseFloat((closePrice - spreadUnit).toFixed(2)),
          askPrice: parseFloat((closePrice + spreadUnit).toFixed(2)),
        };
        updated = true;
      }
    });

    this.updateNativeTokens();

    if (updated) {
      this.notifyTickers();
    }
  }

  private scheduleReconnect() {
    if (this.reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    this.reconnectAttempts++;
    const delay = Math.min(30000, 2000 * Math.pow(1.5, this.reconnectAttempts));
    this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.connectBinanceWebSocket();
    }, delay);
  }

  private fallbackToCoinGecko() {
    this.setStatus("CONNECTED_COINGECKO_REST", 85);
    this.pollCoinGeckoOnce();
  }

  private startCoinGeckoPoller() {
    // Poll every 15 seconds to ensure continuous freshness even if WS drops
    this.coinGeckoInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.wsConnected) {
        this.pollCoinGeckoOnce();
      }
    }, 15000);
  }

  /**
   * Fetches real recent trades from Binance REST API (with US proxy fallback)
   */
  public async fetchRecentTradesFromBinance(symbol: string): Promise<LiveTrade[]> {
    const cleanSym = symbol.replace("/", "").toUpperCase();
    if (!["BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT", "SOLUSDT"].includes(cleanSym)) {
      return this.recentTrades[symbol] || [];
    }

    try {
      // Try binance.us first (unrestricted in US/Cloud Run), then binance.com
      let response: Response | null = null;
      try {
        response = await fetch(`https://api.binance.us/api/v3/trades?symbol=${cleanSym}&limit=35`);
      } catch (e) {
        // try binance.com
      }

      if (!response || !response.ok) {
        try {
          response = await fetch(`https://api.binance.com/api/v3/trades?symbol=${cleanSym}&limit=35`);
        } catch (e) {
          // ignore
        }
      }

      if (response && response.ok) {
        const rawTrades = await response.json();
        if (Array.isArray(rawTrades)) {
          const parsed: LiveTrade[] = rawTrades.map((t: any) => {
            const price = parseFloat(t.price);
            const qty = parseFloat(t.qty);
            const totalUsd = parseFloat((t.quoteQty ? parseFloat(t.quoteQty) : price * qty).toFixed(2));
            const side: "BUY" | "SELL" = t.isBuyerMaker ? "SELL" : "BUY";
            return {
              id: `binance-rest-${t.id}`,
              symbol,
              price,
              quantity: qty,
              totalUsd,
              side,
              timestamp: t.time || Date.now(),
              source: "BINANCE_REST",
              isBuyerMaker: t.isBuyerMaker,
              isWhale: totalUsd >= 10000,
            };
          });

          // Sort descending by timestamp
          parsed.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
          this.recentTrades[symbol] = parsed;
          this.notifyTrades(symbol);
          return parsed;
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Ignore network error and retain existing trades
    }

    return this.recentTrades[symbol] || [];
  }

  private async pollCoinGeckoOnce() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        "https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum,solana&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_vol=true&include_24hr_change=true",
        { cache: "no-store" }
      );
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = await res.json();

      let updated = false;
      if (data.bitcoin) {
        const p = data.bitcoin.usd;
        const c = data.bitcoin.usd_24h_change || 0;
        this.tickers["BTC/USDT"] = {
          symbol: "BTC/USDT",
          baseAsset: "BTC",
          quoteAsset: "USDT",
          name: "Bitcoin",
          price: p,
          change24h: parseFloat(c.toFixed(2)),
          high24h: p * 1.02,
          low24h: p * 0.98,
          volume24h: data.bitcoin.usd_24h_vol || 1500000000,
          source: "COINGECKO_REST",
          lastUpdated: Date.now(),
          bidPrice: p * 0.9998,
          askPrice: p * 1.0002,
        };
        this.generateCoinGeckoTradeTick("BTC/USDT", p);
        updated = true;
      }
      if (data.ethereum) {
        const p = data.ethereum.usd;
        const c = data.ethereum.usd_24h_change || 0;
        this.tickers["ETH/USDT"] = {
          symbol: "ETH/USDT",
          baseAsset: "ETH",
          quoteAsset: "USDT",
          name: "Ethereum",
          price: p,
          change24h: parseFloat(c.toFixed(2)),
          high24h: p * 1.025,
          low24h: p * 0.975,
          volume24h: data.ethereum.usd_24h_vol || 800000000,
          source: "COINGECKO_REST",
          lastUpdated: Date.now(),
          bidPrice: p * 0.9998,
          askPrice: p * 1.0002,
        };
        this.generateCoinGeckoTradeTick("ETH/USDT", p);
        updated = true;
      }
      if (data.solana) {
        const p = data.solana.usd;
        const c = data.solana.usd_24h_change || 0;
        this.tickers["SOL/USDT"] = {
          symbol: "SOL/USDT",
          baseAsset: "SOL",
          quoteAsset: "USDT",
          name: "Solana",
          price: p,
          change24h: parseFloat(c.toFixed(2)),
          high24h: p * 1.03,
          low24h: p * 0.97,
          volume24h: data.solana.usd_24h_vol || 350000000,
          source: "COINGECKO_REST",
          lastUpdated: Date.now(),
          bidPrice: p * 0.9998,
          askPrice: p * 1.0002,
        };
        this.generateCoinGeckoTradeTick("SOL/USDT", p);
        updated = true;
      }

      this.updateNativeTokens();
      if (updated) {
        this.notifyTickers();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Offline fallback: simulate realistic micro-fluctuation so UI never freezes
      this.simulateMicroTicks();
    }
  }

  private generateCoinGeckoTradeTick(symbol: string, currentPrice: number) {
    if (this.wsConnected) return; // Prioritize WebSocket when connected
    const delta = (Math.random() - 0.49) * 0.001 * currentPrice;
    const tradePrice = parseFloat((currentPrice + delta).toFixed(2));
    let qty = 0.1;
    if (symbol.startsWith("BTC")) qty = parseFloat((0.02 + Math.random() * 0.25).toFixed(4));
    else if (symbol.startsWith("ETH")) qty = parseFloat((0.2 + Math.random() * 2).toFixed(3));
    else if (symbol.startsWith("SOL")) qty = parseFloat((2 + Math.random() * 20).toFixed(2));
    const totalUsd = parseFloat((tradePrice * qty).toFixed(2));
    const side: "BUY" | "SELL" = Math.random() > 0.5 ? "BUY" : "SELL";

    const trade: LiveTrade = {
      id: `coingecko-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      symbol,
      price: tradePrice,
      quantity: qty,
      totalUsd,
      side,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      source: "COINGECKO_FEED",
      isBuyerMaker: side === "SELL",
      isWhale: totalUsd >= 10000,
    };
    this.pushTrade(symbol, trade);
  }

  private startNativeLiquidityEngine() {
    // Generate realistic institutional matched trades for TW-EQ and TREE3
    this.nativeTradesInterval = setInterval(() => {
      const nativeSymbols = ["TW-EQ/USD", "TREE3/USDT"];
      const chosen = nativeSymbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * nativeSymbols.length)];
      const ticker = this.tickers[chosen];
      if (ticker) {
        const spreadOffset = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.002 * ticker.price;
        const tradePrice = parseFloat((ticker.price + spreadOffset).toFixed(2));
        const qty = chosen === "TW-EQ/USD" ? Math.floor(25 + Math.random() * 300) : Math.floor(10 + Math.random() * 100);
        const totalUsd = parseFloat((tradePrice * qty).toFixed(2));
        const side: "BUY" | "SELL" = Math.random() > 0.45 ? "BUY" : "SELL";

        const trade: LiveTrade = {
          id: `twe-ats-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
          symbol: chosen,
          price: tradePrice,
          quantity: qty,
          totalUsd,
          side,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          source: "TWE_ATS_MATCH",
          isBuyerMaker: side === "SELL",
          isWhale: totalUsd >= 10000,
        };
        this.pushTrade(chosen, trade);
      }
    }, 3800);
  }

  private simulateMicroTicks() {
    const keys = ["BTC/USDT", "ETH/USDT", "SOL/USDT", "TW-EQ/USD", "TREE3/USDT"];
    keys.forEach((k) => {
      const t = this.tickers[k];
      if (t) {
        const delta = (Math.random() - 0.49) * 0.001 * t.price;
        const newPrice = Math.max(0.01, t.price + delta);
        this.tickers[k] = {
          ...t,
          price: parseFloat(newPrice.toFixed(t.price < 10 ? 4 : 2)),
          lastUpdated: Date.now(),
          bidPrice: parseFloat((newPrice * 0.9999).toFixed(2)),
          askPrice: parseFloat((newPrice * 1.0001).toFixed(2)),
        };
      }
    });
    this.notifyTickers();
  }

  private updateNativeTokens() {
    const btc = this.tickers["BTC/USDT"];
    const eth = this.tickers["ETH/USDT"];
    const marketBias = btc ? btc.change24h * 0.1 : 0.05;

    // TW-EQ valuation
    const tweqBase = 52.50;
    const tweqPrice = tweqBase * (1 + marketBias * 0.01);
    this.tickers["TW-EQ/USD"] = {
      symbol: "TW-EQ/USD",
      baseAsset: "TW-EQ",
      quoteAsset: "USD",
      name: "Token World Treasury Growth Equity",
      price: parseFloat(tweqPrice.toFixed(2)),
      change24h: parseFloat((5.75 + marketBias).toFixed(2)),
      high24h: parseFloat((tweqPrice * 1.03).toFixed(2)),
      low24h: parseFloat((tweqPrice * 0.97).toFixed(2)),
      volume24h: 125000000,
      source: "TWE_TREASURY_ORACLE",
      lastUpdated: Date.now(),
      bidPrice: parseFloat((tweqPrice - 0.05).toFixed(2)),
      askPrice: parseFloat((tweqPrice + 0.05).toFixed(2)),
    };

    // TREE3 valuation
    const treeBase = 125.00;
    const treePrice = treeBase * (1 + (eth ? eth.change24h * 0.08 : 0.02) * 0.01);
    this.tickers["TREE3/USDT"] = {
      symbol: "TREE3/USDT",
      baseAsset: "TREE3",
      quoteAsset: "USDT",
      name: "Token World Sovereign TREE3 Security Token",
      price: parseFloat(treePrice.toFixed(2)),
      change24h: parseFloat((3.20 + marketBias * 0.5).toFixed(2)),
      high24h: parseFloat((treePrice * 1.025).toFixed(2)),
      low24h: parseFloat((treePrice * 0.975).toFixed(2)),
      volume24h: 88500000,
      source: "TWE_TREASURY_ORACLE",
      lastUpdated: Date.now(),
      bidPrice: parseFloat((treePrice - 0.10).toFixed(2)),
      askPrice: parseFloat((treePrice + 0.10).toFixed(2)),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generates high-density order book depth levels around current mid price
   */
  public generateOrderBookDepth(symbol: string, depthCount: number = 10): LiveOrderBookDepth {
    const ticker = this.tickers[symbol] || this.tickers["BTC/USDT"];
    const mid = ticker ? ticker.price : 100;
    const spreadHalf = Math.max(0.01, mid * 0.0003);

    const bids: OrderBookLevel[] = [];
    const asks: OrderBookLevel[] = [];

    let cumBidTotal = 0;
    let cumAskTotal = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < depthCount; i++) {
      const step = (i + 1) * (mid * 0.0005);
      const bidPrice = parseFloat((mid - spreadHalf - step).toFixed(2));
      const askPrice = parseFloat((mid + spreadHalf + step).toFixed(2));

      // Realistic random depth size
      const bidQty = parseFloat((1.2 + Math.sin(i * 1.4) * 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.9).toFixed(3));
      const askQty = parseFloat((1.1 + Math.cos(i * 1.3) * 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.8).toFixed(3));

      cumBidTotal += bidPrice * bidQty;
      cumAskTotal += askPrice * askQty;

      bids.push({
        price: bidPrice,
        quantity: bidQty,
        total: cumBidTotal,
        depthPercent: 0,
      });

      asks.push({
        price: askPrice,
        quantity: askQty,
        total: cumAskTotal,
        depthPercent: 0,
      });
    }

    const maxBidTotal = bids[bids.length - 1]?.total || 1;
    const maxAskTotal = asks[asks.length - 1]?.total || 1;

    bids.forEach((b) => (b.depthPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((b.total / maxBidTotal) * 100))));
    asks.forEach((a) => (a.depthPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((a.total / maxAskTotal) * 100))));

    const bestBid = bids[0]?.price || mid;
    const bestAsk = asks[0]?.price || mid;
    const spread = parseFloat((bestAsk - bestBid).toFixed(2));
    const spreadPercent = parseFloat(((spread / mid) * 100).toFixed(4));

    return {
      symbol,
      bids,
      asks,
      spread,
      spreadPercent,
      midPrice: mid,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  // Subscription APIs
  public subscribeTickers(listener: TickerListener): () => void {
    this.tickerListeners.add(listener);
    listener({ ...this.tickers });
    return () => {
      this.tickerListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  public subscribeStatus(listener: StatusListener): () => void {
    this.statusListeners.add(listener);
    listener(this.status, this.pingMs);
    return () => {
      this.statusListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  public subscribeTrades(symbol: string, listener: TradeListener): () => void {
    this.tradeListeners.add(listener);
    // Trigger initial state
    if (this.recentTrades[symbol]) {
      listener(symbol, [...this.recentTrades[symbol]]);
    } else {
      const initial = this.generateInitialTradeBatch(symbol, this.tickers[symbol]?.price || 100);
      this.recentTrades[symbol] = initial;
      listener(symbol, [...initial]);
    }

    return () => {
      this.tradeListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  public getRecentTrades(symbol: string): LiveTrade[] {
    if (!this.recentTrades[symbol]) {
      this.recentTrades[symbol] = this.generateInitialTradeBatch(
        symbol,
        this.tickers[symbol]?.price || 100
      );
    }
    return [...this.recentTrades[symbol]];
  }

  public getTicker(symbol: string): MarketTicker | undefined {
    return this.tickers[symbol];
  }

  public getAllTickers(): Record<string, MarketTicker> {
    return { ...this.tickers };
  }

  public setTickerPrice(symbol: string, newPrice: number): MarketTicker | undefined {
    const t = this.tickers[symbol];
    if (t) {
      t.price = parseFloat(newPrice.toFixed(2));
      t.bidPrice = parseFloat((newPrice * 0.999).toFixed(2));
      t.askPrice = parseFloat((newPrice * 1.001).toFixed(2));
      t.lastUpdated = Date.now();
      this.notifyTickers();
      return { ...t };
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  public getStatus(): { status: FeedConnectionStatus; pingMs: number } {
    return { status: this.status, pingMs: this.pingMs };
  }
}

export const liveMarketFeedService = new LiveMarketFeedService();

// ============================================================================
// DOCUMENT SUMMARIZER (summarize_document helper)
// ============================================================================

export const REGULATORY_RISK_KEYWORDS = [
  "litigation",
  "volatility",
  "regulatory",
  "cybersecurity",
  "investigation",
  "subpoena",
  "default",
  "breach",
  "penalty",
  "sanction",
  "material weakness",
  "adverse",
  "enforcement",
  "cease and desist",
  "going concern",
  "remediation",
  "indictment",
  "delisting",
];

export const REVENUE_KEYWORDS = [
  "revenue",
  "net sales",
  "gross margin",
  "topline",
  "operating income",
  "deferred revenue",
  "annual recurring revenue",
  "ebitda",
  "turnover",
  "billings",
];

export const GUIDANCE_KEYWORDS = [
  "guidance",
  "forecast",
  "outlook",
  "forward-looking",
  "projected",
  "full-year estimate",
  "target range",
  "revised guidance",
  "expectation",
];

/**
 * Predefined document summarizer that calculates risk_mentions, revenue_mentions,
 * and guidance_mentions alongside semantic score and risk sentence extraction.
 */
export function summarize_document(text: string): DocumentSummary {
  if (!text) {
    return {
      risk_mentions: 0,
      revenue_mentions: 0,
      guidance_mentions: 0,
      cybersecurity_mentions: 0,
      word_count: 0,
      length: 0,
      sentiment_score: 0,
      key_risk_sentences: [],
    };
  }

  const length = text.length;
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const word_count = words.length;

  let risk_mentions = 0;
  for (const kw of REGULATORY_RISK_KEYWORDS) {
    const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${kw}\\b`, "gi");
    const matches = text.match(regex);
    if (matches) risk_mentions += matches.length;
  }

  let revenue_mentions = 0;
  for (const kw of REVENUE_KEYWORDS) {
    const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${kw}\\b`, "gi");
    const matches = text.match(regex);
    if (matches) revenue_mentions += matches.length;
  }

  let guidance_mentions = 0;
  for (const kw of GUIDANCE_KEYWORDS) {
    const regex = new RegExp(`\\b${kw}\\b`, "gi");
    const matches = text.match(regex);
    if (matches) guidance_mentions += matches.length;
  }

  const cyberRegex = /\b(cyber|cybersecurity|data breach|ransomware|malware|unauthorized access)\b/gi;
  const cyberMatches = text.match(cyberRegex);
  const cybersecurity_mentions = cyberMatches ? cyberMatches.length : 0;

  // Sentiment approximation: positive words vs negative words
  const positiveTerms = /\b(increase|growth|profit|record|strong|expanded|accretive|favorable|exceeded|outperformed|dividend|surplus)\b/gi;
  const negativeTerms = /\b(decrease|decline|loss|litigation|adverse|penalty|subpoena|investigation|breach|impairment|default|severance)\b/gi;
  const posCount = (text.match(positiveTerms) || []).length;
  const negCount = (text.match(negativeTerms) || []).length;
  const totalTerms = posCount + negCount;
  const sentiment_score = totalTerms > 0 ? Number(((posCount - negCount) / totalTerms).toFixed(2)) : 0;

  // Extract key sentences containing high-risk keywords
  const sentences = text.split(/(?<=[.?!])\s+/);
  const key_risk_sentences: string[] = [];
  for (const sentence of sentences) {
    const lower = sentence.toLowerCase();
    if (
      REGULATORY_RISK_KEYWORDS.some((kw) => lower.includes(kw)) &&
      sentence.trim().length > 30 &&
      sentence.trim().length < 280
    ) {
      key_risk_sentences.push(sentence.trim());
      if (key_risk_sentences.length >= 4) break;
    }
  }

  return {
    risk_mentions,
    revenue_mentions,
    guidance_mentions,
    cybersecurity_mentions,
    word_count,
    length,
    sentiment_score,
    key_risk_sentences,
  };
}

/**
 * Load Watchlist with resilient Firestore + LocalStorage fallback
 */
export async function loadWatchlist(): Promise<string[]> {
  // If Firestore write/read is bypassed, return local storage
  if (shouldBypassFirestoreWrite()) {
    try {
      const local = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_WATCHLIST_KEY);
      if (local) return JSON.parse(local);
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }
    return DEFAULT_WATCHLIST;
  }

  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, "sec_monitor", "watchlist");
    const snap = await getDoc(docRef);
    if (snap.exists() && Array.isArray(snap.data()?.tickers) && snap.data()?.tickers.length > 0) {
      const tickers = snap.data()?.tickers as string[];
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_WATCHLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(tickers));
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      return tickers;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    if (isQuotaError(err)) {
      markFirestoreQuotaExceeded(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    }
    console.warn("Firestore watchlist load failed, using local storage:", err);
  }

  try {
    const local = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_WATCHLIST_KEY);
    if (local) return JSON.parse(local);
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }

  return DEFAULT_WATCHLIST;
}

/**
 * Save Watchlist to Firestore & LocalStorage
 */
export async function saveWatchlist(tickers: string[]): Promise<void> {
  const cleanList = Array.from(new Set(tickers.map((t) => t.trim().toUpperCase()))).filter(Boolean);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_WATCHLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(cleanList));
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }

  if (shouldBypassFirestoreWrite()) return;

  try {
    const docRef = doc(db, "sec_monitor", "watchlist");
    await setDoc(
      docRef,
      {
        tickers: cleanList,
        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
        lastUpdatedBy: "maurodar08@gmail.com",
      },
      { merge: true }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    if (isQuotaError(err)) {
      markFirestoreQuotaExceeded(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
      return;
    }
    console.warn("Firestore saveWatchlist warning:", err);
  }
}

/**
 * Subscribe to real-time Watchlist updates
 */
export function subscribeToWatchlist(callback: (tickers: string[]) => void): () => void {
  if (shouldBypassFirestoreWrite()) {
    try {
      const local = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_WATCHLIST_KEY);
      callback(local ? JSON.parse(local) : DEFAULT_WATCHLIST);
    } catch {
      callback(DEFAULT_WATCHLIST);
    }
    return () => {};
  }

  const docRef = doc(db, "sec_monitor", "watchlist");
  return onSnapshot(
    docRef,
    (snap) => {
      if (snap.exists() && Array.isArray(snap.data()?.tickers)) {
        callback(snap.data()?.tickers as string[]);
      } else {
        callback(DEFAULT_WATCHLIST);
      }
    },
    (err) => {
      console.warn("Watchlist snapshot subscription error:", err);
      try {
        const local = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_WATCHLIST_KEY);
        callback(local ? JSON.parse(local) : DEFAULT_WATCHLIST);
      } catch {
        callback(DEFAULT_WATCHLIST);
      }
    }
  );
}

// Helper to generate dynamic financial facts for any custom added ticker
export function getOrCreateXbrlFacts(ticker: string): XbrlFactRecord[] {
  const upper = ticker.toUpperCase();
  if (SEED_XBRL_FACTS[upper]) {
    return SEED_XBRL_FACTS[upper];
  }

  // Deterministic generator for custom added tickers
  const hash = upper.split("").reduce((acc, c) => acc + c.charCodeAt(0), 0);
  const baseRev = Math.max(2, (hash % 80) + 10);
  const quarters = ["2023 Q1", "2023 Q2", "2023 Q3", "2023 Q4", "2024 Q1", "2024 Q2", "2024 Q3", "2024 Q4"];

  return quarters.map((q, idx) => {
    const growth = 1 + idx * 0.08 + ((hash * (idx + 1)) % 15) / 100;
    const rev = Number((baseRev * growth).toFixed(2));
    const net = Number((rev * 0.22).toFixed(2));
    const eps = Number((net / 3.5).toFixed(2));
    const ocf = Number((net * 1.2).toFixed(2));
    const assets = Number((rev * 3.8).toFixed(2));
    return {
      ticker: upper,
      period: q,
      fiscalYear: Number(q.split(" ")[0]),
      fiscalQuarter: q.split(" ")[1],
      revenue: rev,
      netIncome: net,
      eps,
      operatingCashFlow: ocf,
      totalAssets: assets,
    };
  });
}

// Generate dynamic filings if a new ticker is added to the watchlist
export function getFilingsForWatchlist(watchlist: string[]): EdgarFiling[] {
  const upperWatchlist = new Set(watchlist.map((w) => w.toUpperCase()));
  const matched = SEED_FILINGS.filter((f) => upperWatchlist.has(f.ticker.toUpperCase()));

  // For any watchlist item with no seed filing, synthesize standard filings
  for (const ticker of watchlist) {
    const upper = ticker.toUpperCase();
    if (!matched.some((m) => m.ticker === upper)) {
      const synthetic10K: EdgarFiling = {
        accessionNumber: `0009999999-24-${(Math.random() * 900000 + 100000).toFixed(0)}`,
        ticker: upper,
        companyName: `${upper} Holdings Corp.`,
        cik: `000${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900000 + 100000)}`,
        form: "10-K",
        filingDate: "2024-11-12",
        reportPeriod: "2024-09-30",
        fileSizeBytes: 4200000,
        fileSizeFormatted: "4.0 MB",
        headline: `Annual Report Pursuant to Section 13 and 15(d) for ${upper}`,
        secEdgarUrl: `https://www.sec.gov/edgar/browse/?CIK=${upper}`,
        rawText: `ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS. Operational volatility in digital asset markets and changing regulatory parameters. Cybersecurity safeguards are established to defend customer records against unauthorized data intrusion. The company experienced solid revenue expansion with top-line growth of 18% year-over-year. Management guidance targets further expansion with zero pending litigation.`,
        htmlContent: `<h2>${upper} FORM 10-K</h2><p>Operational <em>volatility</em> in digital asset markets and changing <em>regulatory</em> parameters. <em>Cybersecurity</em> safeguards established. Solid <em>revenue</em> expansion. Forward <em>guidance</em> targets expansion with zero <em>litigation</em>.</p>`,
        summary: summarize_document(
          `ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS. Operational volatility in digital asset markets and changing regulatory parameters. Cybersecurity safeguards are established to defend customer records against unauthorized data intrusion. The company experienced solid revenue expansion with top-line growth of 18% year-over-year. Management guidance targets further expansion with zero pending litigation.`
        ),
        isHighRisk8K: false,
        receivedAt: "2024-11-12T15:00:00Z",
      };
      matched.push(synthetic10K);
    }
  }

  return matched.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.filingDate).getTime() - new Date(a.filingDate).getTime());
}

// ============================================================================
// EXPORT UTILITIES (CSV & HTML DOWNLOAD)
// ============================================================================

export function exportFilingsToCsv(filings: EdgarFiling[]): void {
  const headers = [
    "Accession Number",
    "Ticker",
    "Company Name",
    "Form",
    "Filing Date",
    "Report Period",
    "File Size",
    "Risk Mentions",
    "Revenue Mentions",
    "Guidance Mentions",
    "Cyber Mentions",
    "Sentiment Score",
    "High Risk 8-K",
    "SEC URL",
  ];

  const rows = filings.map((f) => [
    `"${f.accessionNumber}"`,
    `"${f.ticker}"`,
    `"${f.companyName.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${f.form}"`,
    `"${f.filingDate}"`,
    `"${f.reportPeriod}"`,
    `"${f.fileSizeFormatted}"`,
    f.summary.risk_mentions,
    f.summary.revenue_mentions,
    f.summary.guidance_mentions,
    f.summary.cybersecurity_mentions,
    f.summary.sentiment_score,
    f.isHighRisk8K ? "YES" : "NO",
    `"${f.secEdgarUrl}"`,
  ]);

  const csvContent = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8," + [headers.join(","), ...rows.map((e) => e.join(","))].join("\n");
  const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
  link.setAttribute("download", `sec_edgar_filings_report_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
}

export function downloadFilingHtml(filing: EdgarFiling): void {
  const fullHtml = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>${filing.companyName} (${filing.ticker}) - Form ${filing.form}</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 900px; margin: 40px auto; padding: 0 20px; color: #1e293b; }
    header { border-bottom: 2px solid #0284c7; padding-bottom: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    h1 { margin: 0 0 8px 0; color: #0f172a; }
    .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; background: #e0f2fe; color: #0369a1; }
    .risk-highlight { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 600; }
    .metrics { display: flex; gap: 16px; background: #f8fafc; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 24px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
    .metric { text-align: center; }
    .metric-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #0f172a; }
    .metric-label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header>
    <span class="badge">SEC EDGAR • FORM ${filing.form}</span>
    <h1>${filing.companyName} (${filing.ticker})</h1>
    <p>Accession: ${filing.accessionNumber} | CIK: ${filing.cik} | Filing Date: ${filing.filingDate}</p>
  </header>
  <div class="metrics">
    <div class="metric"><div class="metric-value">${filing.summary.risk_mentions}</div><div class="metric-label">Risk Mentions</div></div>
    <div class="metric"><div class="metric-value">${filing.summary.revenue_mentions}</div><div class="metric-label">Revenue Mentions</div></div>
    <div class="metric"><div class="metric-value">${filing.summary.guidance_mentions}</div><div class="metric-label">Guidance Mentions</div></div>
    <div class="metric"><div class="metric-value">${filing.summary.word_count}</div><div class="metric-label">Word Count</div></div>
    <div class="metric"><div class="metric-value">${filing.summary.sentiment_score}</div><div class="metric-label">Sentiment</div></div>
  </div>
  <article>
    ${filing.htmlContent}
  </article>
</body>
</html>`;

  const blob = new Blob([fullHtml], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${filing.ticker}_${filing.form}_${filing.accessionNumber}.html`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

  {
    id: "latest_10k",
    title: "1. Latest 10-Ks",
    description: "Retrieve all annual 10-K reports sorted by filing date descending",
    sql: `SELECT\n    ticker,\n    filing_date,\n    accession_number\nFROM filings\nWHERE form_type='10-K'\nORDER BY filing_date DESC;`,

    description: "Query extracted GAAP XBRL facts for Revenue across all entities",
    sql: `SELECT\n    period_end,\n    concept,\n    value\nFROM financial_facts\nWHERE concept='Revenue'\nORDER BY period_end DESC;`,
  },
  {
    id: "ai_search",
    title: "4. pgvector AI Search",
    description: "Cosine similarity search over Item 1A and 8.01 1536-dim embeddings",
    sql: `SELECT content\nFROM filing_embeddings\nORDER BY embedding <=> :query_embedding\nLIMIT 5;`,
  },
];

export function executePostgreSqlQuery(rawSql: string, vectorQueryParam?: string): PostgresQueryResult {
  const startTime = performance.now();
  const sql = rawSql.trim().replace(/;/g, "");
  const normalized = sql.toLowerCase();

  let columns: string[] = [];
  let rows: (string | number | null)[][] = [];

  if (normalized.includes("from filing_embeddings") || normalized.includes("<=>")) {
    // Vector search simulation
    columns = ["accession_number", "ticker", "section", "similarity_score", "content"];
    const queryTerm = (vectorQueryParam || "risk").toLowerCase();
    
    const scored = SEED_POSTGRES_EMBEDDINGS.map((emb) => {
      let score = 0.55;
      const lowerContent = emb.content.toLowerCase();
      for (const tag of emb.tags) {
        if (queryTerm.includes(tag) || tag.includes(queryTerm)) score += 0.25;
      }
      const words = queryTerm.split(/\s+/);
      for (const w of words) {
        if (w.length > 3 && lowerContent.includes(w)) score += 0.15;
      }
      return { ...emb, score: Math.min(0.98, Number(score.toFixed(3))) };
    });

    scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    rows = scored.slice(0, 5).map((r) => [
      r.accession_number,
      r.ticker,
      r.section,
      `${(r.score * 100).toFixed(1)}% match`,
      r.content,
    ]);
  } else if (normalized.includes("from financial_facts")) {
    if (normalized.includes("concept='revenue'") || normalized.includes('concept="revenue"')) {
      columns = ["period_end", "concept", "value"];
      rows = SEED_POSTGRES_FACTS.filter((f) => f.concept === "Revenue")
        .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.period_end).getTime() - new Date(a.period_end).getTime())
        .map((f) => [f.period_end, f.concept, `$${(f.value / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B (${f.value.toLocaleString()} USD)`]);
    } else {
      columns = ["accession_number", "concept", "value", "unit", "period_end"];
      rows = SEED_POSTGRES_FACTS.map((f) => [
        f.accession_number,
        f.concept,
        `$${(f.value / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B`,
        f.unit,
        f.period_end,
      ]);
    }
  } else if (normalized.includes("from filings")) {
    if (normalized.includes("form_type='10-k'") || normalized.includes('form_type="10-k"')) {
      columns = ["ticker", "filing_date", "accession_number"];
      rows = SEED_POSTGRES_FILINGS.filter((f) => f.form_type === "10-K")
        .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.filing_date).getTime() - new Date(a.filing_date).getTime())
        .map((f) => [f.ticker, f.filing_date, f.accession_number]);
    } else if (normalized.includes("form_type='8-k'") || normalized.includes('form_type="8-k"')) {
      columns = ["accession_number", "cik", "ticker", "company_name", "form_type", "filing_date"];
      rows = SEED_POSTGRES_FILINGS.filter((f) => f.form_type === "8-K")
        .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.filing_date).getTime() - new Date(a.filing_date).getTime())
        .map((f) => [f.accession_number, f.cik, f.ticker, f.company_name, f.form_type, f.filing_date]);
    } else {
      columns = ["accession_number", "cik", "ticker", "company_name", "form_type", "filing_date"];
      rows = SEED_POSTGRES_FILINGS.map((f) => [
        f.accession_number,
        f.cik,
        f.ticker,
        f.company_name,
        f.form_type,
        f.filing_date,
      ]);
    }
  } else {
    // Generic fallback query response
    columns = ["accession_number", "ticker", "company_name", "form_type", "filing_date"];
    rows = SEED_POSTGRES_FILINGS.slice(0, 5).map((f) => [
      f.accession_number,
      f.ticker,
      f.company_name,
      f.form_type,
      f.filing_date,
    ]);
  }

  const executionTimeMs = Number((performance.now() - startTime).toFixed(2));

  return {
    columns,
    rows,
    rowCount: rows.length,
    executionTimeMs,
    query: rawSql,
  };
}

export function exportDuckDbParquetScript(): void {
  const pythonScript = `# =============================================================================
# Token World Exchange ATS® (TWE)
# Creator: Mauro Lomibao Dar III <maurodar08@gmail.com>
# 945 Westholme Avenue Los Angeles California 90024
#
# DuckDB Parquet Ingestion & Quantitative Analytics Pipeline
# =============================================================================
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import json

print("Initializing DuckDB In-Memory & Parquet Pipeline...")
con = duckdb.connect("sec_edgar_analytics.duckdb")

# 1. Install & load spatial/vector extensions if needed
con.execute("INSTALL json; LOAD json;")

# 2. Ingest hybrid relational tables from CSV
print("Ingesting SEC filings and financial facts...")
con.execute("""
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE filings AS 
SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('filings.csv');

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE financial_facts AS 
SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('financial_facts.csv');

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE filing_embeddings AS 
SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('filing_embeddings.csv');
""")

# 3. Export high-performance compressed Parquet files
print("Exporting compressed Parquet files (ZSTD)...")
con.execute("COPY filings TO 'filings.parquet' (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION ZSTD);")
con.execute("COPY financial_facts TO 'financial_facts.parquet' (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION ZSTD);")
con.execute("COPY filing_embeddings TO 'filing_embeddings.parquet' (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION ZSTD);")

# 4. Multi-entity quantitative screening query (Power BI / Pandas ready)
print("Executing quantitative GAAP XBRL fact screening...")
df_revenue = con.execute("""
    SELECT 
        f.ticker,
        f.company_name,
        ff.concept,
        ff.value,
        ff.period_end,
        f.form_type,
        f.filing_date
    FROM filings f
    JOIN financial_facts ff ON f.accession_number = ff.accession_number
    WHERE ff.concept = 'Revenue'
    ORDER BY ff.period_end DESC;
""").df()

print("Top GAAP Revenue Records:")
print(df_revenue.head(10))

# 5. Export processed facts to Power BI format
df_revenue.to_csv("power_bi_feed.csv", index=False)
print("SUCCESS: DuckDB Parquet pipeline executed. Ready for Pandas and Power BI.")
`;

  const blob = new Blob([pythonScript], { type: "text/x-python;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `export_duckdb_parquet_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.py`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function exportPandasCsvBundle(): void {
  // Filings CSV
  const filingsHeaders = ["accession_number", "cik", "ticker", "company_name", "form_type", "filing_date", "filing_url"];
  const filingsRows = SEED_POSTGRES_FILINGS.map((f) => [
    `"${f.accession_number}"`,
    `"${f.cik}"`,
    `"${f.ticker}"`,
    `"${f.company_name.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${f.form_type}"`,
    `"${f.filing_date}"`,
    `"${f.filing_url}"`,
  ]);
  const filingsCsv = [filingsHeaders.join(","), ...filingsRows.map((r) => r.join(","))].join("\n");

  // Financial Facts CSV
  const factsHeaders = ["accession_number", "concept", "value", "unit", "period_end"];
  const factsRows = SEED_POSTGRES_FACTS.map((f) => [
    `"${f.accession_number}"`,
    `"${f.concept}"`,
    f.value,
    `"${f.unit}"`,
    `"${f.period_end}"`,
  ]);
  const factsCsv = [factsHeaders.join(","), ...factsRows.map((r) => r.join(","))].join("\n");

  // Embeddings CSV
  const embHeaders = ["id", "accession_number", "ticker", "chunk_id", "section", "content", "tags"];
  const embRows = SEED_POSTGRES_EMBEDDINGS.map((e) => [
    e.id,
    `"${e.accession_number}"`,
    `"${e.ticker}"`,
    e.chunk_id,
    `"${e.section}"`,
    `"${e.content.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${e.tags.join(";")}"`,
  ]);
  const embCsv = [embHeaders.join(","), ...embRows.map((r) => r.join(","))].join("\n");

  // Combined bundle format
  const combinedPayload = `=== FILINGS METADATA (filings.csv) ===\n${filingsCsv}\n\n=== FINANCIAL FACTS (financial_facts.csv) ===\n${factsCsv}\n\n=== FILING EMBEDDINGS (filing_embeddings.csv) ===\n${embCsv}\n`;

  const blob = new Blob([combinedPayload], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `pandas_sec_analytics_bundle_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

/**
 * GOOGLE WORKSPACE SERVICE
 * 
 * Provides end-to-end authentication and API access for:
 * 1. Google Workspace OAuth (In-Memory Access Token Caching per AIS Skill guidelines)
 * 2. Gmail Threads & Messages API (fetching threads, detailed multi-turn messages, sending, drafting)
 * 3. Google Keep Notes (fetching, real-time Firestore synchronization, checklists, tags)
 * 4. Token Description Importer (transforming Keep notes and Gmail threads into rich token descriptions)
 */

import {
  GoogleAuthProvider,
  signInWithPopup,
  signOut,
  onAuthStateChanged,
  User,
} from "firebase/auth";
import { auth, db } from "../lib/firebase";
import {
  collection,
  doc,
  setDoc,
  deleteDoc,
  getDocs,
  query,
  orderBy,
  onSnapshot,
  serverTimestamp,
} from "firebase/firestore";
import { TokenRecord } from "../types";

// ============================================================================
// CONFIGURATION & SCOPES
// ============================================================================

export const WORKSPACE_GMAIL_SCOPES = [
  "https://mail.google.com/",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.compose",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.labels",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.metadata",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.insert",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.settings.basic",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.settings.sharing",
];

// In-Memory Token Cache (CRITICAL per Workspace Integration Skill: NEVER in localStorage/sessionStorage)
let inMemoryAccessToken: string | null = null;
let isAuthenticating = false;

// Google Auth Provider configured with Workspace scopes
const googleProvider = new GoogleAuthProvider();
WORKSPACE_GMAIL_SCOPES.forEach((scope) => {
  googleProvider.addScope(scope);
});
googleProvider.setCustomParameters({
  prompt: "consent",
  access_type: "offline",
});

// ============================================================================
// DATA INTERFACES
// ============================================================================

export interface GmailMessageSummary {
  id: string;
  threadId: string;
  subject: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  date: string;
  snippet: string;
  labelIds: string[];
  unread: boolean;
  starred: boolean;
  bodyPreview?: string;
}

export interface GmailThreadSummary {
  id: string;
  snippet: string;
  historyId: string;
  messagesCount: number;
  subject: string;
  senders: string[];
  recipients: string[];
  latestDate: string;
  unread: boolean;
  starred: boolean;
  labelIds: string[];
  messages: GmailMessageSummary[];
}

export interface KeepNoteItem {

}

export interface GoogleKeepNote {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  items?: KeepNoteItem[];
  color: string;
  pinned: boolean;
  archived: boolean;
  tags: string[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  userId?: string;
  source?: "manual" | "gmail_clip" | "ai_prompt" | "token_spec";
  linkedTokenId?: string;
  importedToTokenId?: string;
}

// ============================================================================
// AUTHENTICATION METHODS
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Initializes Workspace Auth listener and notifies callbacks of user changes.
 */
export const initWorkspaceAuth = (
  onAuthSuccess?: (user: User, token: string) => void,
  onAuthFailure?: () => void
) => {
  return onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user: User | null) => {
    if (user) {
      if (inMemoryAccessToken) {
        if (onAuthSuccess) onAuthSuccess(user, inMemoryAccessToken);
      } else if (!isAuthenticating) {
        if (onAuthFailure) onAuthFailure();
      }
    } else {
      inMemoryAccessToken = null;
      if (onAuthFailure) onAuthFailure();
    }
  });
};

/**
 * Authenticates user with Google popup and stores OAuth access token in-memory.
 */
export const authenticateWorkspace = async (): Promise<{
  user: User;
  accessToken: string;
}> => {
  try {
    isAuthenticating = true;
    const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
    const credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credentialFromResult(result);
    if (!credential?.accessToken) {
      throw new Error("Did not receive Google Workspace OAuth access token.");
    }
    inMemoryAccessToken = credential.accessToken;
    return { user: result.user, accessToken: inMemoryAccessToken };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Google Workspace authentication error:", error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    isAuthenticating = false;
  }
};

/**
 * Legacy alias for authenticateWorkspace
 */
export const signInWithGoogleWorkspace = authenticateWorkspace;

/**
 * Returns current in-memory access token.
 */
export const getWorkspaceAccessToken = (): string | null => {
  return inMemoryAccessToken;
};

/**
 * Explicitly sets the in-memory access token (used during initial handshakes)
 */
export const setWorkspaceAccessToken = (token: string | null) => {
  inMemoryAccessToken = token;
};

/**
 * Logs out and clears the in-memory token.
 */
export const logoutWorkspace = async (): Promise<void> => {
  inMemoryAccessToken = null;
  await signOut(auth);
};

// ============================================================================
// GMAIL THREADS & MESSAGES REST API
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Fetches Gmail threads with aggregated metadata, subject, senders, and message counts.
 */
export async function fetchGmailThreads(
  queryParam = "in:inbox",
  maxResults = 10
): Promise<GmailThreadSummary[]> {
  const token = getWorkspaceAccessToken();
  if (!token) {
    // If not authenticated, return realistic sample threads for instant UI verification
    return SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS;
  }

  try {
    const url = `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/threads?q=${encodeURIComponent(
      queryParam
    )}&maxResults=${maxResults}`;

    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errorText = await res.text();
      console.warn(`Gmail Threads API warning (${res.status}): ${errorText}. Using sample threads.`);
      return SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS;
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.threads || !Array.isArray(data.threads)) {
      return SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS;
    }

    // Fetch full thread details for each thread ID
    const threadDetails: GmailThreadSummary[] = await Promise.all(
      data.threads.slice(0, maxResults).map(async (th: { id: string; snippet?: string; historyId?: string }) => {
        try {
          return await fetchGmailThreadDetail(th.id, token);
        } catch (err) {
          return {
            id: th.id,
            snippet: th.snippet || "Discussion thread...",
            historyId: th.historyId || "0",
            messagesCount: 1,
            subject: "Workspace Thread",
            senders: ["Sender"],
            recipients: ["Me"],
            latestDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
            unread: false,
            starred: false,
            labelIds: ["INBOX"],
            messages: [],
          };
        }
      })
    );

    return threadDetails.length > 0 ? threadDetails : SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn("fetchGmailThreads failed, falling back to sample threads:", error);
    return SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS;
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches single Gmail thread details including all messages in the thread.
 */
export async function fetchGmailThreadDetail(
  threadId: string,
  providedToken?: string
): Promise<GmailThreadSummary> {
  const token = providedToken || getWorkspaceAccessToken();
  if (!token) {
    const found = SAMPLE_GMAIL_THREADS.find((t) => t.id === threadId);
    if (found) return found;
    throw new Error("No Google Workspace access token available.");
  }

  const url = `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/threads/${threadId}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=Subject&metadataHeaders=From&metadataHeaders=To&metadataHeaders=Date`;
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to load thread ${threadId}`);
  }

  const json = await res.json();
  const rawMessages = json.messages || [];

  let threadSubject = "";
  const sendersSet = new Set<string>();
  const recipientsSet = new Set<string>();
  let hasUnread = false;
  let hasStarred = false;
  const allLabelIds = new Set<string>();

  const messages: GmailMessageSummary[] = rawMessages.map((msg: any) => {
    const headers = msg.payload?.headers || [];
    const getHeader = (name: string) => {
      const found = headers.find((h: any) => h.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase());
      return found ? found.value : "";
    };

    const sub = getHeader("Subject");
    if (sub && !threadSubject) threadSubject = sub;

    const fromVal = getHeader("From") || "Unknown";
    const toVal = getHeader("To") || "Me";
    sendersSet.add(fromVal);
    recipientsSet.add(toVal);

    const labels: string[] = msg.labelIds || [];
    labels.forEach((l) => allLabelIds.add(l));

    const isUnread = labels.includes("UNREAD");
    const isStarred = labels.includes("STARRED");
    if (isUnread) hasUnread = true;
    if (isStarred) hasStarred = true;

    return {
      id: msg.id,
      threadId: msg.threadId || threadId,
      subject: sub || threadSubject || "(No Subject)",
      from: fromVal,
      to: toVal,
      date: getHeader("Date") || new Date().toLocaleString(),
      snippet: msg.snippet || "",
      labelIds: labels,
      unread: isUnread,
      starred: isStarred,
      bodyPreview: msg.snippet,
    };
  });

  const latestMsg = messages[messages.length - 1];

  return {
    id: json.id,
    snippet: json.snippet || latestMsg?.snippet || "",
    historyId: json.historyId || "0",
    messagesCount: messages.length,
    subject: threadSubject || "(No Subject)",
    senders: Array.from(sendersSet),
    recipients: Array.from(recipientsSet),
    latestDate: latestMsg?.date || new Date().toLocaleDateString(),
    unread: hasUnread,
    starred: hasStarred,
    labelIds: Array.from(allLabelIds),
    messages,
  };
}

/**
 * Sends an email message through Gmail API v1
 */
export async function sendGmailEmail(options: {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  body: string;
  cc?: string;
}): Promise<{ id: string; threadId: string }> {
  const token = getWorkspaceAccessToken();
  if (!token) {
    throw new Error("No Google Workspace token in memory. Please sign in with Google.");
  }

  const utf8Subject = `=?utf-8?B?${btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(options.subject)))}?=`;
  const emailLines = [
    `To: ${options.to}`,
    ...(options.cc ? [`Cc: ${options.cc}`] : []),
    `Subject: ${utf8Subject}`,
    "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8",
    "MIME-Version: 1.0",
    "",
    options.body,
  ];

  const emailRaw = emailLines.join("\r\n");
  const base64EncodedEmail = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(emailRaw)))
    .replace(/\+/g, "-")
    .replace(/\//g, "_")
    .replace(/=+$/, "");

  const res = await fetch("https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/send", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      raw: base64EncodedEmail,
    }),
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errorBody = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to send email (${res.status}): ${errorBody}`);
  }

  return await res.json();
}

/**
 * Creates a Gmail draft message
 */
export async function createGmailDraft(options: {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  body: string;
}): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  const token = getWorkspaceAccessToken();
  if (!token) {
    throw new Error("No Google Workspace token in memory. Please sign in with Google.");
  }

  const utf8Subject = `=?utf-8?B?${btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(options.subject)))}?=`;
  const emailLines = [
    `To: ${options.to}`,
    `Subject: ${utf8Subject}`,
    "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8",
    "MIME-Version: 1.0",
    "",
    options.body,
  ];

  const emailRaw = emailLines.join("\r\n");
  const base64EncodedEmail = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(emailRaw)))
    .replace(/\+/g, "-")
    .replace(/\//g, "_")
    .replace(/=+$/, "");

  const res = await fetch("https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/drafts", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      message: {
        raw: base64EncodedEmail,
      },
    }),
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errorBody = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Failed to create draft (${res.status}): ${errorBody}`);
  }

  return await res.json();
}

// ============================================================================
// GOOGLE KEEP NOTES (FETCHING & FIRESTORE SYNCHRONIZATION)
// ============================================================================

export const KEEP_COLLECTION = "keep_notes";

/**
 * Fetches all Google Keep notes from Firestore.
 */
export async function fetchGoogleKeepNotes(): Promise<GoogleKeepNote[]> {
  try {
    const q = query(collection(db, KEEP_COLLECTION), orderBy("updatedAt", "desc"));
    const snap = await getDocs(q);
    const notes: GoogleKeepNote[] = [];
    snap.forEach((d) => {
      notes.push(d.data() as GoogleKeepNote);
    });
    return notes.length > 0 ? notes : SAMPLE_KEEP_NOTES;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("fetchGoogleKeepNotes error, falling back to samples:", err);
    return SAMPLE_KEEP_NOTES;
  }
}

/**
 * Subscribes in real-time to Google Keep notes in Firestore.
 */
export function subscribeToGoogleKeepNotes(callback: (notes: GoogleKeepNote[]) => void) {
  try {
    const q = query(collection(db, KEEP_COLLECTION), orderBy("updatedAt", "desc"));
    return onSnapshot(
      q,
      (snapshot) => {
        const notes: GoogleKeepNote[] = [];
        snapshot.forEach((d) => {
          notes.push(d.data() as GoogleKeepNote);
        });
        if (notes.length > 0) {
          callback(notes);
        } else {
          callback(SAMPLE_KEEP_NOTES);
        }
      },
      (err) => {
        console.warn("Firestore keep_notes subscription warning, using fallback:", err);
        callback(SAMPLE_KEEP_NOTES);
      }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Failed to subscribe to keep_notes:", err);
    callback(SAMPLE_KEEP_NOTES);
    return () => {};
  }
}

/**
 * Persists a Google Keep note to Firestore.
 */
export async function saveGoogleKeepNote(note: GoogleKeepNote): Promise<void> {
  const docRef = doc(db, KEEP_COLLECTION, note.id);
  await setDoc(
    docRef,
    {
      ...note,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      _serverTimestamp: serverTimestamp(),
    },
    { merge: true }
  );
}

/**
 * Deletes a Google Keep note from Firestore.
 */
export async function deleteGoogleKeepNote(noteId: string): Promise<void> {
  const docRef = doc(db, KEEP_COLLECTION, noteId);
  await deleteDoc(docRef);
}

// ============================================================================
// TOKEN DESCRIPTION IMPORT & FORMATTING ENGINE
// ============================================================================

export interface FormatDescriptionOptions {
  includeTitle?: boolean;
  includeChecklist?: boolean;
  includeTags?: boolean;
  includeSourceAttribution?: boolean;
  mode?: "replace" | "append";
  maxWords?: number;
}

/**
 * Converts a Google Keep Note into a rich, structured token description
 * suitable for Web3 protocols, tokenomics documentation, and marketplace listings.
 */
export function formatNoteAsTokenDescription(
  note: GoogleKeepNote,
  options: FormatDescriptionOptions = {}
): string {
  const {
    includeTitle = true,
    includeChecklist = true,
    includeTags = true,
    includeSourceAttribution = false,
  } = options;

  const sections: string[] = [];

  // Title section
  if (includeTitle && note.title) {
    const cleanTitle = note.title.trim();
    sections.push(cleanTitle);
  }

  // Core narrative content
  if (note.content && note.content.trim()) {
    sections.push(note.content.trim());
  }

  // Checklist / Deliverables milestone summary
  if (includeChecklist && note.items && note.items.length > 0) {
    const checklistText = note.items
      .map((item) => `• [${item.completed ? "✓ Audited" : "In Progress"}] ${item.text}`)
      .join("\n");
    sections.push(`Roadmap & Verification Status:\n${checklistText}`);
  }

  // Narrative Tags
  if (includeTags && note.tags && note.tags.length > 0) {
    const tagsText = note.tags.map((t) => (t.startsWith("#") ? t : `#${t}`)).join(" ");
    sections.push(`Narrative Pillars: ${tagsText}`);
  }

  if (includeSourceAttribution) {
    sections.push(`[Imported from Google Keep Note: ${note.id} on ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}]`);
  }

  return sections.join("\n\n");
}

/**
 * Imports a Google Keep note directly into a TokenRecord's description,
 * tags, and market evolution notes.
 */
export function importNoteIntoToken(
  token: TokenRecord,
  note: GoogleKeepNote,
  mode: "replace" | "append" = "replace"
): TokenRecord {
  const generatedDesc = formatNoteAsTokenDescription(note, {
    includeTitle: true,
    includeChecklist: true,
    includeTags: true,
  });

  let finalDescription = generatedDesc;
  if (mode === "append" && token.description && token.description.trim()) {
    finalDescription = `${token.description.trim()}\n\n---\n${generatedDesc}`;
  }

  // Merge tags from note into token tags
  const existingTags = new Set(token.tags || []);
  if (note.tags) {
    note.tags.forEach((t) => existingTags.add(t));
  }

  const updatedToken: TokenRecord = {
    ...token,
    description: finalDescription,
    tags: Array.from(existingTags),
    marketEvolutionNote: `Note imported from Google Keep: "${note.title}" (${new Date().toLocaleDateString()})`,
    generationPrompt: token.generationPrompt || generatedDesc,
  };

  return updatedToken;
}

/**
 * Formats a Gmail Thread into a token description (capturing consensus or community thread discussions).
 */
export function formatGmailThreadAsTokenDescription(
  thread: GmailThreadSummary
): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  parts.push(`Protocol Discussion: ${thread.subject}`);
  parts.push(`Summary: ${thread.snippet}`);
  parts.push(
    `Thread Metrics: ${thread.messagesCount} message(s) involving ${thread.senders.join(", ")}.`
  );

  if (thread.messages.length > 0) {
    const messageLog = thread.messages
      .slice(-3) // Last 3 messages
      .map((m) => `[${m.from.split("<")[0].trim()} - ${m.date}]: "${m.snippet}"`)
      .join("\n");
    parts.push(`Recent Thread Log:\n${messageLog}`);
  }

  return parts.join("\n\n");
}

export function resolveTokenGenre(token: Partial<TokenRecord>): Web3Genre {
  if (token.genre) return token.genre;
  if (token.narrative === "quantum_defi" || token.narrative === "rwa" || token.narrative === "liquid_restaking") {
    return "defi_liquidity";
  }
  if (token.isVanity || token.tokenStandard === "ERC-4337") {
    return "onchain_identity";
  }
  if (token.narrative === "autonomous_worlds" || token.tokenStandard === "ERC-721" || token.tokenStandard === "ERC-1155") {
    return "gaming_media";
  }
  if (token.narrative === "depin" || token.narrative === "ai_agents") {
    return "depin_infra";
  }
  return "defi_liquidity";
}

import Prism from "prismjs";

// Ensure base prism grammar dependencies are loaded safely
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  // Browser environment
}

/**
 * Custom EVM ABI grammar definition for Prism.js
 * Explicitly separates and tokenizes:
 * 1. ABI Keys (e.g., "name", "type", "inputs", "outputs", "stateMutability", "internalType", "indexed")
 * 2. EVM Types (e.g., "address", "uint256", "bool", "bytes32", "string", "tuple", "uint8", array suffixes)
 * 3. EVM Function / Event Keywords (e.g., "function", "event", "constructor", "view", "pure", "nonpayable", "payable")
 * 4. Values (e.g., "transfer", "balanceOf", "recipient", "amount")
 * 5. JavaScript language keywords (for single-line ethers, viem, web3 wrapper expressions)
 */
export function initAbiPrismGrammar() {
  if (Prism.languages.evmAbi) {
    return;
  }

  Prism.languages.evmAbi = {
    // JavaScript keywords for wrapper code: const, let, new, import, await, etc.
    "abi-js-keyword": {
      pattern: /\b(const|let|var|new|import|export|from|await|async|return|function)\b(?!\s*[:=]\s*["'])/,
      alias: "keyword",
    },

    // Cast CLI command tokens
    "abi-cli-command": {
      pattern: /\b(cast|call|send|rpc|forge|anvil)\b/,
      alias: "builtin",
    },

    // ABI JSON Property Keys (specifically preceding a colon in JSON or object literals)
    "abi-key": {
      pattern: /"(?:name|type|inputs|outputs|stateMutability|constant|payable|anonymous|indexed|components|internalType)"(?=\s*:)/,
      greedy: true,
    },

    // EVM Types: in JSON string values ("address", "uint256") or unquoted in human-readable signatures
    "abi-type": {
      pattern: /"(?:address|uint256|uint8|uint16|uint32|uint64|uint128|int256|int8|int16|int32|int64|int128|bool|string|bytes32|bytes4|bytes|tuple)(?:\[\d*\])*"|\b(?:address|uint256|uint8|uint16|uint32|uint64|uint128|int256|int8|int16|int32|int64|int128|bool|string|bytes32|bytes4|bytes|tuple)(?:\[\d*\])*\b/,
      greedy: true,
    },

    // EVM Entry Kinds & State Mutabilities
    "abi-keyword": {
      pattern: /"(?:function|event|constructor|error|receive|fallback|view|pure|nonpayable|payable)"|\b(?:function|event|constructor|error|receive|fallback|returns|view|pure|payable|nonpayable|indexed|anonymous)\b/,
      greedy: true,
    },

    // Ethereum Addresses (e.g., 0x5AFE... or 0x000...)
    "abi-address": {
      pattern: /0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}\b/,
      greedy: true,
    },

    // General string values (e.g., function names, variable names, descriptions)
    "abi-value": {
      pattern: /"(?:\\.|[^\\"\r\n])*"/,
      greedy: true,
    },

    // Booleans
    "abi-boolean": {
      pattern: /\b(?:true|false)\b/,
      alias: "boolean",
    },

    // Numbers
    "abi-number": {
      pattern: /\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b/,
      alias: "number",
    },

    // Delimiters & Punctuation: braces, brackets, colons, commas, semicolons
    "abi-punctuation": {
      pattern: /[{}[\],;:()]/,
      alias: "punctuation",
    },

    // Operators
    "abi-operator": {
      pattern: /[=+\-*/%&|^~<>!]/,
      alias: "operator",
    },
  };
}

// Auto-initialize grammar
initAbiPrismGrammar();

export interface HighlightStats {
  keyCount: number;
  typeCount: number;
  valueCount: number;
  keywordCount: number;
}

/**
 * Highlights an ABI string using Prism.js with custom EVM ABI tokens.
 * Returns safe HTML with classes for key, value, and type distinction.
 */
export function highlightAbiString(code: string): { html: string; stats: HighlightStats } {
  if (!code) {
    return {
      html: "",
      stats: { keyCount: 0, typeCount: 0, valueCount: 0, keywordCount: 0 },
    };
  }

  initAbiPrismGrammar();

  // Run Prism highlighting
  const grammar = Prism.languages.evmAbi || Prism.languages.javascript;
  const html = Prism.highlight(code, grammar, "evmAbi");

  // Calculate quick stats from rendered tokens
  const keyMatches = html.match(/class="[^"]*abi-key[^"]*"/g);
  const typeMatches = html.match(/class="[^"]*abi-type[^"]*"/g);
  const keywordMatches = html.match(/class="[^"]*abi-keyword[^"]*"/g);
  const valueMatches = html.match(/class="[^"]*abi-value[^"]*"/g);

  return {
    html,
    stats: {
      keyCount: keyMatches ? keyMatches.length : 0,
      typeCount: typeMatches ? typeMatches.length : 0,
      keywordCount: keywordMatches ? keywordMatches.length : 0,
      valueCount: valueMatches ? valueMatches.length : 0,
    },
  };
}
