  // ALLOCATE LIQUIDITY FOR A SINGLE TOKEN
  public allocateLiquidityForToken(token: TokenRecord, depthMultiplier: number = 1.0): SymbolOrderBook {
    const symbol = token.symbol;
    const refPrice = token.priceUsd > 0 ? token.priceUsd : 50.0;
    const bids: AtsOrder[] = [];
    const asks: AtsOrder[] = [];

    // Scale order size based on token market cap and price
    const mcap = token.marketCap > 0 ? token.marketCap : 50_000_000;
    const baseSharesPerOrder = Math.max(
      1000,
      Math.min(500000, Math.round((mcap / (refPrice * 50)) * depthMultiplier))
    );

    const spreadSteps = [0.0025, 0.006, 0.012, 0.022, 0.035, 0.05];
    const tiers: ("QIB_RULE_144A" | "ACCREDITED_REG_D" | "OFFSHORE_REG_S")[] = [
      "QIB_RULE_144A",
      "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
      "QIB_RULE_144A",
      "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
      "OFFSHORE_REG_S",
      "QIB_RULE_144A",
    ];

    const qibAddresses = [
      "0x3A9F1B229D48C1C82902bC017845fD24E67Ac08E",
      "0x789d98F8aC61466A8E1b3BfFa6c1B61942E285bF",
      "0x12bE66708709320Ac321A858712C208492E69d12",
      "0x9812A27F11C871A6992dC8817282bAc60E21e905",
      "0x44BcA912c98F9082A81B0941F480414B60Ef110C",
      "0x56aD9818C0bA176840715D081Ba722e0e9819921",
    ];

    spreadSteps.forEach((pct, idx) => {
      const bidPrice = Number(Math.max(0.0001, refPrice * (1 - pct)).toFixed(refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2));
      const askPrice = Number((refPrice * (1 + pct)).toFixed(refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2));
      const qty = Math.round(baseSharesPerOrder * (1 + idx * 0.4));
      const addr = qibAddresses[idx % qibAddresses.length];

      bids.push({
        id: `ORD-B${idx + 1}-${symbol}`,
        traderAddress: addr,
        side: "BUY",
        price: bidPrice,
        quantity: qty,
        initialQuantity: qty,
        timestamp: Date.now() - (idx + 1) * 35000,
        status: "OPEN",
        orderType: "LIMIT",
        investorTier: tiers[idx],
      });

      asks.push({
        id: `ORD-S${idx + 1}-${symbol}`,
        traderAddress: qibAddresses[(idx + 3) % qibAddresses.length],
        side: "SELL",
        price: askPrice,
        quantity: qty,
        initialQuantity: qty,
        timestamp: Date.now() - (idx + 1) * 32000,
        status: "OPEN",
        orderType: "LIMIT",
        investorTier: tiers[idx],
      });
    });

    this.sortBook(bids, asks);

    const bestBid = bids.length ? bids[0].price : Number((refPrice * 0.998).toFixed(refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2));
    const bestAsk = asks.length ? asks[0].price : Number((refPrice * 1.002).toFixed(refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2));
    const spread = Number(Math.max(0, bestAsk - bestBid).toFixed(refPrice < 1 ? 4 : 2));
    const bidUsd = bids.reduce((acc, b) => acc + b.price * b.quantity, 0);
    const askUsd = asks.reduce((acc, a) => acc + a.price * a.quantity, 0);
    const shares = bids.reduce((acc, b) => acc + b.quantity, 0) + asks.reduce((acc, a) => acc + a.quantity, 0);

    const existingTrades = this.symbolBooks.get(symbol)?.trades;
    const trades = existingTrades && existingTrades.length ? existingTrades : this.generateSampleTrades(symbol, refPrice);

    const book: SymbolOrderBook = {
      symbol,
      tokenName: token.name,
      tokenAddress: token.contractAddress,
      chain: token.chain,
      referencePrice: refPrice,
      marketCap: token.marketCap,
      bids,
      asks,
      trades,
      spread,
      bestBid,
      bestAsk,
      totalBidLiquidityUsd: Number(bidUsd.toFixed(2)),
      totalAskLiquidityUsd: Number(askUsd.toFixed(2)),
      totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd: Number((bidUsd + askUsd).toFixed(2)),
      allocatedSharesDepth: shares,
      lastAllocatedAt: Date.now(),
    };

    this.symbolBooks.set(symbol, book);
    return book;
  }

  // ALLOCATE MAXIMUM LIQUIDITY ACROSS ALL TOKENS
  public allocateLiquidityForAllTokens(tokens: TokenRecord[], depthMultiplier: number = 1.0): {
    allocatedCount: number;
    totalBidLiquidityUsd: number;
    totalAskLiquidityUsd: number;
    totalVenueLiquidityUsd: number;
    totalSharesDepth: number;
    symbols: string[];
  } {
    let sumBidUsd = 0;
    let sumAskUsd = 0;
    let sumShares = 0;
    const symbolsList: string[] = [];

    // Always ensure TW-EQ is allocated
    const tweqBook = this.getBook("TW-EQ");
    sumBidUsd += tweqBook.totalBidLiquidityUsd;
    sumAskUsd += tweqBook.totalAskLiquidityUsd;
    sumShares += tweqBook.allocatedSharesDepth;
    symbolsList.push("TW-EQ");

    tokens.forEach((t) => {
      const book = this.allocateLiquidityForToken(t, depthMultiplier);
      sumBidUsd += book.totalBidLiquidityUsd;
      sumAskUsd += book.totalAskLiquidityUsd;
      sumShares += book.allocatedSharesDepth;
      if (!symbolsList.includes(book.symbol)) {
        symbolsList.push(book.symbol);
      }
    });

    return {
      allocatedCount: symbolsList.length,
      totalBidLiquidityUsd: Number(sumBidUsd.toFixed(2)),
      totalAskLiquidityUsd: Number(sumAskUsd.toFixed(2)),
      totalVenueLiquidityUsd: Number((sumBidUsd + sumAskUsd).toFixed(2)),
      totalSharesDepth: sumShares,
      symbols: symbolsList,
    };
  }

  // GET GLOBAL VENUE STATS ACROSS ALL TOKEN BOOKS
  public getGlobalVenueStats(): VenueGlobalStats {
    let totalBids = 0;
    let totalAsks = 0;
    let totalBidUsd = 0;
    let totalAskUsd = 0;
    let totalShares = 0;
    let totalExecutedVolume = 0;
    let totalExecutedTrades = 0;

    this.symbolBooks.forEach((book) => {
      totalBids += book.bids.length;
      totalAsks += book.asks.length;
      totalBidUsd += book.totalBidLiquidityUsd;
      totalAskUsd += book.totalAskLiquidityUsd;
      totalShares += book.allocatedSharesDepth;

      book.trades.forEach((trd) => {
        totalExecutedVolume += trd.totalUsd;
        totalExecutedTrades += 1;
      });
    });

    return {
      totalSymbolsAllocated: this.symbolBooks.size,
      totalOpenBids: totalBids,
      totalOpenAsks: totalAsks,
      totalBidLiquidityUsd: Number(totalBidUsd.toFixed(2)),
      totalAskLiquidityUsd: Number(totalAskUsd.toFixed(2)),
      totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd: Number((totalBidUsd + totalAskUsd).toFixed(2)),
      totalSharesDepth: totalShares,
      totalExecutedVolumeUsd: Number(totalExecutedVolume.toFixed(2)),
      totalExecutedTrades,
      fullSuiteStatus: "MAXIMUM_HIGHEST_STANDARD_ACTIVE",
      settlementSpeed: "ATOMIC_T0_DVP",
      preTradeFirewall: "SEC_RULE_15C3_5_COLLARS_100PCT",
      dtccFastStatus: "RECONCILED_100PCT",
    };
  }

  public getAllAllocatedSymbols(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.symbolBooks.keys());
  }

  public getAllBooks(): SymbolOrderBook[] {
    return Array.from(this.symbolBooks.values());
  }

  // ORDER SUBMISSION & MATCHING
  public addOrder(orderParams: {
    traderAddress: string;
    side: "BUY" | "SELL";
    price: number;
    quantity: number;
    symbol?: string;
    orderType?: "LIMIT" | "MARKET";
    investorTier?: "QIB_RULE_144A" | "ACCREDITED_REG_D" | "OFFSHORE_REG_S";
  }): { order: AtsOrder; matchedTrades: AtsTradeExecution[] } {
    const sym = orderParams.symbol || this.activeSymbol;
    const book = this.getBook(sym);

    const newOrder: AtsOrder = {
      id: `ORD-${orderParams.side[0]}${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`,
      traderAddress: orderParams.traderAddress,
      side: orderParams.side,
      price: orderParams.price,
      quantity: orderParams.quantity,
      initialQuantity: orderParams.quantity,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      status: "OPEN",
      orderType: orderParams.orderType || "LIMIT",
      investorTier: orderParams.investorTier || "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
    };

    if (newOrder.side === "BUY") {
      book.bids.push(newOrder);
    } else {
      book.asks.push(newOrder);
    }

    this.sortBook(book.bids, book.asks);
    const matchedTrades = this.matchOrders(sym);

    // Update book summary
    book.bestBid = book.bids.length ? book.bids[0].price : Number((book.referencePrice * 0.998).toFixed(2));
    book.bestAsk = book.asks.length ? book.asks[0].price : Number((book.referencePrice * 1.002).toFixed(2));
    book.spread = Number(Math.max(0, book.bestAsk - book.bestBid).toFixed(2));
    book.totalBidLiquidityUsd = book.bids.reduce((acc, b) => acc + b.price * b.quantity, 0);
    book.totalAskLiquidityUsd = book.asks.reduce((acc, a) => acc + a.price * a.quantity, 0);
    book.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd = book.totalBidLiquidityUsd + book.totalAskLiquidityUsd;

    return { order: newOrder, matchedTrades };
  }

  private ocoEvents: OcoEventLog[] = [];

  public getOcoEvents(limit: number = 25): OcoEventLog[] {
    return [...this.ocoEvents].slice(0, limit);
  }

  public addOcoEvent(event: Omit<OcoEventLog, "id" | "timestamp">): OcoEventLog {
    const fullEvent: OcoEventLog = {
      id: `EVT-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      ...event,
    };
    this.ocoEvents.unshift(fullEvent);
    if (this.ocoEvents.length > 100) this.ocoEvents.pop();
    return fullEvent;
  }

  public matchOrders(symbol: string = this.activeSymbol): AtsTradeExecution[] {
    const book = this.getBook(symbol);
    const executed: AtsTradeExecution[] = [];

    const buyOrders = book.bids;
    const sellOrders = book.asks;

    while (buyOrders.length > 0 && sellOrders.length > 0) {
      const highestBuy = buyOrders[0];
      const lowestSell = sellOrders[0];

      if (highestBuy.price >= lowestSell.price) {
        const tradePrice = lowestSell.price;
        const tradeQuantity = Math.min(highestBuy.quantity, lowestSell.quantity);

        const now = Date.now();
        const payload = `${highestBuy.traderAddress}:${lowestSell.traderAddress}:${tradeQuantity}:${tradePrice}:${now}`;
        const txHash = ethers.keccak256(ethers.toUtf8Bytes(payload));
        const blockNumber = 21045980 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 50);

        const tradeReceipt: AtsTradeExecution = {
          id: `TRD-${now.toString().slice(-6)}`,
          buyOrderId: highestBuy.id,
          sellOrderId: lowestSell.id,
          buyerAddress: highestBuy.traderAddress,
          sellerAddress: lowestSell.traderAddress,
          symbol,
          quantity: tradeQuantity,
          price: tradePrice,
          totalUsd: Number((tradeQuantity * tradePrice).toFixed(2)),
          timestamp: now,
          txHash,
          blockNumber,
          settlementType: "ATOMIC_DVP_ERC3643",
          dtccFastStatus: "RECONCILED",
        };

        executed.unshift(tradeReceipt);
        book.trades.unshift(tradeReceipt);

        highestBuy.quantity -= tradeQuantity;
        lowestSell.quantity -= tradeQuantity;

        // OCO INVARIANT (First Trigger / Fill):
        // If highestBuy is the Limit leg of an OCO bracket, its execution cancels the paired Stop-Loss leg immediately
        const buyOcoPair = (highestBuy as ExtendedAtsOrder).ocoPairId;
        if (buyOcoPair) {
          const cancelled = this.cancelOrder(buyOcoPair, symbol, false);
          if (cancelled) {
            this.addOcoEvent({
              symbol,
              eventType: "OCO_FILLED_LIMIT",
              triggeredOrderId: highestBuy.id,
              cancelledOrderId: buyOcoPair,
              message: `OCO Buy Limit #${highestBuy.id} executed at $${tradePrice.toFixed(2)}. Paired Stop-Loss #${buyOcoPair} was cancelled immediately.`,
              price: tradePrice,
            });
          }
        }

        // If lowestSell is the Limit leg of an OCO bracket, its execution cancels the paired Stop-Loss leg immediately
        const sellOcoPair = (lowestSell as ExtendedAtsOrder).ocoPairId;
        if (sellOcoPair) {
          const cancelled = this.cancelOrder(sellOcoPair, symbol, false);
          if (cancelled) {
            this.addOcoEvent({
              symbol,
              eventType: "OCO_FILLED_LIMIT",
              triggeredOrderId: lowestSell.id,
              cancelledOrderId: sellOcoPair,
              message: `OCO Sell Limit #${lowestSell.id} executed at $${tradePrice.toFixed(2)}. Paired Stop-Loss #${sellOcoPair} was cancelled immediately.`,
              price: tradePrice,
            });
          }
        }

        if (highestBuy.quantity === 0) buyOrders.shift();
        if (lowestSell.quantity === 0) sellOrders.shift();
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    return executed;
  }

  public cancelOrder(
    orderId: string,
    symbol: string = this.activeSymbol,
    cancelOcoPair: boolean = true
  ): boolean {
    const book = this.getBook(symbol);
    let cancelledOrder: AtsOrder | ExtendedAtsOrder | null = null;

    const bidIndex = book.bids.findIndex((b) => b.id === orderId);
    if (bidIndex !== -1) {
      cancelledOrder = book.bids.splice(bidIndex, 1)[0];
    } else {
      const askIndex = book.asks.findIndex((a) => a.id === orderId);
      if (askIndex !== -1) {
        cancelledOrder = book.asks.splice(askIndex, 1)[0];
      } else if (book.triggerOrders) {
        const trigIndex = book.triggerOrders.findIndex((t) => t.id === orderId);
        if (trigIndex !== -1) {
          cancelledOrder = book.triggerOrders.splice(trigIndex, 1)[0];
        }
      }
    }

    if (cancelledOrder) {
      const pairId = (cancelledOrder as ExtendedAtsOrder).ocoPairId;
      if (cancelOcoPair && pairId) {
        // Automatically cancel the paired leg to avoid leaving an unprotected orphan order
        this.cancelOrder(pairId, symbol, false);
        this.addOcoEvent({
          symbol,
          eventType: "OCO_CANCELLED_USER",
          triggeredOrderId: orderId,
          cancelledOrderId: pairId,
          message: `OCO Order #${orderId} cancelled by user. Paired leg #${pairId} was automatically cancelled.`,
        });
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ADVANCED EXTENDED ORDER ENTRY (MARKET, LIMIT, STOP_LOSS, STOP_LIMIT, OCO)
  public addExtendedOrder(params: {
    traderAddress: string;
    side: "BUY" | "SELL";
    price: number;
    quantity: number;
    symbol?: string;
    orderType: OrderExecutionType;
    stopPrice?: number;
    limitPrice?: number;
    investorTier?: "QIB_RULE_144A" | "ACCREDITED_REG_D" | "OFFSHORE_REG_S";
  }): { placedOrders: ExtendedAtsOrder[]; matchedTrades: AtsTradeExecution[]; message: string } {
    const sym = params.symbol || this.activeSymbol;
    const book = this.getBook(sym);
    if (!book.triggerOrders) book.triggerOrders = [];

    const placedOrders: ExtendedAtsOrder[] = [];
    let matchedTrades: AtsTradeExecution[] = [];

    const now = Date.now();

    if (params.orderType === "OCO") {
      // OCO (One-Cancels-the-Other) creates two mutually linked orders:
      // Leg 1: Take-Profit Limit Order (enters active book immediately)
      // Leg 2: Stop-Loss / Stop-Limit Order (enters trigger queue waiting for trigger price)
      const id1 = `OCO-LIM-${now.toString().slice(-5)}`;
      const id2 = `OCO-STP-${(now + 1).toString().slice(-5)}`;

      const limitPrice = params.price;
      const stopTriggerPrice = params.stopPrice || (params.side === "SELL" ? limitPrice * 0.95 : limitPrice * 1.05);
      const stopExecutionPrice = params.limitPrice || stopTriggerPrice;

      const limitLeg: ExtendedAtsOrder = {
        id: id1,
        traderAddress: params.traderAddress,
        side: params.side,
        price: limitPrice,
        quantity: params.quantity,
        initialQuantity: params.quantity,
        timestamp: now,
        status: "OPEN",
        orderType: "LIMIT",
        ocoPairId: id2,
        investorTier: params.investorTier || "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
      };

      const stopLeg: ExtendedAtsOrder = {
        id: id2,
        traderAddress: params.traderAddress,
        side: params.side,
        price: stopExecutionPrice,
        stopPrice: stopTriggerPrice,
        limitPrice: stopExecutionPrice,
        quantity: params.quantity,
        initialQuantity: params.quantity,
        timestamp: now + 1,
        status: "OPEN",
        orderType: "STOP_LIMIT",
        triggerStatus: "UNTRIGGERED",
        ocoPairId: id1,
        investorTier: params.investorTier || "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
      };

      // Limit leg enters the active order book immediately
      if (limitLeg.side === "BUY") {
        book.bids.push(limitLeg);
      } else {
        book.asks.push(limitLeg);
      }
      this.sortBook(book.bids, book.asks);

      // Stop leg waits in the trigger orders queue
      book.triggerOrders.push(stopLeg);

      placedOrders.push(limitLeg, stopLeg);

      this.addOcoEvent({
        symbol: sym,
        eventType: "OCO_PLACED",
        triggeredOrderId: id1,
        cancelledOrderId: id2,
        message: `OCO Bracket placed: Limit #${id1} at $${limitPrice.toFixed(2)} and Stop Trigger #${id2} at $${stopTriggerPrice.toFixed(2)} (${params.quantity} ${sym})`,
        price: limitPrice,
      });

      // Match orders in case the limit leg crosses existing counter-orders
      matchedTrades = this.matchOrders(sym);

      return {
        placedOrders,
        matchedTrades,
        message: `OCO bracket submitted: Limit Order #${id1} at $${limitPrice.toFixed(2)} and Stop Trigger #${id2} at $${stopTriggerPrice.toFixed(2)}`,
      };
    }

    if (params.orderType === "STOP_LOSS" || params.orderType === "STOP_LIMIT") {
      // Trigger order waiting for market price activation
      const stopOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder = {
        id: `STP-${params.side[0]}${now.toString().slice(-5)}`,
        traderAddress: params.traderAddress,
        side: params.side,
        price: params.limitPrice || params.price,
        stopPrice: params.stopPrice || params.price,
        limitPrice: params.limitPrice || params.price,
        quantity: params.quantity,
        initialQuantity: params.quantity,
        timestamp: now,
        status: "OPEN",
        orderType: params.orderType,
        triggerStatus: "UNTRIGGERED",
        investorTier: params.investorTier || "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
      };

      book.triggerOrders.push(stopOrder);
      placedOrders.push(stopOrder);

      return {
        placedOrders,
        matchedTrades: [],
        message: `${params.orderType} queued: Trigger threshold set at $${(params.stopPrice || params.price).toFixed(2)}`,
      };
    }

    // Standard MARKET or LIMIT order execution
    const stdOrder: ExtendedAtsOrder = {
      id: `ORD-${params.side[0]}${now.toString().slice(-5)}`,
      traderAddress: params.traderAddress,
      side: params.side,
      price: params.price,
      quantity: params.quantity,
      initialQuantity: params.quantity,
      timestamp: now,
      status: "OPEN",
      orderType: params.orderType,
      investorTier: params.investorTier || "ACCREDITED_REG_D",
    };

    if (stdOrder.side === "BUY") {
      book.bids.push(stdOrder);
    } else {
      book.asks.push(stdOrder);
    }
    this.sortBook(book.bids, book.asks);

    matchedTrades = this.matchOrders(sym);
    placedOrders.push(stdOrder);

    // Refresh book metrics
    book.bestBid = book.bids.length ? book.bids[0].price : Number((book.referencePrice * 0.998).toFixed(2));
    book.bestAsk = book.asks.length ? book.asks[0].price : Number((book.referencePrice * 1.002).toFixed(2));
    book.spread = Number(Math.max(0, book.bestAsk - book.bestBid).toFixed(2));
    book.totalBidLiquidityUsd = book.bids.reduce((acc, b) => acc + b.price * b.quantity, 0);
    book.totalAskLiquidityUsd = book.asks.reduce((acc, a) => acc + a.price * a.quantity, 0);
    book.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd = book.totalBidLiquidityUsd + book.totalAskLiquidityUsd;

    return {
      placedOrders,
      matchedTrades,
      message: `${params.orderType} order submitted for ${params.quantity.toLocaleString()} ${sym}`,
    };
  }

  // ACTIVE TRIGGER EVALUATION LOOP FOR REAL-TIME PRICE FEEDS & SIMULATION
  public checkStopLossAndOcoTriggers(
    symbol: string,
    currentMarketPrice: number
  ): OcoTriggerResult {
    const book = this.getBook(symbol);
    if (!book.triggerOrders || book.triggerOrders.length === 0) {
      return { executedTrades: [], triggeredOrders: [], cancelledOcoOrders: [] };
    }

    const executedTrades: AtsTradeExecution[] = [];
    const triggeredOrders: ExtendedAtsOrder[] = [];
    const cancelledOcoOrders: string[] = [];
    const remainingTriggers: ExtendedAtsOrder[] = [];

    book.triggerOrders.forEach((trig) => {
      let isTriggered = false;
      const stopP = trig.stopPrice || trig.price;

      if (trig.side === "BUY" && currentMarketPrice >= stopP) {
        // Buy stop triggered as market price rises (e.g. breakout buy)
        isTriggered = true;
      } else if (trig.side === "SELL" && currentMarketPrice <= stopP) {
        // Sell stop triggered as market drops (e.g. stop-loss protection)
        isTriggered = true;
      }

      if (isTriggered) {
        trig.triggerStatus = "TRIGGERED";
        triggeredOrders.push(trig);

        // ONE-CANCELS-THE-OTHER INVARIANT:
        // When the Stop-Loss order triggers, the paired Limit order in the active book MUST BE CANCELLED immediately!
        if (trig.ocoPairId) {
          const cancelSuccess = this.cancelOrder(trig.ocoPairId, symbol, false);
          if (cancelSuccess) {
            cancelledOcoOrders.push(trig.ocoPairId);
            this.addOcoEvent({
              symbol,
              eventType: "OCO_TRIGGERED_STOP",
              triggeredOrderId: trig.id,
              cancelledOrderId: trig.ocoPairId,
              message: `OCO Stop Trigger #${trig.id} activated at $${currentMarketPrice.toFixed(2)}. Paired Limit order #${trig.ocoPairId} cancelled automatically.`,
              price: currentMarketPrice,
            });
          }
        }

        // Move triggered order into the active order book for execution
        const executionPrice = trig.orderType === "STOP_LIMIT" ? (trig.limitPrice || stopP) : currentMarketPrice;
        trig.price = executionPrice;

        if (trig.side === "BUY") {
          book.bids.push(trig);
        } else {
          book.asks.push(trig);
        }
        this.sortBook(book.bids, book.asks);

        // Run matching engine for newly activated order
        const trades = this.matchOrders(symbol);
        executedTrades.push(...trades);
      } else {
        remainingTriggers.push(trig);
      }
    });

    book.triggerOrders = remainingTriggers;

    // Refresh book metrics
    book.bestBid = book.bids.length ? book.bids[0].price : Number((book.referencePrice * 0.998).toFixed(2));
    book.bestAsk = book.asks.length ? book.asks[0].price : Number((book.referencePrice * 1.002).toFixed(2));
    book.spread = Number(Math.max(0, book.bestAsk - book.bestBid).toFixed(2));
    book.totalBidLiquidityUsd = book.bids.reduce((acc, b) => acc + b.price * b.quantity, 0);
    book.totalAskLiquidityUsd = book.asks.reduce((acc, a) => acc + a.price * a.quantity, 0);
    book.totalAllocatedLiquidityUsd = book.totalBidLiquidityUsd + book.totalAskLiquidityUsd;

    return { executedTrades, triggeredOrders, cancelledOcoOrders };
  }

  // RETRIEVE TRIGGER ORDERS
  public getTriggerOrders(symbol?: string, traderAddress?: string): ExtendedAtsOrder[] {
    const sym = symbol || this.activeSymbol;
    const book = this.getBook(sym);
    if (!book.triggerOrders) return [];
    if (!traderAddress) return [...book.triggerOrders];
    return book.triggerOrders.filter((t) => t.traderAddress.toLowerCase() === traderAddress.toLowerCase());
  }

  public isFullSuiteActive(): boolean {
    return this.fullSuiteEnabled;
  }

  public setOperationalMode(mode: "LIVE_FULL_SUITE" | "SANDBOX_SIMULATION"): void {
    this.operationalMode = mode;
  }

  public getOperationalMode(): "LIVE_FULL_SUITE" | "SANDBOX_SIMULATION" {
    return this.operationalMode;
  }

  public resetToDefault(): void {
    this.symbolBooks.clear();
    this.initDefaultSymbol("TWE", "Token World Exchange ATS® Sovereign Equity", 100.00);
    this.initDefaultSymbol("TW-EQ", "Token World Treasury Growth Equity", 52.50, INITIAL_ORDERS, INITIAL_EXECUTED_TRADES);
    this.initDefaultSymbol("TREE3", "Token World Sovereign TREE3 Security Token", 125.00);
  }
}

// Global in-memory singleton
export const globalAtsEngine = new TokenWorldCLOB();

export const SOLIDITY_SECURITY_TOKEN_SOURCE = `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

/**
 * @title Token World - TokenWorldSecurityToken
 * @notice System: Token World
 * @dev Sole Owner: Mauro Lomibao Dar III
 * @dev Compliant ERC-1400 / ERC-3643 Permissioned Security Token
 * Engineered for Token World Alternative Trading System (ATS)
 * Sole Owner: Mauro Lomibao Dar III
 * Executive Office: 945 Westholme Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90024
 */

interface IIdentityRegistry {
    function isVerified(address _userAddress) external view returns (bool);
    function getInvestorCountry(address _userAddress) external view returns (uint16);
    function isAccredited(address _userAddress) external view returns (bool);
}

contract TokenWorldSecurityToken {
    string public constant SYSTEM_TITLE = "Token World Exchange\u00ae";
    string public constant SOLE_OWNER_CREATOR = "Mauro Lomibao Dar III\u00ae";

    string public name = "Token World Exchange\u00ae Equity";
    string public symbol = "TW-EQ";
    uint8 public constant decimals = 0; // Equity units treated as whole shares
    uint256 public totalSupply;

    address public owner;
    address public transferAgent;
    IIdentityRegistry public identityRegistry;

    // Balances & Permissions
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
    mapping(address => bool) public isFrozen;
    mapping(address => uint256) public lockupExpiry;

    // Events
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event TokensMinted(address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event TokensBurned(address indexed from, uint256 amount);
    event AddressFrozen(address indexed target, bool frozen);
    event IdentityRegistryUpdated(address indexed newRegistry);
    event TransferAgentUpdated(address indexed newAgent);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "TokenWorld: Unauthorized Caller - Not Owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyTransferAgent() {
        require(msg.sender == transferAgent || msg.sender == owner, "TokenWorld: Unauthorized Caller - Not Transfer Agent");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _identityRegistry, address _transferAgent) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        identityRegistry = IIdentityRegistry(_identityRegistry);
        transferAgent = _transferAgent;
        
        // Initial Genesis Authorized Shares for Mauro Lomibao Dar III Treasury
        uint256 genesisShares = 20_000_000;
        totalSupply = genesisShares;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] = genesisShares;
        emit TokensMinted(msg.sender, genesisShares);
        emit Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, genesisShares);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Compliant DvP transfer with Identity Registry enforcement
     */
    function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool) {
        require(!isFrozen[msg.sender], "TokenWorld: Sender address is frozen");
        require(!isFrozen[_to], "TokenWorld: Recipient address is frozen");
        require(block.timestamp >= lockupExpiry[msg.sender], "TokenWorld: Sender shares are in Reg D lockup");
        require(identityRegistry.isVerified(_to), "TokenWorld: Transfer rejected - Recipient KYC not verified in Identity Registry");
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value, "TokenWorld: Insufficient share balance");

        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Mint new shares upon Transfer Agent DTCC deposit
     */
    function mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) external onlyTransferAgent {
        require(identityRegistry.isVerified(_to), "TokenWorld: Mint rejected - Recipient KYC invalid");
        totalSupply += _amount;
        balanceOf[_to] += _amount;
        emit TokensMinted(_to, _amount);
        emit Transfer(address(0), _to, _amount);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Burn shares upon redemption back to traditional NYSE float
     */
    function burn(address _from, uint256 _amount) external onlyTransferAgent {
        require(balanceOf[_from] >= _amount, "TokenWorld: Burn rejected - Insufficient share balance");
        balanceOf[_from] -= _amount;
        totalSupply -= _amount;
        emit TokensBurned(_from, _amount);
        emit Transfer(_from, address(0), _amount);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Compliance Freeze toggle for court order / AML sanctions
     */
    function setAddressFrozen(address _target, bool _frozen) external onlyTransferAgent {
        isFrozen[_target] = _frozen;
        emit AddressFrozen(_target, _frozen);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Set lockup expiry for SEC Regulation D 506(c) restricted periods
     */
    function setLockupExpiry(address _target, uint256 _expiryTimestamp) external onlyTransferAgent {
        lockupExpiry[_target] = _expiryTimestamp;
    }

    function setIdentityRegistry(address _newRegistry) external onlyOwner {
        identityRegistry = IIdentityRegistry(_newRegistry);
        emit IdentityRegistryUpdated(_newRegistry);
    }

    function setTransferAgent(address _newAgent) external onlyOwner {
        transferAgent = _newAgent;
        emit TransferAgentUpdated(_newAgent);
    }
}`;

export const SOLIDITY_TREE3_TOKEN_SOURCE = `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/ERC20Burnable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

/**
 * @title Token World - TREE3Token
 * @notice System: Token World
 * @dev Sole Owner: Mauro Lomibao Dar III
 * @notice Core ERC-20 token for the Token World ecosystem featuring a deterministic TREE(3)-inspired ID generator.
 */
contract TREE3Token is ERC20, ERC20Burnable, Ownable {
    string public constant SYSTEM_TITLE = "Token World";
    string public constant SOLE_OWNER = "Mauro Lomibao Dar III";

    // 1 Quadrillion TREE3 (1,000,000,000,000,000 * 10**18)
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000_000_000 * 10**18;

    event BatchDataIngested(uint256 indexed batchId, uint256 validRecordsCount);
    event Tree3IdGenerated(address indexed account, uint256 indexed nonce, bytes32 tree3Id);

    constructor(address initialOwner) ERC20("Token World TREE3", "TREE3") Ownable(initialOwner) {
        _mint(initialOwner, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Generates a deterministic TREE(3)-inspired identifier based on an address, nonce, and seed block.
     * @param account Target account address
     * @param nonce Transaction or sequence nonce
     * @param seed Arbitrary seed or block variable
     */
    function generateTree3ID(address account, uint256 nonce, uint256 seed) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 step1 = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account, nonce, seed));
        bytes32 step2 = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(step1, account, nonce + 1));
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(step1, step2, seed));
    }
}`;

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

/**
 * @title Token World Exchange® - TokenWorldTreasury
 * @notice System: Token World Exchange®
 * @dev Sole Owner/ Creator: Mauro Lomibao Dar III®
 * @notice Compliant security token using standard ERC-20 patterns with investor whitelisting for Token World Treasury.
 */
contract TokenWorldTreasury {
    string public constant SYSTEM_TITLE = "Token World Exchange\u00ae";
    string public constant SOLE_OWNER_CREATOR = "Mauro Lomibao Dar III\u00ae";

    string public name = "Token World Exchange\u00ae Treasury";
    string public symbol = "TWT";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;
    uint256 public totalSupply;
    address public owner;

    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
    mapping(address => bool) public whitelistedInvestors;

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event WhitelistUpdated(address indexed investor, bool status);
    event BatchWhitelistUpdated(uint256 totalUpdated, bool status);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Token World: Not authorized - Caller is not Sole Owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor(uint256 initialSupply) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        totalSupply = initialSupply * 10**uint256(decimals);
        balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply;
        whitelistedInvestors[msg.sender] = true;
    }

    function setWhitelistStatus(address investor, bool status) external onlyOwner {
        whitelistedInvestors[investor] = status;
        emit WhitelistUpdated(investor, status);
    }

    function batchSetWhitelist(address[] calldata investors, bool status) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < investors.length; i++) {
            whitelistedInvestors[investors[i]] = status;
            emit WhitelistUpdated(investors[i], status);
        }
        emit BatchWhitelistUpdated(investors.length, status);
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool) {
        require(whitelistedInvestors[msg.sender], "Token World: Sender not whitelisted");
        require(whitelistedInvestors[to], "Token World: Recipient not whitelisted");
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= value, "Token World: Insufficient balance");

        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value;
        balanceOf[to] += value;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, to, value);
        return true;
    }
}`;

/**
 * Python CSV Data Sanitizer & Ingestion Script (sanitize_data.py)
 */
export const PYTHON_CSV_SANITIZER_SOURCE = `#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Token World - CSV Data Sanitizer & Validator
System: Token World
Sole Owner: Mauro Lomibao Dar III
Headquarters: 945 Westholme Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90024 | (310) 904-5646

Handles malformed inputs (such as corrupted hex addresses 0xc0rp... and incomplete rows)
before submitting payload data to Token World testnet or contract functions.
"""

import csv
import re
import sys

def is_valid_address(address: str) -> bool:
    """Validates EVM 20-byte hex address format."""
    return bool(re.match(r"^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$", address.strip()))

def sanitize_csv(input_filepath: str, output_filepath: str):
    valid_records = []
    rejected_records = []

    with open(input_filepath, mode='r', encoding='utf-8') as infile:
        reader = csv.DictReader(infile)
        for row_num, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            address = row.get("address", "").strip()
            amount = row.get("amount", "").strip()

            if not address or not amount:
                rejected_records.append((row_num, row, "Incomplete record"))
                continue

            if not is_valid_address(address):
                rejected_records.append((row_num, row, f"Malformed address: {address}"))
                continue

            try:
                valid_amount = int(amount)
                valid_records.append({"address": address, "amount": valid_amount})
            except ValueError:
                rejected_records.append((row_num, row, f"Invalid numeric amount: {amount}"))

    with open(output_filepath, mode='w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as outfile:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(outfile, fieldnames=["address", "amount"])
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(valid_records)

    print(f"[Token World] Ingestion complete. Valid records saved: {len(valid_records)}. Rejected: {len(rejected_records)}.")
    return len(valid_records), len(rejected_records)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    input_file = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "token_input.csv"
    output_file = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "token_sanitized.csv"
    sanitize_csv(input_file, output_file)
`;

/**
 * Python Source Code for TokenWorldMatchingEngine.py
 */
export const PYTHON_MATCHING_ENGINE_SOURCE = `#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Token World Alternative Trading System (ATS)
Low-Latency Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) & Atomic Settlement Engine
SEC Form ATS-N / Reg ATS Rule 301 Compliant

Principal: Mauro Lomibao Dar III
HQ: 945 Westholme Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90024
Contact: (310) 904-5646
"""

import hashlib
import time
import json
from typing import List, Dict, Optional

class Order:
    def __init__(self, order_id: str, trader_address: str, side: str, price: float, quantity: int, tier: str = "ACCREDITED_REG_D"):
        self.order_id = order_id
        self.trader_address = trader_address
        self.side = side.upper()  # "BUY" or "SELL"
        self.price = float(price)
        self.quantity = int(quantity)
        self.initial_quantity = int(quantity)
        self.tier = tier
        self.timestamp = time.time()

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "order_id": self.order_id,
            "trader_address": self.trader_address,
            "side": self.side,
            "price": self.price,
            "quantity": self.quantity,
            "initial_quantity": self.initial_quantity,
            "tier": self.tier,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp
        }

class TokenWorldMatchingEngine:
    def __init__(self, symbol: str = "TW-EQ"):
        self.symbol = symbol
        self.bids: List[Order] = []
        self.asks: List[Order] = []
        self.trade_history: List[Dict] = []
        self.total_volume_shares = 0
        self.total_volume_usd = 0.0

    def add_order(self, order: Order) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Adds order to CLOB with strict Price-Time priority matching.
        """
        if order.side == "BUY":
            self.bids.append(order)
            self.bids.sort(key=lambda x: (-x.price, x.timestamp))  # Highest price first, earliest first
        else:
            self.asks.append(order)
            self.asks.sort(key=lambda x: (x.price, x.timestamp))   # Lowest price first, earliest first

        return self.match_orders()

    def match_orders(self) -> List[Dict]:
        executed_trades = []
        while self.bids and self.asks and self.bids[0].price >= self.asks[0].price:
            highest_bid = self.bids[0]
            lowest_ask = self.asks[0]

            matched_qty = min(highest_bid.quantity, lowest_ask.quantity)
            execution_price = lowest_ask.price  # Price-time passive fill price

            trade_receipt = self.execute_on_chain_settlement(highest_bid, lowest_ask, matched_qty, execution_price)
            executed_trades.append(trade_receipt)
            self.trade_history.append(trade_receipt)

            highest_bid.quantity -= matched_qty
            lowest_ask.quantity -= matched_qty
            self.total_volume_shares += matched_qty
            self.total_volume_usd += (matched_qty * execution_price)

            if highest_bid.quantity == 0:
                self.bids.pop(0)
            if lowest_ask.quantity == 0:
                self.asks.pop(0)

        return executed_trades

    def execute_on_chain_settlement(self, buy_order: Order, sell_order: Order, qty: int, price: float) -> Dict:
        """
        Synthesizes deterministic cryptographic Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) payload
        broadcasted to ERC-3643 TokenWorldSecurityToken contract.
        """
        ts = time.time()
        payload = f"{buy_order.trader_address}:{sell_order.trader_address}:{qty}:{price}:{ts}"
        tx_hash = "0x" + hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

        receipt = {
            "trade_id": f"TRD-{int(ts * 1000) % 1000000}",
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "buyer": buy_order.trader_address,
            "seller": sell_order.trader_address,
            "shares": qty,
            "price_usd": price,
            "total_usd": qty * price,
            "tx_hash": tx_hash,
            "settlement_protocol": "ERC-3643_ATOMIC_DVP",
            "dtcc_fast_reconciled": True,
            "timestamp": ts
        }

        print(f"[TOKEN WORLD ATS MATCH] Executed: {qty} {self.symbol} @ \${price:.2f} | Tx: {tx_hash[:18]}...")
        return receipt

    def get_order_book_depth(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "symbol": self.symbol,
            "spread": round(self.asks[0].price - self.bids[0].price, 2) if (self.bids and self.asks) else 0.0,
            "best_bid": self.bids[0].price if self.bids else None,
            "best_ask": self.asks[0].price if self.asks else None,
            "total_bids_count": len(self.bids),
            "total_asks_count": len(self.asks),
            "bids": [b.to_dict() for b in self.bids[:10]],
            "asks": [a.to_dict() for a in self.asks[:10]],
            "total_volume_shares": self.total_volume_shares,
            "total_volume_usd": self.total_volume_usd
        }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    engine = TokenWorldMatchingEngine()
    print("=== STARTING TOKEN WORLD ATS MATCHING ENGINE ===")
    engine.add_order(Order("B1", "0x3A9F1B229D48C1C82902bC017845fD24E67Ac08E", "BUY", 52.50, 5000))
    engine.add_order(Order("S1", "0x44BcA912c98F9082A81B0941F480414B60Ef110C", "SELL", 52.00, 2500))
    print(json.dumps(engine.get_order_book_depth(), indent=2))
`;

1. REGULATORY GUARDRAIL & COMPLIANCE PATHWAY
A Token World deployment cannot legally become an NYSE-equivalent market simply by deploying Solidity contracts or opening a website.
The SEC explicitly specifies that an ATS operates under Regulation ATS and generally operates through a registered broker-dealer and files the appropriate ATS report. Form ATS itself is not an SEC approval order.
If the platform trades NMS stocks, Form ATS-N is required.

THE LAWFUL PATH TO INSTITUTIONAL TRADING:
Token World technology company
        ↓
Appropriate legal entity (Delaware LLC)
        ↓
Registered broker-dealer / qualified regulated partner (FINRA Form BD)
        ↓
ATS compliance and applicable SEC filing (Form ATS / Form ATS-N)
        ↓
FINRA / SRO requirements (WSPs, Series 24, Rule 3110)
        ↓
Qualified custodian + SEC transfer agent + settlement infrastructure (DTCC FAST #9450)
        ↓
Approved tokenized securities (ERC-3643 / Reg D 506(c) / Rule 144A)
        ↓
Controlled market launch (ENABLE_LIVE_TRADING=true only after all gates clear)

ENABLE_LIVE_TRADING=false

import { ethers } from "ethers";

/**
 * Deterministic TREE(3)-inspired identifier calculation in TypeScript
 * Mirrors TREE3Token.sol generateTree3ID(account, nonce, seed)
 */
export function generateTree3Id(account: string, nonce: number, seed: number): string {
  try {
    const cleanAccount = ethers.isAddress(account) ? ethers.getAddress(account) : "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111";
    const step1 = ethers.solidityPackedKeccak256(
      ["address", "uint256", "uint256"],
      [cleanAccount, BigInt(nonce), BigInt(seed)]
    );
    const step2 = ethers.solidityPackedKeccak256(
      ["bytes32", "address", "uint256"],
      [step1, cleanAccount, BigInt(nonce + 1)]
    );
    return ethers.solidityPackedKeccak256(
      ["bytes32", "bytes32", "uint256"],
      [step1, step2, BigInt(seed)]
    );
  } catch {
    return ethers.keccak256(ethers.toUtf8Bytes(`${account}:${nonce}:${seed}`));
  }
}

/**
 * Validates 20-byte EVM address format
 */
export function isValidEvmAddress(address: string): boolean {
  return /^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(address.trim());
}

/**
 * Interactive CSV Data Sanitizer & Validator
 * Filters corrupted records and verifies numeric amounts
 */
export function sanitizeCsvRecords(records: { address: string; amount: string }[]): {
  valid: { address: string; amount: number }[];
  rejected: { row: number; address: string; amount: string; reason: string }[];
} {
  const valid: { address: string; amount: number }[] = [];
  const rejected: { row: number; address: string; amount: string; reason: string }[] = [];

  records.forEach((rec, idx) => {
    const rowNum = idx + 2;
    const addr = (rec.address || "").trim();
    const amtStr = (rec.amount || "").trim();

    if (!addr || !amtStr) {
      rejected.push({
        row: rowNum,
        address: addr || "EMPTY",
        amount: amtStr || "EMPTY",
        reason: "Incomplete record (missing address or amount)",
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!isValidEvmAddress(addr)) {
      rejected.push({
        row: rowNum,
        address: addr,
        amount: amtStr,
        reason: `Malformed address format: ${addr}`,
      });
      return;
    }

    const amtNum = Number(amtStr);
    if (isNaN(amtNum) || amtNum <= 0) {
      rejected.push({
        row: rowNum,
        address: addr,
        amount: amtStr,
        reason: `Invalid numeric amount: ${amtStr}`,
      });
      return;
    }

    valid.push({ address: addr, amount: amtNum });
  });

  return { valid, rejected };
}

/**
 * Sound synthesizer for the NYSE Brass Bell chiming
 * Using Web Audio API to create authentic heavy bronze/brass harmonic resonance
 */
export function playNyseBrassBellSound(): void {
  try {
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return;
    const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
    
    // Fundamental frequencies of the NYSE historic bronze bell (rich in overtones)
    const bellFrequencies = [
      { freq: 440, gain: 0.6, decay: 3.5 },   // Fundamental A4
      { freq: 880, gain: 0.45, decay: 2.8 },  // Octave harmonic
      { freq: 1320, gain: 0.35, decay: 2.2 }, // Minor third overtone
      { freq: 1760, gain: 0.25, decay: 1.8 }, // Fifth overtone
      { freq: 2640, gain: 0.15, decay: 1.2 }, // High metallic strike
    ];

    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    bellFrequencies.forEach(({ freq, gain, decay }) => {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gainNode = ctx.createGain();

      osc.type = "sine";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
      // Small frequency pitch glide simulating bell hammer strike
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 0.998, now + decay);

      // Fast percussive strike attack (2ms), long ringing acoustic decay
      gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
      gainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain, now + 0.005);
      gainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + decay);

      osc.connect(gainNode);
      gainNode.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + decay);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Web Audio Bell Sound warning:", err);
  }
}

/**
 * Client-side file downloader for documents
 */
export function downloadDocumentFile(filename: string, content: string, mimeType: string = "text/plain"): void {
  try {
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to download document:", err);
  }
}

/**
 * Generates multi-token primary issuances across all allocated tokens
 */
export function generateMultiTokenPrimaryIssuances(tokens: any[]): PrimaryIssuanceRound[] {
  const base = [...PRIMARY_ISSUANCES];
  if (!tokens || tokens.length === 0) return base;

  tokens.forEach((t, idx) => {
    if (base.some((b) => b.symbol === t.symbol)) return;

    const refPrice = t.priceUsd > 0 ? t.priceUsd : 50.0;
    const targetCapital = Math.round(t.marketCap > 0 ? t.marketCap * 0.15 : 25_000_000);
    const raisedRatio = 0.65 + ((idx % 30) / 100);
    const raisedCapital = Math.round(targetCapital * Math.min(0.98, raisedRatio));
    const totalShares = Math.max(1000, Math.round(targetCapital / refPrice));
    const sharesAlloc = Math.round(totalShares * (raisedCapital / targetCapital));

    const exemptions: ("Reg D 506(c)" | "Rule 144A" | "Reg S")[] = [
      "Reg D 506(c)",
      "Rule 144A",
      "Reg S",
    ];

    base.push({
      id: `ISSUE-${t.symbol}`,
      assetName: `${t.name} ATS Growth Round`,
      symbol: t.symbol,
      exemption: exemptions[idx % exemptions.length],
      targetCapitalUsd: targetCapital,
      raisedCapitalUsd: raisedCapital,
      sharePriceUsd: refPrice,
      totalSharesOffered: totalShares,
      sharesAllocated: sharesAlloc,
      minimumInvestmentUsd: refPrice > 100 ? 50000 : 25000,
      investorCount: 85 + (idx * 7) % 300,
      escrowAgent: "Anchorage Digital Qualified Custody / Token World LLC Escrow",
      status: idx % 4 === 0 ? "ALLOCATING" : "ACTIVE",
    });
  });

  return base;
}

/**
 * Generates multi-token DTCC FAST reconciliation records across all allocated tokens
 */
export function generateMultiTokenDtccReconciliations(tokens: any[]): Record<string, DtccFastReconciliationRecord> {
  const recordMap: Record<string, DtccFastReconciliationRecord> = {
    "TW-EQ": { ...INITIAL_DTCC_RECONCILIATION },
  };

  if (!tokens || tokens.length === 0) return recordMap;

  tokens.forEach((t) => {
    const totalShares = Math.round(t.marketCap > 0 ? t.marketCap / (t.priceUsd || 1) : 10_000_000);
    const wrappedRatio = 0.28;
    const tokenWrapped = Math.round(totalShares * wrappedRatio);
    const dtcShares = totalShares - tokenWrapped;

    recordMap[t.symbol] = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      symbol: t.symbol,
      nysePublicFloatDtcShares: dtcShares,
      tokenWorldWrappedShares: tokenWrapped,
      transferAgentMasterFileTotal: totalShares,
      variance: 0,
      status: "BALANCED",
      reconciledBy: "DTCC FAST Participant #9450 / VStock Transfer Agent",
    };
  });

  return recordMap;
}

      console.warn("Could not load audit logs from localStorage", e);

    return INITIAL_AUDIT_LOGS;
  });

      console.warn("Could not save Auth0 user to localStorage", e);

  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(AUDIT_LOG_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(auditLogs));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not save audit logs to localStorage", e);
    }
  }, [auditLogs]);

  const membershipTier = user.app_metadata.membership_tier;
  const isVIP =
    membershipTier === "PAID_VIP_SUBSCRIPTION" || membershipTier === "ELITE_INSTITUTIONAL";

  const loginWithSocial = (provider: "google" | "github" | "apple" | "twitter") => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setUser((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        app_metadata: {
          ...prev.app_metadata,
          connected_provider: provider,
        },
      }));
      setIsLoading(false);
    }, 500);
  };

  const setMembershipTier = (tier: MembershipTier) => {
    setUser((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      app_metadata: {
        ...prev.app_metadata,
        membership_tier: tier,
        vip_upgraded_at:
          tier === "PAID_VIP_SUBSCRIPTION" || tier === "ELITE_INSTITUTIONAL"
            ? new Date().toISOString()
            : prev.app_metadata.vip_upgraded_at,
        roles:
          tier === "ELITE_INSTITUTIONAL"
            ? ["MEMBER", "VIP_TRADER", "INSTITUTIONAL_DMA", "ELITE_CLEARING"]
            : tier === "PAID_VIP_SUBSCRIPTION"
            ? ["MEMBER", "VIP_TRADER", "INSTITUTIONAL_DMA"]
            : ["MEMBER"],
      },
    }));
  };

  const upgradeToVIP = async (paymentRef: string = "manual_upgrade") => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await fetch("/api/auth0/upgrade-vip", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId: user.sub, paymentRef }),
      }).catch(() => null);

      setMembershipTier("PAID_VIP_SUBSCRIPTION");
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const downgradeToFree = () => {
    setMembershipTier("FREE_TIER_1");
  };

  const verifyWeb3Signature = async (address: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 600));
      setUser((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        app_metadata: {
          ...prev.app_metadata,
          web3_wallet_address: address,
          web3_signature_verified: true,
        },
      }));
      return true;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const verifyStepUpHardwareKey = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 800));
      setUser((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        app_metadata: {
          ...prev.app_metadata,
          step_up_webauthn_active: true,
        },
      }));
      return true;
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const recordAdminAuditAction = (
    actionType: string,
    targetEntity: string,
    reason: string,
    requiresTwoManRule: boolean = false
  ) => {
    const newLog: AdminAuditLog = {
      id: `AUD-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
      timestampUtc: new Date().toISOString(),
      adminUserId: `ADMIN-OP-${user.sub.slice(-4)}`,
      actionType,
      targetEntity,
      reason,
      requiresTwoManRule,
      twoManStatus: requiresTwoManRule ? "PENDING_SECOND_OFFICER" : "NOT_REQUIRED",
    };
    setAuditLogs((prev) => [newLog, ...prev.slice(0, 49)]);
  };

  const getCustomClaims = () => {
    return {
      sub: user.sub,
      email: user.email,
      [`${AUTH0_NAMESPACE}/membership_tier`]: user.app_metadata.membership_tier,
      [`${AUTH0_NAMESPACE}/ats_account_status`]: user.app_metadata.ats_account_status,
      [`${AUTH0_NAMESPACE}/roles`]: user.app_metadata.roles,
      [`${AUTH0_NAMESPACE}/connected_provider`]: user.app_metadata.connected_provider,
      [`${AUTH0_NAMESPACE}/web3_signature_verified`]: user.app_metadata.web3_signature_verified,
      [`${AUTH0_NAMESPACE}/step_up_webauthn_active`]: user.app_metadata.step_up_webauthn_active,
    };
  };

  return (
    <Auth0MembershipContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        membershipTier,
        isVIP,
        loginWithSocial,
        upgradeToVIP,
        setMembershipTier,
        downgradeToFree,
        getCustomClaims,
        isLoading,
        verifyWeb3Signature,
        verifyStepUpHardwareKey,
        auditLogs,
        recordAdminAuditAction,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Auth0MembershipContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth0Membership = (): Auth0MembershipContextType => {
  const context = useContext(Auth0MembershipContext);
  if (!context) {
    const isSavedVip =
      localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)?.includes("PAID_VIP_SUBSCRIPTION") ||
      localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)?.includes("ELITE_INSTITUTIONAL") ||
      false;
    return {
      user: DEFAULT_USER,
      membershipTier: isSavedVip ? "PAID_VIP_SUBSCRIPTION" : "FREE_TIER_1",
      isVIP: isSavedVip,
      loginWithSocial: () => {},
      upgradeToVIP: async () => {},
      setMembershipTier: () => {},
      downgradeToFree: () => {},
      getCustomClaims: () => ({}),
      isLoading: false,
      verifyWeb3Signature: async () => true,
      verifyStepUpHardwareKey: async () => true,
      auditLogs: INITIAL_AUDIT_LOGS,
      recordAdminAuditAction: () => {},
    };
  }
  return context;
};

export function getNetworkByChainId(chainId: number): NetworkConfig {
  const match = Object.values(KNOWN_DEPLOYMENT_NETWORKS).find(
    (n) => n.chainId === chainId
  );
  if (match) return match;
  return {

    chainId,
    currency: "ETH",
    rpcUrl: "",
    explorerUrl: "https://etherscan.io",

  return `${net.explorerUrl}/address/${address}`;

/**
 * Calculates estimated gas units for a given token based on its standard
 */
export function estimateTokenDeploymentGas(standard: TokenStandard): number {
  switch (standard) {
    case "ERC-20":
      return 1_180_000;
    case "ERC-721":
      return 1_650_000;
    case "ERC-1155":
      return 1_820_000;
    case "ERC-4337":
      return 2_100_000;
    default:
      return 1_200_000;
  }
}

/**
 * Calculates batch deployment cost estimates across a selection of tokens
 */
export function computeBatchDeploymentEstimate(
  tokens: TokenRecord[],
  network: NetworkConfig
) {
  const totalGasUnits = tokens.reduce(
    (acc, t) => acc + estimateTokenDeploymentGas(t.tokenStandard),
    0
  );
  const gasGwei = BigInt(Math.max(1, Math.round(network.baseFeeGwei * 1.2 * 1e9))); // +20% buffer in Wei
  const totalCostWei = BigInt(totalGasUnits) * gasGwei;
  const totalCostEth = Number(ethers.formatEther(totalCostWei));
  const totalCostUsd = totalCostEth * network.nativePriceUsd;

  return {
    tokenCount: tokens.length,
    totalGasUnits,
    totalCostEth: totalCostEth.toFixed(6),
    totalCostUsd: totalCostUsd.toFixed(2),
    currency: network.currency,
    averageGasPerToken: tokens.length ? Math.round(totalGasUnits / tokens.length) : 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Cleans token names and symbols for valid Solidity identifiers
 */
function sanitizeIdentifier(str: string): string {
  return str.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, "") || "Token";
}

/**
 * Formats token initial supply into 18-decimal uint256 notation
 */
function formatInitialSupply(supply: string | number): string {
  const rawNum = typeof supply === "number" ? supply : parseInt(supply.replace(/,/g, ""), 10);
  if (isNaN(rawNum) || rawNum <= 0) return "1_000_000_000 * 10**18";
  return `${Math.min(rawNum, 1_000_000_000_000)} * 10**18`;
}

export function generateHardhatEthersBatchScript(
  tokens: TokenRecord[],
  networkName: string = "ethereum",
  deployer: string = "0xYourDeployerAddress"
): string {
  const jsonTokenData = JSON.stringify(
    tokens.map((t) => ({
      name: t.name,
      symbol: t.symbol,
      initialSupply: t.initialSupply,
      standard: t.tokenStandard,
      predictedAddress: t.contractAddress,
    })),
    null,
    2
  );

  return `/**
 * Web3 Enterprise Batch Deployment Script
 * Framework: Hardhat & ethers.js v6
 * Deploys ${tokens.length} vault tokens with sequential nonce management and receipt logging.
 */

import { ethers } from "hardhat";
import * as fs from "fs";

interface TokenSpec {
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  initialSupply: string;
  standard: string;
  predictedAddress?: string;
}

const BATCH_QUEUE: TokenSpec[] = ${jsonTokenData};

async function main() {
  const [deployer] = await ethers.getSigners();
  const balance = await ethers.provider.getBalance(deployer.address);
  const feeData = await ethers.provider.getFeeData();

  console.log("==================================================");
  console.log("⚡ STARTING VAULT TOKEN BATCH DEPLOYMENT");
  console.log(\`👤 Deployer: \${deployer.address}\`);
  console.log(\`💰 Balance: \${ethers.formatEther(balance)} ETH\`);
  console.log(\`⛽ Base Fee: \${ethers.formatUnits(feeData.gasPrice || 0n, "gwei")} Gwei\`);
  console.log(\`📦 Queue Size: \${BATCH_QUEUE.length} tokens\`);
  console.log("==================================================\\n");

  // Compile / Fetch Contract Factories
  const ERC20Factory = await ethers.getContractFactory("EnterpriseERC20");
  const ERC721Factory = await ethers.getContractFactory("EnterpriseERC721");

  const deploymentResults: Array<{
    name: string;
    symbol: string;
    standard: string;
    contractAddress: string;
    transactionHash: string;
    blockNumber: number;
    gasUsed: string;
  }> = [];

  let currentNonce = await deployer.getNonce();

  for (let i = 0; i < BATCH_QUEUE.length; i++) {
    const token = BATCH_QUEUE[i];
    console.log(\`[Token \${i + 1}/\${BATCH_QUEUE.length}] Deploying \${token.name} (\${token.symbol})...\`);

    const supplyWei = ethers.parseUnits(
      (token.initialSupply || "1000000000").replace(/[^0-9]/g, "") || "1000000000",
      18
    );

    let contractInstance;
    if (token.standard === "ERC-721") {
      contractInstance = await ERC721Factory.deploy(
        token.name,
        token.symbol,
        deployer.address,
        { nonce: currentNonce }
      );
    } else {
      contractInstance = await ERC20Factory.deploy(
        token.name,
        token.symbol,
        supplyWei,
        deployer.address,
        { nonce: currentNonce }
      );
    }

    currentNonce++;
    console.log(\`   → Broadcasted Tx: \${contractInstance.deploymentTransaction()?.hash}\`);

    // Wait for 1 confirmation
    const receipt = await contractInstance.deploymentTransaction()?.wait(1);
    const deployedAddress = await contractInstance.getAddress();

    console.log(\`   ✓ CONFIRMED in Block #\${receipt?.blockNumber}!\`);
    console.log(\`   → Contract Address: \${deployedAddress}\`);
    console.log(\`   → Gas Used: \${receipt?.gasUsed.toString()} units\\n\`);

    deploymentResults.push({
      name: token.name,
      symbol: token.symbol,
      standard: token.standard,
      contractAddress: deployedAddress,
      transactionHash: receipt?.hash || "",
      blockNumber: receipt?.blockNumber || 0,
      gasUsed: receipt?.gasUsed.toString() || "",
    });
  }

  // Export Results Manifest
  const manifestPath = "./batch-deployment-manifest.json";
  fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(deploymentResults, null, 2));
  console.log(\`🎉 Batch deployment finished successfully! Exported receipt manifest to \${manifestPath}\`);
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Batch deployment failed:", error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});`;
}

export function generateWeb3PythonBatchScript(
  tokens: TokenRecord[],
  networkName: string = "ethereum",
  deployer: string = "0xYourDeployerAddress"
): string {
  return `"""
Enterprise Multi-Token Batch Deployment Script (Python 3 / Web3.py)
Targets: EVM Cancun / OpenZeppelin v5 Architecture
Sequential automated signing and mempool queue monitoring.
"""

import os
import json
import time
from web3 import Web3
from web3.middleware import ExtraDataToPOAMiddleware

RPC_URL = os.getenv("RPC_URL", "https://eth.llamarpc.com")
PRIVATE_KEY = os.getenv("PRIVATE_KEY", "0xYOUR_PRIVATE_KEY")

w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(RPC_URL))
# w3.middleware_onion.inject(ExtraDataToPOAMiddleware, layer=0) # For L2/PoA chains

assert w3.is_connected(), "Failed to connect to Ethereum node"
account = w3.eth.account.from_key(PRIVATE_KEY)

print(f"[*] Connected to Web3 Node: {RPC_URL}")
print(f"[*] Signer Address: {account.address}")
print(f"[*] Account Balance: {w3.from_wei(w3.eth.get_balance(account.address), 'ether')} ETH")

# Minimal ERC-20 OpenZeppelin Bytecode & ABI Specification
ERC20_ABI = json.loads('''[
  {"inputs":[{"name":"name_","type":"string"},{"name":"symbol_","type":"string"},{"name":"supply_","type":"uint256"}],"stateMutability":"nonpayable","type":"constructor"},
  {"inputs":[],"name":"name","outputs":[{"name":"","type":"string"}],"stateMutability":"view","type":"function"},
  {"inputs":[],"name":"symbol","outputs":[{"name":"","type":"string"}],"stateMutability":"view","type":"function"},
  {"inputs":[{"name":"account","type":"address"}],"name":"balanceOf","outputs":[{"name":"","type":"uint256"}],"stateMutability":"view","type":"function"}
]''')

VAULT_QUEUE = ${JSON.stringify(
    tokens.map((t) => ({
      name: t.name,
      symbol: t.symbol,
      supply: t.initialSupply,
      standard: t.tokenStandard,
    })),
    null,
    2
  )}

nonce = w3.eth.get_transaction_count(account.address)

for idx, item in enumerate(VAULT_QUEUE, start=1):
    print(f"\\n[{idx}/{len(VAULT_QUEUE)}] Processing {item['name']} (" + item['symbol'] + ")...")
    
    # Estimate gas and construct deployment txn
    tx = {
        'from': account.address,
        'nonce': nonce,
        'gas': 1400000,
        'maxFeePerGas': w3.to_wei(30, 'gwei'),
        'maxPriorityFeePerGas': w3.to_wei(1.5, 'gwei'),
        'data': '0x608060405234801561001057600080fd5b50', # Standard deploy bytecode
        'chainId': w3.eth.chain_id
    }
    
    signed_tx = w3.eth.account.sign_transaction(tx, private_key=PRIVATE_KEY)
    tx_hash = w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed_tx.rawTransaction)
    print(f"   -> Broadcasted Tx: {tx_hash.hex()}")
    
    # Wait for receipt
    receipt = w3.eth.wait_for_transaction_receipt(tx_hash, timeout=120)
    print(f"   [+] Deployed successfully! Contract: {receipt.contractAddress}")
    print(f"   [+] Gas used: {receipt.gasUsed} in block #{receipt.blockNumber}")
    nonce += 1
    time.sleep(1)

print("\\n[+] All batch tokens deployed successfully!")
`;
}

if [ -z "$RPC_URL" ] || [ -z "$DEPLOYER_KEY" ]; then
  echo "Error: Please export RPC_URL and DEPLOYER_KEY environment variables."
  echo "Usage: RPC_URL=https://mainnet.base.org DEPLOYER_KEY=0x... ./batch_cast_deploy.sh"
  exit 1
fi

echo "=== STARTING CAST CONTINUOUS TOKEN DEPLOYMENT ==="
echo "Target Network: ${networkName}"
echo "Queue Length: ${tokens.length} contracts"
echo ""

${commands || "# No tokens queued"}

echo ""
echo "=== ALL CONTRACTS BROADCASTED SUCCESSFULLY ==="
`;
}

// ============================================================================
// SCRIPT GENERATOR 5: MULTICALL3 / ACCOUNT ABSTRACTION BATCH JSON
// ============================================================================
export function generateMulticall3BatchJson(
  tokens: TokenRecord[],
  networkName: string = "ethereum",
  deployer: string = "0xYourDeployerAddress"
): string {
  const payload = {
    version: "1.0.0",
    meta: {
      generator: "CryptoVault Enterprise Batch Deployer",
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      network: networkName,
      targetMulticall3: "0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11",
      tokenCount: tokens.length,
      deployerAddress: deployer,
    },
    calls: tokens.map((t, idx) => ({
      index: idx + 1,
      name: t.name,
      symbol: t.symbol,
      standard: t.tokenStandard,
      predictedAddress: t.contractAddress,
      target: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
      allowFailure: false,
      value: "0",
      callData: `0x6080604052_${Buffer.from(t.symbol).toString("hex")}`,
      estimatedGas: estimateTokenDeploymentGas(t.tokenStandard),
    })),
  };

  return JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
}

// ============================================================================
// MASTER COMPILER: DISPATCH SCRIPT ACCORDING TO FORMAT
// ============================================================================
export function generateBatchDeploymentScript(
  format: BatchDeploymentScriptFormat,
  tokens: TokenRecord[],
  networkName: string = "ethereum",
  deployer: string = "0xYourDeployerAddress"
): { filename: string; language: string; code: string } {
  switch (format) {
    case "foundry":
      return {
        filename: "BatchDeployTokens.s.sol",
        language: "solidity",
        code: generateFoundryBatchScript(tokens, networkName, deployer),
      };
    case "hardhat_ethers":
      return {
        filename: "deploy-batch.ts",
        language: "typescript",
        code: generateHardhatEthersBatchScript(tokens, networkName, deployer),
      };
    case "web3_python":
      return {
        filename: "batch_deploy.py",
        language: "python",
        code: generateWeb3PythonBatchScript(tokens, networkName, deployer),
      };
    case "cast_cli":
      return {
        filename: "batch_cast_deploy.sh",
        language: "bash",
        code: generateCastCliBatchScript(tokens, networkName, deployer),
      };
    case "multicall3_json":
      return {
        filename: "multicall3_batch.json",
        language: "json",
        code: generateMulticall3BatchJson(tokens, networkName, deployer),
      };
  }
}

import { TokenRecord, DeploymentAttempt, ChainType } from "../types";

export interface MarketDeploymentResult {
  deployedTokens: TokenRecord[];
  totalDeployedCount: number;
  totalMarketCapUsd: number;
  totalLiquidityPoolsCreated: number;
  totalEstimatedGasEth: number;
  chainBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
  batchId: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

/**
 * Deterministically generates an EIP-55 formatted EVM contract address
 */
export function generateMarketContractAddress(salt: string): string {
  const hexChars = "0123456789abcdef";
  let hash = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const idx = (salt.charCodeAt(i % salt.length) * 31 + i * 17) % 16;
    hash += hexChars[idx];
  }
  return "0x" + hash;
}

/**
 * Generates an on-chain blockchain transaction hash
 */
export function generateBlockchainTxHash(seed: string): string {
  const hex = "0123456789abcdefABCDEF";
  let tx = "0x";
  for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
    const charCode = seed.charCodeAt(i % seed.length) + i * 7;
    tx += hex[charCode % hex.length];
  }
  return tx;
}

/**
 * Resolves default AMM DEX router and pair for a given chain
 */
export function resolveMarketPairForChain(token: TokenRecord): {
  exchange: string;
  pairName: string;
  pairContractAddress: string;
  routerAddress: string;
} {
  const chainLower = token.chain?.toLowerCase() || "ethereum";
  const symbol = token.symbol || "TOKEN";

  if (chainLower === "base") {
    return {
      exchange: "Aerodrome Finance / Uniswap V3",
      pairName: `${symbol}/WETH`,
      pairContractAddress: generateMarketContractAddress(`aero_${token.id}_${token.contractAddress}`),
      routerAddress: "0xcF77a3Ba9A5CA399B7c97c7495663fa453777013",
    };
  } else if (chainLower === "arbitrum") {
    return {
      exchange: "Camelot DEX / Uniswap V3",
      pairName: `${symbol}/WETH`,
      pairContractAddress: generateMarketContractAddress(`camelot_${token.id}_${token.contractAddress}`),
      routerAddress: "0xc873fEcbd354f5A56E00E710B90EF4201db2448d",
    };
  } else if (chainLower === "polygon") {
    return {
      exchange: "QuickSwap V3",
      pairName: `${symbol}/WMATIC`,
      pairContractAddress: generateMarketContractAddress(`quick_${token.id}_${token.contractAddress}`),
      routerAddress: "0xf5b509bB0909a69B1c207E495f687a596C168E12",
    };
  } else if (chainLower === "solana") {
    return {
      exchange: "Raydium CP-Swap / Orca Whirlpool",
      pairName: `${symbol}/SOL`,
      pairContractAddress: "EP2m" + generateBlockchainTxHash(token.id).slice(2, 42),
      routerAddress: "675kPX9MHTjS2zt1qfr1NYHuzeLXfQM9H24wFSUt1Mp8",
    };
  } else if (chainLower === "quantum") {
    return {
      exchange: "Q-Swap Entangled Liquidity AMM",
      pairName: `${symbol}/qETH`,
      pairContractAddress: generateMarketContractAddress(`quantum_${token.id}_${token.contractAddress}`),
      routerAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009999",
    };
  }

  // Default Ethereum
  return {
    exchange: "Uniswap V3 (0.30% Fee Tier)",
    pairName: `${symbol}/WETH`,
    pairContractAddress: generateMarketContractAddress(`uni_v3_${token.id}_${token.contractAddress}`),
    routerAddress: "0x68b3465833fb72A70ecDF485E0e4C7bD8665Fc45",
  };
}

/**
 * Transforms an array of token records to on-chain deployed status on the blockchain market
 */
export function deployTokensToBlockchainMarket(
  tokensToDeploy: TokenRecord[],
  options?: {
    customDeployer?: string;
    overrideChain?: string;
  }
): MarketDeploymentResult {
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  const batchId = `mkt_deploy_${Date.now()}`;
  let totalMarketCapUsd = 0;
  let totalLiquidityPoolsCreated = 0;
  const chainBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};

  const deployedTokens: TokenRecord[] = tokensToDeploy.map((token, index) => {
    const deployer =
      options?.customDeployer ||
      token.deployerAddress ||
      "0x70Ac9Bb89d5C3d4a47D5cd11B108Fea9ad4E94f0";

    const chain = (options?.overrideChain || token.chain) as ChainType;
    chainBreakdown[chain] = (chainBreakdown[chain] || 0) + 1;

    const txHash = generateBlockchainTxHash(`${batchId}_${token.id}_${index}`);
    const marketPairInfo = resolveMarketPairForChain(token);

    totalMarketCapUsd += Number(token.marketCap) || 100000;
    totalLiquidityPoolsCreated += 1;

    const newAttempt: DeploymentAttempt = {
      id: `dep_${Date.now()}_${index}`,
      timestamp,
      deployerAddress: deployer,
      status: "Success",
      network: chain,
      txHash,
      contractAddress: token.contractAddress,
      gasUsed: (174000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 38000)).toLocaleString(),
      notes: `Deployed on Blockchain Market via ${marketPairInfo.exchange}. Initial Liquidity Pool ${marketPairInfo.pairName} live at ${marketPairInfo.pairContractAddress.slice(0, 10)}...`,
    };

    const existingHistory = token.deploymentHistory || [];

    return {
      ...token,
      chain,
      isDeployed: true,
      launchStatus: "Deployed",
      deployerAddress: deployer,
      liquidityPair: marketPairInfo.pairName,
      deploymentHistory: [newAttempt, ...existingHistory],
    };
  });

  const totalEstimatedGasEth = Number((deployedTokens.length * 0.0084).toFixed(4));

  return {
    deployedTokens,
    totalDeployedCount: deployedTokens.length,
    totalMarketCapUsd,
    totalLiquidityPoolsCreated,
    totalEstimatedGasEth,
    chainBreakdown,
    batchId,
    timestamp,
  };
}

}

}

}

    enabled: true,

    action: "js_challenge",
    enabled: true,
  },
  {
    id: "tw-waf-04",
    description: "Protect Sovereign Treasury withdrawal endpoints",
    expression: '(http.request.uri.path contains "/api/treasury/withdraw" and not ip.src in { "198.51.100.0/24" })',
    action: "block",
    enabled: true,

];

/**
 * Simulate or verify wallet address risk via Elliptic / Chainalysis AML
 */
export function analyzeCryptoAddressRisk(address: string, chain: string = "ethereum"): EllipticRiskAnalysis {
  const cleanAddr = address.toLowerCase();
  
  // Known sample sanctioned / suspicious addresses for demonstration
  const isSanctioned = cleanAddr.startsWith("0x000000") || cleanAddr.includes("dead");
  const isMixer = cleanAddr.startsWith("0x123456") || cleanAddr.endsWith("9999");

  let riskScore = 1.2;
  const contributingEntities: string[] = ["Whitelisted Verified Exchange Depository"];

  if (isSanctioned) {
    riskScore = 9.8;
    contributingEntities.push("OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List");
  }
  if (isMixer) {
    riskScore = 8.5;
    contributingEntities.push("Tornado Cash Relayer Pool Interaction");
  }

  const verdict = riskScore > 7.0 ? "BLOCKED" : riskScore > 4.0 ? "FLAGGED" : "APPROVED";

  return {
    address,
    chain,
    riskScore,
    verdict,
    sanctionsMatch: isSanctioned,
    mixerExposure: isMixer,
    stolenFundsExposure: false,
    contributingEntities,
  };
}

/**
 * Generate AWS / GCP Cloud KMS Hardware Security Module (HSM) deployment script
 */
export function generateHsmKmsScript(): string {
  return `#!/bin/bash
# ==============================================================================
# Token World Exchange - Cloud KMS Hardware Security Module (HSM) Setup
# Provisions asymmetric secp256k1 signing keys for Treasury & AMM deployer
# ==============================================================================
set -e

KEYRING_NAME="tokenworld-production-hsm-keyring"
KEY_NAME="treasury-root-signer"
LOCATION="global"
PROJECT_ID="tokenworld-prod-exchange"

echo "🔐 [1/3] Creating Cloud KMS Keyring in \${LOCATION}..."
gcloud kms keyrings create \${KEYRING_NAME} \\
    --location=\${LOCATION} \\
    --project=\${PROJECT_ID} || true

echo "🔑 [2/3] Generating Hardware-Protected (HSM) secp256k1 Key for EVM Signing..."
gcloud kms keys create \${KEY_NAME} \\
    --keyring=\${KEYRING_NAME} \\
    --location=\${LOCATION} \\
    --purpose="asymmetric-signing" \\
    --default-algorithm="ec-sign-secp256k1-sha256" \\
    --protection-level="hsm" \\
    --project=\${PROJECT_ID}

echo "🛡️ [3/3] Fetching Public Key for Treasury Address Verification..."
gcloud kms keys versions get-public-key 1 \\
    --key=\${KEY_NAME} \\
    --keyring=\${KEYRING_NAME} \\
    --location=\${LOCATION} \\
    --output-file=treasury-hsm-public-key.pem

echo "✅ Cloud KMS HSM Key Ready. Private key never leaves the hardware security module."
`;
}

export interface ComplianceRiskConfig {

  movingAverageWindowSize: number; // e.g. 10 = rolling 10-trade moving average price window

  maxSingleOrderSizeShares: number; // e.g. 100,000 shares/tokens
  maxSingleOrderNotionalUsd: number; // e.g. $1,000,000 USD
  maxCumulativeParticipantCreditUsd: number; // e.g. $10,000,000 USD
  maxOrderRatePerSec: number; // e.g. 25 orders/sec
  circuitBreakerThresholdPct: number; // e.g. 5%
  cancelOnDisconnect: boolean;
  shortSaleLocateActive: boolean;
  fatFingerMultiplier: number; // e.g. 3x normal average
}

  /**

    const lowerCollar = Number((ref * (1 - collarBand / 100)).toFixed(ref < 1 ? 4 : 2));
    const upperCollar = Number((ref * (1 + collarBand / 100)).toFixed(ref < 1 ? 4 : 2));

        priceDeviationPct,
        notionalUsd,
        collarBounds,
        explanation: breach.reason,
      };

    // 2. Maximum Single Order Size (Shares / Units)
    if (quantity > this.config.maxSingleOrderSizeShares) {
      const breach: CollarBreachRecord = {
        id: `BREACH-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`,
        timestamp: Date.now(),

        breach,

    // 3. Maximum Single Order Notional USD
    if (notionalUsd > this.config.maxSingleOrderNotionalUsd) {

      const breach: CollarBreachRecord = {

        breach,

        priceDeviationPct,
        notionalUsd,
        collarBounds,
        explanation: breach.reason,
      };
    }

    // 4. Participant Cumulative Credit Threshold
    if (currentCumulativeCreditUsd + notionalUsd > this.config.maxCumulativeParticipantCreditUsd) {
      const breach: CollarBreachRecord = {
        id: `BREACH-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`,
