      heuristicRule: "RULE-DIST-02B: Float Concentration Warning",
      evidence: `${holders} holders for $${(mcap / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M market capitalization.`,
      remediation: "Incentivize wider community participation and LP token staking to expand distribution breadth.",
      isAutoRemediable: false,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 12;
    if (distributionRisk === "BALANCED") distributionRisk = "MODERATE";
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // HEURISTIC 3: LIQUIDITY LOCK & RUG DEFENSE
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  let liquidityLockStatus: "LOCKED" | "PARTIALLY_LOCKED" | "UNLOCKED_AT_RISK" = "UNLOCKED_AT_RISK";

  if (token.launchStatus === "Rug-Proof Vault") {
    liquidityLockStatus = "LOCKED";
  } else if (token.launchStatus === "Liquidity Locked") {
    liquidityLockStatus = "LOCKED";
  } else if (token.launchStatus === "Audited" || token.launchStatus === "Deployed") {
    liquidityLockStatus = "PARTIALLY_LOCKED";
    findings.push({
      id: `UNLOCKED_AMM_LIQUIDITY_${token.id}`,
      category: "LIQUIDITY_LOCK",
      severity: "HIGH",
      title: "Uncertified AMM Liquidity Lock",
      description: `Current launch status is '${token.launchStatus}'. No cryptographic proof of time-locked LP tokens detected for pair ${token.liquidityPair || "N/A"}.`,
      impact: "Liquidity provider tokens may be withdrawn by pool deployer at any moment, collapsing the automated market maker pool (Classic Rug Pull).",
      heuristicRule: "RULE-LIQ-01: AMM Liquidity Lock Verification",
      evidence: `Launch status is '${token.launchStatus}' with active pool ${token.liquidityPair || "Uniswap v3"}.`,
      remediation: "Deposit LP tokens into an immutable certified locker (e.g. Unicrypt, Team Finance, or Rug-Proof Vault) with minimum 1-year lock period.",
      isAutoRemediable: true,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 24;
  } else if (token.launchStatus === "Presale" || token.launchStatus === "Paused") {
    liquidityLockStatus = "UNLOCKED_AT_RISK";
    findings.push({
      id: `RISK_LAUNCH_STATUS_${token.id}`,
      category: "LIQUIDITY_LOCK",
      severity: "CRITICAL",
      title: "High-Risk Pre-Launch / Paused Status",
      description: `Token is marked as '${token.launchStatus}'. Trading or token transfers may be halted or restricted.`,
      impact: "Users may purchase tokens but find transfer or selling functions blocked or uninitialized.",
      heuristicRule: "RULE-LIQ-02: Non-Finalized Market State",
      evidence: `Launch status '${token.launchStatus}'.`,
      remediation: "Finalize presale contracts, initialize automated AMM pool, and execute Rug-Proof lockup.",
      isAutoRemediable: true,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 30;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // HEURISTIC 4: SUPPLY INFLATION & CEILING CHECKS
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const supplyNumeric = parseFloat(token.initialSupply.replace(/,/g, "")) || 0;
  if (token.tokenStandard === "ERC-20" && !token.tokenomicsPillars?.mathematicalBoundaries?.uint256Ceiling) {
    findings.push({
      id: `UNCAPPED_SUPPLY_RISK_${token.id}`,
      category: "SUPPLY_INFLATION",
      severity: "MEDIUM",
      title: "Missing Immutable Supply Ceiling Guard",
      description: "Smart contract configuration does not explicitly declare OpenZeppelin ERC20Capped or fixed total supply ceiling.",
      impact: "If mint() permissions remain accessible, unauthorized supply inflation can devalue existing tokens.",
      heuristicRule: "RULE-MINT-01: Supply Ceiling Enforcement",
      evidence: `Initial supply: ${token.initialSupply}. No mathematical ceiling confirmation found in contract pillars.`,
      remediation: "Enforce OpenZeppelin ERC20Capped standard or assert require(totalSupply() <= MAX_SUPPLY) on all mint operations.",
      isAutoRemediable: true,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 14;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // HEURISTIC 5: QUANTUM ENTROPY SIGNATURE & KEY HYGIENE
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const entropySignature = token.quantum_entropy_signature || "";
  const shannon = calculateShannonEntropy(entropySignature);

  if (!entropySignature || entropySignature.length < 64) {
    findings.push({
      id: `MALFORMED_ENTROPY_${token.id}`,
      category: "ENTROPY_SIGNATURE",
      severity: "HIGH",
      title: "Truncated or Missing Entropy Signature",
      description: "Cryptographic entropy signature is truncated or absent, indicating potential pseudo-random key generation.",
      impact: "Weak seed entropy allows attackers to reverse-engineer deterministic deployment salts and hijack contract addresses.",
      heuristicRule: "RULE-ENT-01: 256-Bit Cryptographic Entropy Verification",
      evidence: `Entropy signature length is ${entropySignature.length} chars (expected 64 hex chars).`,
      remediation: "Regenerate deployment salt and bytecode using CSPRNG crypto.getRandomValues().",
      isAutoRemediable: true,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 18;
  } else if (shannon < 3.5) {
    findings.push({
      id: `LOW_SHANNON_ENTROPY_${token.id}`,
      category: "ENTROPY_SIGNATURE",
      severity: "MEDIUM",
      title: "Low Shannon Entropy in Generation Signature",
      description: `Shannon entropy evaluated to ${shannon.toFixed(2)} bits (expected >= 3.75 bits for CSPRNG 256-bit hex).`,
      impact: "Potential statistical predictability in cryptographic salt generation.",
      heuristicRule: "RULE-ENT-02: Shannon Diversity Analysis",
      evidence: `Shannon score: ${shannon.toFixed(2)} / 4.0 bits.`,
      remediation: "Pass key generation through NIST SP 800-22 compliant whitening transform.",
      isAutoRemediable: true,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 12;
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // HEURISTIC 6: AUDIT COMPLIANCE & SCORE VERIFICATION
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const auditScore = token.securityScore || 0;
  if (auditScore < 80) {
    findings.push({
      id: `SUBPAR_AUDIT_SCORE_${token.id}`,
      category: "AUDIT_COMPLIANCE",
      severity: "HIGH",
      title: "Sub-Baseline Security Audit Score",
      description: `Security audit score evaluated to only ${auditScore}/100 by ${token.auditFirm}.`,
      impact: "Contract contains known medium or high severity audit warnings that have not been patched.",
      heuristicRule: "RULE-AUD-01: Minimum Security Audit Baseline",
      evidence: `Score: ${auditScore}/100 from ${token.auditFirm}.`,
      remediation: "Address unresolved findings in the audit report and execute a re-audit cycle.",
      isAutoRemediable: false,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 20;
  } else if (auditScore < 90) {
    findings.push({
      id: `MODERATE_AUDIT_SCORE_${token.id}`,
      category: "AUDIT_COMPLIANCE",
      severity: "LOW",
      title: "Minor Audit Advisory Notes",
      description: `Security score is ${auditScore}/100 with pending informational or gas optimization suggestions.`,
      impact: "Minor gas overhead or informational style deviations.",
      heuristicRule: "RULE-AUD-02: Informational Audit Advisory",
      evidence: `Score: ${auditScore}/100.`,
      remediation: "Review informational findings in audit documentation.",
      isAutoRemediable: false,
    });
    threatScorePoints += 6;
  }

  // Normalize Threat Score between 0 and 100
  const normalizedThreatScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, threatScorePoints));

  // Determine Overall Status
  let overallStatus: ThreatSeverity = "SAFE";
  const criticalCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "CRITICAL").length;
  const highCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "HIGH").length;
  const mediumCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "MEDIUM").length;
  const lowCount = findings.filter((f) => f.severity === "LOW").length;

  if (criticalCount > 0 || normalizedThreatScore >= 65) {
    overallStatus = "CRITICAL";
  } else if (highCount > 0 || normalizedThreatScore >= 45) {
    overallStatus = "HIGH";
  } else if (mediumCount > 0 || normalizedThreatScore >= 25) {
    overallStatus = "MEDIUM";
  } else if (lowCount > 0 || normalizedThreatScore > 0) {
    overallStatus = "LOW";
  } else {
    overallStatus = "SAFE";
  }

  return {
    tokenId: token.id,
    token,
    threatScore: normalizedThreatScore,
    overallStatus,
    findings,
    vulnerabilityCount: {
      critical: criticalCount,
      high: highCount,
      medium: mediumCount,
      low: lowCount,
    },
    isOwnershipRenounced,
    distributionRiskLevel: distributionRisk,
    liquidityLockStatus,
    scannedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Run heuristic analysis on the entire batch of active tokens
 */
export function runBatchThreatScan(tokens: TokenRecord[]): BatchThreatReport {
  const startTime = performance.now();
  const assessments = tokens.map((t) => analyzeTokenThreats(t));
  const scanDurationMs = Math.round(performance.now() - startTime);

  let criticalCount = 0;
  let highCount = 0;
  let mediumCount = 0;
  let lowCount = 0;
  let safeCount = 0;
  let totalScore = 0;

  const categoryCounts: Record<ThreatCategory, { count: number; maxSev: ThreatSeverity }> = {
    OWNERSHIP_RENOUNCEMENT: { count: 0, maxSev: "SAFE" },
    DISTRIBUTION_PATTERNS: { count: 0, maxSev: "SAFE" },
    LIQUIDITY_LOCK: { count: 0, maxSev: "SAFE" },
    SUPPLY_INFLATION: { count: 0, maxSev: "SAFE" },
    ENTROPY_SIGNATURE: { count: 0, maxSev: "SAFE" },
    AUDIT_COMPLIANCE: { count: 0, maxSev: "SAFE" },
  };

  const vulnNameCounts: Record<
    string,
    { count: number; severity: ThreatSeverity; category: ThreatCategory }
  > = {};

  const sevWeight: Record<ThreatSeverity, number> = {
    CRITICAL: 4,
    HIGH: 3,
    MEDIUM: 2,
    LOW: 1,
    SAFE: 0,
  };

  for (const a of assessments) {
    totalScore += a.threatScore;
    if (a.overallStatus === "CRITICAL") criticalCount++;
    else if (a.overallStatus === "HIGH") highCount++;
    else if (a.overallStatus === "MEDIUM") mediumCount++;
    else if (a.overallStatus === "LOW") lowCount++;
    else safeCount++;

    // Track category findings
    const tokenCategories = new Set<ThreatCategory>();
    for (const f of a.findings) {
      tokenCategories.add(f.category);

      // Track individual vulnerability names
      if (!vulnNameCounts[f.title]) {
        vulnNameCounts[f.title] = { count: 0, severity: f.severity, category: f.category };
      }
      vulnNameCounts[f.title].count++;

      // Track max severity per category
      const currentMax = categoryCounts[f.category].maxSev;
      if (sevWeight[f.severity] > sevWeight[currentMax]) {
        categoryCounts[f.category].maxSev = f.severity;
      }
    }

    for (const cat of tokenCategories) {
      categoryCounts[cat].count++;
    }
  }

  const total = Math.max(1, tokens.length);
  const averageThreatScore = Math.round(totalScore / total);

  // Overall Batch Risk Determination
  let overallBatchRisk: ThreatSeverity = "SAFE";
  if (criticalCount > 0 || averageThreatScore >= 60) {
    overallBatchRisk = "CRITICAL";
  } else if (highCount > 0 || averageThreatScore >= 40) {
    overallBatchRisk = "HIGH";
  } else if (mediumCount > 0 || averageThreatScore >= 20) {
    overallBatchRisk = "MEDIUM";
  } else if (lowCount > 0) {
    overallBatchRisk = "LOW";
  }

  const categoryBreakdown: Record<
    ThreatCategory,
    { affectedCount: number; percentage: number; maxSeverity: ThreatSeverity }
  > = {
    OWNERSHIP_RENOUNCEMENT: {
      affectedCount: categoryCounts.OWNERSHIP_RENOUNCEMENT.count,
      percentage: Math.round((categoryCounts.OWNERSHIP_RENOUNCEMENT.count / total) * 100),
      maxSeverity: categoryCounts.OWNERSHIP_RENOUNCEMENT.maxSev,
    },
    DISTRIBUTION_PATTERNS: {
      affectedCount: categoryCounts.DISTRIBUTION_PATTERNS.count,
      percentage: Math.round((categoryCounts.DISTRIBUTION_PATTERNS.count / total) * 100),
      maxSeverity: categoryCounts.DISTRIBUTION_PATTERNS.maxSev,
    },
    LIQUIDITY_LOCK: {
      affectedCount: categoryCounts.LIQUIDITY_LOCK.count,
      percentage: Math.round((categoryCounts.LIQUIDITY_LOCK.count / total) * 100),
      maxSeverity: categoryCounts.LIQUIDITY_LOCK.maxSev,
    },
    SUPPLY_INFLATION: {
      affectedCount: categoryCounts.SUPPLY_INFLATION.count,
      percentage: Math.round((categoryCounts.SUPPLY_INFLATION.count / total) * 100),
      maxSeverity: categoryCounts.SUPPLY_INFLATION.maxSev,
    },
    ENTROPY_SIGNATURE: {
      affectedCount: categoryCounts.ENTROPY_SIGNATURE.count,
      percentage: Math.round((categoryCounts.ENTROPY_SIGNATURE.count / total) * 100),
      maxSeverity: categoryCounts.ENTROPY_SIGNATURE.maxSev,
    },
    AUDIT_COMPLIANCE: {
      affectedCount: categoryCounts.AUDIT_COMPLIANCE.count,
      percentage: Math.round((categoryCounts.AUDIT_COMPLIANCE.count / total) * 100),
      maxSeverity: categoryCounts.AUDIT_COMPLIANCE.maxSev,
    },
  };

  const topVulnerabilities = Object.entries(vulnNameCounts)
    .map(([name, data]) => ({
      name,
      count: data.count,
      severity: data.severity,
      category: data.category,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
    .slice(0, 6);

  return {
    batchId: `BATCH-SCAN-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`,
    totalTokensScanned: tokens.length,
    overallBatchRisk,
    averageThreatScore,
    criticalTokensCount: criticalCount,
    highRiskTokensCount: highCount,
    mediumRiskTokensCount: mediumCount,
    lowRiskTokensCount: lowCount,
    safeTokensCount: safeCount,
    categoryBreakdown,
    topVulnerabilities,
    assessments,
    scanDurationMs,
    scannedTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Remediates an individual token by applying safe, un-ruggable defaults:
 * - Renounces ownership to 0x0...dEaD
 * - Sets launch status to 'Rug-Proof Vault'
 * - Locks distribution allocations with 24-month linear vesting
 * - Boosts audit verification & logs mitigation
 */
export function remediateToken(
  token: TokenRecord,
  options?: {
    renounceOwnership?: boolean;
    lockLiquidity?: boolean;
    vestDistribution?: boolean;
    boostAudit?: boolean;
  }
): TokenRecord {
  const opt = {
    renounceOwnership: true,
    lockLiquidity: true,
    vestDistribution: true,
    boostAudit: true,
    ...options,
  };

  const updated: TokenRecord = { ...token };

  // 1. Renounce Ownership
  if (opt.renounceOwnership) {
    updated.targetOwner = "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD";
  }

  // 2. Lock Liquidity
  if (opt.lockLiquidity) {
    updated.launchStatus = "Rug-Proof Vault";
  }

  // 3. Vest Distribution
  if (opt.vestDistribution && updated.tokenomics?.tokenomics) {
    updated.tokenomics = {
      ...updated.tokenomics,
      tokenomics: updated.tokenomics.tokenomics.map((item) => {
        const cat = item.category.toLowerCase();
        if (
          cat.includes("team") ||
          cat.includes("founder") ||
          cat.includes("insider") ||
          cat.includes("private") ||
          cat.includes("treasury")
        ) {
          return {
            ...item,
            lockup: "24-Month Linear (6m Cliff)",
          };
        }
        return item;
      }),
    };
  }

  // 4. Boost Audit & Security
  if (opt.boostAudit) {
    updated.securityScore = Math.max(98, updated.securityScore || 98);
  }

  // Add remediation tag & note
  const currentTags = updated.tags ? [...updated.tags] : [];
  if (!currentTags.includes("Ownership Renounced")) {
    currentTags.push("Ownership Renounced");
  }
  if (!currentTags.includes("Rug-Proof Vault")) {
    currentTags.push("Rug-Proof Vault");
  }
  if (!currentTags.includes("Vesting Locked")) {
    currentTags.push("Vesting Locked");
  }
  updated.tags = currentTags;

  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
  updated.marketEvolutionNote = `[Security Threat Scanner Remediated ${timestamp}]: Ownership irrevocably renounced to 0x0...dEaD. AMM liquidity locked in Rug-Proof Vault. Insider distribution locked under 24-month linear vesting.`;

  return updated;
}

/**
 * Batch remediates all vulnerable tokens in an array
 */
export function batchRemediateTokens(
  tokens: TokenRecord[],
  targetTokenIds?: string[]
): TokenRecord[] {
  const idFilter = targetTokenIds ? new Set(targetTokenIds) : null;
  return tokens.map((t) => {
    if (idFilter && !idFilter.has(t.id)) {
      return t;
    }
    // Only remediate if has at least one risk
    const assessment = analyzeTokenThreats(t);
    if (assessment.overallStatus === "SAFE") {
      return t;
    }
    return remediateToken(t);
  });
}

/**
 * Exports Threat Report to CSV string
 */
export function exportThreatReportToCsv(report: BatchThreatReport): string {
  const headers = [
    "Token ID",
    "Name",
    "Symbol",
    "Chain",
    "Contract Address",
    "Threat Level",
    "Threat Score",
    "Ownership Renounced",
    "Distribution Risk",
    "Liquidity Status",
    "Critical Findings",
    "High Findings",
    "Medium Findings",
    "Top Finding Rule",
    "Top Finding Remediation",
  ];

  const rows = report.assessments.map((a) => {
    const topFinding = a.findings[0];
    return [
      `"${a.token.id}"`,
      `"${a.token.name}"`,
      `"${a.token.symbol}"`,
      `"${a.token.chain}"`,
      `"${a.token.contractAddress}"`,
      `"${a.overallStatus}"`,
      a.threatScore,
      a.isOwnershipRenounced ? "YES (Renounced)" : "NO (At Risk)",
      `"${a.distributionRiskLevel}"`,
      `"${a.liquidityLockStatus}"`,
      a.vulnerabilityCount.critical,
      a.vulnerabilityCount.high,
      a.vulnerabilityCount.medium,
      `"${topFinding?.heuristicRule || "None"}"`,
      `"${topFinding?.remediation?.replace(/"/g, '""') || "N/A"}"`,
    ].join(",");
  });

  return [headers.join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
}

/**
 * Seeded PRNG & Fisher-Yates Shuffling Engine
 *
 * Implements an unbiased Fisher-Yates (Knuth) shuffle driven by the Mulberry32
 * pseudo-random number generator (PRNG).
 *
 * Why Mulberry32 + Fisher-Yates?
 * 1. Unbiased: Every permutation of N elements has exact equal probability (1 / N!).
 * 2. Deterministic & Seeded: The exact sequence is 100% reproducible for auditability.
 * 3. High Performance: O(N) linear time and low memory footprint, scaling to large datasets.
 * 4. Bias Elimination: Removes temporal, alphabetical, and chain insertion bias from large datasets.
 */

/**
 * 32-bit Mulberry32 PRNG generator
 * Produces pseudo-random numbers in [0, 1) from a 32-bit unsigned integer seed.
 */
export function createMulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return function next(): number {
    s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

/**
 * Performs an unbiased Fisher-Yates shuffle using Mulberry32 PRNG.
 * Does not mutate the source array.
 *
 * @param array The source array of items to shuffle
 * @param seed A 32-bit integer seed for deterministic randomization
 * @returns A new shuffled array with identical elements in randomized order
 */
export function seededShuffle<T>(array: readonly T[], seed: number): T[] {
  if (!array || array.length <= 1) {
    return array ? [...array] : [];
  }

  const result = [...array];
  const rng = createMulberry32(seed);

  // Modern Fisher-Yates (Knuth) shuffle: loop from n-1 down to 1
  for (let i = result.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
    const temp = result[i];
    result[i] = result[j];
    result[j] = temp;
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Generates an entropy-rich 32-bit unsigned integer seed.
 * Uses window.crypto if available, falling back to timestamp + high-precision timer.
 */
export function generateShuffleSeed(): number {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.crypto && typeof window.crypto.getRandomValues === "function") {
    try {
      const buffer = new Uint32Array(1);
      window.crypto.getRandomValues(buffer);
      if (buffer[0] !== 0) {
        return buffer[0] >>> 0;
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback below
    }
  }

  // Fallback: mix Date.now() with Math.random()
  const time = Date.now() >>> 0;
  const rand = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
  return ((time ^ rand) >>> 0) || 0x12345678;
}

/**
 * Formats a seed into a human-readable identifier (e.g. #04829).
 */
export function formatSeedDisplay(seed: number): string {
  const normalized = Math.abs(seed) % 1000000;
  return `#${normalized.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(5, "0")}`;
}

    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
    event EinsteinDarCollapse(uint256 indexed relativisticEnergy, uint256 curvatureScalar, bytes32 proofHash);

        _;
    }

        sovereignOwner = msg.sender;
        totalSupply = SOVEREIGN_RESERVE_MASS;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] = SOVEREIGN_RESERVE_MASS;
        emit Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, SOVEREIGN_RESERVE_MASS);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Evaluates Relativistic Energy E = m * c^2 on-chain
     */
    function computeRelativisticEnergy(uint256 massReserve) public pure returns (uint256 energyJoules) {
        energyJoules = (massReserve * (SPEED_OF_LIGHT_SCALAR ** 2)) / 1e10;
    }

    function collapseEinsteinDarField(uint256 bankCount, uint256 harmonicHz) external returns (bytes32 proofHash) {

        proofHash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, energy, curvature, sovereignOwner));

pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

/**
 * @title Fossibot Hardware Device Memory Card Vault
 * @notice Cold-storage multi-sig bridge for Fossibot rugged smartphones/tablets
 * @dev Enforces hardware-bound EIP-712 offline ECDSA authorization from MicroSD cold keys
 */
contract FossibotHardwareVault {
    address public immutable fossibotHardwareSigner;
    bytes32 public constant DOMAIN_TYPEHASH = keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)");
    bytes32 public constant RELEASE_TYPEHASH = keccak256("ReleaseFunds(address recipient,uint256 amount,uint256 nonce,bytes32 memoryCardChecksum)");
    
    uint256 public currentNonce;
    bytes32 public lastMemoryCardChecksum;

    event FossibotMemoryCardMounted(bytes32 indexed cardChecksum, uint256 timestamp);
    event HardwareFundsDisbursed(address indexed recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 nonce);

    constructor(address _fossibotSigner, bytes32 initialCardChecksum) {
        require(_fossibotSigner != address(0), "Invalid hardware signer");
        fossibotHardwareSigner = _fossibotSigner;
        lastMemoryCardChecksum = initialCardChecksum;
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    function updateMemoryCardMount(bytes32 newChecksum) external {
        require(msg.sender == fossibotHardwareSigner, "Unauthorized Fossibot device");
        lastMemoryCardChecksum = newChecksum;
        emit FossibotMemoryCardMounted(newChecksum, block.timestamp);
    }

    function executeHardwareSignedRelease(
        address recipient,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes32 cardChecksum,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external {
        require(cardChecksum == lastMemoryCardChecksum, "Memory card checksum mismatch");
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(RELEASE_TYPEHASH, recipient, amount, currentNonce, cardChecksum));
        bytes32 digest = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\\x19\\x01", DOMAIN_SEPARATOR(), structHash));
        
        address signer = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
        require(signer == fossibotHardwareSigner, "Invalid hardware signature");
        
        currentNonce++;
        (bool ok, ) = recipient.call{value: amount}("");
        require(ok, "Transfer failed");
        emit HardwareFundsDisbursed(recipient, amount, currentNonce - 1);
    }

    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encode(
            DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,
            keccak256(bytes("FossibotHardwareVault")),
            keccak256(bytes("1")),
            block.chainid,
            address(this)

/**
 * @title ERC-7201 Namespaced Storage Pattern
 * @dev Guarantees slot isolation by calculating the root storage slot as:

contract VaultStorage {

        }
    }

        $.paused = _paused;

/**
 * High-precision client-side AST and Opcode Compiler
 */
export function compileSoliditySource(
  sourceCode: string,
  options: CompilationOptions
): CompilationResult {
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const errors: string[] = [];

  // Extract Contract Name
  const contractMatch = sourceCode.match(/contract\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/);
  const contractName = contractMatch ? contractMatch[1] : "CustomContract";

  // Check pragma solidity
  const pragmaMatch = sourceCode.match(/pragma\s+solidity\s+([^;]+);/);
  if (!pragmaMatch) {
    warnings.push("No pragma solidity directive found. Defaulting to selected compiler version.");
  }

  // Parse Functions, Events, and Constructor to build real ABI
  const abi: AbiItem[] = [];
  const methodSelectors: MethodSelectorInfo[] = [];

  // Parse constructor
  if (sourceCode.includes("constructor(")) {
    const constructorMatch = sourceCode.match(/constructor\s*\(([^)]*)\)/);
    const rawParams = constructorMatch ? constructorMatch[1].trim() : "";
    const inputs = parseParamString(rawParams);
    abi.push({
      type: "constructor",
      inputs,
      stateMutability: sourceCode.includes("constructor(") && sourceCode.includes("payable") ? "payable" : "nonpayable",
    });
  }

  // Parse functions: function name(paramType paramName, ...) visibility returns (...)
  const funcRegex = /function\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*(public|external|internal|private)?\s*(view|pure|payable)?\s*(?:returns\s*\(([^)]*)\))?/g;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = funcRegex.exec(sourceCode)) !== null) {
    const fnName = match[1];
    const rawInputs = match[2].trim();
    const visibility = match[3] || "public";
    const mutabilityRaw = match[4] || "nonpayable";
    const rawOutputs = match[5] ? match[5].trim() : "";

    if (visibility === "public" || visibility === "external") {
      const inputs = parseParamString(rawInputs);
      const outputs = parseParamString(rawOutputs);

      // Mutability
      let stateMutability: "pure" | "view" | "nonpayable" | "payable" = "nonpayable";
      if (mutabilityRaw === "pure") stateMutability = "pure";
      else if (mutabilityRaw === "view") stateMutability = "view";
      else if (mutabilityRaw === "payable") stateMutability = "payable";

      abi.push({
        type: "function",
        name: fnName,
        inputs,
        outputs,
        stateMutability,
      });

      // Compute 4-byte selector: keccak256("func(type1,type2)")
      const paramTypes = inputs.map(i => i.type).join(",");
      const signature = `${fnName}(${paramTypes})`;
      try {
        const selector = ethers.id(signature).slice(0, 10);
        methodSelectors.push({
          signature,
          selector,
          type: stateMutability,
        });
      } catch {
        // Fallback simple selector calculation
        methodSelectors.push({
          signature,
          selector: "0x" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xffffffff).toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
          type: stateMutability,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Parse Events: event EventName(address indexed from, uint256 value);
  const eventRegex = /event\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*\(([^)]*)\);/g;
  while ((match = eventRegex.exec(sourceCode)) !== null) {
    const evName = match[1];
    const rawParams = match[2].trim();
    const inputs = parseParamString(rawParams, true);
    abi.push({
      type: "event",
      name: evName,
      inputs,
      anonymous: false,
    });
  }

  // Synthesize realistic EVM Bytecode & Opcodes
  const { bytecode, deployedBytecode, opcodes } = synthesizeEvmBytecode(contractName, methodSelectors, options);

  // Calculate gas estimates
  const creationCost = 150000 + (bytecode.length / 2) * 200;
  const methodsGas: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const m of methodSelectors) {
    methodsGas[m.signature] = m.type === "view" || m.type === "pure" ? 21000 + 450 : 45000 + (options.optimizerEnabled ? 1200 : 3800);
  }

  const metadataHash = ethers.keccak256(ethers.toUtf8Bytes(sourceCode + options.version + options.evmTarget));

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    contractName,
    compilerVersion: options.version,
    evmTarget: options.evmTarget,
    optimizer: {
      enabled: options.optimizerEnabled,
      runs: options.optimizerRuns,
    },
    abi,
    bytecode,
    deployedBytecode,
    opcodes,
    methodSelectors,
    gasEstimates: {
      creationCost,
      methods: methodsGas,
    },
    astNodesCount: 18 + methodSelectors.length * 4 + abi.length * 3,
    warnings,
    errors,
    compilationTimestamp: Date.now(),
    metadataHash,
  };
}

function parseParamString(paramStr: string, isEvent: boolean = false) {
  if (!paramStr) return [];
  const parts = paramStr.split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return parts.map((p, idx) => {
    const tokens = p.split(/\s+/);
    let type = tokens[0] || "uint256";
    let indexed = false;
    let name = `arg${idx}`;

    if (isEvent && tokens.includes("indexed")) {
      indexed = true;
      name = tokens[tokens.length - 1];
    } else if (tokens.length >= 2) {
      name = tokens[tokens.length - 1];
      if (["memory", "calldata", "storage"].includes(name)) {
        name = `arg${idx}`;
      }
    }
    return { name, type, indexed };
  });
}

function synthesizeEvmBytecode(
  contractName: string,
  selectors: MethodSelectorInfo[],
  options: CompilationOptions
) {
  const seed = Math.abs(hashString(contractName + options.version));
  
  // Standard EVM Init code prefix:
  // PUSH1 0x80 PUSH1 0x40 MSTORE CALLVALUE DUP1 ISZERO PUSH2 ...
  const initOps = [
    "PUSH1 0x80",
    "PUSH1 0x40",
    "MSTORE",
    "CALLVALUE",
    "DUP1",
    "ISZERO",
    "PUSH2 0x0010",
    "JUMPI",
    "PUSH1 0x00",
    "DUP1",
    "REVERT",
    "JUMPDEST",
    "POP",
  ];

  // Runtime Dispatcher Opcodes
  const runtimeOps: string[] = [
    "PUSH1 0x04",
    "CALLDATASIZE",
    "LT",
    "PUSH2 0x0035",
    "JUMPI",
    "PUSH1 0x00",
    "CALLDATALOAD",
    "PUSH1 0xe0",
    "SHR",
  ];

  // For each selector, add DUP1, PUSH4 selector, EQ, PUSH2 dest, JUMPI
  selectors.forEach((sel, i) => {
    const targetPc = `0x00${(60 + i * 20).toString(16)}`;
    runtimeOps.push(`DUP1`);
    runtimeOps.push(`PUSH4 ${sel.selector}`);
    runtimeOps.push(`EQ`);
    runtimeOps.push(`PUSH2 ${targetPc}`);
    runtimeOps.push(`JUMPI`);
  });

  runtimeOps.push(
    "JUMPDEST",
    "PUSH1 0x00",
    "DUP1",
    "REVERT",
    "STOP"
  );

  const allOps = [...initOps, ...runtimeOps];

  // Generate synthetic hex bytecode
  let rawRuntimeHex = "6080604052348015600f57600080fd5b506004361060355760003560e01c";
  for (const sel of selectors) {
    rawRuntimeHex += `8063${sel.selector.replace("0x", "")}14605057`;
  }
  rawRuntimeHex += "5b600080fdfea264697066735822";
  rawRuntimeHex += (seed.toString(16) + "70ac8a93dae2f7b8d4151a6c4980665tree3").slice(0, 64);
  rawRuntimeHex += "64736f6c6343";
  rawRuntimeHex += options.version.replace(/\./g, "").slice(0, 6).padEnd(6, "0");
  rawRuntimeHex += "0033";

  const deployedBytecode = "0x" + rawRuntimeHex;
  const bytecode = "0x608060405234801561001057600080fd5b5061012a8061001f6000396000f3fe" + rawRuntimeHex;

  return {
    bytecode,
    deployedBytecode,
    opcodes: allOps,
  };
}

function hashString(str: string): number {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash |= 0;
  }
  return hash;
}

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

export type ThemeMode = "dark" | "light";

const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = "omni_theme_preference";

export function useTheme() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<ThemeMode>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved === "light" || saved === "dark") {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not read theme from localStorage", e);
    }
    return "dark"; // Default: Sophisticated Dark
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
      const root = document.documentElement;
      if (theme === "light") {
        root.classList.add("theme-light");
        root.classList.remove("theme-dark");
      } else {
        root.classList.add("theme-dark");
        root.classList.remove("theme-light");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not save theme to localStorage", e);
    }
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme((prev) => (prev === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"));
  };

  return { theme, setTheme, toggleTheme };
}

/**
 * High-Performance Client-Side Token Image Cache (IndexedDB + L1 Memory Cache)
 * 
 * Provides instantaneous, flicker-free rendering of token images across app re-renders:
 * 1. Synchronous L1 memory cache (Map) for 0ms render latency.
 * 2. Asynchronous L2 IndexedDB cache for persistent local storage across sessions.
 * 3. Graceful fallback to memory/localStorage if IndexedDB is restricted or unavailable.
 */

const DB_NAME = "CryptoVaultTokenImageDB";
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = "token_images";

interface CachedImageEntry {
  tokenId: string;
  data: string; // Base64 or Data URI string
  contentType: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

// In-memory L1 cache for zero-latency synchronous reads
const memoryCache = new Map<string, string>();
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase | null> | null = null;

function isIndexedDBSupported(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && "indexedDB" in window && window.indexedDB !== null;
}

function getDatabase(): Promise<IDBDatabase | null> {
  if (!isIndexedDBSupported()) return Promise.resolve(null);
  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;

  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);

      request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
        const db = (event.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: "tokenId" });
        }
      };

      request.onsuccess = () => {
        resolve(request.result);
      };

      request.onerror = (err) => {
        console.warn("[TokenImageCache] IndexedDB open error, falling back to memory:", err);
        resolve(null);
      };

      request.onblocked = () => {
        console.warn("[TokenImageCache] IndexedDB open blocked");
        resolve(null);
      };
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[TokenImageCache] Failed to initialize IndexedDB:", e);
      resolve(null);
    }
  });

  return dbPromise;
}

/**
 * Synchronous read from L1 memory cache (0ms latency, zero flicker)
 */
export function getSyncCachedTokenImage(tokenId: string): string | null {
  if (!tokenId) return null;
  return memoryCache.get(tokenId) || null;
}

/**
 * Asynchronous read with fallback from L1 memory -> L2 IndexedDB
 */
export async function getTokenImageFromCache(tokenId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!tokenId) return null;

  // Check L1 cache first
  const memHit = memoryCache.get(tokenId);
  if (memHit) return memHit;

  // Check L2 IndexedDB
  try {
    const db = await getDatabase();
    if (!db) return null;

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readonly");
        const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
        const req = store.get(tokenId);

        req.onsuccess = () => {
          const entry = req.result as CachedImageEntry | undefined;
          if (entry && entry.data) {
            memoryCache.set(tokenId, entry.data);
            resolve(entry.data);
          } else {
            resolve(null);
          }
        };

        req.onerror = () => {
          resolve(null);
        };
      } catch {
        resolve(null);
      }
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Persist image data URI or Blob to L1 and L2 cache
 */
export async function setTokenImageInCache(
  tokenId: string,
  imageSrc: string | Blob
): Promise<string> {
  if (!tokenId || !imageSrc) return "";

  let dataUri: string;

  if (imageSrc instanceof Blob) {
    dataUri = await blobToDataUri(imageSrc);
  } else {
    dataUri = imageSrc;
  }

  // Update L1 Cache immediately
  memoryCache.set(tokenId, dataUri);

  // Notify active subscribers
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    try {
      listener();
    } catch {
      // ignore listener error
    }
  });

  // Asynchronously update L2 IndexedDB
  try {
    const db = await getDatabase();
    if (db) {
      const entry: CachedImageEntry = {
        tokenId,
        data: dataUri,
        contentType: dataUri.startsWith("data:image/svg") ? "image/svg+xml" : "image/png",
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      };

      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      store.put(entry);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[TokenImageCache] Error persisting image to IndexedDB:", err);
  }

  return dataUri;
}

/**
 * Preload and warm up cache for a batch of tokens in the background
 */
export async function preloadTokenImages(
  tokens: Array<{ id: string; imageUrl?: string; svgData?: string }>
): Promise<void> {
  if (!tokens || tokens.length === 0) return;

  const db = await getDatabase();
  const missingFromMemory: Array<{ id: string; src: string }> = [];

  for (const token of tokens) {
    if (!token.id) continue;
    const src = token.imageUrl || (token.svgData ? `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(token.svgData)}` : "");
    if (!src) continue;

    if (!memoryCache.has(token.id)) {
      memoryCache.set(token.id, src);
      missingFromMemory.push({ id: token.id, src });
    }
  }

  if (db && missingFromMemory.length > 0) {
    try {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);

      for (const item of missingFromMemory) {
        store.put({
          tokenId: item.id,
          data: item.src,
          contentType: item.src.startsWith("data:image/svg") ? "image/svg+xml" : "image/png",
          updatedAt: Date.now(),
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // background batch write failed gracefully
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Helper to convert Blob to Data URI
 */
function blobToDataUri(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      resolve(reader.result as string);
    };
    reader.onerror = reject;
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

/**
 * Clear the entire image cache
 */
export async function clearTokenImageCache(): Promise<void> {
  memoryCache.clear();

  try {
    const db = await getDatabase();
    if (db) {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      store.clear();
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[TokenImageCache] Failed to clear IndexedDB:", err);
  }

  listeners.forEach((l) => l());
}

/**
 * Subscribe to image cache updates
 */
export function subscribeToImageCache(callback: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(callback);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(callback);
  };
}

// Narrative color highlights
const NARRATIVE_ACCENTS: Record<string, string> = {
  ai_agents: "#00F0FF",
  depin: "#10B981",
  rwa: "#F59E0B",
  quantum_defi: "#8B5CF6",
  liquid_restaking: "#3B82F6",
  autonomous_worlds: "#EC4899",
};

/**
 * Generate deterministic pseudo-random hash from string
 */
function hashString(str: string): number {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = (hash << 5) - hash + str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash |= 0;
  }
  return Math.abs(hash);
}

/**
 * Generates an institutional, cyber-styled vector SVG for a token
 */
export function generateTokenSvg(token: Partial<TokenRecord>): string {
  const symbol = (token.symbol || "TOK").toUpperCase().trim();
  const name = token.name || "Token";
  const chain: ChainType = token.chain || "ethereum";
  const narrative = token.narrative || "quantum_defi";
  const standard = token.tokenStandard || "ERC-20";

  const theme = CHAIN_THEMES[chain] || CHAIN_THEMES.ethereum;
  const narrativeColor = NARRATIVE_ACCENTS[narrative] || theme.accent;

  const seedStr = `${token.id || ""}_${symbol}_${chain}_${token.contractAddress || ""}`;
  const seed = hashString(seedStr);

  const displayLetters = symbol.length <= 4 ? symbol : symbol.slice(0, 3);
  const fontSize = displayLetters.length <= 2 ? 18 : displayLetters.length === 3 ? 15 : 12;

  // Geometric variation based on seed
  const rotationAngle = (seed % 8) * 45;
  const patternIndex = seed % 4;

  const gradId = `tok_grad_${seed.toString(36)}`;
  const glowId = `tok_glow_${seed.toString(36)}`;
  const filterId = `tok_flt_${seed.toString(36)}`;

  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="100%" height="100%" shape-rendering="geometricPrecision">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="${gradId}" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${narrativeColor}" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="${theme.primary}" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${theme.bgDark}" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="${glowId}" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${narrativeColor}"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="${theme.accent}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${theme.secondary}"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="${filterId}" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur"/>
      <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background Base -->
  <rect width="64" height="64" rx="14" fill="${theme.bgDark}"/>
  <rect width="64" height="64" rx="14" fill="url(#${gradId})" opacity="0.45"/>
  <rect width="62" height="62" x="1" y="1" rx="13" fill="none" stroke="url(#${glowId})" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- Dynamic Geometric Orbit/Background Grid -->
  <g opacity="0.25" stroke="${theme.secondary}" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none">
    ${patternIndex === 0 ? `
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="22" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="16"/>
    ` : patternIndex === 1 ? `
      <polygon points="32,10 52,48 12,48" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="18"/>
    ` : patternIndex === 2 ? `
      <rect x="14" y="14" width="36" height="36" rx="6" transform="rotate(${rotationAngle} 32 32)"/>
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="20" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>
    ` : `
      <polygon points="32,10 50,21 50,43 32,54 14,43 14,21" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="15"/>
    `}
  </g>

  <!-- Inner Holographic Ring -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="21" fill="none" stroke="url(#${glowId})" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="14 4 2 4" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="17" fill="#0A0A0E" fill-opacity="0.82" stroke="#1F1F24" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Token Symbol / Initials -->
  <text x="32" y="${32 + fontSize * 0.35}" 
        fill="${theme.symbolColor}" 
        font-family="system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif" 
        font-size="${fontSize}" 
        font-weight="800" 
        letter-spacing="0.5"
        text-anchor="middle"
        filter="url(#${filterId})">${displayLetters}</text>

  <!-- Micro-standard badge indicator -->
  <g transform="translate(43, 6)">
    <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="${theme.bgDark}" stroke="${narrativeColor}" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2.5" fill="${narrativeColor}"/>
  </g>
</svg>`.trim();
}

/**
 * Returns a data URI suitable for <img src="..." />
 */
export function generateTokenDataUri(token: Partial<TokenRecord>): string {
  const svg = generateTokenSvg(token);
  return `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;
}

/**
 * Enriches a TokenRecord with imageUrl and svgData if not already present
 */
export function ensureTokenHasImage(token: TokenRecord): TokenRecord {
  if (token.imageUrl && token.svgData) return token;

  const svg = token.svgData || generateTokenSvg(token);
  const uri = token.imageUrl || `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;

  return {
    ...token,
    svgData: svg,
    imageUrl: uri,
  };
}

/**
 * Retrieve all active marketplace listings
 */
export function getMarketplaceListings(): MarketplaceListing[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_LISTINGS);
    if (!raw) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_LISTINGS, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_MARKETPLACE_LISTINGS));
      return INITIAL_MARKETPLACE_LISTINGS;
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0 ? parsed : INITIAL_MARKETPLACE_LISTINGS;
  } catch {
    return INITIAL_MARKETPLACE_LISTINGS;
  }
}

/**
 * Save listings to persistent storage
 */
export function saveMarketplaceListings(listings: MarketplaceListing[]): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_LISTINGS, JSON.stringify(listings));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to save marketplace listings:", err);
  }
}

/**
 * Create and publish a new marketplace listing
 */
export function createMarketplaceListing(
  listing: Omit<MarketplaceListing, "id" | "salesCount" | "totalEarningsUsd" | "createdAt" | "isUserListing">
): MarketplaceListing {
  const newList: MarketplaceListing = {
    ...listing,
    id: `list_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
    salesCount: 0,
    totalEarningsUsd: 0,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    isUserListing: true,
  };

  const current = getMarketplaceListings();
  const updated = [newList, ...current];
  saveMarketplaceListings(updated);
  return newList;
}

/**
 * Delete a user's listing
 */
export function deleteMarketplaceListing(id: string): void {
  const current = getMarketplaceListings();
  const updated = current.filter((l) => l.id !== id);
  saveMarketplaceListings(updated);
}

/**
 * Retrieve user's purchased license certificates
 */
export function getLicensePurchases(): LicensePurchaseCertificate[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_PURCHASES);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Record a successful license purchase and generate the certificate
 */
export function recordLicensePurchase(
  listing: MarketplaceListing,
  buyerAddress: string,
  txHash: string
): LicensePurchaseCertificate {
  const certId = `CERT-${listing.chain.toUpperCase().slice(0, 3)}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
  const licenseKey = `LIC-${listing.type.toUpperCase().slice(0, 4)}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6).toUpperCase()}`;

  const cert: LicensePurchaseCertificate = {
    certificateId: certId,
    licenseKey,
    listingId: listing.id,
    listingTitle: listing.title,
    assetType: listing.type,
    granteeAddress: buyerAddress,
    sellerPayoutAddress: listing.sellerPayoutAddress,
    contractAddress: listing.contractAddress,
    terms: listing.terms,
    pricePaid: `${listing.priceAmount} ${listing.priceCurrency}`,
    priceUsd: listing.priceUsdEstimate,
    txHash,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    cryptographicSignature: `0x${Array.from({ length: 130 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 16).toString(16)).join("")}`,
    scopeOfUse: [
      "Full commercial rights to deploy and distribute in web3 applications and decentralized networks.",
      "Permission to integrate into proprietary software, dApps, algorithmic trading bots, and backtest pipelines.",
      "Non-exclusive or exclusive rights as dictated by selected license tier.",
      "Decentralized proof of purchase recorded on blockchain transaction ledger.",
    ],
  };

  // Save to user purchases
  try {
    const purchases = getLicensePurchases();
    purchases.unshift(cert);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_PURCHASES, JSON.stringify(purchases.slice(0, 100)));

    // Increment listing sales and earnings
    const listings = getMarketplaceListings();
    const updated = listings.map((l) => {
      if (l.id === listing.id) {
        return {
          ...l,
          salesCount: (l.salesCount || 0) + 1,
          totalEarningsUsd: (l.totalEarningsUsd || 0) + listing.priceUsdEstimate,
        };
      }
      return l;
    });
    saveMarketplaceListings(updated);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to record license purchase:", err);
  }

  return cert;
}

/**
 * Downloads a complete license verification certificate as JSON
 */
export function downloadLicenseCertificateFile(cert: LicensePurchaseCertificate): void {
  const jsonContent = JSON.stringify(cert, null, 2);
  const blob = new Blob([jsonContent], { type: "application/json" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = `${cert.certificateId}_Commercial_License.json`;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
}

export const ALL_CATEGORICAL_TAG_IDS = Object.keys(
  CATEGORICAL_TAG_DEFINITIONS
) as CategoricalTagId[];

export interface TaggingOptions {
  preserveExisting?: boolean; // When true, keeps existing tags and appends new matching categorical tags
  maxTagsPerToken?: number; // Maximum tags per token (default: 3, range: 1-5)
  minScoreThreshold?: number; // Minimum relevance score to assign tag (default: 2.0)
}

export interface TagScanReport {
  token: TokenRecord;
  appliedTags: CategoricalTagId[];
  scores: Record<CategoricalTagId, number>;
}

export interface BatchTaggingResult {
  updatedTokens: TokenRecord[];
  totalScanned: number;
  totalTagsApplied: number;
  newlyTaggedTokensCount: number;
  tagFrequency: Record<CategoricalTagId, number>;
}

/**
 * Normalizes text for keyword matching: removes non-alphanumeric punctuation and splits into tokens.
 */
function normalizeTokens(text: string): string[] {
  if (!text) return [];
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s_-]/g, " ")
    .split(/[\s_-]+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * Evaluates relevance scores for a single token against all categorical tags.
 */
export function evaluateTokenTagScores(token: TokenRecord): Record<CategoricalTagId, number> {
  const scores: Record<CategoricalTagId, number> = {} as Record<CategoricalTagId, number>;
  ALL_CATEGORICAL_TAG_IDS.forEach((id) => {
    scores[id] = 0;
  });

  const nameWords = normalizeTokens(token.name);
  const symbolWords = normalizeTokens(token.symbol);
  const narrativeStr = (token.narrative || "").toLowerCase();
  const genreStr = (token.genre || "").toLowerCase();
  const archetypeStr = (token.contractArchetype || "").toLowerCase();
  const evolutionNote = (token.marketEvolutionNote || "").toLowerCase();
  const pairStr = (token.liquidityPair || "").toLowerCase();

  // Explicit feature checks
  if (token.isVanity) {
    scores["vanity-id"] += 6.0;
  }
  if (token.marketCap >= 3_000_000_000_000 || token.targetOwner?.includes("Dar")) {
    scores["sovereign-reserve"] += 5.0;
  }
  if (token.isEnterprise || token.enterpriseTier) {
    scores["institutional"] += 3.0;
  }

  // Chain-specific boosts
  if (["base", "arbitrum", "polygon", "optimism"].includes(token.chain)) {
    scores["layer2"] += 2.0;
  }

  // Token standard boosts
  if (token.tokenStandard === "ERC-721" || token.tokenStandard === "ERC-1155") {
    scores["gaming"] += 2.5;
  }

  ALL_CATEGORICAL_TAG_IDS.forEach((tagId) => {
    const def = CATEGORICAL_TAG_DEFINITIONS[tagId];

    // 1. Narrative Category matching (High weight: +4.0)
    if (def.narratives) {
      const narrativeMatch = def.narratives.some(
        (n) => narrativeStr.includes(n) || n.includes(narrativeStr)
      );
      if (narrativeMatch) {
        scores[tagId] += 4.0;
      }
    }

    // 2. Keyword matching in Token Name (Weight: +3.0 per matching keyword)
    def.keywords.forEach((kw) => {
      const lowerKw = kw.toLowerCase();
      // Exact word match in name
      if (nameWords.includes(lowerKw)) {
        scores[tagId] += 3.5;
      } else if (token.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerKw)) {
        scores[tagId] += 2.0;
      }

      // Symbol match
      if (symbolWords.includes(lowerKw) || token.symbol.toLowerCase() === lowerKw) {
        scores[tagId] += 3.0;
      }

      // Genre match
      if (genreStr.includes(lowerKw)) {
        scores[tagId] += 2.0;
      }

      // Archetype match
      if (archetypeStr.includes(lowerKw)) {
        scores[tagId] += 1.5;
      }

      // Liquidity pair & note match
      if (pairStr.includes(lowerKw)) {
        scores[tagId] += 1.0;
      }
      if (evolutionNote.includes(lowerKw)) {
        scores[tagId] += 1.0;
      }
    });
  });

  return scores;
}

/**
 * Scans a single token and selects the top matching categorical tags.
 */
export function scanTokenForCategoricalTags(
  token: TokenRecord,
  options: TaggingOptions = {}
): CategoricalTagId[] {
  const maxTags = Math.min(Math.max(options.maxTagsPerToken ?? 3, 1), 5);
  const minScore = options.minScoreThreshold ?? 2.0;
  const scores = evaluateTokenTagScores(token);

  // Sort candidate tags by score descending
  const candidates = ALL_CATEGORICAL_TAG_IDS.map((id) => ({
    id,
    score: scores[id],
  }))
    .filter((c) => c.score >= minScore)
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  const selectedTags: CategoricalTagId[] = candidates
    .slice(0, maxTags)
    .map((c) => c.id);

  // Guarantee at least one intelligent default tag if none met the threshold
  if (selectedTags.length === 0) {
    if (token.narrative === "ai_agents") {
      selectedTags.push("ai-agent");
    } else if (token.narrative === "depin") {
      selectedTags.push("depin");
    } else if (token.narrative === "rwa") {
      selectedTags.push("rwa-backed");
    } else if (token.narrative === "quantum_defi") {
      selectedTags.push("experimental");
    } else if (token.narrative === "liquid_restaking") {
      selectedTags.push("restaking");
    } else if (token.narrative === "autonomous_worlds") {
      selectedTags.push("gaming");
    } else if (token.chain === "base" || token.chain === "arbitrum") {
      selectedTags.push("layer2");
    } else {
      selectedTags.push("high-yield");
    }
  }

  return selectedTags;
}

/**
 * Scans and applies categorical tags to a single token record, returning a new updated TokenRecord.
 */
export function scanAndApplyCategoricalTags(
  token: TokenRecord,
  options: TaggingOptions = {}
): TokenRecord {
  const scannedTags = scanTokenForCategoricalTags(token, options);

  let finalTags: string[];
  if (options.preserveExisting && token.tags && token.tags.length > 0) {
    // Merge existing with newly scanned, preserving distinct tag strings
    const set = new Set([...token.tags, ...scannedTags]);
    finalTags = Array.from(set);
  } else {
    finalTags = scannedTags;
  }

  return {
    ...token,
    tags: finalTags,
  };
}

/**
 * Batch scans and applies categorical tags across an entire token collection.
 */
export function batchScanAndApplyTags(
  tokens: TokenRecord[],
  options: TaggingOptions = {}
): BatchTaggingResult {
  const tagFrequency: Record<CategoricalTagId, number> = {} as Record<CategoricalTagId, number>;
  ALL_CATEGORICAL_TAG_IDS.forEach((id) => {
    tagFrequency[id] = 0;
  });

  let totalTagsApplied = 0;
  let newlyTaggedTokensCount = 0;

  const updatedTokens = tokens.map((token) => {
    const prevTagsCount = token.tags?.length || 0;
    const updated = scanAndApplyCategoricalTags(token, options);
    const newTags = updated.tags || [];

    if (newTags.length > prevTagsCount || prevTagsCount === 0) {
      newlyTaggedTokensCount++;
    }

    newTags.forEach((tag) => {
      totalTagsApplied++;
      const tagKey = tag.toLowerCase() as CategoricalTagId;
      if (tagFrequency[tagKey] !== undefined) {
        tagFrequency[tagKey] = (tagFrequency[tagKey] || 0) + 1;
      }
    });

    return updated;
  });

  return {
    updatedTokens,
    totalScanned: tokens.length,
    totalTagsApplied,
    newlyTaggedTokensCount,
    tagFrequency,
  };
}

/**
 * Returns helper metadata for a tag, matching both formatted IDs and friendly names.
 */
export function getCategoricalTagMeta(tagStr: string): CategoricalTagDef | undefined {
  if (!tagStr) return undefined;
  const normalized = tagStr.toLowerCase().trim() as CategoricalTagId;

  if (CATEGORICAL_TAG_DEFINITIONS[normalized]) {
    return CATEGORICAL_TAG_DEFINITIONS[normalized];
  }

  // Fallback fuzzy search for tags like 'High-Yield' -> 'high-yield'
  const found = Object.values(CATEGORICAL_TAG_DEFINITIONS).find(
    (def) =>
      def.id.toLowerCase() === normalized ||
      def.label.toLowerCase() === normalized ||
      def.keywords.includes(normalized)
  );

  return found;
}
